{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：星學大成三十卷，明萬民英撰。民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"英字育吾，大寧都司人。嘉靖庚戍進士，厯官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"河南道監察御史，出為福建布政司右參議。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"是編取舊時星學家言，以次編排，間加註釋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"論斷。其一曰星曜圖例；其二曰觀星節要、宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452945845321791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"度主用、十二位論，其三曰諸家限例、琴堂虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"實，其四曰耶律秘訣；其五至七曰仙城望斗、三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"辰通載，其八曰總龜紫府珍藏、星經雜著，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"其九曰碧玉真經、鄧史喬拗，其十曰光矞淵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"微、星曜格局。其於星家古法，纎鉅不遺，可稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"大備。自來言術數者，惟章世純所云：其法有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"驗有不驗。騐者，人之智計所及；不騐者，天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"㣲妙斯存。其言最為𠃔當。而術家必欲事事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452945845305407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"皆騐，故多出其途以測之，途愈多而愈不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"中。其尤難信者，無過於喬廟一説。其説以火、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"土二星相反而相成，晝火參、軫及箕、壁無咎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"乃大告；夜土角、斗及井、奎降福亦如之。不知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之理，惟主生尅，如季土坐於凋零之木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"本自借其疏通；旺火臨於瀺灂之流，亦轉樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"其滋益。若乃冬火坐水鄉，春土居木位，豈可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"目為喬廟而定其吉乎？且土雖盛而木已被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452956498673702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"其沈埋，火即熾而水己虞其枯涸，有利於此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"即不利於彼。是皆好竒求騐，而不計五行生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"尅之故者。民英於此𩔖大抵沿襲舊聞，未能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"駁正其謬。且今之五星躔度嵗差，既異於古，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"亦難必其盡合。然其鳩集衆説，多術家不傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"之本，實為五星之大全，與子平之三命通㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"並行不悖。後來言果老術者，參互考證，要必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"於是取資焉。明史藝文志及黄虞稷千頃堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452766945755171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"書目皆以此書為陸位撰，而别出萬民英三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"命會通十二卷。今檢此本卷首自序及凡例，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"確為民英所撰，藝文志葢沿黄氏之誤，故仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"以民英之名著録焉。乾隆四十六年五月恭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"校上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者聖人明於天之道，而察於民之故，爰命司天，首創","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"璣衡，以齊七政，而厯法始具。其大要不外欽若昊天，敬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"授人時而巳。其流為推歩占候，至禆竈、甘、唐、臯、石輩相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"接踵，候星氣，察禨祥，以修人事，而禄命之説，未之聞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"惟唐初吕博士一敘，言始及之，則又深疑而不敢信。五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"季、宋、元，其説寖盛，縉紳學士往往信以為然。故蘇子瞻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"有退之命在尾箕，余命亦在磨蝎之語。夫以天象之高，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452956498722854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"天道之幽逺，一星辰變異，皆足以兆妖祥而基理亂。近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"則歲月，逺至數十年外，無有不騐。况人禀天地五行之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"氣以生，其初誕之時，羣曜變於上而會逢其適，人事協","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"於下而感與天通，亦理數自然之符也。且如宋德隆盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"五星聚奎，諸賢輩出，而文章世道遂為丕變。星家之説，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"不亦有明徴哉？葢嘗論之，天之化也，運諸氣而貞夫理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"氣有純駁，而理則無二。命也者，合理與氣言之也。孔子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"作春秋，紀災異而事應不書，天道命不言，雖言不著，葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854795537334299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"皆欲人以理御氣，居易以俟命而巳。余非知天者，然星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"命之説亦留心考究，頗得要領旨趣。病世之專門者不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"達天人之故，妄言禍福以惑世人，乃取三辰通載、五星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"總龜、望斗殿駕、耶律喬抝虚實等書，及家所藏不傳之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"秘，刪其繁複，訂其訛繆，或已有所見而古人未發，或舊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"有所解而今則非是，分别次第，考究註釋，纂為全書，共","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"若干卷，名曰星學大成，以廣厥傳，以助我聖天子欽天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"授時之政，是則余之志也。或者謂是書之行，將使君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854795537350683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"恃命而怠於為善，小人恃命而敢於肆惡，母乃不可歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！易以道隂陽，是卜筮之書也。聖人作之，以教人趨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"吉避凶，而一言以蔽之曰：天下之動，貞夫一者也。若曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"吉者吾趨之，非趨夫吉，趨夫所以獲吉之理，視履考祥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"之𩔖是也；凶者吾避之，非避夫凶，避夫所以致凶之故，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"復即命渝安貞之𩔖是也。由是則吉，而非求也；由是則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，而有所不避也。六十四卦，三百八十四爻，無非此理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"葢聖人幽贊神明，開物成務之精意。余之心亦若是也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854795537367067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"而胡不可哉？是書之行，使知命之士觀之，遇富貴則曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"命也，吾不可以倖致。遇貧賤，則曰：命也，吾不可以茍免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"行法以俟，夭壽不貳，將齊得喪，一死生，其為教不既多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？若恃命之將通而㝠行徑趨，見命之將否而徼倖茍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"免，是則桎梏而死，立乎巖墻之下者，雖聖賢亦末如之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"何矣。豈予之所知哉！豈予之所知哉！是為序。嘉靖肆拾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"貳年歲次癸亥十月朔日，易水萬民英謹序。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"星命之説，頭緒多端，如推論星曜，有廟樂垣殿、遲留伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"逆、變不變之不同；取用神煞，有天干地支、吉凶善惡、用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"不用之互異。遡流窮源，顧名思義，莫不有一定之理存","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。看星者不先明諸星曜神煞所以然之理，而欲通貫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"諸經，斷人命吉凶禍福，是猶瞽者舍其杖而問途，將貿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"貿焉莫知所之矣。今觀星家諸書，不能兼綜條貫，明示","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"後人，或露其易而隱其微，或傳其名而昧其實，或載其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452766769512485"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"一而遺其二，識者病焉。余取臺厯諸星圖、神煞及諸家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"之所散見，凡有關於是者，推求理之所以然，總定為凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"例三卷。上卷定吉凶雜曜，中卷定觀星節要，下卷論位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"次強弱。諸家限例，間多附以巳意，别為或問。雖未能盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"天地古今星煞象數之精，其於歴代觀星三命之法，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾根極而有要云。易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"約太陽行度法歌我朝立法多在虚一度，立春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"立春虚四度，雨水危十求。驚蟄室九度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"春分壁六遊。清明奎十一，　榖雨婁九留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"立夏胃十一，　小滿昴十收。芒種畢十四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652208164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至井一頭。　小暑井十八，　大暑井初秋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"立秋柳十二，　處暑張十週。　白露翼五度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分排軫遊。寒露軫十八，　霜降角十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬氐五度，　小雪房五時。　大雪尾火九，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至箕六依。　小寒斗十三，　大寒牛五遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"約太隂行度法歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"十八正相室，　三五居東壁。　十七半奎闌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"十三婁不覓。　胃言十四半，　十一昴全算。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452944402563124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"二八畢躔加，　半觜河邊燦。參九在其方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"三十遇井郎，　一増雙是鬼。　二七柳花芳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"七星夜還走。　張、翼各十九，　軫宿十八半，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"十三角當首。　亢九日光輝，　十六氐相宜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"房、心各五度。　十七尾南飛。箕輝照十方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四斗郎。牽牛七夕過，　十一半女娘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"虚星無十度，危星十六當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957303323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":1199,"lineType":2,"content":"十干𠮓曜所以然之理，無可稽考，余故作此圖以𤼵明之。甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、已、庚、辛、壬、癸，專配火、孛、木、金、土、月、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":1201,"lineType":2,"content":"水炁、計、羅，而太陽不與者，葢十曜皆由陽君所授，分配十干而化為䘵，一定之序也。以下凡化福者，皆其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":1203,"lineType":2,"content":"食神。化蔭者，皆其偏財；化貴者，皆其六合。化刑者，皆其七煞；化囚者，皆其梟印。化暗者，五陽干皆是陽刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":1205,"lineType":2,"content":"五隂干皆是傷官。化耗者，五陽干皆是傷官，五隂干皆是正財。化印者，五陽干皆是正官，五隂干皆是正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"印。化權者，五陽干皆是正印，五隂干皆是比肩。夫傷官、陽刃俱為之耗，正官、正印俱為之印，此理固然。而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"五隂干以正財為耗，以比肩為權，何也？葢五隂柔順，能濟五行之剛，而不能尅五行之剛，今見所尅，用力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":1211,"lineType":2,"content":"有損，故謂之耗。五隂雖有印綬相生，隂柔不能主事，故賴陽干比助，而後有力，故謂之權。此天地自然之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":1213,"lineType":2,"content":"道，隂陽不易之理也，豈易知哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452960730988585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":1217,"lineType":9,"content":"十干變曜所屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"凡當年之變為天元禄者，即其星之管官禄也；變為暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"者，屬相貌；變為福者，屬財帛福德遷移；變為耗者，屬兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"弟；變為䕃者，屬妻妾；變為貴者，屬男女；變為刑者，屬奴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"僕；變為䕃者，屬田宅；變為囚者，屬疾厄；變為權者，屬命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，此又變曜之所屬也，故名為管庫星云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":1229,"lineType":9,"content":"論天元禄主星與官禄並詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"凡祿主星，一宜在七強宫，二喜照命，三要順行，四要廟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992649461800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，五要在當生年納音長生臨官帝旺宫，以上並得用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"主大富貴。如在五弱宫，或入四煞位，更行留逆，故為福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"不純，主人淹滯，雖不在五弱，臨在七強，亦初中年不得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"發福矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：禄主當生入命宫，　田財旺氣大亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"官星更在高強位，　年少聲名達聖聰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"凡福財星宜照福德為上，身命次之，男女宫見之為上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965134893110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，緣此宫與福德相對，故為上。喜在廟旺兼行順段為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"福，如在陷弱宫及伏逆留段，為福淺，更宜消詳身命根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"本，方可以輕重斷之。大凡在財帛，在七強與身命主同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，主大富。或有惡星同宫，更行留逆，主人一生財帛成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"敗聚散不常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：身宫及命福星臨，　廟旺高強享福深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇陷宫并惡曜，榮華消鑠禍難禁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":1267,"lineType":9,"content":"天印星與田宅並詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965008883727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"此星喜居田宅宫，及七強入廟生旺之地，主多業產。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"留逆無氣，更在閒極陷地，俱不得祖業，主多破敗。田宅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"宫别有吉星臨照，亦自能成立。如田宅地更是忌星相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"犯，加以命弱失陷，一生並無田宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：生來須有皇恩命，官禄高強位䕃星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇科名科甲貴，　因兹食祿播王庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"此星同男女之象，居七強順行樂廟旺宫，及當生年貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452960663715891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"人，馬上更無惡曜刑尅，主生貴子。如在遷移奴僕兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，主過房。或在七強被惡曜刑破，多主傷尅。或四煞得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"用，多男無女。男女宫星弱，主子不得力。男女宫星強，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"一子力，二者強，子孫衆多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"此星妻宫星喜入生旺得妻財，入死絶主多病，順行則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957336091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，逆行則凶，七強宫見之相宜，五弱宫不利。妻星居遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"移主外婚，在奴僕不宜正婚，居四正宫主有妻財，惡星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"不犯，主夫妻偕老，或與惡星同躔妻宫，又犯空，又妻宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"主星闘，必再婚相尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：䕃星逢著有操持，須是高強廟旺時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"福祿印權并貴會，官榮極品耀天墀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"天權照命及身，若入廟順行，主得貴人扶持，更與太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652306468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄星同，必大權貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"此星怕入七強生旺，及在逆段，或照命或臨身，並不相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"宜。若是紫炁木星為囚星，然其性本善，不可便以囚忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"為嫌，但戊癸人見之減力，終不為禍。　恰齋云：囚星大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"槩不可拘泥，如汪安撫丙戌生，火星對照命宫，葛樞相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992649478184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申生，水星守命宫，二公曾未見其為囚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：天囚若在四刑星，　膿血傷殘命夭終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"若是壽星臨照著，　也須為福不為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"此星在閑極宫，無惡星相犯，奴僕皆得力，或在七強及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"得地主，僕從奸狡，更有凶惡加宫，小人無故相侵犯凌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"辱，此星宜弱不宜強，宜順不宜逆，若是命主星，又不妨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"無自刑之理故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452960663748659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：天刑若陷最為惡，身命田宅怕逢著，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"限臨必主身不全，　黥面文身方免却。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"此星耗財之星，故以兄弟當之，忌在田、財二宫，别宫無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"甚害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：天耗之星不可逢，　生來財帛化為空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨貴地并權禄，　尚自區區待限通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":1375,"lineType":9,"content":"天暗星與相貌同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652322852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"此星最忌在官宫，及官魁文星，身命逢之，皆無發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：富貴因何福不榮，　只縁命内暗傷星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"高強皆是為凶惡，　入陷孤高患自輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":1385,"lineType":9,"content":"變曜歌訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"禄暗、福、耗、䕃貴、刑、印、囚、權。　火孛、木、金、土、月、水、炁、計、羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"六吉夾四凶，每三吉夾二凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":1391,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲生人，欲推何星化貴，則念至貴是第六字，又念火孛至月是第六字，便知月化貴也。若乙生人，欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":1393,"lineType":2,"content":"推何星化福，則火不要念，只念孛起至金止，又念䘵起至福止，便知金化福也。餘依此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452956968648731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":1397,"lineType":9,"content":"七政旺宫星度歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"七政各得居強所，君看分明乘旺處。日據白羊十九間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"月入金牛第三度。土在天秤二十一，火居磨蝎四與七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"水居女上三五中，金占雙魚必當室。不離七與十三前，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"據此求之始為的。木經巨蟹初入鬼，此生所舉多如意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"但於旺處逢一星，斷然莫作常人視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":1409,"lineType":2,"content":"論七政旺宫：太陽躔婁宿八度，是戌宫十九度也。太陽躔胃宿六度，是酉宫三度。土躔亢宿六度，是辰宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":1411,"lineType":2,"content":"二十一度也。火躔斗十八度并二十一度，是丑宫四度與七度也。水躔翼八度并十度，是巳宫三度與五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452956968697883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"度也。金在室，七度并十三度，屬亥宫。木在鬼，初度并十三度，屬未宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":1417,"lineType":9,"content":"論廟旺尅忌歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰本宫為廟堂，生我之宫為樂鄉。我生之宫為旺度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"福與禍兮堪審詳。星尅其宫名入制，其星若忌號刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"本元星主居其位，貧乏之徒可較量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫度者，號樂旺廟，要與太歲相攝。若處刑尅之中，雖樂旺廟而無用。若處帝旺駕勲朝垣入局之上者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":1427,"lineType":2,"content":"更不以刑尅為忌。雖在樂旺廟，而汨没凶敗休囚衝驀之宫，亦不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":1429,"lineType":9,"content":"星辰妙度歌又為貴格辛待制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965134925878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽東出度經房，腰下須懸金印黄。玉兎始生心宿度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"桓圭衮冕侍君王。鎮星若也度躔氐，旌表門閭衣錦衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑正行心宿度，高牙大纛擁旌旗。首曜一星氐宿度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"上將封侯十萬户。尾星房宿最為佳，沙漠揚威兼宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"辰星偏好度經箕，丹桂高攀第一枝。熒惑之星躔尾宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"禹門一跳過天池。彗星寅位必躔箕，侍宸獻納古今稀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"金星若躔箕宿度，功葢諸侯披錦衣。太隂最喜度牽牛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"極品功勲世罕儔。歲星宿躔南斗㑹，論功列爵豈能酬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652339236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"火星行度經南斗，間世英雄真國寳。太白次度到牽牛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"朱紫分明應不朽。土宿若也居南斗，富貴榮華兼壽考。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙如臨南斗方，尺璧寸珠未為寳。鎮星好度女星居，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"柱石功成鎮帝都。曰宿正躔虚宿度，官居輔弼掌鈞樞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂好處最宜危，男必封侯女后妃。天尾度危偏福厚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"保安皇祚不傾危。熒惑歲星居廟室，勲臣永鎮昇平日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"水星度壁福偏濃，突出千羣推第一。熒惑當生樂廟婁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"官高職重位分茅。計曜若躔奎宿度，開邊拓土烈難侔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992649494568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"木到奎星須列爵，文章錦繡佐王侯。太陽旺度奎最便，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"閫外英聲衣錦裘。那頡廟宫星度胃，佩玉鳴珂朝紫陛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽遇昴福偏多，超羣必作人間瑞。計都又喜經躔胃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"秉鉞分符除僭偽。羅㬋若還到昴鄉，樊噲霍光真此類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星最喜躔在觜，極品官勲世罕如。木孛到參非失位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"貴持節鉞更無疑。火星觜宿福偏洪，龍躍天池氣概雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"水宿正行參宿度，貴居廊廟至三公。太隂本廟居秦鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"累世緋衣居顯位。金宿經躔於鬼度，決定為官服朱紫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992649445416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"攙搶東井福偏饒，邊塞藩垣任可倚。木星最好東井宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"官既居高福又隆。孛宿若躔於柳度，榮昌富貴福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋本廟最宜張，出將英聲閫外揚。土宿若躔於柳度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"虹蜺膽氣錦肝腸。君日周天廟在星，功齊傅説與阿衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"水曜正行星宿度，經邦論道佐昇平。太隂又喜張星度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"官入中書聲望騰。火宿最好來躔翼，佐助邦家權要職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"水星到軫是真垣，委任股肱扶玉厯。太白金星若躔亢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"輔佐當朝神聖王。木星廟度經龍角，為官必定佐岩廊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957401627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"首曜一星度龍角，六印一時都掌握。天乙來歸角亢方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"萬里台星光爍爍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":1509,"lineType":9,"content":"星曜喜宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識星辰躔廟宫，土丑羅寅火卯中。金在辰宫計在已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"水羅午地好相逢。孛星惟向未中取，紫炁申宫總一同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"日月戌方云入廟，計都木亥盡亨通。　更有諸星乘旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"方，水瓶火丑孛寅當。土羅計在卯中旺，辰位土宿再榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"昌。水日已宫金到午，木居未上紫乾揚。太隂在酉天尾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452956968665115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，金木之星亥上藏。　又㸔諸星入樂鄉，但尋宫主在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"何方。土星子丑金辰酉，未屬太隂午太陽。火星卯戌水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"巳申，木星躔到亥兼寅。羅㬋午上計都子，紫來戌上孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"逢辰。　十二宫中有喜星，日寅月亥水辰清。土居午上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"木居未，火申羅戌便昌榮。更識星辰所好局，但尋次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"舍星何屬。太隂太陽與土星，子午卯酉為垣局。木星辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"戌及丑未，水火寅申及已亥。羅計卯酉福猶奢，孛紫寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"申邦國㤗。　再識星躔廟樂儔，日躔奎宿月躔牛，水星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452960663732275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"土亢金胃上，火星木氐喜渉游，角躔羅宿婁躔計，月孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"東井南日炁。星行此地產公侯，列爵功名題史記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":1545,"lineType":9,"content":"星曜怒宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"火燒牛角水漂羊，土埋雙女命𡬶常。木打寶瓶須粉碎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"金騎人馬實恓惶。三限之星俱值此，終身貧苦走他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然落陷為灾淺，若占強宫見禍殃。或在第五并第七，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"刑妻害子細推詳。假令命在金牛宫，歲星當占寶瓶中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"第一吉星推木德，反遭鞭打性強凶。又如命在天秤安，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491702795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"便㸔巨蟹甚星辰。第一凶星推月孛，當生守占反為官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星為禍凶為福，但從宫分測根源。星居怒地最堪憂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"地產姦邪起簒謀。木怕玄枵金怕卯，戌婁遭水被漂流，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"土嫌已上無飱食，火到大梁盡焚炙。日居朔日遇羅㬋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"月在計都同望夕。日月二星最忌蝕，大抵五星皆惡逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"五星留逆最不祥，善惡五星皆少力。金星不喜躔尾宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"榮華太過終受辱。土星到軫不為良，害義傷廉遭法戮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星不欲經行女，罔法奸邪難制禦。火星度昴禍偏多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957385243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"子告父愆臣反主。水星最怒奎戌度，日月相同非曰怒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然日月不相同，不忠不孝天不䕶。羅與日同當朔月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"簒亂人主興大蘖。計都同月在望時，速取誅鉏及癰結。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"計都月孛最凶星，二者相逢惡怒名。紫炁從來同吉慶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋只恐蝕交征。大槩廟星皆曰福，稍遇凶星皆主辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"最𦂳五星明變段，廟順俱全享天祿。前法星分廟怒宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"須知星度在何中。廟星在分生賢哲，怒在何宫產禍凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":1591,"lineType":9,"content":"論禄勲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965134942262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"祿者，天元祿。甲火乙孛丙屬木。丁是金星戊土求，已是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂庚是水，辛炁壬計癸羅㬋是也。勲者，甲在寅，乙在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":1599,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，丙戊在已，丁已在午，庚在申，辛在酉，壬在亥，癸在子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"星入垣廟即為崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":1603,"lineType":9,"content":"論玉堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"玉堂者，天乙貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":1607,"lineType":9,"content":"晝貴人詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊庚𠔃是牛鄉，　乙己鼠兮丙猪方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965134958646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"丁猪壬癸居蛇位，　六辛逢馬貴為陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":1615,"lineType":9,"content":"夜貴人詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊庚兮居羊地，　乙已在猴丙丁雞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":1619,"lineType":1,"content":"辛遇虎穴壬癸兎，　此是夜中貴人梯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":1621,"lineType":2,"content":"按此晝夜貴人，依臺厯推載，其通書所載隂陽貴人，乃是冬至後用陽貴，夏至後用隂貴。其法以陽貴出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":1623,"lineType":2,"content":"於先天之坤順數，隂貴出于後天之坤逆數。天干之德，未足為貴，而干德之合氣乃貴爾。雲間儲先生曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":1625,"lineType":2,"content":"至靜而能制羣動，至尊而能鎮虚浮，以其有坤，黄中通理，乃為貴人之德。三車一覽五行精紀論貴又不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":1627,"lineType":2,"content":"同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652355620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：天乙貴人衆所欽，命宫全帶福彌深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"蜚聲騰實人爭慕，博雅該通貫古今。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"女命休須帶貴人，　空亡驛馬不堪聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":1637,"lineType":1,"content":"五行更忌逢生旺，　偏愛休囚死絶神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":1639,"lineType":9,"content":"論文星詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"甲羅乙計丙戊金，　丁火已炁庚木星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人見土壬逢日，　癸人見月定昌榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":1645,"lineType":2,"content":"文星者，五行相濟而成文也。甲見羅，則通明。乙見計，已見炁，則疏通。丙見金，則陶鎔。丁見火，則光明。戊見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452960663765043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":1649,"lineType":2,"content":"金，辛見上，則秀氣；壬見日，癸見月，則暉光。庚見木，則斵削。此皆相濟而成文。獨不以水孛為文者，以其無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":1651,"lineType":2,"content":"質也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":1653,"lineType":9,"content":"論魁星詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":1655,"lineType":1,"content":"甲用太隂乙太陽，　丙羅丁計戊炎方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"已金庚水辛逢孛，　壬炁癸水號魁光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":1659,"lineType":2,"content":"魁者，隂陽和合相生而成魁。獨不以土為魁者，以土愚濁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":1661,"lineType":9,"content":"論文昌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙已午報君知，　丙戊申宫丁巳鷄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452976933322752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"庚猪辛戌壬逢虎，　癸人見兎入雲梯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":1669,"lineType":2,"content":"文昌星者，乃天干生地支所藏之人元也。甲生丙在巳，乙生丁在午，丙生戊，戊生庚在申。丁生已，己生辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"在酉，庚生壬在亥。壬生甲在寅，癸生乙在卯。獨辛不以生，而以戌為文昌。戌在辛之方位，以其有從魁、河","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":1673,"lineType":2,"content":"魁夾之也。子丑辰未不與者，何也？葢文昌欲顯而不欲隱，子丑地下辰未庫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":1675,"lineType":9,"content":"定科名星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生人木向榮，　丙丁火宿實通亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"戊已土星壬癸水，　庚辛金宿定科名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"科名十干配天元，　廟旺之時第一仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957418011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"若居陷沒及留逆，　發薦連連不步蟾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":1687,"lineType":2,"content":"此上謂之十干科名星。若在七強順段旺廟，則名位高也。若在五弱及留逆段，雖中科甲，名次低也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":1689,"lineType":9,"content":"定科甲星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":1691,"lineType":1,"content":"科甲文星對命宫，　逆留弱惡必難逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"廟旺七強行順段，狀元高第必登龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":1695,"lineType":2,"content":"假令人馬宫為命，與隂陽宫相對，即以水星為科甲星，在七強順段，入廟必主高。甲在五弱留逆，雖貴，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":1697,"lineType":2,"content":"第必低。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":1699,"lineType":9,"content":"論官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652372004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"甲炁乙水是官星，　丙羅丁計戊孛成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"己火庚金辛見木，　壬隂癸土定功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":1707,"lineType":2,"content":"官星者，乃十干官星之禄星，琴堂謂對禄是也。甲以辛為官，辛以炁為祿，則甲人用炁為官星，十干皆以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":1709,"lineType":2,"content":"此例。獨陽君不與者，以其官君之所授也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":1711,"lineType":9,"content":"論印星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木乙日丙是熒，　丁月戊土已羅辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金辛計壬逢水，　癸人見孛是印星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":1717,"lineType":2,"content":"印星者，五行相符，合而為印。甲以木，丙以火，戊土、庚金、壬水是也。五隂干取日、月、羅、計、孛，亦以相生而相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957434395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":1721,"lineType":2,"content":"𩔖。然十一曜獨炁不與者，以其善柔，而非羅、計、孛之比焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":1723,"lineType":9,"content":"論催官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"甲金乙水丙日宣，　丁羅戊木見為歡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":1727,"lineType":1,"content":"已炁庚孛辛土宿，　壬月癸計是催官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":1729,"lineType":2,"content":"催官之星，主遷官進職也。大扺此星與祿主相為催尅，如甲人以火為祿，而見金則催；乙人以孛為禄，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":1731,"lineType":2,"content":"見水則催；丙人以木為禄，而見日則催；丁人以金為禄，而見羅則催是也。十一曜獨火不與者，以其有太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":1733,"lineType":2,"content":"陽在焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":1735,"lineType":9,"content":"論祿神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965134975030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":1739,"lineType":1,"content":"甲兼木孛，乙水星，　丙計丁羅戊土居，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":1741,"lineType":1,"content":"己火庚金辛紫炁，　壬日癸月是祿神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":1743,"lineType":2,"content":"禄神者，正祿神，遇之主食正祿俸。十一曜俱全，而甲獨兼木孛者，以其陽干之首也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":1745,"lineType":9,"content":"論喜神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":1747,"lineType":1,"content":"甲羅乙計丙炁星，　丁水戊月是喜神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":1749,"lineType":1,"content":"己土庚金辛見水，　壬孛癸火最堪親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":1751,"lineType":2,"content":"人命月逆行，喜神逆祿，十曜司祿而順布，喜神隨月以逆承。故祿之序，火孛木、金、土月、水炁計羅；而喜神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":1753,"lineType":2,"content":"之序，羅、計炁、水月、土金、木孛火是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965008965647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":1757,"lineType":9,"content":"論天厨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙已午丙在子，　丁戊已午已申儲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"庚落寅中辛尋午，　壬厨居酉癸居猪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":1763,"lineType":2,"content":"天厨祿名食神祿。指南云：假如甲生人，逢已甲食丙，丙祿在已；乙生人，逢午乙食丁，丁祿居午是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"歌云：天厨一祿少人知，　識時須是泄天機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"若在命宫為福𦂳，福德遷移又次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":1769,"lineType":1,"content":"男人遇此多財旺，　交入中年好爵縻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"女命逢之主封號，此是天上麒麟兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965008982031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"八宫宫主號天厨，宫主星高強最殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":1777,"lineType":1,"content":"更得吉星同在命，管取潭潭府中居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":1779,"lineType":1,"content":"此星陷了人無壽，若在高強意自如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":1781,"lineType":1,"content":"男兒坐命遭逢此，真是人間大丈夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":1783,"lineType":9,"content":"論天嗣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"甲月乙水丙炁餘，　丁計戊羅已火居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":1787,"lineType":1,"content":"庚孛辛木壬金宿，癸人見土是天嗣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":1789,"lineType":2,"content":"六合為夫婦，有夫婦而後有男女。人之父母，凡祿之餘者，孰不與其子？故甲人祿是火，己人祿是月，甲人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965008949263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":1793,"lineType":2,"content":"以妻之禄月與子，名之曰天嗣。故欲推天嗣者，即其變曜中化貴者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":1795,"lineType":9,"content":"論歲殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":1797,"lineType":1,"content":"只㸔他命天元干神宫主是。且如丙辰生人，從辰上起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":1799,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，數至午見丙，便是歲殿也。餘倣此。須是福主權，財命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":1801,"lineType":1,"content":"主身，主星官星科甲、科名居其上，方曰登殿。第一要身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":1803,"lineType":1,"content":"命臨之，次則福祿主臨之，入此格局，皆貴命也。若殿中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":1805,"lineType":1,"content":"無星，有身命二主，日月福祿主星祿馬官魁拱之，尤主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":1807,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。茍被飛星遷其上，兼囚煞加臨，則曰客曜臨朝，飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905183258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"星破殿，不為福也。如有主星處其上，又為煞星、客曜混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":1813,"lineType":1,"content":"雜刑尅，縱主功名富貴，不惟艱辛，亦難久享。夫歲殿者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":1815,"lineType":1,"content":"乃天上太歲之尊，人命十干之首。吉曜臨之，疇非富貴；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1817,"lineType":1,"content":"凶曜臨之，必皆貧賤。殿者，猶天子之御殿也，有金馬玉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"堂之邃，龍池鳯陛之高，警蹕森列，威儀整肅，非榮華顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1821,"lineType":1,"content":"達之士，莫能至其上也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：主星入殿福非常，客曜加囚必主殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1825,"lineType":1,"content":"福祿官魁如不陷，　拖青紆紫列朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491735563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1829,"lineType":9,"content":"論歲駕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"只看他命支神宫主是也。若是子年生子宫便是駕，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"星居其上，則曰臨駕。第一要身命主，第二要曰月宫，第","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"三要福星祿，主大貴。如駕上無星，得身命、日月福祿主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1837,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁祿馬拱之，亦主富貴。若飛星遷其上，則曰客曜臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"朝，飛星破駕，乃為灾凶。縱有主星臨之，復為飛星雜處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"囚煞加臨，雖見祿亦為磨難。夫駕者，乃太歲之位，歲君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"所臨之地，茍非富貴榮華之人，孰能居其上而享其福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854961971527689"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1847,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：客曜臨朝第一凶，　飛星破祿亦皆同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"若還囚煞加身命，假使為官是䕃封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1851,"lineType":9,"content":"論地爵五言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠猴元是土，猪羊火裏生。馬牛均下水，逢兎炁孤神。虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇皆屬木，鷄犬便逢金。龍人惟見孛，為爵必官清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1857,"lineType":2,"content":"爵者，地元爵也，自年支中出也。遇之進爵除拜，最要官福身命為之。又喜在高強，惡居陷地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1859,"lineType":9,"content":"論紅鸞天喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"紅鸞子年加卯逆數，天喜子年加酉逆數。此星主夫妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854961971544073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"喜事。若限坐其上，主有喜事動。二者每每相對。子紅鸞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1867,"lineType":1,"content":"則午是天喜，卯紅鸞則酉是天喜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1869,"lineType":9,"content":"論天德月德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"天德子年加酉順數，月德子年加巳順數。天月德二星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"乃是三合。若坐命，主男女大貴。又名壓煞星吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1875,"lineType":9,"content":"論解神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1877,"lineType":1,"content":"解神一年有二，乃天解、地解是也。天解每從辰上起，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1879,"lineType":1,"content":"年挨宫順輪，值本年歲君即是。地解以子丑年在未，寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854961971560457"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1883,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年在申，辰巳年在酉，午未年在戌，申酉年在亥，戌亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"年在午，只居六隂之地，不到陽宫。此二神能解一切凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"能興一切善，化凶作吉之曜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1889,"lineType":9,"content":"論赦文以上俱依臺厯吉神次序","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"赦文乃命之父母星。假如土為命，主飛坐已，土失地，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1893,"lineType":1,"content":"火為命，母在戌，而戌為赦文，得火飛來生我者是也。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1895,"lineType":1,"content":"金生水，土生金，木生火，水生木為例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1897,"lineType":9,"content":"唐符祿前八位是國印祿前九位是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1897,"lineType":2,"content":"二星守照身命為奇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854961971576841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1901,"lineType":9,"content":"論福星貴人歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"甲丙相邀入虎鄉，更逢鼠穴最高強。戊猴已未丁宜亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"乙癸逢牛福祿昌。庚趂馬頭辛到已，壬騎龍背喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1907,"lineType":1,"content":"此為有福文星貴，遇者應須被寵光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：福星之貴與天官，時日如逢一様㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇祿神同守占，　高攀月桂又何難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1913,"lineType":9,"content":"論官星貴人歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"甲愛金鷄乙愛猴，丁猪丙鼠已寅頭。戊尋玉兎庚壬馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854961971593225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1919,"lineType":1,"content":"辛癸逢蛇官未休。此為六甲官星貴，士人談笑取公侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲以辛為官，辛祿在酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1923,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：十干官貴妙難言，　更遇文星太極神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1925,"lineType":1,"content":"少壯榮華登仕位，安邦鎮國展經綸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1927,"lineType":9,"content":"論天德貴人歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1929,"lineType":1,"content":"正丁二坤宫，三壬四辛同。五乾六甲上，七癸八寅同。九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1931,"lineType":1,"content":"丙十居乙，子巽丑庚中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：天德元來大吉昌，若臨時日最為良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854961971609609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1937,"lineType":1,"content":"修文必定登科甲，　庶俗經營事事強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1939,"lineType":1,"content":"天德貴人罕遇之，　若臨限運最為奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1941,"lineType":1,"content":"成家立業皆緣此，　富貴之中細細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1943,"lineType":9,"content":"論月德貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1945,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，月德在丙。申子辰，月，德在壬。亥卯未，月，德在甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1947,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑月德在庚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，月在壬。申子辰，月在丙。亥卯未，月在庚。已酉丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1977,"lineType":1,"content":"月在甲。從寅上起，壬庚丙甲，逐位順數，周而復始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1979,"lineType":1,"content":"月空之人亦罕逢，那堪官貴在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1981,"lineType":1,"content":"金鱗豈是池中物，　不日天書下九重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1983,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4ktqno/1-SK1609_figure_00020.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1XI%2BeSigtWvZlNiX8p%2FbYpebExs%3D","pictureHeight":332,"pictureWidth":333,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4ktqno/1-SK1609_figure_00020.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QgidI1uRK2BsSl0NKTRbhdCEJRY%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4ktqno/1-SK1609_figure_00020.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
