{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"世人論命，止論十二支，而於甲、庚、丙、壬、乙、辛、丁、癸、乾、坤、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"艮、巽，皆不言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":2,"content":"餘度，於十二宫中，為神藏煞没天徳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"星盤之中，且不知此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"十干，安知其中之妙理？獨不聞隂陽家之說乎？凡為人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977756179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"立宅架造，移吉避凶，其有出東作西，不曰出甲作庚，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"曰出乙作辛，何嘗云出卯作酉，出寅作申？至於三隅方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"道皆然。葢支神乃神煞所居，而干神乃天徳、月徳、月合、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"月空，嵗徳所㑹，避凶而趨吉也。予於星盤上亥子隔界","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"之中著一壬字，子丑隔界著一癸字，十二宫各有一干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"一支，相比而去，而每宫之中，度數有狹闊之不同，吾亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"因闊狹而分焉。且如子之一宫有三十一度半，危六乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"壬之半，女至八度為癸之半。丑宫二十七度太，則牛金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479804979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"始二度為癸之半。斗至十度乃艮之半。寅宫二十八度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"半，箕六度乃艮之半。尾至九度乃甲之半。卯宫二十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"度半，心初乃甲之半，至氐七乃乙之半。辰宫三十度太，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"亢三乃乙之半。軫至十六乃巽之半。已宫三十度，前後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"各八度，軫一乃巽之半，翼四乃丙之半。午宫三十度，前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"後各七度半，張一乃丙之半，栁十一乃丁之半。未宫二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"十七度半，鬼一丁之半，井十五坤之半，申宫二十八度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"井二乃坤之半，畢十三乃庚之半。酉宫二十七度半，畢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992649527336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"初乃庚之半，胃十一乃辛之半，戌宫三十二度，前後各八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"度。𡝤七辛之半，奎九乾之半，亥宫三十二度半，壁二属","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"乾之半，室四屬壬之半。以此所屬而觀命者，命宫、命主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"二位俱臨于神之位數，皆富貴之人，亦必本命為嵗徳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳、月空、月合、卦氣六合有用之地，其人資性亦了了，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"不至蠢弱。其三台八座與州長官、富家大室，白手成立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"之人，往往臨之，所以秉陽徳之剛明，絶隂柔之晦惡。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"地支神，亦聞有富貴之人，而必星度十分合格，此干神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977788947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"貴者最多，不可不察也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":75,"lineType":9,"content":"歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支神隂徳居，十二干神陽徳管。止論支神不論干，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"算得命来只一半。二徳月空與月合，干神十二位中居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"身命主曜俱臨此，不貴當為富丈夫。月徳無如嵗徳髙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽等對待如何。丙壬庚甲强於戊，論命觀星細揣摩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"甲加心尾丙加張，畢得庚臨危北方。更有戊坤培井木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"命身臨此最為强。劍鋒大煞本干神，凶吉於中亦細明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905248794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲月前金位毒，名為真劍剉人身。假如不死得人身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"十箇之中九箇刑。帶角披毛真畜類，多因坐處上刀砧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛丁已癸隂干，若比陽干貴裏難。尚論支神此為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"於中分晰吉凶看。癸水女牛生與尅，乙臨氐亢尅其躔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"丁居栁鬼尅生半，胃土生辛巳産乾。乾坤艮巽四維髙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"乾巳坤辛戊位牢。此位劍鋒多半吉，巽淵艮土得功勞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗駕從来號吉神，殿勲籍貴與齊名。干神一位人多忽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹者星翁第一人。十干之位本純陽，君子居之大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479788595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"女子小人居則亢，可為鰥寡孤獨傷。卦氣從来止論干，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"支神卦氣亦湏看。往来身命詳交互，不是公侯也品官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"年值支神煞最凶，尊神嵗駕獨臨方。惟旁干神凶不射，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"不然禄馬貴人鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"假如未年生命在未，乃嵗駕也，若偏傍於丁坤土坐，則無煞也。所謂甲庚丙壬、乙辛丁癸，乾坤艮巽神藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"煞没者此也，故為天徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":121,"lineType":9,"content":"又歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗君對位亦凶神，帝座衝干曰一星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"乃太嵗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"人命莫當一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905232410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"星正，偏干庶可免其刑。太嵗支干有真合，甲人合已乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"人庚。若人身命兩臨此，早得妻財琴瑟鳴。午辰酉亥四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"年生，又向支神安命身。此上若無刑囚位，六親骨肉必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"罹迍。嵗刑之位既加詳，子午宫神互换方。寅已申宫叅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"錯見，更明丑戌未相妨。六害之年看互換，此宫安命亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"妨親。六親不尅身尅命，亦主重妻異子人。四廢干神人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"皆惡，誰知神旺徳之光。星盤位不嫌斯廢，喜在陽神干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"位方。空亡二位曰凶神，安命其中亦損身。宜向干傍非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991957581851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"正位，其凶可怕是支神。十干官星宜細詳，葢以五隂配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"五陽。隂人見合為官貴，尅我我尅有雙傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"天上三竒甲戊庚，地下三竒乙丙丁。若人命值三竒貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"三元及第冠羣英。太乙妙㫖云：乙丙丁，甲戊庚，命局相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"成生復生。不作蓬莱三島客，也應金殿玉堦行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生人見辰是，丙丁生人見戌是，得此二位主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":167,"lineType":9,"content":"論拱禄交禄暗禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄者，戊辰生人見丙午，丙午生人見戊辰，丁巳生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"見巳未，巳未生人見丁巳，前後相拱，只此四位是，其他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"不係。交禄者，甲申生人見庚寅，庚寅生人見甲申，如此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖是。暗禄者，甲生人逢亥，是亥能合寅，乙生人逢戌，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"戌能合卯，他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977821715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：暗禄仍湏仔細㸔，甲人須向亥中安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"乙人禄戌尤相喜，　入格才髙作狀元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"夾禄拱貴并交禄，命裏重逢金滿屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"食前方丈與諸侯，富貴是人之所欲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":189,"lineType":9,"content":"論飛騰禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲申、甲子、甲辰生人見寅是，葢禄馬俱在寅。庚寅、庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"午、庚戌生人見申是，葢禄馬俱在申。命得此者，主大貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479723059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：命中若遇諸般禄，徳潤身與富潤屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟日享五侯筵，　一食萬錢尤未足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":203,"lineType":9,"content":"論禄馬食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、甲子、甲辰生人見丙寅，庚寅、庚午、庚戌生人見壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"申，只此六位，主大顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":209,"lineType":9,"content":"論連珠食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"甲食丙，丙食戊，戊食庚，庚食壬。年月日時胎相順，自上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"食下是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491801099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":217,"lineType":9,"content":"歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"時人欲識食神名，甲人食丙乙人丁。丙食戊兮丁食已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"已食辛上戊食庚。庚壬辛癸偏相喜，壬甲癸乙最光榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇食神騎禄馬，必居豪富顯功名。不食空亡陽刃煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"不食休囚并死絶。食生食旺食貴神，食印食財别優劣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"有能推究得其真，禄食天厨無休歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":229,"lineType":9,"content":"論學堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"凡身宫主星是學堂星，假令太隂星在人馬宫，是身宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479772211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"也，即木為宫主星。看木星在何方，若在四正七强宫，并","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"順旺入廟，主文章之士。若在留逆段五弱宫，不㑹文章，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然登第，必出他人之力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：身宫宫主為學堂，　怕六十二八宫當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"若到此處皆為䧟，　雖有文章夀不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫宫主為學堂，　留逆怕逢三惡方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"廟旺更𠔥行順段，　七强宫裏錦肝腸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：納音生處為學堂，金人見巳，辛巳為正。木人見亥，巳亥為正。水人見申，甲申為正。土人見申，戊申為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009778901001"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"正。火人見寅，丙寅為正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":255,"lineType":9,"content":"論學館","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生人屬木，得寅，庚寅為正。丙丁生人屬火，得巳，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"巳為正。戊巳生人屬土，得申，戊申為正。庚辛生人屬金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"得申，壬申為正。壬癸生人屬水，得亥，癸亥為正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":263,"lineType":9,"content":"論官貴學堂學館","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生人，見巳是學堂，申是學館。葢甲乙用庚辛為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"星，庚辛屬金，金生巳，臨官申。丙丁生人，見申是學堂，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965135007798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"是學館。葢丙丁用壬癸為官星，壬癸屬水，水生申，臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"亥之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":275,"lineType":9,"content":"論正印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"金命逢乙丑，水命逢壬辰，木命逢癸未，火命逢甲戌，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢丙辰。謂五行正印，空則為僧道，旺則為貴人也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁人得甲戌，壬癸人得丙辰，又謂之夾貴印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"水生人得正印，吉中有凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：正印分明格局清，　士人唾手取功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965009080335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼華葢臨身命，晝錦還鄉示顯榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":291,"lineType":9,"content":"論官貴六合印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子得乙丑，戊午得癸未，丁酉得壬辰，巳夘得甲戌，辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"酉得丙辰是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":297,"lineType":9,"content":"論五命財庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"金命木財，未為庫。木命土財，辰為庫。水命火財，戌為庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"火命金財，丑為庫。土命水財，辰為庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":303,"lineType":9,"content":"論外財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009778884617"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"只取長生宫是，如甲用戊巳為財，見戊申是也。癸用丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"丁為財，見丙寅是也。此𩔖多得外財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":311,"lineType":9,"content":"定驛馬十二位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":313,"lineType":10,"content":"驛馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"五行驛馬最超羣，更遇生官禄貴神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"君子成名加爵位，　庶人營運足珠珍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"病絶驛馬值空亡，　士庶營謀半吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"更有工商并技藝，徒勞心力走忙忙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965009113103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":325,"lineType":9,"content":"六害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"馬前六害不堪名，月上逢之損弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"父母胎中先見尅，　日時妻子更防刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"六害湏憂損六親，　只宜僧道可安身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"又逢沐浴𠔥陽刃，　百世空為一世人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"馬前一辰名六害，命若逢之多破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"除非奴隸定生涯，　四體不完始安泰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":339,"lineType":9,"content":"華葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479739443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢聰明號吉星，　大宜執卷主科名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢天徳同官印，　位至公𡖖佐聖明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢華葢主文章，藝術偏多智慮長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"女命縱然多色慾，　也湏榮貴坐髙堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢空亡僧道同，　更𠔥陽刃在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"縱饒手藝多能解，百事終無一事通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":355,"lineType":9,"content":"刼煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"刧煞為災不可當，徒然奔走利名塲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009778917385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"湏防祖業消亡盡，妻子如何得乆長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"四位逢生刼又来，　當朝振業逞儒魁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"若𠔥官貴居時上，　鯁直名標御史臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"刼神包褁遇官星，　主執兵權助聖明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"不怒而威人仰慕，須令華夏悉安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":371,"lineType":9,"content":"災煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"災煞身多主禍殃，　更逢陽沐細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨日月并時上，　兄弟妻兒定夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977772563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"災煞當加帝旺方，　更𠔥禄貴此中藏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"變災為福誰知得，　一舉成名入廟堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":383,"lineType":9,"content":"天煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"天煞難招父命長，　纒綿宿疾不離床，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"除非祖業先磨滅，難免此身䧟禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"天煞加臨冠帶鄉，　不愁衣著不愁糧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"身閒命吉無災咎，枝葉偏多福禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":393,"lineType":9,"content":"地煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009778950153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"地煞難招母命長，須知前後喚人娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"若然在舍應愁悶，南北衣資始大强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"地煞如逢貴禄鄉，若能脩學富文章，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"不然營運多財寳，立業成家事事昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":405,"lineType":9,"content":"年煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"年煞原来最是凶，　不招祖業走西東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"重重婚娶無男女，　外族湏教破一重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢年煞臨時日，帝旺重加福禄强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452988652470308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"君子脩文應富學，　小人謀運足衣糧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":417,"lineType":9,"content":"月煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"月煞之神半吉凶，　弟兄男女有無中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"師巫僧道閒過日，　却主前程命運通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"月煞加逢自墓臨，　聰明智慧衆人欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"農商工賈并僧道，營運豐盈各稱心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":427,"lineType":9,"content":"亡神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"一名天官符又為大煞破軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神七煞禍非輕，　用盡機心一不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491784715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"尅子刑妻無祖業，　士人猶恐有虚名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫若也值亡神，須是長生遇貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"時日更𠔥天地合，　匪躬蹇蹇作王臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":439,"lineType":9,"content":"將星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"將星文武兩俱宜，禄重權髙足可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"不做宰臣清要職，便居帥府擁旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"將星財寳永無窮，家活生涯事事通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙更来天徳上，　少年平步上天宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009778933769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"將星一位最為良，時日相同命必昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"官職崇髙宜世賞，安邦定國鎮邊疆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":455,"lineType":9,"content":"攀鞍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"攀鞍在命最為竒，年少登科世所稀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"更得官星加冠帶，晚年定有貴男兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"命中帶馬用攀鞍，華葢前當四柱安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"管取飛黄騰踏去，　狀元及第又何難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":465,"lineType":9,"content":"定納音長生十二位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965009063951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":469,"lineType":9,"content":"長生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"長生管取命長榮，時日重臨主性靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"更得吉神相㑹遇，少年及第入王庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"長生若也得相逢，生下須招祖業隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"父母妻兒無尅䧟，　安然享福保初終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":479,"lineType":9,"content":"沐浴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴凶神切忌之，　多成多敗少人知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"男人值此應孤獨，　女命逢之定别離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479755827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴喜堪禄位逢，　更𠔥引從在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"讀書必定登科甲，莫把諸神例説凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花沐浴不堪聞，伯叔姑姨也合婚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"日月時胎如犯此，　定知無禮亂人倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"女命若還逢沐浴，　破敗兩三家不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"父母離鄉夀不長，　頭男頭女須防哭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":499,"lineType":9,"content":"冠帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢冠帶少人知，　初主貧寒中主宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479706675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"更得貴入加本位，　功名成遂又何疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"人命若還逢冠帶，　兄弟妻孥無䧟害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"因何接祖紹箕裘，　只為胎中有華葢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":511,"lineType":9,"content":"臨官帝旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官帝旺最為竒，祿貴同宫仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"若不狀元登上第，直須黄甲脱麻衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":517,"lineType":9,"content":"衰病死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"納音：衰病死重逢，成敗之中見吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009779015689"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"若得吉神来救助，　變災為福始亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":525,"lineType":9,"content":"墓庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"墓庫元来是塟神，　一為正印細推論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"相生相順無相尅，　富貴之中次第分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"人命若還逢墓庫，積穀拘財難計數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"慳貪不使一文錢，　至老人呼守錢虜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":535,"lineType":9,"content":"胞絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"絶中逢旺少人知，　却去當生命裏推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009779081225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"反本還原宜細辯，　忽然迍否莫猜疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"胞神一位名為絶，尅䧟妻奴家道劣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟朝暮走忙忙，　羊食狼貪無以别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":547,"lineType":9,"content":"胎養","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"胎養湏宜細審詳，半凶半吉兩相當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神相㑹應為福，　惡死重重見禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"或云胎養小長生，　人命惟逢自積靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"若也脩文應稱遂，　不然營運亦光亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905379866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":559,"lineType":9,"content":"論納音定子息歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"長生之位中旬半，沐浴一雙保吉康。冠帶臨官三子位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"旺中五子自成行。衰中二子病中一，死中至老沒兒郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"除非養取他人子，入墓之時難保雙。受氣為絶一箇子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"胎中頭女有孤娘，養中三子只留二，男女宫中仔細詳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"取納音尅我者是也。如金命人，用火為子孫。火生寅，寅上起長生。看男女宫在何方，順數依此斷之，即知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"吉凶也。假如火命人，男女宫在午，從寅上起長生，至午是帝旺，旺中五子自成行，則主有五子之位也。依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"此而推，萬無一失。又如木命人，男女宫在申，取納音尅我者為子孫。金尅木，金生已，從巳上起長生，至申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905363482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"是臨官。冠帶臨官三子位，則主有三子之位，餘皆倣此。又云：取我生者為兒孫，如金命人，金生水，用水為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"兒孫。水生申，從申上起長生。看男女宫在何方，如在酉上，則主一雙男女。以上一則取納音尅我者為子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"孫，一則取我生者為子孫，俱要數至男女宫斷之，皆為有理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":583,"lineType":9,"content":"定禄元宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"人生各有禄元宫，惟此宫中號最雄。但把日時從日數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"數從逆主本年終。更㸔宫內何星曜，宫主髙時星復廟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"更加金木作宫星，本禄重加官必妙。儻然䧟弱帶凶囚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"反福成凶皆惡兆。推尋此地若精時，貧富自然心下曉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491866635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"禄元一宫，人所罕知，若求此宫，只將太陽推過宫定凖，然後生時從太陽宫逆數至本年住，即為禄元之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"地。夫此宫者，要本家之禄，或官禄，或坐本命，若遇吉星，無不享福。如其坐䧟弱而遇惡星，或與囚煞同行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"或遇計羅成黨，斷主刑傷尅破也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"申馬寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"木星，在尾十五度，火為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"子馬寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"木星在箕五度，火為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977854483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"辰馬寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"木星，在斗四度，火為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"寅馬申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"金星，在觜一度，水為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"午馬申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"金星在參五度，水為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"戌馬申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"金星在畢十四度，水為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"亥馬巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"火星在翼八度，木為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"卯馬巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"火星在軫二度，木為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"未馬巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"火星，在軫十四度，木為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"已馬亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"水星在室九度，計為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"酉馬亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"水星在𤩹三度，計為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"丑馬亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"水星在奎一度，計為驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以驛馬宫天元祿主為是。如申子辰馬居寅，則遁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"甲禄在寅，甲以火為天元禄，故火為天馬，甲木為地驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009779113993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"也。寅午戌馬居申，遁庚祿在申，庚以水為天元祿，則水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"為天馬，庚金為地驛。巳酉、丑馬居亥，遁壬祿在亥，壬以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"計為天元祿，則計為天馬，壬水為地驛。亥卯、未馬在巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"遁丙，戊禄在已，丙以木為天元祿，戊以土為天元祿，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"木土為天馬，丙火戊土為地驛。自本主星天馬宫泊定，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"隔宫逆數，零年順數數起，一年一宫，若逢到馬臨官分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"即有喜事遷轉。若土計火孛混之，乃雜馬臨官，三十年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"纔逢。恐不純論此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905429018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":667,"lineType":2,"content":"三車一覽云：驛，郵亭也。馬有代勞之功，病處見子是也。如申子辰水局，生於申，病於寅，而得木為子，以代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"其勞，故曰驛馬。按此説，則寅午戌病於申，必取土而不取金，其說未融。余為之說曰：驛馬之論，乃病處而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"見財，非病處而見子。如申子辰水局，至寅而病，得丙火為財、為馬，以代其勞；寅午戌火局，至申而病，得庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"金為財、為馬，以代其勞；巳酉丑金局，至亥而病，得甲木為財、為馬，以代其勞。亥夘未木局，至巳而病，得戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"土為財、為馬，以代其勞。古人亦以官為祿，以財為馬，未聞以子為馬也。寅申巳亥為四衝，故衝處置驛，驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"中有馬，亦取長生之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":679,"lineType":9,"content":"定卦氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣者，六十花甲俱納於八卦之中也。如甲壬生人，卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452976933421056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"氣在乾；乙癸生人，卦氣在坤；六庚生人，卦氣在震；六辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"生人，卦氣在巽；六丙生人，卦氣在艮；六丁生人，卦氣在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"兊；六戊生人，卦氣在坎；六巳生人，卦氣在離。凢星盤、身、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"命、官、福坐於卦氣之上，無不富貴，是卦氣耶律之最重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"者。又攷範圖河洛中天大定諸數，悉皆以此為正祿，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"可忽諸？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"七政隂陽各有取，品量以配三方主。晝生只在日上求，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864575528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"夜則須從月中取。當知月火金為隂，日木土向陽𩔖尋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"夜宜。隂主晝陽主，不背端能為福深。隂如逢晝陽逢夜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"難説終身禍不侵。西天之法重乎此，最要其星在髙位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"各得其宜乗旺行，必主生来居富貴。七曜更臨身命宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"超騰必作人間瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"論三方主星立例及明其大畧：晝生就日，夜生就月，各於其所在宫取之。日木土主陽，月火金主隂，晝夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"不背則為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"金木從来是善星，所臨非主亦非榮。三方却怕逢火土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452976933437440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"的有無情惡曜名。夜見隂宫方烜赫，晝生陽位始光明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"論金木水火土，惟不是三方方主星，其禍福不同如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"從古賢愚皆有命，世人徒自苦經營。天元順廟居强位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"早嵗須登富貴名。印星守順七强宫，旺廟之中甲第雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"復與地元同廟位，不為𡖖監必三公。辰戌丑未宫名䧟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"天印星分入此宫。為人雖貴無官品，定有迍災及不終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452976933470208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：大抵天元號印星，此星宜順冠羣英。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然留逆仍居䧟，　難望朝中顯大名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":761,"lineType":9,"content":"論地元禄星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"主禄當星仔細看，七强四正有多般。生時旺廟兼行順，以此須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"知作省官。禄星不背又三方，如在髙强官禄昌。武品定知為大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"使，文資應也至員郎。三合位中逢此星，此星不弱最相親。同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"躔若使逢留逆，到得郎官須退身。禄星雖好印星滯，縱有官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"資禄不深。印禄二星皆得力，此人必得四方欽。禄印其宫占七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009779097609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"强，亦有科名禄又昌。若見夀元當弱位，縱能榮貴命危亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：品位髙低看地元，　生時沈陷禄多邅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢廟旺兼强位，　不是文僚即武權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":781,"lineType":9,"content":"論人元夀星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"夀元星正在東西，順段之時命絶竒。仍向命中逢旺樂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"天年應與嶽山齊。人元陷在五弱宫，不出初年命必終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"若向陷宫逢正度，縱教延逺四旬中。人元主夀細推詳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅逢之命豈長。更在忌星兼伏逆，兩旬之內見危亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009779130377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"夀星居命䧟祿元，縱有年長且没官。又值天乙不得力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"一生落魄主孤寒。印祿二星盡居强，獨有人元守弱方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有科名及祿位，柰何年夭且非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：人元曜得旺宫居，更在髙强夀不疎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"便見忌星臨在命，也應年及七旬餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":803,"lineType":9,"content":"論三魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星有三，惟正魁頗驗。若人行年星限遇之，必占甲科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"身命臨之，進取必魁多士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905412634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"正魁例：甲用太隂乙太陽是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":813,"lineType":9,"content":"小魁例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"甲羅乙紫丙金星，　干屬丁兮火上尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"戊水已計庚水宿，辛土壬陽癸太隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":819,"lineType":9,"content":"三元都魁例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚乙孛丙木方，　丁計戊巳水邊藏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"庚與辛遊火位上，　壬癸那堪紫炁當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"論四元歌四元乃仁元、夀元、禄元、馬元是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864542760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"馬星為貴祿為禄，仁元干配的無疑。夀元惟向納音取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"要在强宫與限隨。仁夀二元如得用，竝是名家極富兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"限星更得入垣局，此人終與聖賢齊。四元三限滿三用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"不犯凶星忌曜傍。滿在强宫明健處，定須執政入朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"上貴之人限星全，先要仁元與夀元。得入正限及身命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"貴祿兩元又相連。或在四正髙强處，清華富貴定兩全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"文星明健當台輔，武星髙貴主重權。或被惡星臨照破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"也為給諌立朝端。金為兵兮火為武，水為文兮土為輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905396250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"四星俱在髙强宫，文武𠔥資佐明主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":849,"lineType":2,"content":"壽元星最忌晝火夜土，馬元又為貴元論。馬元如申子辰馬在寅，寅屬木，即木星是也。禄元者，如甲生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"禄在寅，寅属木，即木星是也。仁元者，以甲乙生人屬木，即木星是也。此謂之木星得三用。壽元者，如甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":853,"lineType":2,"content":"生人納音是金，即金星是也。須㸔仁壽二元為先，貴禄為次，此四元要在七强宫及四正順段，廟旺好樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"之地。㑹限為上，守限宫主及命為次，最嫌在五弱宫及留逆死絶之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":857,"lineType":9,"content":"論九事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"九事者，四元星與三限星并時命兩星是也。若在四正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"七强宫，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479903283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"九事全兮順五行，自然享福得遐齡。九事若雜福不至，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"萬般智慮一無成。生時九事得五六，終身只可為中福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"欲明九事本元例，四元三限時命備。此為九事歸垣局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"不知垣局也為非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":873,"lineType":9,"content":"論八煞宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"八煞宫中最要窮，時人只謂八宫中。見聞未叩天機處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"難定浮生吉與凶。此宫理致最竒妙，禍福吉凶皆有兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星臨此福非常，惡曜到時災不小。若知窮算此宫中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965009162255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"兩句幽深務通曉。子午隂陽辰戌稱，寅申二位寳瓶宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"數年退數從逆取，尋取生年何位終。宫主又髙星又吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"何愁福祿不豐崇。福官身命宜居此，權宿加臨祿位隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"囚忌儻然相尅戰，為官必定少年終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"凡八煞一宫號為最髙者，此宫所主貧富貴賤，無不應驗。自臺諫吳秘正而下，罕得此訣，往往傳聞之誤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":893,"lineType":2,"content":"夫八煞一宫，甲子甲午旬隂陽宫起，甲寅甲申旬寳瓶宫起，甲辰甲戌旬天秤宫起。對宫逆數至本生年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"止，即是八煞宫，有吉星臨之，合主大權。身命居此，何愁福祿不豐隆。縱使福禄兩宫俱無星照，終還顯赫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"若囚忌相尅戰，雖為官亦主少亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009779163145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"圗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4ku3as/1-SK1609_figure_00021.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=eidJGI3HvKy3wGaKhq2XS9I953E%3D","pictureHeight":1052,"pictureWidth":838,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4ku3as/1-SK1609_figure_00021.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=J%2BUXZT8hwBs7CWQgq8bRVxdAxyc%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4ku3as/1-SK1609_figure_00021.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"天厨福局實難逢，年時次日順天輪。身命逢之皆吉慶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"局星照命亦光明。善星守局皆為福，空局亦為足食。人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢局上福立發，布衣換作錦衣榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"論以生年或同時併在天命宫，有善星守照，主貴。或身命分作年時二局亦緊。若無星守照，或官禄二星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":927,"lineType":2,"content":"俱䧟，只主衣食富足之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":929,"lineType":9,"content":"論天堂貴局歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人自有天堂局，尋取生時命所屬。若居四正及身命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491899403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"助限由来貴無並。武星髙照主將材，文星為限主儒魁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"日月分明㑹金水，三星得地乃三台。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":939,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人本生時及命宫所屬之星是也。如子時即水星，夘上為命即木星。若人生時與命所屬同是其星来","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"助限得力，即天堂局也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":943,"lineType":9,"content":"論天祿貴局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"當生年祿上為命宫，其次身坐祿宫，無不貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":947,"lineType":9,"content":"論䄄褥局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"法，以五命庫墓中坐命，如火庫戌，金庫丑是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
