{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"凡立功名主重權，須要坐限命入垣。星滿三用居本位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹命見限福仍堅。火為天市居天蝎，土是太常守磨蝎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"金星天秤亦太常，榮顯水星在南方。火星占入紫㣲垣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"紫木辰宫為限元。木星三用正臨亥，營室角道主兵權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"或然兩用𠔥為限，俊譽英雄發少年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452976933453824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1007,"lineType":2,"content":"金為太常垣在亢宿，土在斗宿，火限在天蝎，水限在星與虚，木限在軫與室，凡此五星若不是限，但身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1009,"lineType":2,"content":"宫亦得。木與紫同在婁角為滿用，亦須仁元入垣為𦂳。凡入垣皆須滿三用，方為正垣，惟木星兩用便是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1011,"lineType":2,"content":"垣也。　　又云木星三用為中台局，水星三用號榮名局，金星三用號文昌局，紫炁見木土金居命位號紫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1013,"lineType":2,"content":"微舍人局。星甚貴乎有用也，三用則大貴，兩用則貴，有用則不賤。若無用，則其星之弱而䧟也可知巳，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1015,"lineType":2,"content":"誠造化之所係。且如六甲人，以木為財、為福，又用以為禄，此星在命誠不可揜。如六戊人，以木為囚、為煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1017,"lineType":2,"content":"若命值此，則平生福淺而禍深，豈木星獨私於六甲人，而憎於六戊人耶？由所遇非所用耳。如孛在乙人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1019,"lineType":2,"content":"則為禄，主在丁人則為囚，此其所遇無用有用之理甚明，後學所宜深辯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1021,"lineType":9,"content":"論嵗徳朝垣歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977887251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"天上一星為嵗秀，地下一星名嵗徳。嵗秀嵗徳俱朝垣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"天地位中相對禄。大凡共值此宫星，一品加官必崇格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"日月能為此二星，弱冠之年榮白屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1031,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗徳朝垣假令夘生人，先定天上太嵗宫，主為嵗星，星乃天蝎宫，卯是後加地下安命宫，主為徳星，二星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1033,"lineType":2,"content":"同宫及衝對，崇勲之宫也。天地二盤更以臨駕登殿入局崇勲，此乃丞相一品極髙之命，其宫星不犯退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1035,"lineType":2,"content":"留伏逆為妙。如若犯弱退留伏逆，為次更凶惡之宫者，雖位崇勲而為難也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1037,"lineType":9,"content":"論入局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"只看他貴元局是也。如乙巳鼠猴之類者，主星居其上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905445402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1043,"lineType":1,"content":"則曰入局。要晝夜不相背，星辰不相反，則曰天乙吉神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"若相背相反，則曰天官凶位。便看三方主星，不要相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"戰，如尅戰則減福。更不係主星居其上，則曰閒神入局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。夫局者，天地精英之所萃，乾坤秀氣之所鍾，人命主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨之，無有不貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：貴局元来喜主星，閒神破局不為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄官魁臨吉位，定知攝職至公𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1057,"lineType":9,"content":"論升殿歌要㑹玉堂也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491915787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"第一躔星妙獅子，次看寳瓶虚日鼠。第三宫日昴金牛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"第四蝎宫房日兎。危月燕兒在子尋，晝太陽兮夜太隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫之上有張宿，酉畢對宫卯日心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1067,"lineType":2,"content":"須與日月為三元，與太嵗相攝。太嵗者，乃酉為金牛，夘為天蝎。或乙巳生人寳瓶，壬癸天蝎，丙丁金牛，六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1069,"lineType":2,"content":"辛獅子，以日為入殿也。與太嵗相干，又要是三元主，如不是三元主，則無用。既得日月為三元主，而入殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1071,"lineType":2,"content":"者，更不以五星為用，乃上品之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1073,"lineType":9,"content":"論臨駕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"一星作三四主者，號受權臨駕。如為二主星，號選職臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864624680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"駕，為一主則無用，嵗駕怕空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1081,"lineType":9,"content":"論登籍歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"帝座加命第一竒，崇勲臨夘亦相宜。崇勲在位第三貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗守勲可憑依。宫星似此號登籍，天地宫中自合儀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"勲嵗宫中言貴禄，限行到此世間稀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1089,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫度者，甲子以寳瓶為第一座，若加天命，第一竒也。人馬寅宫為崇勲加命，為貴。若寳瓶子加寅，人馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"寅加子，巨蟹加丑，磨蝎加未，此是天地合儀星處其中，名曰登籍第一限主乃一品二品之禄，第二運主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1093,"lineType":2,"content":"乃次也，第三宫主則為不明之禄。如此論合儀之星者，定三元而後用，不係三元，不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452965009178639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1097,"lineType":9,"content":"論崇勲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"只看他祿宫主是也。如甲禄寅，乙祿夘，有主居其上，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"曰崇勲。遇於駕殿，亦為臨駕登殿。若是飛星臨之，則曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"飛星破祿，凶。夫勲者，功也，崇者，髙也。窮則詩書事業，逹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"則號令文章，功名所在，萬世不冺，載之於竹帛簡冊之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"中，無非有功有勲者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1109,"lineType":9,"content":"歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"竊聞逺祿最相干，星入崇勲不等閒。更得馬乗天相禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491932171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"男命遭馬必貴，女命值馬必貧，寅多相逢，名為活馬。田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"財相見，成敗有之，病絶死逢，徒然無用，六害相㑹，奔馳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"勞碌。玉堂者，天乙貴人，不臨辰戌，日時衝而不足，命主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹而有情，貴在丑未，衝却無妨。禄主臨而不貴，人命值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"而未宜。卦氣臨命，則名利顯赫，慷慨聰明。嵗破逢身，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"先敗後成，破蕩難支。運限逢而財敗，六合濟而孤貧。倘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹天中，不祥尤甚。田財身遇，必主破財。陽刃者，凶敗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"怕在命宫四柱，又忌加見刼亡。若㑹三刑，如虎添翼，君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479919667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"子逢之，有權好殺，亦難善終，小人值之，逢凶好逞，多主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"横死，女命逢之，主産厄，男命遇此，見是非亡。刼者，亡為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"官符，刼為大煞。亡神值命，㑹勲印玉馬而反吉，獨守命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，則駁雜凶頑而狂蕩，倘加陽刃，難保善終，六害相逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"其凶莫比。刼煞在命，宜於生鄉，忌臨衰地，身命限主，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"可逢加。驀為悖逆之𧰼，衝為白虎之神，在命有貴則吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"運行到此，有日月傾倒之災，更加惡神，其凶非小，驀到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"身命近君，不乆末後尢乖。飛廉者凶神，身命遇而必招","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864608296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"凶惡。汨没者淫神，身命限主不可居，更㑹其祿，好酒破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"家，在位加官進爵不為難。登籍之星多智慧，平生早達","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"動人心。成名金榜全忠孝，天下聞名冠古今。主星臨駕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"受强謨，主性多機與衆殊。非只言官主庫藏，他年財榖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"有盈餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1161,"lineType":9,"content":"論特進歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬雙魚木守春，火居天蝎白羊神。秋金天秤金牛上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女隂陽冬水神。四季主星登此進，先行日月有其明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977903635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"因斯宫度闗非漏，細取三元分等倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1171,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫度者，乃主星先進。晝生在太陽之前，夜生在太隂之前。在此宫者，故曰廟進。如在駕勲，故曰特進。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1173,"lineType":2,"content":"在宫分樂旺廟𠔥與太嵗相攝者，則曰入進。特進則一品二品之貴，廟進則為第二。入進難言其位，縱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1175,"lineType":2,"content":"而嵗晚方發。如位隔者，或前進隔日月兩位者，名漏闗。處日月之後者，名曰末後。既進要係三元主星，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1177,"lineType":2,"content":"後觀其度數用之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1179,"lineType":9,"content":"論近帝座","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"假令天蝎卯宫為帝座，若二三主居天秤，號曰近帝座，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"一二三品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864641064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1187,"lineType":9,"content":"論受職星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"取本宫對宫上逆數至太嵗是。如戊申人自地盤寅上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"逆數甲，至太嵗上得庚，以水受職星也。受職星臨本生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗，宜為貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1195,"lineType":9,"content":"論食邑星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"文武尊榮食邑星，住命宫主取元情。午屬太陽未屬月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"申巳水宿辰酉金。卯戌火星寅亥木，子丑遇土来天福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"廟順須封萬户侯，怒逆難為榮上爵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479936051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1205,"lineType":9,"content":"論漏闗歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"推命先須覓漏闗，四方三位不相攀。一如申子逢辰月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"年上星辰善惡間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1211,"lineType":2,"content":"星坐之處，即照六陽宫。每宫星連對照三合漏闗六位也。漏闗者，不在對照三合之内。如申子辰為三合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1213,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥為四方，則午戌為漏闗，常在前後二宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1215,"lineType":9,"content":"論衝殿歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗後一辰為衝殿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"乃隂刃也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"駕後一官名驀越，大凢人命防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"衝越，致禍為災不可測。駕前宫度嵗後辰，更恐其星行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854595729063986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"退逆。衝勲衝嵗亦為凶。太嵗支干刑又尅，三元主落在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"其中。干祿求榮終大隔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"本命太嵗後一辰為衝殿，駕後一位為驀殿，帝座前一辰為近駕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1229,"lineType":9,"content":"論救䧟宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"相奴兄疾名為䧟，䧟了星辰祿不昌。更有一般消息好，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"若䧟嵗時必無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1235,"lineType":9,"content":"論管辰星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"人生自有管辰星，禍福災祥自此明。本日生人推本宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854595729080370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"宿中算取甚星臨。福星到此皆為福，禄宿臨之祿自興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"身命躔之均得力，值囚凶忌定遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人之生，各有管辰星，以主生人禍福。如本生月初一日屬亢星，十四日則屬奎星，看取奎星有何曜，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1247,"lineType":2,"content":"斷人禍福，貧富夀夭，未嘗不自此而基之。凡起管辰，先置積日，以　一十七萬一千三百單九算去之，餘者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1249,"lineType":2,"content":"又以二十八算去之，不滿者從角宿輪起，即知管辰星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kufxw/1-SK1609_figure_00022.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SXnGzsRjQEe0kdpkQSavqsL46zc%3D","pictureHeight":306,"pictureWidth":308,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kufxw/1-SK1609_figure_00022.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Vzf8HfncFwwcqzL9%2ByEK8zr6WVQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kufxw/1-SK1609_figure_00022.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":9,"content":"論十二宫管庫星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"人命推排十二宫，宫星為主實難通。今人只論元来曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"誰把宫神主宿窮。此宿從来為管庫，主人禍福吉和凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"精窮主星歸何地，善惡推来得度中。得時不論居䧟弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429668391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"失時何問在髙强。伏逆順留居段局，廟旺喜怒細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"逐宫推算從頭始，著意躔教首尾終。此説精㣲難説盡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"心機徹處透天工。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"夫人命中推排十二宫者，皆有實局，自命而推，次則財帛以至相貌，配為十二宫，又分為七强五弱。凡宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"分有主星，如寅木則屬木之𩔖，如此星者為主星。今之論星，第以十二宫主為重，此法亦西天之精神，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":2,"content":"較之十二宫管庫主星，則又驗前宫主也。凡欲求十二宫之禍福，但推詳其管庫星在何宫，分得地失時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"以别强弱，庶乎論定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":9,"content":"論得地失時星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864821288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中有强弱，七强五弱例難窮。命宫官祿最髙位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳妻宫次强宗。近强男女并田宅，第九遷移合照宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"五弱疾宫并相貌，兄弟奴僕八宫中。强宫愛見吉星照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"弱處星辰無福功。古人雖有推詳例，理致未為長乆通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"洞天宫法窮其妙，失地逢時廟旺中。不問强弱宿星地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"只將好廟論窮通。得地不問居强弱，失時休誇强最雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟處得時猶享福，强宫失位總成空。那堪髙處重居廟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"作福興財分外豐。倘還䧟弱加時失，一分凶作十分凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008978001939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"星辰之要，貴在得時，懼在失時。得時則享福，失時則䧟害。休咎吉凶，轉移甚易。官之强弱，固不必執定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":9,"content":"論得地不得地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"夫十二宫者，各有分野，而星辰類有好樂之官。論五星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"者，先論其廟與不廟，强與不强，則無不應驗。且如木星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅亥，為樂廟好之宫，凡得地為福深，不得地為福淺；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"得地為禍亦輕，不得地為禍亦重。若用福星得地照臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"其福百倍。假令為福而不得地，亦猶當生年不用之以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"福也。若其用為煞星失地，則其煞誠不可解，得地則未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636278312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"必不轉煞而為福矣。其得地如此，不得地如彼，君子不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"得不講究乎是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":9,"content":"論强弱前後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論五星善惡之混照者，湏辯其强弱先後之理也。劉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"少白問曰：何謂强弱先後？曰：强者譬大國，弱者譬小國，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"小固不可以敵大，弱固不可以敵强。在智者深究之，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":2,"content":"前後，入宫之前後也。或强而後入，或弱而先入，當以强弱論。若强先弱後，當以前後論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432304163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":9,"content":"論留順伏逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論五星，不過金、木、水、火、土之五宿。五者運而無息，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"有留順伏逆之推移。劉少白問曰：何謂留順伏逆？曰：五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"星者，臣下也。太陽者，君象也。臣當敬其君之威，而不敢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"犯，使其近太陽則伏，對太陽則逆，三合見太陽則留。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"順而有用，則十分之福，可以輕重而詳斷之也。如光芒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"不見，不能為福，亦不能為禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"留順伏逆，與强弱先後並㸔。如前進而留，後進而順，則後者反在前矣。如强者伏，弱者逆，則强亦不能作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991492014091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"福，而弱者反興禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":9,"content":"論吉凶星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅、計、孛四凶神，炁、水、金陽本吉星。當究生時善惡用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"莫専自古吉凶名。吉星為惡災非淺，禍曜為祥福自興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"不論用時徒泥迹，貧窮富貴又難明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"善論星者，無疑其善惡之名，當究其善惡之用。夫名者，乃炁、金、水、火、孛、羅也。夫用者，乃福、權、財、禄、囚、煞、忌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"刑也。用之為福禄，則福禄居髙。用之為囚煞，則囚煞必有。若徇其名，不究其用，則是無造化耳。且夫火、孛、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"羅、計四星之最惡，然亦能為福星、權曜，亦能為祿主、財元，如是則不純乎惡也。炁、金、水、木四星之最善，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636327464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"亦能為煞曜、刑星，亦能為囚星、疾宿，如是亦不純乎善也。天機造化，實轉移乎是，烏可泥其名而不究其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"用乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":9,"content":"論休囚歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"水土卯星居其鄉，三元主落定為殃。木居午未宫刑戰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"身命逢之不可當。火星戌上無星管，運行衝破卒他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"金向丑邊為正局，學人須要細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":9,"content":"論汨没歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"水絶巳木絶申之説也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰居雙女邊，亥卯未兮申上還。寅午戌怕雙魚位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864788520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑来人馬安。四季相加災又緊，運臨其上定為寃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"三元宫內無刑戰，神煞臨排第一篇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"定乾濕沈没宫　一説巳午為乾宫，　亥子為濕宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"更是　丑亥未為濕宫，　寅卯酉辰為乾宫，　卯為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"沈宫，　酉為没宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":155,"lineType":9,"content":"論五行沈泄法歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"通於子平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"火見水而死，金沈怕水鄉。土逢火化烈，木見水生芳。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"消逢火地，木火過須妨。水見火而戰，火金而刃傷。土見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123744267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"火生處，土反脱火光。木見土而種，水土尅難當。金生存","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"土位，水見水而愴。土見金而泄，木懼金捐黄。水清金越","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"秀，金逢木鈍鋼。火生懼木地，土見木虚亡。欲慕淵源法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"其理要精詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":171,"lineType":9,"content":"定天空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗前一位是也。如天地諸般煞星逢之，皆不能為禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"若有用之星逢之，皆無力，不能為福。身命二星逢之，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"是有藝業之人，頗聰明，只是多學少成，大槩處事必少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123711499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"恩義。若陽刃與的煞夾之，多不吉。其流年嵗駕前一位，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"能空其吉凶之星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":185,"lineType":9,"content":"定驀越","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"駕後一位是也。如駕在前，此位乃是趕駕，有驀越之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"凡諸有用之星逢之，皆减一半之力。若煞星逢之，或化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"直難與身星並見，陽刃的煞又来。凡行限見之，或太嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"流年填之，多主惡死，衝之，必見官事災晦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":195,"lineType":9,"content":"定天厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636294696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"天空對位是也。不宜諸煞交入此宫，且此宫極忌，同於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"八厄，若男女犯之，定主厄難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":203,"lineType":9,"content":"定血刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"以子年加戌，逆數一年一位至本生年，是此星主有血","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"光，行限犯之惡死。然必陽刃劍鋒聚㑹，或天星羅孛交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"戰，而後為災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":211,"lineType":9,"content":"定勾絞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"勾以子年加卯，逐年順數。絞以子年加酉，逐年順數。二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977969171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"煞未始不相對，主刑囚，然必加三刑，或流年白虎、官符、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗衝動，方以此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":221,"lineType":9,"content":"定喪門白虎吊客病符","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"此四煞當年太嵗之所布。假如子年，一太嵗在子，三喪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"門在寅，九白虎在申，十一吊客在戌，十二病符在亥。喪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"門、吊客主孝服哭泣，白虎、病符主官非病破。若有赦文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"天解、天徳、月徳解救無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":231,"lineType":9,"content":"定天哭披頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051596303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"天哭以子年加午逆數。披頭以子年加辰逆數。此二煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"與喪吊並，主有喪服。若更值惡星到，而太嵗亦到其上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"則孝服不可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"飛符以子年加辰順數。暴敗以子年加未順數。此二煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"主横災官事，惟天月二徳解神可以救免。然暴敗最怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"身命相值，飛符忌日時同到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":249,"lineType":9,"content":"定天狗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636343848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗在駕後二辰，五位值之，主多生少養。若火孛交攻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"子星落䧟，方以無嗣續斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":257,"lineType":9,"content":"定刃鋒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"刃者，子年子位是，丑年丑位是，十二位皆依此推。鋒者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"子年癸，丑年戊寅、甲卯乙辰已巳、丙午、丁未、已申庚酉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"辛戌、戊亥壬是。大抵取比肩禄旺，亦陽刃之意也。此煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"身命值之，更加陽刃，主惡死限值之尤甚。若身命髙强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"反成威福。經云：馬頭帶劍，威鎮邊疆。言此煞利在馬前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452992905494554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"也。耶律云：女人切忌刃鋒辰。言此煞女人最忌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":273,"lineType":9,"content":"定伏尸卷舌欄干貫索四刑星宫度歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"四正宫中取四刑，命低限弱怕刑星。子年起子尋戌亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"破家凶惡出其星。伏尸卷舌為膿血，命限臨之依此說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"欄干貫索主傷殘，隨限尋之仔細看。四刑宫中更多惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"暗曜囚星莫並逢。那更若来宫度內，必然破敗主刑徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"兩主不宜相㑹遇，不須更坐命身宫。一切加臨皆剥煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"伏尸度內亦多凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432320547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"若四位之中，有用之星，反能制福，無用之宿𠔥為忌煞，必然䧟凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"伏尸星辰最為凶，惡曜併之真可畏。若能吉星同位中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"福祿榮昌有職位。欄干之曜最凶辰，惡曜臨之必見刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"若有吉星同位坐，富貴榮華百年春。貫索星辰不可當，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥惡宿最為殃。三方四正吉星入，福夀榮華職禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"卷舌凶星逢吉曜，或朝或會最為宜。三方四正星辰旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴榮華百嵗期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"伏尸：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"子　丑　寅　夘辰　巳　午未　申　酉戌亥。虛三、女二、尾十四，　尾一、角一、軫　星二、柳四、井一、畢四、　婁二、　畢五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432336931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"卷舌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"酉　戌　亥　子　丑　寅　卯　辰　巳　午　未申。胃九、胃二、　壁二、　危一、斗十九、　斗一、　房二、　角主：翼十、張十四、井二、十八觜初。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"欄干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"午　未　申　酉　戌　亥　子　丑　寅　卯　辰　巳。張四、柳二、參四、　畢七、奎九：　奎一、　危二、女二、　箕二、　尾初、　亢一、翼十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"貫索","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"卯　辰　巳　午　未　申　酉　戌　亥　子　丑　寅。氐九、　亢七、　翼十二，　張七、井十九：井四、　昴一、婁十、室九、　危十二、　牛四、箕初。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":313,"lineType":9,"content":"論沐死墓絶四煞宫度歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"生年納音算也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"古法當求四煞度，最忌沐浴死絶墓身宫躔此定多殃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"限若逢之招死禍。或然更有吉星來，度近猶能成吉。䕶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅計孛若相侵，早知趕入黄泉路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"木生人，　絶參二，　墓柳四，　死星五，　沐危九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452991491997707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"金生人，　絶尾十七，墓牛三，　死危一，　沐星四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"水生人，　絶翼十九，墓氐一，　死氐十六，沐胃十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"土生人，　絶軫一，墓軫十八，　死心一，　沐畢四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"火生人絶璧三，墓婁一，　死昴二，沐房一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":333,"lineType":9,"content":"論産星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"其法申子辰年金，已酉丑年水；寅午戌年木；亥卯未年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"火。此煞男主血光，女主生産。若與惡星交，則主禍厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":339,"lineType":9,"content":"論血支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123678731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"其例丑寅土，子卯木，辰亥火，已戌金，午酉水。未日申月，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"星盤所屬而移一位也。此煞犯之，男血光，女産厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":347,"lineType":9,"content":"論血忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"其例丑寅土，子日夘月，辰亥、木，巳戌水，午酉火，未申金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞犯之，其凶禍與血支同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":353,"lineType":9,"content":"論擎天遊奕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"擎天屬火，遊奕屬水，數以六十，花甲隔節，布於十宫，起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"於子，終於夘，而丑寅不與未申飛變者，以河漢始於丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864804904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，終於未申，故擎天屬火，不入故也。其煞男怕擎天，女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"怕遊奕，皆主刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":365,"lineType":9,"content":"定空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"陽謂之空，隂謂之亡，陽年空陽，隂年空隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":369,"lineType":9,"content":"歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡為害最愁人，才智英雄悞一身。只可為僧并藝術，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"堆金積玉也須貧。金空則鳴火空發，水空日夜流不歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟財寳積如山，官爵重重無斷絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008977985555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":379,"lineType":9,"content":"直難星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"正二太陽三四隂，五六火星君休説。七八水孛更為殃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"九十木炁為難絶。十一十二是金星，此是神仙真口訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"一説十一十二，土星是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"直難者，難星直月也。雖日月金木善星以為難直，則反吉為凶。假如丑宫命正　二月夜生，則太陽為直難；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"寅宫命晝生，則太隂為直難，更化刑囚，其凶必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":391,"lineType":9,"content":"陽刄煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞在天為紫暗星，在地為陽刃，命吉則吉，命凶則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051579919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：陽刃之煞最為凶，　那堪五鬼在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"刑妻害子渾閒事，配遞徒流不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"祿前一位為陽刃，　日月逢之也不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"更怕祿星居其上，　一生成敗主多傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃雖為凶惡神，　只宜君子掌權人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"五行若更逢生旺，　定有兵機作帥臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":409,"lineType":9,"content":"論的煞一名破碎煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"夫金乃太白之星，將軍之象。子午夘酉的在巳，寅申巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051563535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"亥的在酉，辰戌丑未的在丑，秉煞最重。如人命犯，更坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"在惡限，又逢凶星，被火土忌星孛、計奴星守照，主星沈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"沒，多主惡死。不然貧窮帶疾徒配之人。若身命逢星辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"或入體格，或吉星飛起，在命為福用之星，主為官顯耀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"重權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：人命若逢破碎煞，破財恰似湯澆雪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"行年運限更加臨，官事連綿無休歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":429,"lineType":9,"content":"飛廉煞一名大煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453013532770330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞子人先是猴，丑鷄寅犬問来由。夘蛇辰午巳逢未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"午虎未兎申龍頭。酉猪戌鼠難迴避，循環亥上却逢牛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞逢吉則主威權，逢凶則主橫死。指南云：凡煞不可執一而論，如入格命視刑煞，若將帥於兵卒，指麾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"喝咄，惟命是從，故用刑煞為之驅使。不入格命，若常人遇兵卒，則為䧟害，故忌刑煞，如畏兵卒。此理甚明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":441,"lineType":9,"content":"亡神刼煞一云亡神謂七煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"亡為官符，刼為大煞。此二煞相對，俱在寅申巳亥，吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"歌斷在前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":447,"lineType":9,"content":"大耗煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008864772136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠忌羊頭上，牛嗔馬不耕，虎憎鷄嘴短，兎怨猴不平。龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌猪面黒，蛇驚犬吠聲。有人犯此煞，財食散伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵煞謂之耗，謂之刼，惟怕田財二位，學者當消詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":457,"lineType":9,"content":"穿心六害歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"穿心六害禍非輕，尅䧟爺娘及弟兄。若然雙親無損害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"自身妻子切須刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":463,"lineType":9,"content":"三刑歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑身體忌傷殘，不測官災大不祥。妻子亦須防尅破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636311080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"為官必定死他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"三刑：寅刑巳，巳刑申，申刑寅，轉轉相刑是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":473,"lineType":9,"content":"吞㗖煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"猪犬羊逢虎必傷，猴蛇相會樹頭亡。鷄逢犬子遭徒配，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"兎趕蛇身走逺鄉。鼠見犬来當惡死，馬牛逢虎定相傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"兎猴逢犬難迴避，龍来未上水中央。凡人若值凶時日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"三合為災仔。細詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞，乃以二十八宿而論，大禽吞小禽也。人命時日值之，更加三合，主骨肉刑併。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453005479985203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":487,"lineType":9,"content":"流霞煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"甲鷄乙犬丙羊加，丁是猴精戊見蛇。巳馬庚龍辛逐虎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"壬猪癸虎是流霞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞人命犯之，男主他鄉死，女主産後亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":495,"lineType":9,"content":"返伏吟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"年頭為伏吟，對宫為返吟。忌行運到此，主刑䧟。六親書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"云：伏吟返吟，泣涕零零。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":501,"lineType":9,"content":"孤辰寡宿歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123695115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰人怕巳丑，巳午未人畏申辰。申酉戌人嫌亥未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑人寅戌嗔。若人值此多孤寡，刑害𠔥須損六親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"男遇孤辰須切忌，女逢寡宿獨眠瞋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":511,"lineType":9,"content":"歌斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"孤辰切忌男妨婦，寡宿須教女害夫。兄弟亦當離别去，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"爺娘骨肉不同居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"孤辰寡宿好為僧，若居庶俗必伶仃。更被穿心来守破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"不然帶疾主雙盲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028355440666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":523,"lineType":9,"content":"論黄幡豹尾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰年則辰是黄幡而戌是豹尾。巳酉丑年則丑是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"黄幡而未是豹尾。寅午戌，戌是。亥夘未，未是。此煞是太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗墓，人命犯之，主孤寡，損六畜及疾病官災。退財有救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"解無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":533,"lineType":9,"content":"紅艷煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"多情多慾少人知，六丙逢寅辛見鷄。癸臨申上丁見未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"眉開眼笑樂嬉嬉。甲乙午申庚見戌，世間只是衆人妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636360232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳怕辰壬怕子，祿馬相逢作路妓。任是富豪官宦女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"花前月下㑹偷期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":545,"lineType":9,"content":"隂錯陽差歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"陽差隂錯是如何，辛夘壬辰癸巳多。丙午丁未戊申位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉壬戌癸亥過。丙子丁丑戊寅日，十二宫中子細歌：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"好風流處不風流，花燭迎郎不自由。不是寒房因孝娶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"殘房入舍兩家仇。女人逢者亦依然，真假公姑或續絃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"否則有刑多寡合，外家零落是前縁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051694607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":559,"lineType":9,"content":"呻吟煞一名孤鸞煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"木火蛇無婿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"木火蛇，丁巳乙巳是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"金猪木虎傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"卒亥甲寅是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"赤黄馬獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"卧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午戊午是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"黑鼠土猴孀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子戊申是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":565,"lineType":9,"content":"總論駕前神煞歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太嵗劍鋒伏尸寄，二、太陽天空仍可畏。三、喪門內外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"孝事至。四、太隂貫索勾絞具。五、官符杖責難迴避。六、死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"符月徳同行位，七、嵗破月空欄干是。八、龍徳暴敗天厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"至，九、白虎飛廉同此據。十、天徳福星卷舌係，十一、弔客","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051710991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗吠，十二、病符順行位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":579,"lineType":9,"content":"總論駕後神煞歌一年一宫逆行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"子年紅鸞卯為首，天喜對宫在於酉。血刃浮沈及解神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"戌上分明牢掣肘。天哭還從午上尋，披頭更向辰宫究。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"流年諸煞與諸凶，逆認地支人罕有。此是神仙不肯留，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"術人依此長相守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":589,"lineType":9,"content":"地煞賦總斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論嵗殿，以登殿為本；論嵗駕，以登駕為先。身命主俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453013532852250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"登臨，顯達無比；日月主若拱夾，富貴非常。殿駕無星而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"無得，禄主加臨而更竒。惟怕客曜臨朝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"餘奴是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"飛星破殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"闕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"囚煞加臨而不美，主當刑煞以須防。勲者，天祿也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"欲全而不破。忌空衝為要，㑹玉馬為竒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"玉堂驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"衝則四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"相衝，破則飛星破祿。祿主臨曰崇勲，宜居官福；命宫值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"曰全吉，忌見刼空。祿逢帝座，足有錢財；貴值垣城，堪稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"文雅。子午相逢，名為活祿。辰戌丑未，禄馬不臨，如合通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"闗，吉無不利。馬者，扶身之寳也，欲生而不病。喜逢勲玉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028355522586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"忌在空亡。馬遇垣城，須當富命，則酒色皆好，遇吉則轉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"禍為祥。空亡者，煞滅也。陽為空而隂為亡，陽忌陽而隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"忌隂。煞者，滅也。滅者，絶也。命與日時值之，暴亡必見。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"木火之位，宜金水之宫。不宜居坎，而宜居離。諸煞逢空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"化凶為吉。的煞相㑹，成敗不無。四柱逢空，不欲再見。空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"亡不亡，尤為庶㡬。二位全見，名利難成。刑害者，凶惡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑守害，遇六害而凶惡難逃；六害命逢，遇三刑而同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"惡相濟。刑居五福，極主官髙。害㑹的亡，孤貧破敗。斯為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453025134231562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福之凖繩，誠乃加盤之妙法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":633,"lineType":9,"content":"百煞經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"夫觀命者，未論祿馬貴人，先論胎息神煞。夫煞，人之成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"器，能掌君子之重權，能發庶人之財禄。煞之一字，千變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"萬化。煞多無貴，即勇猛暴亡；煞絶無貴，即𤰞微孤獨。君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"子帶煞，權貴福祿之任；庶人帶煞，挺立鄉黨之間；女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"人帶煞，子夫。刑傷之患，煞無欄處，定是傷身。閉門帶煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"反受災殃。年上帶煞，自損其身；月上帶煞，必損父兄。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453025134247946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"上帶煞，夫妻必喪；時上帶煞，子女先亡。若見四位無刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"害，須知夭折守空房。陽刃之煞怕逢金，刼煞最忌火加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"臨。的煞須知頭粉碎，亡神最忌水深臨。六害重見六親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"損，隔角逢之主孤貧。孤神日上逢隔角，未申戌亥、丑寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"辰巳，其妻到底定生離。桃花咸池来深處，春花照水定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"生淫。若是仕宦人家女，不用媒人自求親。大耗之煞怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"逢空，家財渾似雪和湯，六甲空亡怕齊逢。金神之煞主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"重喪。六親不足而自嘆，年年常為仵作郎。呻吟之煞怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123826187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"金神，白虎逢之定不仁。日時帶著損妻子，定於中途斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"絃聲。命帶孤神寡宿星，看經念佛作道人。少年娶室妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"子分，至老定是作孤身。一七之煞是亡神，為人性躁有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"英聲。衝入本身人凶暴，衝出之時有功名。勾絞之煞疊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑，逢之為人編配身，春申酉，夏亥子、秋寅夘，冬巳午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神之煞五鬼臨，限行見孛水亡身。幼年當忌火湯厄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"為人作事百無成。長生之位主聰俊發達，英雄財祿亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢之煞為僧道，學堂逢貴為儒名。桃花帶貴多淫慾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453013532868634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"常思月下戀風情。命坐刼煞十五年，爺娘不損是夙緣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"若見雙親無刑害，自身帶疾病相連。命坐陽刃忌血星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"限行見煞定損身。命中帶煞難迴避，惡曜臨之禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"雙頭合煞，十有九死。兩頭合刃，百有九傷。合煞翻身，三旬內","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"患。合煞回身，傷刑而已。合煞逢衝，事事省半，煞合逢刄，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"主夭折。煞星逢貴，能伏諸煞。天月二徳加臨日上，一徳當權，衆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"凶皆散，吉曜加臨，災反為祥。煞去逢空，煞去逢旺而凶，煞去逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"絶而亡。女忌血蠱，男忌光。官符怕火，喪門怕水。男怕擎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305418767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"天，女怕遊奕。男愛紅鸞，女愛天喜。喪門加於白虎，主有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"孝服之事。官符臨於刼煞，必生口舌之嘆。須要見行吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"星之地，忌在刼煞之上，嫌於拱臨之中。限行臨於惡曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"一年反背而已。吉星臨於運限，門庭多生喜色。日時莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"逢太嵗，不死一年多迍。少年限行禄馬，為人愈康愈徤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"少年限行死絶，必生迍邅之憂。老者限行生旺，必是孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"身之漢，損尅成家之子。老来限行庫墓，必擅鄉尊之福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"又有優游之樂。能察經中之句，敢斷命限祥災。判吉判","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123891723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"凶知生死，明如日月寳鏡臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"子中單，癸水　丑巳癸辛當。寅中甲丙戊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"卯獨乙為良。辰中乙癸戊，巳丙戊庚藏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"午中丁及巳，未乙丁巳鄉。申隠庚壬位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"酉字只辛强。戌上辛丁戊，亥為壬甲方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028355538970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳之年丙作首，　乙庚之嵗戊為頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛之嵗從庚上，　丁壬壬位順行流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"更有戊癸何方起？　甲寅之上可推求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"看太陽在何宫，以生時加太陽宫起，順數。如太陽在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051792911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"子，即從子上起生時，挨丑順數至夘，便是立命宫。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"看太陽躔第㡬度，以量天尺對立命躔何宿，第㡬度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
