{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男隂女順行，隂男陽女逆行，俱從本生月起。順行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"者，數未来節氣；逆行者，數巳往節氣。皆以三日為一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗。少一日者，借一日，多一日者，减一日。只論立春、驚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"蟄、清明、立夏、芒種、小暑、立秋、白露、寒露、立冬、大雪、小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"寒，論節不論氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028221272127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子曰：觀夫大運者，乃八字之表裏也。取用當度其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"淺深，成嵗須較夫多寡。然三日而成一嵗，見有餘，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之零；見不足，人謂之借。但知其零借，不知其所以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"零借。假如陽命正月初一日丑時正一刻生，至初四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"日丑時正一刻立春節，乃作一嵗。全。若立春在寅時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"則多一時，乃零一旬也。若欠一時，乃借一旬也。又以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"行運之法論之，假如甲子年正月初一日子時正一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"刻生，行運算至乙丑年正月初一日子時正一刻，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028355555354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"作一嵗，內小六箇月，即進六日，在初七日子時正一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"刻，方作一嵗，只要算足十二月，却為本年有閏四月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"乃多一月矣。當退還本年十二月初七日子正一刻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"交運。從此算後十週年方换一運，倣此永無差悞。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"學者不知其生刻，獨知其生時，即以生時扣算交節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，亦不差逺。凡行運在干，𠔥用地支之神，在支則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"棄天干之物，其間理妙，自宜詳玩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":807,"lineType":9,"content":"起小運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453000123875339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"凡小運不論隂陽二命，男一嵗起丙寅順行，女一嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"起壬申逆行。一宫或與大運相合相生，或臨祿馬貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"人之鄉，其年即有喜慶。或與大運相衝相刑，或交併，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"更臨反伏吟及煞方，其年即主破財、悲泣、死亡、孝服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"男怕衝，女怕併。又云：君子不刑不發，不併不達。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"大運如天將，太嵗如人君，二者相得相和，然後隨事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"所至，逢善則吉，逢刑則凶。所逢者，當生年有則吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"重，當生年無則吉凶輕。乆困而運通，未必通，乆通而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429733927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"運困，未必困。賦云：寅午雖逢於冠帶，尚有餘災；行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"初至於衰鄉，猶披勘福。五行衰者運宜旺，五行旺者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"運宜衰。仔細推詳，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子曰：小運者，補大運之不足而立名也。古人以男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"起丙寅，女起壬申為從三陽三隂之象，以是定逐年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福，鮮有左驗。予嘗見一秘書，以為男女小運皆由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"時生，而行之逆順亦以年定。如陽命陽年，甲子時生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"墮地即行，乙丑，二嵗丙寅，一位一年，週而復始。隂命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028221222975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"隂年，逆行亦然。嘗試用之，屢驗。亦要與大運及柱內","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"用神日主較量吉凶，及童限未交大運，専用此法，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶煞旺之宫，必有厄難。先詳八字衰旺喜忌，然後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"以此叅詳，蔑不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":855,"lineType":9,"content":"起大限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"琴堂洞微皆同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫十五為例，以太陽正處為中度，遇交宫隨宫交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"三度起一嵗。如立命在子，女二、女三、女四共三度起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"十一嵗，女五、女六、女七共三度起，十二嵗，女八、女九、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453008978067475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"女十起，十三嵗後照此順推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"如八月十四日太陽在巳翼十度，照量天尺本行下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"推，即十三嵗出童限入寅。二十三卯，三十三辰，四十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"八巳，五十七午，六十四未，七十五申之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行限遇生我之星定福，尅我之星定禍。若生星守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"限，更限主飛去又逢生，謂之體用俱生。若限主飛在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"别宫受尅，謂之體重用輕，主是限中有吉有凶。若限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"主受尅得重，則雖𤼵而難出此限矣，若有救亦無害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453009636458536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":885,"lineType":9,"content":"起小限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"從命宫起，逆轉，如亥生人立命在丑，就丑上數亥，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"年在子，丑年在亥，寅年在戌，夘年在酉，辰年在申，巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"年在未，午年在午，未年在巳，申年在辰，酉年在卯，戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"年在寅之例。以宫分言，則一命宫，二財帛，三兄弟，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅，五男女，六奴僕，七妻妾，八疾厄，九遷移，十官禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"十一福徳，十二相貌。逆數右轉。以限度言，則一命宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453025134264330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"二相貌，三福徳，四官祿，五遷移，六疾厄，七妻妾，八奴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"僕，九男女，十田宅，十一兄弟，十二財帛。順數左旋，宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"分次第，不可亂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"小限者，是流年生日後交過宫，其吉其凶，一依大限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"斷之。若在財帛，遇吉發財，遇凶破財，兄弟等上禍福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"一一依宫斷之，無有不驗，須叅原守及流年兩斷乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"小限宫中起生月，名為月限訣。凡一年休咎，在小限一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429750311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"宫內，若十二月吉凶，則散居十二宫。如小限在申，值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"恩星、官、福、田、財等吉宿臨之，是年發福。若值煞難凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"星，其年必災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"月限亦然。如正月看申宫，二月未、三月午、四月巳，依宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"逐月逆週十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"從小限行到太隂所泊之宫，起生月逆數，遇凶吉斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"之。假如午生人，午上安命，戌年小限在寅。三月生，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"月在寅。四月丑、五月子，次第逐月移宫，謂之月限，輪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453010051809295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"流十二宫，週而復始，行一宫，遇吉凶斷之。假如戊子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"年，丑宫安命，流土為太嵗，流木為喪門、病符，流水為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"的刼，流金為官符。月限十宫，逐月出入，見木炁則此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"月有災事，見火羅則此月有喜事發財。以當生流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"一體論之，見木則病或孝服，見流金則官事，見流水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"則費財、口舌不寧，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":949,"lineType":9,"content":"日宿者直日之宿也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"月限又將日宿𠔥推，須以太隂為主。月是流年，太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305402383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"即人之身也。行度甚速，兩日半過一宫，故日月之災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"福繫焉。以之加命，看當生流年㑹何吉凶星，隨遇而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"如命坐巳、未、申三宫，以月水為主，喜金水、月木，畏火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"羅、土計，却看流月行宫，遇何日宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"若日宿遇亢牛𡝤鬼金度，乃生命之宿，遷官近貴得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"財。遇斗奎井角木度，乃尅難之星，解災獲福。遇參箕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"軫壁，水度，乃本行之星，室家和好，事業安平。遇心危","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028355571738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"畢張，月度，亦本行之星，朋友康寧，內外親睦。遇女氐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"栁胃土度，災病口舌，官符是非。若二限䧟弱，身命主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"星，逢刑遇煞，禍病死傷。遇尾翼觜室火度，是非瘡熱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"驚恐啾唧。若二限䧟弱，與女、氐、栁、胃、土難度同斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"若辰酉安命，以金為主，流月喜逢胃、栁、女、氐之日，宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"忌尾、室、翼、觜之宿，餘倣此推。仍將原守流年十二曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"利害之星叅看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊子年丑宫安命者，則流土為太嵗，流木為喪門、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"病符，流水為的刼、白虎、煞，流火為太隂、吊客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788723747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"如以丑安命，土為主，見木炁則災，見火羅喜事、財名；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"流木疾病、孝服；流水破財，是非不寧。將當生與流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kusl0/1-SK1609_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=I9EAfMQ%2F3rAAUSMPuL4L4vmXat4%3D","pictureHeight":347,"pictureWidth":369,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kusl0/1-SK1609_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=EMR9zqc56g%2F6ImqbIqEBV9qTWvY%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kusl0/1-SK1609_figure_00023.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432451619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"育吾子方裒集刪定諸家星命之說，以廣厥傳，忽有客","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"坐而問曰：五星麗於天者也，凡民麗於地者也，天地邈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"不相及，胡術家者流以五星而推人禄命，其說亦有理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129112076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"與？余應之曰：天地不外隂陽，隂陽不外五行，人不能外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"五行以生五星，乃五行之精凝結成𧰼，天𡸁以示人者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"也。人之生也，禀天地之精英，萃隂陽之造化，天星運於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"上而適恊厥期，人命鍾於下而感與天通。是故長庚入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"夣而太白生，歲德下臨而曼倩降，郎官應宿，庶民惟星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"以五星而推人禄命，其理至著，其道至微，但術者未盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"知耳。客曰：星命之說，固云有理，然所以推星與命者，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"吾未之喻也。敢問何以先排十二宫？一命宫、二財帛、三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129095692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟，四田宅、五男女，六奴僕，七妻妾，八疾厄、九遷移、十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄、十一福德、十二相貌，其立名次序，無乃牽强也與？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：人之生也，以身命為主，故命宫為第一。財為養命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"之源，故次二。分我之財者獨兄弟，故次三。田宅所以安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"命藏財而居兄弟，故次四。既有財帛、兄弟、田宅，而男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"所以承田與財者也，故次五。奴僕所以輔男女，故次六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾敵體，與命宫對衝，故次七。夫自命宫而至妻宫，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"敘自不可亂。疾厄，人命之所不能無者，故次八。遷移，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453013532999706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"之所不能免者，故次九；官禄，天之所予，係於命而最要，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"故次十；福德，人之所享，係於天而難得，故次十一；相貌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"所以成身，故次十二。自疾厄而至相貌，其敘却乃倒言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？十二宫之中，命與妻相對，相貌、福德、官禄出天上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"故列在身前；財帛、兄弟、田宅隱地下，故敘在身後；遷移、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄、妻妾，限數最緊，皆太陽過午而行促。有相貌而後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"見福德，有福德而後居官禄，有官禄而後厯遷移，有遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"移而後見疾厄，自相貌而至於疾厄，皆日月之喜升而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129079308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"惡沉。有財帛而後見兄弟，有兄弟而後分田宅，有田宅而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"後歸男女，有男女而後居奴僕。自財帛而至奴僕，皆日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"之右轉而分布。人之所以為人，不過如此，故十二宫之名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"足以𥁞人之一生也。男女身命所生，遷移父子所専；兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"弟和樂、妻奴雍睦，人之福德，此二者最難。財與官禄相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"連，奴僕所以服官而營財也；貌為疾厄所苦，田宅所以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"安身而養疾也，故皆三合。此十二宫流行之敘，對代之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"體，錯綜之用有如此，子殆未之思乎？客曰：星盤十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462074422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"既聞命矣，然何以午未屬天，子丑屬地，亥寅屬木，卯戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火，辰酉屬金，已申屬水，與五行地支十二之理不同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"又何說與？余曰：五行以寅卯為木，已午為火，申酉為金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子為水，辰戌丑未為土，乃地支十二維也。午與未合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"居於上，而屬乾，故以為天；子與丑合居於下，而屬坤，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"以為地。上天下地，一定之體也。亥與寅合屬春，故以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"木；卯與戌合屬夏，故以為火；辰與酉合屬秋，故以為金；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"已與申合屬冬，故以為水。春夏秋冬，四時之序也。日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462107190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"麗天，水金輔之，故喜金水；土石麗地，木火生之，故喜木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"火。此雖與地支十二維分布不同，而其道理則相貫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"客又曰：人一日之生，不啻億萬，何以從太陽為命，太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"為身，遂據此斷吉凶禍福？僕未深信，敢問其故何也？余","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：善哉問，我明告子。天形如卵而左旋，日月代明而右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"轉。天體日週，東方常抽，惟其東抽，是以西沉，一沉一抽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"無停留也。太陽之升出在東方，太隂之没入在西鄊，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"升一没，無差忒也。人之出乎胎中，即天轉乎地上。若是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462123574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"卯時而生，天日俱出東廂。惟卯時以後，天體無形，以日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"為準，故因日而數至卯，即卯地而出蒼穹。太隂，日之配，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"身之所自出也。故以太陽立命，太隂安身。身命，人之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"最重者，故先求此二宫天體度數各有對度，是以日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"同其好惡，身命同其禍福。東出父命，西没孃身；東出太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，西没太隂；東出亢金，西没婁金；東出井木，西没斗木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"故琴堂有身命一般般之說，葢為此也。客又問曰：人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"身命同乎天地，得夫子之教，已喻其理。但加關之說，樓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429897767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"上架樓，而禍福却以為準，又何理與？願盡洩天機以教，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"僕請授業於門焉。余曰：前言巳盡，子猶未深悟乎？夫天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"開於子，地闢於丑，人生寅出卯，千竅萬妙，不出一卯。天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"盤之加，順天左旋十二宫；地盤之關，因日右轉十二宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"洞微飛數，遍周天皆左旋；陽九小限，逐日月皆右轉。曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"加曰關，惟卯互換。地盤卯酉，定地不易天盤卯酉房昴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"是的。前言人之生也，因天體之出卯也。天運不息，不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"昴卯，故隨所生而值所宿，皆謂之卯酉也。吾人之卯酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429881383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"以天日之卯酉為準，故以卯加命宫，此之謂三才合一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"道理，故吉凶禍福可得而判也。星之源流，吾已畧註，望","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"斗三盤之法，詳著卷首，子取而觀之，予何言哉？客又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"星家源流，其理既同，然何以有準於古而差於今，驗於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"今而謬於古，其故又何？僕也惑，敢問。余曰：此天道自然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"之運也。天之運也，積氣曰月，五星，積氣之光曜者也。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"循行次舍，七十年而差一度。天道且然，而况於人乎？世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"有升降，國有隆汚，皆囿於天道自然之運。人乃積氣中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788789283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"之動物，身之用舍，道之行藏，又囿於國家一時之運。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"古今人命之所以不同，而星家準與不準之辯，咸在此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。客恍然而悟，醒然而得，再拜而退。閱數日，請見，作而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：今夫天日陽精忌火，月隂精忌土，五行獨以火、土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"惡，為日月所畏；以金、水、木為善，為日月所喜。今夫人凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"水、凡木、凡金、凡火、凡土，為命主皆日，為身主皆月。忌有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之不齊，皆火土；喜有五行之不一，皆金水、木，此亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"是否乎？余黙然不答。客退不敢復言。或又有問曰：諸星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305566223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"家俱以太隂為身，琴堂雖有身命一般般之說，乃是命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"宫所喜，身亦喜之。如命度屬金喜土，太隂傍土，亦不為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"忌，謂之安身傍母。今夫子答客，乃不以太隂為身，而以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"身為太隂所自出，不知指何者為身也？答曰：命者，父之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"所鍾；身者，母之所生。星家既以太陽數至卯為命，獨不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"以太隂數至酉為身，葢未悟耳。夫十二宫，命宫與妻宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"正對，合為夫婦，有夫婦然後人生焉。是身命乃夫婦所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"出，觀立命則立身可知矣。東升是命，西没是身，可見當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788772899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"以命對宫之度為身，不可直指太隂為身。此身命所以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"為一，般般而好惡禍福同也。此余獨得之妙，因子問而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"盡發之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"士君子凡欲看命，先看身命二主落在何宫，専以空、實、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"强、弱、夾、拱、衝、驀八字，定其人品出處高下；次以福、禄、恩、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"官、田、財六主，定其貧富貴賤、真假輕重；然後次以金、木、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"水、火、土、炁、羅、計、孛、日、月十一曜、天德、月德，并的、刄、刼、煞、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432549923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞、白虎、華葢、六害等，守命安身，以分其為君子小人、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"奸直、麄細之性行。却以大小二限、太歲、流旬直難填實、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"逢空有無貼襯之𩔖，以斷其發達衰遲、好惡生死。大要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫所主𦂳切處，吉星坐實，勝居强位，凶星落空，勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"居弱宫。明實不如暗實，原空不若流空，有實不如有夾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"有夾不如有拱。空其位莫若空其星，實其主莫若空其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。貴人禄馬殿駕，此五者明浄純粹，喜天恩拱福，不喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"拱煞黨惡。日月、官、福、田、財，此六者喜互換飛出，坐實不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462058038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"喜雜煞，散漫無情。用星不可被傷，身星不宜落䧟。天煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"地煞切忌拱福拱官，駕前駕後，尤怕逢刄逢的。身命逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"官無實拱，禄秩難高。福官坐實值身空，發施不出。身官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"值好，既能貴而臨事俱能。福恩兩高，縱遇險而依還不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"險。如身命二主并限主值流旬，一齊空却，須看限宫拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"夾之有無，直難天地二煞夾身者，有空亡限行其上，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"防凶死，但遲一歩爾。大抵恩能取信，恩一䧟而信令不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"行。福能保官，福一空而官居不久。福嫌身弱，田忌財空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432566307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱福强，似病人而挑重擔；田高財䧟，如浪子而逞風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"流。忽然福，忽然灾，多是殺恩守命；暫時貧，暫時富，定縁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"直難傷財。論尅父母，在古說則無此理，而今以生害之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"理推之。如計犯月，夜生人必先尅父；羅犯日，晝生人必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"先尅母。此乃隂陽相峙，子午流注之理。或是日月同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之日月合朔，日生人必先尅母，夜生人必先尅父。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"日月衝照，謂之日月對望，日生尅母，夜生尅父，葢取其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"有光無光之義也。日生人，太陽落隂宫，則父先亡；夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453025134395402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"人，太隂落陽宫，則母多先死。隂陽反背之義也。至於夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"妻男女，俱有成法，兹不復論。但琴堂星法，其𤣥妙只在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"空實二字，其禍福只在夾拱二字。貴賤真假，須㸔四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"上四箇實字，俱有吉曜得用之星守之。三方左右夾拱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"有力福星，恩、官、田、財各得其實，當決定作真富貴命斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"之。或四柱上實地只有二處守吉星，則看其所守者是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"何宫主，如是田財之主，則其人可富。或身星限星强，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"此命必是自家成立發達。或日月、田財、命主都守實，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305615375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"斷其人必多祖業承䕃有餘，生平不受勞碌。如命主守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄，或坐天月二德、貴人禄馬，有實字拱夾者，則知其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"為文獻衣冠，故家之裔，有德守成之士也。或身命同文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星坐文昌長生實地者，須分晝夜日月司天之法看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"之，則知其人有學有識，極聰明，多才多藝之士也。或身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"命守的刄、刼煞、白虎、六害之宫，或的刄、六害、咸池之𩔖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"夾之，則知其人為奸麄小人，市井𡬶常之徒也。或天月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"二德、貴人禄馬，雜的刄、刼煞、白虎、六害之𩔖，守夾身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462025270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"二主者，則知其人界乎君子小人之間也。或天馬守實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"地馬逢空，身命二主與之同宫者，則知其人乃幫閑隨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"時附勢之徒也。或身命與金炁孛同守天空，或入兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"宫者，則多浮蕩江湖，醫卜賣活之軰無疑。或身命主坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕貴人禄馬衝夾，此則多在公府皁隷之𩔖。其他可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"依此例活法斷之，不可具述也。如病人欲問其目下生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"死，或凡人行限，問其壽夭應在何年月日者，其要只把","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"各年太歲逐宫輪轉，看其宫分，原有何吉凶星守之。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500405787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲帶的刄、禄馬、貴人之𩔖值年填之，以分其灾福。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲帶刄，填起煞星衝我命宫，并大小二限者，斷其人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"是何年月日灾病破財。或是官禄主星在限上，被其當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"頭衝填，其煞入官禄之宫，又有直難的刄重見，被太歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"填實，則知其人此年必因官事囚禁，破耗勞苦，大不稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"心，有官則剥官停俸，次年有恩星填實救之，則可解脫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"或太歲填煞入福德財帛田宅者，則止破財營運，不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"有利，門户疊見繁擾，却無他重災。其餘妻子奴僕之宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453013533016090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"並依此例推之。如身命二主逢空，大限主星又落空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"後限主星又不如先者，流年太歲一連趕起的刃三箇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"地煞到命到限，其年小限主星又作煞論者，并其月令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"透出黨三煞，又有直難坐實，則善病而亡。若太嵗一般","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"趕煞到身，亦未即死。大凡欲逐流年看星，必須以流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗論之。葢太嵗能吊起三方之星，如太嵗在申，則能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"吊起子辰二宫，其三宫所得力之星一時皆動，是名吊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"起之法。其太嵗所守之位有星並皆填起，其吉凶動靜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305631759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"皆由此而應，如士大夫功名之人，問動靜則以催官、天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"禄、天馬之𩔖。太嵗吊起之法，依正經所載，一一斷之，萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"不失一。大槩煞星乃小人之𧰼，偏喜合不喜衝，故太嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"三合吊之有吉則能成吉，衝宫之衝有凶則能成凶，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"謂小人女子合則喜，衝則怒也。天理人事，一而二，二而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"一也。其實皆可以理推其玄微，以形像求其彷彿。夫吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"凶消長、得失存亡之道，固不可以預知，然果能依此求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"之，雖不中，不遠矣。然易有言曰：君子修之吉，小人悖之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500422171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。則天理本具於人心，修身之道或可消非於無，妄迎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄於大有者，必灼然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"化化者，如命主財帛田宅、主福德官禄，身主并天元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"禄主是也。凡此六主，一元命限，見之皆不作煞斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129128460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"此即所謂化也。其餘主星，惟金星無餘炁，計、羅、孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"除化天元禄不作煞斷外，餘皆一例作煞論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"氣盛衰消長，隨時𠮓易之義。五星論氣，當隨氣運𠮓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"遷而觀之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"體靜也。謂如四柱中有八箇干支，乃無形不動之定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"位，分布於十二宫，以填實地，戴五星日月四餘，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"行原守流年衝合焉，是則所謂體也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"用，動也。謂如十一曜皆動物，行度有遲留伏逆，躔於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432599075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫分，隨其躔處以論所屬，并大小二限，定吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"凶焉，此則所謂用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"星，天星、日、月、金、木、水、火、土、孛羅、炁計、天禄、天馬、催官、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"實，謂四支中所有四字，於十二宫中填於本位是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"拱，謂三方拱向，如申、子、辰、亥、卯、未之類，要四柱有字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"為實拱也。大凡看有用之星，極喜拱處，是名真富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453032432582691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，惟煞星的刄，若有拱，極禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"夾謂左右夾起，如子寅二位，實能夾丑宫之類，與拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"同。斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"衝：衝謂對宫有實字，即能衝起本宫也。凡空者，若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫一實字衝之，禍福之星皆起本宫。如有實字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"不怕衝，若本宫原守落空，須得一實字衝之纔實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"凡煞星落空不喜衝，有用之星落空，則喜衝起。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"原守嵗駕一字衝之，不問本空實與不實，並衝得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305598991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"落空，禍福皆不能准。流年嵗駕若至各宫，除有用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"之星逢空，喜他衝起，若煞星逢空，不喜他衝起，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"流駕輪還填起。各宫若值有用之星，是名太嵗有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"情，則一年凡事稱意，喜美進益。若填煞難的刄之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"星，是名太嵗填煞，則一年災敗。或值福空限空，并","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"身命恩星皆逢空，流年復惡，則多死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"合：　即上文拱者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"貼：　貼襯，謂命宫、身星、官、福、田、財等主星飛起别宫，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129161228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"值四柱空亡，及流旬空𨚫，本不為吉，緣他宫主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"雖空，我命限二宫支上又有字填起，是名貼襯有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"力，雖危無咎。若貼襯無力，一空却死矣。此法有驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"看星凡例八條","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命宫有星無星，并主星飛出何宫，得令不得令，母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"星尅制化伏身星傍毋傍鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"二看天元禄，主官福田財如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"三看禄勲卦氣，驛馬天馬地驛，貴人在年月日時否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500389403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"四看刼亡的刄，桃花冠帶紅喜，有碍無碍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"五看滿盤空亡，四柱虛實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"六看大小二限，流年神煞，十二宫神比和生尅如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"七看直難，小兒最緊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"八看四柱天干俱化吉凶，若福禄權貴印守命大貴限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"逢亦發。又看納音生尅上壽夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":9,"content":"看星節要八十一條","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"一看五星之法，先排太陽，以生時加在太陽度上，逆數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177054771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"至卯，則知安命在何宿何度，方為端的。須是以度主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"為要，宫主次之。葢宫主者，州郡也，度主者，縣令也。由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"縣而州，其宫主必要逢生得令，不要尅制，不為太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"所伏，及三方四正無星相尅方好。更看度主，又坐高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"强，又坐禄馬，長生嵗駕，又逢生旺得時為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"一、立命既定，更看是晝生夜生。晝生人不要火、金、月、孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"羅照命，夜生人不要日、木、土、炁計照命，名曰五殘星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主貧賤。不然則多憂少樂，生平成敗，碌碌到老，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043970883611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"不切中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"一、立身在何度何宫，晝生人看命度主，夜生人看身度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"主。如上弦望前望後，及下弦生者，看身度主為𦂳，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"如命度之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"一、須先看福德宫為𦂳。葢人生處世，以福為最，有福則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"有妻子，立名利，致富貴。福德既虧前數者，未見其可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"得也。福德者，人生一世之主，若見福居禄，禄居福，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"主命主入福，又有日月照福德，權貴䕃映之星入福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305664527"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"德，金水夾月居福德，皆是有福之人。為人性必端厚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"量必寛洪仁慈，處世無刻薄之患，有福有壽，可以定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"人性情，毎試果驗。若見土計坐福德者，必寡言語，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"性沉重。若見福德宫有刑囚耗星居其上者，必是刻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"薄之人，凶悍之徒，大寛小急，不仁不義之流，心多好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"殺，言不忠信，詭譎欺詐，奸謀機巧，未見其為福。如福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"德宫無好星，又看三合對照，有何星守照。如三合對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"照守照俱無星，亦未可便言其吉凶，更看財帛宫如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043970916379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"一、財帛宫亦人生受用大端也。或福禄守財帛，日月照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛，田財互垣，命身二主臨財，財帛又逢生旺，得令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"得時，是乃有禄之人。斯人既是有財，則可以養妻子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"致奴僕。既有財則有名。若財主失經刑囚暗耗照財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"帛，是無用之人。如財帛不好，未可便言其吉凶。又去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"看田宅宫何如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"一、田宅之位亦人生受用之源。如田宅主星不起，或有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429963303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳照田宅，日月照田宅，身命坐田宅，亦看作有財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"名望之人既有田宅，則妻子皆自田宅而出。人之一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"生，福徳、田宅、財帛三宫既無吉星，便不可以為福，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"是𡬶常碌碌，成敗命斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看生平行限如何。如人一生命好身吉，若行限不好，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"却不作發福論之。葢命好不如限好，如身命好，行限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"又好，方是好命。葢命為魂，身為魄，限為血氣，三者須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"要相扶。譬如人之一身，血氣稍滯則血不流，故為寒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788871203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"熱相攻，瘡毒並作，風邪客氣得以侵之。若血氣和暢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"其身既壯，安得有病也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"一、行限須要向明不背方吉。何謂向明？夜生人，見火金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"月當限，日生人，見日木土水炁當限，皆謂向明，發福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"可期。如日生人，不曽見日木土星，又皆獨見火金月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"照限行限又經行的煞刼、煞陽刃三煞空亡之上，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"可以發跡許之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"一、凡大小限，以生日後交神煞禄貴，以冬至日後交命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043970899995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"宫行度。九嵗以前在童限，至十嵗上本生度起行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看命須要看得令為𦂳，如春木、夏火、秋金、冬水，土則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"寄旺四季為令。令者，如臣禀君令，宣其教化，生民休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"戚係焉。以令主之不背，則赫然號令，從所瞻仰。立春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"木為令，主發生則萬木萃於春，為人亦清麗煥彩。然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"木既主令，金不可尅，木乃掌時月之星，金當藏刃，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"則培木，只怕金土參差，是為逆亂伐上，禍由斯𤼵，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"為凶厄。夏月火陽當空，水縱泛濫，豈敢侵月令之火？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462156342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"金廢則沮於爍石流金之勢，何所用焉？亦當廢𣓪。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"夏金多行南方，若金火日用事，必有酒色之疾。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"當廢之星主事，為人志大謀踈，虛空無實，愚而好自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"用，平生怏然，易於退失。只怕金水相合，與火爭勢，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"反逆之曜，以此用事，主凶惡而不得其死。秋金用事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"大火西流，本自棄置，萬木黄落。當廢之時，惟金司權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"逆金為禍。若水火相合，既不受令，又有陸梁，安得不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"凶？冬水沍隂，必藉火為順流温助之宿，土為隄防之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453035305713679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"星，皆無傷用事之時，却水木無相生之理，相合氷凍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"若水星夜見，以之用事，其人必孤寒。大抵令星春時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"必借土為栽培之宿，冬月火土自為相生相養，亦與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"水而濡沐者，雖星廢不當時，却畢竟相為表𫟚，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"只有火金月不可相見，必不能相順，見之禍𤼵。令星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"從陽，順則吉，為賛助恊翊之星，逆則凶，為䟦扈飛揚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"之宿。所以順者，或引陽，或從陽，逺在十度，不為尅奪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂逆者，侵陽用事。令星最要得日君行事，居有氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129193996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"之位，與命不相反，方為令自出。稍為尅奪，則是聽令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"於人。令星司奪，當之必死。令星司福，用之必祥。五星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"犯殿傷宿，即尅奪之星也。主為人行所不為之事，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"受人所不受之禍，萬萬必中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太嵗最為𦂳要。大凡人命要主星臨駕，與太嵗相關","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"攝，則富貴，嵗君不收録，則無用之人。又忌煞星破駕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命身與福德為重，有禄無福，禄將安享；有命無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"身，命將安保？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051462172726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"一、凡煞星不要逢時，要失時，如春水逢金，冬水逢土之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"類。煞星失時，主星有氣。凡火為煞，不宜晝生人；土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，不宜夜生人；木為煞，防春；金為煞，防秋；水為煞，防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"冬；火防夏，皆得時失時之妙論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"一、金星若在太陽之宫，名曰映進，若作命主在太陽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"前，為特進，各名曰金星映日，又曰金星當權，皆主權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。太陽之前，只喜身度主、命度主及金星在前者，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"作吉論。若太陽之前，或是刑囚暗耗，名曰誤進，十進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185363519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"不吉。命主及金星在太陽之後者，名曰後進，其福减","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星並行，有先有後，大凡煞星則欲其前行，主星則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"欲其後至。且如水火二星同行，水能尅火，則以水為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星。如水星在前行，則不能尅火，如火在前，水在後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"其煞逼身，最為利害，不可不審，諸星皆然。經云：煞前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"主後，當膺藩輔之權；煞後主前，必有徒流之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：身命二星若無尅，須交金向木前行；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043970932763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"水火二星不相尅，　更饒水向火前行；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"土月二星無相食，　最宜月向土前行；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"土之行遲月行疾，　不分前後極難言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星退行，有退而有力者，有退而無力者。且如退而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"有力，火金二星同行，金在前，火在後而退行，此煞星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"不敢進前以尅其金，是退而有情。如或金星退遇火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"順行，是退而逢其煞也，五曜皆然。亦有退而升殿，退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"而入垣，退而逢生，皆為有情，又作吉論；或退而坐煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177071155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"退而逢煞，或退惡弱之宫，皆為無力，可作凶論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"一遲留伏逆，五星中緊要，學者不可不明。遲則順度，留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"則不行，伏則不見，逆則退行。有用之星，順行為福，遲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"留伏逆，進退减力。經曰：順則優游，逆則退縮。留則拘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"繋抑欝，伏則韜晦無光。如命午太陽，忌木炁同躔，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"前日後，退之為禍，日前木後，退之為福。留者，用星留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"於實地，為福久遠。煞星留於實地，為禍不休。若留於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"虛地，禍福皆無。伏者，用星伏則無力，忌星伏則無灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788887587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"逆者，退行也，有退為福，有退為禍，以理推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：五星遇日須當伏，　三合逢陽必定留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"若是對宫為逆度，　不逢陽處是為遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"一、羅計截斷半天星，有吉有凶。或截斷諸星在左，而限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"行右，名曰反背行限，不遇諸星故也。又有升沉之不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"同，或日生而諸曜當天，截在辰巳午未、申位，而有星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"行限從酉戌、亥、子、丑、寅位，而無星者，為不得體。又有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生截斷在戌亥子、丑、寅位，而有星，行限從辰已午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453012429979687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"未、申位，而無星者，皆為升沉之不同，並不合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"一、羅計截斷半天星，斗有跳出一星在外者，當専論在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"外一星禍福。如跳出一星為福主禄文命主身主，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁權貴星，夜火、夜月、晝木、晝土，皆為得格，主人必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"有富貴名利之事。如跳出一星刑、囚暗耗，或奴僕主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刄刼煞、的煞主星，晝生而火漏出，夜生而土漏出，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"在外者皆不合格，主人貧賤勞役，奔波勞碌，度世無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"成，不為吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185330751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"一、截斷不要太陽跳出，如太陽格在外，名曰孤君孤遁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"君而無輔，極為不好，葢太陽乃人君之𧰼，必諸星輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"佐而行，或左右，皆為吉論。若太陽孤立，主其人不得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"人之力，雖親輔人，人多遠之，平生勞苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星聚㑹，有吉㑹，有凶㑹。吉㑹者為命主、身度主官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"魁福、禄，或化權、貴䕃印，皆為吉㑹，雖是火羅計孛，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"無害。如不為前項等星，而為的刼陽刄等主，或化刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"囚暗耗，皆為凶㑹，不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177087539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命主坐奴僕，有凶有吉。貴人之命，多有身命主入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕而貴者，亦有入奴僕而賤者。如奴僕宫主，原是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人、禄馬、長生、帝旺、籍駕、殿勲、垣卦之地，皆不可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕論，皆是大貴之命。如奴僕宫主，原是刼的、亡、刃、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"死、絶、暴敗之鄉，而身命限主居其上，皆是奔波勞役","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"無成之人，方可以奴僕言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"一太陽孤立照妻宫，皆主夫妻年紀不等，不然妨尅重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"婚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177120307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"一太隂正照妻宫，皆主妻妾無貌，不然亦非正禮而婚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"緣太隂虧盈之不常也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"一、夜生人，太陽獨照男女宫，無星以輔之，其人主無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生而見太隂在男女宫，無星以輔之，亦無子。夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"人惟有水輔日在男女宫，反主有子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
