{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"一、妻宫不論妻妾宫主星，假如甲子年丙寅月，寅亥木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"垣，木為兄弟，乙已日已乃水垣，為妻妾。水得地逢生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"坐實，則妻賢貌美，内助榮夫。或坐籍駕禄馬貴人，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185379903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"因妻致富。或水星坐空脫之地，逢煞星同行，皆不好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，或無妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"一、男女宫。不論男女宫主，只以時論之。如丙戌時，卯戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"火垣，火星逢生坐實禄馬貴人之地者，皆主得貴子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"火若虛脫或逢煞，主無子，送終必有損破，否則破蕩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"之子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命須是四正為𦂳，或日月照四正，或金木照四正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"福德照四正，及用星居四正之地，皆貴，乃有受用之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177103923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"人。亦有火羅計孛守四强，及化得好者，皆為合格。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"是刑囚暗耗等星居於四正宫中，而逢相尅之曜，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"主破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"一看諸星皆如看命之法，亦看三合，亦看正照，方斷吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。大抵論三合，四餘輕，五星重，對照，四餘重，五星輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"葢四餘乃横衝直突之曜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"一看帶疾，先看命度身度，受尅與不受尅，及起處坐煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"與不坐煞，更看疾厄宫中何星坐其上。如疾厄宫有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044704837643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅計孛、刑囚暗耗諸凶星併㑹其上者，皆主重疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"如疾厄宫無星，而三方對照，有凶惡之星夾照者，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命主度主起，坐刼的亡刄，主人尅害父母，骨肉不全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"或出祖破祖，過房自立，方免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"一、遊行坐驛馬，主人過房出祖。坐長生馬者，有四方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命主起遷移，入兄弟奴僕宫者，皆主出祖過房，偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177136691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"生庶出也，試之驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"一、十干坐命，如六甲生人，不要立命在金宿度上，名曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼尅，皆主不安勞役，只喜坐生星。坐水宿，名曰父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"之上，坐土宿，名曰財帛之上，坐火宿，名曰脫局之上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"當以意㑹消息，得時得令為好。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"一、男女宫有土、羅、火、計、孛、暗、耗刑、囚照者，其人多子女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"一年一産，及至老來，皆不得力，如鷄抱鴨相似。不然，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"忤逆之男多出在外，亦同無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177169459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐禄、坐貴、坐長生、坐庫、坐駕、坐殿、坐夾貴窠、坐禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"馬樞、坐生旺鄉，皆主富貴，不然亦主衣禄盈饒。天玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云禄馬貴人持世，立身須主清高。咸池凶煞臨身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"出處必然微賤是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐刼的亡刄、暴敗、空亡死絶、三煞、飛亷煞者，皆主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"人性不好，心險行怪，狠暴不仁，成敗勞苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"一、夾命要日月夾命，福禄夾命，官魁夾命，印貴夾命，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"合拱之者亦吉。或命度主，身度主，起在别處，而夾拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788969507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"之者不露人見，皆大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"一、刼的亡刄之宫，或凶星夾拱，其凶暴不可言，亦主死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"于非命。然無官符不成煞刄，無歲破不成刼的，無病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"符不成疾厄，此乃五行真生煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官禄不要星尅其宫，名曰官鬼。且如官禄在寅地，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"不要金星入內，亦不要三合四正宫值之，皆主其人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"健訟，不然遭官事，亦無食禄之分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官禄福德二宫，最要吉星臨，如日月居官禄福徳，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043970949147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄居官福水，曰金月各居官禄行限，遇之皆發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"如官福二宫無星，有吊起，或吉曜居其上者亦吉。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"看對照三合之宫，以斷休咎。富貴之人未嘗官福二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"宫無星，如二宫原無本星，官主又惡吊起對照，又無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰照臨，一生虛花無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人不要太陽坐命及照命，如身弱，皆主欺夫奪權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"性有男子志氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人田宅宫，如刑囚暗耗坐其宫，并有惡煞坐其上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044788936739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"者，皆主破耗，外家零落，兄弟無情。婦人最重田宅財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"帛之宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人坐驛馬，又帶水孛照身立命，或在五弱之宫，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"主淫奔，其餘與男子一體同斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命惡弱之星，則要其居䧟弱。明顯得用之星，則欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"其居高强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"一看八煞之宫，非但主人疾厄，亦主一生權柄之地。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"權星印星福星禄星居之，皆主人有權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177202227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"一、貴人之命多是䧟弱，有不可觀者，其中有一星得用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"坐煞得時，及官禄有吊起吉星暗加其位者，皆貴。不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"然三方有吉星交照官宫，又不然有吉星交照八煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"一、金星不要坐陽刄刼的煞之上，葢金星主煞，遇則煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"氣騰輝，為煞最重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太乙抱蟾，常人若見月與孛同行，謂之太乙抱蟾，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"也。須是上弦及望既望下弦，在未上見之，又生於戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177185843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑之時，方謂之太乙抱蟾。如非上弦下弦及望","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"前望後，名曰太乙抱鬼。如在辰亥戌子丑之宫，又是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"下弦既晦之後，遇之者名曰抱死鬼，却不為福。如他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"宫遇之，皆非抱蟾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命只可求其主星命度，命主身度，身主看强弱禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"福，不必諸星一一高强，一一得地。故經云：一星得地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"終為貴顯吉人。又云：使一星背而莫究其非，縱羣曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"吉而莫能為福。譬如五七員官員在任，不必員員識，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043970965531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"而其中有一員得力，則羣從州縣莫不刮目。觀星當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"以理推，其次看限主行限，須要限主高强，得地受生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星交㑹，方為好限發達，不然皆為不福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"一凡有用之星辰，要在高强，大抵小人命多是有用者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"居於䧟弱，無用者處於高强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：相生須用他生我，相尅還須我尅他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"他尅我時為禍大，我生他時福消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"有用為我，無用為他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046307061775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"一、論命必言身，論身必言命，二者出於一體。且如立命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑土為命主，木炁為難，火羅為恩，月為身主，亦以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"月為土之用星，並不可使月與木炁同宫，亦不可木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"炁合時與月，亦不可使土月二星躔於四木度，及泊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"於木宫，此二星倘逢木炁，又躔木度木宫，便見有禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"無福。如土月二星躔於火度，泊於火羅，便以吉斷，切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"不可以身命二主異用。父母、兄弟、妻子、田財限主，並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"可依此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453052783132712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官禄福徳二宫，主人中年成敗生死、富貴貧賤，於此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"實為利害。有中年一落千丈，有中年奮發馳騁，有中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"年衣紫腰金，有中年孤苦伶仃。福德且干係妻子兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，如吉星守照，於福德照妻照子，不但官中光景，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"許佳兒隹婦；如凶星守照，不但初年蹭蹬，亦早傷子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"刑妻。官禄干係田財二宫，如吉星守照，許其田財，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星守照，一生决無福矣。更所忌者，羅㬋守官禄，少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"年逞訟權豪，若為用恩二星，又許有用。不問是何命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453059942760500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"並依此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"一、晝生人，則要太陽在卯辰、巳、午、未上，方應晝生，為朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"陽向明之格。如日生人，太陽坐申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑之上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"皆非合局。夜生人，則要太隂照命行限，亦要火羅月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"金、孛當限，方為得體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"一、余論五星，毎毎推究太隂躔度次舍，斷禍福吉凶，貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"賤富貴，十有九中。葢人命以太陽為主，身宫以太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"為主，主本既危，何所根蒂？故凡日生人，當推太陽，夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453052783116328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"人，當推太隂。如日生太陽逢惡曜，夜生太隂逢凶曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"無不貧賤夭折。日生吉宿逢陽，夜生吉星釣月，無不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"功名富貴。然猶當論其在十五度中與不在度中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"一、木羅㑹舍，在寅上為㑹吉，葢木喜於寅，羅樂于寅，二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"星相得為㑹舍則吉，其他處不可以㑹舍言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"一、火炁為職權，在卯寅上方為合格。葢火入廟於卯，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"於寅，寅又炁星之垣，卯為炁旺之地，二星相生，故為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"職權，不以晝夜為忌，他宫減半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044789035043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐弱宫，主星又微，行限又微，一見好星在前，却不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"能勝其任，而命即亡。葢素貧賤而行乎貧賤，雖有富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，不能享也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐高强，主又高强，行限又好，一見凶惡之星在前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"而不能進。葢素富貴行乎富貴，雖有貧賤，不能處而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"一、人命合主有疾，而少年未見，乃是未曾遇煞星尅星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"行限，故不發也。一行煞地，又見煞星高强，决是重疾、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500553243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"廢疾，有中年患目患風者由此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"一日生人，自少至老，一見太隂在前，謂之陽極隂生，决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"主人死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"一夜生人，一生見行太隂，又行隂星之限，至老一見太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在前，謂之隂極陽生，决主人亡。又如命躔房日度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"行限至張月度必死，葢有月光而無日光也。又如躔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"心月度，行限至星日度必死，葢有日光而無月光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"然須看有無惡星當關，方可以此斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500569627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太隂逐月隨日而右轉，化金木水火土。太隂屬水，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜土月同躔，如太隂屬木，則不喜金月同躔，皆主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄妨尅。如更在亡煞刼刄空亡之鄉，决主其人亂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"說，言語不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"一、男女坐亡神，及主星起坐亡神，桃花帶馬者，而又有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"炁孛金水照之，皆主其人慷慨風流，歌唱風月。女人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"值之，决主為娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"一、定人心性，先以守照論。守照如無，以對照論。對照又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500586011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"無，以三合論。或四宫無星，以福徳宫論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命好星辰俱善柔，而不能作大事業，又要一凶星以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"助其權。大凡吉星多，凶星少，則以吉論。凶星多，吉星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"少，則以凶論。貴人之命，非權煞不能治世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"一、人命多有生時不定，以子為亥，以亥為子，以初為末，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"以末為初。故其言禍福不准，須加减定其災難，受制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"受尅，方能定其死生。故經云：一不可拘，二當敢斷。妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"在識其通𠮓。如是禍福不應，未可據言休咎。村居之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044704886795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"人，不近譙樓，標牌更皷之下，亦有晦㝠風雨，氣侯不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"齊，難以定時，故筭禍福不應。况古今聖賢立法，未有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"不驗，在意消詳以定之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"一、有人命不好而享用者，不當有妻子，有妻子者，何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"言之？或有父母在，𠋣恃父母福䕃，故安享受用；父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"一殁，便破敗，不當有妻子，而不能受妻子之奉，至于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"死亡而後已。一、有妻子在前，而命中無妻子，未至終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"身，妻子俱亡，零丁半世，孤寡至老。皆初年限路稍强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185445439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"因主其一時之榮；及至末年，限路一弱，氣運不佳，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"非所有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"一、有人命身好，初年行限不佳，未免奔波，辛苦無成，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以貧賤視之，一旦行限好，平地發跡立名利。故舜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"起側微，傅說起于版築，不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"一、人命皆要日月明㓗，方為吉論。葢天地以日月為主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月明淨，方始貴顯。故經云：貴人日月要分明，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"月不明非貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043971014683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"一、炁、孛、羅、計，乃四凶之星化凶，並皆要獨行，則主重權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"一、福禄權貴，亦要單行，方為顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"一、原守之星固好，又恐流年之星為患。如限主人惡人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，流年凶星重，則亦能死人，不可不察。若限主健，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"是流年為禍，必侯凶星出去方好。故經云：原守雖然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"無咎，流年又怕為災。原守雖醇，尤勝膏梁之有味；流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"年為患，譬猶潢潦之無根是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"一、行限有迎有送，人多送煞之年，皆能死亡。若是逢煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500602395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"不好，迎送又不好，决死無疑。若迎送不好，非有好吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"星，不能救其活，亦十死一生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"一、行限須要限元得援，故經云：得援高强，失援孤弱。限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"主失援，莫不𤰞微。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"一、壽之修短，不可以限度定，止從難星。若難俱受制，全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"主高壽。且如立命在辰，金星為主，火羅二星為難，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"被水尅，羅被孛尅，各各受制，莫能為毒，的許高壽，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"使限到難度，亦不為害。如或被火尅，羅無制，未可斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500635163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"其高壽，必二難俱受制，方可斷壽之高也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"一財庫，五星中各有庫，如壬子生人，木為庫，在未，未上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"有好星，主財盛。如無星主管耗星，凶星居之，反破財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"庫。若平生不聚財，乃田宅財帛坐馬多揺動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"一得妻財，假如戌命妻在辰宫，或身主起於妻位，若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"土計與火同宫，三合生金，主得妻財。如無土計不以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"論。如身命在妻，有火計相生，主進妻財。亦有因妻失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"財者，如未命妻宫在丑，土為妻星，月若在酉，土在已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185494591"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"或三合加合相㑹，必因妻失財，亦不和合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"一婦人有破父母家者，如命坐酉，金為主，有火羅居申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"必破父母家。出外行限，遇火羅，必破夫家。內則父母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"外則夫家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"一妻妾有權者，如寅亥命，木為主，妻乃水星，或水化權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"行限遇之，必有權之妻。孛為權星，主有權之妾。辰宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"命火為妻，羅為妾，羅强火弱，妻無權，妾有權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"一老得少妻：土孛同行得少妻，計、孛同行得少夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177251379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"一立命安身在女心：畢柳及身命二主泊貴人咸池，遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"移官宫，又逢炁孛土星，合作九流百技之人也，富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"豪家之人，亦主高壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"一多口舌人，如甲乙生炁為口舌，丙丁生羅為口舌，戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"已生計為口舌，壬癸生孛為口舌，庚辛人金是。如人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"命或對頭三合守命，見之多口舌，亦主口嘴不中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"一凡行限遇難星，須論金木水火土，分别緩急輕重。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"以火為難，望見生災。以水為難，過去為禍。以金為難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453028129243148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"對度方凶。以土為難，則緩而遲。以木為難，則急而輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"葢火未然而先烟，水既流而後濕，金正遇而後能傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"人。土之性緩，水之性柔故也。其為災禍凶難，亦以五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"行類推。如以内言之，火則心血燥熱，痰痢等症，水則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"腎胱冷濕，白濁遺精等症，金則腸癰痔漏等症，土則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"脾胃噎塞等症，木則肝膽風眩等症。以外言之，水則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"溺，火則焚，金則刄，土則壓，木則撲之類。又須看三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"四正加關通，無救解，或有救而力不能，又命主低微，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185527359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"故以此斷。余屢試有驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1371,"lineType":9,"content":"竇陶氏十問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"竇陶氏能推占天文人事，要其吉凶休咎，不出十二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"之外。葢天道遠，人道邇，一貫之理，外天求人非理，外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"人求天非道也。請試其一二，方知天道不遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1379,"lineType":9,"content":"或問太嵗尊神互相管攝如何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"竇陶氏答曰：太嵗宫神，各有管屬，尅我者禍，生我者福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕當頭，犯之不足。男命犯之，受他制伏；女命犯之，並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453052783181864"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"無養育。馬若當頭，退晦反覆。禄若當頭，波波碌碌。貴若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"當頭，受人凌辱。夫妻犯之，多見反目。老人犯之，至老奔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"逐；小兒逢之，多見災毒。嵗為尊貴，怕入奴僕；若來尅我，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"必遭刑戮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"右此専怕當頭，正是利害，須占命中，有相管攝，方有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"是說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1399,"lineType":9,"content":"或問坐命行限遇空亡如何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：立身立命，空亡中坐，福不見福，禍不見禍。馬遇空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453052783165480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，奔波到老。禄入空亡，終身僧道。妻入空亡，一妻難保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"奴入空亡，自㸑自掃。貴入空亡，少離襁褓。財落空亡，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"帛自耗。日落空亡，少年必破。官落空亡，徒有負抱。若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神救援則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"右此空亡，隂怕陽空，陽怕隂空，前後最驗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1415,"lineType":9,"content":"或問五星發用十二宫神生旺如何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：馬遇長生，多動刀兵；男空奔波，女必淫顛。沐浴在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"命，處事流連；命逢冠帶，妾奪妻權。臨官在命，發在少年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500667931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"男命喜之，女命不然。帝旺守命，難結夫緣。衰病死絶，女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"德必賢。處於墓地，能顯財田。男命逢此，晦昧萬千。若遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"胎神，罵鬼怨天。男亦如此，胡語亂傳。小兒逢養，端的還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"魂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"右十二宫禍福，應之如響，須於安命處所裁酌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1433,"lineType":9,"content":"或問二十八宿立命何度善惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：鬼有二度，號曰天眼，男命係之，多見凶狠，不是權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"豪，便是反叛。心月為狐，五度有半，女命逢之，必淫必亂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453059942875188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"且是精靈，多招離悶。亢金為龍，井木為犴，命立其中，敢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"言敢斷，箕風畢雨，倐忽聚散。男女立命，多有病患，可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"詳觀，不可例斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1447,"lineType":9,"content":"或問水命怕土子上土旺水亦旺何以斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：子宫安命，以土為主，水來受制，其水可取。若行夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"令，當云以火，土必得時，於水何補？若行秋令，得金為母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"金能生水，有水無土。冬水得時，水勝土負。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1455,"lineType":9,"content":"或問卯為火垣又為木局何以辯别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453043971031067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：若行夏令，有火無木；若行春令，有木無火；冬令得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"時，返為木黨。三方有水，凑成木局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1463,"lineType":9,"content":"或問人之父母兄弟妻子叅酌孤寡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：十二宫中，寡宿孤神，若逢太陽，先䘮其父；若犯太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，先䘮其母。日火月土，則又有準，左右逢此，必無親情；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟宫見，必無弟兄；妻宫見之，一世單身；奴僕見之，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"世艱辛。逢禄逢貴，出家道人；逢刼逢的，終身山林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"右人命不可犯孤神寡宿位，諸般煞上有凶則可畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453059942809652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1477,"lineType":9,"content":"或問既分十二宫坐命隔界何以斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：十二宫中，皆屬宫神。既有子丑，合論癸壬；既言戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，又有乾辛；既論申酉，合論坤庚；雖言午未，亦有丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"曰乙曰巽，以配已辰；曰甲曰艮，以隷卯寅。隔界之處，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"看分明。若以主論，辯其重輕，純言其度，取用不真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1487,"lineType":9,"content":"或問小兒關煞何以取之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：前後有煞，命在其中，三方拱夾，亦是煞門。原守如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"是，更有加盤，若無救援，十死九難。更有一件，為小兒關，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453041500618779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"春命在酉，夏命子看，秋嫌卯位，冬怕午安。此上安命，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"為災難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"右此關小兒關煞，細推有理，但忌三嵗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1501,"lineType":9,"content":"或問官貴之命何以見之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：官貴之命，有官有印，官印相生，方有權柄。印强官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，掌財之命；官强印弱，虛名不正。金水清高，只是受䕃；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁高强，正科必定；羅孛高强，只膺武品。前後試之，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"不有應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044704903179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"右生我者，印，尅我者官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1515,"lineType":9,"content":"或問七政四餘守命何如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：計都守命，愚而自用；羅㬋守命，色心最重；孤炁守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"命，難與人共；木星守命，性執且迷；孛星守命，為人慳吝；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"金星守命，義重財輕；水星守命，詞唱輕清；火星守命，性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"急兇狠；土星守命，貪酷而淫；太隂守命，為人不佞；太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"守命，快性便行；日月合朔，晦而不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"右如明字者，吉，如反日月字者，凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177267763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1531,"lineType":9,"content":"再將十二宫辯問為証","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：十二宫中帶煞神，煞神排布甚分明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"須知月建有强弱，　反凶作吉各位均。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"願聞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1539,"lineType":9,"content":"假如子上安命以土為主或見木炁為凶或見木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1541,"lineType":10,"content":"不夭何以斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"若生夏令，母星是火，火羅乗旺，必能生我，毋星占强，安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"能為禍？若生春令，木炁高强，無金與羅，必定相傷，身逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453059942826036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛，實有不良。若生秋月，金星得時，土亦不厚，木炁有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"虧，倘有災殃，不至深危。若生冬令，水土俱旺，木炁彫零，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"土星堅壯，小兒遇此，所以保養，中年行限，財物亦昌。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火羅，福壽愈長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1557,"lineType":9,"content":"假如丑上安命以土為主何以斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"丑宫所論，與子無異，春、夏、秋、冬，皆如其理。只論官星，太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"白得地，趕退餘奴，無有不是，便看隂陽，斷其終始。又怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥，身逢土計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453059942891572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1567,"lineType":9,"content":"假如寅宫安命或見金炁有傷或見金炁無傷何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1569,"lineType":10,"content":"斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"若生春令，有木無金。若生秋令，有金無木。三方暗加，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"計是煞。夏令炎炎，子母相生。秋令見炁，炁反為榮。冬令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"見金，煞星躔身，若見太陽，反煞為榮。金水高强，必主富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。孛炁高强，刑尅有畏，遇月虛名，品官不正，可以詳觀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"不可例斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1581,"lineType":9,"content":"假如亥宫與寅宫叅酌以何辯别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453052783214632"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"若論亥宫，寅宫頗同，限逢金炁，皆斷為凶，又怕火尅，戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"尅重重，夜計與炁，十死九生，三方吉曜，返本還元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1589,"lineType":9,"content":"假如卯上安命或見水孛而天或見水孛不天何斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢夏令，火星乗旺，水孛相攻，本身堅壯。若逢秋令，母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"星黨子，縱有吉星，不破即死。更逢春令，母星有力，縱遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神，不能損失。忽在冬天，水土俱强，生子潔浄，安能有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"傷？須分晝夜，子細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":1599,"lineType":9,"content":"假如安命戌宫與卯宫何强何弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046177284147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1603,"lineType":1,"content":"戌宫火庫，本是强宫，水孛相攻，秋令甚凶。若見日月，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"炁相同，更遇旺神，福更昌隆。餘月遇鬼，與卯宫通，攅聚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞，反榮受傷，亦當一發，發成便亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1609,"lineType":9,"content":"假如辰上安命或見火羅而夭或見火羅不死何斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"辰垣以金，度有軫角，雖忌火羅，亦分强弱。軫度水局，計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"孛為殃。角道屬木，見火必亡。亢金堅剛，秋不忌火，剗度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"忌羅，四時皆禍。若逢夏令，火爍亢金，灰飛煙滅，角木不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"禁。若逢春令，角度平穏。若逢冬令，軫度無損。雖遇火羅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453058185543743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不危困。依此辯别，吉凶有準。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1623,"lineType":9,"content":"假如酉宫安命與辰宫何以分别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為西垣，太白本地。若逢秋令，火羅不忌。若逢夏令，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1627,"lineType":1,"content":"火不利。春冬平平，水孛泄氣。四季土旺，金神所喜。限行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1629,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄，恩鄉得意。齊地貴人，稱遂無比。辰宫官禄，與酉不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"同。太隂為主，夜生則榮。加盤俱換，須要研窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1633,"lineType":9,"content":"假如已宫安命或見土而死或見土不死何斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢夏令，當云以火，土必得時，安能尅我。若逢秋令，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453059942907956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"金為母，土能生金，金能生水。若遇春令，得木為鬼，尅戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"餘奴，不能尅水。若逢冬令，土旺水旺，不能相傷，本身皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"壯。若逢四季，水無所望。子細推詳，依經勿忘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1645,"lineType":9,"content":"假如申上安命與已宫何以分别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"辰宫軫水十度至十六度以金論，忌火羅，喜土計發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"角木三度至十二度以木論，忌火羅凶。亢金垣喜土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"計，忌火羅夭折。氐土初度至一度以土論，喜火羅，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664100902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"已宫：張月十五度至十九度以太隂論，忌土計，喜金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"月發福。翼：火水正垣忌土計，喜金水月，忌火孛羅。軫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"水二度至九度以水論，喜金月，忌土計孛羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫：柳土四度至十三度以土論，忌木炁，喜火羅。金星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"日日正垣喜金水，忌木炁凶。張月初度至十四度日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"生以太陽論，喜水金月，忌木炁夜生，喜火金月，忌土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"計夜生，逢木炁金月大發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433707554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"未宫：井木九度至十五度以木論，忌金羅土計。十六度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"至三十度以太隂論，喜金水月，忌土計，主夭折。鬼金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"月正垣，喜金水月，忌土計，主夭折。柳土初度至三度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"以土論，喜火羅金，忌木炁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫：畢月以太隂論，忌土計金月，主發福。觜火以水論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"忌土計，喜金月水發福。參水喜金，忌土計孛，主夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"井木二度至八度以木論，忌土計，夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫胃土。初度至十三度以土論，忌木炁，喜火羅金，㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453046307291151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"命毋，主發福。十二度至十五度以金論，木炁土計發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"福，火羅孛，主夭折。畢月初度至六度半太隂論，半以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"金論，忌火土計，凶，喜月水旺發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"戌宫奎木。二度至八度以木論，喜土計水，忌金羅，凶，夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"折。九度至十六度以火論，喜木發福，忌水孛，凶。婁金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"火垣，喜三方木炁發福，忌水孛，主夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"亥宫危月十三度至十八度太隂論，喜火月金水，主早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"年發福，忌土計為煞。室火木正垣，所喜者水孛，所忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570720802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"者火羅、金，主夭折，土計為仇。璧初度至九度木論，喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛，忌土計、火羅、金，凶。奎木。初度至一度以木論，喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛為福，忌金羅，凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":457,"lineType":9,"content":"陳都憲十二宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"理精","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":459,"lineType":10,"content":"子宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"女二度直至虛日六度，帝旺之貴土也。危一至危五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"度，乃海涯之土。危六至十二夜生人，以太隂論，為海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"濱初出之月，晝生人以土論，不以危月論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732543012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"詳宫主屬土，最喜太隂在南方已午未，謂之安身傍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"毋與火羅同行則吉，遇木炁水孛為鬼黨，其煞皆主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"不祥。女土虛土忌木炁水孛出門行斗木度三方有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"三合拱照斗四便夭。葢斗度乃煞限，見水孛為鬼助","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"煞權，如寅午戌上三方，有火羅相引，至尾火虎度，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"還一發危。土六度內外見木炁水孛不夭，大難臨身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"復見計前迎必䘮，乃是奴星犯主，煞難相逢。見金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"孛火，徐徐而發，見金生子禦鬼，為福最大，見火為恩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939608091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"限中如遇木炁，要見火羅，煞生印化，無不發福。危四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"至危十二，太隂之議，此以危月燕而言，見金水火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"皆吉。危八至危十三，亦太隂忌，見木炁土計行卯限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"見土計前迎木炁引出者，無不夭矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":495,"lineType":9,"content":"丑宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"斗四度至斗九度至十三度以木論，東方寅卯辰遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"見水孛印生身限，三方拱照，主少年發福。行限至辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"入亢金度，又見三方土計金合照，便斷一險。限中稍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453052783280168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"見水孛，天盤加出，主有一病，免死而已。如春令木逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，再加三度木論，又見水孛生我者，無往不利。子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"細推究，出見炁土金，則夭矣。見炁乃曰奴星犯主，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"土星為鬼生煞權。斗十四度至二十四度以土論之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生人又以木論，此以宫主言之。限行火羅卯辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"限係官福之宫，三方合照，亦主善發。木炁稍輕，煞乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"居丑金鄉，木不得地，有制尅我無力無妨，出限見計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"奴前迎，禍必慘矣。五星中最忌奴星犯主，若木計同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939575323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"行，亦不可解，狂奴之星犯主也。牛一至牛七，全以土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"論，最喜羅月相逢，居於子午之宫。子細推之，大造初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"行寅限見火羅二十以上在寅宫，行尾火虎度，發而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"大富。羅月在子，三十六入辰限，官禄之鄉，亦能發福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"限至南方巳午之地，愈見福厚。土至南方，乃為父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"之邦。只怕孛炁鬼生煞，計炁不受傷，只於過宫之時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"子細推究。女一度亦以土論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":537,"lineType":9,"content":"寅宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732592164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"尾三至尾六七度以尾火虎論，便看安身立命。太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"吊起木炁，謂之安身傍毋，便享祖業。如行辰已限，單","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"見木炁，當途恩用之星，或三方外拱便發，再見水孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"以助木炁，煞又生印，發福非小，加增田産。大怕安身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"近水孛，謂之安身傍鬼，必無祖業。見金水孛，號曰鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"生，其煞相引過關，斷夭無疑。尾八度至末度以木而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"論，丙丁生人亦以火論，此斷宫主。而安身與水孛相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，謂之安身傍母，必享祖業，根本壯厚。臨官之木，次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433756706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"看木起何宫。如是寅申已亥四正之宫，豈是尋常，斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"作吉論。二十五六後行辰限，遇見水局，或有水孛於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰三方拱照，平平而發。如已宫遇孛水單行，巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"乃水鄉，為水在水，故吉。若遇金星相扶助，是曰煞生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"印，此時發奮進田莊。出限稍見土金前迎，是曰鬼生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，若不主䘮身，災禍重重。已酉丑亥卯未生人，先主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"官符之破，免死而已。如夏令生人，遇火氣炎，或稍可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏。箕水豹至五度看月令。如夏令遇火氣，春生；遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518649890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"木氣，冬生。遇水氣在寅箕六度至九度，全以水論，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"艮山柔弱之水也。畧見些少金水之氣，亦發福行亢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"度，金乃父母之鄉，軫水局善發如此。出限稍見火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛三方，見火羅為黨，土計見孛為奴，故主凶。前迎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"後送，死難之鬼。斗一斗三度以木論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":587,"lineType":9,"content":"卯宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"氐一至氐九及十六度以土貉而言。辰戌丑未年生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"人，由其屬土，真土論也。最喜近火羅，相逢無有不發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433740322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五六初行已限，翼火度斷入佳境，如見火羅，至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"已午單行，見木炁以助其威，發福非小。按卯為火宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"房心火之地，氐土居之，是曰入垣入廟。若火羅更在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"已午，真如錦上添花，二十五六便發，歌曰吉星望見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"先為福是也。更加木炁相助，其吉可知。最忌水孛相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"引，木乃歲徳之星，為福不為禍，惟水孛引之，故為災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"也，名曰鬼生之煞。推至送限之年，斷其禍福，歌曰凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"星過去始為災是也。氐十以後至夏令以火論，餘以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518633506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"土論。房一度至心一度，全以火論。此宫主論安身，太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"隂居於亥卯未宫，木炁逢之，便是吉人造化再詳。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"為恩主，居巽亥垣，行巳午限官福之宫，亦發一場便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉論。心二度至五度，寵姬之月，晝生火論夜生月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"論斷卯宫，則以火月土三件而論。尾一至尾二度火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":625,"lineType":9,"content":"辰宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"軫度以水而論。秋氣三分之金同納音，秋金九分之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570769954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"金，此以金論。此星屬水，最喜金月躔角，及三方拱照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"行限見金水木炁前迎，一生發福興隆。如遇火羅，險","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"中復險，事事不吉。若有水孛尅制，方免其死。角一至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"角八，秋冬生，乃是枯敗之木，其論金明矣。角後度生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"春令并甲乙生人以木論，餘俱金論。亢乃正垣之金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"要太隂共土計尤妙。亢金喜土計，發福非淺，最怕寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌合限，遇火羅木炁相引，出入十死。其九見水孛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"能潤辰宫亢金，亦主發福。氐一度在辰，土論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051021623307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":649,"lineType":9,"content":"已宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
