{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"張十五度至十七度，葢如水中之月，秋令人此度安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"身立命，决主清貴。是水中之月見金乃花酒中無心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"發財。或太隂起近孛，㑹於危畢度，一生得隂人為侣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"助，限內三方見炁合照，多因婦人財禄成家。翼一至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"十九度，夏令生以火論，秋冬生以水論。軫一至軫九，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"乃東方河漢之水，行西方申酉限，单見金，或在辰上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛宫，或在子上奴僕宫，三十五六後畧見申限，發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939722779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"福非小。此宫土計難星，最怕火羅相接，斷必禍死。喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"金居財帛，主白手成家，惟不喜金居田宅，限元稍弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"必破祖矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":673,"lineType":9,"content":"午宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"柳四度至柳八度，端門之貴土也。今以土言之，先看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"土起何宫，若居四木度，早年十五歲內逼井木度限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"看水孛之鬼三合亥卯未見之，便當一忌。如是四土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"或四火之地，太隂與火羅相逢，少年無災。限行申酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518731810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"稍見火金单行限相逢，决然一發。喜羅单行，夜生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"見寅午戌宫相照，亦必一發。柳後度并星六日馬以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽論，鶉火之中日論明矣。最喜照官福之宫，申酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"處權貴有名利，凡事吉慶。不怕火，最忌木炁之鬼，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"春令甲乙生人，木旺之時，限若相逢，出入見火羅相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"引，必䘮其壽。若木炁黨之，只主官災破蕩。張月鹿有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"十四度居午旺時，前三後二，月論明矣。晝生人以太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"陽論，張四至十四度，乃天之月也，夜生太隂明矣。最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518764578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"喜見金水，無往不佳，徐徐而發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":705,"lineType":9,"content":"未宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"井九至十五度，及二十一度，歸庫之木，遇金亦能剥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"削，見火羅亦能災傷，皆主不利。限若交接，前迎後送，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"必作少年之鬼，福氣難享。井二十二度以後春令，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"木鬼二度夜生，全以太隂而論。正垣之月，晝生喜金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"出門行申酉戌限，如遇金水火羅单行，無有不發，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"孛亦妙，如見土計，禍患輕也。出限三方見木炁之鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518682658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"加以流年填難斷夭折也。柳初至二度，夜生太隂，論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生土，論土則資質本薄，少年行限井木度，子細推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"究三方，若遇見水孛之鬼，少年便夭。喜酉戌係官福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，遇金火羅便能大發。三方外拱，為恩雖重，尤能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"發福。戌中奎木之宫，詳天盤加減。且如水孛之鬼，外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"生木炁之煞，斷死無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":733,"lineType":9,"content":"申宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"畢七至十四度，夜生月，論晝生水論，喜金水孛發福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008782363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"其理最明，忌見火羅為禍，限行寅午戌三方，見土計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"則夭折而死。觜參全以水論，乃是長生水，最喜見金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"水在辰酉便發。二十六七歲行戌宫，見金在寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"宫合照，發福亦輕，須至亥限官禄宫，亥卯未三方照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"起，方見發福。子丑限若見土金，離祖發財，廣布田莊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫水之至清行限見奴孛鬼羅相逢臨照險地，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"不善終，遇火亦能䘮命。井一至井三度分金氣，秋令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"全以金論，遇土計金迎而發，寅午戌相逢，刑尅不免，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570753570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇火羅，若不傷財，險中復險，蕩散家貧，免死而巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"井五度至八度甲乙生人木論，餘作水論，遇金亦能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"剥削，見火羅亦忌，同前叅詳論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":763,"lineType":9,"content":"酉宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"胃度以土論之，自敗之。土喜見火羅，金則發，木炁㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"孛而險阻。胃九至十四度納音金，又秋令庚辛生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"金論，昴日真金而論，不怕羅，遇土計单行，大能發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"行亥子丑限，見土計吉，忌見木炁不吉，只怕行限合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044705067019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"見，主凶災，見火羅木炁為黨，必死。畢一至畢三水論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"畢四至畢六，夜生月論，晝生金論，乃是妃妾之金也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"喜見月孛臨胃度，無不吉利，有禍不折，見火羅，非貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"賤則夭折也。水孛平平，木炁宜卓立成家，行戌限若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火羅，必死無疑，遇土計不能害身，子細推論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":785,"lineType":9,"content":"戌宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"奎二至九度全以木論，遇水孛發福，見火羅单居子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"丑亦發，見木炁不凶，交限見金土相照，并三方拱，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939739163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"禍死。奎十至十五度、十六度，春令木論，夏火論。奎十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"七度全，以火論，乃是火正垣，見木炁善發，見金水孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"行限至此，相引相迎，必死無疑。此宫火不怕水，只怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"羅、孛婁度，晝以火論，如納音金，秋冬生以金論，餘火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"論。胃有三度居戌土論，此宫土資質本薄，見木炁水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"孛，必禍死。行限喜見火羅，木金平平發福。此宫火不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"怕水，只怕羅孛，險中復險，破耗刑衝災難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":807,"lineType":9,"content":"亥宫安命論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433773090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"危十三度至十五度末上弦明月而論，以歩天衢星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"光彩行子丑限，危月斗牛度，見水孛樂然而發，夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"見火羅亦然。如遇木炁土計之鬼煞，前迎後送，便斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"禍凶，出限則天。室初至十七度皆以木論，此木初生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"不能當其火羅，如夏令生人限，若逢火命在須臾，前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"迎之限，土計金照，必主夭折。璧一至十度以水論，春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"令木論，乾金所生，江湖之水不怕土計行子丑限，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"金火相逢，一發而福，怕忌難尅戰不宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518748194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭幼學二十八宿元髓血脉經：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"角木蛟者，乃是刀頭斧柄之木也。自初至十，喜春生見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"金禍輕，遇火羅禍甚，夏忌火羅尤𦂳。其木喜亥卯未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"局及四木四水度，初年已限，必得父母遺廕。翼四至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"初不無悔，破張度有徐徐之福，見水孛必能白手富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。行星度木惡南奔至柳度關隘之地不吉，更六丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"生人陽刄，遇火羅無救夭折，有水孛土計解之，不夭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"必破財刑害。柳度平，鬼度井中遇吉星則吉，遇火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664182822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"更丁生人陽刃，如羊投虎口，井十三關隘，縱無火羅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不全善。參觜畢有水孛助，更六庚生人禄，寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬到此必發，若得天馬官魁相助，晚景功名，老當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"益壯。昴度金局，更六庚生人陽刃，寅申巳亥生人的","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"煞到此，刑害破蕩，若遇秋金，就此阻壽。胃土財限平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"平。戌上婁度枯木投火，縱有水孛援之，老有風燭之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"患，若遇火羅，更六辛生人陽刃，於壽有碍，無火羅，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"不免腸胃下部之疾。亥宫璧室，晚節黄花，清香在尾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939755547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"子地，木逢地刼，曷可言也。丑寅二限，無火羅金，可享","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"𦒿頥之壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"亢金龍者，乃堅剛之真金也，亦刀劒成器之物，生於春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"夏，忌火羅，見之禍甚。初午已限水局，故水孛能潤其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"色。若壬癸生人貴人，丙戊生人禄，少年奮迅，白手成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"功。翼三至初，晦昧無成。春夏生人遇火羅，碍决阻壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬生人禍輕，更申子辰、子午卯酉生，刼煞的煞之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"地，到此應無素休。張度平平，遇土計、水孛，白手而成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008798747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"名香利潤。星度有木炁，或火羅碍道，死亦無疑，更丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生人，陽刄招非命而終，或火計同為煞生，毋吉。柳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"土平平小福。鬼度返吟拖戈。若夏月丁已生人，陽刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"到此，非死亡，必破蕩刑傷。井度財鄉，遇水孛必主福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，見火羅，春夏禍甚，秋冬為禍稍輕。參觜畢皆順酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"宫。昴胃度金局，老當益壯。戌上婁度不吉，更六辛生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"人，陽刄，若遇三煞天鋒，主死於非命，或火羅木炁居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"之，死無疑矣。或火局遇土計，許有黄花晚節之味。亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664199206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"子限中，宜守株度日。丑限見火羅，有風燭之患也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"氐土貉者，乃扶桑之地，日出之所也。帶火氣，自初至一，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"與亢金同，自二至十四五，乃土為主。喜生辰、戌、丑、未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"月及秋冬，得時喜火羅，忌木炁，春生見之禍甚。初行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"角木，更六乙生人陽刄害不一。軫度乃汪洋之水，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"寒之地，晦困見木炁、水孛，不吉，遇火羅，不能為福。翼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"四至，初見火羅，一發不久。張度淡淡。星度離明，火局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"决能發福，見木炁，倍加光彩。柳土平平之福。鬼度順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051021639691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"井，木中淹晦，見木炁凶，遇火羅，尤加春色，利潤名香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫無木炁，守株度日，遇木炁阻壽。酉限金局脫氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"更六庚生人陽刃。寅申生人的煞招，心腹之疾可延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"婁度，晚年康健。奎八關隘，决無素休。亥限室璧，木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"倘木炁臨衝照合，壽止於此。子限土局，旺甚不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"房日兎，乃扶桑太陽之真火也，當作火論。喜木炁，忌水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"孛，限行少年。亢度中見水孛，必阻壽，遇木炁，小小福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"力。角度平淡。軫翼度晦滯，更子午卯酉申。子辰生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570802722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"乃的煞之地，到此有碍，若水孛居之，乃是煞星居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，卜此地死而無疑，否則傷殘肢體，官非刑害。張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"度無水孛，淹晦守株。星度順得木炁，決能顯用。柳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼中如常。井度得意，如順水之便，倘木炁助之，更甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚生人，天乙貴或官魁天馬元局，主臨衝窵合，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"為臺閣勲臣，吉利名香人物。申宫水局，多凶少吉，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛居之，無木炁救，如羊投虎口。酉宫財局見金，晚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"年稱遂，遇水孛，壽决難延。戌宫火局，得木炁相助，老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939771931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"當益壯。亥限木局，黄花晚節，子限晦阻，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"心月狐者，亦扶桑初出之月也。自初至三，房火同論，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"四至六，不問晝夜，皆以月論，喜秋夜生，忌土計，喜金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"火相助，十五歲内，氐度晦困，亢度，便能振作。角軫度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"中，守株度日，翼火中，若壬癸生人貴人，更金生助，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"能發福。張度雖返吟，不為忌，倘遇火或金，必能顯達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"星度，日助月明，更丁已生人禄，六辛生人貴，到此利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"潤名香，前程亨奮。柳土度，無火羅助惡，守株無咎，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044705132555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"土計，晦蹇刑害。鬼度，稱意。井度，如常見火羅，生意春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"風。申宫水局，平平無咎，更六庚生人禄，寅午戌生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，晚景優游。酉宫金旺之地，更遇金乃福壽之鄉。胃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"土稍晦，遇金吉，見土計凶。婁度，火助月華，遇土計阻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"壽。奎度，淹晦平淡。亥限木局脫氣，子限土旺難鄉，安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"能至福，鬼録難逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"尾火虎度，乃樹尾所燃之火，自初至三，當以火論，喜木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"炁，忌水孛，自四至十八乃臨官之木，喜春生得時，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732624932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"冬失令，宜居亥卯未局，生平享福，一世優游。倘居巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"午，乃離明星度，辰酉乃亢金大梁之位，身體𤰞微，勞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"碌不吉。初限卯木之鄉。天乙生人禄，壬癸生人貴，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"金臨衝窵合，早年得意。辰上亢度，晦破，更秋生遇金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折無疑。倘六乙生人陽刄，更遇天鋒刑囚，死於非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"命。角軫翼度，小小福力，如壬癸丙戊生人禄貴，福氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"倍加。張度，徐徐之福。星度，木惡南奔，灰飛烟滅，更丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生人陽刄，倘遇飛來窵煞、天鋒等凶，重則非命䘮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051021656075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"身，輕則遭官刑害。柳鬼度中，守株度日。井度，晚景優","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"游。申限木絶之鄉，老有殘疾。酉限金局，更六庚生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃。寅申已亥生人的煞遇土為天鋒，助煞為患，安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"能善終？得水孛可延其壽。戌限火局，脫氣不足言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"亥限木局，旺甚不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"箕水豹度，乃丑艮山下䝉泉之水，忌土計孛喜金，宜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏，不利秋冬，限行卯，遇土計决夭，更六甲生人陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"刄，其禍愈甚。辰宫亢度，順必能發用，得金倍加福力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453068939788315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"如秋生更六甲生人陽刄，到此遇孛，主縊溺䘮身。角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"度，脫氣，宜守株度日。軫度，返吟拖戈。翼度，頗順，如壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生人貴更吉。張星度順。柳度午宫丙戊生人陽刄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"或天鋒飛刃，决主不義亡身。鬼度小福。井度脫氣，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"可强求，只宜守舊，遇土計孛，又何患乎？申度限，亦宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"退守。酉宫，水敗之鄉，得金助，晚年康壯。胃婁中忌見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"土計，更六辛生人，陽刃，如羊投虎口。亥子限土旺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，不足言也矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453051021672459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"斗有二十二度，乃橋沉底下之木也。初至十八九度，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"問四季，皆以木論，不忌金火羅，惟忌炁，遇之有碍。夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"生男命，遇之輕則尅戰，重則夭折。初年尾心度皆是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"順境，早能振作。房火中平淡生涯。氐度財限，六乙生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"人禄。壬癸生人貴，必能顯用。辰宫亢角不順，六乙生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"人，陽刄到此，不無破尅。軫水泛濫無成。翼淡淡生涯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙戊生人禄。壬癸生人貴，若得金水助之，或魁職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"元局，主臨衝窵合，决能白手成名，無吉曜相助，則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570835490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"進寸退尺之憂。張度生意頗順。星度晦，無成。柳度無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星，免咎，有炁就此阻壽。鬼度淹晦。井度返吟拖戈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"十五度，關隘之地，丁已生人，陽刄更炁當途，夭折無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"疑。申宫水局，木絶之鄉，不無險阻。酉宫金局，六庚生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"人，陽刄，寅申已亥生，的煞遇此，鬼録難逃，否則必遭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"官刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"牛度，乃未經煆煉之礦金也，當以土為主，見木無咎，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"炁禍重。初限斗箕，早年晦滯。尾度，頗稱無炁，平平之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453044705148939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"福。心房氐火局，生意勝常，更火羅當途，六乙生人，禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"居福，壬癸生人，貴人到此，必能超顯，積榖拘財，亢角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"中亦無阻隔，見炁禍輕。軫翼水局，遇炁不吉，無炁碍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"平善。張星柳中，得火羅發達，水孛炁同，不無戰尅。未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"宫雖木局無炁，平淡生涯，若遇炁更丁已生人，陽刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"女多，尅戰無救，阻壽。申限水局，無咎，見炁有碍。酉限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"戌宫，老當康壯。奎璧度，有風燭之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"女度，乃積聚糞壤之土也，至輕微，至薄賤，喜生辰戌丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732641316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"未寅午戌月得時，忌亥卯未月生此土泊土局土度、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"火局，火度吉。居木局，木度凶。如生遇木水孛，刑害破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"耗。初午限行斗箕尾木局，晦昧無成，更遇水孛，木碍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"道。倘已酉丑生人，刼煞輕則貧病，重則夭折。尾三、尾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"四度至心房氐度，母鄉得意，見木炁、火羅，大能振作。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"氐五度，反吟關隘，六甲生人，陽刄到此不利，得火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"臨衝窵合無咎，遇木炁，死而無疑。亢度，清淡守株。角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"度晦破，見木必夭。軫水中泛濫漂流，其禍如燃，家財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008847899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"冷退，猶招肢體之疾，見木决夭。翼四至初許，有平平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"之福。張度，平淡家風。星度，老更精神。柳土無咎。未宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"木局，多凶少吉，如丁已生人，陽刄木炁居之，必登鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"録。申限頗順，酉限皆不能保守，於此問壽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"虛度，乃午上星，曰太陽照臨下土之日影，廣厚高大之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"土也。喜生辰、戌、丑、未月，得令得時，忌生春及亥、卯、未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"月，無氣，喜火羅，忌木，見之禍甚，計奴猶能犯主。初年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"入斗箕度，淹晦破害，遇木碍，少年夭折。尾度平淡，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518780962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅，更六甲生人禄。申子辰生人馬，决能白手成名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"財豐禄厚。卯宫火垣，得火羅木炁同，更六乙生人禄居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，壬癸生人貴居官，前程亨奮，名利兩全。氐度遇木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"計，化刑囚暗耗，更六甲生人陽刄，猶慮夭於非命。亢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"角中平淡，軫翼度寒地，土愛暖而惡寒故也。如遇木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"炁，更申子辰，刼守疾厄，或化刑囚，非䘮命必傷肢體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫火局，老當康壯，晚福優游。未宫木局，晦滯災非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"丁已生人陽刄，阻壽無疑，否則刑害。申宫水局，小吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433822242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫金鄉，脫氣不足言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"危月乃張度之月影，日生自初度至五，與虛土同論。危","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"六至十五度，當作太隂看，喜夜生秋令，忌弦望晦朔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"見土輕忌計重，喜火羅金以助其輝，忌行四土計，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅同决，阻其初年。虛女晦滯多災，牛斗箕未能作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"事。尾火自初至七為事，頗稱，無土計迤𨓦春風。心房","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"氐火局見之得意。氐土十五度關隘，如土計同决，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害破耗。辰宫亢金，生意洋洋，得土計倍加春色。角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518797346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"度平淡。軫度水涵月魄，作事有進寸退尺之憂。翼度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"如常。張度雖拖戈，無土計不忌。星度日助月華，老當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"康壯。柳土晦滯。鬼度、井度，有三五年晚福。酉宫康壯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"室火乃樹頭之火，初至二火為主，自三四至十八度，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中初生之木，喜生春夏及亥卯未月，暨亥卯未之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，如人命遇此，終身無咎，喜水孛，忌火羅，金見之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"患。㓜年危度平善。虛度，女土財局，遇金不吉，更六壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"生人陽刄，六丙生人飛來陽刄到此必䘮於非命，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008864283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛解減福，逢火羅無咎。牛度平平。斗度遇火羅禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"甚，無火羅或水孛臨衝釣合，更甲戊生人貴，如官魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"職元局主相助，决然白手成名。箕尾度臨官之地，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛，更六甲生人禄。申子辰生人馬，倘天馬官魁衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"拱，富貴雙全，名揚寰宇。卯宫遇土計，積榖聚財，火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"同倍加春色。心房度，遇金更春夏生人，不能為患，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"生更六甲生人陽刃，决主刑害。官非氐土，小小福力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"辰宫亢金難地，如遇金，更秋生六乙生人陽刄，六庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433838626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"生人飛刄，見之禍甚，主非命而終，春夏生人減福，刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"害破尅。角度，無火羅平平之福。軫翼度，水泛木浮，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"遇水孛，未為全善，見金火羅無咎。張度，徐徐之福。星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"度，木惡南奔。柳度，晚年康壯，遇金碍壽。鬼度，晦人。井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"度，得意有黄花之賀，遇火羅，必登鬼録。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"璧度，乃文章之宿，天然養木之水，初至二與室同論，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"至九以水言之。喜行四水四木度，乃財福之限，更官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"魁禄馬職元局主，或薦元官星臨衝釣合，必為顯達","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075855949843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"之人，名馳翰苑，聲播寰宇。忌行四土度，及遇土計更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚，或陽刄天鋒當道無救，决無素休非夭，必破蕩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害。四火度，及火局遇土計，禍亦無疑。夏生尤怕火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"羅煎焚之禍，如羊投虎口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"奎木乃文章之宿，火柴之木也。凡人於此安命者，聰明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"智慧，自初至十五，不問四季，皆以木論。忌者，火羅金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"也。凡行限見之無救，為禍必甚。亥限㓜年平善，子限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"虛度。木為地刼，火羅無咎，遇金為患，無救夭折。金牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075855933459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"度稍晦。斗度天盤返吟，若遇火羅，更六癸生人陽刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未的煞到此，必然夭阻。斗十關隘，如羊投虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"口。箕尾度臨官，若水孛，更六甲生人禄申。子辰生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，如官魁禄馬局，主職元衝合，白手功名，前程亨奮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫木局，得水孛木，迤𨓦春風。房度遇火羅，更六甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"生人、陽刃，非夭折，必官刑破尅。氐土財限得意。亢角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"中蹇，剥刑破軫。翼度水泛木浮，有進寸退尺之憂。張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"度平平，星度灰飛烟滅，更火羅臨衝拱，合六丙生人、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518813730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刄，遇此，决阻壽無疑。柳土平淡。鬼度晦滯。井木返","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"吟，拖戈十五度，關隘申宫，木絶不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"婁度，乃鍋鼎之金，以火為主，喜生寅、午、戌之月，及春夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"得時，忌水孛為難，遇羅犯主，見木炁白手發用，若火居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、午、戌局，得令得時，終身獲福。若居巳、酉丑，一世迍邅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"初行亥限，早年稱遂。子限，見水孛，有制禍輕。牛金守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"株度日。斗木母鄉，若遇木炁當途，更甲戊生人貴，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"能發福，更官魁天馬職元局，主决許名題鴈塔。箕度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570851874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"稍晦，有木炁發福，遇水孛禍甚。尾度得意，見金戰尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"破蕩，得水孛木炁返增福力。心房迤𨓦春風，更六乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"生人禄，遇炁老當益壯。氐角亢金，早宜退守，慮有風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"燭之患。軫水中、翼火中，皆非順境，於壽有碍。張星度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"旺甚，亦宜守常。术限木局，老更精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"胃度，乃泥竈之土也。初至一與婁火同，二至十四以土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"為主，喜生辰、戌、丑、未月，怕春失時，忌木炁，喜火羅限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"行婁，㓜年得意。奎木晦人，遇木炁必阻，得火羅早能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198304774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"卓立。亥限木局，晦昧無成，得火羅却能顯用。子局土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之鄉，六癸生人禄居禄，乙已生人貴居官，更单火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"獨羅，大能展布，利潤名香。牛度如常。斗度不吉，木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"得道，更六癸生人陽刄，倘更刑囚的煞，死何悔哉。箕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"水財地，無木炁吉，遇木炁凶。尾度遇木炁碍，其凶甚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火羅稍順。卯宫火位無水優游之福，有火羅，遇水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"孛，事事晦。辰宫亢角度不利。軫水翼度，乃羊腸之道，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼錄書名。午宫火局，老景康壯。未宫井木，多晦少安，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198321158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇木炁，决阻壽筭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"昴度乃酉宫西沉之日影也。餘光次舍，只以金論。喜已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑月及秋生，忌春夏失時，見火羅尤重，忌孛泄氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土計决能發用。初行婁度，早年晦滯，更火羅或六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生陽刄，到此夭折無疑，有救減福，此度見土計必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"發。奎木財鄉，無火羅，平善，有火羅，禍甚。亥限遇木炁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"必能發用，見火羅返禍。子宫土局，子歸毋腹，必發優","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"游之福，更六癸生人，禄居禄。乙巳生人貴居官，得土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198337542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"計，或官魁禄馬局，主職元居之，决然白手成名，富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"人矣。遇火羅，倍加福力，見孛禍輕。丑宫牛度，徐徐平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"福。斗木財限，得木炁，水助之，發福，見火羅，居之，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"箕水脫氣晦滯，遇孛阻壽。尾度，木臨官，木炁當道，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"意洋洋。卯上心房二度，火之正垣，忌見火羅，怕木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"居之，黨其煞氣，更六甲生人，陽刄遇此，决無素休，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅、木炁，於壽無碍，多見坎坷。氐土老當益壯。亢度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"有土計，無咎。午限有孛或火羅，不吉，更丙戊生人，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198353926"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"刄於壽有傷。未限木局，丁已生人，陽刄遇火羅，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"畢月乃酉宫太隂次舍餘光，寒潭之月影也。自初至四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"與昴同論，自五至七度，上弦中旬夜生，以太隂為主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"喜金火助力，忌土計，及行土局土度，晦滯多災，更遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"土計、火羅，凶。四金度，得意。畢八至十六觜參同論，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"水為主，喜生秋度，春夏失時。申宫乃西方金臨官之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"地，見土計禍輕，忌孛尤重，故西方初生之水本清，怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"孛混濁之。初行酉宫金局。畢昴度，少年得意，得土計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198370310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"助之，愈加福力，如孛居之，主縊溺傷亡之患。胃土晦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"人。婁度火局，見木羅，必發財福，遇木炁同，倍加春意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"奎璧室度木局，脫氣守株，平淡家風。子宫土局，見金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"必能發用，六癸生人禄。乙巳生人貴，愈更精神，無金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"晦昧，進退得失不一。此局遇土計亦晦，見孛主隂人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"破蕩。牛度，平淡生涯。斗度，脫氣，見土計無咎，遇火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"發財。箕度，無孛計，平淡。心房氐，小小福力。氐五度，關","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"隘，更六甲生人陽刄，如不䘮身，决傷肢體，破蕩人矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198386694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"亢金，老當益壯。角軫翼，晦滯迍邅，更申子辰生人刼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉生人的，或見孛碍衝合，到此必登鬼錄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"觜度，乃漁燈之火，與參水同論。參水乃申宫初生清冷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"之水，喜金及秋冬生。辰戌丑未月生，見土計，禍稍輕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"遇孛禍甚。限行金局，金度更得金助，或禄馬貴人，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁天馬局主職。元隂注陽，受臨衝窵合，决能白手","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"成名，增財進業。行四土度，及遇土計刑破多危，見金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"同返吉。如四水度，或金度遇孛，更陽刃天鋒當道，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198403078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"壽無疑。若婦人遇之，主落孕傷胎之患，如木炁解救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"减禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"井木，自初至八，乃西井之木，除初度與參水同論，自九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"至二十五，不問四季，皆以木論。此木乃東井丹桂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"木也，與凡木不同。見金火羅為患輕，遇炁，禍甚少。年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"參水度，水局早有成立。金局昴度，作事進退，水孛必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"能顯用，立業興家。胃土財，限得土計，决然增添財産。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"婁奎度，脫氣返吟之地。奎八關隘，倘遇炁，更六辛生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198419462"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"人陽刄或天鋒等煞臨衝，非䘮命，必破蕩。璧水室火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"皆是順境，如遇水孛及土，皆能發福興田進業，危虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"亦宜守株藏器，入牛女度如常。斗度返吟，斗十關隘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"更六癸生人陽刃。辰戌丑未的煞，無炁破蕩刑害，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"炁阻壽。箕水無炁，老亦康壯。尾度平平無咎。心房氐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"局，脫氣多滯，六甲生人陽刃不吉。氐土財限，無火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"炁稍順，如行亢角中，老有風燭之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"井二十六至三十，與鬼金同論，此金嫦娥首飾之金也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198435846"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以老隂為主，喜秋夜生，得時忌晦朔，怕土計，及行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"四土度，喜金局、金度、火局。火度初行申水局，平平之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"福，酉宫金局。倘金月同更夜生，及六辛生人禄居禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁生人貴居福。更官魁天馬薦元，官星居之，必白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"手成名，權居翰苑。昴度得土或計，倍加光彩。胃度得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"金，愈更精神。婁度遇火羅，為剛星助月，遇土計不吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"若八月秋生减福。辰戌丑未月遇之，更六辛生人，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"刃到此，應無素休，有救則刑害破病，無救死而無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198452230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"奎璧室木局，得火羅能助，月華土計居之，受制無咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"子宫土局，淹晦坎坷，遇土計单行，為福必矣。輕則貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"病，重則䘮身。牛斗中守株度日。箕尾限豈能邀福。心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"房火位夜生，得火外助，老當益壯，遇土計阻壽。氐土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然。亢金度，晚景康壯。角度天盤返吟。倘六乙生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"柳土，乃離明天河之土也，乃日之正垣，火之旺地，此土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"主貴。喜生辰戌丑未月。自初至一，乃柳稍之月，與鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198468614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"同論，自二至十二，皆以土言。喜火羅及行火局，火度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"忌木炁及行木局。四木度，初年未限。井度，晦蹇不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁已生人，陽刄到此，見木或炁，夭折必矣。井度見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅，必發初年之福。申宫水土長生之地，未為全美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"進退得失。酉宫土敗，皆未可言福。胃土返吟。拖戈得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅，喜木炁同，愈加福力，如無木炁必阻。婁度火局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"事事平和，得火羅，臨衝窵合，晚年稱意。奎璧室木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"遇木炁阻，壽見火羅，老更康健。子宫土旺，平淡守株，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198484998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵怕遇木炁，見之為患。丑宫牛度如常。斗度難鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"斗十關隘。若六癸生人陽刃，辰戌丑未生人，的煞到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"此終壽，見木炁，死亦無疑。箕尾中皆非順地。卯宫火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"位，康壯無咎。氐土返吟，六甲生人陽刃更木炁，刑囚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"碍之，决為泉下之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"星度乃離火之精，真太陽也。喜夏晝生，不宜夜生，喜金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"輔佐，忌木以蔽其光，怕羅薄蝕之。春夏木羅逢之禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"甚。秋冬木羅遇之禍輕。初行未限，井木晦人。申宫水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198501382"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"局，稍稍見金水吉，遇木必災破。酉宫得金或水拱守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"臨衝，更六辛人禄居禄，丙丁人貴居官。如官魁天馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"局，主職元，臨衝窵合，必能白手成名，聲播寰宇。胃土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"或木，不吉。戌宫火局，迤𨓦春風，奎婁度遇羅，更六辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"人陽刃，必主中年之憂，刑傷破尅。亥限木局，晦困蹇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"滯，遇木决阻，子限，平淡無成。丑限斗度，忌見木炁，羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"碍之不吉。寅限猶忌木當途。卯宫火位，遇羅有咎。六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生人陽刄，於壽有碍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198517766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"張度初至三，太陽同論。張四至十四度，太隂為主。喜秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生，忌朔望弦晦，怕土計及行。土局土度，喜金火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"以助其輝，喜行四金度。金局得意，幼年星度無碍。柳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"土晦人，遇土計必夭，更丙戊生人陽刄，倘天鋒飛煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"必䘮於非命。鬼度得意，井度平善，見土計無咎，遇火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"羅必能發福。申宫水局，金臨官之地，徐徐之福。酉宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"金局，生意春風。六辛生人禄居禄，丙丁生人貴居官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"更得金臨衝窵合，或官魁天馬拱合，中年得意，必發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198534150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"非常之福。胃土遇金，倍加光彩，土計居之，更六庚生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"人陽刄，主刑傷破害。婁度火局，得火羅助，更夜生，决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"然得意，土計同反禍，更陽刄，其禍愈甚。奎璧室，木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"不利火羅居之，黨土計之威。子宫虛危度，六壬生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刄，更刑囚暗耗，臨衝非䘮命，决刑傷破蕩。丑宫牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"斗度，多晦少利。寅宫箕尾度，得火羅助，平平無咎，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"計居之，亦能為患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"翼度，乃漁燈之火，自初至三乃火為主，忌水禍輕，見孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198550534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"禍甚，自四至二十度皆以水也，與軫同論，軫水乃大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"海汪洋之水，與翼同論，喜金忌土計孛見之無救，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"夭則破蕩貧病。得金水㑹蛇癸與已酉丑人位居清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"要，給諫之臣，初限張星，少年擢用，名播乾坤。柳土不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，無火羅，有土計，平淡災咎，遇土計、火羅，非夭必刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"破鬼度，一載無光。井三十至二十三，二年生意出入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"順便利禄。井二十五至井初。木局得火羅，白手發財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"無火羅、土計，平平無咎。遇火羅，金平福，遇土計無碍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198566918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"參度雖拖戈，乃金臨官之位，不能興害。若得金助，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚生人禄居禄。寅午戌生人馬居官，如天馬官魁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"臨衝窵合，由文學進，白手成名。酉宫金局遇金，更六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生人禄，丙丁生人貴。無火羅孛，必發非常之福。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"土計助，愈加厚福。胃中遇土計凶，得金反吉。戌限火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"局，得火羅必發福，木炁助尤妙。土計居之，為禍不少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"奎璧室木局，見火羅居之有財，土計孛碍之減福。子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1599,"lineType":1,"content":"宫土旺之地，土計碍道。三合衝拱，更陽刃决阻其壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198583302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1603,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑二限見金，無火羅孛老更精神。寅限木局脫氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"慮有下部之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1607,"lineType":2,"content":"此分經造化，大抵舉一而知十，只依五星生尅制化，子細消詳，萬舉萬中，更五星遲留伏逆為𦂳，度數闊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1609,"lineType":2,"content":"狹推究，若能熟讀之於心，可作術家之衣鉢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1611,"lineType":9,"content":"十二宫定數賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1611,"lineType":2,"content":"文義俱佳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"寶瓶子位，𤣥枵齊邦。女虛乃屬土之正垣，危月亦為水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"之旺氣。水孛冬旺而立見成家，火羅夏生而必然富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。火土生成招厚福，計炁忌怒遭憲章。日月順躔，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198599686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"坐孤亡而生涯飽暖；木炁攻度，如不夭折而家計傾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"頺。若逢太白照臨，必趕退當年之弱木，更兼夭首入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，未可化正宫之難炁。晝火未能成器，夜羅必能致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1627,"lineType":1,"content":"祥。寅卯二宫，官魁顯而名早登鴈塔；寅亥二宫，暗耗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1629,"lineType":1,"content":"欺而財似雪溶湯。冬火無光，亦主家道充足；春木有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，必愁體用早亡。夏水臨官而慳貪吏輩，秋計同位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"而兜攬牙郎。夜月明在虛躔，文章不露；晝陽輝於虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"位，福禄愈昌。限值寅宫之歲宿，虛度少年；更逢卯位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198616070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"之孤神，惜乎壯歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎丑位，星紀揚州，正當斗牛之星輝，偏喜火金而燦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"爛。夜土单行而千災不䧟，晝火獨立而百禍俱消。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"月無情，不照覆盆之下；木炁相攻，難保生身之全。单","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"炁而六親氷炭，獨計而五族華夷。金星入局，一生發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1649,"lineType":1,"content":"非横之財；熒惑歸垣，終世享優游之樂。卯辰火羅，寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"亥炎熒。夜生為貴以榮身，晝誕為災而不難。五星朝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"官居極品；九曜㑹，貴不可言。若在空亡之地，火羅生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198632454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"夏令，何愁不發；若在高强之位，木炁攻秋金，必主無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"成。冬水入垣，必須破祖；秋計㑹命，亦當損財。孤神照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"而常挑嫁帳；寡宿臨而孤苦無兒。寅宫强木之為凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"必主天年之不保；卯位健炁而為煞，斷定人禍以相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"招。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬寅位，析木燕分。尾斗乃木之真垣，箕宿亦水之次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"舍。文士生而多此宫泊宿，舉子現亦於燕地安身。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"火交而多招病患；水火㑹而過惡難施。金月臨五更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854838198648838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1675,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣，筆下生煙；孛羅㑹三春得用，閙𫟚有錢。旺氣居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，常患風恙；秋金入局，亦忌癆癱。更看天上何宿，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"推地下何星。官魁現於天上四旬，名揚四海；爵印顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"於地下三十，位列三公。水陽居鄭，虛逞嘍囉。土計守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"亢，一生愁嘆。忽逢刑孛與高强，因官致富。若有囚水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"占官宫，傍貴成家；身同亢躔，縱夜生傷財，難免。太白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"歸垣，若冬令不能為害。亥藏土計，生身不出辰宫；荆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"有水羅，大貴必生。已上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667215414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎。卯宫，流火宋分，正當大火之尾房，亦㑹氐心之土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛星守而心腹災生，水宿臨而臆肝疾定。最喜入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"命，木星為刑囚，亦當致富。又宜到限，紫炁作暗耗，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"能有成。福熒夜朗，功名早動宸京；刑孛攻熒，魂魄早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"歸岱嶺。木炁攻田而田宅進益，水孛破福而福壽俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"消。金牛見孛，常防隂女而傷身；人馬逢金，大忌官符","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"而破碎。日東月西，名不求而自得；隂陽易位，利多取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"亦無成。陽酉隂卯，决無久遠家風；水西孛東，那有連","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667231798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"綿活計。羅星守而自逞英雄，計星入而為人愚蠢。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"抵星躔如此，亦觀月令相同。限到煞宫須夭折，命逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"難宿定遭凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤辰宫，鄭國兖邦。芒孛呈輝於亢度，壽星亦現於水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"𨇠。最宜金月夜朗，而名動甲科；又逢土計晝生，而官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"居極品。若逢火羅旺三河，必斷少年之薤露；又值孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"熒臨獅子，壽於壯歲不經霜。太隂獨行巨蟹，更喜孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"星；太白獨守亢宫，又宜土宿。身月獨明。月孛单照，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667248182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"還反生於魯分，傷妻害子；又或順行於雙女，損子離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"夫。大抵太陽獨行午位，而百福來迎；設有五星㑹合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"離宫，而千瘡不利。宋宫遇計而家積珍珠，豳位逢苴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"而粟藏千囷。水孛㑹命，錢財常施於隂人；計孛背行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1737,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄每求於吏輩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
