{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1739,"lineType":1,"content":"巳宫雙女，鶉尾楚荆。張軫二宿真水局，火蛇秋令正清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1741,"lineType":1,"content":"辰土宿臨宫防不壽，計都到命必傷殘。金水同宫，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1743,"lineType":1,"content":"令亦能發跡，水金獨旺，夏月必能有成。单水若㑹隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667264566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1747,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，末年大富。太隂夜生巨蟹，唾手成名。太陽臨位為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1749,"lineType":1,"content":"人萬𧰼包容；太白對望此輩千機兜攬。孛計立而身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1751,"lineType":1,"content":"流四海，孛羅㑹而命䘮三隅。太隂生於瓶地，一生勞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1753,"lineType":1,"content":"碌不曽閒。土計若旺留宫，半世顰眉而獨立。若逢空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"庫，中年萬一不如前；更㑹呻吟，末世千倉亦破碎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1757,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫獅子，鶉火三河。星張為君臣之正禮，柳土作輔弼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"之相隨。太陽臨星而登正殿，一世無災；太隂入張而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"守后宫，終身有慶。金水扶陽而為貴，木炁相攻而作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667280950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。火羅重疊，晝生必定傷殘；孛計交㑹，夜誕亦當産","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮。单水為人巧計，单金主性多剛。朔望反而衣食何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1769,"lineType":1,"content":"益，隂陽順而富貴非遲。最宜单火单羅，福權反盛；若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"還獨計孤孛，威勇尤昌。逢木月則重粧嫁飾，遇月炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1773,"lineType":1,"content":"則再作新郎。須為林下之先生，方免刑傷于一世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"未宫巨蟹，鶉首秦州。太隂初生於鬼躔，少年薦鶚快横","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1777,"lineType":1,"content":"秋，旺木四時生井宿；壯歲化龍知有日。土計交始為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1779,"lineType":1,"content":"蝕神，不啞聾必遭毒藥，孛羅背方能為福，作武士必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667297334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1783,"lineType":1,"content":"主英雄。太陽单行，六親失力；紫炁獨旺，俗計無縁。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"水伴，而名必顯；火羅背，縱富無名。木月同躔，非特富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1787,"lineType":1,"content":"而且貴，太隂遇忌，雖聰秀亦奚為。月羅來往，此身難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1789,"lineType":1,"content":"免不歸鄉。月計同行，斯命必然暴外路。須教破病暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1791,"lineType":1,"content":"纒身，庶使優游於一世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1793,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫隂陽實沈晉益。觜參乃水之正宫，畢井為身之次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1795,"lineType":1,"content":"度。水宿難經，名早題於虎榜；木星入命，利常滿於龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1797,"lineType":1,"content":"倉。日月不明，任得地只成小富；土計為煞，縱為福也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667313718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1801,"lineType":1,"content":"主凶危。孛羅背，財求陸路；孛計㑹，切忌遠方。太白獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1803,"lineType":1,"content":"行，富而且貴；火羅順往，任富無名。土計同入雙魚，本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1805,"lineType":1,"content":"為煞而無患；水孛戰於白羊，雖為吉亦傷殘。紫炁入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1807,"lineType":1,"content":"而財豐厚，土宿獨而禍俱消。身同官宫，功勲生於毫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1809,"lineType":1,"content":"管；金月魯分，名利出於征鋒。火土獨守，福官横財可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"取；土計夜臨衛分，一世迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1813,"lineType":1,"content":"酉有金牛，大梁趙分昴畢，乃日月出入之門，胃度亦土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1815,"lineType":1,"content":"金相生之宿。月生滄海利黄昏，太白歸垣宜夜𫟚。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667330102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"計為人豐厚，火羅主性多剛。夜生為禍不侵，晝誕天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1821,"lineType":1,"content":"年不永。日為西没，卯時必定早亡；月臥金牛，晝誕名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"亦何益。木炁忌星，逢春生必獲資財。孛宿凶神，遇二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1825,"lineType":1,"content":"八不能為禍。水宿躔身，為財星入命。月居卯戌，作鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1827,"lineType":1,"content":"旺身衰。少年多富多福以榮昌；壯歲破財破宅而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"利。火羅為煞，夜生喜照於寶瓶；木炁為財，四季不宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"於齊子。金火不降，舉手傷人之輩；月熒爭耀，敢獨衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"陣之徒。葢忌星反作吉星，吉曜反為煞曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667346486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1837,"lineType":1,"content":"戌地白羊，降婁魯國，甘羅幼歲成名；月居奎度，鄧通少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"年巨富。太隂在婁，日月臨，錢財常滿於囊篋；火羅旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"名利毎出於旌旗。身月奎宿呈輝，文章奮發。孛宿婁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"宫争水，痼疾躔身。单羅可忌，恐壯歲暴亡；水孛相攻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"定少年天折。木炁守而財帛昌盛，木炁限而富貴非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":1847,"lineType":1,"content":"遲。孛計晝生而不夭，常患災生；水火夜誕亦無傷，難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"堪疾苦。单炁為人好善，隻木主性多能。若逢旺土守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":1851,"lineType":1,"content":"官宫，末年獲福；更植紫木在丑位發成便亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667362870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"亥位雙魚，五星好顯於娵訾；豳到天門，九曜宜臨於衞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":1857,"lineType":1,"content":"分。位極官高，葢因太白旺乎室；名登臺省，身月常照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1859,"lineType":1,"content":"璧兼危。忽遇炁金，身恐隨於蝶夣；若逢計孛，命必䘮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"於龍宫。出地入天，日生有氣；移乾就濕，晝誕無虞。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":1863,"lineType":1,"content":"星入而防妻魍魎，水宿㑹而恐子螟蛉。单羅而功名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"葢世，单計而妻妾重傷。炁孛常患於性剛，恩中反怨；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":1867,"lineType":1,"content":"羅月必遭於病患，服藥無功。縱有刑囚内夾，因官致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1869,"lineType":1,"content":"富；若教福禄齊行，為吏成名。水孛单行，喜居寅丑，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667379254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"金有氣，最喜燕邦。单金单木占妻田，中年發福；孤陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1875,"lineType":1,"content":"单月坐官福，縱富無名。身月若居天秤，太隂忽坐金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1877,"lineType":1,"content":"牛。若逢春生必貴，若生秋令無光。三方䧟而無吉助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1879,"lineType":1,"content":"一世安能進身。更推諸煞以伏降，末年皆由平坦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1881,"lineType":9,"content":"二十八宿坐命詩斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1883,"lineType":1,"content":"安命若在鬼井中，敢言敢斷性英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"生身若在星柳位，孛計同躔作貝戎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"東西南北月歸垣，筆下文章冠世賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667395638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"若是晝生無發用，中年見月必斷弦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1893,"lineType":1,"content":"翼軫從來屬地户，唾手成名文必露。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":1895,"lineType":1,"content":"若還孛計在高强，　决定中年尸外路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":1897,"lineType":1,"content":"角躔安命性不柔，機關作事世無儔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":1899,"lineType":1,"content":"若歸亢度生秋月，高官極品百年秋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"氐房心宿屬卯宫，　定他氣性最英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"若還水孛一齊入，　設使居官不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"尾箕主人多病患，管有一呼百人喚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667412022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"斗木為人性有剛，牛女為人寛且緩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"虛宿单行分晝夜，晝生剛直言語徐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":1913,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生必是破資財，富貴浮雲如水苴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"室璧從來木向榮，包容萬𧰼性如神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1917,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟服衆居鄉校，不日成名達紫宸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1919,"lineType":1,"content":"奎宿文章世所稀，少年筆下有珠璣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼夜火一齊入，身著錦衣換布衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":1923,"lineType":1,"content":"婁星度兮有十二，　日生兇頑無可比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855177667428406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1927,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生没有福禄臨，大抵作事無終始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1929,"lineType":1,"content":"胃昴二宿與金同，為人自逞有成功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1931,"lineType":1,"content":"若還木炁臨齊子，　一世空為百歲翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"觜參立命屬隂陽，倐忽聚散未為昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1935,"lineType":1,"content":"朝雨暮雲無定性，木火臨之福必降。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1937,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/S {"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"星家源流，以太陽為命之所自出。太陽出夘，故人之立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"命亦在夘。不知太陽出夘者，舉大較也。以大較例人安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"命，此命之所以不準。今以太陽東升考之，小寒至芒種，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"小暑至大雪，俱出夘。若冬至後十九日，晝極短而出辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664346662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"初初刻，夏至後十五日，晝極長而出寅正四刻。人立命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"既以太陽為體，則所生所出時候，亦當隨太陽推遷。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"余觀之，凡日出夘時，則立命在卯，若出寅辰，則立命當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅辰。通闗加盤，俱因輪轉，方足以體造化之妙。臺厯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"首論十二宫立命，専考對度。余命太陽在斗十九，對度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"是張一，當以張一度立命是也。況太陽過宫處，毫𨤲之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"差，宫分判然，又不可不細考也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":9,"content":"十二位論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"當生日㸔在何宫，　加向元時回視東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"天輪自轉地輪定，夘上長為命所宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"然後配以十二位，其中昭然賤與貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"巳夘午上為最强，子酉之方是其次。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申亦以近名之，　三合要㸔亥與未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"此為照處餘則非，　吉星要聚凶星離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍二方稱惡弱，　天象奚堪下臨著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732739620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"善曜何常能致祥，　凶星好事渾銷鑠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"第三之宫號閑極，　五星不得纎毫力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有月在此方生，却向命中添福徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":2,"content":"十二宫高下乃逆數也。凡吉凶星曜在命三合及對見之，則力𦂳也。丑之為位，乃在癸水之末，且其為土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"又是虚處，水遇虚則明，故宜於月，雖曰閑極，實可為用，比其他星曜所不能及。大抵以夘為命，則當從此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"推之。在餘位者，固不可執為例也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":9,"content":"論命宫主星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"本位無星理對宫，縱橫三合理皆同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570933794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"若無一宿推宫主，宫主星同斷吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":2,"content":"如人命宫無星者，但㸔宫主星在何方。若在七强宫，更在廟旺，亦主富貴。若在五弱宫，并留逆段，或作忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"星，主貧賤。或更與惡星犯身命不得其死矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":9,"content":"論身宫主星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"古人常重在陰陽，此法推來第一强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"日向東生為命局，月從西出作身方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"今人只筭在身宫，但把當年月位終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"理謬不知真造化，　枉將心力妄推窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703509031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"造化、身宫源流皆有自來。今之論星，皆以太陰坐處即為身局，是為淺陋。夫身宫者與命宫同，即以生時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"從太陽數至夘則為命宫，胡不以太陰數至酉為身宫。既以太陰生處即為身宫，則當以太陽生處為命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"局。此法甚長，余世家之學每每賴此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":9,"content":"論身命宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"身命第一號高强，惡曜偏防犯此宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"日忌火兮夜忌土，不宜十五度中逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"前後最嫌逢惡曜，吉星釣月有光耀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"更加金木作宫神，宫主尊時第一妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664363046"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"天之稟賦，實根原身命二宫。人之操持，亦憑賴陰陽二宿。身命二宫，防惡曜之侵，陰陽二主，忌凶星之入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"擇其尤者，則日生重太陽，夜生重太陰。推其至者，則男人重身，女人重命。然十五度中而遇忌星加宫，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"星無氣，必然禍起災生，此論甚審。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":9,"content":"論身命二主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中，惟身命二主最為利害，論五星先當輕重乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"此。夫主星如魚之水，木之根，魚無水則死，木無根則枯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"身命無主則危，此理甚明。論主星者，畏刑煞，忌陷弱。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢煞與刑，逢陷與弱，欲長年享福，將何所恃？必然刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075855982611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"害夭折。凡論主星，一喜逢禄，二喜逢貴，三喜逢生，四喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"逢廟旺，五喜高强，與善星並立，遇此者必功名富貴。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"陷入遷移，必主流蕩。在疾厄，主傷殘，臨財帛，多積聚。入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅，則田宅萬頃。居福禄，則福禄有餘。入奴僕，則奴僕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"不走。與善星併，則先艱難而後富貴。若逢惡曜，斷然貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"薄，隨驗隨應，余嘗試之而屢中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":9,"content":"論星曜同照命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水同宫，若臨廟旺樂度，主文章秀麗，聦明智慧，清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092775772198"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"職品序貴格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"金土炁日月同宫，若廟旺得地，主蔭潤福禄，龎厚性𡩖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"處世温煖也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"金火水孛日同宫，若陷沒，主尅父尅妻，平生多蹇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"金火羅同宫，得地則貴，乃武職品序。若陷沒，反成蹇破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"招刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"火土計孛同宫，若陷沒，主凶暴夭刑，若非兵權武卒，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"難保平生之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732723236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"金木火計孛同宫，則曰疊刑，主人成中反破，福中反禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"尅害陷禍，多蹇招刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"日月羅計同宫，則曰蝕神，主人損尅父母。若在第四宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"必主破相𠔥，主權性暴，出身低㣲，偏生庶出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛計同宫，若夜生更陷沒，必主夭夀，卑㣲下愚狠毒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"主刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"火土同宫，不問日夜，若陷沒宫，決多蹇破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計金水同宫，主性姦雄淫慾，酒色招刑，是非愛憎臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433904162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"身，雕身不足。舉此十例，其他尅剥，皆准此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":9,"content":"論星曜合照命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"木金水合照，主聦明文藝，性多巧伶俐，貴氣文秀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"日月炁合照，福禄厚重，享福豐足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"火土合照，主性靈不藏事，得地則聦明，陷沒則凶暴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計火土合照，主形性膽氣，凶暴雄豪，若為武職，主威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"日月合照，主大富貴，為人材貌英偉，聦明近貴。且舉此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008946203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"五例，若有一星臨之，須詳前段星辰，論其禍福，隨宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"分𦂳慢而言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論五星，全在於命宫分野宫度，然後論其身宫主星，禄主星，三方三限主星，其星辰禍福，子細消詳，廟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"旺陷弱而言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：土日同方生在晝，更在陽宫當富有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"夜人倘見落陰鄉，作事多艱是殃咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"土星合照福堅牢，好潔難婚亦貴豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"金如㑹火守强位，性緊貪華性更高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570982946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"水與土合有學禄，智慧無窮愛畨覆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"木火同照主貴權，設施驚衆誇神速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"木金宜得女財多，貴貌端嚴心多慾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"此二星在命宫，或對合見之，主得富貴，貴而多妬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"日在火兮生在夜，若㨿火西必權霸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"木星更照定封侯，尤於武庫増聲價。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"從來日與木同塗，貴顕成家與衆殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生月若火相㑹，縱然殘減亦分符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664313894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"更向高强逢著木，名達財豐真貴族。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"火如照月當晝盈，却苦瘡痍每煎蹙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":9,"content":"論星曜對照命宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"更推星曜相衝望，就中火土為災障。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"對在强方并見月，中年困苦多消歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"濕宫水照當憂溺，乾位却須防獸嚙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"少男少女少資財，多病多迍多口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"或遭毒藥及刑傷，了了經中皆具説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664379430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"東南巳午為乾宫，西北亥子為濕宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"諸方最怕陽對木，復在陰宫更勞漉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"金如望火不利婚，若使迎陰却宜娶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"土星衝月蹇語言，作事多妖難與語。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"月如見土夭并狂，　見水其音為吃苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"火日自傷先尅父，　土月須知不宜母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"火星對月轉就火，須信望中俱作禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"火月或土對，土月或火對，及月對土火是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433887778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"不然共守上下宫，或伴月行西沒，過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"此為夭折寒㣲人，縱使暫成終亦破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"流年星與限值及太嵗相宜，則有如意之事，然根基","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"淺薄，終久不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"若見金木日月，主豐足温厚富福。經云：足禄多財。木星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"與太陽同㑹，平生不耕蠶而衣食具，所謂生居豪族世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570966562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"無虞，出有輕車食有魚。福夀厚高天與佑，平生萬事稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"心。如。○金主得妻財，○月常有財帛，多成敗。不積貯，○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"日多積蓄，星聚為福，忌土火孛計。水臨照此宫，或臨巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"午之上，更有火土之照，決多蹇剥。土主耗散，縱得錢，纔滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"必傾。若吉星合照同宫，不妨四十後五十㣲發。經云：火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"居財上旺年年，中主交時即不堅。若得吉星三合照，中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"年破得末團圓。○月孛生來少積貯。假使中年承祖宗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"付托，有如三春之花，正開時，被狂風猛雨折了，若有吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732788772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"星照視，方免破敗。○計求財如縁木求魚，隨得隨喪，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"成多敗，中末却主旺。○水主初年耗散。經云：財帛宫中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"遇水星，如人把火照霜冰。第二宫中逢此宿，初年囊槖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"盡皆傾。水星生旺莫臨財，進退難逃主有災。縱有資財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"千萬倍，如人把火照氷開。别有吉星轉助則可，若見水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"星獨臨陷沒，必多破敗祖業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":9,"content":"論兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟只論其和睦與不和睦。今人多愛問幾兄弟，若與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092775755814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"他分其數目，則失矣。兹見日月金木炁，則兄弟慈和友","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"愛。日喜於陽位，則福緊，夜生在於陰宫，則禄慢。月主有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟姊妹，上下和睦無尅害。月在第三宫，號為入廟。經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"云：第三宫中為閑極。金主兄弟三人，姊妹二人，皆得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"木主三兄二弟，孝順和睦，無尅。只忌羅、計、孛、火、土，必須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"尅剥，當自立也。羅主有兄弟三兩人，亦得力，主大貴。計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"有兄弟不得力，若獨行則兄友弟恭。孛總不得力，縱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"亦爾東我西，相見如水火，與他人一般，只宜自卓立。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703558183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"難得兄弟力，土不得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":9,"content":"論田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅亦為父母宫，若見日月金水炁福星臨之，得地必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"主滋蔭，享上人之福。經云：多居産業，金水木照田園。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"金主有祖業，父母具慶，衣食自豐。○水難招祖業，自立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"方旺。○木多居産業，父母全○月，主尊親有夀，宜居祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"業，忌羅、計、火、土入宫分，必須尅剥父母，不然主過房，庶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"出破敗，祖業破而再成也。○羅自宜卓立，更有吉星照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703541799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，則家道大興。○計祖業難靠，宜自卓立，如炁木二星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"傍照，不以此論。○火不得祖業。賦曰：少失資財。金火同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"臨獅子位，獅子非午也，葢獅子乃官禄之位，對照田宅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"在子位也。若吉星則禍福又異。○土雖紹祖業，亦尅父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"母，因田宅争訟。○孛主尅父母，有祖業，終破敗。若居次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"胎，則父母無碍。更加土計同宫，則主過房偏生。經云：田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"宅宫中土孛防，三方閑極可悲傷。此身若不為僧道，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"喚他人作父娘。又云：土星月孛居四鄉，合招異姓作爺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703492647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"娘。不是偏生婢妾養，東房移過喫西房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":9,"content":"論男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"第五宫中號男女，最忌孛計并火土。必然尅剥少女男，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"若非外姓應難主。○若見金木水日月，必主貴子俊麗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"之男。○金長宜見女，次則男貴，主有三男二女。或晝生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"人，或在寅上，名為愠怒，𠔥六巳人，宜見異姓之子。○木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"主少女多男，日生則多，夜生則次。男聰明智慧，女四徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥全。○水主有四子，聦明端正，至老得力。如在戍位，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008962587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"宜偏生過房。桃花夾竹，異姓之子。若六壬人見之，即主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"二男二女，須詳吉凶星斷。○日主五男二女，至老不尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬人見之，謂之魁星，倍加福力。○月主男得力，若被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計照破，則主遲晚，或長見女。若在夘酉亥未巳者，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"怕惡星，若見月孛，必主尅剥。經云：子孫之位怕孛過，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"男應是女生多。若得善星來照視，晚招一對定應多。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"孛主女多，男女遲見方保。六丁人，此宫見之全無，縱有亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"不得力，如有吉星合照不妨，若太陰相對，則主男大貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453072664330278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"女封號。日生則減力。○火主二三人，若為土星首尾合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"照，或白日生人，六丙生人，全不得力，主孤寡。土主一子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"若入廟則有二子，忌曜則減力。○炁主有男女宜遲，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"星亦名孤星，○計男女少，若早見則定尅晚年，主一子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"羅不宜早見。經云：蝕神臨子最難為，得力還招外姓兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"假饒若過三旬外，親生一箇是便宜。主桃花夾竹，偏生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"過房。惟六甲辛壬人主三男二女，至老得力。若六巳人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫見之，全無子息，縱有不得力。○又論命宫，福星盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075008929819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，必主子息之盛，若見凶星惡弱，必然蹇破。經云：妻無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"子息，都縁月孛在七强。凡論女人子息，大槩與前同，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午宫坐命曰乾宫，若見計孛忌星，則主難子不生。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子坐命曰濕宫，若見金木土星，多主子息三男二女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"之數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"第六宫中號惡弱，五星不得臨照著，一切加臨在此宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄資財日消鑠。凡星辰皆不喜此一宫，若得善星在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703590951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"其中，福力慢，主奴僕侍從之福。金木得力，定主少年尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"父母，○水主有奴僕鞍馬，中年走失，○土有奴僕多走","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"失。若有木星同位，則至老奴婢成羣，○羅主奴婢自然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"豐厚，一呼百諾○日，一生得力。若見計孛火土刑星，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"遭其害，○計常被脫賺，○孛不得力多走失，○火有奴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"僕不久逺。六甲人見此星者，所謂禄主臨惡弱之地，難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"為享福。若魁星科甲，三方高强，無慮此宫。若科甲、魁星、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"官星、學堂、禄主，一切星落此，總不得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703525415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":9,"content":"論妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾一宫與命宫相對，又曰西沒宫。㸔此宫有何星曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"若見金木水星，則主美貌，夫婦和睦。若見火星計孛，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"然尅破陷害。又況金為人之妻星，㸔金星落何宫，又㸔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡星相㑹言之。若㑹木水，必近妻家財，妻之蔭潤，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"近陰人財。若同火土計孛，必多尅剥。經云：尅妻害子，太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"乙與首尾同宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":9,"content":"論疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075570950178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"第八宫中號疾厄，忌見計孛并火土。忽然陷沒更疊刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"難免疾厄終身禍。如有福星來解免，尚且疾中難可保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"若無救療決生違，至死必須還尅破。君子貴命見之，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"主脚疾股肱之患，終身常帶氣血之疾。小人則折脚眇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"目，拳秃駝腰，官刑徒杖之禍。女人多招産難血氣之疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"至重者亦至身疾。金計相㑹，男女多主雕青痕痣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":9,"content":"論遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移主行藏，喜金木炁福星臨之，主君子遷官進爵。經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076732756004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"云：欲問榮華，大扺金居九位，凡見善星臨之，處世行藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"皆吉。若見凶刑忌星，主平生多歇滅，縱有官品，常多蹇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"滯。若見忌土，多主九流商旅，㳺學紫炁土星並係客星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"此論載靈臺經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":9,"content":"論官禄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"第十宫中號官禄，若見善星多富足。貴人職品必須高，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"小人必近食官禄。凡貴命又㸔宫主是在何宫，却分品","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"序。此宫若見凶刑忌星，計孛陷弱，反成不足，職𤰞命薄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518895650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":9,"content":"論福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"十一宫中號福徳，若見吉星須享福。加與金木紫炁同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"更在强宫必為淑。○若見計孛火土，必多蹇破，亦多主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"福中之憂，禄中不足，縱使富豪，常有意外之不足。○太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"陽福徳最為竒，白日生人喜得之。五福俱全尊上徳，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"榮三爵福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":9,"content":"専論福禄二主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624420352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"人元當生之年，稟賦者十有一星，安排者十有二局。十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫中所要者，惟福禄為主，十二局中所重者，惟福禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫。今推之五星，質之人為，凡有卓立功名致富貴者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"而此二宫未嘗無吉曜，而福禄二主星亦未嘗陷，○或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"禄主歸窠，或福星歸福，或帶吉而逢生，或歸徳而帶權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"或入廟旺，似此之𩔖，往往皆是，豈福禄無星而可耶？○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"如其處世孤貧，為人流蕩，以其福禄二宫驗之，未嘗有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"一吉曜，而二星亦未嘗不弱，或禄主背命，或福曜逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624387584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"囚，或禄宫帶刑星而黨立，或福徳帶惡曜而傷殘，似此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"之𩔖，往往皆是，豈五星闗鍵而不在此二宫耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":9,"content":"再論福徳宫變格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳一宫人莫窮，晝生從日夜從陰，數取日月相去位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"還從東出配其終。數盡之處為相位，次㸔何宿守其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇善星相對照，福夀高崇禄料豐。又𠔥金木作宫主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳高强福更隆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"見西天都例經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"福徳者，為身命之根源，吉星聚此，則福夀堅牢，惡曜臨之，則命浮弱，吉凶如響。凡推其福徳宫，日生則從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703607335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽數至太隂，夜生則從太陰數至太陽，數其相去幾宫，然後從命宫數其相去宫位，即為相貌，次則福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"徳。若正坐高强，復得吉星為本宫之主，加以文星又在高强，必然享福無窮，受禄綿逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":581,"lineType":9,"content":"再論相貌奴僕兩位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌奴僕非高位，兩者多縁凶與忌。當生七曜落其間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"一世孤窮苦憔悴。晝裏生人火占高，月最不宜來對視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"夜逢土宿同此推，太薄如何望身貴。月在惡曜行度間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"惡者復强善者閑。三方不救五星伏，必為賤隷處人寰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"論相貌奴僕，於理為長，識者宜詳味之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433969698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":595,"lineType":9,"content":"定三日宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"若下胎元宫不下三日宫若下三日宫不下胎元宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"三主高强福禄昌，文星㑹命貴人鄉。更逢紫水臨其限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"少年及第佐朝廊。○三日宫中紫孛羅，三方辰戍更相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"過。若被忌星來照著，定向三朝損命多。○三日宫中居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"惡弱，更加凶曜在其中。吉星不照難延命，縱然不死患","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"重重。○三日宫中土孛傍，三方閒極可悲傷。此身若不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"遭迍否，定教他人作父娘。○三日宫中水木星，平生聦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"俊佐王廷。三方若在高强位，金榜無疑定有名。○三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097657958400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"始得力，羅紫命中行。縱然為文職，須當帶珮行。○一生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"身命處高宫，三方精徹在其中。官禄遷移吉星照，員郎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"給諫至三公。○三日宫中晝火星，夜生遇土一般同。紫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"炁限星如交著，定見危亡三嵗中。○火星有夀只三年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得成人被禍纒。大限不到三四十，須交十五入黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔生後三日宫，月到何星分度中。金木相逢俱是吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"若交見水性偏聦。○善星更作身命主，復占强方不失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"度。此為有福無難人，一生謀運何嘗阻。忽然至此却逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075856064531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"火，終身豈免興災禍。第一損夀二損財，所向多乖遭折","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"挫。更坐土星同照地，常時分外生迍否。木曜縱橫不救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"之，禄𥮅永終天然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"夫三日一宫，最難分别，或者以為身命第三宫，或者又為日第三宫，互相矛盾，妄指其説以為竒。吁！論五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"星者，尚不識三日宫，何以論人之禍福？夫三日宫者，係人一身禍福之地，惡星躔之，災禍隨至，吉曜臨之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"福夀可期。如其又在十五度中，其應立驗，烏可不詳論之？今以三日宫併言之，大凡論三日宫，先推太陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"躔何星宿，而後迤邐推其宫分，前三日則前三星，後三日則後三星也。如太陰躔尾宿，前三日尚屬斗宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"後三日屬房宿，此為三日宫甚明，而禍福如影響，捨是推何星而躔三日之宫乎？從其輕重分剖，則造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097657991168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"可窺矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":651,"lineType":9,"content":"定胎元宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰所歴過一宫是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"余按此條有二明三暗之説，葢引天機所重者，而証巳之言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元宫裏金𠔥木，貧賤性殘當夭促。人生不幸定遭之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"若見時臨傷眼目。○土火胎元係二明，男子遭之則昌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。婦人逢之夫位顯，莫教柔曜月前迎。○金水二星號","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"最柔，蟾魄無令與聚頭。抱病打傷猶可巳，其間貧苦更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"憂愁。○月過一宫為胎元，金木相逢定夭貧。火土二交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453079433986082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"并孛曜，高强即是富華人。天機數有胎元星，三暗相扶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"及二明。必取富豪并世禄，其中一半是官人。疾病多端","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"見小孩，只因金火犯元胎。奈何上下相闗照，眼目瘡痍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"競發來。身宫胎元紫炁星，不是疾厄與孤刑。尅害爺娘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"身自立，不然有異見雙生。男女紫炁犯胎星，且為僧道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"及孤貧。不是雙胎并異母，又須刑害尅雙親。後扶前引","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔星辰，强曜康寧福夀人。錯説陰柔凶短折，更加惡弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"老憂貧。太陰却到㑹空辰，金木從高性且迍。恩及親知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453076518944802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"成悔吝，到頭顧遇有誰人。月限犯孤星不救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":685,"lineType":2,"content":"月前方九十度。無星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"對月皆金木水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"行年又却值三災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"月限忌土木二交，行年不要見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"後人推步知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"相識，若使斯人禍患來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰所歴過之一宫，謂之胎元宫，以未生三日之前，月在其中故也，亦名生前三日宫。此宫有星曜，禍福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"尤切。月在之宫謂之身宫，未到之宫謂之生後三日宫，此三宫星曜照見善惡，與身一例言之。天機無生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"前三日、生後三日之説，只以前扶後引，有何星曜，依訣斷之，則無不驗。然只以去太陰二十七度為准，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"二十七度外，雖是隔宫，亦如不見，不謂扶引也。天機更取前一方者，葢以十二宫分之為四方，則一方者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"月前三宫是也。定九十一度為準，九十一度外不是，如無强星輔之，月限孤矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":705,"lineType":10,"content":"命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經：天柱星飛在禄宫，又玉堂貴人宫，夘上謂之明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"堂，午上謂之軒轅，戍上謂之武庫。身命主星居此，未可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"作下流命，㸔天柱而羅計同不吉。獨行主人身閑，若在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"天門及飛天宫上吉。大凡禄主居廟旺之地，皆主發禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"財主星㑹天柱在弱宫，吉。天柱命主二星俱入金門宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"不必論田宅，最好文昌星入學堂，主修學。如丁巳生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097657974784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"天柱在未，名夜劍鋒煞，未為陽刄，主夭夀。凡人天柱帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"馬獨行，見太陽，主人心狂。天柱躔遷移宫，主人入贅過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"房，遷居離祖之類，與天蠱星同，主人好訟。或天蠱入身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫，主多招訟事。天柱入官禄之宫，乃官禄入命主星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"尋官並以吉斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金星入命夜生吉，白日生人減半力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"木星照命有多般，白日逢之必作官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生若有暗曜雜，返為凶禍主憂煎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858716713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"水星在命合入廟，夜裏生人太陰照。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"或居雙女與陰陽，決定少年居顯要。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"火星入命不堪詳，白日生人主禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"更被孛羅三合照，定知啞吃與人傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"患勞枉死人孤寡，夜生又宜却無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"土星入命主頑鈍，夜裏生人不可論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"水命定知須啞吃，黄腫氣疾命難存。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽坐命若逢木，羅紫同宫須食禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097658007552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"火星不照定封侯，月孛臨之患心腹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰在命生逢夜，水宿同宫為僕射。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿入命孛星來，有禄定知非乆謝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁印星號天乙，　凡在命宫皆有益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"生時不被惡星臨，善宿合兮多子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"未月見紫入夜宫，夜裏生人為輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"若是土星三合照，　雖則高强終是疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋入命計謀多，木紫同宫主富豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703623719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"金木太陽三合照，此人慷慨更英豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"女人夜生羅照著，自縊勞刑貧又薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"紫火水計入命時，此則定主十般惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"計都入命。憂火命，此則十煞惡無定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人遇者以無權，白日生人宜修進。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"木星紫日如照臨，　主命俱强為福慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星入命人廉潔，目快心清為性别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"紫木日金合照時，所作高强皆有節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097658023936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"日生火孛主星㣲，決定刑傷蛇虎食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"掩口不開氣衝人，直得為官須歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":797,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕，經天寶星，財帛者天寶所司，㸔飛在何宫，禄主玉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"堂吉，見羅計孛火土正忌星反，財物耗散，怕廢星財不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"興，耗星財不聚，陷星及狼籍分，皆不吉。㑹天蠱星，主訟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"破財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金臨財帛足隨時，夜裏生人皆進滋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858569257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"木臨財帛必豐隆，　日中生者最難逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"水臨財帛財帛散，更被孛來不足㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"火居財帛與前同，土居財帛皆豐亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽居此足錢財，　貿庫常開待物來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"月居財帛多財帛，　只怕土星三合尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"紫入二宫亦忌之。　遇日木扶還又得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計孛入損資財，　終身不得資財力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":825,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092855529498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經天玉星，所司兄弟之宫，名為閑極，如獨行飛入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"陷宫，主少兄弟，或本宫上見羅計孛，多凶。金木主二人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"水月主二人，紫炁與水星皆善。星日生人忌太陰，夜忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽，並為孤宿，㑹刑廢耗主尅害，狼籍主尅損，見火孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟如仇讎。大抵男女二命，可詳細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：木金兄弟主英雄，水星和樂旺門風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"火在此宫定孤寡，夜生不與孤寡同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"土臨兄弟終和睦，　日居未可同年語。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092775870502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"生時父母決相背，木計合宫主貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰若得主星來，輔弼榮華由此胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"紫臨第三兄弟少，計星遇此斷生災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛來時損兄弟，古今傳説禍難推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
