{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經天富星：田宅者，天富所司，在命宫主田宅，加凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"宿即無，落陷終有亦少强宫廟旺，承祖業，如羅計、孛星、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"土忌刑廢耗星相㑹，或被劍鋒狼籍，天蠱對照，或三合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075856080915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"傍照，並主破産。如飛陷宫，主先無後有，禄宫玉堂皆是，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"自能卓立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金居田宅父母宫，白日生人主困窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢夜裏最為吉，産業自營邁祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"木臨田宅興父母，　自然福夀世難同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"水居第四旺田莊，更有雙親夀命長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"火星臨此不堪説，土星躔入有房廊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"白日生人為最吉，夜生父母早身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075856130067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"日居田宅足田園，木臨雙親夀命全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛不照多産業，水金合㑹常堪憐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"月臨雖稱旺田地，　白日生人反作累，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁居之多壯宏，父母一時居富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"木星入位必有官，水月合兮居顯位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"羅入田宅不堪猜，十般惡死及破財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"計都侵之憂父母，　田莊牛馬化成灰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛居此亦如之，　夜生亦可減毫𨤲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858651177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生又忌火來尅，父母早亡主孤恓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":903,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經天孤星男女乃天孤所司，大槩與兄弟同。推詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"入陷宫，主遲或刑耗，忌星化劍鋒狼籍。天廢星並主尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"損，更㸔犯星輕重。太陰在五宫先見女，金水多男女羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"計，主抝性及尅害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金星若在男女宫，　三男聦俊各英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"火在此宫不得地，遇著定來更莫窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092968693797"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"土臨第五遲遲有，夜生決定主孤蹤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽若照男女宫，　必主貴子顯門風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰居之亦如此，　三男富貴夜為功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁當生照男女，　不被惡星并火土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"三合水月同聦俊，　男女榮華定文武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"羅照男女主夭亡，　計都臨照亦災苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星倘若照此官，　十生九死空費乳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"為人性狠惡肚腸，　此乃依經與君語。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858585641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":937,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經僕馬星，六宫見孛與人不和，太陰星入此宫，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"主𤰞㣲下賤。又惡星㑹極不好，天柱星入此宫，主閒事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"勞漉，小人反覆不情之態。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金木星居足奴僕，土若加之夜為毒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"火在此宫必少力，太陰值此多悲哭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"非惟辛苦有多般，決定生時非正屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"月若居之被日土，　一世多迍更貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858618409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"第六宫中見太乙，　男女頑愚多忌疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"不然遲忌亦寡㣲，此乃皆言為不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"計羅居此有災殃，孛若臨之號凶極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":961,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"殿駕經天，對星妻妾乃此星主之忌。惡星在此宫主損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，天對之星入陷婚遲。此星見劍鋒狼籍及主星皆不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。金為婦星，須要明浄，如同劍鋒，煞主凶亡，見羅計主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"尅害。孛寅金申，主妻有貌。帶官星主妻有蔭，見刑星即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624371200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"刑。火主重婚。土主重濁肥短貌不佳。金水秀麗，木星長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦。金星逢天耗、狼籍二星，女命全見，主尅盡外家財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"人口之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金在七宫妻妾好，木星㑹此日相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"其妻非但能廉潔，貌白容妍世孰同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"水在妻宫多妖冶，火則傷殘莫論容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生猶自主離别，何況生逢在日中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"土入妻宫無貌娘，妻妾命如日裏霜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092968710181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽美貌火孛醜，　太陰見水美容粧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"紫木星臨太陰吉，羅㬋自縊檢尸傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"計入妻宫勞患死，不然毒藥溺江亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾宫中見孛星，計都水火自相刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥主蛇傷並自吊，不然産難墮青冷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛瘟黄死暴哀，落水懸崖産難灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"金鎮太陽真絶妙，多招妻妾外家財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"火土生離并帶疾，鼓盆三度請良媒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453096106049576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"木紫二星多美麗，姿容可與孟姜偕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計二妻産難别，暴䘮迯亡自帶來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"紫孛水金淫慾甚，交情奴僕老心灰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1015,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"殿駕經煞難星，疾厄者，煞難所司。如見本宫星，主帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"六、八、十二同見孛，主破相，或有宿疾。此宫水月同主風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"疾，土計同主脚患，土孛同主耳聾。火化劍鋒，主心腹血","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之疾。金忌火傷，主血膿腸風之𩔖。大凡命宫疾厄，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075856097299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"火忌孛星照，羅計穿命，不問福禄，皆主夭折。火星大忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"午上照，身命及天柱星皆不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：金在疾厄永無疾，木居富貴常安逸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"水在此宫遇計孛，必定腰駝并背屈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"白日生人火曜衝，必定風疾吐血終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"熒度疾厄須驚悸，　土臨八宫主瘟凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽遇計火土孛，風癆血病不久歿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"如見木陰獨照之，　一世優游無消歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092855545882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫若見紫炁臨，　定是安榮居要津。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"羅照此宫應篤疾，計㑹孛來定凶侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"非惟勞瘵又瘟黄，抑且吐血卧床亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1051,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經：遷移，謂之近强。人命三合宫見土宿，主離鄉。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"星，主貧賤福貴。禄星吉曜，主經商。如見月孛，謂之客死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"星。見羅計，主偏生庶出，過房出祖，帶刑出祖，不離鄉土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"若四刑星無紫炁星解救，亦主過房出祖。金木吉水宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092775837734"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"逺行，金木合照封侯，火入凶土阻逺行。太陽主晝生吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"月㑹金水夜生吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：此宫見紫主為官，太陰合兮為瑞端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"羅在遊行必見刑，家中長見檢屍靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"計都若㑹孛星入，決定蛇傷并虎擒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"切聞月孛入遷移，損田損宅損妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1075,"lineType":9,"content":"官禄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經：官禄强星，乃司命掌之，又為文解恩牒之星。士","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453083703672871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"人遇之，主發解。僧道遇之，主披剃。庶人遇之，主𤼵財置","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"業。如下流命本宫見之，㑹天蠱狼籍，主犯刑法，官災小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"人，最怕陽刃。官符宫主星相㑹，及與的煞狼籍星㑹，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"福貴二曜救解，凡與宅宫主星相㑹，皆不甚好。更㸔命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"主星明净㑹羅計，主凶死，不然㸔有禄無禄，大禄小禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡主星㑹羅計者，主夭，不然中年火孛照身命宫皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"不吉，即賤人也。孛星在官禄，主貧窮下賤。刑憲初主貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"末必不好。限入官禄宫，添羅計天蠱入限或在六八十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092775936038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：太白金星入官禄，　一世為官居要軸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"天上之宫㑹水星，太陽合照作公𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"水居好樂合於月，官居顯位職非輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"火在十宫夜入廟，朝端定列仍年少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1107,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經福夀星，福徳之宫福，夀星所掌宜天權，福財照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫上吉。如男女宫得木星紫金水善星照尤佳，縁福徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"與男女宫相對，吉星在廟旺之宫，順行為福深，在陷宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092855676954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"為福淺，最忌火星，主傷福徳故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：福徳宫中或見金，　夜生一世福神欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"木㑹太陽居十一，　禄優福厚居顯秩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"水㑹月吉火淺薄，金土同照主食邑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"十一宫中羅最吉，太陽木炁三合值。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"生則須封萬戸侯，　死則定知須廟食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1129,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"欄駕經：相貌當與六八此三宫用，推詳孛羅計㑹，或主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453075856211987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害破相、疾厄，六根不足之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：土星相貌却烏黃，木宿元來瘦且長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"金白不惟多嗜慾，水星行動愛趨蹌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋薄藝隨身有，月孛為人帶黒醜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"熒火一星多性惡，水星最是雙眉好，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"計都巧計愛談論，　羅火東西打殺人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相隨多雜藝，太陽為性却逡巡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛一生多口嘴，　水星伶俐木都美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092855660570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"土星頑鈍言語澁，羅火為人貪可鄙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1155,"lineType":9,"content":"琴堂十二位論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1157,"lineType":10,"content":"論命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"凡坐命宫，官禄福徳田，財星飛入為吉，此乃富人之命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌空亡、的破。流霞刼煞不吉，必主暗疾。破相、華葢居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"此，必主傳符度法之人。六害星辰飛入，一生勞碌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1165,"lineType":9,"content":"論財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"凡財帛主度主，官禄福徳主居此一生富貴。財星飛出，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624469504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅、官禄、福徳宫富，弱宫陷地主貧賤，更空亡、的破居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"此，再財星失陷，則食不𠑽口，衣不葢身。若財帛高强，根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"基厚重，衣禄豐隆。若六位星辰居此，管幹起家之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1177,"lineType":9,"content":"論兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"凡田宅官福四星入此，兄弟豪富。空亡的破入此，兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤。孤寡星居之，則鴈行無伴。官符居之，主兄弟逞訟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"華盖居之，主兄弟道粧疾厄。流霞刄星入，則兄弟帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"破相馬星入，則兄弟東西。咸池入，則兄弟迷戀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453096106131496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1189,"lineType":9,"content":"論田宅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"凡官禄財星太陽入此，祖業見承，田地加進。空亡的破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"入此，則産業破蕩。或胎星嵗破通闗，則兄弟争奪。奴僕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"主入，則僕幹莊田之徒。或田星飛起，官禄福徳財帛之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"地，則富。財帛同田星飛起，則重賣交易矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1199,"lineType":9,"content":"論男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"凡空亡的破居此，則男女貧賤孤寡。六害華葢入此，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"子女如石中求玉。流霞刃星居此，則男女帶疾。若居女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092855693338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"位，女必産亡。咸池星入，男女迷戀。田財官福居之，男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"豪富。遷移星居此，男必過房，女必重嫁，然陽宫男多，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"宫女多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1213,"lineType":9,"content":"論奴僕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"流霞的刄刼居之，主奴僕有疾，長生帝旺，則無災，鬼宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"居之，則奴僕偷竊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1219,"lineType":9,"content":"論妻妾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"七宫隨禄，妻有粧奩，因而致富，家業興隆，空亡的破居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092968775717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"之，妻性不常，若逢木星生旺，不是為煞，招妻俊雅炁。計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"居之，妻醜頑抝，孤寡星居之，必孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1229,"lineType":9,"content":"論疾厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1229,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫乃八煞宫若火星入之無制主人一生多難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"月到見煞，母有疾，日到見煞，父有疾。五位飛來，男女疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫星來，兄弟有疾，七宫星來，妻妾有疾。流霞的刃煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"難居之，主帶疾，不寧於厥身也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1237,"lineType":9,"content":"論遷移","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1237,"lineType":2,"content":"本宫忌孛星居之主離祖遷轉無定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"身命主居此，必當離祖過房，三位星居之，兄弟離祖。女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858733097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"見桃花煞居此，有合則不良，不然必嫁逺夫，并陽刃居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"之，則離鄉别井。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1247,"lineType":9,"content":"論官禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"身命二主并財福居之，則禄位高强。的破居此，不吉，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"位星居之，兄弟豪富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1253,"lineType":9,"content":"論福徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"本宫田、財、身、命四星居之，主清閑享用，有福之人也。的、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"刼飛來，有福不能享，流霞亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫名弱宫，身、命、官、福、田、財不喜居之。臨官帝旺、金、木、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"水陽居此，則狀貌青秀。若刼的、流霞居之，主破相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kvuic/1-SK1609_figure_00026.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HsZ9ffX0BsJvwRvyRA3THpmThHI%3D","pictureHeight":336,"pictureWidth":364,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kvuic/1-SK1609_figure_00026.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=eKngTcg%2BcrlXyyeeEukOKhS9cCI%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kvuic/1-SK1609_figure_00026.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097658056704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
