{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":8,"content":"總論諸限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":9,"content":"洞微百六限起例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":10,"content":"洞微大限一百年零六箇月故曰百六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫十五貌宫十，福徳妻宫十一詳。官禄十五最髙位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移止有八年粮。疾厄七兮共六六，財帛兄弟五年强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421225482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅子孫并奴僕，四年之半定毫芒。假令晝生火在已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"午未申酉併空亡。二十六七為盡處，不然破敗卒他鄕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":2,"content":"假令夘上安命日生人，火在已為忌星，二十六嵗限𢿙至此不行，故午未申酉併為空亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"木在午兮火在酉，三旬之七福非常。天蝎之前生在晝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"六旬之六定為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":2,"content":"當生木星在官禄宫，至三十七嵗以後，限入天中，至此稱心。夘為命宫，前即酉也。日生人限至此逢忌星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"故為禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"人生百六以為凖，學人細説莫能忘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624551424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":9,"content":"命宫十五嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫初排十五年，㸔取生時善惡躔。晝夜隂陽分兩曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"值命須知短夀年。更有羅計孛星照，不過七七入黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"兩曜者，火土也。日生忌火，夜生忌土，如在命宫必夀短，更遇惡星臨照，見命身者，不過七七，至四十九日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"須死亡也，故云七七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"若只三合五年定，對衝三嵗見迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"三合宫有惡星，不過五嵗，對照不過三嵗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔星宿幾時入，再侵元限定為寃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092968874021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"行年惡星入守舊位則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"生值紫炁木星照，自然長大少災躔。此限管年十五嵗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔取生時禍福元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫十嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌十嵗限須知，㸔取生時善惡推。若遇晝熒并夜土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"十六七上定須危。若遇吉曜生時過，一自六七喜歡歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"更言孛計相臨照，十年困苦似神迷。初入宫中十六嵗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"對衝八九喜𠔥悲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421209098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"初入限　一二年有應，對照三四年方應灾福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"三合十與十一數，宜須逐位細詳推。此限管㑹都一十，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"通前二十五年期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫十一嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳十一細推排，二旬六嵗限方來。生時善宿躔於此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"二旬七八受恩回","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":2,"content":"金木紫炁羅㬋水月入順旺合照此位大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"若言忌曜當臨照，定須催促入泉臺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955251724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"生時忌曜，日火夜土惡星同此，二十八嵗身亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇行年吉星照，吉星退後必興灾。五七三方善星照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"三旬一二笑顔開","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"三合有喜星，至三十一二嵗見喜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"若是惡曜同前述，禍惡皆從生受來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":9,"content":"官禄十五嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄十五限髙強，生時善宿在何方。紫木金羅來照此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"三旬七上入朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345744423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"官祿宮住十五年，三十七嵗入，五十一嵗出。若吉星守照，主榮位進職也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢忌曜當臨位，行年暗宿又來傷。四七之年當惡死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"未交前限早身亡。三合見逢六七嵗，對衝三十九恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":2,"content":"如三合見凶星，四十一二重灾。若對照，主三十九嵗身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"此限管行五十一，宮中善惡細推詳。吉曜生臨當喜夢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星照處惡還當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宮八嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移八嵗命合方，但看生時善惡詳。五旬二上交中限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453096106229800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星臨照足財糧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"合方三合也。五十二嵗入，五十九嵗出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"加官進職分明定，在外須知利四方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"主星有力，乃紫木羅星守此，主進職，僧道加服，庶人有財喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢惡曜凶星守，五旬六七定身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"忌星計孛照此主灾。五十六嵗主身亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"對照防灾七八嵗，三方五十八九防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"如對惡星，五十六嵗有灾。如吉星守則喜慶。三合惡星照，五十八九有灾危也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106474023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄七嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄七嵗限須防，但看生時善惡詳。吉曜六旬添喜慶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"灾星照著有灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"六十交入，六十六交出，初入限逢吉星，六十交限便受吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"蝕神首尾如狼虎，利害計孛大為殃。忌宿若非是方主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"六旬有一定身亡。對照六十三灾至，三合六旬六限當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"正逢限星，六十一嵗灾如對衝，六十三凶如三合，六十六主身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢惡曜灾應厚，吉曜臨時百福昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345826343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾十一嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"西没妻妾十一年，六旬七嵗到其邉。生值惡星居此位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"六旬七八便憂煎。尅妻害子加灾至，為官罷職不堪言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"三合防灾七十一，對照六十九來躔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"惡星火土計孛也，六十七交入，七十八交出，吉則吉凶則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕田宅男女共十三嵗半","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕子孫與田宅，此限共計十三年。每位分明四載半，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"都來半載一周天。七旬八嵗交前限，生時星宿細推遷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345809959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"八旬一嵗歸男女，八旬四上入田園。五宮惡曜八十一，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"四位八旬六七言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"男女宫，凶星八十一主身亡。田宅宫凶星八十六七身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡限看當生宿，灾殃須算降生年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"看當生星辰元守宫排凶吉，逐限交入合遇吉凶，一一如是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"前限不逢凶惡曜，兄弟五年財帛全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"財帛兄弟各五年也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"逐年行宫到此吉，壽星高照亦安然。限位都排一百六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106441255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"仍須學者細推研。若更有人彭祖壽，又從命裏説根源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":9,"content":"綂論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵洞微所急者，限主也。洞微所貴者，祿星也。所重者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"諸曜順行也。所發者，廟宫也。所畏者，忌星也。所好者，吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"神也。所輔者，行年也。所助者，三方也。所惡者，計孛在他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"宫也。如是善星䧟逆則福慢，順行則福緊。凶星䧟逆則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"灾緊，順行則灾慢。如遇吉星順行，即得本宫加數。若遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星他宫，則其數半減。若是限星居廟度，即於本數外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092776067110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"更加四年，居旺樂度，即増算二年。如一限之中見兩星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"在旺樂合共，延四年，以此増損數，更在子細加減。凡逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"惡限，行年上却逢吉星臨照，身命即延得一年壽，其行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"年星過便亡也。大凡吉星居七强為福緊，五弱力慢。灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"星在强宫為灾慢，五弱為灾緊。凡限本宫見星，灾福之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"應十分，對照七分，三合四分。凡限星在終末之度，即灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"福之力側微，而不可以定數言之。凡忌星在好樂宫，入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"限三年内為福，三年以後反為灾咎。大凡限逢忌星，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106424871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"死亦灾。若火在陰宫，土在陽宫，或為三方主，雖有厄而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"不亡。故歌曰：夜忌土星日忌火，三方不是死無疑。此星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"若是三方主，雖有灾侵命不離。火陰土陽宫尤妙，好樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"位中别有奇。謂此也。凡灾忌星生時在伏段，限内為灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"禍，只有三四分力。福星生時在伏段，亦只得三四分力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋被太陽所伏，光芒不見，有𩔖臣居君側，包藏光美之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"象。凡一限中見吉凶星同聚，即以入宫先後及順逆而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"斷吉凶，故限入宫深者先見，限入宫淺者後逢之也。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624567808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"遇本限及對照三合，並不見一星，名曰空限，主多灾凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"圖事不成。若得限主當生有力之位，則反此。惟有官祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"宫上逢空限最凶，必於四十六七嵗死矣。凡當生，若吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"星照身命者，主中年富貴，縱逢灾數，直至限末始見灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"厄。若當生凶星照身命者，中年雖逢福限，四旬之後亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"主迍滯，至限末方為福。大都吉凶之應全藉根基，當生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿則吉，限上無祿則喜宫難發，是猶無根之木，雖逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"春終不能發葩而成實也。故經云：若無一星居身命，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114040942630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"是賢愚别有因，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":9,"content":"洞微歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"百六惟推星命人，　有星方是富豪論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"若無一星居身命，自是賢愚别有因。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"夜誕晝生忌自别，晝土夜火前經説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"陽宫晝火陰夜土，　此限逢之死可决。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"夜生人忌土，晝生人忌火，此是忌星各自别也。若更晝火在陽宫，夜土在陰宫，限數遇之，死無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"福曜相兼榮裏亡，　暫時延得少時節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092968890405"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"若忌星限内却有福星照臨，即此人在稱意中亡但是一時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"生時計孛若同宫，　迍邅還是死前發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"生時若計孛同宫而限內逢者，必先失官散財，然後巳身亦亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"夜土晝火是主星，亦為灾害亦為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"夜土晝火非為主，　災禍相仍難再生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"日月金木并紫炁，當生限内成貴榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"以上七曜要當生得力，度分不移，旺廟宫掩映，方為貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋亦是貴權星，限若逢之無不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453096106213416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋是天中貴曜，别無凶星刑尅，當領重權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"當生孛至為灾異。家宅不寧禍有餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"限遇月孛，主老幼不寧，陰私氣悶，兼有哭聲。夜生較輕。惟到金牛胃宿九度，巨蟹二十一度，則反有遷榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"剝官退職因何事，限裏元來見計都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"若在亥宫并戌位，　反為遷轉涉亨衢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有吉星同限内，些小灾患不能無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"三空若遇灾頓併，　六年之内増重病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"惟到獅子十五年，　出限之時須喪命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421192714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"中限災福有遲速，　對時三四合五六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是正八最無疑，　一二年中之禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"好星限内惡星來，　身命行年小可災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"限星最忌逢惡曜，　定行催促入泉臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人逢忌星行年，又有凶星照臨，㫁定不生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"限星若在旺廟處，　必見貴人有遭遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"廟星増算，四五年　樂旺，一二年為據。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星若在廟旺宫，　不為災害福相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345760807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"星入宫淺官早來，星入宫深晚為職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡五緯忌留逆，善惡逢之皆減力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"計都要在戌亥宫，命限之中不可逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"星限之内一百六，　説盡人間災與福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"好星増算惡星乖，限內分明一一排。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽大抵須消息，　必候聰明可㫁裁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":9,"content":"洞微歌二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"前限惟推富貴人，　不知更有苦併貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624600576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"若要得知從何起，但看生時與限辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽為父在高强，　火孛同之必早亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽兩處怕猪蛇，　凶宿臨之少哭爺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰為母同惡宿，　不死之時禍又速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"火月相對如非主，方信無男亦無女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"金與孛計入陰陽，不見妻身媱亂𢦤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"多姊多妺多兄弟，只看命前第三位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"命前三位有惡星，　兄弟多傷亦無義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097658089472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"限數如來到火上，　晝誕夜生不為主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"及與二星相對時，不配不溺遭蟲虎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"生來何得早貧窮，　二星同到兄弟宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"如有善星對合照，　縱教有始也無終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"孛計到兄弟宫及火日在四宫，雖有金木紫相衝合身命，始貴終貧作盜賊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻喪婦從何得，　二宿同來見太白。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"太白反與火宫同，陰陽身命須消息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":2,"content":"凡妻星與水火同在陽宫，主生離及性惡，在陰宫主自縊暗死。與孛計對照，主無亦主縊離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453095858831401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"日月同宫夾火星，月宫人馬土星臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"平生雖道無災福，久後須交眼不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"出家移父在他鄉，不必星辰在廟堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"但看生時與九宫，　四星何處奠其方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"此歌雖是長如牘，子細推之有災福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"學者要得逢其真，看取行年限遲速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":9,"content":"百六吉凶歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"人生貴賤禀星推，　限數交宫各有時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345793575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人貴賤，皆禀日月五星之氣，如以星限推之，可見休咎。限數者，若夘宫十五，辰宫十之數是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇羅㬋金木曜，　太陽紫炁月宫隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢此曜遷官職，火土星宫到便危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":2,"content":"若人當生以上吉曜，在高强得力度分限數遇之，必合遷官喜慶。如其星生時不得力，雖逢之，為福亦微","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"薄。此歌中略不言水星災福者，蓋水無定性，附善則善，附惡則惡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"夜逢土星晝火曜，　三方不是死無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"此星若是三方主，好廟宫中别有奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":2,"content":"夜生人土不是主，晝生人火不是主。限數逢之，立見災危。若是方主，雖有厄而不亡。又如甲人逢火，戊人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106457639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":2,"content":"逢土，惟此二命雖是忌曜，亦於其限内遷官轉職，將出此宫，然後身亡故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"家宅不寧因孛至，　更兼迍悶恰如癡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"月孛多主家宅不寧，心神不快，陰私迍悶，晝生尤甚，惟六乙生人較輕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"計都失職終須記，　若逢奎婁立轉移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"計都臨限，居官者失職，常人散財疾病。如更值日月，其災轉深，移到白羊宫奎婁二宿，則反有遷榮稱意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"之喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"首曜陽宫為福緊，　尾星陰位定災稀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋好晝在陽宫，則福力更加。計都好夜在陰宫，為災較可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092968906789"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"宫中對視三方淨，空限凡營事不期","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿上逢空限死，　四旬六七命須悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇本限及對照三合，並不見一曜，名曰空限，主多迍邅，圖事不成。若得限主，當生在有力之位，則反此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"惟官祿宫上逢空限最凶，必於四十六七身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"善星限内逢災忌，稱意中亡是此基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"只有災星宜詳審，剝官孛計限仍知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢忌曜因何死，　失職中亡請細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"若人行金木炁限，晝火夜土，與計孛同宫，即有祿者遷官而死，無祿者進財而亡。如星限中只有災星，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624584192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"是忌曜，即須子細消息定之，蓋災星慢於忌曜故也。孛計限仍知失官散財，憂撓疾病，如更於忌曜同行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"此人必有災而後身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"晝土夜火如是主，限逢稱意主官資","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"火陰土陽宫為妙，好廟宫中别有奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"主領重權王委任，　延年四二細推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"晝土夜火如是主仍土在陽宫，火陰宫，則有加官進財之喜。諸星入好樂廟限者，合綂清要之權，為王腹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"心。兼廟限者，於本限别更延得四年，在好樂限者，延得二年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"五星伏段臨宫位，災福三分與四齊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345728039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"五緯居伏段，與日月相近，則災福之應有三四分。蓋為太陽掩映，光芒不見故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜七强為福緊，　災星五弱有災疲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"吉星在七强，則福倍加，災星在五弱宫，則災較重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"臨宫一二對三四，　三合年中五六推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"凡限在本宫者，發在第一二年中。對照限者，發在第三四年中。災福之應十分。三合見限者，災福之應四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"分，而發在五六年中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"限數臨宫未一嵗，身命行來災忌隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"前宫更有忌星迫，　未交前限命須悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114040975398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡行限到將來之時，身命行來宫上，見災忌之星，前一宫又遇忌星來迫，則更不候入前宫而便亡。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"令夜生白羊，是命生時土在人馬，自三十七至五十一限在磨蝎，於五十嵗又遇土星臨照身命，則便不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"候交人馬限而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"身命行年逢吉曜，　不候交宫福佑之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"如人將入福星限，未交限前一年，遇金木紫炁羅㬋照身命行年宫，則不候交到前限，便有遷官喜慶之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"災星忌曜命宫位，樂宫二位莫生疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"一二嵗中為福慶，巳後災侵禍不遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114040959014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"若晝生人，火在天蝎，夜生人，土在磨蝎。寳瓶數遇之，初入限一二年，主有喜事，巳後必有災危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"又看疾厄遷移宫，　更詳諸曜命宫推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計相逢無吉曜，　限數將交定死期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"妻妾、疾厄、遷移，名曰三緊位。當生切忌惡曜照臨，若見計孛，則壽夭而不善終。行限至此，又無吉星照臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"則出宫時死矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"限中紫炁星相見，　職位清高主翰詞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"十一曜中惟推天乙紫炁遇之，倍勝别星。若當生更與日月同對。此限數遇之，未仕者主釋褐授官，巳得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"仕者職加清峻，名位顯掦，或居臺閣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114041073702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"一限兩宫俱好樂，　益壽四年福要知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"假令獅子為命宫，行金牛宫限，遇見金月二星，是官祿宫中好樂。又火土同在磨蝎，火臨旺度，土臨廟堂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"是兩宫好樂。限數遇之，不問晝夜，在限本數，只加一星之數。經云晝火不増數，夜土不加年故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢惡曜兩相見，　為災至甚定難移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"一限之中見兩災星臨照，則災重。雖遇善曜，亦不能救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"初入忌星宫限裏，身命行年惡曜隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"留逆之月為亡月，宫居五弱不須疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"如人正入晝火夜土限，身命行年宫入值凶星守照，兼其宫在五弱位，雖是初入限忌星，留逆之月身便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453096106278952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"亡，更不候依常數而災發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"限惡行年身命惡，好曜過時也便危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人限在火孛，計宫上時下，若遇福曜臨身命行年吉曜方過，主見災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰本宫勝餘位，　七强宫内福加之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"五弱添災福祿減，學者須詳善惡推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"七曜若在當年本宫度分更若高强，限數遇之，勝於他宫。若遇五弱，則災重而福輕矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"死生災福無一失，　方信從來學洞微。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"論百六數有増減。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106539559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星滿用記前篇，賾探幽𤣥是㑹元。百六限中得本數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"更求増減又玄𤣥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"星躔廟樂益四年，廟好之宫加二算。星躔廟旺増一年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"星在怒宫減一半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰遲伏且平行，限到其宫不減増。減於本限除一半，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"増於前限外加添。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"獨論五星増減數，六曜吉星只平度。怒逆星辰同一宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"內減外増無差悞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955284492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星滿用平平過，忌星廟樂不増加。的取天機經百六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"興衰生死的無差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":599,"lineType":9,"content":"論限有出入半限定吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"何知根本理休為，出入宫中有細微。増減後來交本限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"惟將星曜細尋推。滿用諸星主限宫，須知滿用福盈豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"設使縱横星曜怒，保全天命不殂終。凶星在限本傾危，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"滿用縱横則庶幾。只怕前宫忌星迫，未交滿限命須悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星初入本為災，若是中分福不來。或有災星期限滿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001372710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"於兹果㫁最難猜。有星滿用限須滿，災星來侵限之半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"喜星救援入限宫，依此推詳為妙㫁。火星入限便為災，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"土計興災限滿來。計火土羅喜救援，例推主事識凶衰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"日月羅計怕相逢，限遇交時命即終。羅計若然逢日月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"如喜滿用即無凶。忌星㑹限則當亡，滿用之時福反昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計孛星如守限，無星催促且無妨。日火㑹水不為憂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"月土得火反為休。不逢滿用逢水火，定行體骨揜荒丘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁福時前限福，欃槍後來方災促。若是滿用福祥多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421274634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"仍識縱横須委曲。限宫凶吉星共同，増減滿用不滿用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰主事分先後，用事先權福為重。星辰滿用吉凶同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"亦尋星入理先蹤。吉星先入先為福，惡曜後來後亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"救限最吉祿主星，更兼食邑與科名。文曜三方并壽宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"限宫當主亦延生。大凡滿用皆榮羙，能伐凶星尤可貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"被伐名為受制星，相喜往來皆慶瑞。滿用相喜來百六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"入仕遷官榮爵祿。例推出入與中分，育子取妻發金穀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"紀綱百六辨凶衰，測驗天機緊洞微。更有細微陽九限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097658155008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"逐年災禍細尋推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":651,"lineType":9,"content":"論限星切驗都例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"單星守限不滿用，仍算行年星入用。若臨善曜福無涯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜交加歸大夢。更知生死憑何據，百年六月分三處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"二分為生一分亡，生限可逃亡則住。生限凶星尚可逃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"三之二分總星交。六十七後為亡限，凶曜當之命即抛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"百六交宫取定期，直須生月日兼時。交宫過後方為准，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"逐限推求深㫁之。交過前宫入限中，除却前限萬端凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955268108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"如囚囹圄遭原赦，魚出疎罟鳥出籠。吉星臨限多發福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"入仕遷官榮爵祿。誰知此嵗濟歡榮，更加日月蒙星福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"又知百六合凶星，救援全無大可驚。須知其年當𣓪世，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"知何日月往泉扄。百六限中當何月，陽九宫中尋甚日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"例使縱横理吉凶，仍識月分前後節。陽星須識屬前節，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"日木水土紫羅别。陰星須知後節期，月金火星并計孛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"又知星曜孰重輕，陰陽兩辰皆㑹合。須明禍福發何星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"主事後先期晦朔。若識死時夜與晝，限内星辰宜審究。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453092969005093"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"陽星興禍夜間亡，陰宿推殘亡必晝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":687,"lineType":9,"content":"陽九限逐年吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"人生災宿禀符陰陽九相逢，即此尋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"求法。命宫坐一嵗　二年財帛逐年臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"只待平期二十五，　移入限中逐例使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"逐年吉凶識星辰，直至限中方始阻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"百六限中守吉星，符陰吉曜福祥興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"官榮超擢移宸陛，仕庶凡謀必稱情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106523175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":703,"lineType":9,"content":"論洞微行年小限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"要識星行禍福時，須在流年位上推。起於東出常為例，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"一宫一嵗逆移之。交來每遇生日後，不問陰陽總若斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"流年小限立例始於命宫，順天輪而轉，次至財帛，若在地盤，則為逆矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"木照金臨皆有喜，益財遷職多如意。復到二星原守宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有所圖無不遂。貴人更得一相逢，舊祿既加新祿至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"納婦生兒吉慶門，此時自是凶星避。行年東出若同此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"榮進有期亦緣水。更看所至主宫星，如在高强自然利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955317260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"假如限到午與未，日月更為其主星。日在長時福即深，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"月遇初生吉無比。日短月虧仍有災，用兹可以推餘位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"行年如到火土處，口舌資財悉堪慮。若使其星復照之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"困厄須知少生路。次第常推第八宫，生時何曜在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"如值蝕神并土火，遭刑遇溺卒然終。或是火月來西没，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"及因上下禍多同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"自一嵗從命宫起，逆行一年移一宫，遇生日即交也。不論男女皆同行所行之宫，但只看其宫内有何星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"照臨，而消息禍福。大凡遇到火土計孛原守宫，即為災，到木金紫炁原守宫，必有遷官進財喜事。若到宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114041040934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"内並無星辰臨照，即看其時有何行年星來到宫內。木星入行年，順行即通泰，退逆喪服及口舌。金星木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"星同入，則君子加官，常人財喜，或在遷移，則有遷轉出入之喜。水月同入，得女人財，君子遷榮。火入，煩撓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":743,"lineType":2,"content":"口舌。土入三合，有惡曜，主刑禁。火月同入，主傷墜驚恐。土月同入，主冷病或痢疾。火入行年在日宫，則君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"子遷官，常人男女得財稱心。土與羅計入，多重病連綿。紫炁入，在公遷進，在私財物稱意。更是原守，則重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"重喜慶，或進人口。計都入，在辰戌宫，孝服官事。孛入，行年，多奸非及迍悶。若更原守，並無星臨視，即看宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"主善惡，而㫁吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"世之術者，雖陽前陰後之飛宫，所住年分不同，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"得其法，故禍福難憑。今得飛宫之法，最為有理，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"之多驗。學者却宜用此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097658171392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kw75g/1-SK1609_figure_00027.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=CdDNhT1%2FopG7NEBaU2M92owKaeU%3D","pictureHeight":952,"pictureWidth":794,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kw75g/1-SK1609_figure_00027.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=PuWRATaHl8xnBl0xLjDhXOmAv1Q%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kw75g/1-SK1609_figure_00027.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"右飛限以當生元守星辰看，遇吉則吉，遇凶則凶。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"流年又遇吉神，無有不吉。流年又遇凶神，無有不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"竹羅三限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌宫，晝生日水土，　夜生水日土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114041057318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未宫，晝生金火月，夜生火金月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰宫，晝生土水木，夜生水土木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑宫，　晝生金月火，　夜生月金火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"安慶信齋有言：愚於諸家星限無不窮究。或言洞微限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"好，竹羅限不好；竹羅限好，洞微不好。禍福分兩岐，更不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"敢㫁。細推竹羅限，其理優長。竹羅限有三不驗：較量生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001405478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"時不正，一不驗也；星辰過宫不正，二不驗也；交限不得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"其理，三不驗也。愚謂信齋之言最為切當，然竹羅、洞微","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"兩家星限不可偏廢，當兼而用之。洞微大限，只看本宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"所守星及限主，然求流年災福，全在飛限、兩限當以竹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"羅為先，飛限次之。若兩限俱好，妙無以加，或飛限好，竹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"羅限不好，識者自當權宜輕重其説可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":881,"lineType":9,"content":"起限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"太極肇分天地位，二氣斡旋生萬𩔖。中有人為物最靈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345842727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"均受五行之秀氣。昔賢立法考陰陽，日月推來理味長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"竹羅三限從兹得，不識其原謬較量。命中三限最難分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"時人將作主星輪。不論陰陽宫宿度，但從命裏起周旋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"若從命裏分晝夜，十二宫中子細詳。寅午戌兮日木土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生木日土為强。亥卯未兮金火月，夜生火金月最光；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰兮土水木，夜生水土木為良；巳酉丑兮金月火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生月金火相當。此星名作三方主，當從出没細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"三方最樂七强位，切忌納音四煞藏。金星四嵗土星五，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421291018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"木三水一火二數；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽元是火之精，太陰便是水之副；二法各取水火行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"便是竹羅三限路。開端隔節數三宫，逆行零順㡬年終；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"若見逺時數二節，零年交入甚宫中。但看當生星曜㫁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"善星為福惡星凶。零年順轉逐宫移，遇交限處便交之；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"中限便從本限起，依前又數三宫止；零年順轉逢末限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"末限又如前限起；零年順數𡬶惡宫，惡極之宫生即巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"一如土為初限在，已上便從已上起。五嵗大數十五在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031606278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，二十五丑，二十六却囘寅，餘准此。更要在七强順旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"廟樂，不宜五弱留逆。經云：三方陷弱，其人空貴無官；一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"主高强，此命永成善慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031622662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kwjsk/1-SK1609_figure_00028.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q {"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"日限土臨日不宜，夜生交此多傾危。日生尋取一周天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"每遇惡星難更延。○日限火入計羅位，或主傷殘或法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"終。或若滿用即堅固，深災過了却亨通。日若為限要滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031671814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":971,"lineType":1,"content":"用，更臨旺樂明健宫。貴者驟遷愚者福，福中又恐催人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"促。若得後限來救之，却向中年多晚祿。日限怕逢納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，夜生更被羅計侵。不惟家破兼無壽，金火臨之主犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
