{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰行限土同宫，忽然相望也為凶。本原易散無根蔕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"此限纔交命即終。假使交時須未死，行宫逢煞命須窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"愚者臨斯應夭折，清高之士吉還凶。惟有太陰好水星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031688198"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"木金紫炁共同行。更臨旺樂無刑尅，月宫高折桂枝榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟福壽如山海，輔助明君萬國寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":993,"lineType":9,"content":"木限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"木限當生遇火尅，更被孛臨全減福。小人此限死無疑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"貴者交之須失祿。更看後限不如前，此限應不到周天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"木限若逢計與羅，自然財散祿消磨。忽然值限無星救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"憔悴危亡怎奈何。木限官宫金主命，榮貴崇高増福慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"或被火孛來衝破，促壽敗官事不寧。更有同宫木火憂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031704582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"晉魯吳宫與鄭州。相貌僕馬遭撲殺，三九宫中謹逺遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星守照難歸舍。縱然歸得命難留。毒藥惡疾來相及，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"限主元宫此是仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1013,"lineType":9,"content":"火限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"火若為限㑹於木，此限之中即發祿。貴者遷榮駭衆人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"小人遇此多財榖。當生首尾不相交，體大安寧兼壽足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊三宫及卯丑，其宫明淨十分福。火限用金無雜亂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"金數加福乃榮遷。後限若踰三四位，火無長焰不能延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031720966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"火若為限主離財，夜裏生人尚有災。或若日中憂壽促，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪尾曜來相觸，自然破敗心多愚，易盛易落時消福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"一箇周天子細推，縱有深災命也危。計都之次有羅㬋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然逢之主徒囚。或更滿用占强宫，後限强臨須福佑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1033,"lineType":9,"content":"土限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"土若為限不宜逆，死敗危亡須嘆息。縱有吉星救不得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"斯人夭折心多惑。或為夜限孛星來，此限交時的有災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"更有太陽相對望，器小無情禍有媒。不惟壽促兼無義，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031737350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1043,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然内美外無財。惟有土星好四處，子午卯酉四宫排。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1045,"lineType":9,"content":"金限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"金星行限火來侵，㫁定斯人至死滛。更被孛來同此㑹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"定傷筋骨復傷心。偏惹是非迷酒色，促壽亡家百禍臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾同之主滯多，須交妻子不相和。若在吉宫逢救宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有深災怎奈何。忽然熒惑㑹於金，私期暗約主奸滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"有時刑法及傷殘，只怕羅㬋計孛侵。火金為限若相㑹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"限星滿用福為最。或在死氣沐浴鄉，滛慾為傷夀不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031753734"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"更被當生暗曜侵，刑法相殘百禍臨。交限更交元氣中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"生時忌曜復來衝。死見氣勞并吐血，或主傷殘或法終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"慎者全無知者半，智人能悟壽延從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1067,"lineType":9,"content":"水限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"水若為限怕逢孛，水厄氣勞并風卒。四刑星照膿血終，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"三九宫中失骸骨。或居第八十二宫，死敗加臨疾似風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"若得滿用居旺樂，為官食祿爵彌豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1075,"lineType":9,"content":"總限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031770118"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"限星明健命有氣，安然享福無災否。三限當生俱得力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"終身福厚無憂戚。三限只得一限力，一限所為多利益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"三限忽若兩限强，只得兩限福榮昌。交入當生無力限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"去者福兮來者殃。初限若居無力地，年年常是見迍否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"中限不力憂夭亡，自然財散亡家計。初中兩限俱低弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"作事難成福銷鑠。若能知命學脩行，末限微福便安樂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"生時三限俱無力，定是終身無子息。若非僧道作閑人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"一世孤貧怎過得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031786502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1097,"lineType":2,"content":"限星怕忌曜，又忌在沉没宫，卯為沉，酉為没。又忌在無氣死敗宫，主多災，家破人亡，帶疾夭折，孤貧餓死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1099,"lineType":2,"content":"三九宫主旅亡，在六十二宫主撲傷，三八宫患手足疾，即延年也。九宫好閑遊，逢暗曜則偷盜奸滛。十宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"火星犯徒，金星奸滛，計都法死，孛星决配。智者倣此，妙在變通，不多言矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"三限各居明健方，頓然𤼵祿異尋常。更得四元星助限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"榖粟錢財金富藏。限强更得吉星照，立事成功服萬方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"後限更高無戰尅，封公公上又封王。限星得力要垣星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"有限無垣亦何憑。定取限星明健處，垣星入限始為精。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"三限四元時命併，臨官有氣夀康寧。不惟易發登榮貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031802886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢合格主長生。日月若逢吉曜臨，明朝執政伏民心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"後限忌星臨破却，自是官高被謗深。人命三元與限同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"須看有氣占强宫。身命三元無煞曜，星辰縱陷祿重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1121,"lineType":9,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"上貴之人看第十，多是太陰并限入。木星金水一箇臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"限主傍宫躡科級。若得限星無雜亂，須為當代秉鈞衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"水土星高主性靈，或然作限更為清。水交日月足文學，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"自然才譽振英聲。文官須得限星强，木金水月臨照傍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031819270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"限轉行年相㑹處，科名遷職總相當。後限不明宜換武，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"免教失祿及恓惶。貶官罷職以何憑，看取生時正限星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"若犯忌星并忌宿，行年到此自災生。最凶孛火如臨限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"早年遁去保前程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人三限惡星臨，此限纔交禍便侵。更被四刑星守限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴星宫子細尋。更有十二六八宫，行年到此見閻公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"忌限本處有些力，更加吉宿庶無凶。忌限當生占七强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見深災未必亡。行年復到惡星度，魄散魂揚似醉鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031835654"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"限惡宫中逢火羅，不惟促壽更奔波。又犯四刑星守照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"王法須遭暗折磨。子午卯酉最為弱，壽福家財自消爍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇行年相對時，莫教忌曜微照著。任是吉星災轉加，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"本宫旺日死無差。此限若為三四用，終於原守莫咨嗟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"限若無力空性靈，官祿宫逢暗曜星。浮沈之人雖得力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"事公堦下度平生。死氣二宫兼沐浴，須知心下不分明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"不然遊藝或僧道，若不浮蕩有虚名。水火限來沐浴宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"火胎在子事還同。忽然作限終身福，莫比諸星例説凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031852038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"限星陷逆本多凶，若然不死大貧窮。惡限破家刑骨肉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"不死必然末限通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1173,"lineType":2,"content":"初中限當死而不死，亦主家破生災失財。若是末限好，必超出初中交末主方吉也。凡限星在三、六、八、九、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1175,"lineType":2,"content":"十二宫為陷，對太陽為逆，多凶害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"限居二八惡星躔，須教脚手見攣拳。十二八宫限火金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽同守忌星臨。定須帶疾并傷目，不然廢疾或傷心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛同宫并守限，只怕刑星四餘侵。若不雙盲定主夭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食生來却稱心。大抵凶星臨限時，不惟自折更傷兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031868422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星行限福星救，却増壽算滅災危。夫人三限忌星刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐斯人性自靈。頑惡痴愚隨限没，智明精妙却延齡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"人生若得限星强，一生康寧命也長。若見多災偏聚散，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"直推三限細推詳。學者精窮自然悟，星辰之祖此中藏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1195,"lineType":2,"content":"限星怕忌曜，又怕在沈没宫，卯為沈，酉為没。又忌在無氣宫及死敗宫。若在三九宫，主旅亡。在六十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1197,"lineType":2,"content":"主撲傷。在三八宫，主忌失足之疾，即延年。限星若圓淨明健，又在七强宫，則主富貴雙全，壽數綿延也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1199,"lineType":9,"content":"貴人改動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"重臣出入要先知，三九宫中子細推。行年限入終當動，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031884806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"凶吉星臨善惡移。明健入垣為本限，如臨吉宿發無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"限惡星臨如㑹此，停官失祿禍須知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1209,"lineType":9,"content":"貴格行年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"上貴之人限星全，先要仁元與壽元。得入正限及身命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"貴祿二星又相連。或居四正高强位，更無忌曜可修仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"若不修仙須弼輔，兵武星高主立邉。或被忌星臨照破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"也為給諫主文權。武星高者有將才，文星為限主儒魁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"日月分明金水㑹，片心忠節應三台。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031901190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1223,"lineType":2,"content":"金為兵，火為武，木為文，土為主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1225,"lineType":9,"content":"賤格行年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星忌曜同行限，纔交此限多魔難。更犯死氣并沐浴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"六親刑害資財散。或時所守沈没宫，自刑自害多凶卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"更向三宫與九宫，客死他鄉無骸骨。六宫十二傷肢節，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"高險須防驚墜失。此宫星曜不堤防，心愚祇是便無良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽二曜全無救，終身貧窘走他鄉。有福聾盲并吃啞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"手脚攣拳却免傷。少年忿欲行奸盜，老為餓莩及孤孀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031917574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若無疾為傷㫁，促壽亡身上法塲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1243,"lineType":9,"content":"行年災福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"行年限裏惡星來，悲憂如醉没心懐。二惡星臨災兩犯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"三惡星臨重有災。若臨財帛資財失，交於人命多災疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"第三宫中損鴈行，第四父母訟災厄。忌星忌曜㑹行年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"浮泛凶星小不寧。若是當生原守惡，不惟破敗更亡身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1253,"lineType":2,"content":"三限行年到何宫分，凶星主災，二凶二度，三凶三度。若當生限明健，行年逢凶則災半矣。行年入二宫，損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1255,"lineType":2,"content":"財，三宫，損兄弟，四宫，父母災或爭訟，八宫，疾病，九宫逺行失財，官非訟厄。五、七、十一宫防妻子災，十二、六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031933958"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1259,"lineType":2,"content":"宫主危險，四煞宫主災。當生限好逢此惡星，謂之浮沈凶星，小小災疾。忌星者，日火夜土。忌曜者，木。忌火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1261,"lineType":2,"content":"孛金，見火孛災淺。火忌水孛計羅。水忌孛土，忌孛及逆太陽，忌羅計土孛月，忌火孛土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1263,"lineType":9,"content":"論遊年星辰入命限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"遊年星入限宫來，或則為祥或則災。本限吉星當日月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"如遭羅計大為乖。遊年莫犯忌限中，又論當生本命宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"入命對宫尤緊限，星辰凶吉最多功。紫羅金木福榮昌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計火土禍兼殃。八位尊星行度數，行年入限定災詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星羅計與孛星，單守百六保全生。遊年重疊臨命限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031950342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"或加金位命當傾。欲識遊年理凶吉，算星交入命限别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"或是入到原守宫，入宫之日星方説。遊年亦論滿用星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"來家命限福祥興。但算臨宫住㡬日，凶星滿用反康寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1283,"lineType":9,"content":"論童限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"一命二財三疾厄，　四妻五福順行流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"六嵗却從官祿起，　看看移到命宫休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1289,"lineType":9,"content":"急脚限例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"子起亥，　丑起寅，寅起巳，　卯起申，　辰起卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031966726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"巳起午，午起酉，未起子，申起戌，　酉起未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"戌起丑，　亥起辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶在亥丑居寅，人馬來蛇蝎奔申。天秤在卯雙女午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子金牛蟹寳瓶。陰陽戌地金牛未，白羊居丑亥居辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"但向命宫尋起處，一年一位掌中輪。不論男女皆順數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"行年逢煞命難存。子午即是黄泉路，卯酉呼為二八門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"限到煞宫人便死，若無惡曜主災迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"假如子上安命，即亥上起一嵗，酉上一十一，未上二十一，零年順數，節節而去，即不隔宫，如算小兒體例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031983110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1313,"lineType":2,"content":"一般。最怕與限星併大小運併在子午卯酉宫，及本命墓煞三刑宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1315,"lineType":9,"content":"論黄泉急脚限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"黄泉急脚衆皆知，兩様推尋識者稀。急則順行還逆轉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"若能曉此是真機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"世人皆以黄泉急脚為一限，不知分為二。蓋順行則為急脚，逆行則為黄泉。若能曉此，是真機也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1323,"lineType":9,"content":"論斗底急脚限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"孟二仲八季加五，但向命宫相對取，一則呼為急脚限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"二名黄泉檢死簿。死絶之宫逢限凶，大忌運限入四墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033031999494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然大小運相逢，即時趕入黄泉路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1333,"lineType":2,"content":"如大小二運入墓者，極怕此限。男忌辰戌，女忌丑未，凶。此限專忌入墓，運順限逆，運逆限順。如命宫納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1335,"lineType":2,"content":"及太嵗入墓鄉，極凶，更忌三丘五墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"大算須知倒限年，海風吹動釣魚船。火羅孛土皆臨限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"此地催人下九泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1341,"lineType":2,"content":"倒限之法，自古為信然但以諸星推求，如諸限皆為惡星相照，死無疑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1343,"lineType":9,"content":"論倒限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"論當生之限，主星限宫星及小限，次及行年星數，四殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032015878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"三合推之。若皆凶星照臨，可定其危矣。若有吉曜救助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"亦當分其輕重而詳辯之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1353,"lineType":9,"content":"西天聿斯經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"人命生來禀星算，厯數幽𤣥妙難㫁。須識西天都例經，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"理義分明有條貫。但問生時日宿宫，加向時辰廻視。東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"天輪轉出地輪上，卯上分明是命宫。因之以配十二位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"十二位中有高貴。卯并巳午最高强，子酉之方次强位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申頭上名近强，未亥微看三合方。此方照處有不照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032032262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"七曜皆同貴此鄉。辰戌二宫名惡弱，星辰不欲照臨著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"一切加臨落此宫，資財福祿盡消滅。第三宫中號閑極，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"五星不得纎毫力。惟有月向此宫生，却向命宫添福徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"七曜陰陽各三主，强弱輪排依此數。白日生人見配之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"夜則歸宫求𩔖取。陰主三方月火金，便為陰曜福其陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主三方日木土，白日生人貴為主。夜生白日背陰陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"福祿不堅難積聚。西天之法重三方，生時貴欲在高强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"三方若得居高位，居宿之中各福貴。忽然七曜並相當，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032048646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"超騰必作人中瑞。金木二星為善星，所為非主亦為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"火土二星為惡曜，三方切怕他臨照。夜生陰宫主光明，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"晝則陽宫最為妙。夜忌土星晝忌火，各自相逢㫁為禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"火在陰宫土在陽，縱有災殃還較可。獨有水星本無定，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"見附近處即為性。附陽即陽之相輔，附陰即陰為害病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"與日合照主榮貴，巧妙聰明難比並。木為文兮火為武，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"金為兵兮土為主。五星見月即非常，三主居高必台輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"諸曜皆言在强位，更要七星乘旺氣。日旺白羊十九度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032065030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"月旺金牛第三位。土旺秤宫二十一，火旺磨蝎四與七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女辰星二五中，金占魚宫旺在室。星七度與栁十三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"太白流之實可堪。木向蟹宫初入鬼，旺氣相成主崇位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"各於旺處逢一星，出入旌旄主權貴。更加所好轉為精，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"木樂尾兮土寳瓶。金愛牛宫火重蝎，水居雙女最為靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"生時一宿皆臨照，即為豪貴處王庭。五星見月三方主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"要得居高生旺處。陽生向日陰生月，將相三公必無慮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"又看生後三日宫，月到何星分度中。金木相逢主文學，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032081414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明必見水星遇，更遇善星作宫主。宫主復來在强宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"此為有福無難人，一生所為稍皆遂。忽然三日月逢火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"推命之中最為禍。第一損壽二損財，迍厄顛危常折挫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇土星相合地，終身坎坷多迍否木曜縱横不照之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"壽終不得夭然矣。相貌福徳宫又别，晝生從日夜從月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"所取日月相去宫，還從東上配其宫。所終之處為相貌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"即看何曜在其中。若遇善星更月照，福壽堅牢添祿料。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"又兼金木作宫辰，復在高强最為妙。其次又看相合地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032097798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"土木金兮同一位。忽居强處照其人，的作公侯得榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢土木水合照，性直文章主巧妙。忽作熒惑反相刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"即向命宫作凶兆。土木同行生在晝，更向陽宫富貴有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生若向陽位中，變作迍邅作凶咎。土金合照福堅牢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"性潔難婚亦貴豪。金火合與照强位，華鮮衣服志居高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"火土合兮有學祿，智慧多端好反覆。木火同宫主貴權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"為事心中多敏速。木星合得好資財，容貌端嚴志多惑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"月合木兮自遷榮，月加即好減差平。火合日兮生在夜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032114182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"日在火兮必權霸。木星照曜定封侯，却向武中稱善價。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"火星合照最超殊，貴顯堂堂出衆徒。火合月兮生在夜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然殘減亦分符。木照更能添福徳，豐厚多財貴宗族。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"月火照兮每倍加，常患瘡病在其足。同宫一處見土木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"火不照兮足財榖。忽然兼居土木宫，主握兵符多侍僕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"木金祿厚有慈貴，名高美貌足財榖。水日同宫或左右，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"必豐學問足文辭。水木同位又同行，高才博學任公𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"月木同宫位清列，又在日前更殊絶。生時值火伏同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032130566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"先代家財盡消滅。福星多處必財豐，惡曜還生貧賤中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"第六位兮對十二，兩宫就分各凶忌。生時七曜居此宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"一世貧窮苦憔悴。白日生人火占高，與日復來相對視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生土曜亦如然，短壽孤窮登望位。月落惡星分度間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星高處善星閑。三方不照五星伏，必為賤隷處人寰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"更有五星相對視，就中五星為災瘴。相對在强并在月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"中年困苦多消竭。濕宫水照投江湖，亁位蟲狼多咬嚙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"少男少女少資財，多疾多迍多口舌。或遭毒藥兼臨刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032146950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"了了經中皆具説。曜經宫中陽為土，復在陰中更辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"火金相對不宜婚，金月相照却宜婦。鎮星對望詞蹇澁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"為事尋常濫心腹。火月促壽及風狂，火月自傷仍尅父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"水月猶自厄言辭，土月對宫不宜母。火星同月轉就土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"土星照月轉就火，火月同宫皆深禍。不然同在十宫生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"或守月行西没墜。此為夭折貧賤人，又更防災家破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"星運要知災福時，却向行年宫上推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"行年初起從東起，還將一嵗一宫移。每嵗皆須就日生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032163334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"數至今年宫上推。木照金臨皆有喜，加官益職定無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"更到金木原守處，木金又照復何慮。必得相逢見貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"舊祿重加福自新，娶婦孕子貴門庭。運縮盈虚皆有據，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"行年東出亦同占，水加原守喜同兼。身命二宫皆要木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"金星同照喜加添。更須促取行年至，善星高位福同住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"但行獅子蟹宫位，日月便為宫主是。日貴長時福即多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"月到初生喜來至。月虧日短為厄時，須向心中明作計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"土火生時原守宫，行年命運到其中。口舌資財須詳忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032179718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"不然憂怕事闗心。如今火土又來臨，厄難慮忌不相容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"末後相看第八位，生時何曜守其中。若遇曜神并土火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"多為法溺促其終。更益火月來西没，或居上下禍皆同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"生時不欲星辰弱，善惡之中皆減力。退留伏守不如行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"對合宫中皆好亟。十五度中皆正照，過此還同不相識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"近轉得好福堅牢，推命之人貯心頭。五星照守近南方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"少年得祿恐非常。好曜初星皆西没，早年祿後與倉卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是火星莫照西，即知不得終簮笏。生時土火在西方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032196102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"所招凶禍難儔匹。更有加臨虚没位，須多理曉其中意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"人生禍福皆前定，分數無逃於天地。但知子細認其歌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"更盡經中玄妙義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"起竹羅三限：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"假如日生人，寅上坐命寅午戌兮日木土。午為日方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為木方，丑為土方，此即三方主，謂之三限。便從午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"上起，二嵗管十年。太陽從火論，火數二，逆數亦二，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"十二在辰，二十二在寅，零年。二十三囘卯，順數二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855033032212486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"四在辰，二十五在巳，二十六在午，二十七在未，二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"八在申，二十九在酉，共二十八年。三十及三十一、三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"十二停住，三十三交木限，在亥，管十年。木三數，四十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"三在申，五十三在已，各十年，木無零數，六十三、六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"四停住，六十五交土限，在丑管十年。七十五在申，十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"年。逆數五，八十五在卯，零年順數，八十六在辰，八十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"七在已，八十八在午，八十九在未，九十在申，共二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"六年。通前是三限一周，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"琴堂虚實五星，術家獨稱驗於我朝。余取而細讀之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"見其議論活潑，理趣深䆳，姑舉其大者，如本四柱以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"定三盤，分陰陽以辯虚實，倒五行以論生尅，補地煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"以配夭曜，隨國運以驗人事，乃發前賢所未發，而琴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421389322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"堂所獨得者。通載博而寡要，緫龜詳而無體。殿駕意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"圓語徤，而道則未盡；望斗理複詞重，而識有未融。耶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"律傳自高麗，頗有發明；喬抝補出鄧史，亦多㫖趣。然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"得失互有，吉凶難憑。若琴堂識玄機之幽𨼆，洩天文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"之骨髓，推人富貴、貧賤、夀夭，無不竒驗，可謂𠔥諸家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"而獨得其妙者矣。古今一理，百世可知，又豈特用於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"今而獨驗哉！余病近世刻本脱漏不全，參差失次，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"取家藏全書，合玉板之舊琴堂註解，得一行之心共","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538537011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四條，分為上、中、下三卷。六十四條，備卦數也；上、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"中、下三卷，法三才也。於乎！論人命而不究五星，論五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"星而不精琴堂，是猶卜筮者而不考之易也。欲斷吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"凶、明禍福，不亦難乎？余非專門者，然於琴堂獨觀其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"深，間試諸搢紳，命其術頗中，與子平相為表𫟚，學者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"宜細詳焉。易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"昔唐玄宗朝有高僧號一行者，乃郯國公張公謹之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538586163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"孫，元素之姪，隠居嵩山，精天文星厯術數之學，嘗測","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"影定候，作氣盈朔虚嵗差之法，以補厯家之未備。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"作星術書十二家誓曰：國興，書則現，否則隠。其術以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"為日月五星皆積氣動物，行度有遲速之不齊，運轉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"有舒縮之或異，歴千百年自是不同，必當隨時占候，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"立法觀察，以求合乎天道之自然。人亦積氣中之動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"物也，氣運有否泰，世道有升降，人之貴賤、夀夭、吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"用舍，其機之所繫，命之所遇，咸有經常時義之道焉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453103106637863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"惡可㨿一定之法而槩論哉？末學支離，膠今泥古，往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"徃多按圖索駿，遂使先正至精至㣲之學，不信於異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"代，良可嘆息。洪武六年秋，予不敏，自福州府長幕獲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"戾，繫御史獄。值蒲庵師來，復以説法忤上意，同待罪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"及至，夜四鼓，天忽大風雨，雷電交作。余因感天道，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"師極論世運古今氣變升降不同。師遂出是書以授","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"作而言曰：是書予昔得之天界寺古佛殿壁箧中，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"源流則傳自青城山僧靈椿，椿傳之江西僧普澄，澄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114472939554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"傳之四明僧慧月，月又質諸西竺國師耶律，耶律逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"知四十年後氣運轉南，至我朝而後驗也。慧月卒於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"天界寺。忻公憐其用心之勤，藏其書於篋，懸壁間，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"俟後之有縁者。予始得而廣其傳，然豈易得哉？子其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"識之。余謹授教，經今六年，用之多驗。十一年冬，予以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"言事，由青州府佐幕左遷栁州别曹，假道建安，寓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"學宫之西軒，以病留未行，獲與校官葉季原商訂此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"書。季原素穎悟，一見即喜其理之有源委，請予以書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114472972322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"傳授之。閲月，予將别去，季原慮予行之速也，復邀同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"志楊文叔聚精研華，每夕繼燭共論，甚相契合。因以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"教外别意，纂成雜詩二十六首，著於七五賦之末。仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"書其所得義理講貫之精，氣運變遷之詳者，冠於七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"五賦之端。使異日學者知其源委，不流於支離，知其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"經變，不泥於固執，庶信此書之理傳於方外，出於斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"文，合於性命理氣，㑹於世變推遷，各極其歸趣之正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"非止於術家之一技而巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"指金之歌，舊分為前後集，乃𨓜齋吕公摹於玉板之文，露玄機之幽𨼆，泄天文之骨髓，誠為星學之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"魁，時人罕有知之。琴堂老師得如重寶，於是摘其六十四條，為一家之捷徑，所以取其易而隠其竒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"也。時之術者，皆拱立下風，一鞭不敢先著。余少學術于天目山，事琴堂老師二十餘嵗，授此全集，誠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"非易也。後之君子，輕泄薄徳之心，為琴堂萬世罪人也歟！古杭月壑老人黄秋山再拜謹書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"人生貴賤皆前定，闗係身與命。逢生。坐實占髙强，名利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421422090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"兩榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"詳曰：人生夀夭賢愚，皆係五星注定。推星論理，身命最重，吉則富貴夀考，凶則貧賤夭折。逢生者，如命坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"寅亥，木為主，喜水孛，故曰逢生。坐實，著如四柱夘戍午未四字用星逢生，又坐夘戌午未之宫，謂之坐實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"天星躔地宫，與四柱不相着者，無力耳。逢生坐實，主人名利兩相全，不值空亡煞曜為美。且夫日月麗乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"天，而地勢起乎北，故曰日居午，月居未，而子丑為土。天道左旋，寅配春為木，夘配夏為火，酉配秋為金，申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"配冬為水，此逆順之中，各有四序，行乎天地之間，此先天之體也。太陰配母道為身，太陽配父道為命，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"以生時加臨配十二宫，此後天之用也。以官、福、田、財、兄弟、妻孥、子息考之身命，富貴貧賤皆係焉。假如安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"命在子，即以土為主，月為身星，土星起坐要逢火羅為恩，是逢生也。更居本生年、月、日、時之宫，是坐實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421454858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":163,"lineType":2,"content":"又占髙强，又逢生，則知富貴人物，故名利兩榮昌也。十二宫有七强五弱。七强宫，命宫，官禄、妻妾、田宅為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"四正髙强，男女、福徳為次强，財帛為近强。五弱者，相貌、奴僕為惡弱，又為陷害宫，兄弟閑極、疾厄、遊行為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"次弱也。凢星辰加居閑極為弱，惟太陰臨之為福，竒哉！歌曰：第三宫中號閑極，五星不得纎毫力。惟有月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"向此中生，却與命宫添福徳。○一行禪師經云：凡論五星無多訣，先從命主分明説。世上只説當生星，死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"法原來不知活。説宫主之星：木寅亥，土子丑，水已申，火夘戌，金酉辰。太陽午，太陰未。本主星，守身命，主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"不起多嘉慶。主星起在高强宫，官禄資財皆鼎盛。吉星守命主星㣲，四元三限任相隨。縱然科甲重重見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"只是青衫不用期。吉星守命主星卑，那逢身主又居衰。若還身禄無𧇊欠，享福還教夀夭危。內外兩臺君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"且聽，命主入身身入命。互垣須是福來當，管取一生長吉慶。財帛星，田宅主，身命二宫喜相遇。若無暗耗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538635315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"與刑囚，當與石崇鬬豪富。閑極主，入命宫，命居閑極緫成空。白日只消閑袖手，不知衣禄在何從。身命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"入田宅，千倉萬箱多蓄積。田宅遷入命身來，貯積金珠無破尅。身命主，入子孫，母來救子豈無情。子主若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"還來顧母，官高禄厚更榮尊。身命主，入奴僕，縱有吉星也勞碌。身閑心自不能閑，又被小人多反復。身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"主，入妻宫，資財昌盛福興隆。若是凶星居七位，尅妻尅子必為凶。身命主，入八煞，官禄少年須早發。若還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"煞星入命來，疾厄躔身那可脱。身命主，入遷移，過房出祖定無疑。若不贅居并過繼，也須奴養庶生兒。官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"禄主，入命宫，須添福夀永無凶。命主若還居官禄，互垣必是拜三公。福徳主，入命來，斷然福禄永無災。命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"主若還居福徳，互垣須是拜三台。身命主，入相貌，相貌堂堂身更長。若被煞星𠔥暗尅，破相為人貌不揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"如此訣，細推詳，先從身命入為綱。時人不解神仙訣，空把星辰錯較量。大凡命好身不好，有夀而無福。身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765045799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"好命不好，有福而無夀。命身主，起處逢吉星生之，不富即貴。凶星傷之，不夭即貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然生煞同其局，向背分榮辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"生我者，猶陽和徳澤，尅我者，猶風雨霜露。且如春景和明，萬物發生。若大風振木，霜露損物，皆非善政。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"人命生煞同途，禍福不絶也。且如命坐子丑土為主，忌木炁，喜火羅。如或木炁火羅同土躔，主有禍福，吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"凶相半。多有吏人逢此格，憂喜相仍，或遭刑獄，或獲厚利，無定也。謂身命與恩煞同宫，當分向背而斷吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"凶也。向背者，如申上安命水為主，若水在申而金亦在申。若金水前順行則為背，退行則為向，謂之有情，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"極難得。大抵尅我之星欲背我而去，生我之星欲向我而來，又有正照，又有合照。申上安命，水星在戌，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":213,"lineType":2,"content":"土在午，順行則為背，雖有禍無妨。若在午退行照着戍宫，則禍太亟。若土在寅順行尅着我水，水在戌右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345941031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"轉，寅見戌，戌見午，午見寅為順，故忌其順。若在寅退午，是土逆而向東南，水順而向西北，不相干涉。榮辱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"之分，觀者慎之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"身命遇煞不逢空，處世有刑凶。身命得助嫌氣脱，㑹煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"逢空𤼵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"身命主逢煞星，喜空則𤼵。坐實不逢空，處世有災刑之事。得助者，身命主受生，忌空亡虚脱，遇而不遇。㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，身命主遇煞星，坐實則凶。逢空亡者，則𤼵財利。所以空亡一訣，乃天地之玄，常術罕有。凡身命宫遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，或身命主及有用之星遇煞不逢空，皆為凶夭。身命主坐空，或煞星坐空，乃不吉之吉，吉不可量也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"凶星有黨凶尤横，吉曜無生吉不成。凡身命主逢母，或身命起處受生，則𤼵福。值空亡者，反為無用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538553395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"不然。限嵗定推遷，虚實一般般。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"限，四柱配限也。嵗，流年太嵗也。謂身命主好處脱了，則要四柱喚起，凶處實了，則要太嵗空之。如戊寅生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":239,"lineType":2,"content":"人，巳上安命，土月在夘，則是用煞。二十六嵗大限行未，又用月為限主，三方又見土星，本為凶重，適值甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"辰十年，把土月空了，反為空手得財。餘倣此推。或大限值旬空、嵗空，皆不吉之吉。故有用之星本坐空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"終為無用，喜流年實之。諸煞尅我之曜與命元同行，却喜流年空之。如命坐未，太陰同土，計在午，却甲申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"旬來空之為福。又如甲戍生人寅宫立命木在申，本主空，一身減力，得申太嵗流年實其木决主此年稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"意，子辰二年喚起亦為福。以上十二句為一條，論身命生煞最重虚實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"天地盤中識者稀。實可尅生虚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203382287"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"二十八宿天盤為實，内百六限七强五弱四元人盤為虚。此虚非空亡之虚，此實非四柱之實。盖吊起者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"為虚星，原躔本度者為實星。此吊盤之法，少有人知之。且如命坐子，土元在丑，吊起此土處虚安在内盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"之丑，即是外盤戍宫，或寅午戍宫，或辰酉宫在火羅，可生内盤之土，此丑限主福。如寅午戍辰酉宫有木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"炁，可尅內盤之土，此丑限主禍。此内盤之土不可生外盤之星。大抵内盤中是虚吊之星，又無形象，此實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"可尅虚生虚，而虚不能尅實生實也。此法奥妙，人鮮識之。此二句為一條，論夭地暗盤之實，能生尅人盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":263,"lineType":2,"content":"之虚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"衝干對禄事如何？六庚怕見羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"三命謂之七煞，五星家謂之衝干。且如六庚生人，用丁為官星，丁用金為天元禄主，即是庚之天元禄主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955350028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"一名天官星。庚忌丙為衝干七煞，丙用癸為官，却傷丁。癸即用羅為禄主，羅即是丙之天元禄主星，又傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":273,"lineType":2,"content":"我庚之天元禄主。此二星同行，為官則失職，為民則禍深福淺。上則天干衝戰，下則禄主傷官，故曰衝干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"對禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人用炁怕逢金，玄㣲妙理深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"甲用辛為官炁，為禄主金，即丁火怕傷辛金之意。日月逢之，主禄失。自一宫見之，損一宫之徳，餘倣此。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"上四句為一條，論衝干對禄，自化曜而言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元為煞尅，日月未産先泣血。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"如十一月生人，稟二月之氣，用夘為胎宫，火為主星。如或辰酉午三宫安命，忌火為煞。火日同躔，在母腹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114472923170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"中，便主傷父。火月同行臨産，主母有厄，難為分娩。火與命元同行，主百日週嵗，闗不可脱也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"胎宫驀煞稍減輕，産際主虚驚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"驀駕。及諸煞為胎宫者，主稍輕，遇産時主艱辛，逢厄無厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時皆實地，禍福皆非細。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"生年、生月生日、生時皆實地，吉星居之十分吉，惡星居之十分凶，禍福皆應驗，故曰非細。且夫五星六曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"守照身命，强宫又守四柱，則為實地有吉星，為人仁厚誠實，富貴夀考。若實地俱無好星，凶星守之，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"凶人。盖實地有吉星，皆為我的，他處有凶星，皆别人的。所以好者尤好，反者尤歹也。胎上有吉星，為生來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴。有凶星，主胎中有孝服，或背父，或不利，毋或生來㣲賤。經云：根本切須㸔兩曜，貴榮須是驗三生。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345908263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"云：三生遇煞憂逢日，四正逢刑怕見身。吉曜不來相救助，一生勞碌不成人。又云三生值煞人無夀，四正逢恩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"福最深。此其驗也。雖是嵗空月，月空日，日空時，時空胎，皆為定盡禍福。如一星在命，一生不好。若是流年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗空之，主大發，但𤼵便夭，盖根虚故也。余三十年留意五星，有驗有不驗，故棄為僧也。辛未年六月初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"一日，得吕逸齋傳此，始知虚實之妙，方悔一生錯了多少命也。以上六句為一條。論胎元四柱之不可逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"田、財、官、福與身宫，即與命元同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"田、財、官、福四宫并身宫，即與命同。論休咎。且如命坐子丑，屬土，喜火羅生，忌木炁尅。田財、官、福身命主及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"十二宫主，不問金、木、水、火、土，並同命元取用，俱喜火羅生，俱忌木炁尅，餘倣此推。且夫人生與萬物一體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001454630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"隨其根源而遇化，故桃梅不結李實，鐡石安可作金？燕雀不生鳳，狐兎不乳馬，惟同者相從耳。人命稟水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"即是水也，夫豈能為火哉？如命在巳申，即以水為主，十二宫十一曜皆作水也。忌土計，而驗其人之富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"貧賤夀夭之事，應如神。若土在命，則斷險難，或多疾病。在財帛，則斷其破財。在兄弟，則斷其兄弟朋友少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"力。在田宅，則斷破祖，或不得祖財。在男女，則斷無子息，主相尅。在奴僕，則斷其小人不忠致禍。在妻妾宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"則斷其妻醜，或多病，亦必尅。在疾厄，則斷破相壓身。在遷移，則斷其路亡，夀不過六十。在官禄，則斷其破官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"官中主多厄。在福徳，則斷其無福。在相貌，則斷其初多間闗，或十六後不讀書，或破相，或夀數不耐逺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"或計居其上，計乃土，餘亦同，斷之逢生則為吉也。更叅諸宫主所遇，𠔥虚實言之。若太陽與土計同宫，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"斷其尅父。太陰與土計同宫，則斷其尅母。尅生者必欲坐空，空不盡者則減一半，全空則妙。若月日坐煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624682496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"與土計並行，則斷其先尅父也。餘宫之星皆以此例言之，與其首宫同斷，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"魯邦立業辰從鎮，官禄俱傷盡。功名不特此宫難，亦主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"夀齡慳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"魯乃戍宫立業，此宫者屬火為主，忌水孛侵。土為官福二主，若與水土同行，則我忌之，官福亦忌之，有尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"土之理。庸術皆曰土尅水，而不知物隨𩔖化之妙。命屬火則官亦屬之，火命喜炁木生，則官福亦喜炁木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"生。命忌水孛尅，則官福亦忌水孛也。故水傷土，或水木炁，則見土不妨。又云官福受傷，不特難樹功名，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"主夀迫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"身命屬金都是金，最怕火羅侵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110421405706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"則與前斷同議，隨命言之是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"土能生水亦生炁，因金從金𩔖。水為財源喜土生，但依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"身命行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"因身命坐酉辰，金為命主，喜土計所生，以財帛主水星，亦喜土生。福徳官禄，木土皆喜，土計生炁乃木餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"適為句韻牽絆，故不言水而曰炁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"火能生木亦生金，土下究元因，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"因子丑安。命屬土，木為主災，羅為恩星。葢命主是土，喜火生土，以此財福主木，田主是金，皆喜火。羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":375,"lineType":2,"content":"生他宫住命，火如何生得金木即從命主所愛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045334043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"識得五行顛倒顛，方是大羅仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":381,"lineType":2,"content":"即上文火能生木，亦能生金之意，謂顛倒明得此理，方為神仙之妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"秦晉楚身闗土計，真是太陰忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"巳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"未申三宫，安命屬水，月為命主，並忌土計真煞也。以上十八句為一條，論十二宫同命元所好惡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"月為兄弟日為妻，子息在其時。主星却㸔居何地，虚實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"從其類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"此家星理，不論男女宫主，及守男女妻宫之星。且如庚申生人，水為本身嵗駕戊寅月，木為兄弟；丁亥日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":393,"lineType":2,"content":"木為妻宫；丙午時，太陽為子息星，隨其地支，得時斷其有無。又云月管初，主二十五年；日管中，主二十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765062183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"年；時管末，主二十五年。各推本屬虚實有無，仍先推本位㑹聚吉凶若何。一云年管父母月日時管兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"妻子。主星逢生坐實則旺相，或落空脱地，或坐實逢煞，則有尅剥損傷。此四句為一條，以月日時配兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"妻子而論虚實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"身命逢官坐貴人，登駕近明君。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"身命主逢天地元禄主，或逢官禄主，同行於駕籍，皆主近君之貴。凡㸔星辰，先以日月為緊，如寅上安命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":407,"lineType":2,"content":"木為主，日與水行，月與孛行。若日月明浄者，第一須㸔身命宫。身命主逢生逢官者無不貴，小人見之亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"富。駕者，本命太嵗，謂之君位也。日月福徳臨之，貴多近君。有身命登駕，格局好，多做朝士，限主居之，主一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"限內亦能近君也。若煞臨之為戰破，縱主星合格，貴而不顯，無夀亦多升沉。更主星不合格，必主疾病纒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765029415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"綿，刑害夭折之禍。禄馬貴人，太嵗所専也，命主居之，乃與太嵗有相管攝，在弱宫不為弱也。若身命不在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":417,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫位，與太嵗無相管攝，則為無用人矣。若身命坐禄崇勲，則衣禄有餘，或日月拱夾禄位，或吉星坐禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"馬，為紫薇華葢崇勲，有台輔之貴，少年榮達。更官禄星臨之，為食邑崇勲，官至𡖖相。身命日月年星朝之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":421,"lineType":2,"content":"雖衝干對禄亦貴。若辰戌安命為自吞崇勲，主禄不久。尅星臨之為破勲，生氣臨之為爵坐勲。大貴命運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"必先推禄馬貴人。若身命坐馬，五馬之貴，凶星照破，争戰不安。坐貴合格，貴不可言。身命宫主見官，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"身命逢官。坐駕守籍，必主近君也。次㸔四柱占何宫，用星髙格局好。煞星空陷，一路好限，顧盻親切，平步","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"公𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"駕前衝驀諸神，煞值難，禍尤烈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453097624666112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":433,"lineType":2,"content":"駕者，子生人，子宫，即是嵗君之駕。衝者午宫，即是衝駕也。驀者，子生人亥宫，即是驀駕也。此四宫禍福最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"緊，值難星及煞主入此，主凶禍速烈。貴人禄馬官福主入此四宫，發福最𦂳，遇凶十分凶，遇吉十分吉。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"人命不要與太嵗相對，謂之衝駕。不要太嵗後一位，謂之驀駕。乃有驀越之象，主近君不久，末主多是不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"利。如亥生人，亥為嵗駕，子為近君之駕也。巳為衝駕，戍為驀駕。身命俱登駕，近君則吉。衝驀駕乃有孛逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"之象，更加凶星則大禍，吉星則大發福矣。刼煞即亥夘未在申之𩔖。第一要身命限，主不喜居之為緊，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"遇者，多刼盜災疾也。第二亡神對衝是也。三陽刄主破相壓身之疾，重者刑傷，六親不具也。且如甲禄在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"寅，夘為陽刄，酉為的煞，一名破碎，一名白衣，一名淫神。男人帶此多淫慾，女人尤忌之。男多好酒色，作事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"汨沒，多破碎也。身命限主居之，有作為能事之人也。小人遇之，膽大心惡，不善之人耳。此煞即飛廉也。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538569779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":451,"lineType":2,"content":"法正月戌，二月巳，三月午，四月未，五月寅，六夘，七辰，八亥，九子，十丑，十　一月申，十二月酉，若遇喜神，乃開","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"藩建閫之命。月煞一名陰煞，正月丑逆行丑戌未、辰四位，週而復始。巳上煞宫主尅我命主星為真煞，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNu
