m":455,"lineType":2,"content":"我命主星不以煞論，反為有力。此法盡善盡美，不可輕泄。難者乃疾厄宫主星也，惟午未二宫十分忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"盖君后二象，惟以官福田財之星為重，不論生尅，但不宜逢難，故太陽忌木炁，太陰忌土計也。然疾厄星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":459,"lineType":2,"content":"亦不要守四柱及身命宫，身命主不喜見之。直難者，正二太陽，三四太陰，五六火，七八水，九十木，十　一十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"二土，𠔥用餘氣推之，不與身命主身命宫相犯，犯着多主心風喬恠，為人百行不純，作事顛倒，更是煞星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"同行，必刑夭，得用極有力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"福星守籍喜相生，犯籍主刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453110345924647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"福官二元守生時，更得吉星相生，為富貴之命。或難煞星犯生時，主刑傷為禍籍者，生時是也。只要官福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"主臨之，身命主尤妙，是為登籍，尤喜相生，縱是弱宫，不為弱也。煞星守之，真為刑傷，仍㸔虚實論之。以上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"六句為一條，論駕籍喜生而不喜煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"八箇字中定真假，輕重量多寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"八字即四柱，定真假，真者乃坐實，假者空亡，輕者空不盡也。且如甲戍生人，申上有用星空了得八字，年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"月日時中有一申字喚起，空不盡也。非空非實，即為輕也。重者，且如甲戍生人，見壬申俱是甲戌旬中，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"無申字填實，此為空得重也。四柱二三坐皆得一旬空亡，此為多也。年月日時中一位空亡，又空不盡，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"為寡也。故生殺二字，主人貧賤富貴，須㸔四柱中帶得帶不得，以定其真假輕重，量多寡也。如巳丑、戊辰、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114472988706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"巳丑庚午，未上安命月在午，此為二主臨財。但午是甲申旬中空得午帶實，又有兩箇巳丑，皆是甲申之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"物，故輕。此等人主心高志大，多虚花妄想，身命空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡一訣少人知，陰陽分兩推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"論五星君子少有識空亡之妙，雖識亦不知分陰陽。且如甲戍、丙子、戊寅、庚辰、壬午，只是金空於申，半空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"於酉。又如乙亥、丁丑、已夘、辛巳、癸未，全空於酉，半空於申。餘倣此推。故陰陽分兩推，流年同論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"流年遇煞喜逢空，好處反為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"流年遇煞曜戰身命限，主本凶，逢太嵗空之，必反為福。若恩星禄馬吉星到身命限，主吉。逢太嵗空之，轉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"福為禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765078567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"行年若值甲寅旬，生煞子上停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"生星乃恩星也，守子官。行年值甲寅旬，陽年災晦，陰年稍吉。煞星乃難星也，守子宫。行年甲寅旬，陽年主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"禍輕福重，隂年福淺禍深。經云陽不管陰，陰不管陽之意。餘年倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"陽年災福應陽年，陰年減半言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"前篇解巳備矣。以上十句為一條，論虚實當以陰陽而推之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"身命臨財萬頃田，官福喜居垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"身命二主喜入財宫，主富也。官禄元喜入垣，主貴也。故言合格。縱逢煞星，亦須還其富貴，然後㸔限虚實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"如何，次定生尅。且如子上安命見木，寅上安命見金，夘上安命見水，辰上安命見火。雖煞星皆為財福入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538684467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"命，或身命主居而見之，皆為身命入財福，皆是用煞為權，平生好利貪功，末後多不吉之吉。經云：兩宫坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"貴三朝禄，二主臨財萬頃田。又云：福星居福真為福，官主居官作顕官。更使身命𠔥駁雜，定知享福必艱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"難。又云：凶星作善事，富貴非遥。吉曜作凶神，敗亡亦速。此二句為一條。言身命臨財，官福居垣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"武官帶煞格局好，主陷為僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"凡武官命，多是帶煞或諸煞，但一位尅身命，或近身命，或傍臨合照，或坐陽刄、亡神、劫煞，或主星驀駕，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"主遇刑星，或坐馬落空，或值直星犯命主，本為凶兆，却合貴局。或官福縱有尅制，官星尅而有救，官星退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"而逢生。其中若帶漏闗、互垣、特進等格，或十一曜擁從，或衆星從日月者，乃建節封侯將帥命也。更㸔日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"月同宫，日月守照，日月拱夾，二曜朝陽，五星隨日，五星隨月，金水輔日，金火逢月，日土晝逢，火月同宵，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538733619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":541,"lineType":2,"content":"星伴月，月居閑極，太乙抱蟾，計羅闌截，金水㑹蛇，七政入垣，十　一曜朝命，官禄互垣，十一曜拱端門，午上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"帝座，子上官福守照，田財拱夾。且㸔命主用得著用不著，斷之妙甚。此皆富貴之格。富人之命，必是體弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"用强，或水火同行，金木同位，或水火羅、金木羅之𩔖，或相生衝尅者皆是。葢為富不仁，為仁不富，故多戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"尅也。亦有二主臨財，財星不起，財星逢生，不帶空亡，富連阡陌。又㸔科甲科名無陷逆，則為殊恩異賞之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"人。僧道之命與官貴同，只是身命主陷三、六、九、十二之宫，或官星背了，得用星空了，或得用星俱陷弱宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"或孤尅星干，身命太重，有權煞，則為住持之人矣。師尼之命，相貌疾厄，兩宫多不足，或夫子二星陷弱宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"制尅，或坐隔界無分曉處，所以孤也。庶出、過房、入贅、移徙等命，多是身命宫。身命主臨寅申巳亥四重之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"位，所以事多更易。妻子二宫坐兩界無分曉處，亦難為妻子。加煞照，無妻子矣。是又煞中有救也。僧道命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045317659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"多因主陷弱，一月得所，或主星守閑極遷移，獨立無輔，或身命虚，為林泉之客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"吏曹之命禍福専，刑害命傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"吏曹之命，官福田財皆好。但此等命，刑星不守相貌，必主生時，或身命逢刑無救解，吉處十分吉，凶處十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"分凶，謂之禍福専也。所以有享用，有刑害，更主坐陷而見刑尅，或煞官星及相貌，或官星被尅，皆刑害之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"命。貴人禄馬必與身命宫主及煞星同行，或官禄星入垣受尅，並為吏曹之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道紫炁逢華葢，庶俗多利害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"申子辰生人，辰上立命。巳酉丑生人，丑上立命。寅午戍生人，戍上立命。亥夘未生人，未上立命。見紫炁守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"之，皆為僧道之命也。俗人見之，決生尅，剥六親，傷妻尅子，無有不驗。更身命落空，皆孤獨也。以上六句為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109417487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"一條，論煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙之星趕月明，妻尅子螟蛉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙者，紫炁也。隨月而行，主孤寡，尅妻害子。子丑宫安命立身尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"不然定作林下客，虚實分清白。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"炁月同行者，主客重則為僧道之流。實則應驗，虚則反是。若紫炁如在月前，一般為俗人而無妨害。官福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"扶之，決作清虚之士。此四句為一條，言身主同孤尅之星，而分虚實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"女人金水淫妬賤，木命夫榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"金水者，為酒色淫心也。女人不宜見之，見之必為妬賤之軰。若木星主，更身主逢生，坐貴，坐禄駕官禄多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203415055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"榮顯，良婦也。且如寅亥上立命，金白水清，能榮夫利子也。他宫立命，雖金水清者，十有九箇，是侍貴婢妾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"命亦多妬，無容徳。火月性悍而淫，水火淫而無情多嗔。金水不清，血氣不調。水金桃花失用者，為娼優妓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"路之人也。土孛淫穢無擇，水火孛淫刑，土火為孤孀。夫星坐閑極，多為夫所棄背，或生離也。夫星坐遷移，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"多主出外，或嫁逺，或傍貴。立身命，夫入奴僕，婬其下人。祿入奴僕，喜自為庖饌。大抵女命身福夫子田財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"好者為貴子，主不受尅，疾厄好則生貴子。若疾厄男女宫主受尅，疾厄主不好者，多産難也。身命主入疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"厄，多病，坐奴僕多下賤，坐閑極或六九宫太陰不得地。若男女星不陷而得地，又當生貴子，因而有稱呼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"也。娼妓命有桃花，無福必賤。夫星陷弱，夫子駁雜，相貌必好，男女必傷全㸔其弔起飛來，我命主星入何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"宫分何星來入我命，言之無不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538750003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"神道：煞星守華葢，痼疾孤一世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":615,"lineType":2,"content":"女人最嫌孤神華葢，又嫌身命坐華葢，逢煞星主粘身疾病，孤眠獨坐之人。假如亥卯未安命，未計守之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"土計又為難星故也。餘倣此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"生星守貴坐禄宫，夫旺子興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"婦人之命，只喜身元為重，命元為次。若逢生坐實禄駕籍官福之宫，主榮夫旺子享福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕餘奴馬上見，奔波淫下賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"且如命坐寅亥宫，木為命元，見炁為餘，奴僕元俱守驛馬之宫，多為淫賤之輩。馬者主淫主勞碌，餘奴者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"主賤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109433871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池星守驛馬宫，女淫主産凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"桃李星守驛馬，更守身命。女命逢之，勞碌淫賤，更尅身命煞曜者，産厄横亡。如寅午戌生命坐辰酉，見火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"金同行，或入身命。夘戌安命，水又尅之。命坐巳申，水火同守，餘倣此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"馬星或起在咸池，酒色性無期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"馬星坐桃花，主好色貪酒，其性無定度。且如申子辰生人，水在酉。巳酉丑生人，水在午。寅午戍生人，水在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"夘，亥夘未生人，水在子。更守身命是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"陽命見之多薄徳性好貪酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池星守驛馬，或馬星守咸池，更無忌曜。男女見之快耍樂，眠花卧栁，有才無徳，終為無成之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045268507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥名利兩無成，帶煞主遭刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"命帶桃花驛馬尅身命者，未嘗有敦厚成家立後之人，必帶煞遭刑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"女人不要坐沐浴，煞多主淫慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"女人命不要坐沐浴，敗地。若坐沐浴，多破家流蕩，或因酒色敗家。女人不要金水同宫，煞要制則好，無救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"則夭，有權則不能享福。女人金水清則多妬，金水䧟而淫。羅在命威權，計在命心毒。太陰身命主不喜坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"疾厄，則多病，坐閑極則舒散。女人身最喜坐福徳，坐奴僕下賤，若得地逢生，勤勞能治，家居官禄，受命稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"呼。火月同宫多淫悍，夫星入奴僕合及下人。水星坐桃花不用者，乃娼優妓路之人也。水木不喜同宫，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"命主多淫慾無度，土木同宫者勝，但夫子同一宫者無嗣，金水同者能謳，土孛同者淫而刑。身宫清者不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765209639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":667,"lineType":2,"content":"生子息，身宫不清者賤。火土同宫多孤寡。水星不清，血氣不利。夫宫雜者無定向。禄入奴僕，喜自庖𢊍。身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"命空者，多僧尼女冠婢妾之命。亦是夫星坐閑極，或六九宫，或太陰，不得地。若男女不陷而得地，當生貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"子，因而有稱呼也。以上十八句為一條，言女命最怕煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"立身不定或多移，身命坐兩岐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"立身不定者，身命二主坐隔界不分曉處，如斗三女二之𩔖，則平生居止多移。此等命非庶出，則過房離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"祖之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"妄想心高不滿意，用神坐虚地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"身命元生星，官福財元並值，四柱空了平生勞苦心高，妄想獲財亦不足意。若犯空亡，人人若是，學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109466639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":685,"lineType":2,"content":"者不可不知。以上四句為一條，言身命不可坐隔界之所，而用神不可虚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然論宫不論度，大限須從過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"如火宫安命，喜行木度，忌行水度之𩔖。夫一家五星，専論度主為要，此家只論宫主，却不過大限所經二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"十八宿，不可不明生尅制化之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"洞㣲限主有生意，貧賤忽富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"凡行限到處，遇着生我之星守照，無有不發之理。更限主起處逢生，謂之體用俱生。若限主受尅，謂之體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"重用輕。此限内有吉凶受尅，重則雖發而難出此限也。且如子上安命，行寅限，以木為主，忌炁尅；行卯限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"以火為主，喜羅生。謂之火遇水生，土遇木生之𩔖。大抵㸔限不以日月金水為吉，不以火羅計孛為仇凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765160487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":703,"lineType":2,"content":"此等例，庸術豈能知之？如命宫十五年，一年行二度；相貌宫十年，一年行三度，皆以所遇生尅之星言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"小限逐年生日後交，若在財帛，遇尅凶星則破財，見生吉星則發財。在兄弟，見吉星，則因人舉薦，發名發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"財，見尅星，則因兄弟朋友上不足。在田宅，見吉星，則門戸有喜；見凶星，則門户不足。在男女，見吉星，則生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"貴子尊年人，則主女子上進，及添人口；見凶星，則子女有災，或損子女。餘倣此推，妙驗。若大小限，主當生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"流行俱壊，身命被尅，謂之滿盤壞，主死亡，貴人專㸔官星也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"若還後限不如前，只許半週天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"若前限平平，後限不如前者，限去不得。如後限不利，前限吉亦可過。如過後限者，有凶星比前限凶，只行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"得一半，便不好了。前限平平，加以後限不如前，乃是限虚脱，及體用受尅之𩔖，去不得矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955399180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"用星跳出當生甲，限至應難發。限度。又值十年空，魂魄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"下幽宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用星俱當空亡之地，行限遇之，巳為不吉。若限星飛出，又遇流星空，謂之麻繩繫鴨子，兩頭脱決死。且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"如子宫安命土為主，入戍亥地，又是甲子旬中生人，謂之空亡地。若命限土既脱了，又值甲寅年來，四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"中衝伏，或三合對照，原守有曜照朗，煞星喚起，不以此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"晝日夜月難一例，金鳴火終昧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"日月行乎虚實，須分晝夜，不可一例作空。言金空則鳴，火空則發，火空終歸煨燼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"限空元脱嵗，空星亦向此中行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114473070626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"此與上文不相同，特相反爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"其間或有玄機𨼆，按圖難索駿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":743,"lineType":2,"content":"謂八字原帶實地，或身命生守本根，或三合守照，有二星照朗，煞星喚起之𩔖也。以上十六句為一條，論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"限而當審虚實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星照命反為亨，主在别宫生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"如命坐亥木為主忌金。金在巳本凶。得命元木星落别處，逢水孛滋生反亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"生曜臨官福作殃，星起受其傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":753,"lineType":2,"content":"如命坐戍宫，得木臨之，豈不為福。若主火落在他宫，水孛夾之，反為殃也。以上四句為一條，論飛釣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765176871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑人亥木命逢金足有病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"酉丑生人，馬在亥，木為馬元。逢金尅之，主手足有疾。大凡馬元受傷，多主足疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"五臟六腑要源流，七政四餘。求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"𥮅星之道，須當推其源流病症。五星配五臟，餘炁配六腑。又以日為魂，月為魄。故木為東震甲乙之宿，屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"肝，紫炁是木之餘，膽是肝之腑，炁即為膽也。火為南離丙丁之宿，屬心，羅是火之餘，小腸乃心之腑，故羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":767,"lineType":2,"content":"為小腸。金是西方庚辛之宿，屬肺，為大腸。葢金為煞曜，無餘氣，故臟腑俱屬金也。水為北方壬癸之宿，屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"腎，孛為水之餘，膀胱為水之腑，故孛為膀胱也。土為中鎮戊巳之宿，屬脾。脾乃五臟之尊，居於中位。五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"五臟，土不缺計。計是土之餘。胃是脾之腑，故計為胃也。既究此理，又推五臟通於九竅。眼病則起於肝，舌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538766387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"病則起於心，鼻壅則連於心肺，耳潰則干於腎，唇口乾燥則通於脾胃。是皆以五行之衰旺推其病源。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":777,"lineType":2,"content":"夫人之精神，則皆形於目。譬之天地精彩，皆聚於日月。茍與煞曜同行，則䘮明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"刼的刄驀不逢空，限遇不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":781,"lineType":2,"content":"刼的刃驀，四煞原守坐實不逢空者，大限見此，主非横之災，不善終也。以上六句為一條，論犯煞致疾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"春金夏水變於囚，金命喜逢秋得令。值煞反為權，妻子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"福不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"春金、夏火、秋木、冬土，變為囚曜，雖為身命元用星，終減力。若身命元用星得令，雖有煞尅，終為得力。身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":789,"lineType":2,"content":"元得令，遇煞為權，但不免尅妻子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449027126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"前夾地尾後天鋒，雖榮不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"天鋒地尾拱夾，雖榮不能長久。鋒尾即陽刃計都也。假如六壬六癸生人，命在未，計在午，土為刃元，在中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":797,"lineType":2,"content":"夾之，雖曰榮顯，到後夭折不善終。餘倣此。以上六句為一條，論生煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"左右二煞月在中，仍㸔三日宫。前後二煞遭三日身殃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"毋成疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":803,"lineType":2,"content":"三日宫者，謂之三百日闗也。生後二百日，㸔太陰所泊何處，更逢左右所夾之煞，主難為養育，亦喪平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"之徳。若與煞星相值，重則身殃，輕則毋疾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"又有三用，是福徳最怕難星尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045301275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"星盤，按圖依二十八宿順數十二宫，一命宫、二財、三兄、四田、五兒、六奴、七妻，次第數去，福徳第十一。依天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":813,"lineType":2,"content":"元右轉順十二宫，福徳第三，謂之三用宫。用者謂此福徳星最緊，論平生之福力，雖有官福不好，亦有名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":815,"lineType":2,"content":"無福。雖然身命財帛好，若福徳犯煞，或文星無力，或犯空亡，亦主薄福，並無受用，喪一生之徳，又怕難星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"尅之。以上六句為一條。言三日三用，不可值煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"刼的陽刄夾者凶，太嵗相逢衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"日月居身命夾刧的陽刃等煞者最凶。更逢太嵗衝，其禍不可言也。且如六庚生人，日戌月申，或身命中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":823,"lineType":2,"content":"夾此陽刄最凶。行逢卯，太嵗衝酉，表出陽刄之凶，其年非刑獄則水災之厄。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"官福禄馬，最喜夾太嵗衝，必發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130448994358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄崇勲貴馬，最喜日月命夾之。太嵗衝起，此年大發財福。且如庚午生人，午命太陽在酉昴度，太陰在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":831,"lineType":2,"content":"未，為身命日月夾官福馬，主福貴無疑矣。遇寅年太嵗衝起，官福馬貴之妙，斯年大發財名福不可量也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"此四句為一條，言太嵗衝夾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"初年至老限俱虚，主壯禄不𧇊。限主所泊更逢空，非夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"即朦朧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"如初年至老，所歴之限並虚脱，而限元起處壯健，衣禄無𧇊。若限元逢空，非夭即朦朧矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"生星坐駕早年榮，時逢末主盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":843,"lineType":2,"content":"生星坐駕，主早年榮顯。生時坐日月，主中年稱意。生星守籍末，主盈豐，結果享福。此六句為一條，言初末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109450255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"限所遇虚實之不同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒要論闗煞定，直頭須不應。前是太陰後是煞，小限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"中間夾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":853,"lineType":2,"content":"初年。小兒須論闗煞星。諸公得傳者，並用直頭星為闗，主小兒驚風暴死。經云：正二太陽三四陰，五六炎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"炎怕火星。七八水孛九十木，十一十二土星尋。此是小兒直難煞。此訣應驗如神。正二生人，如何便忌？太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":857,"lineType":2,"content":"陽日月為天地之秀氣，為人之精粹，得日月守命，身所喜者衆，不可一槩論。五六生人，見火為闗，只命在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":859,"lineType":2,"content":"辰酉午三宫畏之。卯戍安命為命元，子丑安命為恩福田。元入命如何作闗煞論，餘倣此。推小兒胎星遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":861,"lineType":2,"content":"生星，主以官禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765193255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"體用尅星相戰争，便是此中闗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"體者，身元也。用者，限元也。戰争者，尅我之星也。若刑戰二星照命傷，限元是此年闗。又如小限在卯，太嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"在寅，煞星在辰夾之，或辰酉命行年，小限寅上逢丑，太嵗羅星在丑逆轉，火在卯順行，夾小限者為真闗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"斷不可出此矣。以上六句為一條，論小兒闗煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"流年一紀一循𤨔，原守嵗相叅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":875,"lineType":2,"content":"凡㸔流年，只把流年太嵗行。十二位宫㸔原有何星聚照，流年㑹合何星，主何吉凶，不問當生流年，並從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"冬日為始，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"更得月將加臨，視禍福如符契。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114473103394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰一星為人之命身，所行甚速，每日取之，加著㑹當生流年，㑹合何星，聚合何宫，吉煞或利或不利，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"大人或見小人，或見口舌或有財，隨其遇而言之，其應如神。又當驗諸星之性格，以定災福之遲速。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"水之餘乃孛也，金乃煞曜，獨無餘氣。羅乃火之餘，炁乃木之餘，是火羅為禍福之速也，得見即發，却易過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"水孛為禍福皆遲，或過了方發，經云火頭孛尾是也。木炁土計禍福稍遲，却耐久。金月自始至末，無改假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"小限宫中起生月，名為月限訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"從小限行到太陰所泊之宫，起生月逆數，遇吉凶斷之。假如午生人，午上安命，戌年小限在寅，三月生，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"月在寅。四月丑，五月子，次第逐月移宫，謂之月限。輪流十二宫，週而復始行一宫，遇吉凶斷之。假如戊子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045284891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":901,"lineType":2,"content":"年，丑宫安命，流土為太嵗，流木為喪門、病符，流水為的刼，金為官符。月限十二宫，逐月出入，見木炁則此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":903,"lineType":2,"content":"月有災事，見火羅則此月有喜事發財，名當生流年。一體論之，見木則病或孝服，見流金則官事，見流水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"則費財，口舌不寧，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"學人學得莫輕傳，説盡妙中玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"葢學此術，玄中之玄，妙中之妙，有得之者，不可輕傳也。此八句為一條，論流年流月訣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449010742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449125430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":3,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定四庫全書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":4,"lineType":4,"content":"星學大成卷九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":7,"content":"明萬民英撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":8,"content":"指金虚實五星天機七五賦中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"推筭必須求命主，得失須㸔取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":2,"content":"推筭之法，所重者命宫之主。得者如逢生坐實，失者如遇煞不空是也。　一家星理，專以命度主為要。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":2,"content":"子宫為命，有女、虛、危三宿，躔女則以土為主用，躔虚危則以日月為主用，竟置宫主而不言，何謬乎？譬夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":2,"content":"人之一家，則必有主，其下雖有弟妹、子姪、僕從之輩，皆為家主所役，所以知家主之重也。至於推星論理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203595279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":2,"content":"亦　一耳。而吾家所要得失，皆以命宫主為重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"次推太隂在何宫，方可論窮通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":2,"content":"太隂為人之一身根基所係。葢命者，衆人之禍福；身者，一人之禍福。命可同者，身乃獨也。是以命主雖切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"於度主，身主尤切於度主也。身命清吉，主星受生，命雖駁雜，亦為富夀之人。若身命俱陷，則貧賤凶夭無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"七政四餘分，喜怒，逐一須詳過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"喜怒者，如午宫安命，以日為主，所喜者，金水也；所忌者，木炁也。且如日為君主，五星逢之皆伏，何獨忌木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":2,"content":"炁？盖木炁為難星，而疾厄乃人君所不能無也。然則木炁又能隠蔽光輝，所以忌之。餘倣此推。此六句為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109581327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"一条，論身命配十　一曜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"天地人盤玄更玄，神仙妙不傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"天為外盤，地為加盤，人是內盤，此訣少有人知。斡玄機之妙，神仙之秘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋右轉合乾坤，星禽可取論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"左旋者，天盤；右轉者，地盤。人盤星禽者，二十八宿也。乾道左旋，故二十八宿隨天左旋。坤道右轉，故二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"八宿應地右轉。合乾坤，造化之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"吊起飛來明此理，泄却天之髓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":2,"content":"今人多不識吊起飛來之理，妄以三合四正為是，皆非也。吊星之法，假如命坐寅宫，逆數至東，出卯，却加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449141814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"宫入命，是天盤。地盤得氐房，人盤屬天蝎，原守金，為煞星纒在角宿，吊起在卯，限入卯宫，必主有飛横官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"事。此地盤禍福，尤切於天盤。暗中遇煞，逺處逢生。其義盡在明心消息，子細推詳，特舉一隅，則三隅可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。此論吊起之義，意深而語妙，後學勿泄之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"身命二主如相尅，玄機藏可惜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"如在子宫，命身在寅之類，所謂身命相尅。此訣藏之可惜，露之不宜，得此秘焉。此八句為一條，以三盤加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"身命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"初末平分一百年，生煞細推研。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"命管初年，身管晚年。如安命子，以土為主，喜火忌羅則福。此係命主所係之故，前集所謂依身命所行是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203546127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"原守躔星來犯主，旺局愁行鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"如立命酉宫，金與火同躔實地，火居生旺之地，金囚死絶之鄉，本主已弱。更行寅午戌火旺之限，煞星恃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"勢愈强，此小人得志。命值此者，非貧則病而夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"立命金宫，火同空限逢寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"巳。解，前篇同論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"前限雖危却無咎，後限須當好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":2,"content":"前限主衰微，本為凶夭，雖見災危，却不夭亡，如此必因後限髙强逓出也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765275175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"我旺須要煞，無氣不能為我制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"我為命主也。若得令乘旺，煞星却陷休囚，而煞受制之不暇，奚能我制哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"主與煞殺不兩立。煞强主必失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"主煞二星不可兩立。我弱他必强，我强他必衰。若彼此皆恃其旺，則為戰鬬，非凶徒之命，則是非之流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"煞倘得朋愁愈盛，受制難為逞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"金為命主，火羅作黨，或外拱內夾，正照傍臨，又居旺鄉，為害愈重。若空亡受制，雖有害我之威，安得而逞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"譬猶虎也，性好噬人，居於山墻傍壁之間，又得羣虎以助其猛，則必受其害。若陷於機檻之中，雖有噬人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"之心，不能施其威矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955530252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"若還有用不為凶，權重凛威風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"此言煞星有用。如命在子，木為財福之主。命在寅，金為福主。命在辰，火為財元。此皆尅命為福，不為災禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"却主掌握重權，揚威沙漠，乃不吉之吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"毋曜化凶誠非好，反主為貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"毋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"曜者，恩星也。此言生星為禍。如甲人未上安命，金為生星，木為吉用，却是甲人衝干對禄，此為非常之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"凶，所遇之宫反為禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"化鬼之訣又不同。木須金水逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼者，如寅宫立命，木位寅宫，却逢金水同居申上對照。盖金生水，竊金氣而為水，煞勢潜消，又為毋曜之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144080482304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"用。命逢此者，多是危中僥倖而得榮華。以上二十句為一條。論命限生殺，有生尅制化之妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"正煞暗中逢有救，凶禍應無有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"木為命主，金水同守寅宫，火炎午地，金星方與木星交鋒，自恃其勢，但貪得之心利於前，不顧失於後。不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"期木星牽惹午地之火，却來破金之强，此為暗中有救，雖有禍而實無禍。或曰金亦尅火，但火木成局，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"金安能尅我哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"明生暗遇煞相干，化曜吉兆㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"木喜水生，水木同躔，本為吉兆。却值旬中空，又被煞星暗處侵陵，此是雖吉而實凶也。尅命主為刑星，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"上木炁尅之，本為不喜。如三合有金尅木，則為煞有所制。若三合有火羅，則謂之化煞。盖木能生火，火能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203628047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"生土，是為煞有所化。化煞又勝於制煞，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"主煞坐實又，同宫妙處更當窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"主煞二星相遇，又不逢空，本為凶兆，反為富貴之命。何以言之？假如金為命主，金與火同躔申宫，乃金旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"之鄉，火病之地，又合起申子辰水局，金勢當權，火氣失令，反為我尅。此乃凶中反吉，即富貴之命。以上六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"句為一條，言三盤之煞有明暗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人不必泥，生星合格主髙明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人之命，不必專㸔生星。若身命二主髙强，却合貴格。如太乙抱蟾，木孛扶印，即是貴命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"貧夭何須尋煞曜，活法真為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765291559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":163,"lineType":2,"content":"貧賤造化不必但求煞曜。身命二主俱入惡陷。田財二主又空。或皆陷弱。身命入遷移，弱宫。多被餘奴侵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"犯。身命，田宅、官福、財帛之主。或占兄弟奴僕，奴星入命。或凶星拱夾。身命天元禄主。或命居死絶空亡刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"煞之宫。此皆貧賤之人。此四句為一條，重合格居强也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽左右逢迎，主朝中朱紫貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽，日月也。若身命主居中，左右引從。或夜生身命，二主隨月。晝生身命，二主隨日。必主常侍天顔，職任","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"樞機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"生曜行隨日月明，金玉必豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"生曜乃父母之星，印綬之䕃，恩渥養育資財者也。守官禄，則世賞天澤，多得富貴餘䕃。不得地，則官司公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109548559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"力。人守田宅財帛，則享祖父基業。守福宫，則得人恩授。守遷移，則遇外交。守妻宫，則多招內助。守子息，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"男女榮華。守兄弟，則鴈行和氣。入命宫，則凡事稱意。臨相貌，則半神飄𨓜。所至一宫，則主　一宫之福。若與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"命主相逢，身星胥㑹，乃利達根基，富貴之物。若日月前後行此，必主積玉堆金之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬夾身還夾命，馬首朱衣引。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅生人，甲禄在寅，寅午戌馬居申，木為禄元，水為馬元。或身坐申，水木左右夾之，乃五馬諸侯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"一貴當權羣煞伏，將相兵威肅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅生人，丑為貴元，生於季月，立業酉宫，土金守命，土為貴人，又為生曜，又乗月令居實，此為一星滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"用，又是天官星，謂之一貴當權，萬煞頓伏，必主將相之材，宰輔之職。此八句為一條，言隂陽禄馬拱夾之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203644431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"至貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"刀筆常招上貴憐，𠋣勢玉堂前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"玉堂者，貴人是也。如六辛生人，午為貴元，太陽守午，安命雙女，謂之傍玉堂，必招貴人引接，乃為吏曹之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"人也。又如六庚生人，晝生土為貴元，夜生月為貴元。晝生人，申宫安命土為貴元，却用凶神飛入未酉之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"宫外夾，此化貴為鬼。夜生午宫，安命月為貴元，躔未被木炁吊起飛來，三合對照，尅破尊曜，必為編配之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"徒。雖傍貴人，却被貴人憎怒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"地驛餘奴前後拱，執鞭為僕從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":213,"lineType":2,"content":"地驛者，貴元星也。餘奴，炁孛計羅也。且如寅生人，馬在申，命居戍水為馬元羅是餘奴，酉亥前後拱夾，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453134555250727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"為奴隷下賤之流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"命陷官福馬居强，雖榮不久長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"身命者，根本也。官福馬者，枝葉也。根本盛，則有花葉之榮；根本弱，雖有花葉，不能勝矣。此言身命之主無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"力，却得官福馬有用，終還富貴，不能久長。自非以格局興。若身命混凶神之地，主星遷陷弱宫，必當以此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"斷之，其驗如神也。此六句為一條。言向貴向馬，命陷而賤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"金星與木互同宫，風斤月斧工。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"金者，刀斧之器也。木者，棟梁之材也。此乃木匠之造化。且如命在寅亥，身在午地，木星飛躔午地，逢月為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"身主星日飛沉酉地。如逢金，乃身命二主互換相逢，金木自相斵削，乃運風斤月斧之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122538848307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"水徳或臨身命陷，音樂并漁梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"身命失陷，却逢一水照臨，得地則是酒色音樂之流，失地乃習漁梁之業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"若還太白入天財，綾羅慣剪裁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"財星者，非惟司人資財，亦且主藝業，莫非天星所定。若身命宫不好，田宅又受尅，獨見一金入於財宫明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"徤，主為裁縫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"主來伴月熒夾鎮陶冶知前定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"熒者，火也。鎮者，土也。其二星象，乃主陶冶工輔之屬也。或身命主值此二星夾拱守照，或身命拱夾迎合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"二星，而田財二主無用，乃燒磚造瓦之匠命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449174582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"命若如還火，遇金鐵石藝中尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"火有煆煉之功，金有從革之𠮓。金火制化，必成器用。人命逢此二星照臨，或拱夾，或守照財宫，若非刻金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"鏤銀，則是琢玉擊石之業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"水木同行財帛上，江湖遶興販。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"水者，屬江湖也。木者，為舟楫也。身命官福𤰞微，而水木同臨財帛之宫，則篙師生涯之造化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡休囚羅計尅，多為僧道格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"僧道格局，多是坐孤辰寡宿之間，休囚冷淡之處，畧無生意。及有孤炁单羅獨孛一木照命者，只一身宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"清吉，皆是僧道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109564943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"狐星烏宿性虚靈，雜學更多能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":273,"lineType":2,"content":"心宿者，屬狐也，其性多疑。畢宿者，配烏也，其性最靈。若身居此，必主禀性聰明，雜學通曉之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"蒼龍第二宫中㑹，竹木良工是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":277,"lineType":2,"content":"蒼龍者，木炁是也。第二宫者，財帛是也。若二星㑹於第二宫中，其人必習竹木之藝矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎帶煞入命時，公門多是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎者，日胎也，為人多牽惹是非。若遇火羅孛、計化煞守之，多主公亊之人也。以上二十句為一條，言星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"曜同命入陷，而為工商僧道之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"馬入遷移更祖姓，身命人無定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453134555234343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遷移之宫，遇驛馬之星照之，定主出祖過房，移根易葉。不然必為萍梗之人，他鄉之客。若身命坐此，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"居止不安，心神無定，常好動揺，不安𨓜矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"魚女之宫。太白來珠，蚌毓雙胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"魚者，亥宫也。女者，己宫也。魚有雙尾，蛇有雙舌。若逢辰酉之時生人，金為男女主星，居已亥上者，必招雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"生之子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"流行九位逢羅火，家主煨燼禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"流行者，流年也。九位者，遷移宫也。且如辰酉宫立命，火羅為煞，㑹於遷移上麗財帛入於田宅，皆主此人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"此年必遭家宅火燒之兆。此六句為一條，言災異與出祖之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045415963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"日月頭項水，背肩胸膈屬金。言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"天有自然之形，人亦有生成之形體。以天之形合人之形也，以人之形即天之形也。午未為頭項，己申為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"背肩，辰酉為胸膈矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"齊吳下部。木為足，火宫為肚腹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"齊者，子宫也。吳者，丑宫也，乃為臟腑。木者，寅亥宫也，乃為足。火者，卯戌宫也，乃為腹。此人自然之形體，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"八難凶神若見侵，災禍必然臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"八難者，疾厄宫主。凶神者，尅我之星，如前所謂頭項肩背、胸膈、臟腑、手足肚腹。若逢疾厄凶神侵尅，主一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955513868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"件之疾，實則有之，空則無之。此六句為一條，以七曜配人身而怕煞難也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"冠帶臨官主尅夫，貪花卧栁娛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"冠帶臨官者，婦人之命不宜逢此也。盖冠帶者，無非淫媚脂粉，體態極妍，招迎外人背夫。且臨官者，乃驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"馬所臨之宫，隂陽交㑹之地，如雙魚雙女之𩔖。盖驛馬主淫佚奔馳，交㑹主重婚疊嫁，二者皆是婦人所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"宜忌。若女人立身命於此，官福田財有氣者，雖為享富貴之家，未免亂倫之行。不然亦主夫婿重招，必好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"艷容麗服。若官福田財無用者，又逢咸池金水、天乙月孛照之，必是娼妓下人。造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"血光下部𠔥陽刄，最忌來刑命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"水孛、火羅、陽刃星，皆主血光，女人最忌此曜。為煞尅命，或躔煞，或戰身命宫，輕則血氣之疾，重則生産喪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045432347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽守照晨，牝鷄對月定妨妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"婦人若太陽坐命照臨，加以身强，必主欺夫奪權，心髙性急，為女中之豪霸，有男子之英雄。男子命若太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"隂守照妻宫，對宫主妻妾無貌，不然亦不正法而婚嫁。所以太隂有缺有圓，不常之意。望前夜生輕，望後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"晝生則重。此六句為一條，言女命怕煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"金星為煞更逢煞，非命𠔥王法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"如命坐寅亥宫，金為煞星，更在諸凶神之上，或亡神、飛廉、的煞、刼煞、驀刃，此人主亡於非命，死於王法。盖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"金為肅殺之星，又逢凶煞，其勢愈増，為禍尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449158198"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"疾宫炁伴主星躔，盧扁舊家傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"疾厄之宫，命主同炁星飛入，乃醫人之命。吉則以此㫁之，凶則帶疾坎坷之人也。此四句為一條，言遇煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"而刑疾也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"别有源流。推姓氏父母妻宫記","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"金為商姓人，木為角姓人，水為羽姓人，火為徵姓人，土為宫姓人四，餘同。論日月以水火論。假如金守父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":371,"lineType":2,"content":"母宫，主父母商姓。木守妻宫，主妻角姓。他倣此。若無守照之星，以宫主所屬何音㫁之。此訣乃星家之寶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"得者宜秘之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"更將所屬别生辰，心精見若神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001503782"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"所屬者，此法有二，　一以天干所屬，一以地支所屬。生辰者，乃父母妻子之生年也。以太隂配戊己，木配丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":381,"lineType":2,"content":"丁，火孛配甲乙，土配戊己，水炁配庚辛，羅計配壬癸。且如丙寅年、壬辰月、甲子日、乙丑時，年為父母，屬寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":383,"lineType":2,"content":"若木星守照，必主此人。丙丁人是父母也，不然木命人是也。又如甲子日，子為妻宫，若土星守照，必是此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"人，戊已人為妻妾，不然，土命是也。又如乙丑時為子息，若金星守照，必主此人，先生丙丁之子，不然丑命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"生亦屬金也。又一訣：丙寅年辰月子日丑時，寅為父母，必看寅宫之主飛入何地，或飛入未上，乃是未生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"人為父母妻子二宫皆倣此詳推，要在㑹精聚神，萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"逢生遇煞分凶吉，𩔖應年月日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":393,"lineType":2,"content":"生星為福，煞星為禍。木星應在亥、卯、未、寅年月日時，火星應在寅、午、戌、卯年月日時，土星應在辰、戌、丑、未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114473201698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時也。且如水星為生曜貴人，則應在申、子辰己年，必榮膺除擢。庶人逢此，則財利稱心。又如木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"煞星貴人，逢亥夘未寅，則降官黜職。庶人逢此，則失耗家財。病人遇此，則殞身喪命，無不應驗也。其餘年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"月日，皆倣此𩔖推之。一章之㫖，真是天機妙語也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"斯文盡是神仙秘，談出天機趣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"斯文者，是𤣥機之奥妙也，皆探造化之靈㫖。受之者，必因徳修行。尊之所致，非易得也。若非韞匱藏珠，輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":407,"lineType":2,"content":"泄非人，其禍不旋踵而至也。以上八句為一條。言五行推筭之精也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"人身亦是小天地，舉一知其𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"戴九履一，左三右七。二四為肩，六八為足。言肩舉足，則眼目心腹腰腎，上下盡在其中矣。且如煞在已午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203578895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"非頭面則目有病。在夘酉，則心腹有疾。盖頭離腎坎坤巽肩震兑腹乾艮足。故人之一身，皆法天象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"官福拱財身得地，既富還饒貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"官福拱，財星也。身得地，身星坐實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"俗夫只把原守説，死局不知活。紛紛雜揉且休言，最𦂳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"是流年。死生最怕流年惡，原守難憑托命强。限弱只主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"夀，身强福元厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"有禄無福，禄將安享。有命無身，命將安保。故命强不如身壯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"日月若夾的刃時，禍極必分屍。陽年刄在東西現，嵗實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453122765307943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"遭刑憲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲年刃在夘之類。嵗實，流年填實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"隂年刃在西北馳，犯此禍難移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛年刃戊之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"駕前衝驀諸神煞，直難休重疊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人命不宜與太嵗衝，不要在太嵗後一位，謂之衝驀。驀在駕之後，悖逆之象。身命在上者必凶，更加凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"星，則大作禍，加吉星則大作福。難星試以午未二宫分之。太陽午駕已位一木立，太隂未駕午位　一上計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"立。人是直星守四柱，身命為人，凡百不能，作事顛倒。此八句為一條，言的刄直頭之為利害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001520166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"直刄伴身坐日支，妻子早分離。妻星遇煞又逢直，二次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"明花燭。男女坐空日月來，必定損頭胎。大槩妻子乃一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"理，尅妻必留子。月為兄弟日為妻。子息在其時。主星却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"看居何地。虛實從其類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":459,"lineType":2,"content":"如申上安命木為妻星，飛入亥宫，如遇癸亥日，則為實地，偕老無疑。如甲子日則為虚刑尅不免。所謂從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"其𩔖也。兄弟子息斷各例此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"句句言言妙理深，故名曰指金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"此歌一言一句皆達妙理之深，萬世萬人盡仰星家之實，得之者自宜韞匱，名曰指金，夫何忝與。此十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453114955546636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"句為一條，言直刃刑尅妻子，宜從虛實以論之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"指金虚實五星天機七五賦下：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"世人開口問為官，提起與君看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
