{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡為官之命，雖要格局之妙，莫大乎漏闗。漏闗者，乃十一曜拱此一處，不惟四正强弱宫，但㸔漏闗，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"是一品之命。且如日月引十一曜拱一位，或是禄馬，或是天門地位，或端門帝座，或福禄主，或生星命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"則大貴大富。又有漏闗，四位無星，八位無星，或左右兩位無星者亦貴。又如日月拱夾福徳。日月同宫照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"命。日月拱夾官禄。日月包羅，五星四餘。日月拱夾田財。五星如連珠，日月如合璧。五星輪序。五星循𤨔。五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"星向順相生。五星聚㑹。羅計截㫁，羅計押班。　一星跳垣，五星入廟。四餘在外，七政在内。又有五星六曜漏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203611663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"闗格，如丙子年、丙申月、甲午日、丙寅時，得木星入命者大貴。盖丙年木為天禄，丙為月禄，甲為日禄，丙為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"財禄，以此　一星為四干元禄星者極妙，更合格，官至極品。又有十二宫安命，富貴興衰格局。如子上安命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"或土埋雙女，大好無尅，十五嵗大限過宫便為官，如受尅不濟。福木旺在寅，十七嵗便有難，二十六嵗火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"為恩則好。丑上安命，先看命，次看金，終看身，三用俱髙强，則為公侯。或主星居午，更得金入垣，官至三公，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"若刑破，只是吏人。寅上安命，先看命，次看身水，三者俱占髙强，為王侯命，不要刑破則吉。夘上安命，最忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"福徳星，只要火羅日月居髙强，無刑破，便是好命。刑破只是吏人。辰上安命，夜生人，只得身居官位，不須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"看命，更得日臨獅子，不論晝夜，謂之星合壁，當膺鍾鼎之任，不要刑破。己上安命，先看命主，次看身，三看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"木。申上孛星躡政，更得限好，不拘晝夜，官列紫綬，不要刑破。午上安命先看命星，次看火星入垣。如遇羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144080498688"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"星同居官禄，或居八煞，遇之死亡。十五嵗大限過宫便授勑，不要尅破。未宫安命先看命星，次看安身，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"看火星入垣。如與羅星同居官禄，則為破格，或居八煞，遇夜生人，十五嵗大限過宫便授勑，不要尅破。申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"上安命，乃隂陽宫也。命先看水，次看孛，終看金、木、火，皆為吉宿。木入宫垣為官星，火入官禄只主富。或居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"八煞，身居官禄，得地主授宣，不要刑破。酉上安命先看金，次看孛，三看土星升垣。在官在煞，為官最殊。晝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"得隂星，夜得陽星，只是吏人命星髙官髙入八煞，官列紫綬。若刑破，只是吏人。戌上安命先看命，次看身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"終看土星升垣。如在官福二宫，官品顕達，受傷、刑、破，只是吏人命。亥上安身先看木炁月，次看火羅金。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"木炁月，有一髙强，為官顯達。如他宫混雜，命帶刑破，多狡。吏命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"為官須要福基厚，福薄終難久。日月分明拱福禄，此命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045399579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"皇家族。天門守福日月扶，恩近相中書。日月扶官恩外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"拱，坐煞邊庭𠖥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"亥為天門。守福者，守照也。日月扶者，日月夾也。恩外拱者，星恩在外，三方拱照也。坐煞邊庭𠖥者，格局髙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"以煞為權矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"恩福扶官身曜明，信重御堦行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"身曜者，太隂司天也。此十二句為一條。言官星有恩福，日月相扶為至貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"身福恩官俱好㸔無拱。三品㫁六曹。四品五品宣，身福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"近君前。六品以下京官走，身福居君後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001569318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":541,"lineType":2,"content":"身者，太隂身主也。禄者，官星也。近君前者，乃登駕，即近君之側也。此六句為一條。言恩福近君之貴，乃其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"次者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"宣官三品不居京，君側欠恩星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"君側欠恩者，乃恩不近君也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"府州縣官俱守印，四正官身緊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"守印者，正官也。四正者，子午卯酉宫也。官身者，官身之星也。𦂳者，坐實而占髙强也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申已亥見官星，佐貳職親民。辰戌丑未官星現，雜職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"隨資轉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144080564224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"以上八句為一條，言四正、四馬、四庫官貴不同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"武官帶煞，身星出地，煞空方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"凡武官命多坐煞，或坐驀越，或主星遇刑星，或主星坐馬落空，或官星受尅而有救，官星逆而逢生。其中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"若帶貴權，主封侯建節。又如日月同宫，二曜朝陽，五星隨日，火月同宵，一星伴月，太乙抱蟾，金水㑹蛇，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"政得垣，或福官互垣，或身命互垣，此皆富貴之命也。若富人之命，必田福宫强實。或水火同行，或金木同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"位，或水火木金羅之𩔖，相生相尅者皆是也。盖為富不仁，為仁不富，故多戰尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星前後福恩隨，開閫列旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，尅命也。生者，生我，乃恩星也。謂之煞星背我而去，恩星向我而來。人𠔥福星入命，是主開閫之權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203660815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"身恩坐駕煞不見，帶劍日上殿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"身星、恩星坐於嵗駕之上，煞星俱空而不見，所以能見於君，而帶劍日上殿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星流空身福竒，馬陷鎮城池。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"煞星者，為流旬所空，而身福二星皆好，雖馬陷没，但主星不空而鎮城池也。此八句為一條，言福恩帶煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"為武職也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬坐實身有拱，財徤運中旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"財徤者，財星坐實地而占强宫也。所以運中旺𤼵非横之財也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"身星最𦂳命次之，恩福要相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144080580608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"此四句為一條，言有恩福無官星而為富也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"命主逢空無祖業，其餘身管攝。身命若陷總無憑，財禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"要身承。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"此四句為一條，言身命陷而貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星全没身星實，福好終身吉。煞星不實居。弱方，衝照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"福無妨。三方見煞却無忌，禍福玄中秘。對宫見煞别無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"災，大槩欠舒懐。災多福少憑何信，福曜居陽刄。福貴明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"如一寶珠，切忌刄星虛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453117203693583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":613,"lineType":2,"content":"此十二句為一條，詳論煞星，而要歸於虛實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星絆福身星弱，進退難名爵。福恩明徤身主髙，官實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"老而豪。官星總好福星弱，好處還失却。恩星守籍少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"起，福陷中途墜。恩星近君信任專，一陷命歸泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"官實者，官星坐實也。為官之人，無福則力不勝任，鮮克有終也。籍者，生時也。福陷空也。中途墜者，不能久","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"也。㫁曰：福能保官，福一空而居官不久也。君者，太陽也。䧟者，旬空也。又曰：恩能取信，　一陷而信令不行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"恩星落空日月逺，府縣瞻天選。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"恩者，生我之宿也。既落空亡人，不與太陽星及身主相近，是以但居府縣之官，而不能覲清光也。此十　二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144080596992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"句詳論恩福官星，而要歸於虛實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"福官當籍喜恩生，煞犯主刑傷。煞星坐籍皆臨忌，身弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"長憔悴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"籍者，我之生時也。若官福二星坐於籍上，則喜恩星生之。若遇煞星尅之，則居官不能善終。若煞星坐籍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"駕，所謂畏首畏尾，是以身弱而常憔悴也歟。此四句為一條，言恩福不可雜於煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"命守垣城福伴恩，壯嵗秉威權。恩臨帝座。身守福限，吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"承天禄。命中最𦂳是八方，格重煞神降。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗駕垣城帝座者，為三生也。命宫官、福、田、財為五用，此八處日月夾拱為第一，諸宫主星逓相次之。但合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144793612297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"此格，不甚忌煞。五星精要云：帝座以本生日納音在處為之，垣城以本生時納音生處為之。又云：帝座，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"宫是也。此六句為一條，言恩福之貴在八方而煞降也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"吏人之命，禍福專，貴馬有相干坐貴向貴。煞守命，刀筆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"操權柄。煞星守貌，福刄并謀，陷没人情。官星坐實貴馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"徤，煞陷風雲𠮓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"吏人之命，煞星守相貌宫官福宫干渉陽刃，其人為吏，尤多尅剥，謀害良人。若官星坐實，貴馬徤而煞星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"空，則有際遇而為官也。此八句為一條，言貴馬與煞刃不可相併也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人之命坐臨官，金孛必淫奔。婦人命宫日木守，貌醜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045547035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"却敦厚。從來女命看身宫，身好必昌隆。福星不棄身居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"二，富貴榮閭里。若教坐馬煞却衝，孤寡更貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"凡婦人命坐臨官之宫，及與金孛同宫者，必淫。若命宫有太陽木星同守，貌雖醜而性敦厚，福星不棄，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"不空也。身居二，身主居財帛宫也。若坐馬位，而煞星與刼的同衝照，孤寡而更貧窮也。大抵女命先看身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"命，次看夫宫，又看福星，𠔥看田財兩宫星辰如何。第一看男女宫，次看疾厄宫。男女宫有吉星，更男女主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"不受尅，疾厄宫又好，則主生貴子，亦無産難。如男女宫低，有刑星守之，尅曜照之，疾厄宫有刑星，必主産","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"厄。如男女宫主受尅者，必招産死。女人除寅亥坐命，喜金水清會，榮夫利子。其他宫安命，不喜金水清，十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"命九婢妾也。此十句為一條。言女命貴身福，而賤金孛煞馬也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453130449272886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"出家物外縁何格，命主居閑極。身居華盖福臨財，名字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"動三台。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"僧道命貴清勝俗，但忌福身落亡。身福俱空命身居華盖，鐃磬尋常之軰。出家僧道之命。又懼命主入兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"弟宫，太隂居華盖之上，以為太隂所忌者也。此四句為一條，言僧道之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐長生身坐虚，非吏亦非儒。身命俱空魁獨露，藝術","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"多清苦。禄居破碎刼衝時，貪酒更能詩。命空身空限全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，頭白鷄窓客讀書。全要福身堅。身福限徒然。文魁拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"命煞都化，翰苑増光價。魁星雖好煞星隨，因學禍遭髠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045514267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"平生一文不能聚身陷的煞。據","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"命主坐長生之上，太隂坐空，文魁煞半强半弱者，乃是非儒非吏造化也。命主星命宫太隂星疊逢空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"文魁獨露於垣局者。又金星炁孛同守天空，或入兄弟者，㫁其人必是九流藝術之人。且如辛酉得禄勲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"之地，辛已生人，酉是破碎，若被對宫夘衝之，乃聰明好酒之徒。如是身命居空，文魁獨露者，更後全弱，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"讀書至老，只作白身人。又如文魁拱命身者，命主及身，福更堅實，則作翰院之官。推之文魁雖在前行，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"星却在後隨，此等命必因學海害身，徒配刺膚之命。若身星飛起，逢空而的煞，又據占本宫，則主其人平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"生一文不能得聚也。此十六句為一條。言身命恩福魁煞，以虛實而論貴賤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"財福重空田宅無。奔走口難糊。限宫泄氣財星窘，生理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453134555349031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"休營運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"謂行限而飛出，遇泄氣之星，而財星又為煞星所制，所以營運多不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"福財身主入遷移，興販足施為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"福財身三主，但　一主守遷移，則能興販而獲厚利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"福身二星坐奴僕，終日心不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"或福身星坐奴僕，則不能純厚享安閑之福也。此八句為一條，言財福限空陷而貧賤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"二主臨財萬頃田，福命勝為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"福命勝為官，一作官福喜居垣。詩云：二宫坐貴三朝禄，二主臨財萬頃田。又云：福星居福真為福，官主臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144793694217"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"官作顯官。須看四柱帶不帶來，以定其真假。評輕重多寡。如丙戌、壬辰、甲子、庚午，未上安命，太隂在午，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"為二主臨財。可惜丙戍旬中，午未空了，雖得午字填起，縁壬辰是甲申中物。二主，身命主也。臨財坐財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":743,"lineType":2,"content":"宫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"有田千頃禄千鍾。財位見恩重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"財位見恩重，言恩星守財帛宫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"財星田主互相守，巨富真稀有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":751,"lineType":2,"content":"財星守田宅，或田宅守財帛宫也。以上六句為一條。言田財遇恩而富也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"馬空貴空命坐奴，身陷走卒徒。咸池守命身刼的，徒配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147159150603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"從軍籍。禄逢破碎曰梟神。身臨薄藝人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"以上六句言貴馬遭陷，而刼的遭凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"身居閒極命天徳，交情極易合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命坐貴馬空位、休囚之所，三方拱夾亦然。命主飛出坐奴僕之宫，又不入格局，福恩亦無力，方可㫁之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"曰奴僕徒卒之命。如貴人亦有坐馬入奴之説，須看恩福田。官垣旺者不可類推。如坐咸池可換，又坐刼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":767,"lineType":2,"content":"的行限，又是離恩虛地，少年中年必在軍伍中也。咸池刼的拱夾身命者亦然。禄勲值破同宫，身星臨其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"上者，必少義無恩徳人也。閒極者，兄弟也。身星臨之，命主命宫，更坐天徳之上，最有情義，與人一見如故，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"春風和氣，慎終如始也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147159134219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"第三宫中號閑極，喜與福星易。若與官禄兩居垣，到老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"也無權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":779,"lineType":2,"content":"閑極者喜入福徳，忌入官禄，二主互換亦然，尤忌之。若與命主相來徃，為有福人，無尅，故為喜也。以上六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":781,"lineType":2,"content":"句為一條。言閑極主宜與福，不宜與官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"少年福宫遇嵗君，此限藹陽春。中年官禄若坐庫，恩合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"還居富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗君者，嵗駕也。守於福徳之間，此限最利少年，二十六七嵗限至此必吉，三十六七限至官禄中年也。官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":789,"lineType":2,"content":"禄宫若坐辰戍丑未之上，三方恩福財官㑹合，斯限主富貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045530651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"老景遷移八載間，疾厄看迎攀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"命年五十二嵗入遷移，六十嵗入疾厄。如至遷移之宫後疾厄無所忌，則遷移大𤼵也。所謂若還後限不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":797,"lineType":2,"content":"如前，只許半週天是也。此六句為一條，言大限貴逢駕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"駕前一位是天空，禍福類旬中。福神十位名壓煞，遇者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"真英傑。白虎官符喪吊凶，命限怕相逢。若與命元真煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，不死遭徒配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"駕。即當生太嵗所主貴煞。駕前天空與旬中空亡，吉凶虛實同𩔖觀之。其餘各隨所生年數，分禄馬貴煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":807,"lineType":2,"content":"為用。更有天空、喪門、白虎、官符、月徳、嵗破、天徳、吊客、病符與當生體用，遇天空則吉凶皆不可用。喪客皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453134555316263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"主孝服也。官符即飛天官符，合限值之，有横災官事，尤忌日時同到。白虎即大煞，主官事破財之患。病符，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":813,"lineType":2,"content":"主病不濟事。嵗破，主動揺不寧。天月二徳，名壓煞星，男女坐命大貴，限嵗見之，進喜解厄矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"陽年空陽隂空隂，此理用心尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"甲、丙戊、庚壬屬陽，乙丁已、辛癸屬隂。更子寅辰、午、申、戌屬陽，丑夘己、未、酉、亥属隂。所以陽年則空天星，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":819,"lineType":2,"content":"不空其地曜。隂年空其地曜，而不能空其天星。陽年則天星為禍福最𦂳，而地曜次之，此理當用心尋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"天星者，金、木、水、火、土、炁孛、羅計、天恩、催官、文魁之類也。地曜者，殿前貴人、天月二徳、陽刃、刼的、禄馬，驀越","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":823,"lineType":2,"content":"天空、白虎、華盖、六害、長生、臨官、帝旺、咸池之𩔖也。此十句為一條。論流年十二位神煞吉凶虚實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"金騎人馬火燒牛，尅命實堪憂。土埋雙女如作主，膽力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453149314973715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"大如虎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":831,"lineType":2,"content":"金騎人馬，木打寳瓶，水漂白羊，火燒牛角，土埋雙女，常術談命，冽作凶言。殊不知金騎人馬，寅上安命方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"忌。若辰酉安命而騎人馬者，則是主星起去制他人，十分得力。其餘土埋雙女，木打寶瓶之類皆然。土埋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":835,"lineType":2,"content":"雙女，子丑安命，土在已宫，與前不同，主其人膽大力强，不伏人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星入命或為權，切忌犯身元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"煞星入命，若金騎人馬之𩔖，尚有用於天元，為財福之𩔖。若犯身主，則凶不可解也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"好星切忌刃刼的身，坐為惡逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":843,"lineType":2,"content":"金主天元，不要坐刼，身宫不要坐刃，女人尤𦂳。若居八煞之上，逢生者反操生煞之權。縱不逢生，為禍亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144793628681"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"輕。如人身宫犯者，金居陽刄為真刄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪二八小限門，財破禍臨身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"小限在財帛疾厄，二八門更合上次官符、白虎、喪門、吊客之𩔖，主破財生病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"天空守命名死穴，刄拱禍偏烈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"天空者，本生年前一位是也。其上坐命，最忌刄煞。拱照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"的煞。莫夾官禄鄉，夾着禍難當。陽刄的刼忌，三合拱命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"身最毒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":861,"lineType":2,"content":"陽刃的刼三星分臨三合之地，最怕拱命拱身。此十六句為一條，論身元命主，最忌犯煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453149314990099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"月支一位喜身逢，行限㸔西東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"太隂坐月支上，日生則日東月西，夜生則月東日西。行限到，視其順逆㫁吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡駕上，喜日月諸曜分優劣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"駕上惟喜日月居之，諸用之星當視輕重而㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"計羅橫截定，朝昏混雜不須論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":875,"lineType":2,"content":"或日或月，漏闗當分晝夜司之，若衆混雜，必不論。格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"兩般化煞天機語，天禄并身主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"化煞，三方對照，衝合正度。且如火為煞，衝合土星，謂之煞化恩也。更土曜化刑囚煞四餘之氣，除化天禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144793645065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"外，皆作煞論。此八句為一條，言支駕位喜日月天禄身主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"士夫功名要問除，催官天馬俱。催官天馬太嵗吊合，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"方遷調。煞不合時只平遷，恩煞合方陞。流年限上恩忽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"到，平地承宣詔。天馬一星逐年起，催官要同至。催官若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"坐在陽宫，東南食禄豐坐隂。其年必西北，此論真竒特。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"催官恩星四正逢，官居直隷京。若臨寅申并已亥，一去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"三千里。辰戌丑未四千餘，此法論無虚。要問陞除何日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"月，只把太隂説。太隂兩日行一宫，恩官要相逢。恩官㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144793661449"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"着是除日，月令喜填出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":903,"lineType":2,"content":"士夫功名之人，專以催官天馬為𦂳。且如太嵗填實催官天馬之𩔖，或三方㑹合，對宫衝起，其年必有動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"遷之喜，合煞則陞之，不合則平遷而已。亦須先看目下見行限，貴與賤則以官民兩論不同，常人皆次吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"原守雖如此㫁，其流年逐宫轉填，實衝合㑹，逐月可推。如太隂流行至辰，則應此月令內，必見遷擢也。催","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"官陽宫隂宫者，以流年為𦂳。且如丑年催官在計，看計星行到何地，與身恩主星同宫者，陽宫必出東南，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"隂宫必轉西北，但流年恩星到所行之限上，必蒙宣詔也。此十六句為一條，論催官天馬陞除也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"病人若要問生死，依此例中詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"此二句為一條，論推病依前例也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453144793677833"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"晝日夜月難一例，金鳴火終昧。火金曽受一畨空，未可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"例言凶限元。脱却嵗星陷，虚實一般論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":923,"lineType":2,"content":"盖人之生與萬物為一體，隨其根𣲖而運化。桃梅不結李，鐵石安可成金？故燕雀不生鳯，狐兔不乳馬。人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"之命稟水，即一水也。十二宫皆作水忌土計，餘倣此推。此六句為一條，言七政當從虛實而論生尅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"其間或有玄機秘，按圖難索驥。識得五行顛倒顛，方是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"大羅仙。生尅制化自有理，癡人多錯擬心上。經綸造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"移，不許俗人知。學人得此莫輕付，神鬼空中䕶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":933,"lineType":2,"content":"此十句為一條，論生尅制化之妙，非人所知，以總結上意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453118109646863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":937,"lineType":9,"content":"教外别意雜詩二十六首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"造化惟將一理推，　旬知虚實發天機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"源流體用俱當辯，運氣尤宜看改移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"理則只今生尅是，氣明天運有推遷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"古今治亂分輕重，　此是琴堂法外傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡一訣少人知，　貴賤災祥各有司。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"空處不空分拱夾，　更將貼襯有無推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"用宿若空衝得實，　凶星空了怕衝來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453115001585702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"不空不實名平局，　地曜天星禍福該。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"貴賤先須明拱夾，　賢愚只要看隂陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"次明日月同天徳，　徳性襟懐總易量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"金輕土重木星慈，　火燥羅麄水性疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"孛狡計奸偏僻氣，　更將的刄為詳推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎嫌入六害孤，　禄空易陷易親疏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"煞居相貌𠔥飛刄，此是人中破疾徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"丑時日是進神星，申刻生人把月評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453133045563419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"子午界開天地宿，　長生有宿更聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"分明一退當三空，　有用之星一例同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"官福田財終蹭蹬，　定知妻子必遲逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"駕前一位號天空，　百煞逢之不作凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"若是用神飛到此，　限宫無照却嫌窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"駕後一宫名驀越，諸星遇着减精華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"惟宜日月居前後，　此是淤泥出異葩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"生星第一喜生身，　財福雖空不苦辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453134555398183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"煞若臨深尤你貴，　限宫一陷命沉淪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"用星飛出落空中，用位分明有實逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"更有駕前衝禄馬，　定為貪利更邀功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨陽刄守財奴，財落三宫好用徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"身命二星閑極見，津津和氣百無拘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"動静能分體用明，　天星地曜更須憑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"三才定位原無改，要識無形有象星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"一年稱意是何因，太嵗填恩照限身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453149315006483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"財福填時財氣盛，　官星填起必髙陞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福相逢禄馬空，　一空一實忌偏枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"官星空了三分實，　限若逢之必降除。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"金水為恩拱駕行，為官定執法司權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"天門有拱多清要，　翰苑聲名共此詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"九流清苦若何知，　只把空亡仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"滿局都空名朽腐，　平生骨肉必參差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"流旬空法有神通，　此法名為御史空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453134555365415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有吉星居貴地，　一時空却欠從容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"諸煞俱嫌太嵗填，　看他填處在何宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"田財官福身星等，　一一依宫論吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星守限若逢遲，　交限三年福始宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"出限三年還有力，　凶星遲了一般推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩凶星最怕留，　凶星留却最多愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"下年太嵗逢迎了，還見餘殃未肯休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"逆時天運促流年，禍福相逢在眼前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147159183371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"不必論他宫濶狹，　只將交處摘其玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"世運推移異昔年，剥官退職横遭愆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"只因流嵗空恩福，　煞不收藏的刄專。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"仕宦諸公要問閑，空亡一訣理中玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"官星身命重空却，福不空時老做仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figur {"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"星命之説，其法傳自西天。今西天都例聿斯等經，散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"載諸家，余弗獲覩厥全。然我朝欽天監有囘囘科，毎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"年推筭七政度數，二曜交蝕，較漢歴為尤凖。乃知西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"天之法，的有真傳，信不誣也。耶律五星，耶律純傳自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453149315285011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"高麗國禪師，國師傳自西天。今觀其大者，如論一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽、五太隂、二金二火、六木六水六土之説，分偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"正以定宫度，别體用以取身命，重天元月令合上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"下盤局，及二百字真經、步天標本等論，皆根極造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"化，洞究天人。後雖有作者，弗可易也。諸家竊其餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"緒，各立門户，究厥㫖歸，不能外焉。今術者但知重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"琴堂，而不知重耶律，是不知二書互相發明，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"舉一而廢一也。術者謂琴堂凖於我朝，耶律凖於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162103586853"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"𨖚、金，此又拘於氣運之說，而不思論道理、重身命、官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"禄、田財、妻妾、逰行，則古今一而已矣。考厯代國家取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"人之法，或以文武進，或以孝廉顯，或假納粟入官，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"推恩蔭受職，或重天潢世派，或喜黄冠緇衣，出身雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"有不同，榮貴則無或異。論星命者能隨時消詳，自其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"所重者推之，則耶律可凖於今，而虚實亦驗於古矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"岐而二之，可乎？余故詳叙為看星者法焉。易水育吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"大𨖚征和二年，翰林學士耶律純以議地界事，奉國書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"使於髙麗。至其國，聞國禪師精星躔之學，具重幣，設威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"儀求見，屢請不從。一日，自請於髙麗國王曰：臣奉國書來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"此，稔聞國師富於道徳星命之學，願借玉音，得遂一見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"以請所有，何啻昌黎之遇大顛也。國王遂命一見。既見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"之後，往復數回，乃請曰：微生跧伏北方，聞國師深於星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"命之學。今日天幸，得面鈞顔，願北面從師，得聞一二，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453148275064842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"聳北方之學者，亦是三生夙縁，不知可乎？國師曰：何不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"可之有？但學士平生論學，有何所得，吾與學士從長商","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"確而巳，何以師為？曰：膚學得於生尅制化之外，亦有十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"條。前六條看根本，後四條看流年。其一曰：太嵗尊神，加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"臨管攝。其二曰：無中有曜，弱處髙强。其三曰：得經失次，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"細辨盈虚。其四曰：身傍母吉，傍鬼者凶。其五曰：同宫千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"里，異宫尺寸。其六曰：黨母福多，藏鬼禍大。其七曰：原守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"雖詳，流年猶急。其八曰：當生𠮓曜，流年飛星。其九曰：限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914289676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"併諸煞，貴禄不臨。其十曰流年諸星，無忽柔曜。此十條","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"者，各有詳註，未審如何？國師曰：十條之說抑末矣，本之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"則無。姑就學士談星根本，以宫主為重耶？度主為重耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：得於平昔之講明，以宫度𠔥論，不可用一而廢一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"國師笑曰：宫度兼論，吾恐子於是度，胸中不能自斷，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"以斷人之禍福也。且如命躔丑宫之牛金宫土，度金，限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"行遇火，一生一尅，何以為斷？又如命坐寅宫尾火宫木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"度火，限行遇水，一生一尅，何以為斷？於禍福何凴？遂再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162103603237"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"拜曰：願棄所學，而從師求敎。師曰：吾嘗以近世談星者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"言宫不知度，言度不知宫，二者胥失矣。吾於海上，異人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"授我以偏正之垣，於二十八宿之中，分之曰一太陽、五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰、六木、六土、六水、二火、二金之説，學士曾聞之乎？曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"未也。國師曰：人生於地，日月五行見於天。其生值七曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"之吉，則一生享福安榮；遇七曜之凶，則一生忙迫，日不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"如意。日月五星，其為物也，於天地間最大，於天下萬物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"日主晝，月主夜，乃天之眼目也。在天有五星，在地有五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235558427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"行，人生於世，五者一日不可缺。觀星談命，茍不知此根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"本，徒學宫度兼論之術，何以決人之禍福？故十二宫有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"偏正之垣，子宫以虚日䑕為正垣，䑕乃子垣之宫神，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"正垣而何也？丑宫牛金牛，寅宫尾火虎，卯宫房日兎，辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"宫亢金龍，已宫翼火蛇，午宫星日馬，未宫鬼金羊，申宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"觜火猴，酉宫昴日雞，戌宫婁金狗，亥宫室火猪，皆本宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"之正垣。此為千古不易之論，談星之大根本，可以盡知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"其要妙也。所謂一太陽者，太陽君𧰼，天無二日，民無二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162103717925"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"王，惟星日馬乃太陽之正垣。五太陰者，后妃之𧰼。后妃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"𡣕衆多，宜太陰之五也。故以鬼金羊為太陰之正垣，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"餘張、心、危、畢，皆偏垣之月也。六木者，寅宫尾火虎，亥宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"室火猪，為木正垣。其餘斗、奎、井、角，皆偏垣之木也。六土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"者，子宫虚日，丑宫牛金，為土正垣。其餘女、氐、胃、柳，皆偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"垣也。六水者，巳宫翼火，申宫觜火，為水正垣。其餘箕、壁、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"參、軫，皆偏垣也。二火者，卯宫房日，戌宫婁金，為火之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"垣。二金者，辰宫亢金，酉宫昴日，為金之正垣。天地之間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147847147535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"水、木、土隨處皆有，隨所居而可得。木滿山林，土滿寰宇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"水滿江河。至於金、火，則不可多得焉，只有二火、二金。使","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"金、火如木、水、土之多，則天下常有持刄縱火之患，豈不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"為世道憂？吾有偏正垣七政論，日月並明說，計八篇。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"有二百字真經二十五題，詳於學士十條者。學士所舉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"十條，人常聞常知也；吾之諸論，人所未聞未知也。今以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"諸論八篇，與夫二百字真經二十五題授學士，純遂拜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"受而寶之。大𨖚征和二年八月十三日，　耶律純自識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"元星入局，富貴無虧；母曜歸窠，榮華有凖。若見財星得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"所，𤼵積成家；倘或制鬼當先，刑傷破耗。母曜莫傷於財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，財星莫制於母星。母入財鄉，清淡守株之士；財居子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"位，慳貪薄藝之人。子衝煞地是英雄，子若衝財家破耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"子居母腹，必多蹭蹬之財；煞守元方，定是孤寒之士。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"抵母曜無傷，元須得地。夀入夀而無虧，年過一百；財遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"財而有制，囊乏分文。母健子明，而男女成行；財破元魁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342125108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"而夫妻反目。元局破而猶可，元星虧而立凶。泄氣重逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"貧無立錐之地；閑神疊見，身無一日之安。戰煞必要其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"降，煞戰必湏他弱。星運一元，氣分萬𧰼。元氣貴乎生旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"官星切忌休囚。當明官鬼之元，一星二用；必達母財之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"理，二曜一情。財破庫傷，終身危蹇；元衰財弱，一世孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼旺則夀筭必虧，子生則田宅有發。元坐孤虚，骨肉參","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"商，却宜僧道。令居驛馬，功名蹭蹬，偏喜醫巫。逢生則皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"致祥，遇絶則能成禍。官印不虧，必作青雲之客。令母有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235574811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"情，當為黄甲中人。煞盛元虧，則早年夭折。令傷母損，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"中嵗孤貧。鬼入元方，利名無就。元居母局，官爵顯榮。財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"庫不生而不絶，亦可守成。令元不旺而不虧，僅能承蔭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"白手成家，必是令生財宿。青雲得路，當知令護元辰。煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"化為官，多是險中僥倖。令𠮓為鬼，必於閑處榮華。妻星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"弱而重害室家，母曜陷而六親早尅。滿門昌盛，皆因格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"局安和；一世貧寒，必是令元臨戰。官令逢傷，縱得名不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"過虚譽。鬼閑太盛，雖有權而終無實貴。煞祿勲得用，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167488892965"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"星純可取。官庫嵗駕不傷，則曜實為佳。切忌無情夾拱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"須看有意揖朝。不可一途而取，要明三限之元。大抵閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"神不可交迎，制忌亦嫌拒敵。尅我者有用何妨，生我者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神何用。空亡絶地，會吉非祥。祿馬旺鄉，逢凶反福。元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"居亡刼，有鬬多災。母坐煞宫，無救多滯。生旺處為禍還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"輕，死絶處有福亦淺。盖五行順則為祥，逆則為禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":9,"content":"玉堂寶書五星斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行者，木火土金水也。在天曰五星，在地曰五行，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634360374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"人曰五常。太極既判，天地初分，合乎至道，體乎自然，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"動一静，萬物生焉，盖造化而有𠮓也。夫金生夏而旺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"秋，水生秋而旺於冬，木生冬而旺於春，火生春而旺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"夏，土乘火氣初生於已。每於四季節中氣前三日為旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"其月在辰戌丑未為正位。故金旺木死，木旺金囚，水旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"木相，火旺土休。生我者為父母，我生者子孫。尅我者官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，我尅者妻財，比和者同𩔖。然五行之性，各致其由，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"以元星入局，福夀無虧；母曜歸窠，榮華有凖。若見財星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147427848227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"得所，發積成家。倘或刑星當前，尅傷喪命。遇子旺宫多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"顯發，子衝煞處必英雄。子可順於財星，財莫傷於母曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"興財享福，印旺滋元。反禍為祥，用强制鬼。刑星有制，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"逢我盛他衰。元若居財，切忌財星受死。本宫正旺。母受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"刑生榮有日，元如虚弱無逢子掘發無因，清談守株。子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"居母局，性貪薄藝。母入財鄉，元局故怕受傷，元星亦嫌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"受尅。元居鬼局，破耗非輕。子入元方，艱辛有救。謀利失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"本。生局逢刑，好事多磨。妻宫制母。元莫傷於財曜，子可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914306060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"逺於母星。衝鬼須當子在先，援母必當鬼在後。為禍須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"逢死絶，為福切忌休囚。妻來入母，父道先亡。母若遇財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"坤宫早逝。呻吟庶出。母入兒胎，衾枕孤單。妻宫夀局，尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"傷離祖。鬼局逢刑，破害臨身。妻宫逢鬼。母入刑宫情斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，子居鬼煞繼無親。子居子局，怕逢死絶之鄊。妻入妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，切忌休囚之地。妻居印局，怙恃乖離。子入夀鄊，女男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"昌盛。子星受制，寄養偏生。妻曜居生，因妻致富。母居夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"局，棣蕚聨芳。鬼入元宫，雁行分序。子入子無傷，則男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147159363595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"成行。財遇財有尅，則夫妻反目。兒鄉有尅，當尋妻曜長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"生。妻局受傷，須要子星帝旺。母星入制，孤尅散離。夀曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"居財，慳貪喪失。五行相尅，便知先者受傷。兩曜相生，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"是後來泄氣。先詳體用，次察尊卑，一舉纔通，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"一太陽者，午為正宫，星為正垣，乃太陽為主也。如房日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"火也，虚日土也，昴日金也，皆有所屬，乃日之次舍。若正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342141492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"月酉時，四月午時，十月子時，立命在午，日在正垣，亦謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"日居日分升殿也。却不喜居於心、危、畢、張，則為日入月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，陰陽反背，偏生庶出之人也。日為君主，則有金水之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"佐，金乃官星，水為福元，前引後從，太陽不宜獨行，無輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"皆貧薄之人。未、申、酉、戌、亥時生於他宫見太陽亦宜有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"輔，皆可取也，無輔皆貧薄之人也。正月酉時生人，太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"在子，謂之移乾就濕。二月申時生人，主入疾厄，木炁强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"者多主疾病。命書云孤陽射破三方煞，又曰水化伏尸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634376758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"遇太陽，豈為惡曜？乃太陽能救諸宫凶煞，不特戌上見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"水得日可救，他宫五怒得日皆可救也。此宫最忌者，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"炁也，以日為君。火、羅、計、孛雖凶曜也，然臣也，豈敢犯上？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"惟木為難星，疾厄雖至貴者不能免。若太陽飛去，與木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"同度，重則夭折，輕則貧病。木在亥為煞難入垣，在子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"難當頭，在寅戌傍臨在卯加入命皆為不足。炁乃木餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"與木同凶。木炁者，樹木蔭翳之𧰼，能蔽日光。其次忌日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"火同行，二曜朝陽，嫌處離明之地。二曜，火羅也。他宫立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147159412747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"命，見火日同行，多早喪父，多敗祖業。日者，祖父也，火者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"自已也，以已與祖父敵，不貧亦夭矣。故凡四五月生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"日在申酉者，不利父母，蓋申酉為日沒之鄉也。惟行限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"喜太陽，煞星近太陽，皆能反凶成吉，四正互加之宫，宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"詳酌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":9,"content":"五太陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"五太陰者，以未宫鬼度為太陰正垣，乃午與未合，日與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"月配也。其次則心危畢張，謂之偏垣，為五太陰也。日為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235542043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫，論生尅之妙者，以月所泊，詳其傍鬼傍母。五星中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"以月最重，若更立命在五太陰者，尤為利害，蓋身宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"宫度主俱從焉，吉則俱吉，凶則俱凶，其可忽乎？五太陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"中以張月鹿為第一宫，何則？未與午合，取日為逺，張鄰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"於星，取日為近，午為一陰始生，月喜居之。次則危對虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"日，心畢皆與日度相連，月非日則無光也。若命度張月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"加以近望，夜生之人皆大富貴，一生無憂。夜生而在他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"宫立命，月躔張者，主一身安享。命在張月，在畢危心，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167488909349"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"四月度立命，月亦在四月度者，皆可起家發跡成立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"最喜金水孛會金為金助，月華㑹水為水涵，蟾魄㑹孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"為太乙抱蟾，皆為貴格。惟女人獨喜一金星伴月，遇水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"孛近身，皆無貞烈。故日生喜太陽，不可獨見；夜生喜太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"陰，却喜獨見。中旬三五之月，最為圓浄。詩云：殘星伴月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"落邊城，月到中天分外明。滿天諸宿皆沉沒，只有團團","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"月照人。又詩云：五更旦氣十分清，斗落參横日未昇。相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"隨寶月上河漢，惟有長庚伴月明。丑寅時生人，金月相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602610728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"隨，皆主文章明了，却不宜木為命度主也。太陰經云：已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"申二命，惟怕月在土宫土宿之中，其餘夜生而遇火羅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之火月齊明。遇木炁而福禄有用，亦吉。木炁强則土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"計衰，土計盛則月必晦。五太陰中有危月到天門，乾有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"金生質厚。歴試人命，有子上危度命者，遇土計則凶。十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"三度在亥命度者，行土計多茍免，此玄之又𤣥者也。獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼度命，其人必詭譎多謀詐，故太乙謂月孛南方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"蓄蠱，乃太陰之精，如此豈曰陰柔乎？此星若正得其光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453148275081226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"明之時，為人相貌堂堂，肌膚皎然。但鬼月遇火，不謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"火月齊明，於金有梗，見土却不曰土生金，乃反害月焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"論者不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":439,"lineType":9,"content":"六木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"尾室火度，實寅亥之正垣，故見水孛則大發。其次有井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"木度者，多於二十八宿。木入秦殿秦州度栁者減力太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"半，次則斗二十三度，次奎有十八度，又角有十三度。井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"以末二度隣於鬼，合還太陰正垣。斗以末度隣於牛，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235591195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"作丑土。奎以末度隣於婁，合作戌火。角末隣於亢，合作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"辰金。此四木惟角木弱，况是金垣，木必衰弱。木在午，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"午限，午為三河之地，其地多風，又為木入離宫，化成灰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"多主夭折。木在巳，已為㢲風動，又屬水，能生木。室尾二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"度見風稍輕。深忌火羅，火能焚木羅為奴犯主。亥上立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"命限行火羅多死。只喜水孛獨行，或金入水鄊，金水同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"行同度為上吉。蓋煞無餘氣，木命得之多富貴，金水加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"合有力，皆為可喜。如金月同宫，不謂之金助月華，若是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162103570469"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"生於冬月及壬癸年，更得天元月令助之為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":9,"content":"六土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
