{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"六土者，虚牛為子丑正垣，次則女、氐胃栁為偏垣。如女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"土近虚，得子正位，子為帝旺之地。氐土近房，亦居明堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"出政之宫。立命於此，得火能發大福，為官必至𡖖相，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"小小也。惟胃土居酉土敗之地，天盤又為反吟局，人多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"不足，若得火羅，十分為上，有木炁往來，必然困厄。至於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"牛金之土，惟喜一火一羅獨行，若限見火羅作黨，則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167488942117"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"吉也。他土亦然。謂二母爭權，遇水孛同行，土亦崩，甚不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"可謂土尅水為財也。最怕木炁當權，得時破局入垣為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"大凶。亦不可在四木度中，謂之失次之土安身。與火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"同度同宫者，皆有福之人。制化加合之妙，又在善詳推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":9,"content":"六水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"六水者，翼觜雖火，皆水正垣論度者皆以二宫見孛，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"水尅火，不知水星行限怕逢孛，為奴犯主也。此二宫安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147847196687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"命多易看，蓋巳申忌土計，其説多騐。巳之張、翼、軫，申之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"畢、觜、參，皆水也，怕見土計，獨有井九度屬木。人之論命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"毎易於此宫。次則辰有軫，八度水。亥有壁，寅有箕，壁水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"生於乾，亥金混水。軫亦生於辰之金，見土計稍輕。惟箕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"水生於艮山䝉泉之地，受質稍薄，一見土計，不破則夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"故寅宫之水，金星得地，為大利主持之命惟喜金水同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"行，或金水互垣亦好。此宫深喜太陰與金同為金助月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"華，深忌月與土計同宫，為安身傍鬼。以行限而言，卯辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147159347211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午四位不可見土無金，行限次第逢之，卯有土，十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗中凶，辰有土，二十五前凶，乃無中有曜。若見金入水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，水居金位，皆是竒特。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":9,"content":"二火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"二火者，七政所躔各有四，而火全不與，何則？尾寅室亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"屬木，而觜翼屬水矣。火之所居，不宜多有，若火之多如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"水，土木隨寓而有，則火性炎而有焚燒之患。故火之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"垣惟卯戌二位，戌為火庫，卯與戌合。卯火居房日之下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914387980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"以燧取火於日也。戌火藏於婁金鼎鍋之下，以金擊石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"乃有火也。喜木炁為上躔，在四木之度為吉，四水度為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。孛與水同，二位之火最怕水居亥子之地，謂之水滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"江湖，火必微滅，何則？水在亥卯宫三合見之，水在子卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"宫加臨之。戌上安命，十五後見亥限，有水破我相貌，二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"十五後行子限，見之破我家福徳，年少逢之多貧夭。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"喜水木在天盤卯辰之間，木在子，不謂之木打寶瓶，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"木在子巳加子戌宫，二十五以後逢之皆吉。此宫喜木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634458678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"月同行，不喜水月同，學者宜詳之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":9,"content":"二金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"二金者，金度有四，而牛婁鬼各有所屬，獨有亢為正垣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"曰龍者，變化不測之物，天為凶器，若動用不可度也。次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"則酉宫金旺，辰與酉合為金，喜土計而畏火羅，此二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"命土計近月，不為土犯太陰，為安身傍母，乃富貴之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。辰上立命，行限至午，見火羅多死。午為火旺之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"又為金敗之鄉，限行多凶。惟酉金遇火為災，遇羅為有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835703315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"救。蓋酉反吟之局，羅㬋在戌，計在辰，辰加戌，羅在亥，計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳，已加亥。羅㬋在子，計都在午，午加子，天盤有救解","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"也。酉上安命，却有土星在子，為福甚大，為官星，為命母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"入垣逢旺，加以祿主為天干月令有用之星，行子限必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"大富貴。如辰宫安命，遇土於午，稍弱於酉金矣。金主不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"宜坐於四火度中，宜在四土度也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":589,"lineType":9,"content":"日月並明說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"日之與月，其次舍在天相近，故在子午卯酉四正。子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171491890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"帝座，午為端門，卯為明堂，皆日月所居。酉為西沒之所，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"人生身命在此，皆富貴之人。安命在午，日在已，月在未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"為陰陽夾命。日月在男女遷移，夾拱有力，必權柄能卓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"立。日午、月子、日卯、月酉，皆富貴命也。月卯、日酉，皆賤命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"也。日居月度，月居日度，亦反背也。其人必庶生二母。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"生忌火，夜生忌土，亦當以標本論。詩曰：十二宫中不言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"主，强云晝火夜忌土。何以不忌水木金，是致五星皆莽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"鹵。行限若是見日月，妙不可言，或限中日月夾拱，皆致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835686931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"富。火羅犯日，土計犯月，皆損害六親。朔日蝕，望月蝕，命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"在日月度，不夭即盲啞之人。日月同在命宫，其人多貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"巳為陽極，月不宜居；亥為陰極，日不宜居。月已妨母，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"亥妨父。日月拱命，拱二主，皆貴；拱田財，必發；拱遷移，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"外發；拱妻子，必得賢妻子力；拱疾厄，必少疾病。以𩔖言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"之，百無一失。日為主躔木度，月為主躔土度，皆失也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":625,"lineType":9,"content":"太陰黄道說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":627,"lineType":10,"content":"太陰論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167488958501"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"夫命，取太陽安命，以明其體；取太陰為身，以明其用。論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"命則人之所可同，身則人所不可同。如命宫諸富貴格、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤格，與此身無相涉，皆所不論，必須與身有干係深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"重者，方是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":639,"lineType":9,"content":"太陰九行說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"月有九行，以黄道為經緯之主。青道二，出黄道東；赤道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"二，出黄道南；白道二，出黄道西；黑道二，出黄道北。四時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"更可隨黄道而𠮓遷。春，黄道始於東；夏，黄道始於南；秋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342157876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"黄道始於西；冬，黄道始於北。其日南陸、北陸，又是隨天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"道而旋也。以九道捷法推之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":653,"lineType":9,"content":"四時太陰所經之度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"立春　木；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"黄道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"火；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"青白道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"土；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"黑道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"金；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"赤道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"水；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"白道月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"立夏，　火、　　土、　　金、　　水、　　木；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"立秋　金、　　水、　　木、　　火、　　土；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬　水、　　木、　　火、　　土、　　金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"以上五行，係月所經由之度，以此推其黄黑道，如太陽則從火，月度則從水。論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634524214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"論命以日月為身所係。考九道晦明，如人身生世而稟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"賦厚薄，道行所屬而為吉凶。黄道內得五星之吉為福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"土、計、孛、羅為減力。蓋四餘暗道之曜，非黄道所可見也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"見則必掩晦。黑道正四餘得志之所，又非五星所可從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"黄道為人聰明，清和粹美，春風和氣，灑落通𠮓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"赤道太陽光輝之所，為人多權畧，任勢敢為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"青白道多清潔，有風節廉操，進退以禮。大抵青白道為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453147847278607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"孤髙之所，若更命局，與當生孤刑煞局，無禄貴駕殿者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"必孤尅更空亡刄碎交横，必是僧道，有吉局，亦為貴中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"孤命。黑道雖富貴人，諸吉局亦必自艱難中起。黄道雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，亦可為吉。但怕黄道遇掩晦，是月行于天而片雲蔽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"之，蓋以其昏晦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"黑道愚而好自用，賤而好自専，心髙無實，志大無成之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"人，大抵専繫於九道之內，次叅得何星之用，如妻星主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"內助而起，亦由內親而成，功名田宅，主得父母力，財得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634475062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"財，官主貴，更叅諸局無失矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":705,"lineType":9,"content":"論太陰之說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"假如太陰度婁，婁，金也，當以金星論。如金星得垣占髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"强，有夾拱，與祿貴駕殿相係，更見土來生之吉，立命在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，人必有貴。如金星失躔，為他星所斷，或截其脉，不與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴駕殿相係，却與陽刄的煞相干，此又下賤矣。如金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"星失道，太陰得夾拱，或見黄道所喜之星，祿馬殿駕，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"人相涉，亦為吉命。如金在辰，升殿當官祿，或火在申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719579683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，當令或難直，此不可以身主居官斷也。蓋受火之欺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"為令所役，為官所驅，何福之有？若更有土與火之脉相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"貫串，此又轉凶為吉之道。蓋火欲傷金，見土則反去生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"土，土又生金矣。挽回一團福氣，全在土上，却看土是何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，主妻得妻力，男得男女力，官則貴，福則富。土為持重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"之星，有培植之功，為人亦有持久之福。若為火所燥，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"土挽回凶焰，為人多受漂忽震蕩之禍，得吉尤凶也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"金見水，却看水是何宫，主，田妻男吉，官福尤髙，是身得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171508274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"此福。若主無用之星，奴僕兄弟無益於我，精神氣脉為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"彼所竊，平生為人無力，以小失大，如金見木為財，看是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"何宫主，妻得妻財，奴得奴用之𩔖，活法推之，無不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":745,"lineType":9,"content":"太陰引從夾拱之辯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"引從夾拱，當辯其孰吉孰凶。如月度婁，前三十度內有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星為引，後三十度内有吉星為從。引以逺者為吉，從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"以近者為吉。前後夾拱匀停，不論何星多寡，皆為引從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"夾拱，但看協和爭鬬如何耳。前引後從，又要求太陰之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719645219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"前，不拘多少，近前一星以之為主。若前面之星與所主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"之星皆相生，無戰尅非貴即富，有戰尅不純粹矣。若所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"主之星與日月有傷，此為下賤。若日與官禄貴殿駕職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"元無非富貴。前後擁從匀停，所主之星與月相得，前面","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星不相戰爭，只要不傷月前主星，不碍其為名利。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"三合釣來，亦如此論。但當明剖合道望道之說，在月前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"為緊，富貴皆特力為之，不藉他人。合道望道必因人而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"成，此二項望道尚可成功名，合道非仰他人則不可。貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171524658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"格亦是蔭官，拱夾中亦有禍福，如夾吉則吉，拱凶則凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"又在詳推之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":779,"lineType":9,"content":"一太陰前犯殿傷宿之說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"犯殿者，如主弱下凌，恃其權而犯殿。傷宿者，上剛下暴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"各恃其力。如太陰度胃，而羅計占昴畢二宿，昴畢日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"也，天之日月，人之君后，羅計乃黑道狂暴之星，犯其日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"月，身前有此凶星，安得不凶？傷宿者，如太陰在胃，立命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"在子丑，木星在月前，身命皆係乎土木，將來傷之，退度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171557426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"尤凶，主為人獷狼愚執，更若當陽刄刼煞之𩔖，必是凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"惡之徒，當受刑法，否則夭折。又有此格而富貴者，乃坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬貴垣，殿駕廟旺，日月聨格，有以伏凶星之勢，雖犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"殿不妨也。推者宜加詳審，不可以一槩論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":801,"lineType":9,"content":"太陰讓殿之説","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"讓殿者，如人不臨正室而在别處，所讓之殿有吉則福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"有凶則禍。如太陰度柳星二度之間，諸星在翼軫之𩔖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"獨讓張宿在中。或月度翼，諸星在栁星，亦是前為緊，後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719694371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"為緩，當禄貴殿駕為富貴，中間更有金水各一星在張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"宿，謂之一星朝后，謂之留守護垣，此至吉也。若讓殿有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"土計羅孛之𩔖，不謂朝后，謂讓殿受欺，此凶格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":817,"lineType":9,"content":"太陰出垣入垣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計界出太陰若登殿駕，祿貴者吉，居煞者凶。月乃柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"星，有晦朔弦望，全籍諸星輔之。日生宜木水炁，日夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"宜金孛計火羅，在太陰之前後見最怕陰陽反背，諸星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"失志。太陰前有吉星相近，禄貴後惡星趕趂尤急。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719677987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":829,"lineType":9,"content":"太隂倒限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"子上危月度立命限，行至卯尾一二度，本宫對合，皆無星，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然死者，蓋日月晦明不同危月也。至卯日出之所，正入剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之地，是謂有他無我，𠔥以太陽惡弱，倒限無疑。又如午上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"日星度立命限，至酉畢度，本宫無星，而忽然死者，蓋星為日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"日至酉，酉為月出之地，亦有他無我𠔥太隂惡弱，倒限無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":841,"lineType":9,"content":"二百字真經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"四正宫神暗加管攝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171541042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"四正者，舉一而三者相貫串也。如子、午、卯、酉、寅、申、巳、亥、辰、戌、丑、未是也。人多以三合論，而不知四正生尅為急。如木在子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":849,"lineType":2,"content":"卯、酉，有金暗受傷尅；如水在申、已、亥，有土亦暗受傷尅；如金在丑、辰、戌，有火亦然。餘倣推之，可知根本之强弱矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"天元得地，有用者昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":853,"lineType":2,"content":"夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":853,"lineType":2,"content":"元者，甲乙年是也，為科甲。若又為命主，官禄福權之星，居髙强，得水為助，必富貴，如受傷害，必貧困矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"月令當權，乘氣之旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":857,"lineType":2,"content":"月令者，寅卯月木是也。如春以木為令，又以為身命主，及官魁福禄之𩔖，乘旺得水助之，為富貴之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"正垣氣旺，傍我無權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":861,"lineType":2,"content":"正坦者，七政各居十二宫，為正垣。吾甞謂言宫不知度，言度不知宫，人多不知此處𤣥妙。如土旺在子，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171573810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"為正垣之所，危之近虚，濱土之水，淺水之下，皆近岸濕土，自危一至危五，皆土也。次則斗二十一起合，還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"土度辰宫。角十　一十二合，還亢午；張　一至三度合，還星未；井二十九，　三十合，還鬼戌宫。奎十七，十八合，還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"婁。此皆歴驗，非億度也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"界限分明，彼木此火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"此八字以寅卯界限之説言之。蓋尾三度屬卯火為主，餘度屬寅木為主，若以寅尾為火，則誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"主居退留，餘曜難救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"觀星以遲留順逆為最急，主星尤闗利害。入順度，則平生作事順快有福；如入退留，一生作事進寸退尺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"𠔥為人不剛果，流於慈懦者有矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835736083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"母居退留，為福不力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"生我者為母，如入退留，則是欲生我而不力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"母星無生，何暇顧子？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"如以火為主，羅為奴，木為母，若木不生火，反生餘奴之羅，或乙丁人又為刑囚，是我父母有用之氣，反黨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"餘奴刑囚之輩，何暇顧我生我而為福哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"母尅於用，福力潛消。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"如土為主，火為母，若火不來生土，却與金同行，則所恃之母氣及與金相戰，縱有力以及火，子亦少減矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"敵强難攻，用力有損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634491446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":901,"lineType":2,"content":"書云：相刑相戰，則處世多迍，相順相和，則終身安静。人多以我尅者為財，言之則謬者多矣。若以金為主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":903,"lineType":2,"content":"限見木炁，木為主限遇土計之𩔖，二星作黨者，强敵也。見之重則刑囚，輕則貧病，必然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"兩母爭權，姑息太過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"如土為主限，見火或羅，則發福。如火羅同會，若吉而實凶。葢母與餘奴方爭權未息，縱能愛子，亦無力矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽當空，羣曜潛伏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽者，君也。如七八月巳午時生，安命在卯。如躔房宿，火為主將，後行巳午限見日。如或金水木土與日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":913,"lineType":2,"content":"同宫，為科名科甲、官魁福禄，遇太陽必伏，諸星必無光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"月兔無光，晦朔𠋣日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719661603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"人命生於晦朔，命在月度，此時月與日同會。若日月前後有吉星必吉，凶星必凶。設若日近火羅土計者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"凶，日近金水木者，吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"河漢艮坤，為士必秀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"河漢者，天文也。秀士者，人文也。河漢始於丑寅，尾於未申，如人命在此宫者，必為秀士丈人，次則戌奎亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"煞尅於奴，本主自旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"如人行險阻而遇賊，必先將奴僕殺傷，而本主得免也。如木為主，金為煞，金不尅木，而與炁同行，是與炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"相敵，而力不及木矣。而本上之木得自旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"餘奴犯主，縱吉為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235656731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"如木為星，炁為奴，木主與炁同，非享福發財之命，甚則早夭。若生年帶煞，十　凶　八九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"限遇煞奴，十難一免。　奴星敵煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"如木為主，金為煞，炁為奴，限行見金煞，又遇炁奴三合，無水火救之，十難免　一。又云如金見火為煞，限行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":943,"lineType":2,"content":"不見火見羅為煞之奴星，亦不免也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"母無餘氣，藉木解讐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":947,"lineType":2,"content":"此言巳申與箕壁之水宿，以金為母，金無餘氣，得木氣居於强宫，以尅制土計之仇，謂之子能敵鬼，與母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"力一同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無餘氣，逢火灰燼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235673115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":955,"lineType":2,"content":"此言木為主星，金為煞而無餘氣。若行火羅，亦能焚燒山林，毒於金煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"正煞暗生，轉禍為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":959,"lineType":2,"content":"正者正盤，暗者加盤。天機禍福，多在加盤。如子上立命，以土為主，行限寅，見木為煞。如是暗盤，已上有火在焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":961,"lineType":2,"content":"木生火，火生土，為暗救有力。又如戌上立命奎度，行子限見金，如已上有水，暗中有救，必能轉禍為福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"正生暗煞，化吉成凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":965,"lineType":2,"content":"如子上立命，土為主，行寅限見火而生。若已工有水孛傷火，乃暗中受傷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"朔望食神，陰陽非利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":969,"lineType":2,"content":"日食朔，月食望。如日正食之時，而人生在四日度，日既食而無光，此命豈能有福？如望夜之時，而人生在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914420748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":973,"lineType":2,"content":"月度中，立命亦然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"界限中安，離家遷祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":977,"lineType":2,"content":"所謂界限者，天文本無界限，而人有之，如軫十氐　二之𩔖。立命於此者，多出祖過房，依於人，否則不佳。祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"屋遷移不定。若諸星多在過宫上，亦主不安也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"上盤下局，加合參商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":983,"lineType":2,"content":"命書所謂天宫地位，十二辰消息其中全看行度，則於加合之中，宜細推詳，有加著加不著，宜觀太陽過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"度。二盤尅合。子午卯酉之正，各於上下二盤寫　一星，然後以　一星加合，則上盤下局之星加合，瞭然可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":987,"lineType":2,"content":"生我尅我，在與不在，合與不合，宜詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453137235689499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"釣合衝臨，分擘闊狹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":993,"lineType":2,"content":"此即同宫千里，異宫尺寸之説。所謂釣合者，申子辰之𩔖；衝臨者，子午卯酉對衝之𩔖。如立命在子，火在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":995,"lineType":2,"content":"午吉，木在午凶。萬一命在女四五之間，木在張十　二三之間，照命度不及，豈能為災？若木在栁七八度正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":997,"lineType":2,"content":"照，則為禍必矣。餘星闊狹，亦宜分擘筭之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":999,"lineType":9,"content":"二十八條斷例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"四正宫神，互相管攝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1003,"lineType":2,"content":"四正者，如日之虚、房、星、昴，木之角、斗、井、奎之𩔖，互相管攝。凡看星辰，先看主星落何方，有何生尅制化。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1005,"lineType":2,"content":"論凶吉，合依星辰而斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914437132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"同宫千里，異宫寸尺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1011,"lineType":2,"content":"且如子上立命，女三至危十，雖是同垣，何止千里。若危十一，危十二，子工立命，視亥上危十三、　十四，有尺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1013,"lineType":2,"content":"寸之隔，此何可以異宫論也，他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"二母爭權，姑息太過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1017,"lineType":2,"content":"如木星見水孛，或臨本宫，三合獨見方為福。若同見二母爭權反為禍，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"一星得地，初無二用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1021,"lineType":2,"content":"或土宫立命，或命主土星在别處三合見火生本吉。設若三合火見金，火性炎上，便去尅金，却不能生　土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1023,"lineType":2,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835768851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相戰，其勢俱敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1029,"lineType":2,"content":"如水命火同在命，或三合，或十五度之内相照，雖火受水尅，火亦不寧，其勢俱敗，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"日月爭權，到底無光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1033,"lineType":2,"content":"如日為命主，夜生本無光，或與月同宫，或見三合，月為命主，日生本無光，或日同宫，或合照，是自爭權，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1035,"lineType":2,"content":"成於福氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"禄嫌衝破，衣食艱難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1039,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲坐人，禄在寅，立命在申，禄當頭，為命衝破，終是艱難。奔走限逢之亦然。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"馬忌空亡，衣食奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914453516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1045,"lineType":2,"content":"如巳。巳生人，馬在亥，行限至此，或命身值此，更加以凶星守照，必生受。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"母主無權，福氣不大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1049,"lineType":2,"content":"如命在子，土為主，限行遇火，或三合，為水字所傷，其母受尅，子必無力，福氣不大。他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"向前得力，再後無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1053,"lineType":2,"content":"如命在亥，木為主，行子限三合，見　一水單行，必能𤼵福。若人行限到辰，再見水孛，必無再發之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"若是無形，終難制有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1057,"lineType":2,"content":"五星乃有形，餘氣無形。五星相尅，此理甚明。如炁近上，孛近火，乃餘氣侵有形，其力終緩。或戌上立命，命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1059,"lineType":2,"content":"主火，星在子，金水同宫，辰上雖有氣，亦難化水生火之理。况子宫水旺之地，其火受尅不淺。以此合言夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835785235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1063,"lineType":2,"content":"命。他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"黨惡則亂，制惡不行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1067,"lineType":2,"content":"如木命，行限遇金，木自受尅，加土計臨三合助威，為煞氣重。若同火羅，則制其金惡不行矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"獨陽不生，孤陰不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1071,"lineType":2,"content":"若男人命遇太陽居四正，為得地，左右無吉星，三合又無，為獨陽不生。女命遇太陰居七强，亦得經入廟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1073,"lineType":2,"content":"三合皆無吉助，為獨陰不成。為事多尅戰無成。男命看四正，女命看七强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚入陷，縱惡難施。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1077,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲生人，命在戍，火為主，水化刑，本能尅我，三合有土計制之，或水入陷地，彼受制之不暇，豈能施惡於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719710755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1081,"lineType":2,"content":"我哉？或土計自陷，又恐不能制水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"暗耗雖强，逢生反益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1085,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲生人，命在酉，金主化耗，限逢土計，不以為耗。又如乙生人，命在亥，木為主，化暗得宫，有水孛生之，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1087,"lineType":2,"content":"暗反明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"四正日月，最怕西沉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"如子午卯酉四正之地，為日月之垣，獨酉為西沉之地。若　日月居其上，終無顯達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"三方禄馬，最喜拱照。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1095,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙生已酉，丑之人，命在未，馬在亥，禄在卯，三合拱照，一生衣禄不少。此論地元禄馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719743523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"安身，傍母福祿尤佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"如土為命主，火為土母，月火同宫，不以傷身論。又如命在辰，金為主，土為母，身與土同行，不以蝕月論，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1103,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴格局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"奴賊臨身，妻兒必尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1107,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅亥。木為主，炁為奴星。若炁與月同行，或傍其人，必孤。又如子丑。土為主，計為奴。若計與月同行，或傍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1109,"lineType":2,"content":"其人，必受刑傷。不然必夭。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"主數遇陷，有救不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1113,"lineType":2,"content":"如木命人，木陷于子，或入金宫化刑囚，或值命限到此，本受尅，縁三合有水孛，能觧金厄，轉凶作吉。但未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342190644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1117,"lineType":2,"content":"免勞心耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"母若當權，為福莫大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1121,"lineType":2,"content":"如子上立命，土為命主，以寅卯為福官之地。若有一火羅獨守在上，是母當權，大吉。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"同室操戈，必遭禍𠮓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1125,"lineType":2,"content":"如立命在子，不問主星客星，但有水火同垣，金木同位，雖彼自相戰尅，與命宫不相干，終是窘我室廬，禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1127,"lineType":2,"content":"起蕭墻之内也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"飛星破駕，終是廢人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1131,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論命，必殿駕為先。假如甲辰生嵗，駕在辰，金為駕主。辰酉立命，金為命主。若有火羅飛入辰宫，乃為害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914469900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1135,"lineType":2,"content":"曜破駕，必賤人也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞抗衝，威烈以怒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1139,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬子生人，命在已，乃的煞之地。更有刑、土、刃星居其上，是謂煞見煞，行限必夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"三元並駕，禄又加官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1143,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子生人，禄馬俱在寅。甲生人，人以木為天元，是木為三元。若臨身，命必顯逹。子丑午未命凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"相順相生，當觀向背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1147,"lineType":2,"content":"如立命戌，火主入丑宫，躔斗九度，又有木躔斗十，此謂之向，𤼵福必大。若火斗十，木躔斗九，謂之背，雖發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1149,"lineType":2,"content":"亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171639346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"相順相尅，須驗實虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1155,"lineType":2,"content":"如命在巳，水在申，躔參。有土在辰，躔角，彼自受制，安能尅我？若有木炁臨照，彼虚我實矣。土若躔氐史，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1157,"lineType":2,"content":"火羅合照助其實，是彼實我虚矣。行限至此，必夭。若其間有金照臨，又能生我之水，反凶成吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"原守推詳，流年尤急。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1161,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：原守雖然無咎，流年尤怕為災。此二句不可忽之。且如火為命行年，水星到命限，焉得不為禍？占煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1163,"lineType":2,"content":"尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1165,"lineType":9,"content":"步天經序","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡論五星，先以本主為重。然本主强弱，闗係輕重，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171622962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"命母厚薄，亦闗係輕重。命母固有闗係，而身宫尤為切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"要。命本既弱，身主有失，雖命母不能以救，其為夭折必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。命主之弱，身宫之陷，得命母之力以救之，却能易危","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"為安。玄齋所謂論命主須論身宫，又當論命母，三主不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"陷不弱，其為富貴格局明矣。其次，則論福徳官禄，福氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"重則享福必厚，官氣重則名位必髙。又其次，則論尅我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"之星，他强我必弱，他弱我必强，彼既伏降，我方得以施","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"其志耳。他若强梁負固，必能為我之敵，我自受制之不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719727139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"暇，何暇為人福哉？蓋三方四正，當看拱夾之何如，然三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"方四正又不可以一槩論。若論三方，又論四正，不無泛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"雜。蓋子午卯酉生人，於子午卯酉上安命，便當以四正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"為重，三合為輕，所謂太嵗宫神互相管攝是也。或者又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：四正無星，便觀三合，三合無星便觀四正，亦是一說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"設若生於子午卯酉，坐命於寅申已亥、辰戌、丑未，又以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"三合拱夾叅看，不必専論四正也。十二宫中皆効此例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"玄齋曰：專以宫主斷人之禍福，則二十八宿躔度不必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835801619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"論，又何謬乎？蓋二十八宿，天經也，金木水火土，五星也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘乃地緯也，常相脉絡，互相往來，二十八宿實於五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"星有所闗係。且如子丑宫乃土之位，子宫有虚日危月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"又是一家之閫奥，如隔界又是一家藩籬也。吾家所主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"却以土為主宰，焉得不以宫主為重，度主為輕，所主却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"論度，以此觀之，萬無一失。蓋五星之中，木怕炁，火怕羅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"水忌孛，土忌計，此理甚明。如子宫安命，所怕者木，假如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"行限到木，便觀木起何宫，躔何宿，若受制坐陷，皆不足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167488991269"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"慮。若居生旺之地，豈不為我撓？不待三方四正照著，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"為禍患。如或拱夾臨限，災愈重也。其餘皆効此例。十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"宫中，獨有午宫星日馬有五數，正是人君九五之位，安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"命於其上，主生平為人寡合，作事無氣，不能勝任大事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"若有凶星惡煞居之，皆不能施其凶惡。天下自古無臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"犯君之理也。如危月、張月、心月、畢月，乃后妃之殿，安身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"於此，必主聰明，膺富貴。又如安身安命於觜火，觜星天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"上無曜，不能安載其身，主人生平飄泊，無有定居。鬼有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163634540598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"二度，號為天眼，此上立身安命，多是奸雄冦盜之流。蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰吉單行，為福愈力，如是凶星惡煞，三方為黨，自相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"鬬戰，又不能為禍。若有一黨惡，其為禍莫大焉。大凡星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"辰在天，激之則變，如安於垣，安於駕，升於殿，其性雖惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"亦善耳，又不能為禍也。且如安命於子午、卯酉，乃四煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，桃花之位，男人安命於此，必能誇逞英雄，躭迷酒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"色。女人安命於此，過於伶俐，酷於貪淫。寅申巳亥為四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"馬之鄊，不問男女，皆不閑𨓜，多受艱苦。辰戌丑未乃為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052417078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"四庫，安命於此，處性晦迷，多是尅戰孤寡。故玄齋論有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"十忌：一忌破禄，二忌空亡，三忌太嵗當頭，四忌閑神入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"局，五忌飛星破駕，六忌客曜臨朝，七忌吉星背行，八忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"背宿入命，九忌女帶男星，十忌晝行夜曜。犯此十忌，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉星扶之，亦不能為吉。小兒闗煞，莫若三六九、十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"之煞為是。士夫功名，便以天馬運行為凖。男人無婦，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"縁身命坐孤神；婦人尅夫，大抵身命居寡宿。僧道格局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"多於華蓋安身；娼妓貪淫，並以冠帶安命。又如立身于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052433462"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"午未，分明以金水日為富貴；若背行於辰巳，雖有官亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"卑；若向於申酉，其為官必顯；若遷官轉職，又以天馬加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"流年而數之，若帝旺長生，必有遷轉，若休囚死絶，必罷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"職剥官。論其造化，其應如響。其流年禍福，看大小限有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"何星辰臨照，吉星臨之則吉，凶星臨之則凶。便以一太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗、二太陽加減而論，遇官符則必有官符，遇嵗破則必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"招破財。其餘十二煞神，推筭禍福，無不明驗。後之學者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"可以寶之。然其術也，源髓老人得之於玄齋，玄齋得之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052449846"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"海上異人，故以此為序，以為星家之衣鉢云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1299,"lineType":9,"content":"步天經警句","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中何所忌，加臨原守細推求。寶瓶最怕飛來木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁臨之不必憂。丑宫又喜金臨照，木炁分明是我仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"大喜火羅為福氣，若還水孛轉為仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1307,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：子宫怕木，却不怕炁。何為喜炁？以炁竊木之氣，是以木不為患。多有癸丑生子上安命，有炁化囚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"者，在命𤼵積。如丑宫喜金怕木炁，蓋金為官禄，以尅其木與炁之仇。况丑為金局，又與子宫不同。然其所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1311,"lineType":2,"content":"喜者火羅，所忌者水孛。盖火羅乃是吾家之命母，水孛乃吾家之賊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052466230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫亥宫皆屬木，惟有水孛能為福。逢金端的是焦枯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火亦能為惡毒。寅上火羅俱不怕，羅㬋能煮雙魚腹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"更嫌土計兩陸梁，設若侵垣多不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：二宫屬木，所喜者水孛，所忌者火羅金。此説誠然。蓋木有二説，亥上冬令之木，寅上春令之木。冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1323,"lineType":2,"content":"令木，火羅焚之，其勢衰敗。至於春旺之木，雖遇火羅，不能焚之，是所怕土計則一也。土計是吾家賊，焉得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1325,"lineType":2,"content":"不怕？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"卯戌二宫皆屬火，卯宫與戌不相同。卯宫不以羅為忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"戌上逢羅定是凶。最此兩宫喜木炁，但於水孛莫相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052482614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"火命若還逢木炁，必是當年運限通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1335,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：二宫皆屬火，喜木炁亦喜上所怕者水孛金也。金能黨賊為凶人，能制吾命母之木炁也。若羅則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1337,"lineType":2,"content":"二宫所怕者不同，戌上最怕羅，如在子丑之間化土，亦無妨害，寅亥逢之必夭折。卯宫之火却不忌羅，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1339,"lineType":2,"content":"火敗之地，反為救而不為慮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"辰酉二宫從太白，却於取用有差别。酉垣最忌水孛侵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛必能為我泄。辰宫又喜水孛逢，若遇火羅必消爍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"土計能為命母星，木炁閑神何所說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1347,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：辰酉二宫皆屬金，喜土計，但取用不同。金旺到酉，怕水孛泄其氣。辰宫水局，喜水孛滋潤相生，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052498998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1351,"lineType":2,"content":"火羅，喜土計，此兩宫功用皆然。若夫木炁，雖是財，亦能為命母之蠧，號為閑神忌曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"申已二宫皆屬水，申宫獨得水之清。西方專稟金之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"何怕當頭土計侵。最是巳宫憂土計，晝生尤怕火羅臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫之水皆防孛，若遇刑囚禍轉深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1359,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：申巳之宫皆屬水，申宫乃金臨官之地，怕上計輕。巳宫乃四月之水，怕土計重。二宫最怕者，孛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1361,"lineType":2,"content":"孛為水餘，能泄水氣。若夫已宫之水，忌者火羅，申宫之水，忌者木炁。火羅炎炎，能燥其水，木炁閑神，能泄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1363,"lineType":2,"content":"其水，所以忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子之宫有太陽，明知金水必為祥。至尊之地皆無忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052515382"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕當年木作殃。炁乃餘星何足畏，無形安得蔽其光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬行令俱零落，春夏之時乃受傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1373,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：太陽之位，不怕火羅計孛，最忌者木也。木乃八煞之主，能蔽日光。秋冬則枝枯葉落，春夏則葉茂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1375,"lineType":2,"content":"枝繁，却能遮蔽日光。紫炁乃木之餘宿，在天無象，焉能為害？多有癸丑生人炁在申，遇此限亦有𤼵者。縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1377,"lineType":2,"content":"不發，亦無大禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子分明怕木星，我之所喜水和金。申宫見木災重疊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"木到金牛禍不生。酉限當頭逢卯木，加臨照命却灾迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"金星入廟如生旺，限到金牛禄福臻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052531766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1387,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：此一段専言午宫安命。人最以木星為忌。行限至申，申上有木，必主重疊之災。至於酉限，是金為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1389,"lineType":2,"content":"管攝，若有木，木到大梁無忌，不能為灾於人。更看金在何處，如入廟生旺，必能𤼵財。若是木在卯，加合酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1391,"lineType":2,"content":"或三合四正照之，却生禍。碧玉經云：木到大梁畨作咎。是以木為主者言，非指午宫命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"未上分明是巨蟹，獨以大陰為主宰。喜逢木炁火羅星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"土計却能為蝕晦。躔在心張危畢地，夜裏生人尤可愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"土星若健木星弱，生平反覆多成敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1399,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：未上月為主，怕土計。若木炁强，何憂乎土計？木炁弱，土計强，未免成敗。若躔四月之地，其福於人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1401,"lineType":2,"content":"可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052548150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"命入寅宫多口舌，罵人罵鬼無分别。為人清秀更文章，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"身命因躔壁奎列。立命若居心與畢，止堪巫覡并才術。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"安命室火定為災，回禄多遭家業失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1411,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：寅乃喉舌之府，奎壁乃文章之宿。安命於寅，必多口舌，罵殺時人。若在奎壁，則為文章之士也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1413,"lineType":2,"content":"如心月狐、畢月烏，諸星中甚有靈性。立命二宿，主多才藝，堪作巫醫、卜筮、術數之人。若室火安身，則多回","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"禄之灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅星辰固易言，若言制化誠難取。申命不怕土居酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"酉命何怕子上火。酉宫有土土生金，子宫有火火生土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052564534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"縱不為福亦無凶。十二宫中皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"生尅制化，理之自然。且如申上安命，水為命主，所怕者土也。設使土居酉，此土能生酉金，金盛水强反吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1427,"lineType":2,"content":"若不為福，亦無禍及人。若土為忌在戌，却有火生土，以黨凶神，為害巳甚。餘倣此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"假如命在亥中居，却有金來窘室廬。三合加臨無救解，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"分明最喜炁之餘。奴星反與敵相抗，本主依然得自如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"更得木星强位立，福根反壯禍根除。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1435,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齊曰：亥之為命，木是主宰，最怕者金也。如有金星在命，或三方照，或行限臨之，却有紫炁合照加臨，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1437,"lineType":2,"content":"木之餘氣抗金之敵，木之本主却無傷也。如更木星入庫旺，必能轉禍而為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052580918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"日月雖為原守星，最嫌日月兩同行。日無晦朔皆明顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"月却無光借日明。若是晝生為福力，設逢夜誕斷無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"術家何可一概論，當以晨昏論重輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1447,"lineType":2,"content":"月本無光，借日之光。日無晦朔，一般光明。月有盈虧，難與同論。晝生之人，月借日光，多有權福。夜生之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1449,"lineType":2,"content":"日既無光，月安有輝？晝生月為命主，怕與日同。夜生日為命主，怕與月同。有此必廢人也。此指日月同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1451,"lineType":2,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"火忌羅㬋木忌炁，水怕孛兮土怕計。假如立命子丑宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁同行何足畏。木星只以炁為仇，那有工夫侵我位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052597302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"羅火單行誠可取，同行端的無生意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1461,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：土之為命，所怕者木炁也。若木炁三方臨照，或同躔共度，木炁自相仇耳，何暇為我仇哉？又如火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1463,"lineType":2,"content":"羅為命母，若單行則吉，同行却不能為福。二母爭權，姑息太過是也。餘依此例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
