{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"最是火羅為性決，若逢牽惹便能燃。土宫坐命限到卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"恩地官鄉喜兩全。更有火羅臨正合，驟然一發必滔天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢水孛來加會，夭折貧窮在少年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1471,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：火羅之為宿，與他宿不同，牽惹便能燃燒。子丑立命行卯，限火垣恩地，必能𤼵達。更有火羅三合、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1473,"lineType":2,"content":"四正臨之，必主大𤼵。如逢水孛，決是貧窮夭折，在少年見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052613686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"水星為性愛流東，限路循行最喜空。除是金星生則旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"閑神若阻不能通。月金若是三方照，為名為利若御風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"秋怕孛星春怕土，混居雜處必無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1483,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：水之為性，疎則決，窒則塞，此理然也。如以水為命，一路行限三方，見金見月，便有生意，其𤼵可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1485,"lineType":2,"content":"其餘火羅能燥水性，終是作事蹇滯。若春逢土，秋逢孛，亦為禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛從來最破官，單行作黨一般看。九流藝術為倫品，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"雜學多能不一般。若在長生多智識，若居死絶又艱難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"若還木炁臨身命，便作巫醫格局看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052630070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1495,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：孛星主巧，土星主多能，官禄乃官星之地。如有孛、土二星，或單行，或作黨，破我官禄，便是九流人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1497,"lineType":2,"content":"物，其人多學多能，加之木炁臨照，便是師巫造化。更加白虎胎神臨之，必罵神罵鬼，妄談禍福之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"日生専取日木土，夜生却以火金月。若是當年有用星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"以是發用皆無阻。設若閑神無用處，背時生旺皆為禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"却將晝夜細推詳，不宜拘泥三方主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1505,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：日生論日木土，夜生論火金月，此理明甚。假如土之為命，若是晝生遇火，是有用之星，必能為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1507,"lineType":2,"content":"夜生遇之，愈見光彩，不分晝夜，皆能為福。如是晝生金神當道，乃閑神，非惟泄氣，又能為禍。却不可以三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1509,"lineType":2,"content":"方主為拘泥。故曰：女人最忌男人曜，日裏須防夜裏星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052646454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"行限須防太嵗衝，不能破尅亦能凶。若還灾病重重見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"行限𠅘亭在此中。要免此災除是喜，喜神當道煞逢空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"若從太嵗上行限，災難無侵禍不逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1519,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：太嵗當頭立，諸神不敢當。太嵗之神，大可畏也。行限若衝太嵗，必見破，必見尅。若在中心對衝，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"為利害。自古道喜神壓煞，除是喜神可以壓煞也。設若太嵗上行限，又有喜神而無凶厄，術者不可不詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜未來先作吉，凶神過去始為凶。先前見了曾為福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"此後相逢定罔功。假若火人行水度，須看水起在何宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"若躔旺位興災害，死絶休囚方免凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052662838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1531,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：人之命，且如辰鄉，有吉星為福，主卯限末便有發用起來。至於行限，則是受用了。設有凶星在卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1533,"lineType":2,"content":"正在卯限，不能為禍。過卯交辰，方有餘殃。如子上安命，丑上見火、見羅，初年必發一段福力。至於辰巳二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1535,"lineType":2,"content":"限，三合四正，再見必無再𤼵之理。如水行過，不必重見。又如卯上安命，行軫水限，最以水為忌。如水生於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"申，旺於子，他得勢，我必衰微，受制宜矣。如或敗於酉，制於土局，彼自受制，豈暇為禍？初不待三方四正見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1539,"lineType":2,"content":"之，皆為禍福於人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神為煞最難當，煞地無星不必防。更有凶星來煞位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"相逢必定見災殃。閑神入煞何干預，吉曜臨垣始吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇空亡難著脚，斗鄉午位更無傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052679222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1549,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：申子辰生人刼煞，巳寅上安命最怕逢金，乃是金生在巳，逢此煞能為煞爾。若煞地無星，不須防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1551,"lineType":2,"content":"也。若是閑神居之，與我無干，亦不為禍。設若水孛居之，反為吉祥。如甲午生人，辰巳為空亡，縱有惡星居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1553,"lineType":2,"content":"上，亦無所施其惡。餘倣此。南斗之地，獅子之鄉，煞星自伏，何暇殺人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"隔角星辰相照應，往來經緯可㕘儔。本宫原守當研究，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"莫把加盤探隠幽。天地人盤多錯亂，恰如樓上駕髙樓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"若還無曜當加合，既有星辰莫逺求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1561,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：天地盤加合，不必過而求之。如本宫既有星辰，三方四正可以叅詳。如本宫無星辰，便當加天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":1563,"lineType":2,"content":"盤以驗吉凶。最是十二宫，隔角上不同，三方四正俱照得著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052695606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉為四煞，喚作闌干併貫索。子行卯限定遭灾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"午命到酉難著脚。行限若教逢惡曜，人離財散家消鑠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"此闗喚作鬼門闗，十有九人難過脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1573,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：子午卯酉，乃黄泉之門，亦是貫索闌干之煞。如子上安命，卯末端的　一闗；午上立命，酉末端的　一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1575,"lineType":2,"content":"闗。及有凶神惡煞臨之，其死無疑。如無凶神惡煞，亦難迯一險。十試九驗，有如影響。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"主星若是朝君位，定是當朝作貴臣。設若母星依日月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"必能大富潤其身。崇勲嵗駕相闗攝，日月朝之定出倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"若是凶神侵禄駕，陰陽相拱反為迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052711990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1585,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：假如亥上安命，木為命主。若木起朝君，居前為引，居後為從，似此必是朝貴之命。更兼水孛强健，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1587,"lineType":2,"content":"便以貴命論。若是水孛依日月，却不能貴，是為大富。造化或有陰陽拱禄，必致富，拱駕必致貴。如拱忌難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1589,"lineType":2,"content":"星，必見破敗，其命徒然，得貴人敬重，不得貴人之力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"若論功名何所據，甲人端的將金取。先看官禄次臨官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"又看此宫星所制。為官蹭蹬老無成，第十宫中逢難火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"爵星若陷印星制，懦弱無權椎且魯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1597,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：多有人以科名、科甲、魁星、官䘵定人之前程，不亦難乎？假如甲人以金為官星，金星受制於火，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1599,"lineType":2,"content":"是官職，未免蹭蹬無成。若使官星髙强，爵星、印星弱陷，是為人真閑懦耳。官星為上，禄星次之，其餘不必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052728374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1603,"lineType":2,"content":"論。餘依此斷，無不明也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"官當遷轉論官星，財主尊隆定富人。財若壓官官不顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"資財必重決名輕。官星若把財星尅，縱合為官徹底清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"兩主相生俱壯健，必膺富貴一般榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1611,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：為官必看官禄主，論財須論財帛星。財星尅官星宜致富，官星尅財星，為官清要財官比和無相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1613,"lineType":2,"content":"尅戰，是兩全造化。富貴命也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"安身安命如向貴，職掌文書為吏輩。命身若在貴人邊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"職在堦墀無坐位。若是刑囚破貴元，為胥不了終編配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052744758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"貴星生我我星强，出入貴人終見愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1623,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：如人身命坐貴，能為貴人。如向貴近貴，是曹吏造化，此最有理。如丙子生人，申上安命，水為命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1625,"lineType":2,"content":"出門逢酉上之貴，酉上或三合逢金，貴人必然敬重。六丁生人，以孛羅為刑囚破貴，如在酉上，必為編配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1627,"lineType":2,"content":"蟲蛆之人，行限逢之，必然不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1629,"lineType":1,"content":"有甚星辰能致富，不論田財先論庫。水人端的在辰宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"破奪侵欺財不聚。財帛宫神不必論，若還木命須觀土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"生成旺相必興財，若陷刑囚拘不住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1635,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：水為命庫在辰，最怕凶神破庫，又怕金星泄庫。所怕者，金氣也。餘宿侵庫者，紫炁也。有此星辰在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052761142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1639,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，生平不住財，惟守耗財而巳。若是孛為福禄，守辰宫，必得婦人財，亦能驟𤼵。又看土在何宫，居財帛有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1641,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，更有火生土，必發財。若居陷弱，不㑹𤼵財，却更破財。餘準此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"得富非難得夀難，夀星須把令星看。令星若起逢生旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"壽筭巍巍等泰山。不怕尅星惟怕煞，根基淺薄福闌珊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"縱敎主曜逢生旺，也作顔回夭夀看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1649,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齊曰：令星者，春木、夏火、秋金、冬水，土在四季也。論令星生尅，以此占人長短。盖金木水火土，在人為仁、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1651,"lineType":2,"content":"義、禮、智、信，俱能致壽。如令星入煞，必是夭折之命。若不陷于休囚死絶，而入於長生帝旺，臨官無不長壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗星最是分凶吉，却把令星明得失。令星若陷嵗星强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052777526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"創業為艱却富室。嵗令二星俱明健，富貴榮華無勞力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"更於命主有相闗係，是人間髙貴格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1661,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：人之造化，最重者納音，次重者令星。此　二星命中根本，若髙强壯健，更與命主有相闗，乃是人間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1663,"lineType":2,"content":"上等之命。若嵗星强，令星軟柔，終能致富，難享見成。令星强，嵗星弱，成敗進退人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕閑神來守駕，又怕淫星奔坐馬。更忌飛星破駕勲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"尤嫌餘宿侵吾舍。背星入限黯無光，孤曜當頭孤且寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽無輔各單行，到老艱難無片瓦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：閑神守駕，是外人當權，我何氣力？淫星坐馬，是妖邪無制，奔走不停。飛星破駕禄，則惡曜占强。餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052793910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"宿侵本垣，乃小人用事。背星入限，謂之失時。孤宿當頭，謂之無伴。獨陽不生，孤陰不成，所以到老艱苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"自古男兒志四方，主星不喜庫中藏。主如入庫為人晦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有文星也不光。獨有婦人偏喜此，為人守志在閨房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"若還孛彗來侵庫，奔走他鄊自嫁郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1683,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：庫者，藏也。男命主星入庫，縱能為官亦晦。女人主星入庫，必能守志。如有孛侵庫，必𤼵淫奔之興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1685,"lineType":2,"content":"先賢以為彗星宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"坐命如居四馬宫，動揺不定颺心風。田財二位如逢此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗興亡頃刻中。若是女人臨馬位，嫁夫招婿必重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052810294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官帝旺那逢著，多是踰墻暗裏通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1695,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：四馬之地，不宜安身立命。男子得之，主　心不定。田財二位逢之，各有動揺。女人於上安身立命，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1697,"lineType":2,"content":"然招夫疊疊。若是臨官帝旺相逢，更主淫蕩。盖寅為人馬，申為陰陽，已為雙女，亥為雙魚，皆犯重疊耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"賤人格局是尋常，安命安身細酌量。若在馬前并馬後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"主星受制暗無光。更嫌奴宿侵吾舍，奴隸為驅離逺鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有吉星來救助，亦須植立傍人墻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：賤人之命，如在馬前安命，馬後安身，多是賤格。如甲子生人，或卯或丑上安命，是馬前後也。若是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1707,"lineType":2,"content":"火為卯，主土為丑，主失陷，本為奴隸之命。又若計丑羅卯，必為驅使，奔走他鄊，是為馬以欄趕爾。設若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052826678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1711,"lineType":2,"content":"吉星救助，亦傍貴人門墻，終是無植立。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"男命須防八煞星，女人切忌刄鋒辰。煞星照限遭官禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"刃宿傷人亂血經。受制不能為我撓，黨之愈重見灾迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"男逢陽刄女逢煞，縱發為災亦少輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1719,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：男怕八煞，女忌陽刃。八煞主官灾，陽刃主産厄。此理甚明。男逢陽刃，女逢八煞，却不為害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"那箇合為僧道格，分明木炁為孤尅。不於華蓋上安身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"或者孤神為命宅。若是木羅相會遇，終身只作山林客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星在命好安閑，亡刼臨之閑不得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052843062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1729,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：人之安命，若在孤神寡宿之鄊，又如木羅相㑹，天華地蓋，合照拱照，皆是僧道造化。如亡神刧煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1731,"lineType":2,"content":"在命，雖欲閑散，不可得也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"且說夫星是尅星，髙强必是聘賢人。若居父母并兄弟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"端的因親上致親。以我生他為子息，若他陷尅必無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1737,"lineType":1,"content":"我之尅破為奴婢，他若髙强必弄權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1739,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：尅我者為夫星，我生者為子，我尅者為奴婢。此理甚明。若是夫在强宫，必招賢夫。若在兄弟父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1741,"lineType":2,"content":"之宫，必因親而致親。此議論不可破。人皆以妻妾、男女僕馬宫，不若此之為真，學者可以知之。如是受尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1743,"lineType":2,"content":"之星髙强，必招妾弄權也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052859446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1747,"lineType":1,"content":"水金原來是情星，相順相生必有情。中有閑神來間斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1749,"lineType":1,"content":"為人刻薄義恩輕。女人却把為淫宿，生旺其間必雜行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1751,"lineType":1,"content":"若是朝君居嵗駕，君前父側不行淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1753,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：金水二星，謂之情星，可相合而不可雜。如有相順相生，必有恩義。如有一星間斷於其中，必無仁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1755,"lineType":2,"content":"義之人。不問何命，當以此斷。女人反是，當以金水星為淫星，金水分明，非娼則婢。如近君嵗駕則不然。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1757,"lineType":2,"content":"此用之，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"多是女人為水性，水從上下多淫佞。羅㬋相向逆而行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"血經來往為無定。火孛同行午未宫，到老巳招勞倦症。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052875830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"設如八煞遇羅熒，胎前産後多灾病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1767,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齊曰：婦人最以火羅為忌，火羅主血經也。羅若逆行，自辰至巳，必是月經不定。設若水順流而行，為人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1769,"lineType":2,"content":"必主淫蕩。火孛同行於午未之宫，必招惡症。設如八煞逢火羅，胎前産後必致多灾。只為八宫見灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"那見婦人好淫冶，不怕貴人不怕馬。身宫若在冠帶位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1773,"lineType":1,"content":"臨死好淫重疊嫁。更加火孛惡星臨，月下花前多引惹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"不為婢妾也為娼，亦是人間女豪霸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1777,"lineType":2,"content":"𤣥齋曰：婦人淫蕩，非惟貴人驛馬，最怕冠帶安命。不惟重重嫁夫，乃淫慾不止婢妾娼妓之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1779,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕小兒逢直難，刃兼刼煞不須嗔。甲壬戊子從申起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052892214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1783,"lineType":1,"content":"庚丙旬人數起寅。數至本年方是數，三九六十二為真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒若是逢斯難，父母徒然生此身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1787,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：甲子、壬子、戊子旬生人，從申上起，子去未上逆數至本生年住。庚子、丙子旬生人，從寅上起，子逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1789,"lineType":2,"content":"數至本生年住。却又從本生年起，自　一數至本年安命宫住。若逢三六九，直數也。更逢直難，其殺身必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1791,"lineType":2,"content":"此乃休扣和尚秘訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1793,"lineType":1,"content":"五黄係是朝廷客，三碧臨垣多破尅。為人清貴有文章，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1795,"lineType":1,"content":"六白一白并八白。生逢四緑必為災。口舌官符為七赤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1797,"lineType":1,"content":"九紫山林客，散人壓身破相為二黑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052908598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1801,"lineType":2,"content":"玄齋曰：此乃方道之書。一白主人秀氣。二黑宜為僧道，破相可免。三碧主人先破後成。四緑主人多灾病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1803,"lineType":2,"content":"破祖。五黄主貴。七赤主凶狠，為軍卒。九紫主人清間，為山林客。以上起法，從太嵗順數至命宫住，看發何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1805,"lineType":2,"content":"數，以定白黑而論禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1807,"lineType":2,"content":"謹按六白一白八白者，以洛書乾坎艮之數也。五黄者，中央之五也。九紫者，離也。三碧四緑者，震㢲也。二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1809,"lineType":2,"content":"黑者，坤也。數以北方一白為最美，故主清貴文章。五黄為黄中，故主朝廷貴客。而三碧四緑二黑為凶。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1811,"lineType":2,"content":"法起太嵗順數至命宫，四仲旬生人起坎，四孟旬生人起震，四季旬生人起坤，而逐位飛數至本年，遂起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1813,"lineType":2,"content":"一白，數到命宫是何色，以斷吉凶。此法以後天之八卦與洛書之數相為經緯，以之叅看人命，不亦備與。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1815,"lineType":9,"content":"論倒限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052924982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗為衆煞之主，統衆煞行於黑道中，所以為灾，不違","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":1821,"lineType":1,"content":"時刻。看人夀夭窮困，終身不吉，皆因身命宫位、日月命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"主俱落煞鄉，更煞神拱夾，又占髙强，縱或得福，皆非横","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1825,"lineType":1,"content":"中得財。然限入煞鄉，未免死於非命，或吉為凶神所惱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1827,"lineType":1,"content":"凶為吉神所臨，刑害可知，宜加詳審，故有十忌：一忌破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，二忌空亡馬，三忌太嵗當頭，四忌坐煞向煞，五忌煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"星得志，六忌限入鬼鄉，七忌粧成鬼局，八忌二煞夾限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"九忌命主受制，十忌母星尅令。立命行限，此十忌為凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052941366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":1837,"lineType":1,"content":"至慘。經云：夀元不永定休論，處世多屯常冷淡。若見當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"生日月，命主俱各受制大限，方入煞神之初，或出煞神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"之末，不見救星，未有不凶者。今分諸煞强弱，為詩二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"首于後：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞原來是煞魁，身空命主不須來。若為鬼局應當死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1847,"lineType":1,"content":"煞曜臨之不必猜；若是無星居此位，更於三合細推排。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"天盤加得凶星到，命似風燈不久摧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1851,"lineType":1,"content":"要知三煞最為凶，直難同臨不善終。三合無星更須忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052957750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星切莫又相逢。若還日月同居此，官禄臨之禍愈隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":1857,"lineType":1,"content":"大限相將離煞尾，黄泉之下定行蹤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":1859,"lineType":1,"content":"煞中陽刃最為凶，身命同臨主破刑。大限若交當畏懼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星在上恐難行。若無凶曜尤當忌，局勢㕘詳判死生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1863,"lineType":1,"content":"三合更加神煞拱，纔離陽刃入幽㝠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"皆言七煞是亡神，莫道亡神禍患輕。身命若還居此地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1867,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮蹇滯過平生。凶星惡曜加臨到，大限渾如履薄氷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1869,"lineType":1,"content":"三合更須明審察，煞來夾拱更難行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052974134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"已中的煞金生處，殺氣嚴凝人畏懼。莫教刼煞又同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":1875,"lineType":1,"content":"便主黄泉尋去路。若為水命土星到，粧起煞神真局勢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":1877,"lineType":1,"content":"世人莫只忌秋生，四季生人尤可畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1879,"lineType":1,"content":"酉中的煞旺中金，金氣秋霜殺氣深。陽刃若還同到此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":1881,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星日月不須臨。若非惡死便言夭，大限纔交便促行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":1883,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗當頭又衝動，此身安有可延生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"的煞如逢在丑宫，煞神歸庫不為凶。更加三煞并陽刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"限數存亡頃刻中。若是亡神煞星到，雖然不死也為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339052990518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"若為日月三方拱，禍患憂危更不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":1893,"lineType":1,"content":"限星不入煞神同，日月三方拱更凶。刃煞夾之尤可畏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1895,"lineType":1,"content":"天盤加到福重重。午宫坐命尤嫌木，亥上還為八煞宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1897,"lineType":1,"content":"不必木星同到此，水星若到亦當終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":1899,"lineType":1,"content":"局勢尤當子細推，世人不識此天機。煞星不到還須忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼曜臨之限亦危。設若太陰居鬼局，纔交限局便傾危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"更加刼煞并陽刃，煞在天盤禍不遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"星家倒限有真機，第一先將煞曜推。切莫一途拘泥著，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339053006902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"須看命主有無虧。命星安穩無刑尅，此生平善實無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"若為命主遭他害，任是仙神也皺眉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1913,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識煞神停力處，二煞中同人畏懼。更看加合反復宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神飛到誠為慮。縱然煞星加不臨，須忌行年太嵗侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1917,"lineType":1,"content":"行年煞星照臨著，大命傾危不可禁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1919,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞怕頭三煞尾，陽刃兩頭皆要忌。陽刃若在相貌宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"破相毁形端的是。此煞排歸八煞中，太陰飛到為凶比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1923,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃刼煞扶兩旁，禍起之時難可避。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339053023286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":1927,"lineType":1,"content":"煞若飛廉凶又凶，莫安身命在其中。欲知鬼局十分重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1929,"lineType":1,"content":"命主陰陽不可逢。此煞不須和合看，只將地局究其功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1931,"lineType":1,"content":"若還行限臨其地，煞曜臨之不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神不可例言凶，煞落空亡逈不同。日月不臨命不到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":1935,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星不在命無凶。若還限脫煞星尾，必定為灾福不隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1937,"lineType":1,"content":"此是天機真妙處，根基淺薄禍無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1939,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星難曜分生旺，春夏秋冬子細推。若是煞星來秉令，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1941,"lineType":1,"content":"也分晝夜論安危。若為反背須還忌，夀算摧殘禍有基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339053039670"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1945,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞下臨人畏懼，此身安有百年期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1947,"lineType":1,"content":"寅丑二宫中立命，陰陽合作難星看。夜陽晝月誠為忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1949,"lineType":1,"content":"煞位相逢限不安。若在貴人并禄上，也須減力命凋殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1951,"lineType":1,"content":"若還煞拱凶尤甚，限數初交死不難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1953,"lineType":1,"content":"若論閻浮死惡人，命身俱各值凶神。煞星入命命入煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1955,"lineType":1,"content":"日月臨之必害身。更怕煞神來拱夾，刑囚為煞更相侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1957,"lineType":1,"content":"必然死在刀兵下，命似殘花滿地零。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1959,"lineType":1,"content":"人行空限無星照，限若無星福不生。加合通闗煞神至，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855339053056054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1963,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神在上恐難行。非惟貧困多凶禍，破蕩田財似水傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1965,"lineType":1,"content":"限度若臨天命絶，縱然度得也伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855386761674795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":2017,"lineType":1,"content":"加盤之法，決要天地盤各有子丑、寅、卯、辰已、午、未、申酉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":2019,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥。且如立命子先以天盤卯對地盤卯，然後寫十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":2021,"lineType":1,"content":"曜在地盤上。且如火星在地盤夘，天盤卯亦相對寫一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":2023,"lineType":1,"content":"火星。諸星并要上下盤各寫一星，却以天盤卯加子，依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":2025,"lineType":1,"content":"此決斷無差也。餘尤奥妙，詳見十二宫安命論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":2039,"lineType":1,"content":"從卯上起子，逆數以丑闗寅，以寅闗丑。夘闗子。辰闗亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":2041,"lineType":1,"content":"巳闗戌，午關酉，未闗申。申關未，酉關午，戌關已，亥闗辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":2043,"lineType":1,"content":"子卯相通，丑寅相通，辰亥相通，已戌相通，午酉相通，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":2045,"lineType":1,"content":"申相通。如人立命，子通闗夘，若卯宫有禄、有殿駕、有火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":2047,"lineType":1,"content":"羅命母，則一生吉利。如通刃刼破碎，有煞氣鬼星，則一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":2049,"lineType":1,"content":"生屯蹇。學者宜知之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855386761707563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kxlpw/1-SK1609_figure_00031.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BxfaDMFhvd3yJaX8AveqG0pioA0%3D","pictureHeight":337,"pictureWidth":353,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kxlpw/1-SK1609_figure_00031.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vUXgrOFviKS1Vs5kNhei3zMHEVA%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kxlpw/1-SK1609_figure_00031.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855386761723947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":20 {"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"子乃土旺地，命坐此土為主。如登垣、登殿、入局、登籍、坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，與宫神太嵗相闗即吉。如㐫忌刑難混雜，則不為福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫相等則中常㫁也。又本宫三宿，如女、虚二宿，不問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719890979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜，並以土論，獨危度夜生，從月取用，亦依弦望而論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"有月可為主，無月只取土用事，然須在望前，太陰有用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"中間亦不離乎土。若夜生火，居強得經最吉。此宫土喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅，又為官星，六丙生人不為囚，六戊生人不為刑，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"生人為真祿，壬生人為真福。夜得火尤為光明，身主臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"之為安身傍母，亦為身主傍官，更在高強無忌曜侵之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"為福。夏末晝生見火亦能為福。如火星獨垣，前後無相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"雜，是官星明健，起於命前，即為滿用，又為貴格。若水星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167489089573"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"晝見，起於高強，當為吉利。葢財元木也，三限星水也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"木與太陽相離，又為得用，春令又強，夏則次之，又不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"為忌。葢日生從陽，木土乃一體之功用，惟夜生為鬼，九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"十月為直。若太陰遇木為安身傍鬼，縱是木得經，財祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"得意，其間亦多刑尅疾病之類。若木入命值留退，不分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜，皆以㐫㫁。若木火交合，可從吉用。水火交合，命母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"受㐫，官星受尅為㐫。若混以刑囚，直難皆㐫。寅宫福徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"木居之，乃害曜入垣，或本命天元納音屬土，即為奪星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719858211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"或臨亡神刼煞，或有刑囚，終為㐫忌。若有太隂在寅已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫，謂之四正逢刑，怕見身也。葢寅中加巳，已中加申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"是寅刑巳，巳刑申，其不足可知矣。其中有一火星為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"星得局，更得土星在寅巳，是寅加巳，已加申，雖曰刑，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"刑而生我，非刑而尅我，更如命主有情，祿馬在命，合此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"格者，寅限可以名利無疑矣。夘為官祿，火星居之，或三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"合見火，皆貴。若無火而有木，更加以太陰在寅夘未，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"為土得木局，多主夭折。若加以難直，尤㐫。亥為財，酉為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479513637"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"田，金木同行於命前後，或交命度此田財二用，實為吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"利。若是冬臘，金木交於命宫，多是不仁而富，春月庶幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"巳為疾厄，水星居之，為難星入垣。壬生人在七八月多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，或有壓身灾病。水星主濕病，臨濕局，多隂濕手足之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"疾，若金助之，為害尤甚。孛水居強，或居官祿遷移亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬甲生人，子夘兩宫通闗陽刃，如官宫值此，難免中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"年之厄。子宫命者，一為天地通闗局，二為四正局，三為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"四破局，須看命與太嵗生時合成何局論之。子宫立命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835932691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"午上有祿，酉上有身，夘有命主，乃一隂一陽之謂道，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"天地通闗局成矣。亦謂之衝干對祿，否則互見之亦佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸人祿子，乙人祿卯，丁已祿午，四正互加，皆是崇勲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"而四正局成矣。四破局者，四位俱不見祿，唯㑹刑星、害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"曜、難直等星。如太隂命主在寅、申、戌未，是未中有戌，戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"中有丑。不然只在丑戌者，亦戌中有丑，丑中有戌，加之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"四位有煞氣守之，為四破局。此乃加盤之妙，正盤所不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"及。正盤，衆人之禍福，加盤，本身之禍福。故前賢云：天盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479546405"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"轉出地盤上，夘上分明是命宫。此加盤之妙用也。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"子上立命，甲、丙戊、庚壬四正徃來，通闗陽刃，其間子午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"有羅計主之，可以鎮定命度，雖在虚危，不為忌論。若是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計偏孤，又不臨於子午，日月福祿臨於二八，多是中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"年發福而不長久。其四正次舍中間限度交對，如女度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"立命，限入氐土；虚危立命，限入房心。此乃四刑度內，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"闌干、貫索、伏尸、卷舌為煞限路逢之中有發福者，忽有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折，又不可測。但是伏吟四正體局者，犯此煞，又不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167489122341"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"以次舍度中為得也。此局正則為四正，偏之亥為三合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"偏之丑為不入局。四正是四正灾福，三合是三合灾福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"一星稍異，理皆不然。且如子上危十二度立命，上盤是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"夘，下盤是子，此乃四正為體，土為命主。如躔於亥宿，初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"度，則是上盤夘，下盤亥，即成亥夘未三合局為用。若偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"之丑，太隂在巳，初度是上盤夘，下盤巳，又成巳酉丑局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"為用。或有祿馬扶之，亦是貴格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：子宫土旺之地，坐命以土為主，如登垣殿、入局、登籍坐貴，與宫神太嵗相闗，則皆貴命也。如難刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835949075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"囚混雜，則不為福。如難直吉㐫相等，無彼此強弱，則平常命也。所忌者木炁二星，所樂者火羅二曜。火之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"一星既為母曜，又為官星，雖丙戊生人化為刑囚亦吉。壬甲生人化為福祿，則錦上添花。木之一星固為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"害曜，雖甲丙生人化為福祿，終以為害。若戊庚生人化為刑囚，為禍尤深。炁之一星為禍與木星同。雖好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"惡如此，然亦須看守宫者何星，所用者何星，混雜者何星，黨與者何星，又不可一槩論也。如福祿權財混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"之以直難，則塞翁得馬，未必為福也。木星固知為害，若混之以火羅，則反為吉。以木能生火，恩有益於我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"也。十二宫之最切者，莫若福、徳、官、祿、八煞也。福宫屬木，設有木星居之，不可為福徳主，謂之害曜入垣。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"有太隂在巳申之宫，謂之四正逢刑怕見身，葢寅刑巳，巳刑申，其不吉可知矣。其寅中有一火星，謂之官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"星得局，又能為福，更得土星在寅巳，是寅加已，已加申，雖曰相刑，是刑而生我，非刑而尅我，更加命主有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479530021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":2,"content":"情祿馬在命，合此格者，寅限可得名利無疑矣。夘為官祿宫，設有火星居之，謂之官星入垣，或三合見火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"皆吉。若無火而有木，更加木在亥夘、未，即為土命人，得木合此格者多主夭折，若加以難直尤㐫，必死於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"非命，萬不失一也。已為疾厄宫，水星居之，為難星入垣，難星，疾厄主是也。更六壬生人生於七八月，多主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"惡死，輕則破相壓身之疾，水星若有金助之，為害尤甚。孛水居強，或居官禄遷移亦㐫。如六甲、六壬生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"子夘二宫通闗，陽刃加官宫，值此難免中年之厄。子宫坐命者，一為天地通闗局，二為四正局，三為四破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"局，須看命主所臨，與太嵗生時合成何局以論之。子宫立命，午上有禄，酉上安身，夘有命主，乃一隂一陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"之謂道，即天地通闗局成矣。此局有四裏，有八表，謂之衝干對祿，否則互換見之亦佳。如癸人祿子，乙人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"祿夘，辛人祿酉，丁人祿午，四正互加，皆是崇勲，而四正局成矣。四破局者，四位俱不見祿，惟㑹刑星、害曜、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342239796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"難直等星，如太隂星命主在寅申戌未者，是未中有戌，戌中有丑，不然只在丑戌二宫者，亦戌中有丑，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"中有戌，加之四位中有煞星守之，故為四破局。耶律所謂四正宫神暗加管攝是也。此乃加盤之妙，正盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"所不及。正盤，衆人之禍福；加盤，本身之禍福。故前賢云：天盤轉出地盤上，夘上分明是命宫。此加盤之妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"用也。又有已加戌，辰加亥，亦有相闗。大槩先看局之重輕，然後叅以加盤，而明禍福。如火星在夘，禍福由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"此而分。四正局見之，則夘加子，火來生土，必然為福。返吟局見之，是夘加酉，火來尅金，必然為禍。此局正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"則為四正，偏之亥為三合，偏之丑為不入局。四正是四正灾福，三合是三合灾福，一星稍異，理皆不然。中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"間又有偏局，且如子上危十二度立命，上盤是夘，下盤是子，此乃四正之體，土為命主，飛入於亥宫，初度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"則是上盤夘，下盤亥，却成亥夘未三合局為用，或有禄馬扶之，亦是貴命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986602020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":9,"content":"丑宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"丑與子合，故以土為主。雖主相同，然取用體局與子宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"别。子為四正，丑為諸不入局。三位互加，以丑加亥，亥中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"無閑極，而兩宫通闗，以寅闗丑。論其星辰，雖緩且急，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"為兄，寅為相，此宫有吉㐫，可以通㫁。外雖緩而實急，胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"中造化，自有玄㣲。所忌者太陽木炁，所喜者金火羅㬋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"正二月生太陽，直難為㐫，多是夜生有此。若秋冬兩季","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生，行太陽之道，而禍亦輕，木炁為嫌。但論晝生，庶幾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167489073189"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"可取。金為官星，火為福主，二皆可用。晝生功淺，夜生用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"多。若火髙強明健，雖晝生亦可發福。如壬甲人見火，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丁人見金，其福尤大。獨羅有用，炁計無成。若混以刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"囚，直難當作㐫㫁。若貴祿馬、職元、局主之類稍吉。此宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"屬土，中有斗牛二宿。斗度命者，當取木為用，須甲乙生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"或納音木，火命，更以春令而生，即以木論，亦且不離乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"土，以此命度見孛，故有功，火亦得用，惟晝生見金為忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"若夏令之際，生在晝時，合得木用，金之不忌，亦明然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479497253"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"若或庚辛生人，或春夏之夜生，木盛金衰，當從何論？或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬以金主事，則又不可以金尅木論。葢庚辛人，金亢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"金也，春夏之夜者，金之廢也，秋冬者，金之權也，已酉丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"者，金局也。三限皆金火，夜生以金火為主，合以金為長，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"土次之，火其用也，何曽以木為本元。若或戊已生，及納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"音土安命於斗，雖春夏生不必論木，即以土㫁土度四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"季不離乎土，土者金之母，二者不可離。若夏令以火行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"權，金不怕火，以土性存焉。若秋冬得金，獨垣局無㐫難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602692648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"功名又何疑。此宫命者，是宫無禄馬，多是三煞臨之。辰、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、丑、未四位皆煞命妻、官、田總局。若命丑身亥，是身入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼鄉，如寅午戌生人，此為三煞，此格多㐫害。然諸宫皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"以身入閑宫為喜，惟此宫難與他比。如身在亥，有木臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"照，為禍尤甚，縱無木炁，亦不為吉。通以㐫㫁，以夘辰午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"為𦂳要之地。午為難宫，太陽居之，為難星入廟。若得火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"居之，或三合見土，為福星入局，是八煞有星，更以禄臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"之，少年功名可必。辰為官祿，金星入廟，太隂居之。身入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171770418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"官鄉，如木炁臨之，是木入水局，土主不宜為害，曜破官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，如失用更不可。如木炁同太隂在酉辰，是亥加酉，午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"加辰，辰午酉亥俱全，皆為不足。夘為福徳，土星臨之，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"土入火垣，有情生土，或木星臨三合，能破我福徳，是夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"加入丑，為我命害，少年刑傷。十二宫命，惟此宫乃緩中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"之急，前所舉相貌閒極是。若命主土星在寅亥者，或有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅合之，是福相造化。若土單行二方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"二方閒相是也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"又為㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"局。若身與火交，是安身傍母，身與木交，為安身傍鬼。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171754034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙祿在夘，乙人丑命為加盤之祿；甲祿在寅，甲人丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"命為通闗之祿；壬祿在亥，壬人丑命乃祿入閑極，以午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"加亥，得下盤之祿，命得此三者為祿也。如辛禄酉，丙戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"禄已，此三者安命於丑，合照有禄，是合禄也，正所謂隠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"中之顯，是製局之體用，合此者無不顯貴，又不可不觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"子寅。若火寅金子，為官福夾命，夜生福尤重。日月在二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"宫亦妙，日在子，月在寅為上，日在寅，月在子次之。已酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"兩宫與此通㫁，當審吉㐫。又以丑之為命，故知其與諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171737650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"不入局，於中又有𦂳要處。若安命稍正，則合從入局㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"若安命偏於子，又從四正局矣。偏正之中有天地徳合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"局，六害局、六合局，又不可以諸不入局㫁，以六害為六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"合，極相霄壤。六合則始終有吉，六害則始終有患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"發明云：丑宫立命，以金為官星，乙丁生人化福禄更美。火為恩曜，若壬甲生人見之，為福尤重。羅乃火餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"為福一也。晝生功淺，夜生用多。若火髙強明健，雖晝生亦可𤼵福。人皆以木炁為善星，火羅為惡曜，豈知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"善星𤼵福緩，惡星𤼵福驟，但恐混以囚忌之星，反能為禍矣。若混以職元祿主，崇勲貴人，為福愈有力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"宫之最切者八煞，官祿、福徳三宫也。午為八煞，太陽在上，謂之難星入垣，惟火居之，或三合見土，一則土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197244479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"命人得火局，二則福星入垣局，三則八煞有星，更有祿馬加臨，少年功名可許。辰為官祿，金星在上，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"官星之垣，又為金星入廟。月在上，謂之身入官鄉，俱為吉利。惟木居之，一則木入水局，二則害曜破官，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"則辰午為煞。十二宫主，惟相貌閑極，乃緩中之急。若命主二星在上，或有火羅合之，多是𡖖相造化。如鄭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"敬齋壬辰十一月十九日辰時，安命在丑，土星在亥，係閑極宫，官至公相。若此顯達者，不可枚舉。雖土在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"亥，本為土逢木局，而未宫有火，却成木生火，火生土。況命坐崇勲，而見火加　入命宫，此其所以為佳也。須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"知此格方妙。亦有於寅位輳成火局，或有火羅乗之者，如單見一土入木局，當以㐫㫁，不可一例推之。要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"之，最切者莫如加盤，最妙者莫如入局。正謂得地不湏論惡弱，失時何必問髙強。今之術者不知加盤之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"妙，以為鄭敬齋之首𤼵達者，何辰限為大魁，又何三十六氣此中氣推之，正交入辰限，辰限無星，不知辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986552868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"加寅，既加見祿，又加見馬，安得不榮達？切不可以弱宫論之。又如巳宫，雖曰遷移，實為切要，若有金星在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"上，　一則照命，二則照禄，三則官星入局，值此者多是晚年顯達，切不可以弱宫論也。然又要觀子寅二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"有夾有扶尤妙，若火在寅，金在子，為官福夾命，日月在二宫亦佳，日在子，月在寅為上，日在寅、月在子次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"之，日在已、月在酉，亦謂之隂陽拱夾，亦好。身命若拱夾好，則一生吉利，若不好，則一生灾晦。又是前為胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"元，後為三日，其為禍福不亦重乎？其次要觀命主，命宫為緩，命主為急，故殿駕經云：命雖空亡，而主領猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"在，即命主也。最要者拱夾，不然，諸星揖拱，日月朝拱，皆貴命也。又其次要觀身主，若拱祿、拱殿、拱駕，皆是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"貴格，若身命主在辰夘上，謂之官福入命，不可與諸煞相㕘。若身命二主拱夘，不為拱福徳，却為拱木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"土命得之，皆為失格，間有救處，亦是貧夭之命。又其次，要觀當生之時，若攀殿駕，登祿馬，亦是貴命。在十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835899923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"二宫皆要太隂居閑極，獨此丑宫與亥宫，最怕太隂在閑極。葢丑土也，亥木也，月臨之，謂之安身傍鬼，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"成木局，主一生迍蹇，重則夭折。既觀此生時，又要觀所生之日，有天月二徳帝座，或日月夾垣城帝座，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"二主夾垣城帝座，或官福夾垣城帝座，或身命夾垣城帝座，此三台八座之格。如日在丑，月在亥，中夾一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"子，若丙子、丁丑日生，水旺在子，乃日生以帝旺為帝座也，納音旺處是帝座也。庚午、辛未日皆土旺在子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"故帝座在子，日月夾之，豈不竒哉？惟癸巳、乙夘、乙酉更髙一著，是謂暗祿入局。日在丑，月在夘，更於丙寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":371,"lineType":2,"content":"丁夘時，是納音火長生在寅，謂之日月夾垣城，畢竟謂之安身傍鬼，以中夾寅木。若更遭刑、煞囚、難等星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"在其中，則必為害，又不可以垣城論也。若無他忌，只恐寅木為害，此亦小節，不足慮也。又以丑之為命，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":375,"lineType":2,"content":"知其為諸不入局，偏則為四正局，於中亦有𠮓處。正則為諸不入局，葢安命稍正，則合從入局斷。若安命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453171171721266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"偏於子，又從四正局矣。偏正之中有天地徳合局，六害局，六合局，六破局，不可便以諸不入局看。以六害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":381,"lineType":2,"content":"為六合，不啻霄壤。六合則始終有成，六害則始終有患，須於偏正中仔細推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
