{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫屬木，獨陽不生，木生在亥，寅與亥合，兩宫互加，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"為通闗，夘為加盤。一則財帛，二則相貌，若有㐫吉臨於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"夘丑，吉則為福，㐫則為禍。人但知拱夾為重，不知互加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"為妙，若在外而實在內也。宫神艮丙生人，卦氣以日木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"土為三限，主木土為田財，以金水為官福。木土二星晝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602676264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"生明健，福力非常，夜生亦可。金為忌害，秋冬之際常行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"於夘辰已之間，是時木瘁而衰，金強而怒，晝見有灾。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"金㑹水日，尤可為用。若金獨立，無水日以制之，三合左","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"右有太隂助金臨之，木土禍何可堪。冬月本非晝用，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"況難星黨鬼，又為身與鬼交，此為慘毒。若春夏之際，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"星行於東南西北，晝生不利，夜生金水同行亦為吉，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"同行為有情，㑹合太隂亦不為㐫。葢夜從陰，金火皆隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"也。若太陰更臨陰方，又為吉用，況其木盛金柔，我強彼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986634788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，何足畏之。水為官星，晝夜有用，此宫尾箕二宿於內，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"尾乃火之垣，寅午戌乃火之局，其火之用明矣。然而火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"乃木之子，木乃火之母，必先母而後子，茍捨木而全取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"火，是為有子而無其母。寅尾命晝生以木為先，夜生當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"以火為用。金星禍福前㫁已明，水雖為忌，亦為利害，獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"有丙丁人及納音火者，可以為𦂳，其他命者，又不相同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"如箕度水，四時取水為用，水乃木之母，先水而後木。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"之一星，一為命母，二為命度，三為官星，諸用畢備。若水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167489105957"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"孛交計水㑹，水火交征，水土相迫，雖為㐫忌，尤當明審。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"如春夏生水為休囚，彼強我弱，是故不足。生於冬月，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"星旺相，命主官星秉令，㐫惡夾之，反為輔衛。是猶武卒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"之於將相，若居於髙強，富貴可必，茍失地亦能為㐫。古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"人云：人命臨於箕，多疾害，兼箕星好風，且主簸揚。身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"忌曜交夾，或星曜戰鬬，於人多灾病，縱有官亦有讒謗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"之類。人馬安命，人多好動，主遷移。此宫禍福與亥不同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"亥以隂為主，寅以陽為論，日木土三者，故不離乎取用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453163835916307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生用輕，亦不可失。辰為福徳，已為官祿，但木忌居福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，若月居之，為身居鬼鄉，遇水解之免㐫。辰與亥通闗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"限，入此者，本宫有星，可以明㫁，若無星，必於亥宫取其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福。若亥有命母、財元、天馬之類，皆以吉言。㐫星臨之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"則㐫，已為官禄一生成就之地，已戌通闗，依上取用。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"為官星，得失強弱，生平賴之。中間輕重，前段已具。午宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"為遷移，諸星臨之，善惡易别。六巳生人，太隂臨其上為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉。午乃六巳人祿兼卦氣，上盤巨蟹乃太隂之垣廟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986667556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"此命當為貴格，又不可以難星㫁之，非六巳人不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"未乃難宫，此宫與他難星不同，此是太隂為難，身主相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"干。若身更入難宫，申來加未，未加午，午未二宫忽有忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，又為前後三日胎元，此兩宫為禍福最𦂳，宜明審察。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"惟丑乃財帛宫，丑與寅通。若此宫有田財二主，或當用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"之星為吉，與他處財帛命管攝者大不同，葢此財帛有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫也。如甲之申子辰坐此，是命有祿馬，以木火為最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"重。如甲之寅午戌，則以木火為竒，亦命宫之有真祿馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602758184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"對衝也。若巳酉丑人身居福徳，乃身命夾三煞。此宫所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"合數局，本為不入局，若偏之卯，則有伏吟局，天地通局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"在焉。雖然如此，亦難捉摸，所貴者得其綱領而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"發明云：寅宫屬木，木生在亥，寅與亥合，兩宫互加，丑為通關，夘為加盤。一則財帛，二則相貌。若有吉星居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"之，財帛相貌皆是貴命。若有㐫星居之，皆是賤命。好則福生有基，不好則禍起蕭牆。人皆知拱夾為重，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"不知互加為妙，若在外而實在内也。此宫所好者，水也、孛也。所忌者，金也、月也，皆難星也。金水二星最闗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"利害，細看閃避，互宫換局，貴賤了然。若金入水位，水入金宫，不然，金入水局，水入金局，皆是仕宦命也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"金水相隔一位，水居無用之地，則為夭折之命。大抵恩星雖化為刑囚直星亦吉，若化為福祿愈佳。然難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167719874595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"星雖化為福祿亦㐫，若化為刑囚尤酷，餘宫依此㫁之。雖然好惡之星如此，又次看守宫之星如何，所用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"之星如何，印䕃混雜之星如何，方可以㫁吉㐫。且如庚生人，以水為祿主，乙生人，以孛為祿主，固為福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"若五六月生人，混之以火土，是火直生土，囚尅祿，水耗尅祿孛，未必不為禍矣。又如已生人，以金化囚為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"忌，辛生人，以太隂化囚為忌，固為害矣。若春生金，混之以水，得水以泄金，太隂水精以生孛，反為有福，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"可槩論也，當審輕重㫁之。若有職元局主、天馬、地驛，與夫難星、害曜、直煞之𩔖，又不可以此㫁論。十二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"惟官祿、福、徳、田宅、八煞至切也。巳為官祿，所屬者水，水星居之，謂之官星入垣；太隂居之，謂之身入官祿；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"木星居之，謂之木入水位。命主有氣，謂之命主坐官。或丙戊生人，謂之祿居官祿，俱是富貴之命。若金星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"居之，謂之害曜破官。午有水星，破禍成福，有火居之，亦能為福。若辰酉有金，破福成禍，辰為福徳屬金，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342256180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"金星居之，不為福星入垣，即為害曜入垣。太隂居之，不為身居福徳，即為安身。傍鬼又為難星黨害曜，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"星居之，不為命主坐福徳，却為木困金鄉，是貧薄命也。若金居之，混之以水，破禍成福。木星居之，若申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"辰有水星，即為木入水局。太隂居之，若六乙生人，夘上有祿，即為身命夾祿。好惡之辯可細推也。田宅亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"宫也，金水若在亥，行辰限多𤼵福，若有金土在亥，行辰限多為禍。男女戌宫與官祿巳宫相闗，有金在戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"行限遇水則吉利。若有土金在戌，到已限不見水則不利。八煞未宫太隂居之，謂之難星入垣。若三四月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"生人月為直星，主生疾病。六辛生人月化囚星，多有官灾。更加申午二宫，若有㐫星臨之，嵗煞值之，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"以煞見煞，有大禍存焉。有吉星臨之，未必為福。是申為胎元，午為三日，前扶後引，惟命主木星居之，一則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"入局，二則入秦，三則八煞有星不為主，居疾厄也。更有吉星扶之，不貴即富矣。此宫亦有數局，一為天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167489187877"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":541,"lineType":2,"content":"通闗局，二為天地徳合局，三為六合局，四為諸不入局，五為六害局。所謂天地通闗局者，以隂加陽，以陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"加隂，主星得宜是也。如寅生人以木為主，飛入於申，加之以酉。申者陽也，酉者隂也，申屬水，酉屬金，是金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"生水，酉生木，木飛申上有祿，寅宫安命，謂之衝干對祿，謂之六合局為吉。若辛生人，木為主星，飛在戌上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"亦加之以酉，雖曰辛祿在酉，酉屬金木，逢之不得其次，反成六害局，酉戌是穿心，六害為不吉也。所謂天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"地徳合局者，此宫坐命有二，丁己生人祿在午，木為主星，飛在午，午宫有未，是午與未合。六癸生人祿在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"子，木為主星，飛在子，子宫有丑，是子與丑合。如甲戊庚生人，貴在丑未，而命主飛在未，是未宫有午，午與未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"合。如六辛生人，貴在午寅，而命主飛在午，是午宫有未，未與午合。如乙已生人，貴在子申，而命主飛在子，子宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"有丑，子與丑合。又甲戊庚生人，命主飛在丑，丑宫有子，子與丑合。有如此數，即為之六合局，不然互拱見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986683940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"貴，尤其佳也。其他皆為諸不入局，是天盤地盤加合不成。如有職元殿駕局，主卦氣天馬地驛，在命主所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"躔之宫，即為好命。如有刑囚難直煞星在命主所躔之宫，即為㐫命也。又謂不入局中，有六害存焉。木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"命主在酉，是酉宫有戌，戌宫有酉，好則為天地通闗局，不好則為六害焉。又如木為命主在夘辰，夘辰是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"六𡧱，辰宫有夘，夘宫有辰，為六害局。惟是這處便有輕重，此寅之一宫，得隂注陽受二星，最為利益，專解","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"直難一星。八煞宫屬月，以月為難星，若得隂注陽受解之，不為身犯難宫，若以月所到處皆成難星，守位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"如此，則此宫安命者俱無好命矣。貴乎有隂注陽受而附加之，尤以為佳。所以大煞僧多值此星，亦有大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"仕宦者多值此星。互加暗加之法，後學鮮知。最妙者，寅中之造化，萬物殊途皆由此出。人徒知有寅也，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"不知有艮也；人徒知有艮也，而不知有震也。先天後天大有施設，誰能明達至此乎？寅宫坐命皆從夘上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506550272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"加，所謂天地左旋而右轉。又以偏正而論，所合者數局，殊不知伏吟局有之，六害、六合局有之，天地通闗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"局、天地徳合局亦有之。惟其如此，亦難捉摸，所貴得其要訣，則判然如在目前矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":581,"lineType":9,"content":"卯宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"卯與戌合，故為火命，居於此為伏吟，偏於寅則為不入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"局，偏於辰則為六害局。子夘通闗，四正取用最為𦂳切，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫體認與四正四刑反吟局相表裏，如天地通局，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"夘起子，夘為東方之地，子為支神之首，以此加之，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"諸局之緫。故先有天地通局，一則生二，二則生三，生生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506566656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"無窮。宫神震庚人，卦氣火、金、月為三限，主以木土為田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"財，以太陽為官主，以水為忌難。夘主陰，夜生用火金月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"也。金火有情於我，處於髙明，為福必矣。晝生則用輕，晝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"生若木土臨命度不為田財之用，而為陽明之助。火為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"本領，與木相維，春夏當權，雖晝生不為忌，夜更有功。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"火滿用，此為最切，得之必有勇畧，又能謙恭，起於太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"之處，為命主，朝君廊廟之士也。若㑹於午最明，若在陷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"宫則減力。水為難星，於春夏者以木土為主，令我強彼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342338100"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，水力終㣲。七月八月生值之者，以難加直，故為不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"身近水，為身與鬼交，多主暗疾生。冬月水常經於寅夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"之間，此時木衰火老，水正得時，見之不利。若得水星合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"木，木能生火，乃絶而復續也。若助之金孛，其㐫尤甚。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"金水交行，是為難星得助。此宫三宿，如房度太陽為性，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"與火通類經云：太陽與火通㫁，生尅制化，惟依火而行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"心月度夜生從太陰為主，金火助之吉，見土計為忌，葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生隂局命者亦以火計為嫌。晝生從火斷，如氐度戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167489204261"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"已生人及納音土者，命宫與土星相管攝，方可以土㫁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"又不可以土助之。葢天地間土從火中出，必有火而後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"有土，以氐為土度㫁，則土生旺，但不可一例以木炁為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌。戊巳人納音土者，九月十月方以木為碍，終無傷人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"元氣。若春夏之際，木又為財元，生旺論之，不可一槩言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"也。庚人得之而為化氣，必能獲福，又喜土計臨之，葢天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"元屬金，故夜生人亦不為忌。此宫立命無分晝夜，不問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"四時，必藉太陽臨之，吉地輔之，吉曜守於禄宫卦氣之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342321716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"上，則功名顯達。茍陷於惡弱，混以刑囚，直難必有㐫累。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"此是㐫暴之徒，每犯刑憲。此宫主命為伏吟之體，難比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"三合六合。論所𦂳者，考於四正。四正吉㐫，有無虚實，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫同一體，午為官祿，子為田宅，酉為妻，俱相闗係。葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"子午夘酉，本為四刑之地。甲丙戊庚壬人之四刑者，闌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"干、貫索、伏尸、卷舌是也。得其吉，則有驟然之福；歸之㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"則有暴然之禍。命宫為始，官祿次之，妻宫為終。翻覆徃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"來，㐫吉𠋣伏，處中交之際，多是世𠮓風移，善惡相反也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986700324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"設若丙戊生人，官宫主事，此為天地盤中上下交。若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"福祿日月臨之，多是𤼵福，中主夭暴。如得子午，上有羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"計主之，方可禦患。葢天星制地煞，此局機闗最為靈驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳主巳，以巳加巳，上下無度，只尋其初而窮其終，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿體勢甚别。或以軫加翼，以其深淺不同，禍福則異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"若丙戊，人祿所在，若子午夘酉，人，破碎所在。當斟酌而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"言。此宫無四正𠮓換之理，合戌中加之通闗，有吉可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㫁，有㐫則以㐫言。通闗無吉㐫之曜，當取三合有無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914519052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"制局解之，方定禍福。夘宫坐命，體勢最難明白。本宫無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"𠮓，但看深淺如何。正則無復𠮓，偏則體局又𠮓其間，詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"審在伏吟圖中。申宫主厄，所忌水星，唯七八月間，多生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"於東南之際，以太陽故也。如初、中、末見之，當審其患，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"看制化如何，最宜明辯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：夘宫屬火，火庫居戌，夘與戌合。戌者，陽也，夘者，陰也，故以火為命主春夏當權，雖晝生不為忌，夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"更有功。命居於此為伏吟，偏於寅則為不入局，偏於辰則為六害局。夘辰是六害，伏吟無度。大槩要推日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"出入度之淺深。如日入淺躔氐一度，雖天盤在夘則加辰，地盤則寅加夘。以夘時而論，則命度與日同度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453167342354484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":703,"lineType":2,"content":"有如此𩔖，便以為伏吟局，其說謬矣。又六合局有之，六害局有之，天地通闗局、天地徳合局亦有之，於中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"暗有造化。若日躔房度以夘時生，則正為伏吟局。既得伏吟局之正，故無徃而不正。在十二宫中亦皆以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"正論，其禍福只在　一十五度内見之。使有一水星在亢初度，水能尅火，是禍起蕭牆。使有一木星在尾初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"度，木能生火，是福生有基。木炁者，此官之父母，水孛者，此宫之鬼賊。木為母曜，炁為木餘，固能為福。若六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生人於十　一月、十二月生者，復混以生，未必不為禍也。難星囚直，不惟作灾，又制其木，不使為福。又如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"水孛固能為害，若六辛、六丙生人於二月、三月生者，混之以木炁，未必不為福也。是水生木，又以炁泄水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"不能為禍。至此方知其妙。要之，十二宫最切者，無如戌宫、酉宫，其次申、未宫，禍福不出乎此。葢戌宫闗我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"官祿，且官福二宫有好星在上未必吉，惡星在上未必㐫，惟有暗加之，吉㐫最驗也。未為遷移，申為八煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602774568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":721,"lineType":2,"content":"申未通闗，難星居之俱為不足，月臨之亦未為善，更火星臨之却不為，火臨坤地，灾消爍而為灾愈甚，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"多不知其然也。此宫坐命，一曰深淺互加，二曰翻覆互加，三曰就本位加。且以深淺互加言之，以　一宫有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"三十度有竒，日初入則謂之淺，日將次欲出則謂之深，不然命宫三十度皆然。今試言此一段加盤，方曉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"其義。以命宫之入淺而論，則八嵗至十五嵗是夘加辰，辰所主也，若有水星在辰，是辰金生水，為灾愈甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"十六嵗至二十　一嵗是辰加辰。二十二嵗至二十六嵗是辰加巳，巳上加見辰水，謂之害星入垣，能制其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"火。二十七嵗至三十四嵗是巳加巳。三十四嵗至四十　二嵗是巳加午。四十三嵗至四十六嵗是午加午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"四十七嵗至五十二嵗是午加未。以命主入深而論，自一嵗至七嵗，謂之夘加寅，雖坐命於夘，而却一半","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"在寅起，所以夘加寅也。自八嵗至十五嵗，是夘加夘，此伏吟局加盤也。大槩日漸淺而漸深，不可便以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602790952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"淺，便以為深，返旋加減，則命度自明，此則言其大畧也。若行限，則又看中氣，更看在何宫上。如逢職元局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"主卦氣天馬，必能為福。如逢嵗煞刑囚直難，必能為禍，不可一例推之。所謂反覆局互加，既以天門加地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":743,"lineType":2,"content":"户，又以地户加天門。天門屬乾，亥宫也。地户屬㢲，巳宫也。奎初至軫七，軫七至奎初，此理㸃實於中，造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"隠然之妙，正在丑加寅，子加夘，亥加辰，戌加巳，午加酉，申加未。所謂本局互加，亦反覆局例。以寅加辰，次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"第加去，禍福了然。以上加盤，要看星辰對度，消詳取用，以論吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":749,"lineType":9,"content":"辰宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"辰與酉合金為主，巳在前，夘在後，人見其夾拱而相統","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"攝。夘本加辰，辰加巳，兩宫互加於此。亥為通闗反覆。巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986733092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"亥兩宫，禍福最𦂳。宫屬四庫，既無祿馬，又無卦氣，命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"於此六害二體考之禍福翻覆為先，互加次之。此宫立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"命，以太陰為官祿主，以火土為田財主。晝生以土水木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"為三限主。如晝之木土本強，若更處髙明，必合體用。夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"生則量輕重，雖為反曜，而亦無㐫水之用，涉得失難辯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"臨㐫則㐫，遇吉則吉。火星為財，夜見為福，晝則無功。戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛人多為不利，甲已丁人見之為喜。秋令則名利兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"全，夏令則名為利奪。行之陰道，財福最多，居之陽分，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197260863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"多貪吝。如逢水孛，則以為㐫㑹，土計為吉。羅㬋泄財之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，木炁養之，取其得失，與其他宫分不同。中有軫、角、亢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"三宿，木同軫，亦無翼。水在金中，土不為忌。角之一宿，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"主乎春，春月生人，則為有用。如甲乙為干，納音屬木。先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"忌金羅，次嫌火氣，與其他干音又不同。秋冬金強於木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"何有晝夜？以金為首，得其吉用為剛方。若例以㐫神，恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"乖仁義。雖宫有三宿，然主用要明，不可一槩以戰為論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水之為相，是金之水，四時常行之道，晝夜不忌乎土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184496795657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"見土用為三限，得土則金有滋生。若角之為度，是金中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"有木，金柔則木盛，金盛則木衰。此二者皆我家本然之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"物，何以刑戰？但白晝以金木相交，則恐為六悲之害，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"以㐫㫁。其他時候，如金木相去争差，何㐫之有？若角木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"茍以金為忌，則亢金豈以火為財？得失消詳，又當明審。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫坐命生於冬月者，金依太陽，毎行東方艮震之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有躔尾箕於寅，人皆以金騎人馬為忌，此乃星家常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"論。此宫與酉宫金騎人馬不同，酉宫論者，晝見為㐫；辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453162602807336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"宫論者，夜生有禍。晝夜造化，巳别明白，更中間藴奥處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"乃玄中之玄也。且以安命在辰，取上盤之夘加辰；財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"在夘，取上盤之寅加夘；閑極在寅，取上盤之丑加寅。雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"下盤是寅字，而上盤却是丑字，金得天之局，故以為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"若戊庚人有祿馬貴人，以是上盤之貴合下盤之祿馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"此又為竒中之竒，所以為吉。中間體勢皆暗中造化。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"有亥為奴僕，多為官星入格此又分别一段論。亥雖奴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"僕，與命相闗，此為弱中之強也。此宫立命與戌宫相等，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453166914535436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"所貴者奴僕也。葢戌中有已，辰中有亥，與其他安命之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕不同。此宫體勢喜太隂與土同，若太隂在奴僕，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"夘未有土合之，即為妙用。所妙者，以下盤之亥為木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"入上盤之戌為火局。若得土合，是火生土，土生金，身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"相闗，最為大利，故曰得天者貴，得地者富。午為福宫，善","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"惡相半，得其吉用，則曰培植，失之於㐫，反成黨鬼。未為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"官宫，上有午，下有未，名曰六合。為官惟此一宫立命有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"此格，其他宫分無此能知者罕有。如有一星得用在其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986716708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"間，可以得名得祿。若六巳人太隂居未，又為官星，更是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"祿主星，又得上盤之崇勲卦氣，豈不為超倫出世之流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"酉入難宫，辰與酉合，彼此相同。戌宫與八難相𩔖。如見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"難星，只依晝夜生尅而論禍福。金為命元，又為難星，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"可以命宫與八難同論。辰宫乃天涯地角之所，若合以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬，臨以水孛，多是離鄉奔走之人。若交之紫炁，是僧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"道師巫之流也。此宫體勢與四正不同，與六合亦異。偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"之夘，則曰伏吟，偏之已，則為不入局，輕重當自察之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022258195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：辰宫屬金，坐命以金為主，金之一星最闗利害。若飛起入官福二宫，又臨駕登殿入局，無惡星雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"之，則以貴命論。若飛入四宫，更加福祿權財相㑹，而不以暗耗雜之，則以富命論。或在奴僕相貌弱宫，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"無官福權財助之，則以貧賤命論。若坐煞宫，㑹刑囚直難，則以刑夭命論。此宫所忌者火羅，所喜土計也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"土為命母，又為田宅宫主，計乃土餘，所以皆喜也。火為煞星，羅乃火餘，所以皆忌也。雖然喜忌如此，取用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"亦須看守宫加合印䕃何如耳。如火羅雖為煞曜，若混之以土計，則轉禍為福矣。土計雖為恩星，若混之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":875,"lineType":2,"content":"以木炁尅我命母，反助火羅之惡，為禍非輕。若以十二宫輕重言之，無如命宫主之最𦂳也。午為福徳，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"為官禄，日在午為福入福宫，月在未為官居官位，不惟官祿入垣，又是隂陽入廟，最為竒也。或命主居於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"強宫，又與太嵗、宫神、祿馬、天馬、地驛、職元、局主互相管攝，則功名顯赫矣。卯為財帛，火星居之，不為財元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022274579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"入廟，乃是刑曜入垣。酉為八煞，金星臨之，不為難星入垣，乃是八煞有星。合此格者，無有不好。若科名科","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"甲拱夾，愈加其妙。若金星在午，福徳之位，日為福主在巳，月為官禄主在未，謂之日月夾主，又為官福夾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"主，則為福不淺矣。且如王待制，甲申十月初五日寅時生，命在辰，金為主，在寅本居閑極之宫，又臨天馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"未足為榮，葢寅為祿馬之地，天盤以丑加寅，是為坐貴坐祿。若日在夘，月在丑，乃日月夾主星，況日月二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"主又是官福，丑寅夘皆隔一位加見官祿，又是夜生人不背年三十餘官至待制地位。若金在午，羅在巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":893,"lineType":2,"content":"火在未，謂之火羅夾命主。若是六戊六丙生人，以火羅為刑囚，謂之刑囚夾本，主刑害可知天盤已加午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"主犯囚星，以午加未，主為刑星所犯，謂之合處受傷，為害不小，必然刑夭破敗，雖日月夾奚補哉？縱富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"亦須夭折。若寅午戌三合者，有土計居之，可以泄火之㐫，不然已申宫有土，則火能生土，土能生金，又可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022290963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":901,"lineType":2,"content":"挽回春意，以有益於我之金。如土計二星更為祿貴，天馬地驛之𩔖助之，尤為大福也。此辰宫安命，隔一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":903,"lineType":2,"content":"位互加，　一則為天地通局，二為六害局。或有官星祿主、祿星貴人在夘辰、已三位則吉，是夘加辰，辰加巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之天地通闗局。若火羅二星，又為刑囚直難，在夘已二位，亦以夘加辰，辰加巳，俱是刑囚，是火來尅金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之六害局。葢吉星居之，則為天地通闗局，其為福可知。㐫星臨之，則為六害局，其為禍可知。或者不識","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"飛宫𠮓局可以互加，舉一隅則三隅反。又如火星在午，是財星逢旺，亦是刑星逢旺，既為財元坐祿，又為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"刑星破福。既看財元，不當以刑星論。葢火為財元逢旺，若是丁巳生人，祿居午位，乃是財元坐福。坐祿加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":913,"lineType":2,"content":"以土計二星為祿主，權星在寅戌二宫，或在巳未二位，大約三十六嵗行午限，得土計為福祿臨之，必大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵福也。若火為財元逢旺，倘㑹刑囚，難直在午，又是嵗煞之所在。若更生於夏月之時，火神用事，若三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022307347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"六嵗限到午，必然夭折。縱有當生之金在己酉丑三位，亦難救。達者觀之，不待辯而自明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":921,"lineType":9,"content":"巳宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"已宫屬水，此宫安命，謂之諸不入局，亦謂之借局。三位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"互加，與夘未兩宫相闗係。已戌通闗，與戌宫為翻覆。命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"宫加夘，福徳加巳，以巳闗戌，以戌通巳。此宫取用為無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"體局，多以借局用之。借局者，即制局之類也。宫神屬㢲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人，卦氣三限之主，則金火月，以水為命元官祿主，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰為福徳，以木為田宅，以金為財帛，以火為難，以土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022323731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"為忌。水之所主，四時不竭。春夏之水為用淺，秋冬之水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"為用多。冬水秉令，得之多謀術。葢水者，主智之義也。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"之於土為忌害，甲乙命猶庶幾，壬癸人實為鬼。土埋雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"女，見木炁不以為忌。火起髙強，見木炁亦為禍。晝生見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"土不甚為㐫，夜生見火反㐫為吉。四季之土必有悲傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月之火為難太重。土星犯月故以為㐫，火星犯月，晝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"尤利害。土為奴僕，犯命臨身，生來輕賤，雖有基業之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如奴僕奔波。火為疾厄，居身入命，生來多招殘疾，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022340115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"有享用，中年亦主殘傷。金木為田財之主，得晝用則義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"重利輕，得夜用則義輕利重。春水敷榮，秋金堅銳，交以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫神，田財亦利。若冬季生人，水與土計㑹，不可以槩論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"葢主神得令，雖有㐫忌，而反輔衛，居命臨官，却有吉用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"水與金交，是為官財得勝。人有進身於仕宦者，多溺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"貪汙，若水會木星，或生於草茅者，亦篤於文學。水朝太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"陽為官，主朝君，少年科第。水背太陽，為官，星潜伏，老無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"出身。水臨月孛，多貪酒色。水近太陰，多逢官貴。水逢紫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022356499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"炁，勤儉立身，多主僧道。水㑹計都，多能計筭，必熟商賈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水為性，遇㐫則㐫，遇吉則吉。此宫二宿，軫翼居之，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"間水火争差，陰陽迭異。翼火度者，水中之火，火中之水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"亦猶五行丙子丙午得其制化，為水火既濟。冬令則火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"不能勝水，夏令則水不能勝火，黨之木則為火勢，臨之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"金則歸水性。丙丁天干，從火則是壬癸命者，取水為先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"若行火令，臨以木炁，是為助難，五六月生，直難𠔥具。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"行水令，㑹以金星，是為生官，冬臘生人，名利兼全。此翼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022372883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"之一宿，乃火之經，復乃水之度，火在中間，以此為之火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"度。合以水星主其本，次以火星求其用。先取時令之強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，次驗人命之緩急。但以水為用，必無差。火之為用，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"明輕重。若行失勢，是謂本主衰㣲。火行得助，是難星火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"熾。中間得失，務要詳察，不可輕㫁。官福二宫，在於申未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"此為要地。如水與月同行，為官福交會，未申通闗，官中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"有福，福中有官。若有一宫得吉，前後俱利。一星為㐫，彼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"此受灾。雖各宫分别，而實相維。未宫亦與已相統攝。申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022389267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"乃官宫，已乃命宫，禍福徃來，可以取驗。申乃水垣吉臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"之官局，㐫則破我官祿，戌宫疾厄翻覆之宫也。下盤乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，上盤乃申子辰，失其用則為疾厄受刑，得其用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"則為通闗有吉。若火土臨之，是火生土，土尅我水也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"三合有金水，反成申子辰水局。上盤加申，與官宫相闗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"係，下盤是戌，與已相徃來。此宫極𦂳，不可緩也，最宜明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"辯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1023,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：巳宫屬水，安命於此，謂之借局，亦謂之諸不入局。隔三位互加，夘為閑極，午為相貌，兩宫雖為怒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022405651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1027,"lineType":2,"content":"陷，實與命宫官祿暗有相闗。水星在午、夘二位，盡是陷弱，為福必難。安知水在午，午加申，皆是水位。水在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1029,"lineType":2,"content":"夘，夘加巳，水星入垣，亦為水臨雙女。若癸酉、癸丑之人，帶此多𤼵達。水在午，午加申，官祿主坐長生，不惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1031,"lineType":2,"content":"命主入垣，亦是官星得局。若六庚生人，水為祿主，乃是祿主居窠，申宫又為嵗殿之所在，必少年騰踏，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1033,"lineType":2,"content":"加盤之妙，能知弱處之強，緩中之急。未為福徳之宫，月居之，為月居月位，福入福宫。若六己六丁生人，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1035,"lineType":2,"content":"祿主福星，為福尤𦂳。孛星在上，為太乙抱蟾，六乙生人得之，為祿居祿位。若兼之以木炁、天馬、地驛、職元、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1037,"lineType":2,"content":"局主之𩔖，乃上貴人也。六丁生人得之，是身犯囚星，若混之以土計四星直難，又是橫夭之命矣。酉為遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1039,"lineType":2,"content":"移之宫，水居之，乃水命金局。金星在申，謂之金水互垣，官星命主有氣。六辛生人，祿在遷移，丙丁生人，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1041,"lineType":2,"content":"在遷移。若有木星在丑酉亥宫照命，多是文章顯達之人，否則離祖榮身也。戌為八煞之宫，水星臨之，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022422035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1045,"lineType":2,"content":"主居疾厄。火入命宫為難，星與命主互垣，水火互換，未免抱病壓身，更加土計在寅午拱主，又是庚申生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1047,"lineType":2,"content":"人，為害不小。若木炁在夘亥二位，夘加已，已加未，又見木炁長火之惡，若無救解，則是抱薪救火，帶此者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1049,"lineType":2,"content":"多主利害惡死，否則手足傷殘，六根不具，子為奴僕之宫。水星在上，謂之主入旺鄉，又是主居陷弱，善惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"難辯。若與金星同居，更於冬月水神用事，謂之逢旺得局。若與火土同居，更生於夏月火土用事，我命水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1053,"lineType":2,"content":"未免有傷，不可一槩而論。若太隂居之，主是偏生庶出。若癸生人，孛羅為福祿夾拱偏官。右選造化葢已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1055,"lineType":2,"content":"宫所喜者金星母星也，財帛官主也。所忌者火星八煞宫主也，土計也，煞星也。金在巳謂之財元逢生，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1057,"lineType":2,"content":"水同宫，謂之金水㑹蛇。水在未，謂主居福徳，與月同居謂之水涵月魄。水在申，謂之官星入垣。月在申謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1059,"lineType":2,"content":"之身居官祿，福入官宫。月在申，水在未，謂之官福互垣，皆是妙用造化。土星在巳，謂之土埋雙女。火星在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022438419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1063,"lineType":2,"content":"已，謂之難星入命。火土在巳，為刑難作黨。土在未，謂之刑星破福加入命宫。土在申謂之刑星破官祿。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1065,"lineType":2,"content":"在子，土在巳，為命主，與奴僕互垣。或水土皆在遷移之宫，必死於道路，皆是刑夭之命。若是丁生人，以金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1067,"lineType":2,"content":"為祿主，乙生人，以金為福主，必大𤼵福矣。如韓丞相八月十五日夘時生人，坐命在巳，祿又在巳，命坐祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1069,"lineType":2,"content":"水為命主，為官星，為祿元在巳，滿三用皆入垣。月為福徳主在亥，乃戴天履地格，正是日月拱，官福合作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1071,"lineType":2,"content":"一品之命。有火為難星，守辰宫臨駕，是為客曜臨朝。水與太陽同宫，坐汨没煞，則主多磨障。凡福星得地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1073,"lineType":2,"content":"得局，臨駕攀殿居驛馬，皆要吉星臨之，為官則一生享福。若有刑星臨之，必為刑煞之所制，縱為仕宦亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1075,"lineType":2,"content":"蹇滯，宜斟酌輕重論之，則不為按圖索驥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1077,"lineType":9,"content":"午宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022454803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"午為離明之地，四正之宫，四位通闗，夘加午，午通酉，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"為對宫。宫神惟六已，人卦氣崇勲，四正互加，官祿為𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"此午未隷於天，故為日月，子丑隷於地，故為土。寅申已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"亥乃四時運乎其間，則為木火金水，秉春夏秋冬之令，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"午為君𧰼，此宫安命與他宫不同。虚昴房不可以太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"為主，惟星日馬為正度，以日為主，金水為官福、財帛，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"木為難，又以日木、土為三方主。以四序而言，晝以木土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"别其用，夜以金星為權，秋令得金官星秉令，冬令得水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022471187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"財星旺夜，不為㐫。晝金用淺，以水、土、木為文經，以金火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"為武畧，得水、土、木為人必賢良，得金、火、羅、計人多勇略。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫取用與其他宫分立命不同，此宫人多以火、羅、計、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"孛為嫌，然太陽當空，羣㐫自伏，雖然火羅亦不敢形見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫之於諸曜，用金水為官福，日木、土為三限主，人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之，木、土、金、水皆有用，得其吉可為吉星之助，得其㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"即為㐫星之忌。如木星多不得用，獨日生用為三限主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"如火、羅、計、孛居子午，人多以為嫌。且以羅、計中分五宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022487571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"是首尾相截之𩔖，人命得之，豈可為忌論？而多有超達","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"者，何也？午猶人君之位，人君居位，固親賢宰輔，尤不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"以無武將以衛之。若人命有火、羅、計、孛臨子午，多是操","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"略之人。如體段稍大，即為貴格。更加善星臨巳午未申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫，㐫星合命，此乃吉星為助，㐫星為衛也。如此必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"制閫之權，非小小守土官也。申為福徳，已為財帛，二者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"徃來吉㐫相應。人徒知巳與申之類，不知夘加午，則寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"加已、巳加申，所以申巳二宫可以通闗用。若有吉臨，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022503955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"為生我福徳，助我財帛。或有㐫破之，又為寅刑巳，巳刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"申，三刑六害之𩔖也。酉為官祿，最為𦂳地，在上盤則午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"加酉，在翻覆則午酉通闗。是命中有官，官中有命，二不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"可捨。金星入垣，多行於春夏之際，白晝見之，或㑹太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"氣𧰼亦可。中間却不以金星失令而遇伏，或得朝陽，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"可言貴，雖然為官，終有讒謗。金居田宅，田宅多居秋冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"之際，夜中見之，更㑹太隂，主名利兼全。秋金主富人多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"義氣剛方。冬金主殺人，有精敢強勇。金生於巳，居官多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022520339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"主貪汙。金絶於寅，為官必主激駁。若金水得經，十分純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"粹，然亦可為富厚之命。亥為疾厄，是以木為難星，於九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"月十月木星髙強，臨官福命宫三合，人多疾厄。若臨於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"疾宫，是為難星入難，為灾尤甚。紫炁者，木之餘，同木取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁，惟白晝見之，雖忌亦小可，或臨於日月之中，及福祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫，中年多殘疾。秋冬生金，主令木衰，又不能為害，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"合處見金，亦如是也。若夜生太陰，與木相值，終不為竒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"更諸㐫忌，是身臨難，終有患害。有命居午，金星入命，太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022536723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"隂居官，身入官宫，官星入命，當為公相。又有命居午，本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"月在申，此乃寅刑已，已刑申，三刑俱動，難主臨身，安得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"不死於法。此則眼前之善惡已自分明。更入太陰，在戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"加未。日為命主，入酉加午。太陽得上盤之午，太隂得上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"盤之未，是日月尊強，得天者貴。此格千中無一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1181,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：午為日宫，坐命於此，以日為主，是為四正之體。且日在子午夘酉四位互加，皆是入廟。葢子有虚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1183,"lineType":2,"content":"午有星，夘有房，酉有昴，四宫皆有日，乃為四正，互加四位。若有殿駕祿貴在上，更兼身命二主，天馬地驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1185,"lineType":2,"content":"臨之，左右拱夾，繼以金水為官福㑹馬，此乃出將入相之格。或孛羅二曜為福為權拱夾，必兼殺伐之權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022553107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1189,"lineType":2,"content":"日為命主，喜金水二星互垣互局，對日宫行。若是金居金局，水入水鄉，此為入格，為官福入垣。或金在申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1191,"lineType":2,"content":"水在酉，又為官福互垣。若身命二主更居官祿福徳之位，臨駕攀殿，又坐貴祿，無雜星以混之，則為大貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1193,"lineType":2,"content":"造化。若身命二主居官祿之宫，不臨殿駕，兼火羅在申酉二位，六丙六乙生人逢之，亦未得為全美矣。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1195,"lineType":2,"content":"金水日在巳，六丙六戊生人，是命主與官福坐祿，亦是仕宦之命。或金水日在酉，更為竒特。若金水日在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1197,"lineType":2,"content":"夘尤妙，更兼安身在酉，是身居官祿，又是日月拱命主。若丙生人駕在子，貴在酉，可為日月拱駕。四位互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1199,"lineType":2,"content":"加，皆是臨駕入局，更加天馬地驛不背，亦是公相之命。且如虞學士乙未四月二十九日午時生，午上安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1201,"lineType":2,"content":"命日為命主在酉，以酉加午謂之升殿。金為官星，化福日為命主，三元上下二盤皆入廟，旺月與火同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1203,"lineType":2,"content":"在戌，以戌加未，又是月居月位，日月升宫。況未生人，未為殿駕，月為嵗星，火為嵗徳，戌未相加，二星臨駕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022569491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"朝垣，是謂嵗徳朝垣，火月升殿。合此格者，少年及第，名冠天下。此酉戌二位與午未本無相涉，而大有相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"闗，以日在酉，月在戌，人皆以為反背晦明矣。然焉知午加酉，未加戌，皆是日月升殿，此乃加盤之妙也。已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1211,"lineType":2,"content":"為財帛之宫，水在已為財元入廟，土星臨之，害我財帛。水在申為福星入垣，土在申破我福徳。若金在夘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1213,"lineType":2,"content":"水在酉，皆加入命宫。日在午為命主入垣，官福左右夾命。日在子，駕在子，為命主臨駕，官福拱命。拱駕皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1215,"lineType":2,"content":"是上格之命，若六庚六丁生人見之更妙。日在子，火在申，羅在辰，謂之火羅拱命。六乙六丙生人見之更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"毒，不可不知也。亥為疾厄之宫，命主臨之，是主居八煞，俱為不足。然則日為命主，乃人君之𧰼，雖遇火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1219,"lineType":2,"content":"計孛，皆不足慮。所慮者木炁二星，木為難曜，炁為木餘如臨照身命，實足為害。日為宫主，與木同居，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"命主犯難，炁星亦然。九月十月生人，為害愈重，不然生於春月，木神用事，必致橫禍。日與木在巳，又是寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022585875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1225,"lineType":2,"content":"生寅時，寅上是煞宫，巳上是月煞，直難刑囚居之，為害尤重。若木在申，身命在申在巳，是皆寅來刑已，巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"來刑申，是為三刑局，合此格者皆刑徒命也。且如晏頭陀，壬寅七月二十四日寅時生，寅刑巳，巳刑申，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1229,"lineType":2,"content":"三刑局命也，不合土水火孛在命，水為囚直，與火土孛戰於命宫，安得不死於非命？葢享賊首之福，是全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1231,"lineType":2,"content":"為官星在巳，逢生坐貴㑹命主，所以享福而終為惡死。今略舉其一　二，乃知加盤之妙，亦知四正局為福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1233,"lineType":2,"content":"三刑局為禍。或木為難在夘，加入命宫，謂之難星，逢旺入命，必為灾矣。若生當冬月之時，水神得地，及與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1235,"lineType":2,"content":"水同居，六戊生人以木為囚，又見水星得時而長，木之囚惡更加身命主星，坐煞逢傷，必死於牢獄，或傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1237,"lineType":2,"content":"殘手足眼目，而為廢人方免，不然或病風癱而死。若木不與水同居，而與金相㑹，七八月生人，秋金用事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1239,"lineType":2,"content":"金神剛健，木被金傷，木自謀巳，不暇傷人，則木不能為害也。若火與木同宫，乃是旺在夘，雖入命宫，如六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855523022602259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1243,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生人，以火星為祿，木星為福。祿元馬元。遇五六月生人，火星當權，是木難化為福，以生權星祿主之火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"反能為福也。造化之妙，須看飛宫變局為要。或貴人為煞所制伏，或煞為貴人之驅馳，亦是多凶少吉，孰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1247,"lineType":2,"content":"重孰輕，禍福如見，以此㫁之，毫髪無差也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kxyd0/1-SK1609_figure_00032.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=aVWuCl3aFC%2F3Nie4aIt2TJjnfLc%3D","pictureHeight":306,"pictureWidth":317,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kxyd0/1-SK1609_figure_00032.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3LThy5BvpOr1QqsxKk8otHrCZMQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kxyd0/1-SK1609_figure_00032.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹屬太陰，命坐於此，乃四墓之地，禄馬不臨，卦氣不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"在，本與申宫相闗，坤為卦氣，有無善惡與申相應。凡安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"命於未，為三合之體，正則為三合，偏則為四正，又偏為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679654921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"不入局，偏正稍異，則取用不同。所重者太陰乃身主也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"以火、金、月為之局主。火為官星，金為福徳，太陽為財，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"為難星，月為金火，皆同功一體，夜生用之。火金㑹月，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生為福最𦂳，是為官福㑹身。金星近月，是為長庚伴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"月。經云：金星伴月常屬曉，迎朔相逢事業弘。此金、月火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"體用最大，盖未屬陰，以陰屬陰，以陰類陰，其用備矣。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"火金月㑹於白晝，故為晝生夜𫟚陰陽，然終為三限交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"聨，特其軟弱，不可謂之凶忌。太陽與金為田財主，若白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184454869055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"晝逢之為吉，此又是金水輔陽，土之為難，遇在晝陰消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"陽長之時，不能為灾，得其吉助。茍夜生逢土計難，必為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"灾厄。若得木炁制之，尤為庶幾。或以火羅助，其禍必速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"人命見之，不惟灾厄傷身，亦且壽年不久。此宫三宿，井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"之一宿二十餘度，臨於秦州。此宫以亥卯未為木局，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"井度屬木，故當以木神主之，中間又不可全用木。木星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"秉春月之令，晝生合從木用，不可言太陰也。其他時節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"難以一體用之，惟以太陰為主最𦂳。太陰本夜生，三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679638537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"主也。又以宫神主之。以三方歸太陰為主，更太陰歸陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"方，是太陰功用，豈可分毫離太陰？茍捨太陰而從木，斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"皆背陰反陽之義。鬼金一宿，與井相與已近。金為福主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜常在乎其間，秋冬時節與金相干者，安可棄乎？金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"栁土一宿，與井鬼又差殊。不以土為難，不以火為忌，羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"孛得之者亦無患。喜獨行輔於命。此宫命者，但是土星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"髙强則為忌，若土星入命，不足為凶。盖命宫以卯加未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"男女宫以亥加卯，遷移宫以未加亥。三合上下皆是木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442382370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"局，土星臨之稍緩，與三合見木炁，亦是一般道理。但恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"夜在三合宫，又有火合土，反成木生火，火生土，其人不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"免於殘夭。此三合為體，而以三合取禍福，通闗翻覆，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"其次也。此三合者，與亥宫坐命體勢稍同，上下十二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為三合中翻覆，與命宫相統攝。亥中又與未善惡相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"闗，雖異而實同。福徳在酉，與財帛通闗，凶吉往來當審","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"之。巳酉丑乃福徳之合，金居其上，是福徳星得局，當有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"興廢。木星居三合之上，則木入金局，人命值之，多主破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679671305"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，雖有鎡基，亦歸消散。火星臨福徳之三合，夜生則火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"有情，晝生則破我福徳，又不可以官星論，盖火入金局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。戌為官禄，夜火顯用，官髙名重。晝火無光，有官不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"顯。夏令得時，為官愈熾。水孛合火，多是驕恣以敗亡。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"炁合火，多是清亷而見用。戌之一宫，與巳相翻覆，但恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中無星，巳中有曜，是暗中有害，即不可救。雖寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"合，得吉相輔，是外助不能制內惡，忌子宫疾厄之為難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"土計臨子，是難星入垣。若是身臨鬼地者，不可一槩言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197359167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。如子生人六，戊生人六，癸生人有太陰，乃身命入在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"子宫，雖是身入難鄉，却是子生人嵗駕，戊生人卦氣，癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"生人崇勲，此三者又不可以為忌。但以大限土計相逼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之身衰遇鬼。依此禍福，斷然不差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：未宫生人，以月為主，所闗二用，以月為命主，亦以月為身主。如命主飛起坐煞，而身主亦是坐煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫坐命乃三合局。地月在夘，又加夘在未，是月到月宫。未加亥，亥加未，亦是月入月宫。三位互加，此其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"為三合局也。午為財帛宫，太陰在午，謂之身居財帛。太陽在未，謂之財元入命，亦謂財命互垣，亦是身主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"入命，命主入身，此為内外臺格，切不可謂陰陽反背，但取身命互垣，俱為貴命。若甲午巳未生人，得此格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442480674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"者愈好。甲午生人，未為貴宫，午為嵗駕，是身命主臨駕，身命主坐崇勲，此則富貴雙全大格局也。若火計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"在午，土孛在未，六丙六丁生人，以火孛為囚，以土計為煞，臨身照命，禍不可言，是為客曜臨朝，飛星破禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"合此格者，必是凶惡之人。如戌限加合，皆是刑囚、破敗、傷、殘，甚至死於非命。如格局布定一星稍異，理皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"不同。巳為兄弟之宫，太陰在上，謂之身居閑極，夜生帶於格局，反添福德，日生不然。若有福禄主權星，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"元居之，謂之身命合財帛。有刑囚直難居之，又是身命夾煞星。凡夾福夾禄皆為福，夾刑夾難皆為禍。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"六丙六戊生人，崇勲在巳，是身宫命主坐崇勲。天盤以巳加酉，丙禄又加福徳，福入禄宫，福禄雙全，皆是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴之命。酉戌二宫最闗利害。酉為福徳之宫，月在酉上，謂之身命坐福徳。金為福主，又為母星飛入命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，不惟宫主與福星互垣，亦是身命二主互垣，又合内外二臺格。若六丁六丙生人帶之坐貴愈佳，更加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479677477"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"殿駕天馬地驛職元局主居上，乃是𡖖相之格。若是寅申巳亥生人，的煞在酉，為禄逢破碎又減力。戌為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄之宫，月在上，謂之身命二主坐官禄。或六丙六丁生人，又是二貴夾官禄，二貴夾身宫。若火為官星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"與身主飛入未宫，是命主官星互垣，亦合内外臺格，須是登殿臨駕，坐貴坐福禄，方為竒特。子為八煞之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，月居之，是身居疾厄。土乃月之所忌，盖月為命主，最忌土、計二主。如土計在亥夘二宫，照命加入命宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"若六戊、六丙、六壬、六庚生人，不為福禄拱命，乃是刑難拱命，雖有吉星拱夾，亦是貧夭造化。如戊子生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"卦氣在子，月臨之，不為身居疾厄，是身臨嵗駕。卦氣若是金為福星在寅，火為官星在戌，正合漏闗格局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"此格尤佳，又不可以疾厄論也。日在夘，月在亥，謂之日月朝命，日月夾官福身命主登駕坐殿臨卦，皆是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"有福有禄之命。若刑囚夾命，或拱夾直難，便是貧賤之格。如蔡樞宻己丑十二月二十七日申時生，太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197424703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":2,"content":"在子，太陰在寅，嵗駕在丑。金為福星在寅，火為官星在丑，日月夾官星，日月夾嵗駕。金在寅，木星怒宫，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"為福星加入官宫，火為官星加入福宫，謂之官福互垣。月居官福，日月拱夾，豈不為大貴之命。若日月居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"奴僕，福星既陷，則不大貴，所謂誰信無中還有曜，豈知弱處是髙强。若加臨有凶星破之，又不可以貴命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"言也。如星命坐殿駕㑹刑囚難直，而官福俱陷，若加盤又有殿駕，禄馬貴人卦氣聚㑹，亦可以貴命言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"若月在辰坐田宅，如金在巳，火在夘，官福宫主夾身。若木在丑，六甲六乙生人見之科名照命，大約三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"六嵗行酉限，得官星禄主福星科名交照，行此酉限，其人英雄傑特無疑。若身命皆坐煞㑹刑囚直難，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"福禄權俱陷，必主剥雜無成。如太陰在辰，土計在寅午二宫，大約三十七嵗入戌限，寅加午，午加戌，戌加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"寅，皆犯土計必以刑夭斷之。若於加合中得金木解救則免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986831396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":9,"content":"申宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
