{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"申乃水垣，以水為先，申屬坤，乙癸生人，卦氣水命得之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"為長生。此宫為諸不入局，惟與未通闗，雖所屬與已相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖，然體用與已不同。已宫以太陰為三限。古人云：夜忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"土星晝忌火，若見三方尤較可。此宫與他不同，以木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"官星，以月為財帛，以水為田宅，以火為福徳，以土為難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"且巳申皆屬水，在巳命者忌土為重，申宫命者忌土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"輕。又以未與申皆以土為難，在未者以土為重，在申以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479644709"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"土為輕。盖巳未二宫屬陰，取土為直難，申宫屬陽，取土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"為三限中之一物，是以不甚為忌。生於晝者多以為得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"更如本命干音屬金，命居申宫，以土計為得其所養，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生以土計為凶，申之忌土計不如未已二宫之甚。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"月為田財，夜生得用，生理厚實。水火為官福，晝則喜木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"夜則喜火。若春令木强，是官星乘勢，雖為金制，終不損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"之，得官必顯達。夏令火炎，是福星得地，雖為水制，亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"為失，得此者福氣尤重。此宫為局，本水之長生地，與絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479661093"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"處之水又不同，土不能勝，木不能泄，遇金亦熾，遇火亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"熱，四時不竭。此宫四宿居之，參宿固與宫神相類，畢雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰偏垣，亦乃水之精，觜火半度，乃水中之火，合從水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"主。井之一宿屬木，申子辰木星亦三限之主，或甲乙人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"及納音木人皆可從木用，其餘干音皆可從水為主，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"以木得時則從木用，立命於井者，但晝生逢金為凶，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不足為忌。當春夏之月，此時木盛火炎，金神消爍，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"是金髙，何懼之有？若時秋冬，金行東南，井木固忌之，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184496877577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"生於夜望，又不為凶，是金火無夜忌，木土無晝凶之理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"此說明矣。今有戊己庚辛命者，在參畢為命度中間或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"得之為福。盖晝生見之多𤼵，夜生遇之亦有小灾。其間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"須尋太陰所躔如何，若太陰居陽分，雖有土計亦無傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"恐太陰居陰分，則土計非我家。三方主是相霄壌，諸宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"最切者，戌亥子丑數宫，自命而交，相貌通闗午酉又當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"取午宫之得失。戌為福徳，與巳相表裏，田宅福徳，來往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"實重。戌為火局，申為水局，水臨戌，一則失其本領，二則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197375551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"破我福徳。上盤巳酉丑金局，固能生水，是又傷下盤寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌之火，若得木星合之，水隨木化，反凶為吉。亥為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，木居之為官主入垣，火居之為變官為福。乃以亥夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"未為木局，以官禄為上盤，午字却成寅午戌火局，縱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"金星破官禄，亦不為破。有一火則火制，無火亦有火局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"可用。盖以木生火，火尅金故也。子之遊行，上盤是未，諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨之為得體，以未宫太陰之垣也。故不為身入鬼鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"是子之土又不能傷申之水，有未字為天盤木局也。丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679622153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"乃土，本傷水，又以命宫之申加丑，是為命主就鬼，此乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"申命加卯，則八煞加申，丑為八煞，是下之丑對上盤之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"申。若有木炁在三合，巳酉丑。又制之於命宫三合，申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。猶為喜，所以此宫體勢與巳宫不同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"𤼵明云：申宫安命，以水為主，已宫安命，亦以水為主。巳與申合，俱屬水命，雖相類，而官福之𩔖不同。申上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"安命為諸不入局，又名借局。隔六位互相加，内無奴僕疾厄。夘為奴僕之宫，若水在夘，本為陷弱，以夘加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"申，是水居水位，命主入垣。丑為疾厄之宫，若水在丑，本為失位，以丑加申，亦是水入水宫，命主入垣。或命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"主水星飛起，登殿臨駕，入局坐貴禄馬，互換有情，與宫神太嵗暗加闗攝，則為富貴之命。若命主水星飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184496893961"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"入煞宫，㑹刑囚直難互換無情，將重易輕，無有闗攝，則為貧賤之命。此宫所喜者，金為母，月為財帛，木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄，火為福徳。所忌者，土為煞星，又為疾厄。計乃土餘，為害一也。或土計二星在當要處，臨照身命，必為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"禍媒。若大限見之，必然為灾，輕則壓身破相，重則傷己戕生。如根基壮厚，福氣雍容，又得木炁加合解破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"其禍稍輕。若根基淺薄，必然夭折，更加流年惡星黨之，決定刑害，死於非命。未為財帛之宫，水居之謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"命主坐財，月居之謂之財星入垣。或水星在巳居田宅，亦謂之水星入垣。或金星在巳，乃是金水㑹蛇，命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"主逢生。或金水日月居午位，不可為身，命主居閑，極是子母日月同宫，此金月雖化為刑囚無害，若化為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"福禄尤佳。如行限逢金月，六丁生人必大𤼵福，更加禄馬官魁，科名科甲，則富貴自來逼人。如命上水星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"在巳，或與日月同宫，或日月拱夾，或官福入垣得局，或官入官宫，福居福位，或官福互垣，或身坐禄，或登","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184496943113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"殿，或守時籍，或㑹科名、科甲、魁星，則當期以大貴。如許狀元戊子七月初一日丑時生，安命在申，月在未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"水在巳，為身命入垣坐禄。木在亥，火在戌，官福入垣。身命與官福俱在髙强，入廟入垣。水為禄元，木為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"星拱身，火又為魁星得位加入身命，豈不為大魁乎？所忌者，土為難星在子，孛為忌星在疾，厄難加入命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"位。羅在巳，計在亥照身，所以不得其壽矣。辰為男女之宫，金星在巳，水星逢金生，又來同宫，謂之母附子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"子顧母格，子母相生有情，極為竒特。或水在夘，火在申，水火互垣不相交戰，是命主與奴僕互垣交戰無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"情，不能安享。或有禄貴殿駕居之，福禄臨之，終欠享福。或月在寅，火計在巳，謂之身犯四刑，又名土計拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"身命。或寅申巳亥四位上，又是七煞，即亡神也。刼煞、陽刃、嵗煞之宫，亦為刑害之命。若月在亥，日水在巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"又為錦上添花。那更火星在未，木在夘，官福俱入明地，福居庫位，是官福拱身。命木在夘，不可謂官星坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506615808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"奴僕，此是逢旺入廟，加起入命。若生於春月，官星愈顯。但防生於秋月，金神得時令，又在寅夘之上，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"官星受傷，難以為福。如水星在戌，不為水泛白羊，是主居福徳。若火星入命，又為福主，與命主互垣。或天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"馬不背職元，局主髙强。或臨身命，則主功名富貴矣。遷移子宫土位，為水旺之所，水星在上，逢生旺則吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"受尅制則凶。或生於冬月，水神得地，是為水星逢旺。或壬辰、癸巳、丙子、丁丑生人，水旺在子，子為帝座之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，丙子帶之尤妙，乃為命主臨帝座之宫，又得日月左右夾之，可以三台八座格局，不謂之主星受傷。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"生於辰、戌丑、未之月，土神得局之時，子上又嵗煞陽刃所破，乃是命主受傷，為貧賤之命。或水在丑坐八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"煞以申加丑，亦是命主入垣。如土居丑位，又不可為命主入垣。論帶此格者，多廢疾之人。如福主居其位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"反能為福。此吉凶相對，歸之於福，則以貴論；歸之於凶，則以貧斷。須分輕重論之，萬無一失矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197441087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":9,"content":"酉宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫坐命，以反吟為體。卯加酉，酉加卯，卯火來制金，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"受火制，卯酉相對，是為反吟。有四破、四正。四破者，火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛，居子午卯酉是也。四正者，如日月官禄居子午卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"酉是也。四正未分俱福，四破未分俱禍。當觀局之變處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"輕重如何。此宫丁生人，卦氣屬兊，立命忌火羅，喜土計，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"用巳酉丑金局，以土計居之為生我，則得地明矣。且以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫金主也。金火月三限主也，水日，田財二主也，木土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442398754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"官福主也。火為鬼，木為難。如土星得用四季為吉，得之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"為官髙禄厚。水日為田財，白晝見之，田財必厚。木為福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，春令有情，得之為利。秋冬無情，見之為害。一木兩用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡當分。但以晝生終有情，夜生終無用。茍或九月、十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"月之際，為直難兼行，加以水孛，即為助虐。惟火與金，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"則為主，一則為鬼。若巳、酉丑金火月，取則如何？且金星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"乃命主也，火賊也，金遇火則失勢，然有得失存焉。古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"人以金火月為三限主，是以陰從陰之義也。但火金二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685572148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"勢不可兩立，如春月金行西北，此宫命者白晝見之，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"時金勢尚柔，不能無患，春金誠為忌火。夏月金行午未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"間，如晝生見之，火秉權，金必衰也。若火金相刑，戰有勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"負，則金果失時。若火金相去隔逺，三合無相干犯，又可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"捨金星而從火用，何也？盖夏月生人，以火秉令，此一不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"可去也。又金火月為三限主，二不可去也。限度望火反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"為祥，望金反為禍。至於秋月，金臨辰巳之間，如秋中見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"之，其時金又司令，火不能勝。如秋冬生命臨金分，此乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506632192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"金星得時，不貴亦富，縱金不得地，命亦安强。冬月金行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"丑寅之左右，時冬陰凍冽，木葉凋零，金星主殺，水星司","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"令，金水相依，水强火伏，金星又勝，火金相合，亦可無凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫三宿，胃以土為經，土為金母，土星為官，豈可多從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"土斷？且木火亦時得時失，亦宜以宫主交叅用之，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"偏用。昴宿雖曰太陽，只從金用。畢月宿取太陰，亦有憑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"據，且以陰從陰，金火月三限主也，亦命度主也。太陰為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"先，金為次，雖以月為主，晝生亦貴乎金，夜生不嫌晝火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479628325"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"甚忌。諸宫最切亥子，以至於寅，戌加於辰，亥加於已，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"禄於子，四正往來。若陽刃加刑，中年多主反覆，初主有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"變。若四正無凶星，陽刃有吉曜臨之，則為富貴。癸卯、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"酉子，己卯午，己酉駕，丁卯午，丁酉駕，此六命人者，官禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉，盖有崇勲卦氣在此四正為得也。丑為遷移，土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"主，以未加丑，是未墓木制土，太陰居之為吉地。寅宫乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄，木居之為凶。若是以火合木，是火得寅午戌之局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"而犯疾厄，其禍尤甚。此宫取用與四正伏吟則異，而大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184454852671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"體有與之相闗者，可以𩔖取也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"發明云：酉為金旺之地，此宫安命，反吟為體。反吟者，是夘加酉，酉加夘。夘屬火，酉屬金，火來制金，金受火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"制，夘酉二位所以為反吟也。此局往來七位互加，又為四破局，又為四正局。火羅刑囚在子午夘酉，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"四破局也。日月官禄在子午夘酉，則為四正局也。曰破為禍，曰正為福，更看局之變處輕重何如以用之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"此宫以金為主，土計，我之命母，火羅我之忌星也。若寅午戌三位，火羅居之，是直鬼賊交横要路，他既得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"地，我必受制矣。更混之以木炁，則為禍尤酷，是黨惡也。若混之以土計，則又反禍為祥，乃是誘火羅為福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"也。更看所守者何星，若金與火羅同宫，必為禍。若金與土計同宫，必為福。如命主在辰，辰乃奴僕之宫，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"居金位，命主入垣，金星得地，不以為弱。火星在戌，辰加戌，戌加辰，俱是刑星。若水在辰，金反生水，水能尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184454885439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":451,"lineType":2,"content":"火，是生子禦宼。若金在午，土在子，午加子，子加午，土能生金，金主失位逢生互換往來，皆見官禄。金在巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"水在亥，亥加巳，巳加亥，金為命主，木為福星，互換往來，此貴命也。若木在巳，土在午，巳加亥，福星入垣。午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"加子，官星入垣。福居福位，官入官宫，豈不美哉？如安墩御史，壬午十二月二十六日午時生，日在子，月在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"丑，土在巳，木在午，安命在酉。金主在亥，身主在巳。亥天門也，巳地戸也。天門加地戸，地戸加天門，身命主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":459,"lineType":2,"content":"戴天履地。況壬禄在亥，嵗貴在巳，禄貴相加。土為官星在巳，木為福星在午。巳加亥，官入福宫。午加子，福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"入官宫。官福互垣日在子，子加午，日居日位。月在丑，丑加未，月居月位。陰陽升殿，官福互垣。三元得地。經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"云：三元得地，為上品之公𡖖，日月升宫，乃百官之領袖，豈不為御史乎？此乃加合隠中之妙。若月在丑，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"在子，若己酉、己夘、丁酉生人，禄在日，正命臨嵗，駕日月拱之。或命主更乘天馬地驛，職元局主亦佳。若六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685555764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生人，太嵗為禄主加在午，月為禄主在子，土為官星在酉，木為福星在夘，夘加酉，互加皆見官福照命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"子加午，官禄加禄，官星坐禄。午加子，崇勲官禄，官主入垣，此乃宰相公𡖖地位。如官魁拱命，福禄夾身，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄拱身，福禄夾身，或日月拱殿，陰陽拱駕，或身命拱駕，官福夾駕，日月夾垣，陰陽拱帝座，皆是大富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"命。如或刑囚拱命，難直夾身，或刑囚拱身夾命，或客曜臨朝，飛星守駕，則為凶惡命也。申為財帛之宫，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"星居之，是財元入廟，月居之，是身居財帛。若六巳生人，月為禄位，又為禄主臨財。寅為疾厄之宫，木星居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"之為難星入垣，月居之為身居八煞。若九月十月生人，木為直星，必多疾病。那更火在申，申加寅，寅加申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"加入八煞，所以寅申之宫相闗也。若六丙生人，以火為囚，又為囚星㑹直，難㑹刑星加之身宫，守於煞位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"若金更在申宫，或在午戌之地，為災非小，必主惡死。未為閑極之宫，月居之，一為身主入垣，二為身居閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685604916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"極，三為身命夾財帛。甲戊生人，丑未為貴人之地，未加丑，丑加未，互換貴人得局。六辛生人，若月在夘，辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"禄居酉，謂之衝干對禄，又為佳也。若金在戌，戌屬火，金乘火位，以辰加戌，辰屬金，又為金乘火位，命主受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"傷則為害矣。水為財星在子，六庚生人為禄主，為財元逢旺。木為福徳主在辰，三合申子辰命主復坐子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"位，禄主之水又生辰上福徳之木，所謂福禄相生，豈不為妙。儻火為刑星，飛來寅位，寅來加申，又有木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"助之，雖然命主之金、禄主之水、福主之木，本來竒特，豈知寅上之火加入申，則是命主之金生禄主之水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"禄主之水生福徳主之木，福徳之木生刑星之火，尅我命主之金，雖有福禄又為無補，是謂抱薪救火，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"焚其身。若土計在午戌二位，以泄火氣，火衰而金旺，可以挽囬春意。戊人以土為禄，壬人以計為禄，則彌佳矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":9,"content":"戌宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453175986815012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"戌以火為主，以六合為體，六位互加，一無奴僕，二無疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"厄，以戌亥相闗乃翻覆之義。卯為疾厄，命宫加卯，此加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"盤之義。卯之闗係尤輕，巳之闗係尤重。此宫無禄馬無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣，先以翻覆觀之，以制為後。諸宫以奴僕為輕，惟辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"戌二宫為重，二宫之奴僕，戌宫奴僕又重於辰宫奴僕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"也。戌宫以日木土為三限，以土為官主，金月為田，財星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"他宫立命，身居田宅福輕。此宫以太陰居未為身入格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"若太陰不在未，但得居寅亦好，是未加寅，得上盤之田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685621300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"宅為次吉也。金為財星，居於酉則為財臨財，若不得金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉，只得金居辰亦好，是酉加辰也。又是金垣，亦謂財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨財，此乃無中有曜也。木土日為三限，或以晝生木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"土髙强，木為父母，土為官星，依附太陽為官主朝君。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"星儻有得處，或居强，或無刑破，皆貴格。如夜生亦可用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"但不如晝之切。水為忌，居命則水泛白羊，此乃萬古不變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"之論。生於春者，如白晝之際，其時司令以水從木化，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"凶亦輕。其他時節雖不居四正之位，但是命宫合之限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197473855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"度合之却為忌。夏秋日見之，火神為主，安可有此，非禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"而何？冬月火衰已甚，水司令行東北，中年限值之，若無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"日制之，其災更慘。此宫二宿，奎為天府圖書，命居之多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"俊秀，為官必居清要，在草茅者亦老於文儒。春令之木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"得水為善，遇金不怕，雖宫主屬火，然木隨水化，火中得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"之，終不為害。秋冬之令，不可取木捨火。夏月火令，雖奎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"度屬木，終歸火性，生尅制化，從火斷之。婁宿是火中金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"金中無位，惟生於秋月金司令，喜得土星生，逢火不畏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506779648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"取金之義固長，其餘月令通以火斷。經曰：水泛白羊，躔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"婁最𦂳。若是夏生，不問婁奎，皆以火斷，且以本宫安身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"命中有卯，對宫有酉，卯酉辰戌為六合體。至於官禄在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，田宅在未，子午加之，却為六害。六合之命則多和合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"六害則多讒謗。亥為相貌，暗加辰字，又與戌通。辰戌對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，雖曰弱宫，實有闗渉於命。子為福徳，暗加巳字，巳戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"又通，是福徳與奴僕有統攝。丑為官禄，以午加丑，以火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之，則曰命主乘旺，此最吉也。或太陰居之，則曰日中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679769609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"見斗，是得中之失。其間或有煞氣臨之，如陽刃破碎之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖尤甚。若金星居之，為財星得地，金入局也。卯為疾厄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"命中有卯，言命宫無疾厄也。諸宫以八煞為難，惟辰命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"加酉，戌命加卯，不可以此論，戌比辰為尤重，巳為奴僕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星臨之可以闗命，凶星破之亦能害命。若水孛在巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為凶斷，惟水獨行為水居雙女，即為凶格。昔有一貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"人，辛巳八月初一日戌時，日月金水火在巳，人以為險，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"其富貴不可曉。不知巳中有戌，又為嵗駕，以諸星闗命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685654068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃弱中之强，其大貴宜也。但戌上立命，有吉星在巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"更以嵗駕卦氣等臨之，皆貴。或有凶星，𠔥以他煞破之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為窮困夭賤之人，決無差矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"發明云：戌宫屬火，火庫居戌，夘與戌合。戌者陽也，夘者陰也，陰陽交合，故戌屬火而夘亦屬火。安命此宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"六合為體，六位互加，最切奴僕疾厄，福徳之宫也。有吉星則吉，凶星則凶。安命在戌，火在夘，夘加戌與戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"合，火居火位，是不為疾厄也。火在巳，戌加巳，火加火位，命主入垣是不為奴僕也。然戌上雖屬火，而巳上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"又屬水，此兩處不相入。或曰火星在巳，火居火位，又曰火入水宫，此戌巳二宫加合之難辯也。如巳宫有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"福禄貴人，驛馬嵗駕居之，必能化為福。或有的刼嵗煞七煞居其上，必能變為災，不可槩論也。如官均光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453170479726629"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":613,"lineType":2,"content":"禄大夫，辛巳八月初一日戌時生。日在巳，月在巳，金水在巳，火在巳，安命在戌，諸星皆居奴僕之位，亦未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":615,"lineType":2,"content":"為奇。然火為命元，水為運元，金為禄元，并日月在巳，嵗駕在巳，戌加巳，命臨嵗駕，三元臨嵗，駕加入福徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"之宫，身命二主上下入垣登駕，所以為貴。水火交攻，未免多迍耳。夘為疾厄之宫屬火，火居其上，不為難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"星入垣，乃是命主入廟，亦為八煞有星。若乙夘生人禄在夘，嵗駕在夘，命主臨駕坐禄，況夘與戌合，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"天地合徳。木在夘，木為科名，火為命主，木來生火有情，至十六嵗行限在亥宫見禄駕辰為夫妻之宫，辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"與酉合，火星在上，火入妻宫，加入財帛，酉辰二宫屬金，皆為得地。儻水星同在上，水為刑星，終是受傷。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"是六害三刑對照，又有月孛居之，愈重其惡。孛乃水餘，以水加孛，煞氣増盛，刑害可知，甚至惡死。若火星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"在辰，土在酉，守財帛，土為官，是福主臨財，辰與酉合，命主暗合財宫，合處有情，乃為貴也。丙戊生人以土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442578978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"為福禄愈妙，縱三合有木炁傷之，又有命主之火在焉，則木炁只生命主之火，火却生土為官福愈有氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"也。大凢戌上安命最切者土，盖官福俱為土也。木炁二星本來尅土，而得命主之火泄其氣，反能生官福之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"土，生而復生，有無窮之造化。未為田宅，本宫月居之，謂之月居月位。身坐田宅，甲生人，身又坐貴。木星居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"之，為木入秦州，亦謂身㑹福主，此為福也。孛星臨之，不為太乙抱蟾，乃是身犯煞曜。水星居之，不為水㴠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"月魄，乃是身犯難星。若以未加子，子加未，皆是六害，為刑星，為禍尤甚。子為福徳之宫，土在上，謂之福主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"入垣。月在工，為身坐福徳，六丙生人見之，為化福坐福。丑為官禄之宫，土在上，謂官主入垣。月在上，為身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"居官禄，六戊生人見之，為真禄歸窠。雖夜生人，不以土為忌日，生人見之愈妙。若大限經過子丑二宫，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"然大發財福。若命主更臨，嵗駕登殿，坐貴天馬地驛，或加職元福禄主，乃享萬鍾之命也。申為閑極之宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185197490239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"火在上，絶處受傷若火躔井，木犴，又得木星，火絶處逢生。水在命宫，𨇠木狼，則水只生木，木泄水之氣，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"水為害小。或丑上有炁，夘上有水，丑加申、夘加戌，又得木炁以助火，則水雖為禍亦輕矣。未可便以水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"互垣為忌也。火為命主，最喜寅戌二宫得火，在火旺處逢生。丁巳生人禄在午，又得旺中坐禄逢生，乃是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"上象垣局。若行刃限，午來加丑，行斗限者謂之日中見斗，必然田財耗散，尤防官刑火災。如耗星在亥，辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"加亥，本為六害局，又是相貌弱宫，有甚好處？所幸亥屬木，火居木位，或夜生人三合，無刑星傷之，是謂火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"照天門。更加日月在子戌二宫，又為日月夾天門，陰陽拱主。若乙亥癸亥生人駕在亥，禄貴在子，又是身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"主登駕，禄居禄位，福入貴地，此為仕宦之命。若水孛二星守子位，破我福德。若六庚六乙生人，水孛化為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"禄貴，行子限亦還一𤼵，發後必夭。此造化之妙，不可不知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442529826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":667,"lineType":9,"content":"亥宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"亥以木為主，此宫以三合為體，故滿盤上下皆三合局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩與未上同，中間並無刑害四破之𩔖。亥卯未木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"若得木星居之，為木入木局，得三合之正。此宫與辰通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"闗，辰通亥，亥通辰，猶巳宫闗疾厄之戌火為難，彼此雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"同而實異。盖巳之難火，是我尅他，亥之難金，是他來尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"我，要審言之。亥中屬乾壬甲人卦氣，若命居於此，有本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"年崇勲卦氣，嵗駕殿與驛馬貴人，又得木局主用為本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184496959497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"然論理，此宫以金火月為三方，主以水火為田財，木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄，以金為難。金火月為三限，須夜生則吉，晝生減力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"若火交金，金交月，則可為三限之用。若金獨行又為難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"火夜生最為用，故為身主，臨財又勝。以水火為田財，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"獨行則宜夜用，並行則宜晝用。若夜中水火交行，却是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"客星攻主。木為官星，木守命，木居寅為命官入垣，木居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"福德遷移，皆為吉用。木入未得上盤亥字甚佳。木臨辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"為八煞，或者金傷為碍，不知八煞辰宫有金則忌，辰宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184454934591"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"無金則是。申子辰三合為水局，是水生木為吉。只木入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，與太陰居酉，此為身命入鬼鄉，不可以身居閑極論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫是無閑極，盖以酉金尅木也。金在命左右，若春月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"見之，則不甚害，乃春木盛而金柔，不足畏也。夏月金星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"背馳於西南，夜中見之，火盛金衰，金不犯分，更以夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"為三限主，是金星不能傷我。惟秋金主殺，毎行東南，冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"金行東北，此二季以金忌。若是白晝見之，或木金合度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"或木前金後，皆為害曜，可忌也。人見之主殘疾，甚而夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453201949360140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"若有水火以濟之，尤庶幾，或見土計助之，為毒尤大。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"宫二宿，室宿乃亥之正度，雖曰火，終是木宫之火，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"木而後有火，木既失躔，火從何出？四時之中不離乎木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"雖夏火司令，亦不棄木為主也。水入室宿，一則田星入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"命，二則母星入命，木得所生，火則有恃。若白晝木火並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"行，只從木論，夜中取用火，然火亦度主也，又財元也，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"為三限主也。壁乃水為度主，水能生木，雖遇土亦何畏？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"以亥卯未皆木局也。與其他處立命，土星躔壁，取用又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685670452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"差。此宫雖土不入命，但居於强，尤實為碍。若木居别處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"三合與難星同一斷也。金居福徳，雖曰土垣，實為金局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"盖上盤巳下盤丑，即金庫也。身主臨之，難為福徳。木星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"到丑，亦為木入金局，有水化金即為得用。若土星合木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑。為土生金，勢鬼暗受生，木又失地，不可以木尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"土而論。寅為官禄，乃自家之地，木臨三合為官星得地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"如火入三合，反為財局。盖下盤寅合上盤午，是寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"火局。木星晝見居强，又為官禄之造化，貴格明矣。若夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442546210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"得火强為財局造化，却主富。木星得局，失於戰尅，亦有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"官，但多讒謗。火星全局失於戰尅，亦有財，特多耗散。盖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"三合局面，諸宫皆合，官宫財宫乃寅午全局。盖三局已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"成，不為他破，可以富貴，却以金為疾厄。雖曰金鄉，喜成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"水局，得金生水、水生木為吉，但恐金星强在他宫，則難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"以制局斷矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"發明云：亥宫屬木，在於乾者亥也。寅與亥合，而寅亦屬木，此宫三合為體，滿盤皆三合也。木為命主，最宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"居亥夘未三合之宫，再須巳申二水宫，皆為得地。惟辰酉二金宫不宜居之，謂之失地。況辰為八煞，酉為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442595362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"閑極，如木飛入辰宫，金尅木，又值弱宫，必難獲福。若以申加辰，辰加子，變為水木局，如更水孛在申子二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":777,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，必至獲福。或有金火在申子二宫，則反為灾。盖申、子辰三宫者，三合之中暗相管攝也。水為命母，孛乃水餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":779,"lineType":2,"content":"所以愛也。金為煞難，火為竊氣。若五六月生人，火為直星，火神用事，命木逢之，為害不小，所以忌也。丑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":781,"lineType":2,"content":"福徳之宫，木星在寅，官入官宫，又為命主坐禄。木星在丑，命坐福徳。若丁丑生人，命主在丑，為嵗駕。亥為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人，命主登駕，命坐貴宫，此為佳也。癸丑生人，雖是為駕，其如陽刃的煞何？所以減力，不甚為佳。如太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"在已，太隂在酉，謂之拱駕朝主。又是六巳生人，太陽為禄元，太陰為禄主，又謂福徳受日月合拱，巳酉丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"三位加合，往來俱見禄元，禄主福星，必為宰輔。如木在寅，壬寅、丙寅乃為奇特。壬寅木生在亥，命坐崇勲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":789,"lineType":2,"content":"命合嵗駕。丙寅生人，命坐貴官星臨駕，豈不美哉？若夘寅甲申生人，更髙一頭地。甲申生人禄在寅，申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506714112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":793,"lineType":2,"content":"辰馬居寅，禄馬俱入禄地。命主官主，禄元馬元，福星權財，科名滿用，坐禄坐馬，登駕入垣，衆善輻輳。若天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"馬地驛不背職元，局主有氣，則富貴雙全，官居鼎鼐。木星雖滿用，須入垣登駕，坐禄為佳。如木在戌，乃木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":797,"lineType":2,"content":"居財帛，是命臨財。若火星在午，火旺在午，謂之財元逢旺。若三十六嵗行寅限，金在戌，財元在午，只欠寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":799,"lineType":2,"content":"一字，輳成財元局。若六甲生人，火為禄主，行此等限，𤼵福發財。若是五六月生人，火又竊木之氣，恐發後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":801,"lineType":2,"content":"必夭。若十一月、十二月生人，水神用事，木得水以蔭之，生子為財，又何害焉？若在午，混之以水，則財元逢傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":803,"lineType":2,"content":"財神不旺。若辛生人，混之以炁，則富擬陶朱。木星在申坐田宅，木居水位。若水星在子，水為田宅主，乘旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"復生命主之木。若六庚生人，以水為禄主，有甚不好？但土在辰申二位，混之以木，又為囚星尅禄主，何益","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":807,"lineType":2,"content":"於我？土在辰，混之以金，金生禄主之水為佳。若六巳生人，以金為田財，福星生囚，囚星尅命主，俱為禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453201949392908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"若水不在子，為禍不小。若水在子，此是福星生囚星，囚星生命母，命母生命主，相生不已，此其為佳，乃水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":813,"lineType":2,"content":"星之力。如木星在酉，謂之木困金鄉。土星在丑，木為官星，土為福星，又為官福漏闗。土在丑，混之以金，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":815,"lineType":2,"content":"是六巳、六辛生人，以金為刑囚，是福星黨刑囚而尅命主之木，更當秋冬金神用事之時，木神無氣，我必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"受傷。如火在巳，不惟不喜，然火居巳，夘丑火來生土，土來生金，以丑加酉，金加木，乃財帛生，刑囚直，難尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":819,"lineType":2,"content":"命主也。若行丑限二十六至三十七嵗，財散人亡，尤防損己。若丑上有卦氣居之，則煞尤輕。大抵亥上安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"命，須要日月在寅，申乃日月拱天門，又為陰陽拱命。若身命二主飛起，臨駕登殿，坐禄坐貴為妙。不然官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":823,"lineType":2,"content":"福守時，科名科甲，魁星登籍，乃是𡖖相之命。若羅在夘，孛在未，六癸人羅為禄主，孛為福權，又為福禄拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"命。太陰在官禄福徳之宫，又是上貴之命，不可以孛、羅為惡曜論也。孛在申，羅在亥，計在巳，謂之四正逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188506746880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"刑怕見身。若　二十七嵗行寅限，加嵗煞在寅，刑害可知。若是十　一月十二月生人，化金為直，乃是刑星，逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":831,"lineType":2,"content":"生在丑，惡之甚矣。婦人則主産難之厄。大抵十二宫主第一怕餘奴犯主不足刑夭之命雖有好惡，終亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"不甚發達。此十　二宫坐命加合𠮓局，隠藏造化，若龜卜燭照，禍福昭然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"星命之說多矣，求其醇正無疵而能發明玄齋之奥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"者，未有若此之盡。雖不知其為誰所作，中有虞學士","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"生年月日，意必元時人也。盖術者得一異書，則為私","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"家秘傳，埋前人之功，大可鄙也。然而傳寫既久，訛舛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"有之，重復有之。僕因得善本，雖相參改正，第智識淺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679785993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"陋，未能盡詳，當更訪先達，悉改正之，使無憾而後可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"洪武甲寅中秋日，呉郡徐繼孫題。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103525926"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":3,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定四庫全書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":4,"lineType":4,"content":"星學大成卷十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":7,"content":"明萬民英撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":8,"content":"入骨仙機望斗經序","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"余觀望斗、璧玉二經，文義相為表裏。璧玉經余既註","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"之，而望斗惡可巳也？舊文倒亂無章，而註又舛謬不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"純，作述之意兩失，論者病焉。武生杜以信、何其俊頗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"通星理，遂命𨤲正訂補。余復叅詳潤色，以發明之。文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147292199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"雖分乎三篇，義則合乎一卷。説雖質之諸家，理則通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"於一貫。自今觀之，布二六以奠地維，定四七以透天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"關。推度數，别黄道，以考星辰進退；揭升沉，按上下，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"論身命官田。可謂洞究天人之藴，深明星命之理矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"中下二篇，辭雖似重，而意各有所指；意雖若淺，而訣則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"所傳。援引諸說，所以證己言之有據；獨執一理，所以信人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"命之無差。欲知人之富貴榮華，貧窮夀夭，舎是經其奚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"適哉？余故表之，以告後之術者。讀望斗經云：易水育吾子，識","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350274102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"新註入骨。仙機望斗經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"余按：望斗三篇，詞意雜亂，似非出一人之手，讀者病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。迺畧更訂。上篇總論十一曜度數，通加生尅制化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"以星命之純吉者言。中篇分吉凶相半，下篇専論凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":9,"content":"上篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"仙機一卷，望斗三篇，説盡隂陽之理，漏窮神鬼之機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":2,"content":"此首言作經之意，而取名仙機、望斗一卷三篇也。斗運乎天心，而星無不拱；機通於入骨，而發無不中。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350372406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽而括人之造化，故謂之仙機；以度數而測天之星辰，故名之望斗。言此經說隂陽生尅之理，終始𠔥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"舉；漏鬼神變化之機，本末無遺。術實精而弗戾，言有大而非誇矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"人雖靈於萬物，命實由於五星。欲問富貴榮華，藴習天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"心之訣；要知貧窮夀夭，深通入骨之經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴榮華，貧窮夀夭，二者人命之大較也。命禀於有生之初，而實五星之所為，人孰不欲問而知之？然舍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"望斗、仙機，則無由而知，非藴習深通，亦惡能窺其奥哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"宫分二六，星列四七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽之數各六。二六者，星盤十二宮也。四方之宿各七。四七者，星禽二十八也。此言㸔命之法，光布十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184455163967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"宮，排二十八宿，以論人立命何宮，主何度也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"周天之數，約行三百六十之有五，分野之間，除太初三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"十度之無餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"周天約行三百六十五度四分度之一，每分野以太初推之，計三十度四十三分八十秒。然天行健，一日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"一周而過一度，太陽一日一周，不及天一度，故一年退三百六十五度四分度之一，與天㑹而成嵗。太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"一日不及日十二度十九分度之七，故每月二十七日有竒，與日㑹而成月。今言三百六十之有五者，舉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":2,"content":"成數也。分野周齊，子午兩宮，每宮計三十度四十三分八十秒，其餘魯、衛、晉、趙、秦、楚、宋、鄭、燕、吴十宫，計三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":2,"content":"十度四十三分七十九秒。今言無餘者，舉大較也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212107931663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"先别黄道之移宮，次推星辰之進歩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"日行黄道，月行九道，天本無道也，因日月之行而强名耳。月道距黄道逺六度二分，而九道當交之處，交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"初為羅㬋，交中為計都。自交初至交中，月在黄道外，名陽厯，乃背羅向計之處；自交中至交初，月在黄道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"内，名隂厯，乃背計向羅之處也。月道猶水道，日道猶陸道，而羅計猶橋道，是黄道在於四七之間，有一定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"之處也。耶律純以春黄道始於東，而以四木度為之。夏黄道始於南，而以四火度為之。秋黄道始於西，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"以四金度為之。冬黄道始於北，而以四水度為之。不明天文，亦大謬矣。夫不知黄道之移宮，又何以推星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"辰之進歩？故為黄道之歌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":9,"content":"周天黄道之歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147193895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"角一至九正黄道，十至十二近天田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"亢一至六五蹊險，七曜加臨吉有驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"限行不忌四空宮，但要吉星黄道現。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"氐三四度直至房，房初至四共北方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"斗宿三四至七度。虚二三度吉中央。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"危八直至十三度，室一至五端無慮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"璧星之度正屬兹，奎一到十皆可許。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"昂一九𠔃參三度，井至十四星相顧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053372940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"栁一二與星二三，此皆黄道無差悮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"時人㑹得黄道經，限裏吉凶自見明；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"五星日月若行此，如無刻剥福非輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":9,"content":"周天黒道之歌曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰到此減輝容，限度臨之即鬼門；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"有人㑹筭精天理，限到無差説可慿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"心一二度黒道生；尾一至三少光明；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"八至九兮皆不吉，箕五六度不堪行；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103476774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"斗只八度有此虧，女至三五禍必侵；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"婁三四度應危險；胃六七躔暗不明；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"畢十一二度全惡，觜只半度不見星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼一二張三至十，翼八九內有灾迍；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"軫十七與十八九，已上皆屬黒道。論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"詳觀本末，省察盈虚，使其體若差㣲，則將用何所補？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"本者，命也；末者，限也；盈者，得經也；虚者，失䧟也。命以本為體，以末為用，貴乎本末相應，首尾得經。使本主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"差㣲，毫𨤲千里，機㣲不審，則無往而非差矣。雖詳於用，亦何補哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350405174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"夫觀宋屬東升父之基；趙為西沒孃之祖。官號天上，田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"名地下。雖云明晦不同，各有隂陽度數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"此一節乃隂陽之至理，星家之玄奥也。夫宋屬夘地為東；趙属酉方為西。太陽命本為父，太隂身主為孃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"天上為午為官，地下為子、為田。東升為明，西沒為晦。善觀人造化者，不以夘為夘，而以東升父為夘，則吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"之命可知；不以酉視酉，而以西沒孃視酉，則吾之身可知。葢地之夘酉，東西也，定地不易；天之夘酉，房昂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"也，随天運轉；人之夘酉，命身也，通乎天地者也。固不可以天地為吾人之夘酉，而吾人之夘酉，實不離天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"地之夘酉為夘酉也。由是自吾之夘而視天中，則官禄之限為獨加，是非午之午也；自吾之酉而視下地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"則田宅之位為至𨼆，是非子之子也。東升則明而為陽，西沒則晦而為隂。隂陽明晦，雖有不同，出入度數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103575078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"則無少異。學者通於此説，則性命之理思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"天傾西北，論乾為尊；地缺東南，詳巽為重。是以乾天布","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"金，金生五行之異秀；巽地藏土，土養萬物之精竒。義知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之紀綱，信秘隂陽之終始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"置乾於西北，列巽於東南，此文王後天之易，而星命之理皆由此出。天傾西北，故以西北屬乾，乃地支戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"亥之方也。地缺東南，故以東南屬巽，乃地支辰已之位也。已亥為天地門户，乾巽總天地生養，故特以二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"宮為尊重。何也？葢兌非無金，惟乾之金得天一之水以清，而能生五行之異秀，壬甲納乾是也。坤非無土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"惟巽之土得地二之火以煖，而能養萬物之精竒，丙戍禄已是也。金於五常為義，剛徤不毁；土於五常為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212120498216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"信，生成咸賴。乾巽綱紀乎天地，義信終始乎隂陽，造化且然，而况於人乎？論星者當知所本矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"或有宮有度，或無曜無星，或釣起有功，或飛來有慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"十一曜運行十二宮，各有本垣之度。然躔有先後，行有疾徐，或有占於一二宮，而别宮則空。或有聚於五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"七位，而他位則無。若不㸔三方四正、釣起飛來，何以論生尅、明制化，而斷人之吉㐫禍福也？故㸔命之法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"當論宮則論宮，當論度則論度。或本宫無曜而觀三方之釣起，或本度無星而察四正之飛來，須知暗中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"有吉，也防起處受傷，不可一例而取裁，併把通加。而研究，此論命之大法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩當論宫則論宮，當論度則論度。先究一身之要，次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"詳三命之原。同宫千里分前後，異宫尺寸㸔遲留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188343152691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"此條發明耶律之意，以提醒夫人也。言十一曜在二十八宿度，其十二宮中有一太陽、五太隂、二火、二金、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"六水、六土、六木之説。當論宮則論宮，如　一太陽、二火、二金是也；當論度則論度，如五太隂、六水、六土、六木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。太陽三十日　一宮，太隂三日行四十度，是立命衆人之所同，而安身一巳之所獨。故太隂視太陽為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"尤𦂳，而安身較立命為最切也。談星者當先究一身之要，果何宫，果何度，孰為得，孰為失？次詳三命之原，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"何為度主，何為命主，何為身主？或同宮而逺若千里，或異宫而近如尺寸。逺者當分其前後，如土遲而在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"前，水疾而在後，雖千里亦近；近者當審其遲留，如水疾而前行，火留而後退，雖近亦逺。此又發耶律之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"未發，而歐陽子所獨得者。大要五星相尅，嫌十五度之中，雖有遲留，亦怕二三躔之内。此星家之口訣，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"深究之。舊註云：三命者，身、命、度是。鈐釋云：禄、身、命是。經云：干為禄本，定一生職位髙低；支作命基，布三限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147128359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"夀元終始。假如甲子年生人，尋絶處為禄命身，以絶處有生也。甲為禄屬木，木絶在甲，以申水為禄主；子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"為命屬水，水絶在已，以已水為命主；以納音金為身，金絶在寅，以寅木為身主是也。此説亦㣲，當併詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"日論行南行北，月分上弦下弦。若有蝕神來往，最嫌朔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"望相逢。晝生父，必早傷；夜誕娘，當先逝。二三躔內，使合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"來須見尅；十五度外，如背去有何妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽夏至行南陸，則晝長而多暑；冬至行北陸，則晝短而多寒。欲論太陽得令，須是夏日臨垣是也。太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"在上弦，則自缺而之圎；在下弦，則自圎而之缺。要論太隂得時，須是秋蟾升殿是也。然日月晦蝕，皆由羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"計，而羅計相逢，最嫌朔望。使日在井之十三，而羅在井之十五，火在井之十一，是謂合來須相尅也。使日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147259431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"在井之十五，羅在井之初一，火在井之二十九，是謂背去有何妨也。碧玉云：日蝕朔，月蝕望，始為蝕神；隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"忌計，陽忌羅，名為忌曜。日火月土，莫臨十五度之中；隂計陽羅，怕在二三躔之內。經云：晝生掩日之輝，去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"父又能損已；夜生埋月之彩，去娘又主傷妻。如此計羅，誠為惡曜，當併觀之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"日到日躔人特達，月升月殿性含靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"日到日躔者，躔四日度也。月升月殿者，躔四月度也。經云：惟有太陽臨位，而榮貴無灾；月曜入宫，而清慈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":2,"content":"獲福。惟容是而且秀，取人事而最足是也。然湏晝日夜月不背，方合此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"秋蟾升殿，生成詩禮之家；夏日臨垣，長在富榮之室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"太隂為命之所自來，既升殿而復在秋，清光可愛也，宜生成於詩禮之家。太陽為命之所主宰，既入垣而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103509542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"又當夏，炎暖可知也，當長在富榮之室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"陽君火木守荆周，片言入相。隂后水金𡚖秦趙，一舉成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":2,"content":"日為陽君，以火木為侍衛，日在已午，火木同宮，是太陽居南，離而不孤。月為隂后，以水金為引從，月在未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"酉，水金同宮，是太隂入垣，廟而有助。片言入相，一舉成名，言易也。日月以入垣升殿為佳，更又夏秋得時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"晝夜不背為福。日月，君后之象，左右要有朝佐之臣，不可使之孤也。故又以此條言之。其意由淺以入深，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"從㣲而至著也。合前三節而觀之，則日月之所喜忌，大畧可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"金水共躔，春有利名秋必折；水熒同歩，冬須破落夏能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147177511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"成。伏逆則㐫，順行則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"此明五曜之旺衰生尅，以論人之吉㐫也。木旺在春，無金斵削不成梁棟，至秋則折，不可絶用金也。火盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"在夏，無水潤澤，易至煨燼，在冬，無氣，不可純賴水也。夫金木水火，躔度雖同，而春夏秋冬，吉㐫頓異。可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"當分别旺相休囚，又要㸔順留伏逆。葢五星貴現而不貴伏，喜順而不喜逆。若順行則以吉言，伏逆則以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫斷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"太白當秋莫病火，清辰旺月不愁鎮。木到春榮金退志，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"水逺夏位火呈輝。火入金鄉須明次度，水居土室亦較","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"當時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212120481832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"太白四句，論五星得時當權，不怕戰尅。火入金鄉四句，言又須明次度以别先後，較當時以論盛裒也。與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"上文互相發明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"智火休逢旺水，義金最慮炎熒。嵗為用而怕金，辰當宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"而懼鎮。猶嫌衆㐫相尅，那堪兩忌戰刑。若不夭折乎命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"定教惡疾躔身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"智火，義金，嵗木，辰水，鎮，土也。五行乗四時而有盛衰，五星本五行而論尅制。貴相生而相順，毋相戰而相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"寃。智火四句，言五星乗旺，分主賔以論生尅。命主失時，别恩用而為强弱。茍賔來尅主，便作福作官，為魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"為爵，猶未㐫害。若聚㐫㑹煞，帯刼化刑，而主受其欺，則其主益傷，實為難救。故曰猶嫌衆㐫相尅，那堪兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350257718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"忌戰刑。若不夭折乎命，定教惡疾躔身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"五星伏逆，和睦亦能獲福。四餘無黨，相順必定加祥。坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"度得經，十有九富。安躔怕鬼，百無一成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"伏逆，五星之最忌者。茍逢生有情，和順雍睦，雖不大發，亦能獲福。經云五星須要比和，以得時而為貴是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"也。餘奴，十二曜之最㐫者。茍獨力無黨，相順不尅，不但無灾，必定加祥。經云四餘不宜充實，宜獨行以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"佳是也。且十一曜之躔度，循二十八宿為次舍，要不過金木水火土而已。茍坐度而得經，如春木之躔四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"水四木，則相生相比，而七政専得其尊；坐度失經，如秋木之躔四金四火，則相尅相戰，而七政不安其位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"故有成敗之分焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103493158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"失序失經名必敗，得時得度性能為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"此以身命主言也。凢七政，以隂陽言則有其序，不可先隂而後陽；以次舍言則有其經，不可就尅而背生；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"以節令言則有其時，喜旺相而惡休囚；以周天言則有其度，喜廟樂而惡䧟弱。人安身立命而得時得度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"則乗旺相，居廟樂，故能設施而有為；安身立命而失序失經，則背隂陽，受尅制，故終無成而必敗。自此以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"下，多論得時而得度者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"包含萬象身居楚，智過千夫命守豳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"楚屬巳，為地户。地則無所不包，身若居之，則徳合乎地矣，故曰包含萬象。豳屬亥，為天門。天則秀出特異，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"命若居之，則清配乎天矣，故曰智過千夫。此二句，湏亥宫立命，巳宮安身。天門加地戸，地户加天門，又有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350306870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"日月以照臨之，方合此格。未必凢亥立命，凢巳安身，便可以如是斷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
