{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"少年身到鳯池，水陽度楚。壯嵗名題鴈塔，金木居豳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"此以已宫立命，亥宫安身言之。楚東南水地，太陽居之則東升，水星居之則入垣。命安於此，是命主朝君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"也。豳西北木地，太白躔之則入格，木星躔之則𡚖垣。身安於此，是恩用兩得也。合上節觀之，豈惟包含萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"象，智過千夫，且將少年登第，壯嵗題名矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"水宿𡚖經，處世身居翰苑。木星度駕，平生足履王庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"水木乃文學福徳，最為吉曜。𡚖經者，如水躔箕、參、軫、璧，木躔井、角、斗、奎。度駕者，登當年之嵗駕。此二句互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":2,"content":"㸔。水𡚖經而度駕，身居翰苑。木度駕而𡚖経，足履王庭。碧玉云：水居雙女，惟癸與已酉丑之人；木入雙魚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350388790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"乃甲見申子辰之命。即此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"一主當權，敢掌當朝之大事；四餘獨旺，能教衆國之來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"降。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"一主者，命主，或水或木是也。度駕歸經，可謂當權。命得此者，必職掌鈞衡而為相也。四餘者，餘曜、炁、孛、羅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"計是也。單居得時，可謂獨旺。命得此者，必威服四夷而為将也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞不降貧且賤，一星得用富而驕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"一星得用，則衆煞自降。衆煞不降，必一星失力。二句互相𤼵也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"財積如山，田廣似海。勳居極品，譽播三公。官福二宫生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453172442677282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"絶異，田財兩位更清竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"此條總論官、福、田、財，為身命主之𦂳要。財積如山二句，極言其富。勳居極品二句，極言其貴。若此者，盖由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"官福二宫升殿坐駕，互換合局而絶異；田財二位，乗時廟旺，㑹命輔身而清竒。此所以為大富大貴之命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":403,"lineType":2,"content":"也。自此以下，散論官福田財，而皆以身命為主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"官彰禄隱，譽播乾坤之貴。爵擁魁從，名傳邦邑之榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":407,"lineType":2,"content":"官魁者，當年之官魁。爵者，地元爵。禄者，天元禄也。官彰則名顯，禄隠則資厚，二者相仍，譽必播乎乾坤。爵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"擁則身榮，魁從則文耀，二者相等，名自傳於邦邑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"魁宿若随，三十六齡輔相。官星如掌，二十四考中書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147275815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"魁宿若随者，言官宮有吉星化魁随官主，則官得魁而益尊，故必如房玄齡，早登宰輔。官星如掌者，言官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":2,"content":"宫有主星化官，則官居官而益顯，故必如郭子儀久任中書。然豈易得而易言哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁乗旺，福禄歸窠。隂陽得體，互換有情。屏內金釵十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"二，門前朱履三千。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"官魁者，官魁星也。福禄者，福禄主也。官魁二句，言𡚖窠。隂陽二句，言互換。𡚖窠，貴乗時而入廟。互換，貴得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"體而有情。命全此者，則為大富貴人也。隂陽對，互換㸔，非指日月言。隂得隂體，如火金月躔隂位。陽得陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"體，如木日土躔陽位是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"命安馬地最超羣，主到官宫當富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453185679900681"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":2,"content":"驛馬之地，四衡之獨吉者。命生驛馬，或遇長生臨官，必為起越之士。官禄，一宫七强之最要者。身命入官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"禄，更得吉星相助，必為富貴之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"有用刑囚掌握，又加權印相從，决有皂纛朱幡之貴，斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"為一呼百諾之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"有用刑囚者，身命二主所化。或以身為刑，以命為囚，或以命為刑，以身為囚。母星亦然，皆為有用刑囚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"權印，乃十干變曜，或以體為權，以用為印，或以體為印，以用為權，皆為權印相從也。以權印而用刑囚，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"刑囚而輔權印，得令得局，相宜相㑹，决居諸侯之貴，㫁為權要之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"煞㑹文昌，權謀出衆。科名見貴，學問過人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103542310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":451,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，大煞是也。煞，㐫神，文昌，吉曜。煞㑹文昌，是文武𠔥濟也，故主權謀異衆。科名，年干是也。科名為文星，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"乙為貴氣。科名見貴，是華秀特出也，故主學問過人。然二者未必能皆貴，要㸔身命官福何如耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"魁遇學堂，功勳生於毫管。官逢大煞，名利出於旗鎗。隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"陽共輔田財，平地致富。福禄順迎官印，唾手成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":459,"lineType":2,"content":"官乃官星，非官主也。煞乃飛廉，非嵗煞也。魁星遇學堂，又足以經邦。功勳生於毫管。官星逢大煞，武足以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"戡亂。名利出於旗鎗。隂陽二曜拱輔田財之宮，是更清竒，宜平地而致富。福禄二主順迎官印之曜，是生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"絶異，必唾手而成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"主到田園，承父基而發迹。田來拜主，守祖業以昌榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453184685850676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"此條専論田主，亦要與身命有情也。主到田園，或乗旺而𡚖窠。田來拜主，或得體而㑹輔。人命得此，非承","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"父基而發迹，則守祖業以昌榮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"賔主相和，則名揚四海。財星㑹輔，而富集全家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"此條以賔主㑹輔為言，亦承上章互換有情之意。假如酉命，金為主，火為賔，火金同躔酉位，值夜生交輝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"有情，更得月助，是三限主，員淨明朗，必主名揚四海。財星㑹輔。假如子宫安命，土為主，木為財帛，火為恩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"木火㑹輔在命，財生恩，恩生命，更得太隂同躔，定是富集全家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"千倉萬箱，田財化義。一富二夀。官福生仁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"仁義為立人之道，金木乃五行之粹，以仁配木，以義配金，自然之理也。金秋生得，用入田財之宫，相生相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203580895232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"成，必主千倉萬箱之富。木春生滿，用入官福之宫，相和相順，不特富也，而又有眉夀焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"福地安身，管主一生閒到老；財飛入局，儘教百事不求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"此條専以財福言，然亦當觀其得體有情與否。若子宫命，不喜福地安身；辰宫命，不喜財飛入局，當併詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"玉堂安命宜脩學，官印扶身貴莫當。魁登嵗駕，胸藏萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"斛珠璣。文㑹書齋，筆掃九天風雨。催宿及限數，功名可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"求。喜神遇身宫，錢財易取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203580911616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"玉堂者，天乙貴人也。官印者，官星印星也。命坐玉堂，則為文人，身逢官印，則為貴客。魁星，甲月乙日之例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。書齋當生，納音長生是也。若魁星登於嵗駕，文曜㑹於書齋，文魁得地，身命無虧，必主學飽五車，文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"成七歩。催宿者，催官也。喜神者，喜神星也。欲求功名於當年，當審催官之度數。冀取横財於非望，必縁喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"曜到身宫。然此當互而觀之，不可執一例論。○舊註云：凡一切吉神，若人身命主度限，主三方四正，官福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"强宫，或逢或見，或坐或加，君子遇此可以為官，賢人逢之可以逹聖，縱遇退留，亦當大發。亦是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"數比龜齡，夀星得地；年齊鶴筭，仁曜𡚖窠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"舊説以當年之天干為仁曜，以當年之納音為壽星。假如甲子生人，天干属木，納音屬金，仁曜與夀星相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"尅，以之為夀，不亦謬耶？愚見壽星以當生之天干言，仁曜以命主之恩星言。謂生年干為太嵗，一世之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147161127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"賴也，若得地則命有所主而不虚。命主恩星，為一生之所資也，若歸窠，則命有所生而不傷，故皆主有壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"仁者，生生之意。子平云：印綬重逢，且比老彭之壽，亦是此意。一説壽星，辰之次也，金命人以土為恩，而土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"又躔於夀星之次，謂之老人星現。此説更精，然百無一二，故老夀之人，一鄉寜幾人哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"五位逢生，兒孫滿眼。七宫無煞，琴瑟和鳴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"逢生則生，無煞則和，亦自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"五宫福木，子顯真英鸑鷟。七位權金，妻婚合起鴛鴦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"五位男女宫也，春木得令，甲年化福，又有母星相生，主其子必貴。七位夫妻宫也，秋金入垣，戊年化權，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"有吉星相扶，主其妻必佳。女命福随，木徳俱好。但權隠金神最忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103689766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"夜土為灾，戊巳之人更難救；晝熒興禍，丙丁之命實堪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"土喜晝生，居六陽之位，使夜生居隂宫，號五殘星，必能作灾。然甲乙人猶有救，若戊已生，則土得嵗為有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"力，其灾愈重。火喜夜生，在六隂之位，使晝生居陽宫，化天刑星，必能興禍。然壬癸人未足憂，若丙丁生，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"火得年列有氣，其禍益烈。又須審垣廟退弱，以别分數也。詩云：夜生戊巳属勾陳，落陷逢㐫最不情。亥子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"二時遭破敗，縱使為官是夭人。又曰第四火星𠔥旺晝，且㸔命宫何所守。少年孤苦老無兒，百嵗何曽開","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"得口是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏火羅能作孽，秋冬孛計愈興灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816656420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"火羅炎毒，在春夏逢生司令，更能作孽。計孛凶惡，在秋冬乗旺當權，愈見興灾。若火羅獨行於隂位，孛計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"單處於陽宫，則亦未為害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"陽限火羅灾害緊，隂宫孛計禍難禁。有福必傷父母，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦損爾明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"陽限，六陽宫也。隂宫，六隂宫也。火羅剛狠，為禍最烈，晝生忌在陽宫。孛計狡邪，為凶猶緩，夜生不宜隂位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"命犯此者，雖有福而父母亦傷，無則必喪其明也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"抱膝長憂身怕鬼，忍饑待死命嫌休。金脆火炎湏夭折，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"水深木弱必漂流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453205103706150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"此四句，下兩句明上兩句。身怕鬼者，怕尅星乗旺，如辰宫命，夏月晝生，最忌火星伴月。命嫌休者，嫌本主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"無氣，如寅宫命，冬月夜生，尤怕木入申宫。盖夏月炎炎金脱，冬月水深木弱，所以皆主夭折之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"熒星近土，終作無成之子；太白逢辰，永為破落之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"此是我生他也，名為脱氣受傷，必無發達。若鬼旺尅我，湏又賴子以制之，不可一槩論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"金火不降，舉手傷人之軰；木羅能化，囬頭無恨之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"金火不降者，金强火閫，故舉手而傷人。即子平庚逢丙擾，多有不仁之意。木羅能化者，木觧羅凶，故回頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"而無恨。經云：衆煞不降，楊脩有捷對之機；餘羅有氣，蘇武䧟羝羊之屈。正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"金非怕火，孤處一生衣禄足；火若愁金，富中半世枕衾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350487094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"金非怕火二句，以金為命主，言太白當權，身旺不怕煞也。火若愁金二句，以火為命主，言熒惑司令，主旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"能尅財也。二者皆主享有衣䘵，但金火不宜相見，見則必尅，故夫妻之間多不如意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"卜商哭子，五位熒星逢惡曜；莊周鼓盆，七宫太白見㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"火星五位，未可論孤，若逢水孛交戰，難免子夏之傷。太白七宫，可謂得位，如遇火羅所傷，必有莊周之嘆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"假如戊申生人，命立戌宮，火孛二星同躔，在男女午位，火化刑，孛帶刃，二星相戰，又逢天狗，必主尅子。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁亥生人，命立夘宫，羅金同躔，在妻妾酉位，羅化刑，金恃旺，二星相拒，又逢的煞，必主傷妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212107964431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"妾奪妻權。金怕火，孫傳後裔。水欺熒。天狗臨兒，兒孫决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"無繼續；地喪戰室，室家斷定相刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"此六句専論五七二宫，由淺以及深也。言金為妻星而怕火者，未必遂尅妻，特妾奪妻權耳。熒為兒曜，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"怕水者，未必盡絶後，亦有孫傳後裔耳。若火被水欺，天星巳為不吉，而天狗為五宫之最忌者，復㑹於水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"火尅戰之宫，兒孫决無繼續，欲孫傳後裔不可得也。金被火照，天星巳為有傷，而地䘮為七宫之最憂者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"併於金火交戰之地，室家斷定相刑，雖妾奪妻權，猶未止也。又經云：水火同行婦尅夫，水火同居夫傷婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"若還夫婦不相傷，斷定至老傷男子。此又不以火金為論，而特以水為斷，當叅詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔隂度，月鎮陽宫，逢蝕神早䘮父母，居命分，多尅妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147308583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"孥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"日月反背而遇蝕神，不止傷父母，亦尅妻拏。可見日月在人命最重，而計羅同隂陽最㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽犯弱，羅計相逢，縱有一善扶持，也教𩀱親早䘮。六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"位身逢此曜，偏生庶出；九宫命㑹斯星，異姓同房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"日月既入乎弱宫，朔望又逢乎羅計，是命之夲原已不立矣。縱有一水善星，能解羅計之厄，然亦難免雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"親早䘮。不特此也，或身臨六位而逢此曜，則主偏生庶出。或命入九宫而㑹斯星，則主異姓同房。羅計之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"不可同處有如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽失力，雙親重拜，首尾相近，半道堪為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350503478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽失力者，乃是隂入陽宫，陽居隂位，或遇落𨺻受傷，或遇孤神寡宿，又遇晝火夜土，四餘相攻，必主重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"拜雙親。首尾一名曰天闗地軸，一名曰廉貞科目。若相近於身命，則為半俗半道之人。經云：羅計在天横","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"行，而衆星莫過，隂陽䧟之，必定薄蝕。木炁值之，刑尅孤獨。水火遇之，必遭刑戮。故經云：廉貞若臨，身命嗣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"續有傷。科目更入命宫，妻身受刃。正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"炁孛對身，兄弟恰如秦楚；計羅蔽日，父子一似華夷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"身值孤，則兄弟相離。日逢蝕，則父子不保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"能侍父母，福權文印佐隂陽；逺棄妻孥，刑囚暗耗凑金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"火。父南子北，四餘忌掩雙精。兄楚弟秦，三宿刑傷一主。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212107948047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅則相寃，使相生而相喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽属父，太隂属母，最喜吉星佐輔。福權文印，當年化曜之吉也。得是吉以輔之，則能侍奉父母，而盡其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"為子之道。金星為妻，火星為兒，最怕㐫曜侵凌，刑囚暗耗，當年化曜之㐫也。得是㐫以凌之，則必逺棄妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"孥，而傷其為夫之情。若隂陽二曜為四餘所掩，則父子必相離。身命二主為三閑所傷，則兄弟不相保也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"夫父子、兄弟、夫婦，皆人倫之所當盡而最重者。合前数節觀之，可見星命相尅，則至親化為㓂讐；星命相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"生，則至親聚成骨肉。吁！人惡可不思自勉，而盡委之命哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":679,"lineType":9,"content":"中篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"文能求貴，仲尼壯嵗合封侯；武觧成名，李廣當年宜佩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350470710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"此四句言人雖靈於萬物，命實由於五星。如使人不由命，則文章可以取貴，武畧可以成名，而何有終身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"不遇者哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"三學士者，身居清吉。一腐儒者，命遇天空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"身，月也。清吉，得地也。如月居天秤，月照白羊，月臨雲漢，月𡚖東井，月到天門，月朝南斗，月生滄海之𩔖。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"遇上弦酉戌亥，下弦子丑寅者，皆為清吉得地，必主翰苑蜚聲，學士之選也。經云身居清吉休愁命，福徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"堅髙不問官是也。天空，正空亡之位也。如身命落在此宫，衆星又值伏逆，到底無成，終為腐儒而巳。經云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡為害最愁人，材智英雄悮一身。只可為僧并學術，雞𥦗勞苦度秋春是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453216147324967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"蹭蹬文章，學堂失次。精竒藝術，天乙當權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"身宫，宫主為學堂，怕入弱而失次。餘曜紫炁為天乙，喜得地而當權。葢學堂得地，必文章發逹之士。天乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"當權，乃清髙藝術之人。反是則不然也。一説身宫，宫主為職元，學堂者乃玉堂位𠔥長生臨官位是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"文若㑹兵，斷作才能之相，主如逢煞，决為謫降之官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"文，文星。兵，大煞，主命主以文星㑹兵煞，文武全也，斷作才能之相。如命主衰弱而㑹大煞，無吉星救助，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"是謫降之官。夫同一大煞，身强為兵，身弱為煞。故曰先究一身之要，次詳三命之原。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"刃刑更屬官星，能裁典章之理。暗煞如逢禄馬，窮搜訟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"獄之情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203350454326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":721,"lineType":2,"content":"官星者，年干對禄之官星。禄馬者，當年干支之禄馬。如官星逢陽刄、刑囚，禄馬加暗煞、嵗煞，縱在貴人禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"馬之中，亦是一生吏曹之軰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"少病優游。身安福徳，多灾坎坷，主怕官宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"身安福徳經云：福禄主星入命來，身居福徳亦無灾。命主若還居福徳，少年富貴入三台。主怕官宫經云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"人生官限最為長，身命逢之主吉昌。最忌煞刑侵此位，多生坎坷有灾殃是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"主拜官宫，則身輔帝闕。官刑主位，則身犯天條。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"命主化禄入官宫，逢生無不富貴。官星化刑入命位，尅主定有官非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"有患經春直難和年，作梗無灾一世。福官與命相成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053422092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"直難和年作梗者，乃身命遇直難㐫星，加以流年㐫星攻併，而後為梗也。福官與命相成者，乃身命與官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"福主曜，加以順垣樂廟相和，而後為成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"主去欺賔，為財為庫，尤還濁富。賔來尅主，作福作官，宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"守清貧。相違則破，相順則成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"主身命，主也。賔對主而言，仇難之𩔖是也。欺者，乗勢以相尅，主賔各有勝負。主或釣起而欺賔，是主為賔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"而賔為主，則賔非閑辰，是財是庫，尤還濁富。賔或飛來而欺主，是賔為賔而主為主，則主非忌曜，作福作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":751,"lineType":2,"content":"官，亦守清貧。此可見主貴旺，賔貴衰，主可欺賔，賔不可尅主也。賔裒受主之欺，則其勢相順。主衰受賔之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":753,"lineType":2,"content":"尅，則其情相違。順則成，違則破，寜非理之必然者乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816640036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"賔來破主，則儉假無情。主去欺賔，而取財不義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"賔破主者，他來尅我也。假如子宮命土為主，木為賔，木飛入，主生春令，是賓來尅主。雖其木化為官福，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"亦儉假無情，上文相違則破是也。主欺賔者，我去尅他也。假如土為命，主飛入中宫，土旺四季，是主去欺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"賔。其宫有水為財庫，則取財不義，上文相順則成是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"主若旺賔，權尊禄重。賔如勝主，偃蹇傷殘。尅巳待人財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"遇鬼，僥倖致富鬼生財。慳吝一毫秋怕計，搜羅萬狀夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"逢熒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"主旺於賔，則其主厚。賔勝於主，則其主傷。即上意也。財遇鬼者，如丑安命，以土為財，而逢木刼是也。鬼生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785052186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"財者，如夘安命，以木為財，而逢水生是也。計至秋而氣巳衰，故主慳吝。熒至夏而性益烈，故主搜求。此理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":777,"lineType":2,"content":"極為明著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"土遇水，火遇金，居金谷而作主。金見火，土見木，在陋巷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"以安居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"此以主賔而言。我身旺，能尅他，則平生享用，如石季倫之在金谷園中。我身弱而為他所尅，則生平不足，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"如顔子之在陋巷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計占財，慳貪吏軰。炁金居命，節儉僧門。那堪一水加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，必主無知破蕩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203580944384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":793,"lineType":2,"content":"孛、計二星，本云曹吏之星，以之占財，則必慳貪。經云善掠人財𡚖自已，為縁水計㑹財星是也。炁金乃是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"清閒之曜，又主孤尅，以之居命，則為儉僧。經云孤神傍照為人難是也。此四星喜獨行，怕與水㑹。若有一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":797,"lineType":2,"content":"水加臨，則孛蕩、金泄，計戰、炁爭，又何疑其破蕩哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"身遇炁計，清閒技藝。財逢金帛，製造羅裳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":801,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：炁居命位，清間技藝之流。金入財宫，製造羅裳之士。即此謂也。但當審其身命官福若何，而後可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":803,"lineType":2,"content":"斷之，不可一槩論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"財主若遇天空，家徒四壁。田身復逢庫印，粟腐千囷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":807,"lineType":2,"content":"天空，天亡宫也。財星落空亡，又逢耗刼破碎，定至家徒四壁。庫印，四庫之中逢印綬也。若田宅身命二主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453188343185459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"入庫，逢恩得局，决主粟腐千囷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"先貧後富主欺三。先富後貧閑尅一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":815,"lineType":2,"content":"主欺三者，主强三弱也。閑尅一者，閑强一弱也。行限有逺近，故貧冨有先後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼旺財裒，雖榮亦辱。官輕禄重，縱富無名。權福若遇髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"强，家享千鍾之粟。耗刑而加地下，居無滴水之儲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼旺者，官星顯也。財衰者，財星䧟也。鬼旺財裒，則雖榮於官，而辱於財，即上章賔來尅主，作福作官，亦守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":823,"lineType":2,"content":"清貧之意。禄重者，禄神有氣也。官輕者，官主失䧟也。官輕禄重，則雖富於財，而歉於名，即上章主去欺賔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"為財為庫，尤還濁富之意。權福俱在髙强，家積千鍾之粟，富而貴也。耗刑而加田位，居無滴水之儲，貧且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785035802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"賤也。故凢人命富貴雙全者，必官福二宫生絶異，田財兩位更清竒，否則必不能𠔥之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"囚刑有用，田財受氣，威鎮邉疆倉廪備。福禄無情，身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"落空，闤闠蘧室忍饑寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":835,"lineType":2,"content":"身化刑，命化囚，謂之有用，本不為忌。若田財二宫，廟旺有氣，是身命田財俱羙，有體有用。故主為官，則威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":837,"lineType":2,"content":"鎮邉疆，更享富貴之樂。忌化福，難化禄，謂之無情，原不為羙。若身命二主，落䧟逢空，是身命官福俱𧇊，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"體無用，故主下賤，則闤闠蘧室，更受饑寒之苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"官星落陷名無久，財主𡚖窠富不休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":843,"lineType":2,"content":"官星者，官禄主也。官星失地入弱，雖榮名而無久。財主者，財帛主也。財主歸垣入廟，定殷富而不休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053438476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"貪濁無厭財命疾，清貧徹底命財留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":849,"lineType":2,"content":"財命疾者，乃命主疾行於財宫，有貪求之意。命財留者，乃財星留尅於命主，有難勝之患。故清濁不同如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"主宿随身，名不求而自得。財星背命，利多取而無成。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"主困於三河，浮舟作計。九宫流於九位，望海為生，蓽蓬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"托宿，四位遭傷，陋巷安居。田星落陷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":859,"lineType":2,"content":"命㑹太隂，坐於强宫，入躔升殿，名不求而自至。財同命主，入於䧟地，相背相尅，利多取而無成。三主，身主、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":861,"lineType":2,"content":"禄主、命主也。三河，周地浮泛之位也。午屬九宫，亦三河之地也。申宫立命，午為閑極宫，三主入此，已為受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621556790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"困。午宫閑極主，又流於遷移。子位子屬大海，是三主輾轉飄流，故主望海浮舟，作生涯也。四位乃田宫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"若四位遭傷，田星落䧟，又安得華屋而居之？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"財從白手而生，運限有氣。魂逐黄泉而去，循數無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"此下二條，専主限而言也。運限有氣者，乃五星入垣，官福髙强，隂陽順躔，馬遇長生，禄逢生旺，煞遇貴人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"四餘樂廟，皆是人命值此，决主財從白手，成家立計人也。循數無情者，乃禄逢衝破，馬遇空亡，限逢倒煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":875,"lineType":2,"content":"命值流星，運逢迎送，衆曜相攻，刃頭煞尾，羅計重逢，刑囚加夾，太嵗廹㐫，皆是人命值此，决主䰟逐黄泉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"亡死夭折人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"少年行空，作事如醉。老來行庫，生涯益昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785068570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"空者，天空及年空也。行空限，失其所依之主。庫者，年干納音基也。行庫地，得其所用之財。故主少年混沌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"作事無成。老來精明，生涯益盛。空雖凶而空其煞，則反凶為吉。庫雖吉而網其難，則反吉為凶。觀琴堂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"説，尤為精當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"炁木相攻，體如刀削。土旺四季，肌必重肥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"以下二條論人之相貌，自其顯露者而言也。木主瘦長，土主肥濁。木見炁攻，則其氣益泄。土逢四季，則其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":893,"lineType":2,"content":"氣益旺。人命稟之，故其瘦肥不同。若土氣春生，奴不勝主，雖瘦弱未必如削。土逢餘月，星不當權，雖豐腴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"未至重肥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水陽居海角，貌勝阿難。計羅土孛鎮天涯，威如那","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230579613706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"刹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":903,"lineType":2,"content":"佛有阿難，十分羙貌。鬼有那刹，十分兇惡。夘命，相貌在辰，是夭涯也。有計羅土孛凶星而居於辰，必生兇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"惡之貌。酉命相貌在戌，是海角也。有金木水陽吉星而居於戌，定禀都姣之容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"五曜順兮，心清如洗。四餘並𠔃，口濁如羝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"此下四條，論人之心術，自其隱㣲者而言也。五曜喜順行，四餘怕同聚。順行則清朗而可愛，同聚則混濁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"而可畏。人身命得之，故清濁不同如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"左吉右㐫心狼毒，前虚後實愈多謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"左吉者，命前相位有吉星。右㐫者，命後財宫逢凶曜。因前後之有吉㐫，則知外貌雖善，而中心狠毒矣。前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230579630090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"虚者，命前四位虚空。後實者，命後四位填實。因前後之有虚實，則知權變難測，而沉謀不露矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"笑裏藏刀身見刄，怒中無毒炁居空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":923,"lineType":2,"content":"陽刄主宰殺，天之凶神，最怕身見。大煞主㐫暴，地之惡曜，極喜空逢。若身見刄，則𥬇裏藏刀，是謂之小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"也。煞居空，則怒中無毒，不謂之君子乎。若身見刄而逢空，命坐煞而居實，則不可以是斷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"暗刑臨主，斯人能謹於言。囚忌當宫，此軰好談話覇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"暗囚乃化曜也。若刑星化暗，来臨本主，忌星化囚，正當命宫。暗則懦，故能謹言。囚則強，故好妄談。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"寡宿當臨，好守煙霞深處；孤神傍照，宜居泉石林中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":933,"lineType":2,"content":"此下三條論人之性情，自其喜好者而言也。寡宿孤神乃紫炁也。當臨是命宫，對照是妻妾宫也。天乙經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785084954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"云：天得紫炁，日月朗明；地得紫炁，祥瑞並生；人得紫炁，萬事光亨。又云：　一云孤宿，二云官星。孤宿妨妻害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":939,"lineType":2,"content":"子，尅䧟六親。官星𡩖慈愷悌，有權有職。詩云：紫炁清閑僧道人，慈悲齋戒藝術精。夀比南山松栢固，空房","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"對月度青春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"金孛與水同躔，迷花戀酒；水木和身共度，咏月嘲風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":945,"lineType":2,"content":"金孛與水同躔一宫，則滛縱無以自持，故好迷花戀酒。水木和身共聚一度，則流麗適以相濟，故主咏月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":947,"lineType":2,"content":"嘲風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"金孛如躔昴畢，皷舞終朝；水日若度參箕，笙歌一世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"昴、畢乃是風花雪月之星，参箕亦是春花秋月之曜。身同金孛躔昴畢，則鼓舞終朝；命和水日度参箕，宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230579679242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":955,"lineType":2,"content":"笙歌一世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"僕馬聚羣，奴婢成類。鴈行成陣，棣萼聨芳。六宫無戰則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"繁華，三位有刑分汝我。極宫兇惡鴈行孤，妾位相和夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"偶盛。四位空而無星，終身獨立；三方䧟而見煞，雙手為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":965,"lineType":2,"content":"聚羣，言多也。成類，則是主奴同心而盡其力。成陣，言衆也。聫芳，則與昆季齊名而並其芳。僕馬聚羣者，六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":967,"lineType":2,"content":"宫有天馬地驛馬元之𩔖。鴈行成陣者，三位照合，有貴人文印之𩔖。然又必有相生相成之星，相合相順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":969,"lineType":2,"content":"之宿，而後能成類聫芳也。妾位者，妻宫也。相和者，寅申巳亥一七相生也。大要六三一七之宫，喜金木水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785101338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":973,"lineType":2,"content":"陽長生，禄馬貴人相㑹，不喜水火金羅、刑囚破耗相尅。四位者，對合四位也。三方者，三方主也。對合無星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":975,"lineType":2,"content":"則其命孤，三方落䧟，則其類失，通加無救，不為獨力雙手之人乎？碧玉經云㸔方主以何如是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"子養外來生處絶，兒孫異姓絶中生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"生處絶者，如年納音是金，見時上丁己納音是土，金長生在巳，土絶在已是也。絶中生者，如年納音是木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":981,"lineType":2,"content":"見時上甲申水，木絶在申，水却生在申也。一云生處絶者，如男主木星躔在亥，是長生也，值丙寅年納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":983,"lineType":2,"content":"絶地在亥，是生處絶也。絶中生者，如木星填在申，是絶也，值壬辰年納音長生在申，是絶中生也。前說以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"時籍言，後說以宫主言，二說俱通，當併詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"交朋有信，體用相和。結義無情，主賔並戰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230579646474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":991,"lineType":2,"content":"體即主，用即賔，體用若相湏相和，必主交朋有信。若相尅相寃，定是交義無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":993,"lineType":9,"content":"下篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"不禄不官，惟㸔十宫誰掌握。無衣無食，便詳十一以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"慿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":999,"lineType":2,"content":"人命惟官福為重，茍有不禄不官，無衣無食者，将何以稽之？惟㸔二宫，慿誰掌握，必其非閑，神乃忌曜，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":1001,"lineType":2,"content":"至此也。舊注云：官福二宫，若官魁印綬，貴人禄馬，有用刑囚。禄主居禄，福主居福，晝陽夜隂之𩔖，管主成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":1003,"lineType":2,"content":"名發達。如晝火夜土，四餘交戰，日月薄蝕。刑囚尖拱，無情福禄，管主遭刑害破蕩之人。經云：身宫清吉休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1005,"lineType":2,"content":"愁命，福徳堅髙不問官。是又以福為重也，當併詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785117722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"信失禮虧，棄功名於物外。仁乖義絶，視富貴若浮雲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":1011,"lineType":2,"content":"在天為五星，在地為五行，在人為五常。其理相通而其氣相貫。故星盤一曜不明，於人未必無欠。茍土䧟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":1013,"lineType":2,"content":"而信失，火伏而禮虧，木空而仁乖，金爍而義絶，則其人終賤，而處世亦難矣，又安有㓛名富貴之望哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"主入天空，業如鎔雪。財親耗難，富若浮雲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1017,"lineType":2,"content":"命主入天空及空亡之位，財宫遇天耗及刼難之星，皆主無成立人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"耗碎欺財，不足守成之軰。刑囚欺本，無端破落之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1021,"lineType":2,"content":"耗與刑囚，化曜之㐫也。碎，的煞也。富命不能無耗碎，特不在財宫耳。若耗碎聚㑹而欺財，豈是守成之軰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1023,"lineType":2,"content":"貴命不能無刑囚，特不欺主木耳。若刑囚拱夾而欺本，必為破落之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621573174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"少喫多閑，三方變忌。朝飱暮討，二主逢空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1029,"lineType":2,"content":"三方主星化為刑忌，身命二主坐落空亡。倘無吉星之助，决為不足之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"暗耗欺遊，街衢呌賣。刄刑並煞，市井屠沽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1033,"lineType":2,"content":"暗耗，尅財之星，遊行街衢之地。刄刑，宰割之曜。大煞，權柄之星。使遊行有氣，身命髙强。無財亦可興販，帯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1035,"lineType":2,"content":"刃反為有權。茍遊行為暗耗所欺，命宫為煞刄所併，而他無可取，非呌賣屠沽之軰而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"暗忌相攻，與四鄰而不睦。田園破制，使三代以無傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1039,"lineType":2,"content":"命之左右為四鄰，使財相暗忌相攻而不相順，必主四鄰不睦，言身命孤也。父母宫為田園，使田園囚忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1041,"lineType":2,"content":"相制而不相生，必三代無傳，言根基淺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230579662858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"海角傷身，夜盖漁翁之網。天涯尅命，朝随裘馬之塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1047,"lineType":2,"content":"戌為海角，辰為天涯。如辰命金論，而身安於戍，是火地傷身，故夜盖漁翁之網，因其在海角也。又如寅命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1049,"lineType":2,"content":"木論，而木入於辰，是金地尅命，故朝随裘馬之塵，因其在天涯也。此命湏官福二宫，通無可取，乃以是斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"六八随身，身居萍梗；九三伴命，命遇栁營。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1055,"lineType":2,"content":"六八兩宫，名為惡弱，九、三二位亦號㐫宫。身命落此，更水孛相逢，孛羅來往，四餘駁雜。星辰退逆者，若非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1057,"lineType":2,"content":"栁營絶塞之軍，必是萍水他鄉之客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"身與四餘同度栁，必好為偷。奴和二主共躔箕，湏當落","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230579695626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1065,"lineType":2,"content":"炁、孛、羅、計為四餘奴曜，而孛、計尤為利害，固不可與身命同度。栁在天傍鬼，曲頭側伏，原非端星。箕在天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1067,"lineType":2,"content":"好風，倐聚忽散，本無定性，亦不可以身命同居。若身與孛計同度栁，以邪濟邪，故好為偷，二主落䧟。奴宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1069,"lineType":2,"content":"共躔箕，以弱濟弱，故主破落，而卒於無成也。若度栁而無四餘，止有太隂，是月掛栁稍也。躔箕而非二主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1071,"lineType":2,"content":"止惟奴宫，是箕翕其舌也。未可純以㐫論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"星栁宫中安首尾閒攤似鬼；虚危度裏有欃槍，見識如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1077,"lineType":2,"content":"釋義云：攤為開為鋪。星栁二星主盗賊，却安羅計，而與命同度。虚危二宿主清虚，若安攙搶，而與身同宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212120530984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1081,"lineType":2,"content":"皆主險邪機變，似鬼如神，非君子之流也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"燕趙有水計而不和，秦楚遇孛羅之交戰。不是蛇傷虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"咬，也遭雷打波沉。𣈆魯無情多縊死，周齊相反衆猖亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"生本者，威而不猛，尅身者，貴亦傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1089,"lineType":2,"content":"燕趙秦楚者，寅酉未已之分野。晉魯周齊者，申戌午子之辰次。燕趙水計相攻，秦楚孛羅交戰。更逢浮沉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"血光血刄，刑尅身命，决主遭厄無疑。夫水計孛羅，論相尅均謂之㐫，何獨言秦楚燕趙之位？葢孛在秦，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1093,"lineType":2,"content":"孛入秦州而羅壊之。羅龍角，是首携龍角而孛戰之。山下蒙泉之水，最忌計尅。大梁金牛之金，最忌孛泄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1095,"lineType":2,"content":"故於此為獨㐫。晉魯無情者，水火交互也。周齊相反者，日月反處也。故皆主不得其死。又當知有生我命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203580977152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1099,"lineType":2,"content":"主、尅我命主之不同。生我命主，星雖威力而有可救。若是尅我命主，縱成貴格，亦難免乎傷殘矣。詩曰：霹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"靂一聲誰不怕，命刑身䧟何湏訝。夀促當逢惡曜臨，其人死在雷霆下。又詩曰：血光入命必傷殘，刑犯㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1103,"lineType":2,"content":"時禍更専。六尺之軀亡虎咬，不然湏是溺波間。又曰：已夘二宫忌曜臨，命身化煞禍尤深。又曰：土金經躔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1105,"lineType":2,"content":"四正宫，死囚鋒刄怕主㑹。尅刑身命定蛇傷，不然虎咬君休恠。又曰：土臨八煞光灼灼，火在財宫福不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1107,"lineType":2,"content":"若是鬼刑属忌曜，蛇傷灾阻定當年是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"燕趙並行，身流西北；荆吳雙立，命喪東南。楚豳之邦逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"土計，宋徐之位見熒羅。身不亡於獸蹄，體必塟於魚腹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1113,"lineType":2,"content":"燕寅趙酉，荆已吴丑，楚已豳亥，宋夘徐戌也。寅酉並行，乃金木相尅。假如癸丑生人，納音木，不可受尅，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462723630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1117,"lineType":2,"content":"金木同躔酉位，是木到大梁，而金居旺地，木削於金，故身流西北。巳丑𩀱立，乃水土相尅。假如辛未生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1119,"lineType":2,"content":"納音土，不可受䧟，却水土同躔已位，是土埋雙女，而水居旺地，土不勝水，故命䘮東南。已亥逢土計者，假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1121,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬辰生人，納音是水，巳亥二宫立命，夜生土計同躔，是水随難而木見仇也。夘戌見火羅者，假如戊子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1123,"lineType":2,"content":"生人，納音是火，夘戌二宫立命，晝生火羅同躔，是火氣脱羅，性暴也。人命值此，皆不免䘮於非命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"風恙者，嵗星入楚。刑流者，辰曜歸揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1127,"lineType":2,"content":"楚属巽為風，木至此則動揺其根，而風恙之疾難免揚厲。坎為水，水至此則泛其性，而刑流之禍奚辭？詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1129,"lineType":2,"content":"云：翼有異風吹百木，火蛇熒木必生㐫。經云顰眉常不足，只嫌水到揚州是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛同行，為人好逞。金羅背去，性氣多虚。女人帯此必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462740014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"驚風，男子逢之為浪蕩。若遇刑囚與暗耗，定教凶夭與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"孤貧。衆憎指背煞難侵，宫半世顰眉，直刑尅本，或觀徃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"来，猶分背去。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1141,"lineType":2,"content":"孛計同行，則其性闘。金羅背去，則其勢分。故主其人皆剛狠，而有好逞尚虚之不同。然惡曜㐫星，在男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1143,"lineType":2,"content":"命中，俱不宜有，則一也。使遇福禄權貴善星助之，猶可觧救。若遇刑囚暗耗交㑹，是以惡濟惡難煞交侵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1145,"lineType":2,"content":"命位，宜取憎於衆人。直刑専尅身星，必憂愁於半世。然亦不可一槩論也。當於煞難直刑，察度數之往來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1147,"lineType":2,"content":"先後，分順逆之向背遲疾而斷之，庶乎其不差矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"五鬼尅身，終是身亡縲絏。三刑尅本，定然命喪沉塗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462756398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1153,"lineType":2,"content":"五鬼者，五官符是也。假如甲子年，五鬼在辰屬金，亥宫立命，金來尅木，太隂在戌，金星同度，又加三煞、飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1155,"lineType":2,"content":"廉，併天羅地網之地，故主極㐫。三刑者，寅、刑、已是也。假如壬寅生人，立命在已土，為刑星躔星，太隂躔申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1157,"lineType":2,"content":"寅刑已，已刑申，申刑寅，輾轉相刑，更加亡神、伏尸、闌干、貫索等關，故主惡死命䘮道路也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘並刑，因官喪已。三命遇煞，為鬪傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1161,"lineType":2,"content":"三命，身主、命主，度主。四餘並刑，乃三命遇煞也。若四餘星與身命度主相攻，或為刑囚加夾，或帯的刃衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1163,"lineType":2,"content":"併，非因官而䘮已，必為闘以傷身，斷斷乎不能免矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"讎鄉疊見，伸訟曷頻。刄處雙逢，兇頑無匹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1167,"lineType":2,"content":"仇鄉疊見者，乃是五鬼陽刄，又帶刑囚亡刼，的煞重疊，必𨺻官非。經云官怕囚星之反集，福嫌忌曜以相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462772782"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1171,"lineType":2,"content":"侵是也。刄處𩀱逢者，乃是陽刃重疊，如自刃、飛刃之𩔖，䧟之必主兇頑無匹。自刄者，戊刃在午，故戊午為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1173,"lineType":2,"content":"刃。飛刃者，午刃飛入子，故戊子為飛刄。詩曰飛刄自刄重叠來，兩般逢此便為灾。煞曜四强同水火，少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1175,"lineType":2,"content":"遇惡死為灰是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"綉靣紋身，貌神㑹煞。截頭刖足，體主加凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1179,"lineType":2,"content":"貌神、體主者，相貌宫之主也。若遇六曜受傷，五星剥雜，血光相㑹，的破交侵，必主綉面紋身，截頭刖足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"累犯三章，伏屍躔中遇鬼。頻遭百辱，卷舌度内逢刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1183,"lineType":2,"content":"三章，刑憲也。伏屍卷舌，闌干貫索，星家謂之鬼門關。躔度見不利，言人之累𤜱憲章，頻遭官辱，皆由伏尸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1185,"lineType":2,"content":"躔中逢尅身之鬼，卷舌度内值尅夲之刑。行限遇之，定主惡死無疑。若不遇鬼，不逢刑，對合参差，或有吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462789166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1189,"lineType":2,"content":"神解救，亦未可以㐫斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"煞難隨身，膏盲及已。刑囚尅本，痼疾躔身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1193,"lineType":2,"content":"煞難随身，㐫神貼體也。刑囚尅本，煞曜刑身也。故皆主不起之疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"奪項覇之材，海角帯刑𠔥尅本。𣑱伯牛之疾，天涯為難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"復纒身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1199,"lineType":2,"content":"海角為地網，為奴僕。天涯為天羅，為相貌。是二宫最弱，貴人不臨之地。而况帯刑囚以尅主，為難煞以躔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1201,"lineType":2,"content":"身，命值此者，豈不死於刑而殞於疾哉？假如六戊人命立辰宫，以金為主，飛入戌位火垣，火化刑尅本，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1203,"lineType":2,"content":"項覇雄材，終不免於㐫死。又如六已人命立亥宫，以木為主，身入辰宫金垣，金化囚躔身，縱伯牛徳行，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462805550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"難迯乎惡亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"衆惡臨夫夫疊損，群凶聚妾妾重傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1211,"lineType":2,"content":"衆惡群㐫，𠔥天星地煞無有救解而言。今人有一婦而損數夫，一夫而傷數妾者，正坐此耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"一七變仇湏失業，六三如反走他鄉。四位相欺家必敗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"本宫聚煞壽難堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"此節雖以一三四六七之相尅而言，而實有闗於身命也。葢十二宮分言之，雖有强弱不同，統言之，要皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1219,"lineType":2,"content":"和順為羙。如一七變為仇囚，六三與命相反，四位星辰相戰，本宫惡煞交侵，皆為不足，故主貧賤奔走，刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"尅不壽也。是知强宫固要有力，弱宫亦不可無情，看星者當𠔥審之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462821934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"方隅有犯，壽命難長。體用無情，福縁易消。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"方者，三方，隅者，四正。茍㐫煞交犯，而無救助之星，則壽命不永。體者，命主。用者，命限。若體用無情，縱有群","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1229,"lineType":2,"content":"曜之吉，則福縁易消。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"四正無星，三方落䧟，壯嵗若居䑓省，末年餓死陽山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1233,"lineType":2,"content":"四正空而無星，三方䧟而見煞，本為不吉，忽行官禄，限遇吉星得地，驟然一發，過此　一限，仍舊守窮途而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1235,"lineType":2,"content":"饑死。前言雙手為人，終身獨立，意猶未盡，故此復言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"命弱限强，發達不乆。命强限弱，榮超終難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1239,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：命强限弱，渾如逆艇上灘；命弱限强，終似槁苗得雨是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462838318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"兒女當傷，室家合戰，莫言安有刑害。限遇孛羅必喪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"兒女，兒女宫主。室家，夫妻宫主。此二宫星辰最怕相刑相尅。假如二宫遇原守孛羅尅戰，勿謂無有刑𡧱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1247,"lineType":2,"content":"湏行限遇之。或在夲宫，或在合照衝吊，孛羅尅妻子無疑。此重限而言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"三悲九哭戰年宫，每被妻孥之削。五鬼六衰欺嵗駕，頻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"遭官吏之辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1253,"lineType":2,"content":"三悲，三䘮門。九哭，九白虎。五鬼，五官符。六衰，六死符。若身命限遇三九五六之位，𠔥以流年相戰，則其㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1255,"lineType":2,"content":"必以類應矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"或有刼煞，多是流年作梗。更逢失墜，必惟嵗煞相攻。審","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462854702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉神之助，便無凶曜之侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1263,"lineType":2,"content":"刼煞乃是應天，所謂十六般亡神、十六般刼煞，人命中所不能無者。或有刼煞為灾害，必是行年衝併而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1265,"lineType":2,"content":"後為梗。不然亦是太嵗與衆煞相攻，故有失墜之禍。若得吉神以救解之，庶可以無㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"客曜占強，六親氷炭。賔星破主，九族華夷。忌讎流尅，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"賔煞難。直刑體用。察無根基之穩，斷為薤露之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1271,"lineType":2,"content":"賔星破主，與流尅主，賔賔字不同，上以難星言，下以限主言也。言七强宫為閑忌所占，則六親如水火之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1273,"lineType":2,"content":"不相入。身命主為閑忌所傷，則族属若秦楚之不相恤。忌囚者，忌曜化囚。煞難者，煞星黨難。直刑體用，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1275,"lineType":2,"content":"衆㐫㑹於當年。根基不穩，定死無疑。經云：太嵗迫㐫而入局，夢入南柯；流年㑹煞於當秋，歌興薤露是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462871086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"四位俱空，披頭撒髮。孤神傍照，員頂方袍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1281,"lineType":2,"content":"披頭撒髪，師巫流也。圎頂方袍，頭陀軰也。四位乃對合之宫，孤神乃煞羅之曜。四位無星，孤神傍主，非僧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1283,"lineType":2,"content":"道師巫而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁髙強，師巫有分。食神共位，俗計無縁。半俗半僧閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"伴主，孤衾孤枕命隨奴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1289,"lineType":2,"content":"紫炁若在髙强，又與羅計共位，是孤中之孤。故主俗計無縁，師巫有分。詩曰：紫炁逢入紫極宸，吉星同照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1291,"lineType":2,"content":"信精神。孤寡空亡閑極位，主為僧道九流人是也。閑極伴主，半俗半僧，命主随奴，孤衾孤枕，又當以紫炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1293,"lineType":2,"content":"遇蝕神而互觀之，不可執一論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462887470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"閑居命裡守孤幃，主到閑宫眠半被。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1299,"lineType":2,"content":"命主入閑，閑主入命，乃是互換孤神。更值紫炁奴羅照合，必主守孤幃而眠半被。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"夙夜忘憂閑伴主，朝昏勞役命随奴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1303,"lineType":2,"content":"凢身命不可失之於弱，弱則必牽於所遇。所以閑伴則閑，奴随則勞也。是故先立乎其大，則其小者不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1305,"lineType":2,"content":"奪。豈特於人為然，雖命亦有然者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婿寄生，一七主星互換。公婆真假，二三四位相依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"夫婿寄生，是夫入贅於妻，賴妻家以資生也。公婆真假，是不公婆其公婆，而父母其公婆也。夫婿寄生，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1311,"lineType":2,"content":"夫星入命宫，命星入夫宫，彼此互換。公婆真假，必財帛田宅，閑極三宫，互相依附，以致是二者又有得失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462903854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1315,"lineType":2,"content":"之辯。假如寅申已亥四宫，為一七互換，是水木相生，雖寄生，主夫妻諧老。未申二宫，為二三四位相依，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1317,"lineType":2,"content":"日月金水𩔖聚，雖真假，主富貴𩀱全。其餘他宫皆主不羙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"孛若欺金妻用妾，計如刑火息為兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"息，女子也。古人稱女為息，如呂翁謂家有弱息配髙帝，左師觸龍謂賤息舒其是也。妻用妾，是以妾為妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1323,"lineType":2,"content":"也。息為兒，是以女為子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
