{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"金孛為謀多侍妾，火羅背約奪人夫。炁計加臨無似有，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮辰交㑹有如無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1329,"lineType":2,"content":"金，妻星。孛，妾星。金强孛弱，妻主能為。孛强金弱，妾奪妻權。男命金孛㑹於妻宫，則多侍妾。女命火羅同於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462920238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1333,"lineType":2,"content":"夫位，則傍人夫益。男以金為妻，最怕孛泄。女以火為夫，最忌羅黨故也。炁孤計毒，相尅不順。鎮濁辰蕩，交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1335,"lineType":2,"content":"戰無情。若加臨交㑹於妻妾之宫，更臨四敗四煞，則於夫妻亦如有而如無矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"九三若㑹暗金，私滛棠棣。一七如加權印，內亂緦麻。太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"白逢凶妻魍魎，火羅帯惡子螟蛉。寡宿臨夫，明月清風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"誰與共；孤刑尅命，髙山流水少知音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1343,"lineType":2,"content":"金乃妻星，化暗則不明，化權印則非體。若化暗化權，與九六、一七相㑹，皆主内亂。然此論其大較也。使君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"前父側，權印何妨？火月齊明，化暗何害？惟賤曜相牽，咸沐相併，故可以此論之。太白逢㐫者，金神值亡刼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1347,"lineType":2,"content":"的刃，為流年衝併，必主魍魎之妻。火羅帯惡者，火羅遇刑囚天狗，為流煞交戰，定是螟蛉之子。孤神在隔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462936622"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1351,"lineType":2,"content":"角之位，寡宿在庫基之鄉。女忌寡宿而臨夫宫，男怕孤神而刑夲命，皆主孤幃獨枕人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"髙堂觀不可同行，河上䑓焉堪共度。自巳不遭妾辱，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"妻也，主淫娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1357,"lineType":2,"content":"楚襄王遊髙堂觀以夢神女，故宋玉有朝雲暮雨之咏。衛宣公作河上臺以要宣姜，故詩人有燕婉戚施","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1359,"lineType":2,"content":"之剌。此二事皆滛縱而破義者。以髙堂觀喻遷移，河上臺喻閑極。不可同行共度，言不可入命宫，占妻位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1361,"lineType":2,"content":"或與妻命同宮同度也。若此四宫主星混處互換，加以刑囚拱夾，其妻妄不豪覇而欺夫，亦必貪淫而可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1363,"lineType":2,"content":"耻矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"貌勝西施膚不朽，賢如孟母命歸基。偎玉偷香身坐馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462953006"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"迎新送舊主咸池。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1371,"lineType":2,"content":"金木水陽與身主㑹於相宫，必主有西施之貌。日月金木為命，主不起本垣，必主有孟母之賢。凢女命，安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1373,"lineType":2,"content":"身最怕臨官，四馬乃臨官之地。立命最嫌沐浴，咸池乃沐浴之鄉。偎玉偷香，迎新送舊，亦甚言其淫也。經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1375,"lineType":2,"content":"云：咸池一煞禍最真，逢水妖嬈主亂滛。沐浴進神仍見貴，必教傾國與傾城是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"六曜朝垣，夫榮子貴。五星聚貌，臉媚肌香。已嫁如未孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"神貼體，失婚似有賤曜磨身。遇木則天香國色，見火則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"佛口蛇心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1383,"lineType":2,"content":"六曜：炁、孛、羅、計、日、月、五星、木、火、土、金、水。朝命垣而六曜合格，聚相貌而五星相生，則四餘不可以㐫言，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462969390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1387,"lineType":2,"content":"相貌難槩以弱論矣。其有容色而享夫榮子貴也，不亦宜哉？孤神，炁也。兩賤，水孛也。貼體磨身，言與太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1389,"lineType":2,"content":"同宫而近度也。孤則孤，賤則賤，又何疑焉？五星中嵗徳最吉，熒惑最毒，故又抽而言之，以見命主貌宫，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1391,"lineType":2,"content":"木則善，遇火則㐫。安可以五星聚貌，盡謂之美哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"終夜迎歡，大忌賤垣合馬；未婚先産，尤嫌水孛扶身。逞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"扮者身臨四敗，披緇者命㑹孤刑。雲水之徒羅遇炁，風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"塵之女孛逢金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1399,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵女人之所忌者，咸池禄馬之地，月孛水金之星。然必身與命坐咸池，或咸池㑹禄馬，或水孛㑹咸池，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1401,"lineType":2,"content":"或金孛臨沐浴，方可以淫賤言也。若女遇孤刑，而男逢羅炁，則雖免於滛賤，亦不失為僧尼之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351462985774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"垣城合馬婦非為，帝座逢虚兒不肖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1407,"lineType":2,"content":"星家以垣城名日支，帝座名時支。琴堂以日支為妻，時支為兒，與子平之法同㸔。假如日属子丑，則以土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1409,"lineType":2,"content":"論；時属寅亥，則以木論。㸔土木二星坐落何宫，若逢生坐實，皆主妻賢子肖。此說的有至理，發星家所未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1411,"lineType":2,"content":"發也。今觀望斗之説，假如寅午戌生人馬居申，已為日支，已與申合，是垣城合馬。甲子旬人，戌亥為空虚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1413,"lineType":2,"content":"時支属亥，是帝座逢虚。故主妻多非為，而兒亦不肖也。此與琴堂之論合。　一説日納音生處為垣城，時納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"音旺處為帝座。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"兩賤扶身，煙花粉黛。雙凶夹命，自縊投河。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"兩賤者，金與孛也，扶身是同行同度。雙㐫者，計與孛也，夾命，是一徃一來。故一落風塵，一主惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463002158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞扶身，非懸屍則刎頸；群凶損已，不産喪也多驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"衆煞群㐫者，非特亡刼的刃、三煞、大煞之属。如火金相戰，水熒交逢，金羅來往，日月被傷，此皆為煞曜往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1427,"lineType":2,"content":"來，俱能傷身損已。經云：交逢陽刄，互帯懸針。楊貴妃身沒馬嵬，戚夫人體為人彘。若有晝陽夜月，福禄吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1429,"lineType":2,"content":"神加拱，天月二徳在命，雖有大凶，亦不横死，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"日换三粧，身營栁鬼。夜眠無伴，命度虚危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1433,"lineType":2,"content":"栁主輕揺，鬼主譎詐，虚主清孤，危主哭泣。如人身命居此四宿，必好為粉飾，而不免於孤眠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳眼桃花，外假慈悲而自重；鼠眸禄馬，內實滛蕩於私","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"期。太乙獨占咸池，風流倜儻；水金如臨沐浴，泛濫妖嬈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463018542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1441,"lineType":2,"content":"鳳眼桃花者，酉為鳯，庚子生人，見酉為鳯眼，酉宮之金飛入亥，見臨官為桃花，故曰鳳眼桃花。鼠眸禄馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1443,"lineType":2,"content":"者，子為鼠，丁夘生人，見子為鼠眸，子宫之土飛入已，遇馬元為禄馬，故曰鼠眸禄馬。二者雖異名，而實一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1445,"lineType":2,"content":"𩔖。女命值此，外雖假慈悲而自重，内實滛蕩於私期也。若月孛占咸池，水金臨沐浴，皆以此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠眼囘頭，踰墻偷漢。鳯眸順視，渡水從夫。見紅鸞，能惹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"王孫之腸斷；逢喜神，暗牽公子之魂消。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1451,"lineType":2,"content":"子生人以酉為咸池，以子視酉，謂之回頭。酉生人以午為咸池，以酉視午，謂之順視。回頭則曰踰墻，順視","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1453,"lineType":2,"content":"則曰渡水，亦曲盡人情也。紅鸞喜神，男命宜見之。若女命㑹於咸池，謂之賤垣，皆主貌羙有情，故多滛賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1455,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池煞，舊説申子辰三合見酉，已酉丑見午，總名咸池。今觀經云䑕眸鳳眼，回頭順視，桃花禄馬之説，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463034926"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1459,"lineType":2,"content":"純以子午夘酉言。如子見酉，酉見午，午見夘，夘見子，咸池遇咸池，故以滛賤言之。若總三合一例，驗諸女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1461,"lineType":2,"content":"命多不然，乃知望斗之論有的見也。經言子酉而不及午夘，餘以午見夘，夘見子，亦當立命，馬足前奔，鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1463,"lineType":2,"content":"頭反顧。然滛欲則不若子酉，豈非子酉為金水，五星中以金水多滛故也。此余獨見，觀者試思之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"權隠金神，掲鞭嫁婿。刑加火宿，及笄從人。咸池見孛，期","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"我桑中之約。寡宿逢羅，空躭枕上之歡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1469,"lineType":2,"content":"男女以火金為夫婦，化曜以權刑為男子女人。金不喜權，火不喜刑。若權𨼆金神，則金益剛。刑加火宿，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1471,"lineType":2,"content":"火益熖。故主敢於自為年少而求夫也。咸池本是浴地，孛星又好祼體。咸池見孛，在身命二宫，嬌滛可耻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1473,"lineType":2,"content":"經云那堪月孛占咸池，才子佳人事事宜。期我桑中清夜約，免教穴𨻶鑚相窺是也。寡宿本是孤宫，羅星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463051310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1477,"lineType":2,"content":"又好隔絶。寡宿逢羅，在身命二宫，孤单難言。經云明月清風誰與共，髙山流水少知音是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"命㑹攙搶，逞艷嬌滛之女。身逢天尾，慳貪節儉之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1481,"lineType":2,"content":"攙搶者，孛星，主滛。女人身命遇之，更逢差錯破碎。咸池沐浴，决主嬌滛逞艷，為色招㐫也。天尾者，計星，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1483,"lineType":2,"content":"筭。男子身命逢之更遇秋生失地。財庫無破，决主慳貪節儉，一毫不拔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒命數禍福宜詳。宫度失留三嵗死，前㐫後惡堕胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。四煞刑膚，胎內湏當破相。三刑尅命，産前必定傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1489,"lineType":2,"content":"小兒之命，亦有當論宫則論宫，當論度則論度。宫度二主，不可去留也。前㐫後惡者，三日宫之前後，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1491,"lineType":2,"content":"有㐫惡也。四煞者，刼亡、的刃也。三刑者，寅刑巳、已刑申也。小兒之命未有根本，最重命度與三日宫。茍宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463067694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1495,"lineType":2,"content":"度失留，則根基不壯。三日有犯，則受氣無資。刼亡的刃以刑身，已申亥寅以尅命，俱主難養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"月逢忌土，貌遇惡羅，不啞聾必生餘指，非秃痴也。主雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"盲。縱有吉星之𦔳，也湏㐫夭難當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1501,"lineType":2,"content":"此以下三節俱論小兒。言身主忌逢夜土，相貌怕遇日羅。如小兒身命值此，定主壓身破相，縱有木炁母星救觧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1503,"lineType":2,"content":"亦未如之何也。経云：生時疾厄臨人馬，又與鬼門同分野。坐䧟或逢土水刑，所傷必定主瘖啞。太隂火土處何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1505,"lineType":2,"content":"万，東出相逢最不祥。八煞惡星如照限，便知目精實遭傷。一主生時躔度逆，又𠔥羅計光相射。臨官𠔥犯太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1507,"lineType":2,"content":"時，左眼失明何慽慽。月逢計羅少光輝，右目盲來指掌稀。主順日月逢此曜，目疾由來且庶幾。忌朔望逢之更㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"月在㐫躔雙共乳，身躔次度兩同胎。奴來主舍，主起奴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463084078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"宫。不是随娘嫁娶，也湏換父操持。生命復生生兩子，尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"身重尅尅雙兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1517,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫躔、次度一也，惟其次度，故是㐫躔。危十二、十三、四度，張十四、十五、六度是也。更十二宫位，星宿隔界之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1519,"lineType":2,"content":"度，亦是亥有雙魚，已有𩀱女。若身臨此宫，又與㐫星同坐次度，多主雙生，奴星入命，主星入奴，又逢逆行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"相尅相反，必主重拜雙親。生復生者，如金為男，主躔巳，又見辛，已年納音金之𩔖是也。尅重尅者，乃煞處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1523,"lineType":2,"content":"逢煞，如金為男，主入戌地，又見羅之𩔖是也。生而復生，故有兩子。尅而重尅，故失雙兒。詩云：𩀱生已亥見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1525,"lineType":2,"content":"金鄉，寅入寅申合此方。未㑹次躔南到丙，火金土月㸔隂陽。男㑹忌星同月宿，此人湏喚妾為娘。又云：雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1527,"lineType":2,"content":"魚雙女主雙生，月入寅申計孛侵。男子兩途分朔望，望過一子一為隂。又云：三刑隔宿更空亡，華盖重併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463100462"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1531,"lineType":2,"content":"主過房。必是偏生并庶出，不然重拜兩爺娘。皆是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"三日加㐫三日䘮，七煞無救七朝亡。使一主之不虧，决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"終身之無咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"小兒生有三日、七日亡者，有長大成人者。三日亡，三日宫加㐫也。七朝亡，七煞無救也。長大成人，命主之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1539,"lineType":2,"content":"不𧇊也。葢三日宫係人一身禍福最緊，惡星躔之，灾禍立至。七煞是亡神，身主在七宫，值亡神，則命宫便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1541,"lineType":2,"content":"是刼煞，最為利害。若身命主廟旺不虧，更有吉星觧救，雖三日宫、七煞宫有傷，决主不死。經云：本主興隆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1543,"lineType":2,"content":"遇㐫危而無咎是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛穿身童嵗死，長庚伴月少馳名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463116846"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1549,"lineType":2,"content":"計、孛本是㐫星，最忌穿夾身命，或加臨三日之宫，童嵗次無成立。長庚本是吉曜，極星伴乎太隂，或更臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1551,"lineType":2,"content":"亥未之位，少年必擢髙科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其體用，察其主賔，復究洞㣲何若，更推流年相應，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"能窮此仙機，亦庶幾於望斗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1557,"lineType":2,"content":"體用，命與限也。主賔，主與難也。洞微，大限、小限。流年，急脚、黄泉。既觀本體，又察末流，既别大限，又推行年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1559,"lineType":2,"content":"則人之星命亦庶幾其不差云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855351463133230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kyb04/1-SK1609_figure_00033.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=L3TS8II%2F8UcHyVttWWsaqC4uyJI%3D","pictureHeight":346,"pictureWidth":358,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kyb04/1-SK1609_figure_00033.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=boBoEUa90zV5l5abnliqnI33FOw%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kyb04/1-SK1609_figure_00033.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"三辰通載一書，集琅玕源髓、西天都例、玉闗等經而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"作也。十一曜為一辰，二十八宿為一辰，十二次舎為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"一辰。凡星辰、廟旺、守照、常變、喜忌、吉凶、禍福，合三辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"而通載之，開卷了然，誠星家之淵海，術者之指南也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053635084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"論者病其博而寡要，法而不活，不善學者遂按圖索","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"驥，膠柱鼓瑟，謂其無驗，而作者之㫖荒矣。余重惜之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"乃摘取十一曜，仍為十一卷，參以總龜算法，綴於四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"經之後。原書首載三日八煞等論，理趣優長，則收入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"凡例。末載二明三暗之説，矯揉太過，則附於喬抝。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"余取舎之意。學星者參四經而㑹通之，又豈有弗驗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"哉？易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"總龜算法，先置積日一十七萬一千三百减七十四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"以周天三百九十八日八十八分六十一秒去之，看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"餘日多少，入在何段下太陽中定星度，又以餘日數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"去之，不滿者為定度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"晨伏，十七日行四度。去日十三度五十分，晨見東方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"順，二百十三日行十七度七十六分。留，一百十三日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"行十七度七十六分。晨逆，四千六百九十四分一十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621687862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"秒半。行四度九十一分八十五秒半。夕退，同上。留，同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"上。順，同上。夕伏，十七日行四度，須與日同度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"木徳，東方嵗星，君子之𧰼，每一年住一宫，十二年滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"一周天。行有前後順遲留伏逆，留段為天喪星，减福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"力；伏段闌干星，善惡都不管；逆段災杖星，反為凶逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生人以為禄主星。甲生人以為福星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"此星其色青，其性仁慈，乃福徳之星。廟亥樂，寅好申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"喜，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕。經云：木躔室宿是宫星，職禄彌髙列縉紳。望鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"應除清峻位，臨箕能出貴豪倫。申宫得見趨財禄，禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"主推之富貴人。身命限中俱見照，聲名財禄自亨榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412184115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"○賦云：木入秦州旺，而初歸巨蟹，木徳星君，所臨非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"主，亦為禄喜與水木日月同居。○鑑心經云：平生福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"禄又多才，水星同與太陽來。異寳從來家裏有，日加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上足多財。若在廟旺宫得地，無凶忌照破，則主人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"紫綬官班，職序貴品，家富豐肥，仁慈道徳，温良恭儉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"每每見之，皆言善宿，能解計孛之難，善免火土之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"縱在閑弱之地，亦為九流僧道之職。縱㑹刑星，亦主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"文章，雖不修讀，也逹文理。又曰：福壽之星，安身寅亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816705572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以此為學堂星；坐命在巳申者，以此為科甲星；坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"命在亥卯未者，以此為天元印；坐命在申子辰者，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"此為地元禄；坐命在巳酉丑者，以此為人元綬。惟六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"戊人見之，全减其力，更忌子丑，則名愠怒之星。○經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"云：木打寶瓶須破碎，○賦云：先吉後凶。木到䑕牛之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"地，此星皆怒，更為疾厄，在十二宫者，却不得力。凡坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"命在酉午者，以此木星為天厨禄主星。若命坐宫，名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"為天厨宫坐命，主人大富貴，一生快活，非特一身榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203581059072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，將來子孫分上，更享無窮之福。○經云：天厨一禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"少人知，識人須是洩天機。若在命宫為福𦂳，福徳遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"移又次之。男人得此多財旺，交遇中年好爵糜。女人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"逢之主封號，此是天上麒麟兒。○又曰：八宫宫主是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"天厨，宫主星髙禄更殊。若得吉星同在命，管取潭潭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"府中居。此星犯了人夭壽，若得髙強意自如。男兒命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"坐多逢此，真是人間大丈夫。帶此星在命者十有九，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴無不顯逹。若得遇水星為丙人天官正禄星，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053651468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"科名科甲五星合格，乃宰執公𡖖之命。如被惡星同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"照，則次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"木星在命為丰姿，眉目分明世所希。文學聰明多藝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"術，常懐仁義有尊𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"木星在命，形相端美，眉目分明，聰明文學，有尊𤰞之分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"無毒，貌怡怡，言談有徳好珍竒。少病利官無險難，夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"年長是及期頥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"木星在命，主人喜悦，言語有徳，少病夀長，每有險難，常有人救助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"廟樂，好官資，紫炁同宫筆吏司","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"若在廟樂宫，主官資顯赫，氣同是刀筆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621704246"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"三合逢之為福厚，對宫尤是好鎡基。日辰㑹合文章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"好，女后同宫貴位推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"木星與日水㑹合，主文章。與月合，有貴位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"夜火合，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"兵機，更逢晝土主旌旗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"與夜火㑹，主有兵權。與晝土㑹，主建旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"來須减力，金同文武佐明時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"金星同宫，文武俱備。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有辰星科","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"甲貴，位同天乙懶施為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"與水㑹，主髙甲及第。天乙㑹，性慵懶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"尾添毒，首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"助威，孛同何似獨居之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"與天尾㑹，主有毒。與天首㑹，主有權。孛㑹，亦㑹，乏力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"宫横寳須收得，閑極三人手足隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"在二宫好財帛，多有横來寳貝。第三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，兄弟三人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅富豪多宅舎，五宫偏見好男兒。第六䧟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212108029967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"宫奴得力，那堪第七美容妻。還居第八無時疫，第九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"他鄉得意歸。十位官資須顯赫，禄宫夀考亦龎眉。前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"言叙盡神仙訣，後學尤宜仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗星之號名為木，亥未虎猴俱作福。作福宫中仍或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，此星必定榮衣禄。○吉星到處皆為福，切忌三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜侵。三方對照還刑破，更居閑極反災迍。○雙魚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"宫內及幽州，此處應當仔細求。若在強宫或守限，少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"年談笑可封侯。○木入秦州事最佳，發財發福自成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453211785248794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"家。若還陷却凶星照，反為災咎走天涯。○木躔寅位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"五分佳，惟逢亥未發英華。不在閑宫為主將，錢財豐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"足四方誇。○莫以木星為大貴，子上依然不得地。兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"弟分離子息窮，辛苦飄流無大智。○金命見木如見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，及第成名因納粟。右官武弁及旺行，只為金星來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"犯木。○土人以木為官鬼，雖是相傷多有意。為官天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"下有竒功，只喜此星居亥未。○土人到巳正無氣，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"得木星先到未。已上如逢金水星，隂人大富陽人貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212120596520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"○木星疾厄反成殃，已前寅後却為祥。水與太陽隨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"後至，文學成名管簿尉。○婦人夘上木為權，大憂男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"女淚漣漣。土命酉生相對見，若無色好有牛田○亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"子午未之四宫，此星一吉為一凶。好問圖書乘廟旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"閑宫安命定昌隆。○三日宫中水木星，定教聰俊逺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"傳聲。三方更在髙強位，金榜髙登第一名。○木星天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"性好文章，須信聲名自此彰。更若官科俱得地，少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"及第紫薇郎。○木乃騰輝向璧中，若逢初度好奢風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816721956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"人知兩府成家者，更見科名不陷中。任是性靈無逺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"慮，終須髙處見乘龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：熒惑嵗星俱廟室，勲臣𣱵鎮昇平日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"木躔璧宿號天勲，金玉豐登近貴榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"若是夜生身不足，　日生終是富安平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"璧宿亥宫正位躔，　木星廟旺正朝天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"天徳好生生木徳，　木為仁曜自安然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"木躔奎宿號天耘，　災厄雖多訟獄頻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053585932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"少年有災妻子尅，老來方始得安寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"奎宿富生是本家，木星到此主榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"官崇位顯人尊重，即忌逆行留伏邪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

Indent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":579,"lineType":9,"content":"木星行度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"木在雙魚，在本宫室三度三十七分二十五秒至九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"度三十七分二十五秒以上，為木度正廟，過此度只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"是向廟，言不行廟度，向廟次之。在井宿二十九度以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"上至三十度為向旺。鬼宿一度為正旺，鬼二度及栁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"三度為次旺，過此為背旺。人馬是樂宫，居此生人主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"作金門之客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212120743976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"木星為清廟，室宿木之廟也。若六度以上九度以下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"為正廟，合居廊廟，為輔弼之臣。若逆行必為武職，居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"機要之地，仍須得火土助之，如金木助之，為文官居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"輔佐之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"木在巨蟹宫，臨鬼初度為旺，居貴地三十年，順為守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"相，逆為將，留為富。若在人馬宫，臨尾十二度、箕七度、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"斗五度至十二度，主大貴，主三進三退，凡三十一年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"仍須有力之地成大吉也。惟宜見火與羅㬋，必大貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212108177423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"與火相合貴，與羅㬋相合，與土不相得。日度，主文藝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"過人，有聲名權柄，親貴族，得國王重用，是主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"月度，主有文章，足詞智，知未來之事，是主星轉加福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"力，若腦後有髙骨，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"木度，主性格𡩖緩，文章出羣，居貴位，有二妻多男女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"更是主星，晝生富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"火度，主多災厄，好爭訟，少年難養，水同則减，主有好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"妻𠔥得妻財，主持國君務之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫主立性沉厚，好慈善，為人有信，作事方圎殊常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212108161039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"有福，每遇貴人見知，𠔥主有壽，更主國王重用，大用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"權貴，晝生人轉加福力，第二宫不見火土，乃大貴人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"見火惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫主聰明有文藝，得貴人見知，有聲名，足財物，知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"未來之事，日生最吉，是主星大貴，不是主星，平生有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"木宫主為人厚重，作事有斷，好聲名，足文學，是主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"日生大貴，不是主星，一生多財物，貴人見知，日生有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212120793128"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"福大富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫主為人性急，足威嚴，能經營事，主財物，是主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"日生在陽宫，有文武權，大貴，不是主星，晝主財，夜微","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫主才智，內貧外富，平生多口舌，足讒佞，無始終，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星，微有職，不是主星，且免貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫，主為人性急，見事深逺明白，於人有義，得大人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"委用，不乏財，近王侯。是主星日生富貴，夜生有財，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233599512587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星，平生多福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"木水同宫，聰明有文好修合，是主星大貴，有貴子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星喜與水星居，天賜洪休慶有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"百六㑹時千福備，等閑平歩入雲衢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"天命之宫水木星，　一生聰俊逺揚名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"三方更在髙強位，金榜須登第一名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616355378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星最喜遇羅㬋，閫外英聲孰可儔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"怒則誅姦欣則徳，如逢百六備休休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有木星無可怕，　最愛羅㬋一同舎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"晝則堂堂韓魏公，　夜則魁梧吕僕射。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁同宫，主少年榮顯，六親皆無妨害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178359331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：紫木不來難得解，任他文學動公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"寄語才髙須要命，不用頻頻祝上清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"木星紫氣福添隆，　百六逄之慶不窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"更在廟宫隂徳重，官為將帥位封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"木孛同宫，主憂驚得疾而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷木孛元來主壽齡，今日無分重與輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"人生九十髙年客，　皆由四正有強星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":771,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053667852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"木乃文才善美之星，順度而行，清髙益壽，臨於廟旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"職禄髙強，與日月同位居顯任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"木為文星，若臨廟旺，順行則主清髙富壽，更為方主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"曰生則主官崇位顯，封妻䕃子。貴格之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"木金禄厚，與水髙才，晝日逢之，輔弼可及。與計同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"臺諫之臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"若木星同金水入廟旺宫，晝日逢之，官至一品。輔弼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"之格與計同在寅位，名入廟旺，貴為臺諫，或掌兵權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616404530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"晝同炁土，貴而豪富。火月夜照，顯於台輔。晝夜背之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"刑而相尅，更在留逆，危而多失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"木同炁土晝見，或同火月夜照，主貴豪。若背而留逆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"即多失職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋同宫，威權極重。與孛同未，職參侍從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"木與羅㬋在宫，即為文職。威權貴祉之命，與孛在未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"不論晝夜皆貴，順臨髙遷，逆行力减，主背同凶，六親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"失陷，托附貴豪，必有謀用，雖同惡曜，少降禍災，遇吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212108210191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"星加之富貴，壽算綿延不絶，妻位有尅，謹儉去奢，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"或順臨，財多福厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":815,"lineType":9,"content":"木星照臨十二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":817,"lineType":10,"content":"命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"守照，命宫形清瘦聳，氣貌柔和，外弱中剛，身輕體重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"為人有貌，文筆自富，為性仁慈好道徳，温良恭儉，作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"事大體，不得進，自然身奮，衣食大旺，不招凶危，益壽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"算，官居五品，順旺則富貴，逆留薄財禄，遇事退懶，敏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453212053684236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"而少斷，與日月同宫，足禄多財，與金同在身命，自然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"顯逹，愛亥卯未宫掌禄大吉，寅宫有官，八宫主殃，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫家庄廣置，在陷害逢火短壽，見火與羅㬋大貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"忌火孛紫，計在六十二宫不得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木照人聰敏，　　藝術及文才，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"逢危能脫難，　　財禄晚年來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"木星在命好容貌，白凈身材又更長，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"若為禄主長生位，　自然聰俊有文章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621737014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"木居命裏性柔和，更説能文主貴科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"水若同宫并對照，淵源滚滚是英豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":851,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"主大貴，近至貴在人馬宫，得十二分力，財物滋潤，積","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"聚無破，中末大旺，○木照，一生財帛豐足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷木星好樂更臨財，　一世榮華少有災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"更得善星居上下，雖然運蹇福還來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺財帛宜拱照，木徳臨之固佳妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178342947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"若是身入弱宫中，决然先破成家道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":867,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"主三兄兩弟，與人皆孝友，上和下睦，𣱵不相尅，○木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"照主有貴相兄弟三人，如伏逆留則全無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷兄弟宫中木照時，吉星虧陷豈相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒鴈序恩情重，恐解東西各自離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟有名不得力，　只為星辰都不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星宜向火中求，紫炁木星是虚得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816771108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":883,"lineType":9,"content":"田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"主業産毗和，田宅増益，父母俱慶。又云：木居田宅極","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"為強，○木照主有絶户隂人田産。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷木星得入四宫中，可見無災喜慶重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅昌榮須守祖，不逢破敗福豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅名為父母宫，木星相並亦為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"除非亥夘未宫見，　他方亦與惡星同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":897,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412266035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"主男少女多，日生則多男，夜生則次男。聰明智慧，女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"有四徳𠔥全。○木照有文章之子，春夏有，秋冬保一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星守位子孫多，太乙臨之怎奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"更有紫氣同宫度，老年絶嗣更多磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"木徳加臨在旺鄉，　兒孫宫裏喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"到頭得力招三子，　箇箇榮華福禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":915,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816803876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"主得奴僕力，○木照合有貴相，鞍馬招得力女婢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷身主之星是木星，豈教陷弱六宫存。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"立身立事皆低下，多幸終身靠子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"萬嵗星居第六位，爭知奴僕最為良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":927,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"主妻子好顔容面貌，有百年偕老，亦無尅害。○木照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"主美貌福相之妻，宜婚外方之家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷有妻又有妻，家産只為紫氣同。木星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616371762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"若在未申亥寅上，置田多是用妻名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"第七宫中木星遊，聰明典雅備祥休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"更饒娶得真賢婦，偕老同心到白頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":943,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"一生無疾厄，常享清福，永無不測之災，自有大來之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"慶。○木照招福壽，不患重病，少非横災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷木星疾厄照其宫，　氣宇安榮語若鍾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"弱位更教金宿尅，　顛狂怪誕有如風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014161947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"木星解散照臨宫，　且免平生患難聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟財禄多饒潤，體貌堂堂逈出羣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":959,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"宜行藏運動，或作贅他人，凡有所謀，吉無不利。○木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"照，招外富貴，接識宜逺行，到處受衣食安樂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷第十宫中見木星，平生衣禄保安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"須知宏麗文章秀，甲第登髙到九𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"木星元出坐官宫，作福從來不作凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014178331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"躔地斗牛星衆顯，千災萬禍不相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"此命必入五福格，一生全無蹇滯，常處康泰。○木照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"主福禄稱意，財食大來，立身髙上，常有貴人喜重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷木星一曜最尊崇，下照當生福徳宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"經史優㳺多博學，不勞跬步至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"主人肥厚，堂堂有子張之容，便便同邊韶之腹，温良","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616388146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"仁義，機變超羣，行步輕健，作事洞然。與人交結，久而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"敬之。喜林泉，好技巧，不懐欺詐，得恩便報，有崇奉道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"徳之意，無凶頑欺狡之志。此星不欲處相貌奴僕之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"位，盖為貧弱之地。○木照，主形相分明，十相具足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷欲究前程看木星，得臨相貌不尊榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"陷宫更有凶星入，　官府刑名累見黥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"木星如臨相貌宫，清竒古怪好相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"傅説植鯺商宰相，太公非虎作三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412282419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1027,"lineType":9,"content":"木星變段名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫。欄干星　又名曲直星，主先破後成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星子位號欄干，命若逢之見福難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾同宫并火孛，厨無禄食盡天年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫亶婁星又名文印星，技藝工巧文筆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：亶婁三公且平和，　八煞宫中阻難多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"身命若能無惡曜，資財足用免奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫禄存星　又名文章星，讀書進身文學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234010570786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木居人馬禄存星，七強宫喜立鴻名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"更得貴人逢禄馬，　三垣滿用佐朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫鳯翔星　又名天甲星，主九流伎術也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：氐房心宿鳳翔星，財旺身宫禄更榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"益子榮妻承祖福，惡星相犯不為驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫青龍星　又名天徳星，横財為福有徳行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：嵗星辰上號青龍，　四正宫中爵禄崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"太白相逢官品極，　不讀詩書也䕃封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234010587170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫岩蛇星　又名科禄星，科名清貴之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：荆州楚分號岩蛇，　狼毒貪汚性好華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"狡猾凶頑曹吏輩，或為商賈不思家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫，横屍星，　又名䘮車星，䘮害六親孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：三河周分木為乖，身命遭逢百禍來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"三限若教一限到，須主性命到泉臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：未宫入廟清華貴，四十五年為福利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178375715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"文臣官列至朝參，武顯邊疆郎將位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫，天傷星，　又名天棊星，主藝能財業成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星西向號天傷，火計相侵入夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"為道為僧身不了，為商為賈路中喪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412446259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"火德南方熒惑星也，一名虛漢星，又名靈漢星。其色","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"赤，其性禮，執法之𧰼，履道而明，民安國泰。退逆失度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"或犯天闕，或犯南斗，或入紫㣲宫，天下大亂，死人無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"數。行度無定，故有前後順遲留逆段，大抵約二年一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"周天，順疾而行則為福；入留段號天虹星，招火災；入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"逆段號天坎星，主瘟疫；入伏段，號走曜，主暴災厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生人以為禄主星：　　乙生人以為權星：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生人以為囚星；　　丁生人以為印星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621835318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生人以為正魁、刑星；　巳生人以為貴星：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生人以為䕃星；　　辛生人以為耗星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生人以為福星：　　　癸生人以為暗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"鑑心經云：夜生火曜照蝎宫，合主三台殺伐權。若然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"居丑與奎婁，夜生必定佐王侯。○厯𧰼賦云：南方星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"官在蝎宫，面貴饒衣食。○詩云：火躔心宿職彌强，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"殺權威鎮遠方。斗宿度中兵任重，婁奎星內禄非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412413491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"夜向申宫名喜位，水金同照任朝堂。星主夜逢宫度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"順，定招財禄兩榮昌。○晝生人逢之為忌星，最怕陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"宫也。又不可以日生火，便言忌曜，須明喜樂好旺，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"為禄主，或為權星，或是三方主，或作科名星，詳其所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"臨宫分三合照臨，察其災福。如晝生見火在隂宫，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"為大害，臨危不危，臨險不險，總有災殃。虎頭䑕尾都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"例經云：夜生忌土晝忌火，各自相逢必為禍。土在陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"害火在隂，縱有災殃還較可。○經云：莫言忌火便為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178474019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"災，若為方主禍不來。此星英雄武畧，威勇猛烈，大怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"酉辰二位，號為怒地，主人尅害骨肉。鑑心經云：火星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"若在酉與辰，其人少失二尊親。又云：火星行到參星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"腰駝眼瞎。賦云：中年運蹇，見生時火在酉宫。賦云：金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"臨火位，其人少失尊親。火入金宫，此命早抛兄弟。葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"辰酉乃金星好樂之宫，火星到此相尅，故為慍怒。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"火命不論此。若君子之命，已入貴格，更得劒鋒星煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"入命，則為三司格局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌生人，劒寅鋒丑。　甲申生人，劒子鋒寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午生人，劒戌鋒辰。甲辰生人，劒申鋒午未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅生人，劒午鋒申。甲子生人，劒辰鋒戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"小人在命主不善，死在八宫十宫有權。此劒鋒之煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"利君子不利小人。君子則貴，小人則凶。女人以火照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫者，口硬心軟，處性不和，生得端正，多與夫不和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"如廟旺則貴，兼以此為夫星，若得地則䕃潤夫宫偕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412429875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"老。大抵火遇夜則光，金遇夜則明。坐命在亥卯未者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"以此為地元禄。坐命在寅午戌者，以此為天元印。坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"命在申子辰者，以此為人元壽。六甲生人，以火為天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"官正禄，與之同宫則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
