{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑之星本日餘，須分晝夜定賢愚。夜生隂位更逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"廟，面色微紅眉又踈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"火好夜生在隂宫，主面色㣲紅，眉目踈秀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"有武藝，㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"兵書，言詞猛快氣豪麄。形神上小下須大，只好安身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621868086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"武位居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"夜生在四强四正宫，主有武藝，言詞猛快有膽氣。只宜武位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"權握重，管兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"機，生來財物又居儲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"夜火在命主有權，掌有財禄富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"惟怕晝生陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"宫度，面生顴骨惡肌膚。火性剛，多燥暴，常懷氣概立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"身軀。不招祖業資財散，博弄經求及宰屠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"火星剛日生為忌，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"陽宫生面骨腮火急，不招上祖産業。多愛博弄，乃屠宰，伏仗氣既立。身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"逢日月事何如，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"爺娘早逝早嗟吁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"晝火逢日月，主尅父毋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"歲熒兩備兼文武，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"土英雄亂世需。若遇金星淫更佚，妻招産厄至。嗚呼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"火木相合，主文武俱備。火土相㑹，必為亂世之英雄，更招妻産難也。火金相㑹，主妻淫佚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"水與孛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230621851702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"愛穿窬，更逢計曜定遭誅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":163,"lineType":2,"content":"水火孛同，主作賊。計都主惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"天首武臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"高貴位，如臨紫炁號師巫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"火羅相逢，主武位有權，與紫炁㑹。師巫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"居財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"帛財帛虛，三宫兄弟主流徒。田宅祖居相破蕩，六宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"放火是家奴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"晝火在，財帛不招。財帛在三宫，兄弟遭徒。在六宫，破祖業。在九宫，主奴僕放火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"五位長男先惡死，七宫妻妾亦先殂。疾厄瘟㾮腰背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"曲，遷移客死别人廬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"晝火在五宫子息惡死，七宫尅妻，八宫主瘟㾮及腰駝背曲，九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"宫客死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"居官禄有憂虞，血光刑獄事區區。福徳宫中人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"促壽，䧟害十相不全俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"晝火十宫主刑獄血光，十一宫促壽，十二宫十相不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233599561739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"微妙仙經無價寶，珍藏待價却沽諸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"廟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"京東路","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"火入天蝎卯上，名為天成天角星。若生本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"路，身命遇之，更八煞官禄宫有星，學館星不閑，便為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"貴命决之。若只八煞官禄宫有星，只陞朝格中富之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"人，如見禄馬八煞官禄無星，亦是四品之官，兼主武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"職，不在䧟宫，兼有官資，或遇留伏逆減半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"樂宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"京湖重宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"火入白羊戌上，為左契右契星。如人身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616502834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之，加臨官禄，更有吉星，定應兩制之貴。中犯煞者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"便為武職將軍之位。星入八煞官禄宫，皆為樞職，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"作從官，須兼帥職，女為命婦，須尋禄馬高低斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"旺宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"兩浙路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"火入磨蝎丑上，名為天權天皇星。若人遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"之，主一生作事亨通而大富。如官宫有星，只作官職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"斷之，僧道見之，有住持之望。若遇兵戎，必作上等郎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"員。留伏逆減半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"順段：火入順段，名為天偕天武星。若人遇之有救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234010800162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"星，更犯煞星，必作武職六品之官，兼為將軍。女人為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"命婦，更尋禄馬斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"留段：　火入留段，名為天剉天哭星。若人於身命見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"之，皆主好殺，其心不慈不仁。若有救星，却主平善。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"入䧟無救星，皆坐遠配軍州，不祥之禍，斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火入留段名天厭，身命逢之名恥玷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"平生雖善治家生，亦被妻兒多怪念。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"伏段：火入伏段，名為天婁天車星。若人身命見之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616486450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"皆犯囚刑重難而死。若有救星，却於分野上尋斷，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"星最怕居忌䧟，主有不祥之禍，或有救助，主於爐冶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"中求覔衣食，亦主孤獨。若婦人為風塵不善之家，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"隨忌䧟高低斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"逆段火入逆段，名為天患伏尸星。若人身命見之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"無入格星辰，皆主孤寒貧苦。若䧟忌，定主惡疾，或犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無救星，皆主非横死，女人産厄，見血而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷火星前逆名困厄，親上施恩反作讐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203581124608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"在命輔身臨妻位，　一生性蕩遠方遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"火星后逆名披首，　心蕩花衢最躭酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"煩燥心神無三思，因兹暗裏成災咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔角宿號天娼，衣食隨時不善良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻尅子婚難合，　免教食禄見恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"火星偏好角星逢，角木相生勢位隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"得禄理財全在手，若逢水曜必須窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014243867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔亢宿號天戈，妻妾宫中有折磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"好色損妻心不定，此人衣食必奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"火加亢宿主離財，　夜裏生人亦有災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"若是日生憂壽促，　只逢孛計為同來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔氐宿號天輕，衣食生來不稱情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"心性輕狂多膽智，晚來稍稍得安寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫見火為之主，未到氐宿度土度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生留逆遇皆凶，夜生順行多智慮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234010767394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔房宿號天梁，官職超遷輔弼良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"將相公侯名極貴，此身佩紫與金章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑房二并四度，　超越之人誠好武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"雄豪大畧主威權，富貴榮華官職固。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔心宿號天相，　統領兵機為上將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼樞府四十年，富貴功名徹天上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"火從心宿號明堂，　初度之三正相當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"統壓萬兵權至重，文星魁發少年郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178441251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：熒惑正行心宿度，高牙大纛擁旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔尾宿號天穆，　此人必定榮衣禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"安然𫟚面不奔馳，超騰晚景最多福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"尾宿之中當防火，姦險所為難保可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"不然瘡癤阻於人，　亦主一生多横禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：熒惑之星躔尾宿，　禹門一躍過天池。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔箕宿號天明，作事機權性最靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"為官須得君王用，大任終當領萬兵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234010832930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"箕星不要火相逢，火躔箕宿益飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"箕好火風終汨沒，水星同度火須凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔斗宿號天征，生殺之權有大聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"禄旺中年主富貴，位至三公及九卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"斗十八至二十一，　火曜夜臨主貴極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"公卿帶印掌高權，尤忌伏行生在日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔牛宿號天朽，先代家資盡滅亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"形貌魁梧多智勇，此生終不少年郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726414371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"牛星雖是屬丑宫，火臨此地晦朦朧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土不明多騫滯，縱教辰上亦生凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔女宿號天暗，多成多敗心狂亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"若非木旺在宫扶，六親害盡資財散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"女子如何被火煎，便教富貴壽難延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"惟甲夜生行順疾，此身當在聖君前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔虛宿號天磨，貧困初年財不多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"心愛是非躭女色，更添女子不相和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252666867739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"虛星屬子一陽生，火逢坎地固難明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"况是北凝兼水旺，火為離曜必傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔危宿號天淋，　好色貪花智勇深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"破家離祖自成立，　施恩終是福重興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"火星齊地過危橋，夜順光明事可饒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"炁若同之為旺處，官位高遷職更超。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔室宿號天强，　勇智操持武職良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"更得木星來救助，　定須學館作文昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252666818587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"火宿從來室火猪，自知夭壽命難踰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"炎炎不息終為禍，男敢妻家女敗夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：熒惑徳星居廟室，勲臣永鎮千秋日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔壁宿號天滅，兄弟兒孫道路絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"伶仃孤苦萬千般，　晚年稍稍身安悅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"璧宿切莫火相侵，　壁為水曜夜常明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"火曜來躔終不利，熒躔璧曜正刑星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔奎宿號天厨，衣禄生來自有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234010783778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"勇藝智高才學美，定是威名達帝都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"奎木之中生火曜，　文學聰明夜生照。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"若是逆留六八宫，　不主令終亦主天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔婁宿號天暘，命裡逢之出賛襄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"恩徳又施家富貴，淵源學問翰林塲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"火星雖為戌宫主，　若是婁中亦可住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"招刑招疾且生凶，　夜則順行人喜遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：熒惑當知廟樂婁，　官崇威重位分茅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816885796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔胃宿名天沒，　定是終身無子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"中間困苦又艱辛，奔走東西漫勞役。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑膽氣更豪雄，胃度之中且莫過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"那更土并羅計合，　自知壽短禍消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔昴宿號天鏤，身蹇身孤性自愚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"貪酒多滛心不足，　到頭衣食亦無餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"昴宿正屬酉命中，火燒牛角正添愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"若是木星同度立，　火無西旺水終揫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014227483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"火𨇠畢宿號天危，身見災迍必損妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"破家蕩業須遊冶，資財耗盡走東西。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"畢宿雖樂月中烏，火行此地自難居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"火燥不堪行沒曜，便有熒光禍自如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"火𨇠觜宿號天滛，　風花雪月四時并。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"浮泛自然家業破，奔馳晚歲始身榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"古法常言火轉申，誰知觜宿好相親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"日月同之多眼疾，夜生順度始光明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453203581140992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：火躔觜宿福偏洪，龍躍天池氣概雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔參宿號天倫，性如風火好傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"工巧細心兼有智，做些隂隲與兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"參宿從來屬隂陽，火入隂陽氣自剛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽配合精神足，　坎離交感火明彰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔井宿號天終，　智慧威嚴膽氣雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食平平人命蹇，晚來方始見榮通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"井宿半度在申宫，　十七度中未位逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616470066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"火到此宫須怕水，縱逢吉曜亦無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔鬼宿號天祥，此星家富少兒郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐天年多夭折，不然惡死沒家鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼宿為曜號金牛，火通明處鬼難當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"金地火星常照灼，此星為惡不為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"火𨇠柳宿號天馳，多慮多疑多是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻害子兄弟絶，平生衣食却隨時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"火星居柳多驚怕，惡死猖狂甚奸詐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453237412397107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"男女必是少年亡，　女人産厄何足迓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔星宿號天榮，必定前程有大聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"更得十宫星有力，為官穏穏到公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"火星切忌來星馬，損父元來從母嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"日生最重夜生輕，處世忙忙無少暇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔張宿號天頡，汨沒平生難共說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"若非壽夭父母亡，　尅子害妻兄弟缺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"張宿更在午星遊，火曜逢宵展大猷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453257284763648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"木曜同躔張宿上，若加禄主位封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔翼宿號天憐，　心性猖狂學少成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"智術多端加嗜慾，衣食生來却稱情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"翼宿屬在雙女宫，　火臨初夏氣英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"火曜不堪來此立，那堪見水又無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：火星最好來躔翼，輔佐邦家權要職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"火躔軫宿號天暴，　手足風狂損年少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"晚年衣食稍平安，　只恐妻兒命難保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726447139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"軫宿屬水又水宫，　兩逢水曜氣英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"火曜不堪來此立，身遭鬼尅不堪供。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"火星在天蝎是本宫，自氐宿五度八十一分至十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"度十一分，係行火度，不為廟度。自氐宿二度至三度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"為正廟，不居此度為向廟，在磨蝎宫。斗宿十八度至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"二十度，并牛宿初度，為正旺。白羊為本宫，是次旺，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"時遇之，主為重權之人。熒惑為明堂，火之廟也，主為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014342171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"將相，秉重權，有威望。若在房二度者，亦旺二十年。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"在心初度至三度，為上將，綂萬兵，出將入相四十年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"見土為旺，見金水，好神仙之事，見首尾𥝠通國戚，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"水，以賤為妻。若在斗十八度及二十一度，必為公卿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"即二十年秉生殺之權，常帶將相之印，仍不犯日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"及水土，則貴，若見水，則被人妬。若在四正宫，為本宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"居奎宿，則有文章，若逆行苐七八，不善終，雖順行亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"損壽，見血亡。與木相資，與金相仇，與水相惡，同宫為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178523171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"水尅，即惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"日度為人性急，幹事不免是非，一生被人作念，損祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"財，老當刀兵之厄，是主星夜生有位，日生有財，不是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"主星，平生多訟，好色慾，𠮓善為惡，晝生帶劒死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"月度主性急，食𤰞下之禄，雖聰明亦短天，其人出言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"不實，多是非，與人交結不久長，多有暗昧災，因文人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"有厄，是主星得免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"木度，主一生多災厄，因疾病中損害四肢，或犯風狂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453257284796416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"損傷男女，是主星得吉曜相扶助，則可減矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"火度，主威名嚴厲，一生足詞智，因武藝則有鋒芒，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫，亦忌小人相損，若是主星，總被人損，亦不成事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"因此得重禄，更兼勇智超羣，若有損即轉貴。土度，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"損兄弟男女，主惡死，木見則免，三十二以後有財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"金度，主一生多受貧窘，因女人敗聲名，木見則免。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星晝生轉加福力，身有貴位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"水度，主一生多災厄，施恩徳有不善之報。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014358555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":631,"lineType":9,"content":"火星入宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫作事多成，為人性急有聲名，善决斷，有武勇，作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"文詞，是主星有權兵之貴，不是主星，目疾損父母或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"夭死，天乙可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫，主性格不安定，多驚怕，出言不審是非，若是主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"星，夜生有位，日生有財，不是主星，夜微有福，日生被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人損䧟，亦主促壽不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"木宫主得王者任用，有兵權之貴，為人內剛外柔，於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453257284829184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"人有義，見事深遠，是主星有權貴，不是主星，大富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫為人性堅宻，有道藝，好文才，足聲名，富貴機巧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"若是主星，富貴非常，不是主星，性急忠直，外敏內剛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"知人災福，又好燒煉，夜生富貴，晝生財薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫性急，形貌魁偉，有勇志，損祖業兄弟，好行凶惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"招暗中是非，有惡聲名，不足畏懼，是主星，好殺有權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"不是主星，多因殺害而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫好色損妻，好鬭争，見事不遠，與人交結無終始，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233616535602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星㣲有職位，不是主星，㣲有財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫，工巧細心，有財智，多刑獄，好殺害，一生多被人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"阻撓，與人結交無終始，是主星見小利，不顧大事，幹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"事多成，每被人損䧟，是主星可免，非主星因小人損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟性命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":677,"lineType":9,"content":"火星同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"火土同宫，主性凶惡，好殺害。土是主星晝生，火是主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"星夜生，及順行本位，至防禦練。土是主星夜生，火是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252666916891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"主星晝生，各乗旺氣，可主監司。如不乗旺氣，主微職，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主多疾，横終腰疾，言語吃𤁧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷。火星㑹土福偏隆，錦繡文章氣概雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"南極星官添福壽，封侯萬户食千鍾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"火金同宫，主性急燥，見事不長。一生少得婦人私愛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"多被婦人損䧟，難婚姻，妻妾不良，多滛慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火星度㑹喜逢金，　百六當之慶瑞深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"人若逢之登上第，佳名蕃衍世皆欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252666949659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"自來熒惑怕逢金，　共照隂陽必主滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"更有惡星刑戰着，不過强仕即悲吟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"火水同宫，主平生多學道藝，兼好文章。若俱順行不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"伏逆者，是事有成。伏逆者，每事多難。有善星相扶助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"主有位。無善星助，主目疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火星怕與水星交，　困苦相殘百事淆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"隳癈凌遲逢百六，　夫妻父毋總相抛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"火如逢水自相刑，怕在陽宫與晝生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453238913744907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"不滿三旬防横死，若能知命學修行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"火木同宫，主大富貴，有權位，主兵刑。在壽限，主長命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"在陽宫，薄壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅同宫日則凶，夜生主為國臣，在九宫方主無力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014374939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"主燒屋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726512675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"火星臨人命，主人意氣雄勇，急直好勝，明敏見快，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"學少成，得志則寛量，失志則𥚹燥，心明性急，意直膽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"大，愛骨肉，與人交則不能長，古執自持，傲上喜大，凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"事後悔，性不好閒，愛技術，善醫卜，不受拘束，不奈觸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"犯，有枕骨，睡多側臥，先瘦後肥，因災𠮓福，始勤終怠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"好食硬物。夢則雲水波澤，荒邱古塜。疾則足同脾腎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"有膽能權握，順㫖則喜，逆意則嗔。夜生逢此廟，樂則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"文武兼資，勇智並用。若逢土孛、計羅同宫，主人凶暴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726479907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折，作事迍蹇，纔有吉慶事，又或顛倒。夜生必有九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"九之數，其事綿延，凡事稱遂。○火照，主性燥暴，不奈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"人侵欺，合主中年抱四時患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火照命宫心量洪，𠋣公附勢立身躬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"初年財散家難聚，順旺如逢財禄豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"火人不要火居命，兩火炎炎空自盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇火星居天蝎，　富貴光華須易熄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"身命宫中遇火星，　此人燥急性聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252666966043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"平生喜怒真難測，凡事須交立便成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":849,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"初年耗散，有似蓮花貯水，纔滿必傾，多招是非。若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星合照同宫，則反凶成吉。財帛四十八後，五十以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"前，漸漸見發。○火照，一生招盗損財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火星財帛旺初年，中主交時恐不堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"若得善星同照犯，末年退後又團圓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛宫中要得豐，豈容惡曜故來攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233599660043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然凶曜來相犯，帑庫炎炎一𤑔空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":867,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"不得祖業。又云：火星守時皆不順，獨行處性也剛雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"○火照主有兄弟雖多，終久全不得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火臨兄弟事如何，爭競紛紛惹禍多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"親戚有恩還反目，　自然手足不相和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":877,"lineType":9,"content":"田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅難靠，宜自卓立，莫問兄弟父母。賦云：少失資財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453234178539555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"金火同臨於田宅。○火照，多因官中破家，常被惡人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"相損，田宅破散，父母家業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：祖基破盡豈難窮，火宿親臨第四宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"若是廟方須發福，　不然孤苦一生中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人為夫别沒刑，　田宅多逢水火星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽若是水火曜，　田宅逢之却大榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":895,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"招三人亦宜桃花夾竹偏生，過房相壓更好。若與土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233599791115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"星首尾合照，兼又晝生及六丙生人，全不得力。孤寡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"若晝生火居男女宫，必主絶嗣。○火照，主有雙生之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"子，貴，可得二人之力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：熒惑臨兒長兩兒，在家出外沒尊𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"不然尅害哀傷子，或者傷娘子復悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"火若來臨第五宫，此星凶暴似寃仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"婚姻若得同偕老，男女必定少年憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":915,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233599676427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"主有僕馬，但不久遠，六甲生人在此宫者，主臨於惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"弱之地，難享福矣。若科甲科名二主高强，則無慮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"○火照同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火徳凶殘勢莫回，䧟害奴僕愈災危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"女人更作當生限，夫位重重見别離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"六位如逢水宿來，害刑牛馬定多災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"屯殃𠮓異起奴僕，得地専權自劇裁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":933,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453257284943872"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"多主生離逺别，若妻命有此星相抵，則無害，不然宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"娶同庚長歲方保遲得始宜不宜早，男二十五前為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"早，男早尅妻，女早尅夫。○火照主尅，宜夭婚，亦主妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"因産厄而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火星合主别離居，　入宫伏䧟少年孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"白日生人為忌曜，夫尅妻兮妻尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"生來火宿若臨西，　女哭男兒男哭妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"或在五宫三五娶，水宫一箇定無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014391323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":955,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌土宿、惡曜同處，主有不測之災，凶險疾病，六根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"不足，風疾躔身。經云：火土同臨疾厄宫，眼不盲時耳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"又聾。賦云：日月有災，八宫見火，如夜生不然，在消息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"論之。○火照主瘡疥之疾，防漏火之厄，有疾不可救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火臨疾厄要推詳，見物為禛更是殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"假使仙丹能起死，　也須身染病臨床。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"火星八位憂血難，　災來非命禍難禁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453257284911104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"腰駝背曲缺唇齒，　必定刑囚死獄深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":975,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"居處不定，宜外居更好，不宜在家。若居祖業，則難以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"興發。如有凶星合照，防惡人侵害財帛，及虫獸之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"○火照同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火星宫分照遷移，不可將同惡曜推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"得在强宫為禄主，　姻聯皇族貴當時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"火星破命入遷移，遷𠮓東西土産離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816934948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"客店與人和合住，末年有屋可遷移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人不可更遷移，若是遷移是滯兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛土星交丑亥，帶兒再嫁要先知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":997,"lineType":9,"content":"官禄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"君子一生主文字煩擾，如係禄主，則少年遷擢，文章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"出衆，才藻非常，汪汪如千頃之波，浩浩傾三峽之水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"用力少，見功多，受厚禄，享重貴。若日生見彩雲易散，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"美處難全，喜地有怨，福中有禍，不宜享福，壽不長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453220014407707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"○火照，主招惡人，連累官災，合牢獄之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷火星凶𦦨入官宫，　仕列全曹少始終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"若在强宫為禄主，　㑹看附鳯與攀龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"火星到卯氣飄飄，　非遇宫主亦官僚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"水土同宫臨任死，皮袋那知被火燒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1019,"lineType":9,"content":"福德宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食豐厚，倉庫盈積，財物足用，更得火星合照，一生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"優游。若與凶曜同宫，則減其力。○火照或忌星，或是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726578211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"尅星，年不過四十，須招富人，有虧尅䧟身之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷火星白日損人壽，若受官班終不久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"蝕神忽若入宫來，骨肉妻兒難保守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"火星滿用臨强位，十一宫中福為最。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"道徳威嚴禮義崇，騰播英聲盈海內。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"火星土宿與金星，　三辰喜在福宫臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"內只火星為急燥，為人因此失人情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1041,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453233599725579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"主人瘦薄，情志輕浮，形神短矮，只見他非，不責巳過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"性潔白，好戱謔，好時喜到底，怒時抝到底，有人激觸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"心中𤼵憤，只是片時過，心中無事，○火照形相惡醜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"言語剛烈，不服人欺，情行忠直。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷世間何事最嗟吁，相貌宫中火德居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"男性剛强多惹禍，女持箕箒泣前夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"火星行𠮓不為佳，却破兄弟與妻家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢計孛兼天首，　孤窮眉目有痕瘕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453224816951332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1063,"lineType":9,"content":"火星𠮓段名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"寶瓶宫天暴星，○又名天刑星，有心膽，能住持。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷坎名天暴火為災，夜生縱可日迍乖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"七宫妻妾多滛蕩，立禍須知妓妾來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫天驛星，○又名天徳星，主有福徳，轉災為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天驛之星為熒惑，此曜偏宜會磨蝎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"更加土宿此宫來，富貴功名憑口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫天倉星，○又名天穆星，主倉庫盈滿，内實外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726545443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"虛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天星寅位火星臨，　官位長生秀氣兼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"不值惡星侵本位，　重金重葢爵重添。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫天輔星○又名天職星，主有大職印大貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天輔貴星臨卯位，　蝎宫最喜火來臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"禄無失䧟身榮貴，名播清聲入翰林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫天休星○又名天勒星，刑尅暴害凶惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷角亢休宜火來臨，　畏逢首尾孛相侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252667031579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"身命遭逢無吉曜，　犯刑惡死少光隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫狐疑星○又名熒惑星，主事多進退。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷狐疑軫翼言難定，志大心高疑慮人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"女人身命若逢此，順則為厄逆為塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫天雷星○又名天時星，横得貴人待用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷火星獅子號天雷，　正直無私福禄來，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"若望太陽人悖逆，　更逢四正子孫乖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹宫天友星○又名天熾星，心性戱謔多詐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453230726610979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷四五七宫并第十，名為天友定應孤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"若非父母隔絶早，往往偏房寄外居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫太虛星○又名天孽星，主夫婿孽毒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太虛之宿最為良，身命俱逢福壽長，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"金木并臨須顯達，若逢八煞即為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫熒惑星，○又名流血星，主怯惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：酉宫熒惑最為凶，　不問七强五弱宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"若得吉星傍臨照，也須辛苦受貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453257284976640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊宫天廟星，○又名天赦星，逢難自脫，明多豐足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：白羊天廟最為竒，禍則消除福則隨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午命宫逢吉曜，少年平歩上雲梯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚宫披頭星，○又名天旋星，主疑惑多驚恐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：亥上披頭何所知，虛名虛譽足嗔嗤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"若不遭遇留伏逆，曹號揚名處處知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kynn8/1-SK1609_figure_00034.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=UgPIYEw%2BGFhzONQOLYEn2nMts8Y%3D","pictureHeight":305,"pictureWidth":312,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kynn8/1-SK1609_figure_00034.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=J5hnJ2xXLYhgY20mBDc5uvaKDBM%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kynn8/1-SK1609_figure_00034.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269150646322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"土徳鎮星，土之精也，一名地羅。㬋建中宫之氣，其色","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"黄，其性信，女主之象。光明順道，所在為福。𠮓退與逆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"隨分野降災。色青黑，主疫疾之患。色赤白，有兵將荒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"亂。其行宫度，一宫住二十九箇月，二十八年行一周。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"夭行有伏，順留逆入，留叚為暗星，逆叚為破家星，伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"叚為瘟星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生人以為禄元星，　甲生人以為䕃星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為耗星。　　丙生人以為福星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453271126097920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生人以為暗星，　　已生人以為權星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生人以為囚星。　辛生人以為印星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生人以為刑星。　癸生人以為貴星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"此星晝生，有禄之魁，夜生人必為災。○楚地逢之，衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"禄淺薄，須要木曜與之同宫，則為禍稍輕。葢楚乃巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"位，屬水，廟旺之地，土到同宫，其中反為尅制。賦云：欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"知淺薄，土居雙女則招憂。○經云：晝生見土事和諧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"夜裏生人反為災。巳位臨之身淺薄，木照縱横禍不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256617984037"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"來。○若更係忌星，或同計孛共度，則為禍凶暴，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"人自忖不受激觸，言語蹇訥，狼性毒害。作事成敗，成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"者必因靠勢，敗者盡縁邪慾。行步大，吃食麄，有威權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"足膽勇，能掌握，多是非，早歳艱難涉歴，壽有四旬以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"下。日中生人若見土者，命壽長，有九九之數。○此星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"正廟在丑，樂在子，旺辰好戌，喜午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕。經云：土廟北方斗宿神，旌旗五馬表門庭，臨齊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"自是招財禄，入亢應為土地星。與木共金榮貴格，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453255997259791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"同炁宿主髙名。陽宫晝日行宫順，老福爺娘壽自榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"○賦云：叅政學士，皆言土好齊瓶。○又云：土歸鄭國，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"好亢而正位。天宫○鑑心經云：亢上若逢戊已者，白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"日生人在榜標，皆為入廟。亢乃辰宫之地，稱為亢者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"乃星辰廟旺之宿也。安命午未者，以此為科甲。坐命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉戍者，以此星為官星。申子辰安命，以此為刑星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"復以此為天元。印○經云：天元一祿少人知，申子辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"上土曜推。地元人元更髙處，必多俸禄定無疑。不逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453255997358095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜相刑尅，為官權握建旌旗。○三元禄主一齊空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛羅計入命宫。六主一時全陷了，定恒求丐路途","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"中。○凡推此三元者，要居旺樂之地，更有喜星相合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"則大貴。若更㑹天宫正禄等星，無不顯達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
