{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮星本生戊巳位，安静為尊象厚地。晝生惟愛守陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"土星愛日生守陽宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌之中主大鼻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"土星主人大鼻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"少言語，多慳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"細。硬直心腸有膽氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"土在命中少言語，多慳吝，心曠直，有膽氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"順行度分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127738932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"廟宫中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"土星愛順在廟樂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"土地旌旗必雄貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"土為主，若順行，主守土，旌旗為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"廟樂分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"掌握資財有福人，只怕夜生反為忌。留與逆，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"可畏，刑尅隂宫身更瘁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"土在隂宫主身短，刑尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"不招上代祖資","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"財，四體多災苦憔悴。居官惡處立其身，愽弄操刀能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"幹利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"夜上在命，主不利上祖産葉身多有病。若有善星夜生人，得免居官惡處立身，或屠宰幹利。在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"家不定好博弄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生人與日㑹。尅了賢尊難躱避。太隂母位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"不堅牢，若在下弦目障翳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"太隂在下弦，主損目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"木來必定主文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"章，火㑹逺行千里外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"土木同㑹主文章，土火相㑹主遠行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"金若來，妻早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127771700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"棄，水星忌與刑同𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"土金尅妻，水土相刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢華葢懶慵人，孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"對雙盲難看視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"上紫㑹主慵懶，與孛㑹主雙盲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"首同隂位法塲終，尾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹腰駝并背曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"與天首同在隂宫，法死與天尾合，主腰背曲之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"財星應有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"外鄉財，三位徒流為昆季。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"在財宫得外財三位兄弟徒流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅宫家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"破易，子息雖多不成器。居奴奴引盜來偷，西沒主妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"先作祟。疾厄宫傷脾胃，癰瘇風邪堪驚悸。遷移作客","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"盜賊侵，官禄重重主官事。福宫晝見相貌位，自是英","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"雄多曕智。須知此訣不尋常，後學得之莫道易。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453255997292559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"九曜鎮星名土宿，得之未必皆為咎。子丑二宫占文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"星，定主為官分左右。○土星入廟最為竒，辰戌二方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"欣得之。南極一星相照處，看他鶴髮與龎眉。○土臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"齊地及揚州，富貴須知必易求。齊地貴時須位顯，揚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"州財盛見錢流。○土星最嫌計相望，平生一向為災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"障。對在東西丑未宫，四十以後渾家䘮。○土星不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"入妻宫，婦人夫位亦遭凶。妻主罵夫無禮義，直饒為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"婦亦欺公。○土星水木反為福，見水未能資福禄。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256618000421"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"星相次入寅宫，初主財多末主窮。○土與孛星同犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"主，壽髙不過三旬許。假饒延引未傾亾，亦主孤貧無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"道路。○土人以土為兄弟，兄弟宫中无不利。五男五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"女十為羣，獨自伶仃直至死。○婦人兄弟土星逢，父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"母家貧姑舅隆。子位或若當兄弟，又愁子息早聞鐘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"○甲人亦以土為財，午未土逢主發財。莫教太隂同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"在午，末年四十死相催。○金人以土為父母，父母宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"中宜在子。此星此宿位偏强，宜主雙親福壽長。○夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269532278795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"生専忌土星侵，吉少凶多更損身。或若更兼凶宿照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"且歸泉路作亡人。○土躔虚宿㝡為宜，行順官須宰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"相為。但得此星來照命，縱然失度亦多奇。○土入揚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"吴傍斗明，或來齊地見危星。强宫日裏科名共，射策","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭一舉榮。○土同孛向命中來，當是英雄亂世才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"對合更教俱有力，股肱王室應三台。○土為夜忌固","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"為災，若在强宫亦有財。但得竒星為左右，不愁晚景","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"不榮來。信厚無過土照人，等閒語話懶開唇。若逢水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"土附太陽，曰勾陳鎮殿，居寳瓶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"丑、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"為本殿，居辰戌丑未為本局，愛氐女胃桞四宿為朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"元，羣曜叅奉曰地㬋，受朝輔佐身命太嵗值之，掌國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"權柄，致身廟堂。仔細推之，戊已生人㝡佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"廟旺樂宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"廣東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"土星寳瓶子上，磨蝎丑上，名為玉鳯玉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252146888754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"珠星。若人命限遇之，禄馬星辰相生，便可言大貴。不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"生本路，只作常貴，更無禄馬，只作三品。留逆伏叚，減","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"半力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁命在巨蟹土寳瓶，　生在此方作帝親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"三公相國分茅土，攝位邦家紫炁生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"土在磨蝎命隂陽，八權之地極熒煌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"若得土星行順叚，　國家侯伯佐堯昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"順叚○土入順叚者，性重厚，為事逺大，寛慢仁義，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127804468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"為國戚。更遇旺氣，禄馬不背，有吉宿照臨，便是列土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"皇侯，亦是帝親國戚，隂人為后。若遇吉曜不犯煞者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主為詞翰侍從之臣，中天台輔。○入後順叚，為性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"如初，上朝本宫，下臨本國，禄馬不背，亦是𡖖監。命終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"遇煞者，便是武職將軍，女為后妃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"留叚○土入留叚，名為時煞、月煞，身命逢之，皆小小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"下賤之流，𠔥主十般惡疾，孤獨僧道之人。若有救星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"主為性清節，作事直達，禄馬不背，須作京朝貴客。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252146905138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞，是都監、巡檢之人，并為僧道庶人，為上等户。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢忌星，大減力矣。○入後留叚，為性如初，照命者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"為上等户庶人。若不入忌限，更為禄馬，亦作九品官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁土星留叚號天休，　主人作事多懐憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"一生患難常花酒，好作狂歌上酒樓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"伏叚○土入伏叚，名為黑煞瘟星，性孤寡，多為不了","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道之人，愚惡無知，兼是兵戎之人。無救星，多為僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269532246027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"若見禄馬，多於火土上求衣食，帶煞者大不祥。○入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"後伏叚身命值者，更無救星，兼入忌限，主人至賤，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"近人道，孤獨尤甚。若又犯煞在身宫，皆流配五千里外，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"兼主十般惡疾。若有救星，只減五分，女人風塵之輩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：斷土入伏叚名天豪，隂謀暗慮多牽惹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"但是招呼便願隨，相生更不論髙下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"逆叚：○土入逆叚，名為四刑八煞，若人身命遇之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"有百般營運，趂衣食為性，不知前後，愚痴暗昧，不慈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256425029671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"之輩，多為僧道。更犯煞入忌陷，便斷夭壽，百般惡疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"惡刑。若有禄馬，無救星入忌陷，平生清閒之人，有救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"星減疾矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：斷土入前逆名辰貟，財上多磨散復聚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"輔星在命好貪求，親戚逺離如萍住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"入後逆叚為性，不知前後，愚痴暗昧，更逢忌限，并逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星，别無救助，必主徒流，婦人産厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：斷土入后逆名血淋，　一生值此必埋沉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269532213259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"凡所運謀多患難，㓜年危禍至如今。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"土星躔宿俱出玉闗經，玉闗歌：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔角宿名天壽，蓋世文章冠魁首。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"經綸事業富胸襟，不是公卿主富有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿雖是好辰宫，夜入土曜不堪逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍戴角須嫌土，龍蟠泥裏不能衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔亢宿號天仁，博厚文章達帝京。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"廊廟之中官極貴，安鎮蠻夷四海清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127755316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"亢宿從来號鎭星，　土歸鄭國庸天宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"季位土星為廟樂，　同宫木曜福兼隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔氐宿號天牢，命宫若值定孤髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"年少定應傷骨肉，　中年榮貴免煎熬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"氐宿要土壯皇猷，　土逢氐宿兩相侔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"氐有火星生處旺，更加禄主福綢繆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：鎮星順叚度躔氐，旌表門閭衣錦人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔房宿號天信，　少年作事苦勞心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127853620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"語言誠信人無妄，男女難招食貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮星如從房裏過，命夭孤寒家自破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"七宫妻濫號奸星，　畱伏之時瘟疾禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔心宿號天忌，　性情遲鈍又多災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病躔身須夭壽，身無意氣性庸呆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"心星日夘土相宜，　心宿土臨夜不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"若在禄星兼福主，自然快樂不奔馳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔尾宿號天竒，　百六逢之必有依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256617967653"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"若是忌星須夭壽，　又須消息本根基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"尾曜雖然號屬寅，中居兩界土逢生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"尾火虎居宜来此，此星到此有生成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔箕宿號天彬，衣食豐隆却稱情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"官位若逢貴星照，　國家掌判有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿何因入箕豹，　狡詐奸雄多計較。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"定是英豪曹吏人，無事如何又入閙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔斗宿號天樞，事業文章富有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127837236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"台鼎任中朱紫貴，定須象簡與金魚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"斗宿在丑木星臨，方為入廟可無傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"禄主更同陽在晝，　土陽宜晝最光明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：土星行度經南斗，間世英雄眞國寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔牛宿號天侗，　心性溫和衣禄豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"若是夜生多蹇難，身多下賤處貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"牛星須要土星遊，土牛惟好退宫求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"若是順行逢木曜，土牛殘蕩必無收。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269150662706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔女宿號天常，柔順機謀足食粮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"經營勞力心多慮，　只恐生来父早亾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"女宿經躔在兩宫，子丑雙宫在廟同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"縱是夜生應有福，　日生長福更無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：鎮星得此女星居，　柱石功臣鎮帝都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔虚宿號天冠，　好樂之宫定出官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"四九度中登宰輔，重金重紫列朝班。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"虚星四度至於九，好樂土星宜永守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453239077552167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"主為將相助君王，福禄堅榮自長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔危宿廟堂窠，禄厚財興事不訛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"舉措施為多利便，　言柔語順性温和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"危宿土曜入廟堂，寳瓶須樂火相當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"火土相生為廟福，若逢木尅必為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔室宿名天伏，　福厚財豐足衣禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"多男多女有資財，家道安然富金谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"室星居亥正為乾，　土宿相躔要木堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453255997341711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"木築髙堂須要土，　土居术位 {"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256425046055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"土好玉奎奎好土，　木有根兮土亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔婁宿號天𩦩，　土婁須要木相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"婁木雖髙非土北，　刀鎗之下走西東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"婁中土宿災難論，　土金相望豈宜婚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"倘是夜生憂壽促，平生沉滯性愚昏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔胃宿號天磨，財物充盈積倉庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"難婚終是少男兒，　不貴仍須還大富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"胃宿終來好土隆，　土髙胃宿有髙功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256425062439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"晝日居方為大貴，富貴雙全比壽松。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：鎮星度胃正為佳，青史書名功業成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔昴宿名天伏，　平生須食貴人禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"多因胥史得榮名，　將相聲名人畏服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"昴宿在酉正雞棲，　土來此位路中迷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"那更水星兼孛立，　凶刑尅戰損兒妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔畢宿號天回，　能通經術足錢財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"中年便得文章力，兒孫必定達三才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269150629938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"中央土宿鎮之星，　畢宿逢之未見明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"改易無常人不信，晝生遇着且平平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔觜宿號天模，父母先亾身早孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食平平身泊沒，　此身應懶讀詩書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"觜宿好土樂隂陽，土星此宿好非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"土居坤位災消爍，戊人科甲有文章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔參宿號天津，立世經營業未昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"男女猶如隣畔客，貴人得禄信非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269532196875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"土居申位號長生，參宿之宫亦可行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"夜則好閑貪懶睡，　日生多學少能成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔井宿號天驪，命若逢之心似癡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"若習文章應費力，　此人衣食也微微。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"井宿度中夜見土，　處世憂勞多辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"初主淡薄損六親，　末主離鄉多破祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔鬼宿號天文，　縱有資財化作塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"男主須防無上下，　一生不足歴艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252146987058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"土星守鬼未能靈，遇木逢金事稱情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"三合若遇刑煞忌，夜生漂溺在波津。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔栁宿號天稽，無禄無財又損妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"若是日生衣食足，晚年終是色沉迷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"桞土獐星不喜土，　多疾破財損父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生刑忌作囚星，　閒疾臨身多是苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：土星若來躔栁度，　虹蜺志氣錦肝腸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔星宿號天途，　子因父貴事非虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936166923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐夜生脾疾苦，　日生應可足金珠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"星日馬中土㑹來，為人魁偉長身材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"且見髙官有貴位，　再逢吉曜主三台。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔張宿號天蛾，　信行為人事不訛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"少年淹滯中年貴，形神肥厚足田禾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"張宿怕土固難禁，張月鹿兮怕土臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"人道午宫宜土廟，誰知張土反為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔翼宿號天然，　經術雖通性不堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256425144359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹有文章身不貴，聲名逺播足威權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"翼宿屬火怕土臨，　火蛇棲土福沉深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"土臨雙女號别宿，若為禄 {"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256618098725"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"火度，主損父母兄弟，四十以前有女人厄。晝生，一生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"有福，多因國家特達用之，夜生，好行凶惡事，主醜惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"殘疾，若是主星，少年多災，日後貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"土度，大富貴，有聲名財産，有權位禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"金度，父先亡，三十以前多厄多辛苦，必有二妻，是主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"星，有殊常之福，每遇貴人見重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"水度，主人畏服，食貴人之禄，損男女，多被人損害，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"木同宫可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453255997390863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":649,"lineType":9,"content":"土星入宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫，主髙位招財，日生大吉，好事清潔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫，主父多聲名，母先亡，損財，平生多災，每被婦人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"相撓，與人結交，多因此致其厄難，是主星，可免，晝生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，不是主星，夜生貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"木宫，主聲名利國家居貴位，妨男女養人子，為子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"性沉厚，作事難測，多得貴人見重，是主星，晝生有位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生有財，非主星，晝生富足，夜生有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445027328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫，主知謀，多膽氣，性鈍多難，有疾病，壽不長，性凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"好殺官，有兵機，作事不長逺，是主星，有貴位，非主星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"多醜惡殘疾，有救星可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫，主性格寛緩柔順，足詞智，見事深逺，於人有情，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"富文章，足道藝，多利便，夜生多難，是主星，國家進用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"身有貴權，非主星，大富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫，主尅母難婚，少男女老孤，一生得婦人敬愛，好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"色能盃，因婦人成立，足財帛，𠔥有貴位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252147003442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫主為人聰明，通經術，少言語，有文章，足財帛，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"主星，晝生大貴，夜生微貴。不是主星，晝生大富，夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"多災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":691,"lineType":9,"content":"土星同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"土金同宫，主好色能盃，一生財帛聚而多散，有婦人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"見重，得好妻妾，亦因女人發旺，為人輕薄，有二母少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"子，且有二男。土是主晝生，金是主夜生，俱有位。金土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"相逢，此命能修合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127870004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星若曰會金星，　妻妾榮華福禄真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"一躍禹門能𠮓日，　九州之衆悉魂驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"土水同宫，主語澁，人多不信，好圖畫書籍，平生多得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人見重，是主星有禄位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星若㑹水星同，學行孤髙膽氣雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"秉節揮戈文武備，福臨百六慶無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"土木同宫，主有重位，兼足財帛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星宜與土星同，　百六逢之稼穡豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256618115109"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹此乘軒須衣冕，記名青史看竒功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"土火同宫，妨父母兄弟，多疾病，不宜先代産業。土紫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"同宫，日生貴顯，夜生貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星紫炁喜相依，　冠冕榮身職位巍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"丹赤是心剛且毅，　徳覃萬里足光輝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛同宫，官至三品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：且如土孛坐天心，　須要分明見太隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"不顧留順與伏逆，　布衣從此出儒林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269532311563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"土羅同宫，主藝髙强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星最忌㑹羅㬋，　百六天災大可愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"人遇一生多困苦，瘟㾮病染坐亡囚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"官榮劍𣑱匈奴血，　羣少傷人被截頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"異疾怪形保安穩，女須墜産最堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"土計同宫，夜生貧窮餓死，徒配刑名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土宿計都不可逢，人生薄淺更顓蒙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"誅徒溺水兼癰患，百六天災萬種凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256425160743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":757,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"土居好樂，壽筭彌髙。晝人得遇順主貴豪。夜土多蹇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"積財有散，富而勞生，貴而退懶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"土為陽星，不為隂夜，雖然三方水旺，有禄有財，終身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"勤苦，縱貴亦懶而退職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"日月土同，財帛被失，對照三合險危。水厄，土與羅㬋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生權謀，夜見刑忌，衣食日求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"日。木水火尅刑多凶，順旺則吉，逆背非忠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269150728242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"土與日月破財，離鄉井，損頭目，尅父母，促壽命，蹇衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，招危險。水厄，土與水火同，凶險之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"土計晝同禄財大蓄，或同炁木，財食豐足，廟旺順行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"顯食天禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"土金孛同，晝生豐厚，隂夜多刑，反招殃咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"一土與金孛同，日生則吉，更行順旺則貴，夜照土在隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，成敗凶險之徒，或犯官刑，或為主星却吉，各係是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"主旺，福禄堅牢，吉曜若同，轉為榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256425177127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":793,"lineType":9,"content":"土星照臨十二宫命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"守照，命宫神色蒼剛，形貌厚實，偏僻寡合，為人沉重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"肥壯無力，赤黑色，性緩純厚，為事大體忠直，信行執","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"古，務實謹細，悔後口不亂言，附貴依勢，聲應可致。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"生則吉，若在廟旺之宫，更得順行，身榮豪富，更是主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"星當主，國王重用，在辰入廟，官至貟外郎，與金相逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"長命修雅，火曜孛同入，主有疾。木不相得，水不相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"在子曰八侯之地，在丑曰氣衝牛斗。火土在丑，一品","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936183307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"公卿。夜生與凶星同，不貧即夭。○土照主性燥暴，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"柰人侵欺，中年抱四時疾患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土照憂勞人命孤，初年祖業有如無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢依附終為有，晝生禄主貴豪居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"土徳髙强臨子丑，富貴聰明世稀有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生若乃為忌星，　破祖破家那可守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"土星居命主心癡，　若有文章命裏遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"更㑹木星并水宿，　此人衣食也微微。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256618147877"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":829,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"生來財帛耗散，十浮九沉，成敗不常，末主興旺。○土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"照合有四方外財，多招不義之財，因財發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星財上最堪加，　田宅凶星反破家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"身命吉星須細筭，陽宫日月問榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜天中號土星，　興災起禍不堪論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"若教財帛宫中見，積貯看看化作塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星尊位為陽徳，髙占强宫為福力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"或在當生四煞中，發禍興災豈能極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"土星到丑十分奇，　田宅宫中喜得之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"若不髙科須食禄，亦須置産得便宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜一子，若入廟則有一雙之力，刑忌囚怒，則減力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。○土照主子多有形相不具，多見三人，少則並無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445043712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土星五位在陽宫，　五箇男兒盡送終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然孛星相照犯，　男孫疾患半成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"土徳凶星世所聞，豈教照臨在兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"若行留逆都無有，　甘旨誰人奉厥尊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷奴婢宫中見土星，　萬般謀運一無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252147019826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"不如釋道歸林藪，髙卧雲中有大名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"多招醜貌之妻，亦主相離，難為偕老，妻命相抵則無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"害。○土照，主多災，亦尅頭妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷莫言土曜便為凶，　東出之時看對宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"若落坎宫明健處，雍容壽考福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿羅㬋不可逢，妻宫正照醜形容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使早年成喜事，亦主分離西與東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936199691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":919,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"有三般惡疾壓身方好，如有吉星臨，則無妨害。○土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"照，多患四肢脾臟之疾，一生忌食四足之物，主頭脚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"風之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土徳來臨疾厄時，　凶星燄燄是災危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"多因䏊啞雙睛翳，　不是駝腰必病脾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄宫逢土與羅，　一生疾病十分多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒紫炁來相助，爭奈家家有病疴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453256618164261"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":937,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜逺出，船行陸步慮有驚。○土照，不利遠行，在外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"逢惡人刑害，失脱財物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土徳當生在九宫，　命星合照莫相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"男女漂蕩他州裏，女子淫奔外姓中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移不止是遷居，　於中土宿忌牛墟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"縱是宅多居好處，　亦於妻妾寄門閭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":951,"lineType":9,"content":"官禄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277685841970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"事多啾唧，然此乃權柄之星，若獨行此宫，亦主兩全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴。○土照必招官中有不測懐憂，因文書相連之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星官禄占髙强，　凶惡威嚴不可當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"若在廟方為禄主，植圭端冕侍君王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"土木同官福禄星，兩星髙位最為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢日裏全為福，夜半生人福又輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":969,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453271126179840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"一生快活，衣食不缺，○土照或忌星或刑星，年不過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"四十，須招富人，有虧尅陷身之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星福徳照臨時，若處生方始為奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"沙漠揚威名國輔，英聲傳播鎮華夷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"土星夜逢多損壽，　與木同行有疾牽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"更若火金星到福，　不愁福壽不延綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"福德宫中土宿臨，利宜商賈又宜僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星對叠家豐足，　凶宿逢之活未能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453252147036210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":991,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"主人醜厚，天庭髙濶性重，眼小則無害，眼大則有傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"更若有孛星照臨，老定有眼疾，不然須有破相，終得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"壽長，所作奸詐，多好積蓄，喜髙堂大厦，好山林遊逸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"○土照主狀貌方滿，禀性重厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土星凶熾不堪聞，限弱之宫主禍迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"不是年來羅網蓋，須愁狂疾不完身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1005,"lineType":9,"content":"土星𠮓叚名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936216075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫天厨星○又名天貴星，日生貴位興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土星子位是天厨，　福徳妻宫慶有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"子息命宫官禄位，逢之禄秩達天衢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫禄厨星○又名天富星，日生財物巨富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷廟居南斗土為尊，　四正宫中達聖君。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"縱此夜生為日忌，也須榮達感皇恩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫貪癡星○又名天吝星，慳吝不與人和睦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷貪癡人馬不堪逢，　耗散多財直至終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453269532327947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"更被四刑星照破，　日生猶可夜生凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫天梁星○又名天保星，多藝，能掌握位禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷夘宫鎮星號天梁，　足有資財旺此方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"旌表門閭官極品，　兒孫代代出朝郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫禄庫星○又名禄權星，文才厚重，有財大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土臨夘元為禄庫，足禄多財又堅固。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"官崇位顯佐君王，若在財宫主巨富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫無依星○又名天咎星，小人讒佞欺罔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411456563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土星已上無依𠋣，縱使吉星多不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"日生人病沒資財，夜遇終歸須自縊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫玉堂星○又名天鎮星，主鎮守安静之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷玉堂吉星位南離，主性温柔喜禮儀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"黄閣馳名金紫貴，光輝家族顯妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹宫天相星○又名天福星，為事反覆無定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天相鎮星未中央，性好清閑本善良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"若見孛星金助月，　功名顯赫佐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411472947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫太微星○又名天罡星，主事快能有剛節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太微土宿在隂陽，信義為人百事强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕孛星同守尾，却將吉事反成殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫都堂星○又名天正星，主事正直無私。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷酉上都堂土喜事，髙名科甲有詩書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"只憂留逆并伏叚，帶酒貪花百事虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊宫天將星○又名天鰥星，鰥寡孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：白羊宫分是天將，　喜日相逢㑹太陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453271126196224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"日土同宫身必貴，更加夭壽得延年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"夕伏三十九日行四十九度五十分，去日十度半而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"夕見於西方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
