{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608147987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"金星，太白之精，一名那頡星，建西方之氣，其色白，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"性義，將軍之象。出依期，民安國泰；伏見不時，兵將暴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"起，將易政。其行宫度有前後，伏順遲逆，叚輔從太陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"不離前後二宫，約法一月一宫，一年一周天。入留段，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"號天阜星，主癆瘵疾；入逆叚，號天赤星，為主兵戎；入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"伏叚，號天虞星，主為性癡愚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生人以為禄主星。甲生人以為耗星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為福星；　丙生人以為暗星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608164371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生人以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1135,"lineType":2,"content":"魁權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"星；　已生人以為囚星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生人以為印星；辛生人以為刑星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生人以為貴星。癸生人以為䕃星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"此星乃文華秀麗，専主兵革文章聰明○廟辰旺亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"樂酉好已喜午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕。經云：金居財帛福偏饒，𠋣靠他財勢必豪。辰上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"角星兵任重，酉宫躔位引旌旗。三方順照多財禄，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"遇未申福壽髙，逆伏囚留俱不遇，超世榮貴福堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608180755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"○賦云：西方太白，向衛分而益壽延年。又云：要問榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"華，大扺金居亢宿。○鑑心經云：金木之星室宿逢，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"知名位至三公；金星在酉火居婁，夜生必定佐王侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"○惟金最喜與日月水同宫。○賦云：生來少疾，日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"與金水相當○都例。經云：金水相逢最為羙，智慧聰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"明須見水。此為有福無難人，一生營求皆稱遂。此星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"名為妻妾星，若臨得地必為榮。只嫌月孛同宫分，中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"年不免被災侵。○夫人命居夘戌位者，以此為科甲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608197139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"若髙强入廟，則主名掛金榜。○經云：科甲文星對命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，陷時及第必難逢。災遭惡曜相刑尅，假使為官是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"䕃封。廟旺更居在四强，驚天動地振文章。如有吉星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"同分度，科名登第好稱揚。○更有安身在酉辰位，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"此為學堂。若居髙强廟旺，則學問必出羣，聰明冠世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"○經云：身宫宫主名學堂，相貌奴僕不可當。更有疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"囚皆是陷，文華縱有命難長。○坐命馬牛宫者，以此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"為官星，如臨人命，更得吉曜相會，無不言羙。怒則反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608213523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"是，寅上躔度則為愠怒星。○經云：金來人馬受恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"若在相貌宫，全減力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1193,"lineType":9,"content":"金星歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"金星潔淨好顔容，秀目踈眉白又紅。身短不長聲響","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"喨，好躭音律習商宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1197,"lineType":2,"content":"金星在人命，主形相潔浄，顔色紅白，身短不長，聲響喨，好音律，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"多淫慾，美情悰，結交朋友久而恭。不奈是非長憫念，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"更於金鐵巧施工。臨身自有將軍勢，照命兵權越是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"雄。妻財有，勢才同，因妻榮達不曾空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1203,"lineType":2,"content":"金者，兵星也。照人身，主有将軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608229907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"之位，在命主有兵。金為妻，主有妻財　而達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽遇貴人提挈，女主如逢母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"外通。水㑹之星淫更佚，火逢因色起災凶。日生主宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"為豪貴，夜鎮令妻貌不中。天乙貴，好相逢，好逰商賈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"走西東。妻妾愛陪僧與道，孛來同枕患殘癃。天首若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"來居武位，尾同至老是田翁。居財帛，財帛豐，三宫姊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"妹是同宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"釒在三宫，只主姊妹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅隂人成卓立，五宫見女定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1219,"lineType":2,"content":"金在四宫，女人卓立。在五宫，只招女子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"第六主妻多下賤，七宫妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"不送臨終。第八病時休針灸，遷移客女作家風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"金在八宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608246291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1225,"lineType":2,"content":"有病不可針炙，九宫客女為事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄妻家有官䕃，福宫白髮福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"第十二宫逢吉曜，其人定主美貌容。此是前賢微妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"訣，學人子細去研窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"金星入廟來天命，初主封侯仍佩印。若還主將不同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"行，只資田地樂平生。○金星聮水清無比，洶湧墨池","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"才調美。如何天下有才名，甲子金星𠔥水智。○金星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"與水居辰位，金木逢龍須入相。不居主將不同行，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"主標名金榜上。○金星位處利天秤，若到金牛分外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608262675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"明。如或更居髙强位，黑頭定是見功名。○金星元來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"名六害，六親縱有不相愛。日生若被火來侵，定是少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"年須死快。○金星最怕太乙星，若在髙强禍必侵。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"在閑極惡星見，男須浮浪女須淫。○金水二星同入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"未，婦人凶事成吉利。更逢日月近宫行，夫不為官須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"子貴。○莫以金星専福星，亦能為福亦為名。併得水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"星居巨蟹，子孫榮曜達天庭。○聾盲喑啞全無氣，寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"上尤嫌不得地。若還木位植其星，専主斯人失厥內。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608279059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"○祖財多破隂財獲，初歳迍邅晚嵗成。晝喜日同夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"逢土，最嫌火孛計來迎。○金居婦室主妻多，亥午宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"中陷子何。若與太陰同照巳，雙生貴息顯家和。○寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"與申宫莫見金，有星若更是刑侵。此生定作孤貧客，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"口舌無憑禍復深。○常招賢貴為妻室，職重權髙有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"令名。廟旺宫中多福力，人形方面更端平。○忽然紫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"炁來相並，須知妻有不良聲。夜生福緊晝生慢，金木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"相逢財自成。○金木二星為善星，所臨非主亦非榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608295443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"本位金臨皆有喜，即為豪貴顯王庭。○在官遷轉加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"重禄，白衣之士選門開。若為商旅多財帛，士庶人家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"喜慶來。○金入辰宫氣已豪，更逢亢宿勢尤髙。三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"不𨺻行仍順，定掌兵權建節旄。○入局天權號貴星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"此星何慮欠科名。玉堂深處還他到，先着青春折桂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。○金名吉宿處何如，禄馬人元要共居。主着官鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇此，魁名終是唱鴻臚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608311827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"金星附太陽曰白虎，從駕在金牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1297,"lineType":2,"content":"酉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1297,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1297,"lineType":2,"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"為本殿，居己酉丑為本局，愛亢牛婁鬼，謂之朝元。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"身命值之，定為將帥，惟六丁生人最佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1303,"lineType":9,"content":"金星廟旺樂順伏留逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"廟旺宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1305,"lineType":2,"content":"淮南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"金入天秤辰上，名為天角天曙星。若人身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"命見之，更在八煞官禄宫，有星皆主極貴，不在本格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"亦應三台兩府命，不然只作平常命斷之。樂宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"梓州、台州、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1311,"lineType":2,"content":"四川。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"金入金牛酉上，名為天旭華盖星。若人身命遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608328211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"更若吉星相應，又有禄馬更廟樂者，主為左右金吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍。若不帶煞，只作文官三品斷之。如在别宫伏留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"逆叚則減力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"順叚○金入順叚，名為天雄榮達星。若人身命遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為福徳。如身宫不在，却斷為淫慾平常之格，雖有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"救星亦平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"入後順叚○入宫，又遇禄馬，主京朝之職，禄馬不背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"更廟樂為大官，并作宗親之命斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608344595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"留叚：○金入留叚，名為天異天阜星。若人身命遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"則癆瘦之病，多帶氣痰，有救却主多藝音樂之人，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"性嬌閑喜華飾，多為僧道。若有忌星同更在水宫土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，主為上等官貟，更帶禄馬，須是六品武職。○入後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"留叚，為性如初，若遇煞者，須是屠宰水土木匠之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"命强有禄馬，只是五百料錢之人，若陰人尅夫，多淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷金入留叚，號天區，運用遲疑必致虞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"凡所圖謀皆不契，　晚年禍患必嗟吁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608360979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"伏叚：○金入伏叚，名為天虞天賴星。若人身命見之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"主為性癡愚，多為火刄之藝，泥水軍人輩。若遇木火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"二宿，些少刀斧之藝，若有禄馬，便斷為小小軍員頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"角之人。女人主殺夫，有救星平善。大率女人命，須是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"夫宫無惡星便清潔，若有忌星混雜，則是淫濫之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：金入伏叚名為弱，為人如繩自遶縛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"究竟不能解其身，致使後思前事錯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"逆叚：○金入逆叚，名為天赤救盜星，凡人身命見之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608377363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"無救星，皆主兵戎之兆，多淫慾無慈惠之人，隂人遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"者，風塵無疑。身宫在閑，主為刀斧之藝，若禄馬行於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"木運，為九品佐職之人，無禄馬主小小刀斧之藝，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"為屠宰之人，陰命多妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"入後逆叚○遇火土二星交，身宫俱閑兼犯煞，并遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"忌宿，其人必總兵戎，若坐禄，却為中福轉達之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：斷：金行前逆名辰隊，平生多入囹圄內。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"所為多是不遜心，　横惡暗躔不能退。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855479608393747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"金行後逆名位傷，　此星降福甚不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"父母兄弟皆見惡，　婚姻之中更有妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：金星躔亢産忠良，　佐助中興國祚昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔氐宿號天將，　少失尊親性自剛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"平生衣禄能文學，　貪欲之人損父娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔氐宿事平平，莫與同居月曜并。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"男子見之多色慾，女若逢之暗室人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733126207"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔房宿名天角，衣食生來殊不薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"為人多義更方圓，形貌端嚴性多學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"金來房日兎中居，　才冠羣英自有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"忽逢首尾日月命，女作為尼男作巫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔心宿號天孚，未離强褓值身孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"温良處已心多慾，　若是文章一字無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"金星喜夘躔心五，　喜曜合照有財賦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"文人五馬作髙官，武則建節當守土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733142591"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔尾宿號天殃，　骨肉資財定見傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"若不修仙并積徳，定須夭壽見悽惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"尾火虎星半寅卯，若是金臨人至狡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"直須水曜解其災，　一切所為皆稍稍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔箕宿號天彤，妻子乖離吉見凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"總饒家活能豐足，老年不免又貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"箕宿更忌太白遊，太白箕躔甚可悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬有金凶且忌，　金居人馬奈難修。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733158975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔斗宿號天銓，　貪財貪色行非賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"男女雖多身是客，　更無衣食少安全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"金星入貯斗中安，為主凶星墓絶間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"作事總乖家業破，　縱登科甲位難攀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔牛宿號天繩，　色慾多貪命𫟚淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7 SentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"聲振四方持節鉞，　任登機宻位尊榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733208127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"室宿衛分屬雙魚，金星到室貴安居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"室宿有金來潤澤，金居室位福應殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔璧宿號天光，彭祖年時壽命長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"女人見喜資財旺，美貌豐容性自剛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"璧玉從來要金厨，金星玉曜內連珠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"金樂此宫偏作貴，金門待詔仰天居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔奎宿名天厭，　未遂功名心更逸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"為人温厚更寛容，　性識孤髙應不淺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733224511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"奎宿眞箇好文章，金躔此位實非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"一二度中方作福，　金星入火有相傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔婁宿號夭薨，　必定為人少失親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825 :"金畢之功至十一，　此度之中主大權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"如居下位郎官吏，　火若同宫妻獨眠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔觜宿號天營，　冠世文章顯貴聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"翰院詞章身獨貴，也應金紫列朝纓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"觜宿從來號火猴，火猴得勢若金鈎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是水星無慮火，金居觜宿福難謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733273663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔參宿號天晶，學問詞鋒冠世英。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"若是官宫星得力，　定須桂籍早標名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"東南有宿號為參，　上下相生特夢金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"若是遷移宫分土，　榮妻貴子惠慈心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔井宿是吉宫，髙才愽學福豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"為官定是居廊廟，福及蒼生禄萬鍾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"金德循行陷井旁，奸淫妖濫事難當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1599,"lineType":1,"content":"大隂并遇人貪色，　文武兼資順度良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733290047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1603,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔鬼宿號天淫，　婦人遇着惡聲名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"戒行不循迷酒色，平生衣食却豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼星元屬鬼金羊，金來此位福深長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"長庚到鬼應加福，　金宜此宿大為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：金星偏喜躔鬼度，榮顯富貴福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔栁宿號天闗，快樂平生衣食閑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人知重多男女，錢物豐盈性自寛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"桞曜經躔午未邊，金來栁位福難堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733306431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"命曜若躔十度上，　穿窬奸宄計争先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔星宿號天熒，　理義精通學業深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"更若火星來會此，是非酒色定奸淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1627,"lineType":1,"content":"金居星位有何竒，金火相逢去路迷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1629,"lineType":1,"content":"須要水清金始白，　火炎金白福攸基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔張宿號天晹，　財物多貪行不良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"若是妻遲難得子，衣食平平壽命長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"金星張宿號金堂，身若逢之最喜强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733322815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴更加人有職，　三方雖背貴人昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔翼宿號天英，學問文章顯大名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"經術更能修顯著，　此身榮貴樂平生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"金係武星恢武業，　只為金宿走翼蛇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"財庫禄行如遇着，更同水徳甚堪嘉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1649,"lineType":1,"content":"金躔軫宿號天程，　口舌輕狂凶害生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"言語不眞心泛濫，多汙非禮事奸淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"軫星最喜金來到，際會遭逢命中坐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733339199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"女兒雅麗男英才，　此身永保無災禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"金在天秤是本宫，角九度三十分以上為向廟。亢二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"度八十一分以上為正廟，過此為次廟。在室七度十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"三分為正旺。牛名為樂，居此廟旺樂生人，必主權國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"柄。太白亢為精粹金之廟也，在五度外八度內為正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"廟，二十年為將相之位，有文武全才，負忠良大節。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"在魚宫臨室五度及十三度，處機宻之務，居節鉞之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733355583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1675,"lineType":1,"content":"榮，旺十八年。若十三度，雖居貴位，心常不快，為節度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"使。若在牛宫胃八度至十一度，官至五品。十二度至終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"度，主兵刑之任，法度之官。自昴初度至九度，為𡖖大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"夫，闗梁之任，三十年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"尾女有厄，自七度至十一度，必為司馬。畢初度至十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"一度，並主大權。若在下位，郎吏之官。若見火，不宜妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"火同宫，妻不良，與蝕神居位，男為覡，女為巫，與木相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"宜，與水相妬。見火為淫，晝為女人好色，夜為狡猾男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733371967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"日度難婚，性凶猛，好争戰，有出長之計，因戰伐而立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"功名。若聲語細，前後必有七星，是使相之財也。月度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"主多淫，因婦人財物上立身，或娶下人為妻，行非禮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"之事，男主貴，女人遇之主淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"木度，主武勇超羣，常歡樂快心性足財物貴人見重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"○火度，因女人有喜，平生難婚偶，亦被婦人損陷。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"土度，主晚婚，娶妻老㓜不等，相去十載以上者，少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733388351"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"離鄉井，因妻妾有憂，好色欲，財帛聚散不定，是主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"主有位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"水度，得人敬愛，有好妻，一生貴達，合娶親戚女為妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"不然先姦後娶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫，主為人性剛，作事無定，多得貴人，見重難婚偶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星有位，非主星長壽，若行留逆，叚行不良，多被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733404735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人相撓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫，主為人性和，作事明白，有宻謀，善貯積，因女人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"財物，日生好女人之事，是主星，夜大貴，晝微貴，不是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"主星，夜生大富貴，晝生有禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1737,"lineType":1,"content":"木宫，主聰明有智，性格過人，作事敏疾，得女人之財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1739,"lineType":1,"content":"有聲名，因貴人有喜，是主星，晝生有財，夜生有位，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1741,"lineType":1,"content":"主星，晝生微富，夜生大富，如對望合照，性格並同，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":1743,"lineType":1,"content":"主有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"933","lineNum":1753,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫，主為人好歡，多色欲，少男女，毎得貴人見愛。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"同，則為事不正，下賤之人，是主星，夜生有位，晝生有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1757,"lineType":1,"content":"財有福，能掌財，貴人見重，非主星，微有福矣。金宫，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"為人聰明，作事和緩，日生好女，因女人有厄，是主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴位，非主星，晝生有福，夜生微有職位。水宫為人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733437503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明，智性超羣，見事敏疾，有節操，是主星，轉加富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生微有職位，不是主星，多因婦人引惹，因而獲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"金水同居，文武雙全，平生有極貴人舉薦。若水是主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1773,"lineType":1,"content":"星，日生，主文中成事，有貴權，不是主星，亦主文中立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"身，微有職位。金是主星，日生，主武中成事，夜生大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1777,"lineType":1,"content":"留逆者，雖有文武之藝，主平生多難淹滯，不可作貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1779,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":2065,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫白獸星○又名天色星，主色事，為美人敬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":2067,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷坎宫白獸怕逢金，　火孛加臨禍最深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855677733716031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":2071,"lineType":1,"content":"若見水星怕月助，　一生方得免呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫絶體星○又名四刃星，因色傷身，婦人犯惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":2081,"lineType":1,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":2083,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷岱岳峯前金絶體，縱逢吉曜也頑愚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"慳貪鄙吝無髙下，女作娼兮男匹夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":2095,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫金鸞星○又名天貴星，因隂貴人成禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":2097,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：金鸞之宿最髙强，　財福加臨見寵光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":2099,"lineType":1,"content":"金木逢龍為福徳，　定知名譽四方揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"水星，辰星之精也，一名滴星，一名龜星。建北方之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"其色黒，其性智，廷尉之象，出沒依期，光明澤潤，歳豐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"民泰。伏見不時，災傷獄訟不平。其行宫度，亦有伏順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"留逆，附日而行，不離前後一宫，一年一周天。入留叚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"號台星，主發薦，不能登科。入逆叚號厄折星，主多災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"難。又伏叚，號天井星，主口舌是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕經云：水居雙女最為靈，華省臺官給諫臣，巨蟹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"栁星超職位，股肱帝力彩絲綸。或臨亥子多招禄，方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"主推之福轉純，身命限中俱見照，財多恩博更相親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127951924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"○此星入命，専主性巧，文章冠世，筆陣超羣。○經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"北方水星専主智，性地惺惺多巧藝，好樂隂陽巨蟹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，若臨申巳尤為貴，生逢坐命最聰明，更在身宫亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"伶俐，非惟辨舌若懸鈴，更主文章多藻麗。○水入命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"者，無大驚恐災厄，逢危不危，臨險不險，大事成小，能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"順人情，合煞星則反吉成凶，見善宿則𠮓禍為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"水星入命最為神，危厄災迍事不成，逢惡則凶善則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，方知此曜順人情。惟有水星本無定，相近之處即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675063834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"為性。附陽與陽為福星，附隂與隂為善慶，與日合兮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"主文章，性巧聰明難比並。世上文才須見水，善星成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"福最為佳。忽然更有吉星照，人間喜美事。奢華。○賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"云：給諫功臣，須假水臨雙女，最怕與計、羅、孛同位，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"主刑害夭折，忌疾壓身。若六壬人見之，為囚，不得其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"用。更在戌位，則為怒地，主早年作事淹滯。坐命在寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"亥者，以此為科甲，安身在已申者，以此為學堂。宜在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"髙强旺樂喜好之宫，更有吉星臨照，或居三合四正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537367564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"大有福力。若為官星為禄主，庚人以此為天官正禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"俱不可陷弱。○經云：官星元在第十宫，此星宜順旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"廟中。若能躔在髙强處，必為將相禄權隆。○天元禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"主星更髙，身命四正福堅牢。此星䧟弱多吉曜，雖然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"有剥免煎熬。○坐命在夘子者，以此星為天厨禄主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命則為坐天厨格，更有金木同宫，即便以富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"兩全斷之。六壬生人見之，四十以前未見食禄，晚年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"大享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"辰星快利有文章，形相清嚴色潤光。智慧聰明多巧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"妙，出人學問不尋常。情不定，性温良，遇員則員方則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"方。樂廟若居已申貴，他宫筆吏好心腸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"水在命宫。樂廟髙曰及第，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"他宫有文才筆吏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"日㑹父筵多酒食，月逢二母莫思量。木月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"見，吉仍昌。李杜文章萬丈長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"日月㑹，主文章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"晝火若同貧且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"賤，刑尅尤防上法塲。夜土㑹，主癱傷。金妻愛入别人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"與夜土㑹，主癱難。與金合，主妻淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙更貪修養術，彗來劫盜惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445174784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"聲揚。首尾氣豪多勇毅，居財一似雪和湯。兄弟犯，隔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"他鄉。田宫祖産破狼當。子息女多男巧妙，僕夫偷走","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"急忙忙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"水在三宫，兄弟離别。四宫破祖業。五宫男女多巧妙。六宫主奴僕走","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"妻位主妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"多外染。厄宫腰腎也羸尫。遷移處，好遊商。官宫早歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"甲科昻。福徳自然多福壽，貌宫儼雅性温良。從頭説","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"盡人間事，後學須教仔細詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"水星善惡本無心，同處尤宜吉曜臨。最怕惡星同入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"陷，平生浮泛不能禁。水星如傍火之精，火土同行何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445191168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"許清。若與金星相夾帶，平生天下有才名。○晋地相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"逢土反宜，衣豐食足不須疑。若還更伏太陽下，萬事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"和平福可期。○雙女宫中得逢金，超昇富貴巳宫臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"金水共蛇蛇㑹處，科甲必定稱人心。○水人以木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟，壬癸生人亦如之。吉曜重重在此宫，兄弟五人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"五箇貴。太隂屬水再逢水，兩水令人多智慧。反成愚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"鈍本無他，只為金牛非正位。○體貌洋洋得水星，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"星又為火同行。相濟相傷成福徳，只憂田宅主多更。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453270127984692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"○太陽紫炁并水星，若當本命富還清。富主堆金仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"積玉，貴時只是自清明。○六合相逢金水鄉，多能相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"line "lineType":1,"content":"相逢多夭死。孛計相逢邪佞人，晝則吏戎僧道爾。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411522099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"金居亥火絶男兒，三十年前未見妻。若也有須生死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，真金必定化為泥。○水火相刑第九宫，土羅對照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"賊徒中。三方若在髙强位，日夜貪謀作貝戎。○水主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"文筆的作竒，木金西沒並光時。一星乘旺三方位，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"作龍頭貴格推。○辰星在已旺非常，與日同躔列軫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉。假使不登黄閣貴，也須官至翰林郎。○水星最喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"遇金奇，富貴須成少壯時。凢有所為無不利，更知有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"壽到期頤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"樂宫　水入隂陽申位上，名為天鸞利英星。若人遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"之，皆有文學，更有吉星相應，便作京朝斷之。若無救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"星，只作名流，上等清貴。若伏留逆叚，皆減力，只主伶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"俐，如在别官，減半福。更若吉星同臨，便應外臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"順叚：水入順叚，名為天犀天科星，凡人身命遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277685956658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"更看主星，便作品貴之格，若論科名，多主二甲四甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡看命，若斷科名，先看此星為準，仍看禄馬得地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"留叚：○水入留叚，名為黄道台星，凡人身命遇之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明，只發薦，不登科，有救星加三分。○經云：水入留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"叚號天嚚，榮妻寵妾是前因，主星三合妻宫位，亦可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"文章以立身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"伏叚：水入伏叚，名為天鳯、天井星，若人身命逢之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"多主口舌是非，為事不定淺薄。若得禄馬入格，有救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277685940274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"星，必多巧藝，更主星在强宫者貴。○經云：水星伏叚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"名宿汨，為人作事尚匆猝，主星前後三宫行，情性無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"常多恍惚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"逆叚：　水入逆叚，名為厄折窮哀星，若人身命遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"識見機関，陽宫多智，隂宫多詐，更㑹禄馬貴人，作貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"命斷，如在低宫，夜生多學傷口，過招是非。○經云：水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"在前逆名厄折，致難見災常切切。主星之後第三宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"好色貪淫無限節。○水在後逆名窮哀，為患為寃不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281527824423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"可猜。主星對日須有位，貪淫迷色損傷財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔角宿號天成，清秀文章學術明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"喜怒無常心不定，　平生財禄自豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"水居角位有金星，金居龍位好辰星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"水角得金分外貴，金水相潤有精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔亢宿號天津，容貌清奇通道術。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"心清閑暇作文章，多學多智善音律。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278822645775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"龍頭水潤有髙功，　最喜學堂四正宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"女必聰明男學士，　禄主權方達聖聰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔氐宿號天旨，　言語聰明知道粹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"人情好惡性能通，遇吉終須文學貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"氐宿所屬夘與辰，　水居初度福堪論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"八度深躔尤怕火，　水火相戰是閑人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔房宿號天淫，　智識聰明如賢人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"衣禄自然心泛濫，　文章學術妙經綸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445158400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"房宫日兎向東家，　水臨此地不堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"日兎不堪辰曜立，　水到東居勢位差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔心宿號天凌，　清潔為人快性情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"巧計多修文業秀，聰明才藝二三分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"心宿從來樂火臨，水遊火分勢難禁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"火須于心居大火，　水焦火位病來侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔尾宿號天澄，　理義該通學術明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"資財耗失多災否，　惟恐風狂染疾人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675047450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"尾宿亦怕水星遊，　火虎從來水不流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"虎若在寅正所屬，水臨此地福難求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔箕宿號天浧，　心閒快樂任天眞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"平生衣食資財足，道藝文詞足講論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"箕星好水水相宜，水豹周流日日竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"上下相流堪作福，水木相扶却有依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：辰星偏喜度經箕，丹桂須攀第一枝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔斗宿號天徳，　俊譽文章心耿直。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277685989426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫榮貴更氣和，衣禄豐盈言語澁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"水來斗宿莫臨妻，　必定難婚事渉遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"若在餘宫怕吞尾，水氣相逢恩䕃竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔牛宿號天甄，　朋友氣和益子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"心謀機宻人難測，財物多應得外人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"水牛相㑹貌超羣，處世榮華䕃子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"只憂計孛相臨照，　凶暗乖離受苦辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔女宿號天驛，眼疾朦朧是貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281527840807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"貪財好學多議論，平生衣食也艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"女星更好月同行，隂曜同隂禄可亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"若見土星同度立，　妻兒孤尅自無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔虚宿號天馴，清潔為人財禄臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"多能技藝心慈善，孝順終須樂弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"虚星星月水中求，水星到此福髙丘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"須要吉星兼禄主，若無留逆福綢繆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔危宿號天中，語澁心艱眼半朧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537302028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"中末之年方得力，外人財物稍寛容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"危宿本是屬水宫，　水無定度木𠔥隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"若是留遲方定貼，　更逢廟旺反無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔室宿號天攸，文學聰明智慧優。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"厯事未能心預測，　筭籌多計樂閑游。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明文曜水星精，臨室度中喜順行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"若作科名并禄主，　安身坐命禄安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔璧宿號天池，　智慧多端有志機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278822629391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"天文玄象多通㑹，衣食平生也不虧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"璧宿在亥號天宫，水要加臨璧度逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"水從此宫元甚妙，須逢福曜木尤隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：水星度璧福偏隆，　挺出千羣推第一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔奎宿號天凌，　忠直為人性急煩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"財禄自然多積聚，平生多事不安閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"奎星七度過乾宫，　水曜臨之福不窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"若是深行宫度分，　白羊水浸實難容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278822678543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔婁宿號天澌，耿直為人不受欺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"衣禄豐隆多稱遂，平生快樂勿凶危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"婁宿從來屬火棲，水還同度固難為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"水浸白羊終汨沒，縱逢禄主亦凶危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔胃宿號天泓，　耿介於人記事明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"忠孝有心多執滯，為官衣禄未安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"胃宿水星切莫逢，天羊孤角自生凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"水位更逢夜裏土，修書無氣更顓蒙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277686005810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"惟藉金星同度分，　方居福禄號文昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔昴宿號天誾，容貌清奇識五音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"心謀巧計事沉静，衣禄平平禍不侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"昴位正屬金牛宫，水躔金宿氣英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"若是主星兼氣力，　少年聰俊廟堂中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔畢宿號天淋，　歴事三思性又欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"容貌清奇衣食足，文才學問滿胷襟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"辰星水蛇方躔畢，　八度如何有貴榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277685973042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"逆伏留遲皆不吉，　若行順旺稍聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔觜宿號天樞，清潔為人足智謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"多財多藝多工巧，　歡樂平生好逺遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"水星聰慧主文詞，　四七之宫不喜觜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"孛曜同行來此地，　色慾貪歡只為斯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔參宿號天湫，歡樂無憂足計籌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"作事未能心已怠，豐衣足食自優游。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"水臨參宿正廟居，文星入廟要因扶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281527857191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"水性聰明専好動，因能自執不凶虞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：水曜經行參宿度，貴榮廊廟位三臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔井宿號天潯，　心好清閑志曉明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"籌䇿文章人薦用，聲名逺播定官榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"井為木犴未宫棲，水來此地福相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"井有水星須得地，　此為富曜福希奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔鬼宿號天洪，　好静為人更美容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"心裏洞明兼道釋，衆人欽用樂無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445142016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼星正管未宫陽，　水鬼相躔未可當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"此曜順行宜見水，　水孤井立必孤孀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔栁宿號天汪，為人柔善㑹文章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"巧計多謀心不定，聲名閭里自揄揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"栁星所樂水相從，　水扶栁曜最從容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"栁緑更宜流水處，科名騰播達宸聰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔星宿號天清，伏見皆能官職榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"與日同宫須大用，定為喉舌顯朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537498636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"火星居地水争衡，星宿騰輝水路亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"水宿星官多巧麗，文成七步氣鏗鍧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔張宿號天榮，富貴雙全性又靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"文武才猷皆並用，賢才兄弟樂平生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"張度水星衆所欽，每臨身命福資深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"必能顯赫人争羡，名譽昭彰達古今。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔翼宿號天異，　年少登科文學貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"清華要路驟遷榮，與日同宫須大貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278445256704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"翼宿八度至十三，　員明淨潔水來參。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"不論遲留并伏逆，　當居科甲有文談。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"水躔軫宿號天岑，　文學之官衆所欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明謀畧人多㑹，藻思文章入翰林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"軫宿本是水樂宫，水星入廟福尤濃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"上下同流為樂曜，男人多學女人聰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"辰星星為員明水之廟也，不以伏逆順見，皆主大貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"常居一人之前後，有出人之才，為喉舌之官。若臨雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"女宫翼二度及十度，為好樂之宫，及為旺度，與日同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"到，少年便貴，歴清華之選。若日在軫，水在翼，為宰輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"之任。日在翼，水在軫，為文學之官。水無正性，以對合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537465868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"為性，近金，好音律兵戈。近木，好近貴人。近火土，貴則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，賤則賤，近蝕神好偷盜。近孛好殺，近天乙好神仙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"之事。入宫十五度以前，好文章。十七度二十度，好醫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"卜。二十一度至二十六度，有見識，好潔，為僧道。二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"五度至三十度，近日則吉，逺日則㐫，若伏逆，皆為技","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"術之巧，與金相好，與火相惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"日度，主性格温厚，內剛外敏，聰明有才智，衆人見重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星晝生有位，夜生大富。不是主星，晝生文藝出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278822694927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"衆，不貴，夜生性巧，因道藝立身，後必富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
