{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫主聰明文學，白日轉加大，有文學聲聞四海，好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277686087730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"圖書，有道藝，合得國王重用，多因貴人喜愛，夜生有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"財，非主星，晝生文藝出羣，順行並貴，夜生微有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫主聰明工巧，好文學，得貴人見重，因此成立，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"事不顧危亾，是主星有位，非主星因武藝立身致富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"木宫主聰明出羣，智量深逺，合道理，明𤣥象，知好惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"能知人，是主星，多近君王左右，得貴人見知，非主星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"微有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫為人性沉厚，作事方圓，有心機，好道徳，明音律","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453288523956276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福，預知人休咎，凡事有成，伏逆諸事難決，是主星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生有位，晝生有財，非主星夜生有福，晝生技巧非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫主性凶猛，見善行善，見惡行惡，言語澁，心細難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"測，得外人財物，主患眼目，是主星，微有職位，非主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"多非横之災，善星救之可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫主形貌端正，心性寛，多憂惱，能音律，與人為師。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫主聰明急性，能知人，智量方圓，見事長，有文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277686071346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"藝，是主星，夜微貴，晝生富，對照三合，性格亦同，福力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"減。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"水木同宫，有智慧，足文章，大人委用，有貴子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木星喜與水星俱，　水賜洪休慶有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"百六㑹時千福備，等閑平步入雲衢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"水火同宫，主富，心平，多奸惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：火星怕與水星交，　困苦傷殘百事淆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411604019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"隳廢凌遲逢百六，　夫妻父子總相抛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"水金同宫，主食妻禄，富貴少年，榮顯足壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：金水二星若相㑹，　俯取官榮如拾芥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡遇此喜非常，百六逢之俱吉太。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"水土同宫多滯，言語不快，㑹文章，日生吉，夜生人，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"年九十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：土星若㑹水星同，學行孤髙膽氣雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"秉節揮戈文武備，福來百六慶無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936281611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"水羅同宫，不論晝夜，生人少疾，衣食平平至，霹靂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"難宜念善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：水星最忌與羅同，詭計無廉一世窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"不孝不忠多暴𩁿，　不然瘖啞與盲聾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"水計同宫，主兵刄㓂盜之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：水與計都相照㑹，缺唇跛足并駝背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"或生癖疾女多淫，　或是迯亡與結配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛同宫，主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278822711311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：辰星不欲相交彗，　男可為奴女可婢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"邪淫奸宄主貧寒，畢世十謀無一遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"水炁同宫，有財禄足壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：炁星若與水星同，　天産其人福勢昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"官爵顯榮家又富，　千斯倉與萬斯箱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"紫與水星能作善，厚徳純性學神仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"醫卜伎巧多文藝，　一生福壽兩綿延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":753,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278822744079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"水乃陽曜，喜樂陽星，輔日而行，助其光熾，主方廟旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"𡖖侯之職。水木同宫，貴重禄豐，加之炁月，主順興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"水乃陽星，宜同太陽，晝居廟旺，官至𡖖監。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"水木同宫，主髙貴豪富，更加炁月，貴為守帥重職。同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"金多欲，遇火不和，貪婪無足，為事妖訛。計孛加臨，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"節非忠，夜生尤順，晝則藏凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"水星同金居廟旺，遇火羅照，雖受衣䕃，主淫濫破田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"業，晝夜不順，必夭壽。如同計都孛，夜生則吉，亦主性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675096602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"不忠良，晝生見之，非戎吏即僧道，或免凶害，即主刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，不仁好殺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"晝同土曜，富盛可期，順則廟堂與身肇業，仕宦亨嘉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"居官名節，夜則湛薄，貴而歇滅，若遇留逆，多屯苦節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"水星見土，白日見之順行，廟旺則貴而忠信，官位興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"隆，官至守土。夜生減福，在强宫則富掌大財，留逆促","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"壽，損尅妻子，不死則帶篤疾中風之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋樂旺，掌權之多，陽宫禄厚，隂夜蹉跎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537515020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"水同羅㬋，晝生陽宫，則貴領重權，禄位髙厚，雄貴出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"羣。夜生隂宫，尅剥刑傷，貧窮下賤，身難卓立，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"最宜旺位，炁木同行，晝逢吉曜，福禄轉増。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":799,"lineType":9,"content":"水星照臨十二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":801,"lineType":10,"content":"命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"守照，命宫形質重厚，體貌威嚴，舉措有成，性快寛厚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"多學多智，有頭無尾，柔中之剛，奸中之義，心有謀用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"不懐遷怒。此星入命，専主性巧，文章冠世，筆陣超羣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411636787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"一生無大驚恐災厄，逢危不危險不險，大事成小，能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"順人情。若見惡星，則反吉為凶，見善宿則𠮓禍為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"寳鑑歌云：水星入命最為精，危厄災迍自不成。逢惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"則凶，見善則喜。入廟主少年及第。在酉宫女有命服，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"已申巧性文章，夘戌藝業，口談到未，謂之八極星，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"生福禄與紫炁同在命，好神仙黄白之事，與日金同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"為輔弼格，最吉。惟水滿三用，吉多則反凶，謂之無救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"樂旺中主大發財，正好處則死，盖水不欲滿用故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537482252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"金木同位同行，少年及第。在陷宫不伶俐，與火星相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"惡。金星忌妬，與日同行，多主淫慾，忌孛及計。同○水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"照合，有文章才學多智識，心性無定主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷水星臨命智多能，　引薦求財事不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"廟旺遷官榮爵秩，餘宫僧道晚年興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"水徳星辰在命宫，　得逢旺處便攀龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明智識多機𠮓，　生在榮華富貴中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫只有一水星，蓋世文章異衆人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281527939111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"父兮生我今何在，　不見登科出仕林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":849,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷財帛宫中遇火争，　一如把火照霜氷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"此二宫中逢此曜，初年囊槖盡皆傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"第二星辰在弱宫，　飄飄財帛去如風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"若無惡曜來衝破，却曉魚塩水利豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":921,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫端正，談論聰明，手足纖細中道，亦主生離死别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"○水照，主妻性不定，多外情及奸盜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷第八宫中水徳臨，温柔情性足人欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星凶惡來侵犯，　沉溺波濤墜井深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷水星合照最為珎，更看東生命位星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"賔主和同無惡犯，遷移出處總歡榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453277686104114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"第九宫中㑹金水，金水太陽同一位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"更加本命對宫濕，屋宇既多尤壯麗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":959,"lineType":9,"content":"官禄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":975,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"君子得之，早年亨通，一世優游，晚年以來，財帛大旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"庸人得之，得力得財，中年横發，衣食自然。所謂不栽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"一株桑，箱中有餘服。不種一畝田，倉中有百榖。○水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"照，有聲譽，貴人舉重之喜，只一生不宜隂人交性，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"反善為惡，尅身之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷十一宫中水德來，　汪洋智識仰賢才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936314379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"公嚴厚徳人欽重，　澤被生人遍九垓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"身形肥小而不瘦，神氣清髙，容貌端正。○水照，主人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"好華，得隂人喜重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷水星相貌最為强，清風凜凛肅冰霜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇惡星無惡曜，容顔端正動君王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌宫中遇水星，機謀多計足嚴明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然羨容豐衣禄，祗恐飄蓬破六親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281527971879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1009,"lineType":9,"content":"水星𠮓叚名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫玉池星，○又名天宸星，主巧妙聰明，得北方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：玉池本是水之精，學館科名萬事亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"更有惡星相照視，　便為僧道也聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫玉龍星，○又名天貪星，主吝財物招是非，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷角亢辰星號金龍，更加金水喜重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278537564172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂四正無凶煞，　馳譽蜚聲翰苑中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫玉女星○又名天驄星，俊傑文章巧妙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷已宫玉女最為良，更得金星佐國王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"男兒得此官榮顯，女人逢此有冠裳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫天目星○又名天妙星，文才巧妙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ass":{"PageId":"7426453288524136500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"喜非常。更得太隂相㑹合，是為慶㑹也輝光。○太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"之宿號尊星，衆曜相尋如轉輪。凡有吉星伏居下，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"能致福反平平。○太陽入祥遇木星，更添命主必官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。若有二星来轉佐，必當榮貴事王廷。○午宫旺廟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"最為竒，更在強宫始得宜。若或陷於閑極位，少年父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"命必凶危。○太陽次喜白羊宫，必定其人祖業隆。夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"見土星晝見火，不能致富反為凶。○太陽與土八宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，夜生惡貌并孤窮。早失雙親路途走，茫茫不識是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453294815445026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"西東。○太陽在命九品遷，小人富貴足庒田。三合近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"強㸔仔細，陷沒沉宫事不全。○炁木日月最為良，儻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"無惡曜不相妨。如逢太乙同對合，智巧多財柔乃剛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"○初限不如中末良，夜生不如晝生強。只怕計孛并","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"火土，總同廟旺亦為傷。○太陽魯分入奎初，此是人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"間大貴圖。更得官星行旺地，安榮終是入鈞樞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁。日躔角宿號天成，晚年須富少年貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"心髙膽大超人衆，　必定前程有大名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽度入東南角，莊重仁慈性端慤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"木金㑹聚宿皆同，大立功名有才學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411751475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔亢宿號天柱，學問文章貫今古。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"為人歡樂最賢豪，性識孤髙名未遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"亢宿従来號金龍，　五陽辰位日居中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"木曜傍臨傾向日，　富貴雙全禄萬鍾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔氐宿號天符，美貌堂堂出衆徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"性快心髙多自耐，　江湖漂泊少年孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"氐宿屬辰并卯炁，此宿辰宫氣未充。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"晝誕孟冬受正氣，壽年長享永無疆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453273936445451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔房宿號天禄，清潔為人享清福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"髙才富學有聲名，耿介超羣還不俗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽東躔房日兎，　出自東方偏喜遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"若加本命晝朝生，發福髙權貴而富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。格云：太陽東出度星房，腰下須懸金印黄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔心宿號天昌，白日生人福壽康。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"若至晚年尤享福，　一生終是足衣糧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"東華唯有心三星，水火同居氣未清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675194906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"若是土星同孛位，陽居此位勢難禁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔尾宿號天枵，　白日生人富益饒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"性急多才人莫敵，夜生鄙俗事煩騷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽来尾漸東升，晝産皆為上貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁更臨加品位，　夜生疑慮却多驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔箕宿號天魁，　俊又文章有大才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"父母定須生貴子，官髙位顯列三台。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"箕宿従来更好風，東風觧凍氣朦朧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243214885"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"水曜並陽同度立，　其人定夭 ":1,"content":"白日生人多富盛，夜生逢此足迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽躔度到虚城，不論賢愚與富貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304432951296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"髙坐華堂延壽相，　従容穩步作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：日曜正躔虚宿度，　官居輔弼掌鈞樞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔危宿號天隆，　性直文章學問豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"營運資財難積蓄，　老年方見免災凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"危宿中隨虚室居，　君陽危立勢難為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"虚室兩星前後立，　位而無輔豈非危？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔室宿號天福，膽氣權謀性多慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"平生歡樂少迍災，父母康強延金穀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304432918528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽一曜最為尊，室宿臨之豈晦昏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"惟愛木金同廟度，此為君象鎮天門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔璧宿號天皓，　富貴雙全兼壽考。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"多男多女見威尊，　必値文章榮達早。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"壁居亥上正天門，　日月同宫合壁連。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"更有金星同水至，水金輔日有髙權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔奎宿號端守，富貴榮華年壽久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"文章髙貴衆難加，　白日生人享富厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642811916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"奎為玉闗號王車，　日曜臨之福不殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"木曜更来辰上位，　腰懸金帶佩金魚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：太陽妙度最宜奎，　閫外鷹揚萬里威。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔婁宿號天宫，　大尹公卿將相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"年少便應居鼎鼐，生時値此必興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"西方婁宿號白羊，金婁西沉日不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"誰識夕陽猶返照，白羊宫裏勝扶桑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔胃宿號天解，令徳惟賢位安泰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453288524120116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"機謀才畧多智能，　有喜須因賢淑輩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"天上太陽臨在胃，　夜生背明真可畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢羅計火孛星，　不尅雙親身必墜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔昴宿號天房，耐事經營足食糧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"脾疾冷涎身有壽，　日生却得世榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽遇昴福興隆，勛業超羣志氣雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"四月卯時人不壽，駒隂過隙翣時中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：宻星遇昴福偏隆，　超羣必作人間瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411735091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔畢宿號天強，　賢徳才髙萬事昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"音律善通憂慮少，　心多嗜慾行無良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"畢宫好雨曜昏迷，陽居東位不宜西。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"須要嵗星心位立，　正臨扶日不終危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔觜宿號天鈞，　足禄多能享世榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"學問淵源才挺出，此人名必播朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"觜中日宿是凶星，　陋短形容菜色青。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"主性頑䝉多暗昧，縱教修學也無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453288524070964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔參宿號天水，冷淡持身欲不累。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"少才多學富聲名，官宫有禄終須貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"水居參宿正居坤，紅輪西墜福難言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"須要木生寅上照，　酉時日沒正黄昏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔井宿號天弼，冠世文章増福力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"公侯卿監世間榮，福禄恩波傳子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有井曜未申宫，　日躔井度要深逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"十七度中尚在未，　向南之地有髙功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304432934912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔鬼宿號天流，先代資財用不休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"巧計機闗人莫測，　世間多事出隂謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼宿從来怕日逢，　此生惟有夜生隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是邪星莫干正，　鬼金羊位日隂沉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔栁宿號天梁，　仕宦須令仕本鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"金帛豐盈多積蓄，晚年須見禄榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"栁星漸次屬離宫，　十三度內未遭逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"二七度中惟得日，方逢午位壓羣凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453294815412258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔星宿號流澤，卿相當朝須得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"三方星主旺髙強，富貴榮華主輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔来午位有三星，　一張一栁一星明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有張星樂月鹿，君居此位有虚名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：君日周天位在星，　功齊傅說位阿衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔張宿號天正，　才智聰明文武並。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"官星得力善星居，禄貴兼全増喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽尊曜臨張月，縱有聲名多歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453278411767859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"休將此宿在廟堂，　錯誤於人難可說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔翼宿號天婁，賢徳文才出世豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"若得木星同位次，定應官職守清髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽翼宿不堪親，翼火為蛇死不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"大主不祥非横死，疾宫又遇惡星辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"日躔軫宿號天階，年少功名自鼎来。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"端潔為人須大量，定須九棘與三槐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有軫宿號天極，　人言陽極福難當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642861068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"日到南宫終熾盛，時居大厦佐君王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"日在奎宿七度六十八分以上至十三度六十八分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"以下，則是火度日，是真火為正廟，若在五度以下為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"向廟，十三度六十八分以上為背廟。日在婁宿八度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"十八分以上至九度為正旺，九度以上至胃一度十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"八分以下為次旺，以上為背旺，在八度十八分以下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"為向旺。白羊宫躔婁宿九度為旺度。如在八度前，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453294815461410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"為大卿及大尹三十年，居三輔六府，或監國負扆設","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"政，忠孝恭謹，大堪委用。如在八度以後，即稍減力，顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"達六年。如在九度，主員郎少年貴，久後無力。午獅子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"宫星宿為樂，亦為卿相，旺三十年，須在有力之地，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"三方主身命宫，在髙強宫分相照，或得諸星助之，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"在廟旺之宫，則為至貴之人。在五弱宫，惟寅丑辰上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"或見木對，欲順不欲逆，三十年富貴，位至三公。或在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"申戌之位見木逆，則為大富之人。與金同伏者，女人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304399364132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，作夫人，如夜生時見蝕神，賤不得其死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"日度，主性忠直，有道藝，宜仕宦，得貴人委用，有聲名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"平生有福，作事長逺，更是主星，晝生有位近君，面員","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"耳聳眼大，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"月度，得父母力，為事有宻謀，見事深逺，善主財，是主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"星有位，不是主星大富。木度，主貴達，平生多福，合仗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"本鄉官，多見金帛，晚年主富。火度主作事清直殊常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"有福，性直不顧危亡，多厯江海。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675178522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"土度主貴人委用，宜男女，亦多伎巧，微貴或虚貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"金度主好音律歡樂，多怨少仁，平生多蹇，是主星晝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"生加福力，有貴位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫主作事明白，足學有智，好修善，有玄藝，是主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生有位，夜生有財，非主星晝生大富，不受貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642877452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫主得父母力，為人性宻，作事難量，立機謀，與人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"結交無終始，少年逺行損財，是主星老年大富，非主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"星微有福力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫主為人聰慧，作事有㫁，多心機，善主財足，財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"少苦老樂。火土同宫，妨父母兄弟，是主星晝生轉加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，與羅計同宫，主災禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫主為人性微急，作事明白，知人災福，多智見，足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"財産，父多病，男女亦然。日生人及在陽宫轉佳，夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243231283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"減半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫，主為人性沉厚，有威嚴，能營運，善㫁割，多財物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"是主星，晝生大貴，夜生大富。不是主星，晝生少孤獨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"微有福力，更在土度則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫，主有賢徳，知未来事，因女人有喜，多計謀，好鬬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"戰，有好妻妾及子孫，兼主殊常有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫，主性極聰明智巧足文才，所為不定，能守事，常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"患冷疾。會天文，晝生是主星，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243280421"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":577,"lineType":9,"content":"太陽同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"日月同宫，主多聲名，好文章，富貴有科名。若晝生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"日是主，夜生月是主，更日月在旺廟宫及本宫，其人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"聲聞四海，又合得國王重用，在未宫，衣食至老無退，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"在戌辰二宫，甚有鞍馬牛羊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日月相㑹嵗嵗同，十二月中月月逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"正月娵訾終玄枵，　聖賢降世福興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"日月慶㑹吉無涯，　天産英雄福邇遐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453288524234804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"百六㑹時邦國泰，　人生値此福奢華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"日木同宫，主近貴人，平生少災有福，足財帛，多子孫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"更得木星乘旺氣轉好，是主星大貴。如木星行伏叚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"損財産，日在廟則貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽交㑹木星臨，　足禄多財冠古今。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"平步青雲昌熾盛，萬般好事稱人心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"日火同宫，主為人有信行，作事方員，好文章，多財物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"若得一生在旺宫者，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453294815510562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日火相逢火失炎，禍盈百六莫迯潛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"天災遇此民遭厄，夭䘮生民害義亷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"日土同宫，主性格聰明，有詞章。若是主星晝生日在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"後，大貴，日在前，損父母財産，及主惡死，月宫尤重，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"主父有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日土相逢慶瑞饒，産人龍首佐昌朝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨百六邦家泰，萬福攸同百禍消。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"日金同宫，主好色慾，有好妻，兼有妻財。夜生金在前，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281528119335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"日生金在後，皆主大富貴有聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日金相遇福生民，必産竒才異世倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"百六㑹時天福熾，當知慶瑞在今辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"日水同宫，為人聰慧，好脩隂徳，是主星不伏逆，其人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"文學出羣，有科名。不是主星順行者，主微貴有職位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有文章，不主文中成事，多因父母立身及貴人舉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"荐成立。若伏逆者，主有技藝，好音律。若是日主在本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，晝生大富，夜生微貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675293210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日水相逢慶瑞盈，欣逢水日賀昇平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"人生値此人中瑞，　間世竒才保大名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"水日同宫得地行，　不能及第也聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"性淳機巧難容事，贏得鄉閭有雋聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"日羅同宫，主不壽，身近貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽正照被羅侵，父在他鄉兒沒親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"先代家財皆破盡，奔波衣食不如人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽朔日怕羅㬋，偏産奸雄起簒謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243296805"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"餘日當之興福處，惟逢百六禍堪愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"日計同宫，主多疾厄，有腹肚之疾，多脫財物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日計相逢景福昌，官尊直諫佐明王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"怕逢朔日生姦偽，　百六如逢大不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"薄蝕皆由惡曜侵，那堪又在一宫臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"破蕩田園皆瓦解，東西南北不寜心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"日孛同宫，宜在外邦，不宜在家，白日生多災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日孛相刑名字損，反産吉人心惻隠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453288524218420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"姦臣叛世不生兹，　百六會時保安穩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"日紫同宫多伎藝，官至三品，父有尅害，有疾可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁：太陽紫炁喜相逢，澤潤生民稼穡豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"百六遇時祥瑞盛，人生㑹此必三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":693,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽照命，金水同位，廟旺主方上達之貴炁，木月同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"顯赫可致。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"金水日同宫，謂之輔弼格。若得地主文章大貴，次要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304433016832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"得地為限，仍須日生，如是夜生，只富而已。有此三星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"在陷害宫，則凶炁。木日同對，或三合見有，即主聲譽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"之人，更各居廟旺，居官清顯，位近王庭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"不係主旺，亦主富貴，主下身低，無不掌治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"如不在方，主不入廟，則為官不顯，亦衣禄不背，富而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"不厚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"水日同宫，財禄可及。孛日對同，機巧可取，才幹及人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"横招財利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453276675276826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"日與孛同對合照，主性機巧，作事靈𠮓，好音樂，智見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"髙，有膽氣，柔中之剛，多矯詐，招外財他息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"非其主旺，財食豐足，見在日時，益於財禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"凡太陽照命，不遇惡星，自然受福積財，不是主旺亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"日同火土，輕禄薄財，又遇蝕神，破離鄉土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢火土二星，主衣食不厚，多招歇滅，損害父母，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"破祖財，亦招刑厄，損壽損身，妻同子逆，善不堅長，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642926604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"無久逺，又加羅計，刑害太甚，離破鄉土，亦主傷殘，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"多憎惡，亦好邪滛，多犯王法，更逢交逆滅傷，壽筭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"淡薄，初年艱難。財禄日沒月藏，富而多福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"守照。命宫主面部嚴方，顔色紅白，陽宫為命，入廟為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"科名文章，貴品清職，修學聰明，為人性快，不藏事，務","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"實不偽，性敏精忠，博通畏事，敏而有㫁，不忍奸欺，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642910220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"妄求，不過貪，見苦生念。其財與禄成在中末之年，福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"禄兼全，有災無虞，及主壽筭長逺，平生有福慶，常得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人見知，不受貧苦。與火同對，在財帛田宅宫，主破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土星，主父母有心腸疾，卒暴顛酒。與孛同對在三、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"六、九、十二宫，主尅父。與木交㑹，足禄多財，在寅、丑、辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫，見木日大貴，在申、戌二宫見水日大富。在酉宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"家藏金玉，在戌宫田宅廣居，在閑極，自小無災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽臨命性融和，　衣禄贏餘禍散磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453294815543330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"東出壽長西沒減，半生澇漉少年過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽在命九品遷，小人富貴足庄田，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"三合近強㸔紫炁，陷沒沉居事不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽原是火之精，躔度偏宜金水星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"晦朔孛羅同一處，太陽薄蝕命須傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"命在太陽孛羅守，太陽又怕逢張栁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人戯謔成姦滛，　男子滛犇别鄉走。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":789,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642893836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"初年多破，中末方吉，主居貴位，同木財最多，此宫同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"水，主失脫。○日照一生近貴人，財帛主得福人財寳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"成立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日居財帛要陽宫，晝生為福夜為凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"只憂計孛来相尅，財帛猶閑壽不中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽来臨陽極宫，　還應財物獲榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"日在長生多得地，　定須豪貴越非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":807,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304399429668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"主招一二人吉，得力富貴。三合性快，為官不過七品，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"為禄必定因同𩔖進財。日照主兄弟，可保一二人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁兄弟有若鴈同行，豈使三宫陷太陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是同胞如手足，　分張各自富田庄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟相邀出外鄉，　只因第四犯刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"刑傷不用他宫取，　男犯太隂女太陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":825,"lineType":9,"content":"田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642942988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"主得父母財物，先破祖後自成，招外田庄，末年方可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"旺盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"日照主髙貴宅舍，大招田宅産業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁田宅之宫有太陽，須知此位最髙強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"膏腴萬頃連阡陌，榮祖榮宗福禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"日月合照来田宅，　田宅定多誇阡陌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢紫炁與羅㬋，　一生長是漂流客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":843,"lineType":9,"content":"五男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304433049600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"主招一子，自身晚貴，與金水同，主招俊麗之男，更入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"廟不同凶煞，男女清貴。○日照先見男吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁子孫宫內得陽宫，才藻文章竟出塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"金馬玉堂應有路，　少年平步上青雲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽男少女又足，禄順行宫逢土木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼熒惑不相刑，子受官班見五六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽子位獨難當，損破頭男子受殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"若有吉星相扶救，　二男異日貴非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243247667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":865,"lineType":9,"content":"奴婢宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"主尅父，奴婢不得力。此星不凶，終吉。在白羊宫，十分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"力，晚榮貴。○日照，主招鞍馬，及有得力女使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁奴婢之宫號陷方，　照臨君父豈為良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"縱饒父體常清健，亦恐當年壽早傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕雖非髙強地，　若是太陽亦為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"其他紫炁及羅㬋，　自然不得分毫利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"日曜加臨侍從宫，賢奴俊馬盛如龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453292642975756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"妻母被滛欺尅陷，　破家偷盗反為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":885,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"主妻美貌有財，性快清秀，有吉宿同者，娶貴家女，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"帛豐厚，増壯門風，身主大貴。○日照，貴相之妻，及因妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"家發旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽臨照在妻宫，位望尊嚴徳貴崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"莫使忌星興悖逆，婚姻皇族富豪中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"西沒之中逢日星，頭妻帶甲始安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453307582840886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"半路分離難保守，更兼孕育不曽停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":903,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"主身近貴，不近小人。見水星，主有刑破。異相火同，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"眼疾，身破免疾。○日照，主身少疾患，有壽，不犯天災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁疾厄宫中見陽星，身體康榮豈見迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"設使忌星多犯破，　反傷眼目不光明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"第八宫中見太陽，偏於酒色起災殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄先陷妻先死，計孛同宫死外鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"主內職出入，近侍上貴人，得人敬重，益壽大旺，多利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"逺行。○日照一生好逺遊，常得他方道路之分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁第九宫中遇太陽，更無凶曜在其傍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"好將平日胷中學，對䇿天庭謁帝王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":929,"lineType":9,"content":"官禄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"主大貴居星宿，定為一品官。小人衣食一生少到官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"府，不加凶危大事成。小○日照，宜奉公，若有官厄，常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453304399511588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"有恩赦之救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽得在十宫居，　抱負宏才仰大儒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"他日遺賢求吕傅，官髙輔弼掌鈞樞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽金水同官禄，　主將同行真有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"計都在巳孛未鄉，横貴功名仍納粟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":947,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"主為人洞達無私曲，一生好動，晝生逢土，夜生逢火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"安閒有壽。逢金水，主福壽雙全，○日照，主身心勞漉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453281528135719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"小人遇之，奔走無寜日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁福徳宫中遇太陽，光明心事又康強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"金水兩扶成輔弼，天然富貴永無雙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽喜臨福徳地，　只嫌朔望逢羅計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"孛亦為災福不全，晝火夜土更須忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"主為人聰明少貴，日生逢火，麄醜髪黄。夜生逢土，項","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"短睂麄。○日照，主形相具足，多破。小人相輕，不可與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243264051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"下等人作事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁相貌一宫名惡弱，吉星照處合虚着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"惟怕羅㬋月孛星，来與太陽相𠋣約。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"善星多向命宫排，相貌宫中君火来。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"又得星辰行順段，平生衣禄自相隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
