{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫日華星○又名天貴星，主得貴人力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽本是日華星，晝夜循𤨔不暫停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453309004709928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"若是日生多福禄，夜生終不免災迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫浮梁星○又名天馬星，主貴而不達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽年有三百六，催促光隂如迅速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"晦朔惟忌計羅侵，夜生之人須減福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫扶桑星○又名天基星，主得貴人成立，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽始出拂扶桑，身命加臨近帝王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄官宫居極品，若臨五弱亦尋常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫晹谷星○又名天烏星，主横得貴人財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295557771301"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁卯酉玄黄二八門，　日生晹谷最英靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅官宫身命貴，六宫十二禍深行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫虞泉星○又名天輔星，得大貴人托輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁日出龍門生角亢，　天中曜影登虞泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"照臨宇宙施恩澤，首尾相逢福綿綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫白陽星○又名天福星，因貴人成福禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁己宫日是白陽烏，照曜乾坤總一如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"無黨無偏君子志，何愁福禄不安居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243280435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫朱明星○又名天禄星，得貴人提挈食禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁騰光離位號朱明，　日出乾坤萬象清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"此是太陽真廟旺，　七強宫內保光亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹宫曜靈星○又名天柱星，因貴人委用成家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁曜靈侵入太隂宫，　錯亂隂陽理不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"性硬氣剛須怕婦，妻強夫弱挫英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫東君星，○又名天弼星，主大貴人成立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁太陽五月至於申，位屬三隂一氣陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243296819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"此是東君為失位，七強宫得也為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚宫朝天星，○又名天殘星，因貴人損傷破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295243329573"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"詩㫁亥上朝天諸位拱，　六隂之位来相并。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"玉璽為名象屬君，子孝臣忠福禄盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kzcxg/1-SK1609_figure_00036.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vVKJNhvmQTdkGhTOdeRqt3NHRJw%3D","pictureHeight":307,"pictureWidth":322,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kzcxg/1-SK1609_figure_00036.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ozloKQ0iI0gxhG13SctwcsQtokU%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4kzcxg/1-SK1609_figure_00036.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"餘不滿順行數者，以九因之，以中數二百四十八數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319226376227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"除之，除不盡者為殘分。在一百二十四以下入疾厯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"二百二十四以上入遲厯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂月宿，水之精，一名莫星。其色青白，其性仁慈，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453322145579017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"臣之象，母之所配。其行宫度有遲疾，弦前行疾，弦後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"行遲，已具于前。大約遲疾中間，率行十三度三十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"分，一月一周天，生於滄海之上，出於正西之方也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"巳生人以為祿主，甲生人以為貴星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"正魁星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為印星。　丙生人以為耗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生人以為福星。戊生人以為暗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319029129279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"此星廟戌旺酉，喜已，樂申，順於亥丑二位，怒於寅㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"此月在何位，則為安身之所，若旺樂之處則為吉。夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"生人見之，會金木二星於身命宫，主福祿全備，享福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"温煖，更為祿主星，在旺宫大貴，至月朔則交會，在卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"十五則相望，上弦生人為福，下弦生人則減福。若圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"望會羅計二曜，定主交蝕。此星配属夜生人三方主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"瑯玕。經云：月精廟旺照娄星，出賛珪璋輔紫宸。臨身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"自然名職重，躔胃應為台鼎人。水金共位威權鎮，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323168972812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"炁同宫秀氣臻，不晦不殘行净道，益財益祿自榮身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"若在驛馬貴人祿宫之地，則大富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：安身好在祿貴鄉，若逄祿馬最髙強，居在妻鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"多作贅，不然妻尅主其雙，若遇空亡孤寡地，九流之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"士甚相當，忽然好生疾囚位，男兒夭賤女非良。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"論星，須安身坐命，臨在祿馬貴人之鄉，則無不吉，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"得善星照視同宫，則其貴無疑。此太隂星，惟六辛人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"見，不分日夜，全不得力，最忌計羅同凶。經云：計都臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319373193256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"身，難免此生之毒藥。鑑心經云：計都身命火星逆，忽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"然羅孛或相當。此命終湏逄夭折，不然横死路頭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：計都坐命太隂中，身命逄之毒藥終。坐命在辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以此為官星，六癸人以為食祿神。坐命在丑，以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"科甲。夫㸔命推星，先㸔其格，斷人災福。如魁星入天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"門，與天官正祿同宫，更吉星照命者，便作大魁斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"金木羅土計五座總入廟，更一星近月，當作侍從命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":105," {"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：太隂好處最宜危，　男必公侯女后妃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"月躔室宿號天鸞，　形貌清竒富貴全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"更得水星同位立，　直須奏對近天顔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453322145529865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上本位属天門，　八萬三星盡拱環。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"月属隂柔關內室，　隂來理內福彌專。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"月躔璧宿號天𣋌，　語言蹇滯事沉思。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇蝕神𠔥月孛，　主須生長在寒㣲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有璧位正天堂，　月沉雲漢有餘光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"女有精神男曉事，　夜生科甲衣金章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"月躔奎宿錦肝腸，　不勞餘力至員郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"更得吉星居十位，　定應台輔見君王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453322145513481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"奎為金闕正陽宫，　月居闕內秀胸襟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"須要正陽端在 {"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"月在婁宿八度十八分以下為向廟，以上及行木度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"為正廟。在胃宿一度十八分為背廟。胃宿十度以上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"至五十一分為正旺。七度十分以上至十度為向旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"十一度以上至十三度八分為次旺，以下為背旺。巨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"蟹為本宫，若此廟旺樂宫生人並貴。在金牛宫胃十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"度外十一度內為旺度，主居貴位。若見金木，又居有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319373307944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"力之地，必為一品之官。若雙魚宫及有力之地，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"節度使。若在辰戌之地，與蝕神併居蝎，則為凶盗之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"徒，見火尤甚，必不善終。在無力之地，見金必落風塵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"以婢妾為妻，及奸通骨肉。若在昴宿之間，亦居極貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，只旺七年。若在蟹宫，為好樂之地，亦為木分之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，主貴。若張氐胃女之宿，及見金，更在下位，多滛及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"於男女，好色慾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":f {"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫主性宻口敏，不是主星，㣲有福力，若是主星，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319226359843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人富貴，夜生足財有權位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫主性温，作事沉審，夜生尤甚，日生好女色，平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"好訟，性好殺，足心機，有詞智，是主星㣲有福力，不是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"主星平生多災，有善星照望則免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫主性聰明，為人有行，多智見，好文章，有聲名，足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"財産，夜生輕巧，會文章，好圖𦘕，不貪多，被人玷汚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"月木同宫，主文學出衆，更得大貴人見知，若二星有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"一星在旺樂宫，有科名，當清要，任為給諫，大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：太隂惟木便相會，　玉骨氷姿謫仙隊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453322145611785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"男主封侯女貴妃，　百六如當足祥瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"木月居命不為僧，　縱然為道也無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"只是幽閒髙處士，　湏攀桂籍有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"月火同宫主性急，多惹人暗地是非，是主星有位，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"主星多災，有善星救則免，亦主被惡人累及，性遲鈍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"因繼女有厄。男娶得富妻，女稼公侯，夀至中年有祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"語澁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：太隂熒惑喜相逄，　智將謀臣著顯功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453307583119414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"天産其人為宰輔，　如當百六慶無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂若被火相逄，　一寸資財散落空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"母賤父亡𠔥夀短，　為僧為道也無終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"月土同宫，土是主星，有學問，身貴，晝生福厚，貴逹，夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"生㣲福。不是主星多災害，言詞蹇澁性純，夜生作事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"淫濫，主缺唇，母有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：月土㑹遇火為災，　偏産頑愚性質呆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"百六會時人夭䘮，　忠臣失職竄天涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323169136652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"月金同宫，平生多與婦人結交，每被婦人相撓。不是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"主星作事無定，宜防婦人相損。婚晚多情欲，有貌志","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"氣髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂金宿喜相交，　百六逄之慶瑞色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"天産其人扶社稷，　官居裂土與分茅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"自來月要與金同，　食祿湏知得位崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"若是當生為土犯，　斷然父母兩三重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"月水同宫，主性格温厚，和睦持重。若水是主星，文藝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319226507299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"出衆，得國王重用，好論訟，女人有厄，木見則免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月水相逄慶瑞饒，　人生遇此賦天才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"温純徳厚榮尊爵，百六當之福祿來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"月羅同宫，必主貧賤，妻棄子逃。日生多招刑法。夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"猶可不宜母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：太隂天首喜相随，智出鷹揚塞外威。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"莫教望時生叛逆，禍臨百六可愁悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323169120268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月炁文章一世豪，　為人志氣冠吾曹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"母夀靈長𠔥清雅，　官班超轉職崇髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"月炁相逄最竒祥，　福被生民慶且昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"萬福攸同逄百六，　人生值此必侯王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：太隂在望計都同，　爰産奸凶不孝忠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"不在望時終有怪，　投河毒藥或瘟逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319226474531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":611,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"月乃隂曜福惠之星，主方夜照，職祿尤増。月圓髙宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"顯任威治，如同金水，益財益位。木與月同，大為福㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙對同，夀筭髙至，孛月對同，才術可委。夜重晝輕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"所應有異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂宜見炁木二星，主性仁敏，名髙才邁，清幹之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"亦宜孛夜照，主廣記博覽，才性宏逺，動逹尊貴，更居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"廟旺，給諫功臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"夜同土星，必招刑害，風狂夭夀之人。夜同火星，雖有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"刑尅，則享福祿，若安廟旺，則主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂好行静道，逄羅計則有交蝕，其光不顯，却為災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"障。若月在於廟旺，减其福祿，貶官失祿。如居常度，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"值殘晦，則犯刑遭法，尅害尊親，妻子多刑，家道不立，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"親近惡黨，恣行兇暴，如若逄之，多不廉矣。更加火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323693293594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"孛逆，則為惡死之人，如得吉星救之，亦帶疾傷殘而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂照臨十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"守照。命宫形貌清古，體不重肥，面方神足，骨秀色清，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"性明急，嚴𦂳能幹，身孤力寡，或假親戚𠋣其勢力，臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"事憂勤不倦，足慮多權，最宜為商，財産失而有成，心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319373324328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"力能當重事，設在窮途，亦能成立。最喜夜生，足財足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"祿。生在廟宫大貴，主福祿全備，享福温煖，為人俊雅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"作事善良，心懐矯曲，結交無終始，修學有科名，小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食不招凶危。日生逄火難為母，主風狂溺水。夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"逄土，口啞缺唇，在無力之地，見金為風塵婢妾，與火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"孛炁同守命宫，損父，若有水助，主風疾。逄月孛同計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"都，主尅母，在陷宫加凶星，難為母，金木相當，生來少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"疾。秦趙宫中金星助月，少年及第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂偶臨身命宫，　更無刑尅起災凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"四元三限同強位，　㸔取封侯列土封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂逄炁起災迍，　計孛交加又變嗔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"夜裏生人難際遇，　遇之名字播天門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319029243967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂隂滯多滛欲，　行度照臨頻受福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"遲留伏逆上推尋，　入廟天厨分得祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":705,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"主財多耗散，得貴人力會祿馬者，有積聚多財寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"月照一生近貴人財帛，亦主得福人財寳成立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂得傍命宫排，　事起隂人大得財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"若見忌星相破犯，　必因奸盗此中來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"月居財上福為深，　更加廟旺足珠金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453332069236736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"蝕神若不相照視，　縱有災星禍不侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":721,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"有夀有財不宜母，兄弟難為，凶曜同照，有亦不和，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"多姊妹，主良善福徳之人。○月照，主兄弟，可保一二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"人之力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷第三宫中號玄虚，　星曜臨之力轉踈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有太隂當此位，　命中福祿乃贏餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂反為福徳星，　只為加臨到弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453332069187584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"金水太陽同一位，　亦知天下有文名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":739,"lineType":9,"content":"田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"主招外産，置立田庄，必命有吉星，方能發祿，如逄凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"曜多貧窮。加羅㬋尅父，加紫炁尅母。流孛破盡祖業，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"又有自縊水厄。○月照主髙貴宅舍，大招田宅産業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂火星同到午，雖是過房猶尅母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"若是金木與同行，　子孫榮貴着金紫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂照曜若相逄，　自立榮華萬事通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295558033445"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"又招隂貴増財力，　遷移三處振家風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":757,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"主身近貴，得一子力，不然義多值羅計。同尅長子。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"月照先見女宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷隂偶臨宫識者稀，得臨子息愈為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟長子無刑尅，　更見髙髙折桂枝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"長子如何多産女，　只因月與命相依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"命裏逄之多是吉，何况此位更逄之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"主尅母，見金，奸通骨肉，得小人力。若金與祿主會者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"乃專貼典吏。背祿馬者，乃卑賤之人。○月照主招鞍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，有得力女使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷陷方奴僕最凶衰，　隂偶臨之母不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"仰念劬勞恩至大，　空持甘㫖泣慈闈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"為官侍從多車馬，　三合太隂出六宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"若是土星相對見，　左右相随並罔功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453309004922920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":791,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"主妻良善，美貌端正，有財益夀。金牛宫大吉會。月孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"妻血疾并生離，吉星救免，主作贅壻。○月照，主貴相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"之妻，反因妻家發旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：太隂西沒最為佳，　明净之宫無㸃瑕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"更若尊星相對望，　必生貴子佐皇家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"夫家有福婦家貧，　只為孛星加太隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"自因夫婦和柔了，　恰主浮生甑有塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"主好㓗净土，同主目疾，獨見可免，值凶星主惡疾，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"加惡曜，疾病尤甚，必主一疾壓身，終不能脱。○月照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"主平生少疾吉，有夀，不犯天災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：太隂臨主八宫存，　畢世災危杳不聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"忌曜莫教同此位，　雙眸渾似月遮雲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂加臨疾厄宫，　太隂官祿足為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"父亡母存母又嫁，　随母飄飄西復東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"出入利見大人，得人輕重。巨蟹宫三倍力加吉星，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"有官職，亦宜財富。如見計孛惡星，一生孤寡多刑，及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"生離死别。吉星救减半，○月照，一生好逺遊，常得他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"方道路之分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂得在九宫中，　三合加臨照命同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"偏利遷移商賈客，　必因隂貴得財豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"九位遷移犯太隂，　父兄纔死便窮貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453329628102690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"對位有星相救助，　方道貧家在富人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"主少年近貴無官災，君子有祿，小人衣食。會惡星，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"徒配。會吉星祿馬，主有科名而貴。○月照大宜奉公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"若有官厄，常有恩赦之救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂官祿作身宫，　木火同行福倍隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計不逄功愈重，貴因戚里得侯封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"身居官祿不尋常，福徳星辰入命鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319226540067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"廟樂不曽刑本命，　為官湏坐紫衣堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"為人性善心慈，有福徳大富。會吉星，主孝順。㑹凶星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"心惡。暗羅在三合宫，主一生暗昧，祿馬皆陷，為事無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"成。雖有權星臨於祿位，不能貴。○月照，多因福人持","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"挈，立身髙上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷隂偶來臨福徳宫，　雍容道徳貴尊崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"更有吉星臨木位，　生長皇家族派中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323693326362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"月居福徳最為妙，處世為人足有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"一生輔弼當明徤，　為官獲福在參厨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"形貌𤕤朗清秀，主富貴聰明。○月照主形相具足，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"被小人相輕，不可與下等人作事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：相貌太隂仍孛星，　羅㬋同位最相刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"兵部牒中著名字，　末年財帛振英聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"三日宫中㸔命星，命中吉徳最為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323169169420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然忌曜來侵犯，　甘㫖空持泣母親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":901,"lineType":9,"content":"太隂變叚星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫天后星，○又名天皓星，主明徤湛寂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂子上為天后，　女貴男榮盡主權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"多缺多盈逄望晦，　三宫得此母長年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫瑤池星，○又名天皓星，主清閑之福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂元來水之母，　丑是滛池佐君父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"遇望英明至下弦，　女則金冠男台輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323693309978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫陽明星，○又名天馘星，主事馘毒多後悔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷陽明寅上曉星臨，　日出扶桑溺太隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"遇夜生人尤减福，　日生澇漉乏資金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫桂影星○又名天車星，好逺行，得衣祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月宫桂影仰扶踈，　對照西華畢月烏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八宿皆仰月，　周囬萬里沒差殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫始晦星○又名天關星，女遇之孤房也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷辰中始晦月無光，　對望宫中怕太陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323693342746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"火土計羅臨照視，　英雄難保少年郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫陽極星○又名天暗星，主女人暗昧欺罔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷陽每極時隂未至，　月臨雙女蕩非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"女逄忌曜多滛蕩，　男是貪花卧酒鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫朝陽星○又名天暗星，主得女子横財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月內金烏躔栁宿，　正臨離位失其明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生朝北身榮貴，身近君王雨露恩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹宫玉魄星○又名天福星，主福祿貴逹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453307583152182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷井鬼宫中月喜躔，未中玉魄夀長延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"女人邑號身長貴，　四正宫逄祿位遷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫地弼星○又名天官星，主文章貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷宫属隂陽遇太隂，　不宜觜宿只宜參。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"參是水猿猿𥬇月，　一生才學貴人欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫玉樞星○又名天後星，男貴顯，女難言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月到金牛號玉樞，　少年必定飽詩書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"三方盡在髙強位，　一世優游在帝都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453323169185804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":971,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊宫歸朝星○又名大道星，主妻不賢潔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太隂元后戌歸期，　總領羣星上玉霄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕日生逄首尾，　為官晚景却蕭條。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚宫執璽星○又名天晦星，母不賢潔，本身福祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷雙魚執璽太隂星，　月到中天分外明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"忌曜不侵湏富貴，　水金相照有佳聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":985,"lineType":9,"content":"天乙紫炁星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453319029276735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"總龜筭法：置積日减一千二百八十八，以一萬二百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八大數除之，不盡者為殘分，轉一當十，以二百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"八十為一度，二十八為一分，次下除為秒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"平行一日行三分五十七秒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":997,"lineType":9,"content":"紫炁論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙紫炁星，續木之餘，吉祥之曜也。一名景星，乃天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"華盖之氣，百川霧露之源，又名道徳之星。順行天輪，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"或隠或見。其行宫度，一日行三分五十七秒，一宫住","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453295558066213"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八箇月，二十八年行一周天。行道有黄赤之不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"同，喜怒之無定。此星名太極文昌之星。山遇此炁，服","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"藥有冲天之人；海遇此炁，水族有化龍之象；國遇此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"炁，則明君出；郡遇此炁，則賢人生；枯木得之，變生蘭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"蕙；蚌蛤得之，能出驪珠。照人身命，則富貴雙全，福夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"備足，仁慈道徳，心孤好善，能觧孛計之難，善救火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生人以為祿主星。　　甲生人以為䕃星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453332069220352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為魁刑星。　　丙生人以為貴星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生人以為印星。　　　戊生人以為耗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"巳生人以為權星。　　庚生人以為暗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生人以為正福魁星。　癸生人以為囚星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"此星廟在丑，旺在亥，好在寅，樂在申，午戌宫安皆喜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"惟未為怒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕經云：炁星牛斗最為珎，福祿崇髙上逹人。室壁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨超職位，尾箕應出貴豪倫。申宫得見招財祿，午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453329628119074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1043,"lineType":1,"content":"戌相逄富貴身，身命限中如見照，益財恩祿有相親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"○經云：紫炁元是木之餘，紅肥清白少髭鬚。同金同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"水皆為貴，木若臨之福最殊。○此星天上文星，行年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"及身命限得之，學者春秋必逄補中，小人見此，一歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"無憂，凡事所為，吉無不利。如遇科舉之年，得臨命限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"定主秋闈一薦，必騰萬里之聲，金榜髙登，直透三層","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"之浪。然亦不可一概論，湏當推詳命中原守星得力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"然後㸔洞㣲限。如遇忌曜，則為不吉，若為方主，反凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453309004955688"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"成吉。遇炁限者，功名成就，凡事稱心。行水限值之亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，一年顯逹。○經云：紫炁不來難發觧，任他才學有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"髙聲，奈何金榜無名字，只為此年無此星。○若與太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"陽同在金牛巨蟹宫，為福甚𦂳，皆主貴位。若不居樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"廟之地，在餘宫照人身命主，為性緩慢，多為九流之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"士，好躭釋氏，為福亦甚薄，與木月同宫在命，主性清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"髙，𠔥有貴勢，多愛竒異，晝生母亦長年。紫炁，天之喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，性頗類木，好清閒淡静，所臨之處，只與人為福，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955841030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"與人為禍，偏樂與水木日月同宫，為福緊也。獨行更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟在辰戌丑未四位，為福甚薄，宜仔細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁衆星中最善，形相分明人仰羡。心懐仁義性温柔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"作事與人為方便。無妬毒，多謹愿，少病利官長夀筭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1089,"lineType":2,"content":"紫炁在命，主人慈善，形相分明，性温柔，有仁義，作事愛人方便，心無毒，少病利官有夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"好躭僧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"道立身孤，舉措施為慵更懶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"紫炁在命，好躭釋氏，孤立性多慵懶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"近貴作閒人，月會母親先化幻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1093,"lineType":2,"content":"與日同近貴，為僧道閑人，月同尅母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955857414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"火同時醫與巫，土木更來尢懶慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1097,"lineType":2,"content":"與夜火㑹，主巫醫，與土木㑹，主慵懶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"金同妻妾是娼尼，水㑹智能稱俊彦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1099,"lineType":2,"content":"與金同妻，非娼則尼。水會有智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"能巧技。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"彗星分得賊人財，天首僧尼訟争戰。天尾星同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"有機變，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1103,"lineType":2,"content":"與月孛同，主分得賊財。與首同，主因僧尼争訟。與尾㑹，主機巧狡猾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"財位横來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"財寳現。三宫姊妹或為僧，四處廟田主巨萬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1105,"lineType":2,"content":"在二宫，主横得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1107,"lineType":2,"content":"古器。寄隂財寳在三宫，只招姊妹兄弟為僧尼，四宫巨富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕門下出緇流，子息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"湏知女先見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1109,"lineType":2,"content":"在六宫，主有僧道出身，門下五宫先招女子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"西沒宫中妻宻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"情，更與别人情似線。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1111,"lineType":2,"content":"在西沒，主美妻與外人通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"八宫終不染時災，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955873798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"官位不曽見州縣。九宫逰賈福宫閑，相貌為人性良","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁見木木見土。或為正限或臨之。相逄必是聲名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。此曜元來是紫㣲，○九星惟有孛堪畏。為福全然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"歸紫炁。跳位臨宫廟次佳，其他災福有定議。○紫炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"若與財星至，當主資財一等竒。只恐早年多破散，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"然妻妾主生離。○未人申上見紫炁，重疊逄生主清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。孤辰隔角并宫行，母死父亡進田地。○紫炁躔宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955890182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"到磨蝎，要於月上推圎缺。圎時清秀有財糧，缺處伶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"仃多破滅。○亥上紫炁到雙魚，若是隂人祖業富。重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"疊逄金尤更嘉，一旦文章定遭遇。○木紫同逄亥子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，髙強衣食大昌隆。水入旺方逄紫炁，子孫清貴富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"家翁。○庚辛之年紫申酉，初主奔波人物醜。貪色貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"財更貪盃，又因娶婦旺資財。○紫炁居前後有日，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"臨田宅尤為吉。月孛計都同共來，老去令人貪女色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"○天乙多為應夢竒，紫袍呈瑞是佳兒。若躔廟旺凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955906566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"星避，的是留侯作帝師。○流年若與炁相逄，種種為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"祥不觧凶。舉子遇之湏發薦，仕途得此必官隆。○當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"年紫炁若臨身，下筆驚人似有神。帝座木星同照着，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"終湏富貴作朝臣。○天乙躔牛是福基，性髙行直更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"心慈。若教陷却三方主，縱使為官只奉祠。○天乙從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"來主大孤，命如逄着莫狂圗。三方不向竒星陷，斷取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"緇黄即是渠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
