{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔角宿號天休，　機智清閑藝術優。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955939334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道逄之多吉慶，庶人不繋若虚舟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁臨人多殊異，　角木蛟中主尊貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道章服庶人財，　職司之人増祿位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔亢宿號天僮，　性善文章藝術通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"不獨為官并富旺，　神仙樂道福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：紫炁若來角亢方，　萬里台星光爍爍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔氐宿號天𤨔，　雲水留心自得閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"耿介孤髙人自傲，　為人只是好居仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955955718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁來氐不十全，　雖為財庫夀之源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"計土火羅同入度，　災多福少不當言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔房宿號天衝，　平生清福有誰同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"道釋白衣好消息，資財衣祿却豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"卯中有宿名為兎，　紫炁正樂房三度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"榮封妻子祿超羣，　又且揚名益宗祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔心宿號天徳，　子孫雖有終湏尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"儒學釋典自能通，　玄象天文湏㑹得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955972102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"心宿大火在東宫，　炁曜來居怕火逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁本無心上火，　炁藏心火必争雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔尾宿號天婣，　心性豪強尅子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"謀畧威權心莫測，聲名忠義播乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"尾星好炁在寅宫，　寅位東方炁曜雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"盖炁好行東令首，　仁慈尊重少災凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔箕宿號天循，　智識機謀果毅深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"性直文章聲逺播，貴人相遇有知音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527955988486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"箕星本在木宫居，　誰知炁属木之餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"此曜好滛為入廟，　箕風好動炁終虞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔斗宿號天斛，飄然孤潔為清福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"文章忠直外安閑，　朋友柔和衣食足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"斗為帝曜自尊嚴，炁宿相躔福祿綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"此位偏宜道徳曜，　得居星斗是朝賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：天乙若臨南斗方，　尺璧寸珠未為寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔牛宿號天輪，　尊重清髙害六親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956004870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"金火逄之官顯赫，　如逄木月富豪人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"牛星從來正丑親，　炁朝北位近嚴宸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵牛星傍斗立，　牛逄炁曜徳惟馨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔女宿號天瑞，　耿介孤髙性獨明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"但得吉星居十位，　必為廊廟福蒼生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"女星雖是子丑宫，　炁來此地木堪逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"炁得女星雖樂好，　女隂炁味不相同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔虚宿號天文，清秀為人近至尊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956021254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉難為自孤潔，逹人僧道樂平生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"虚位躔宫在北辰，　炁來望闕正朝真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"湏是獨居方有福，　更逄土忌不相嗔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔危宿號天僮，　為僧章服貴人同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"談天玄象心明悟，　樂道逍遙善事叢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"危星亦在子之宫，　炁曜來躔福不隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"炁係木餘無旺子，　炁星危曜不安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔室宿號天玄，　道釋儒流性自然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956037638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"經術從來胸臆悟，文才洞徹事神仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙來臨室火猪，　此星無憂木之餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"不值空亡孤貧地，　福髙貴夀富難如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔璧宿號天覺，機智文章更多學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"更能籌筭悟天機，舉錯施為應不錯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星到壁事相和，妻子逄之有難多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"最是清孤偏尅陷，　若為僧道却無磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔奎宿號天乙，　性直忠良又煩急。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956054022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"平生多是不安閒，　不受人欺財聚積。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"奎星漸属戌白羊，　此星炁曜主權綱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"炁若躔奎珍重徳，　徳星珍重自相當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔婁宿號天虚，　為人孤害六親踈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"緇黄自是平生事，衣食清閒一事無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"婁宿莫要炁來臨，　金狗相逄炁不清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"此曜要行清貴宿，婁金狗與炁相刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔胃宿號天音，衣食生來却稱心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956070406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子宫中難聚㑹，　四方交友自同襟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"胃星本是酉戌初，戌位同躔炁有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"西位火沉無猛曜，　此星柔順要西居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔昴宿號天端，　為人崇重命孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"情性耿介難侵犯，　忠孝家門百行安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"昴中正属金中臨，　炁依金牛道徳純。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"此曜孤辰躔昴位，妻兒孤獨福閒人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔畢宿號天吉，　天乙居中加福力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956086790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"為人清秀善為心，　官祿星扶進爵秩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"炁曜名為華盖星，　如臨畢宿酉和申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"十六度中皆喜旺，　最宜坐命與安身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔觜宿號天福，　衣食安然勝僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"金玉財寳自天來，妻子難為終夀考。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"觜星明處炁來遊，　必使君王早夜求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"更是官星𠔥祿主，　布衣何慮不封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云天乙最宜躔在觜，　極品官資性至慈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956103174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔參宿號天瓊，　為官終是貴遷榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"幹直忠良叅相位，　文章事業擅西清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"叅星偏要炁同行，　炁臨祿位必公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"道徳要逄西位立，　炁逄西旺必安榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔井宿號天令，　文武兩全才更敏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"參樞給諫盡功臣，　官職崇髙年夀永。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"井宿雖是未宫中，炁要恬居愛井逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"盖井深沉太乙静，　女尼男道自心聰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956119558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔鬼宿號天榮，積善之家有此人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴崇髙聲逺振，官途超越旺門庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼星年位要炁星，　炁属木餘入廟深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"此是隂居宜炁静，　金羊偏愛炁金臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔栁宿號天平，　好静温良免禍生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"衣祿平平無破敗，　子孫終是不相親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"栁宿本是午未宫，　炁躔兩位更英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"炁入栁宫同廟樂，　一生清貴不生凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855527956135942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔星宿號天強，　命中若遇定孤孀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺家門自興盛，若為僧道夀延長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁行宫入到星，　名彰祿至照人榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋同度成勲業，　位顯官崇台鼎臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔張宿號天芒，　尅䧟妻兒命裏當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有髙才心又急，　晚年方可免恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"張宿好與炁同宫，　炁若同時必主聰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有張星偏好此，　月鹿喜有夀星逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128841279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔翼宿號天牢，命宫若值定孤髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"生計為謀多費力，　若為僧道自逍遙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"翼星漸入雙女家，　已火燄燄炁咨嗟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"炁柔不旺在雙女，　翼躔此宿困天涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"炁躔軫宿號天嗟，　子孫足處定迍乖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"命若逄之身獨喜，　此人衣食少寛懐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁軫位雖孤獨，　身命若逄多發祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不能入禍不深，　吉曜終與人為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙室，牛為旺，箕為樂，觜為廟，居此生人得大人敬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"重，常近至尊。惟宜見金木火、月，為極貴，入宫親宻之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"任，旺二十四年。見水月，好竒異書。見金火，急性，居官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"顯赫，好神仙之事，在僧道宜章服。在陷宫有水月金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"火，亦為貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"日月宫，主為性緩，作事方圎，好藝術，有慈心，因道藝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"成立後乃富貴。水木宫，主為人性格聰慧智量大有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128874047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"心機，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫，主性格慈惠，文武異常，見文習文，見武習武。更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星居有力位，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫，主好兵法，有謀畧，得貴人擢用。若諸星在強宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，主有位。土宫為人有信，作事方圎，有聲名，好文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"章。三主星居有力位，必有典郡之權。三主在稍髙位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"定主大富。三主在無力位，亦主㣲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1471,"lineType":9,"content":"紫炁同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128890431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"炁日月同宫，得父母力，近貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太陽紫炁會相逄，澤潤生民稼穡豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"百六遇時祥瑞盛，　人生遇此會三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"月炁文章一世豪，為人志氣冠吾曹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"母夀靈長𠔥清雅，官班超轉職崇髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"炁金同宫，主得貴人女為妻，女人愛慕。在陷害宫，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"有妨害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷金星相逄紫炁星，禹門先躍化凡鱗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128906815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"威加夷狄為良將，爕理隂陽輔帝辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"炁水同宫，主有聲名，足文章，居清華之地，大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷水星紫炁㑹相逄，　天産其人福勢長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"官爵顯榮家又富，　千斯倉與萬斯箱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"紫與水星能作善，　厚徳純性學神仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"醫卜技工多文藝，　一生福夀兩綿延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"炁土同宫，主為土地之官，好神仙之事、長生之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷土星紫炁喜相依，　冠冕榮身爵位巍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128923199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"丹赤之心剛且毅，　徳延萬里足光輝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"炁火同宫，主宜服色，心卑下。火星順行，主福祿宏逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"炁木同宫，主大人舉薦之力，亦主貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：紫炁不來難發觧，任他才學動公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"寄語才髙湏要命，　不用頻頻祝上清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"木星紫炁福豐隆，　百六逄之慶不窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"更在廟宫隂徳重，官為師相位侯封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"炁羅同宫，主器量宏大，雄貴顯祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128939583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：紫炁羅㬋喜㑹同，　人生剛毅抱英雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"揮戈却日平姦虜，𥬇取勲名反掌中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"炁計同宫夜照，主文學，晝生多招凶險，成敗尅害事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：紫炁相逄見計都，家多粟帛富庄租。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"廟宫人值貂冠任，　百六逄時萬禍祛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁計都同一位，　復定經中尤為忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫逄此災不輕，　若見身宫最難避。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128955967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"炁孛同宫，主足謀多慮，能掌兵機，職任清髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：蹇薄皆由孛紫逄，離鄉背井道途中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"多情色慾仍為盗，千方百計也還窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁天乙，福貴之星，官髙遇善，福祿彌堅。金木同宫，名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"望之重，各臨旺度，明君委用。星行順旺，清貴之職可領重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"權，乆而不失。日月同之，助其福祿，初度加臨，大為榮旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"炁同日月，多助其福，更在初度旺宫，身名榮逹。如主不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713128972351"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"順，遇蝕神，即為僧道術巧之人。木祿不背，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"首羅同行，職祿殊勲，臨於旺樂，偃武脩文，炁同孛計，足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"謀多智，夜逄貴旺，文權武畧。若是日逄多主，興廢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋。日曜宜日生，計都隂曜利夜生，文武全備，雄貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"顯祿，反此則招險厄，成敗尅害之重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"日土順行，財業豐富，或旺或廟，引從旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"土日同宫順行，主富貴有名望。若在廟旺，貴權節帥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿顯揚，子孫超卓，無不榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1591,"lineType":10,"content":"命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"守照。命宫主顔容尊貴不肥重，骨節柔長，性敏多通，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"臨事有斷，博通畏事，為事善良，性情慈善出衆，尊重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"仁慈道徳，一生好静，大利僧道，孤害六親，惡曜刑破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713129005119"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"處世孤貧。見金木火月，為極貴之人，居親宻之任。見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1603,"lineType":1,"content":"金火，急性，居官顯赫，及好神仙之事。見水月，好竒異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"書𦘕。更得諸福星在強相扶，必大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1605,"lineType":2,"content":"闕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"此星名諫善。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"木土同入命宫，謂之紫㣲垣。○炁月同入命宫，醫卜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"顯名。計孛同入命宫，主因酒色犯刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：紫炁臨命照，　　身髙財帛低。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"初年六親散，　　　後運總相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁文章最吉祥，　照臨身命福非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855713129021503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1619,"lineType":1,"content":"更觧諸凶明道徳，　庶民僧道亦安強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁臨宫學冠倫，　如臨暗曜號孤神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然不是天庭客，　亦作禪門第一人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙月孛星，属水之餘，天暗之宿也。一名彗星，一名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"妖星，一名天哭毛頭星。隠行於天，其行宫度，一日行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"十一分二十九秒，一宫住九箇月，九年行一周天。行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"道有黄赤之不同，喜怒之無定，喜則為少㣲星，怒則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"為彗星。此星出現，使衆曜無光，羣星失色，或入南北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541094946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"斗中，或入太㣲宫，或犯天闕，國須有災，所主分野，郡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"必有災，人民饑饉，流離其方。若兵興，將死兵亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為祿主星。　　　甲生人以為暗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453332069367808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕經云：命與身宫孛照時，栁躔初到最為竒。諫官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"御史元相稱，兵寄文衡又所宜。富貴可期經翼軫，聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"名當發在虚危。更臨身宿直難者，最喜隂方夜見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"○此星空與人為福，多與人為祸。若乗栁梢旺度之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"分，善星相㑹，便作大官。命斷之，縱使為官，亦為歇㓕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"又最忌金星同宫，亦主尅害妻子。○經云：欲問榮華","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"及好妻，生來太白順遷移。若逄對照家無子，那更同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"宫被孛欺。○賦云：尅妻害子，太白與月孛同宫。○又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541111330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"云：妻無子息，都縁孛在髙強。推星者宜仔細消息，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"有不應，君子得之，在命亦喜。劍𨦟同宫。乙未人，劍亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"𨦟夘，巳酉人，劍𨦟俱丑；乙亥人，劍卯𨦟亥；巳丑人，劍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"巳𨦟酉；乙卯人，劍未𨦟亥，已已人，劍酉鋒巳。此煞在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"命，專主權柄，在妻損妻，臨子害子。○經云：劍𨦟之煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"細推詳，又臨身命最為良。執卷之人湏及第，釋衣道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"術足財糧。惟有小人全不好，㑹教早夭法塲亡。更被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"天刑㐲尸制，投河自縊眼無光。此星吉星名福煞，百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326549581887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"人逄之百箇昌。若更盡傳真言訣，合用金銀數十廂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"○六乙生人，孛為正官，祿星、月孛星同宫，不為凶惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"之宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453322145726473"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"乙星若在星邊過，　又與羅㬋同度坐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"峥嶸負氣武兵人，　志壯心髙膽又大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"孛躔張宿號天權，妻子宫中未保全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食生來自豐足，　性情髙尚樂忠賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"張宿月鹿明，　　孛臨號元真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"須是旁奎宿，　　　張曜孛華明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙權威勢如虎，　不宜張宿居於午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"偏生庶出二重親，　卓立生涯難守祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453332069449728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"孛躔翼宿號天譁，　此是星辰到本家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"喜怒不常多色慾，　心如狼虎毒如蛇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"翼好孛同行，　　孛躔翼宿亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"孛水宜同立，　　聲應位持衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙本是惡強星，　翼宿躔之疾壓身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"女主産亡男癖疾，　限行至此不光明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"孛躔軫宿號天忒，　戀酒迷花好遊奕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"家財盡破好行偷，　若不投軍須有尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453329628299298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"軫星屬巳宫，　　　巳水孛争雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"陽極隂相續，　　　相續自無凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙獨行來到軫，　為人性急多明敏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄土木再同居，　破散資財離鄉井。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":585,"lineType":9,"content":"月孛入宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙月孛在虚、危、栁為樂，井、畢為廟，翼為旺。居此生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"人，主居官有威望，人多畏服，主有節察之位，刑殺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"權。在身命八煞宫，見火為盗賊，見金為不軌之事，妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453329628315682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不良。在財帛則多耗散，為脱賺。但在身命官祿則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，在諸位則凶。此曜為災福力大於諸星。若見木，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"為臺憲之任；見火為亂世英雄；見水為盗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"日木宫，主為人重厚心直，三方盡在強宫，主少年榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"逹。非在強宫，主少年雖得貴人見知，諸事不成。立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫，主為人性快，出言不審是非，一生宜防婦人損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"陷，及小人暗窺。主星在最髙之地，立在㣲職，合少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"立身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453327052898313"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"土金水月宫，主為人性剛，作事忠直，有謀計，好殺害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"守虚、危、井、栁、鬼、翼宿者，主節察位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":617,"lineType":9,"content":"月孛同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"孛金同宫，為行不良，妻亦然，男為巫，女為覡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：金星與孛若縱横，　百六逄之大吉亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"人産遇時須抱福，　家居金玉保康寜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"孛水同宫，主因文學有災，多虚詐，見四刑星，主膿血","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"之災，在三九宫，主落水死，不見屍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453333105360907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：辰星不欲相交彗，　男可為奴女可婢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"邪滛奸濫主貧寒，　畢世千謀無一遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"孛火同宫，心好善而實不能行，亦多癰疽膿血。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：熒惑最能誅孛彗，掃除攙搶為慶瑞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"官榮上爵秉威權，　百六逄之為禍害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"孛木同宫，宜官不宜才藝，夭夀為悖逆之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：木孛原來主夀齡，　今日無分重與輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"人生八十髙年客，皆由四正有強星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283439625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"孛土同宫夜照，損夀傷財，刑害瘖瘂之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：其如土孛坐天心，　雖要分明見太隂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"不顧順留并伏逆，　布衣從此振儒衿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅同宫，各居廟旺，主有威權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：彗星若與羅㬋㑹，勒石紀功揚塞外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"常人遇此至千殃，　百六遇時愈殃害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計同宫為姦滛，不廉不潔，多損多破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：彗星計都不可逄，　人生薄賤主貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283423241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"須招風疾并癆厄，　百六當之不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"隂人計孛若入命，定是滛邪色慾娘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"若得善星來同照，　遏雲歌舞近侯王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"孛炁同宫，主性巧聰明，多技藝，足文詞衣祿有權治","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：蹇薄皆由孛紫逄，離鄉背井道途中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"多情色慾仍為盗，千方百計也還窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"孛日月同宫，主防父母居官有生殺之權，日好訟，夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453329628332066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"好酒賭博。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：日孛相交名字損，　反使吉人心惻隠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"姦臣叛世不生兹，　百六㑹時保安穏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"日同彗孛大為凶，　百六當之禍患重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"犯法蛇傷并虎咬，　倥侗畢世一顓䝉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":695,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"孛為隂曜，最宜夜照，廟旺身髙，機權兵要：晝孛日同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"財名有望，夜孛月同財祿榮旺，主背多貧，運為阻障。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453333105377291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋同位喜旺雄貴逄忌宫，惡，多迍多否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"二星各居廟旺，或在髙強，主雄貴重權之位，更若同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星在陷弱宫，即多刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙同宫，竒能巧技，衣祿豐厚，不無掌治。土與孛同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"夜招刑尅，晝人若逄，廣招財利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"孛同計，火晝逄，主祸短夀多刑，災厄破敗。夜生貴旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"衣祿常殊，臨順廟權掌兵符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計日逄，主夭夀，不夭折則風癩顛狂凶死。夜照主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339182825491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"衣祿興崇，好華餙，若在廟旺，有武祿重權貴氣。金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"夜同，職位顯榮。晝人主順，財祿豐隆，身主同惡，妖濫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"困窮，忽然無救，亦不善終。木星照順，福慶亨通，縱然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"惡厄，亦不致凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"守照。命宫眉目踈秀，體貌堂堂，噐量宏偉，瞻視自尊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"大寛小急，為人性重，易好易惡，好殺毒害，奸雄氣烈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339182792723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"入廟反為權柄，善星相扶，少年及第，無吉星輔助，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"為災咎，為人不足，多病不快活，假饒富貴，亦主犇波，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"食祿之人無由安閒，貪酒好色，夜照獨宫，身名亨逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"如是晝生，破失根涯，在妻宫則妻損早，在官祿則居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"官有威望，人多畏服，有生殺之權，與首尾同宫，尅害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子，與天乙對望，處世多迍。其星名天吏星，主祿雄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"豪，又名催官煞，諸星皆吉，而孛方入，乃為催官。若孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"臨要出宫者，不係旺在秋冬，為災為福，力大於諸星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339182809107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"在身命則吉，在諸位則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：孛照命宫人，　　　初年災破頻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"老隂月孛最凶神，豈有臨人照命身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"若在強宫為祿主，　總領邦國作權臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星守照在巨蟹，　若在髙強亦得觧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339182841875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"更遭羅計與土星，　只主有錢能放債。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛昏沉性不常，讀書多懶好遊行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"不如别作榮身計，莫被儒冠誤一身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛須知是惡星，　逄之禍患卒難行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"若要入廟宫中者，　必定前程有大成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":785,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"生來少積，夜食平常，假饒初年承祖之付託，財帛興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，如三春開花正發時，狂風猛雨折㧞其根枝，若土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453332069466112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"星照視，則産業生旺頻加，無破敗也。○孛照財上暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"昧無主執，財物耗散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：孛照財宫真可畏，　須防人頼暗為災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"限逄惡曜君湏忌，　吉宿同臨主横財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神月孛臨財時，破蕩傷殘豈所宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"假使堆金如山海，　會合消鑠似塵㣲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":805,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不得力，縱有昆季，他東我西，彼死我活，相見之時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283456009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"如水投火，却見他人，反成親戚，所謂親踈義重，不親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"却親，宜自卓立。○孛照主尅，兄弟惡横。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：孛星無禮最乖張，那更凶殘在陷方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"不見弟兄同燕鴈，　只聞手足似𧲣狼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星對照兄弟宫，各自榮家各自豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使牛田衣食足，　兄若西時弟亦東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"手足為親難得力，　只為其宫逄月孛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"争取家資不孝人。　兄弟心強相妬嫉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541144098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":829,"lineType":9,"content":"田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"尅傷父母，縱有祖業，終須破散。若居次旺，則不以傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"尅論，更加土孛同行，多主偏房庶出。○孛照一生破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"散，住宅不定，有成有敗，祖業破盡，宜與異性同活。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：田宅宫中土孛防，　三方閑極可悲傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"此身若不為僧道，　必喚他人作父娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"莫愁月孛是凶時，　有人因此田園旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"只縁廟坐午申間，　午後申前及未上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453327052914697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星加臨在田宅，　𥘉年資財真不竭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"隂人最不喜其星，　嫁出夫家無寸鐵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":851,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"主男少女多，又宜心性相壓，及遲見方好。○經云：男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"女宫中怕遇孛，無男只是女生多。若得吉星同照視，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"晚招一對不堅牢。如六丁生人，化囚見之，在此宫者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"全無子息。假饒有三男二女，如寃家骨肉，一箇抝東，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"一箇抝西，如有吉星合照，則猶較可。與太隂對視，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339182858259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"男主有貴，女主封號，長則性慵昏蔽，少則伶俐惺惺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"别星則减力矣。○孛照合難得子息，多患瘡癤之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：子孫宫裏孛星攻，　狀𩔖根甘蒂苦同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"假使門庭當旺盛，　也生不肖辱先宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛來遊至第五，　男女雖多多枉死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒庶子與過房，　於法推之多絶嗣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":877,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"多不得力，亦有走失。○孛照，不可托小人作事，有暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283472393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"昧刑尅之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷奴僕惟推最弱宫，　孛星臨照愈為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"當生祿主或全䧟，　衣食犇波守困窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛為星不可言，　當生逄着病相纒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"若交奴僕同宫分，　反主妻奴白日眠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":893,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"須兩三妻，妻命有此星相抵，反有偕老之期。賦云：妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"無子息，都縁孛在髙強。○經云：月孛守妻宫，奴婢結","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326549680191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"為宗，無曜居六五，為人主脱空。○註云：妻性惡則免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"孛照，合得尊貴慈善之妻，反招偏房之妾方應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷孛星若在照妻位，　不是傷夫妻亦防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"多幸随人為側室，　不然卑賤得從良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人月孛入夫宫，　反主夫家財帛豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"更在未方為主將，　母死父亡財帛隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"望門尅婦婦家貧，　只因月孛到孤神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥丑申三四位，　夫妻和順定無因。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷孛居第八照身宫，　三合無星不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"死在路頭無板載，　更防官死獄囚中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛伏劍疾宫來，　年少沉疴染重災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"歲乆不聞歡喜事，年來常聴哭哀哀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷孛宫第九死他鄉，　路上横屍不可當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計更臨獅子位，　法塲之地見身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"孛計遷移又併羅，　偏於土木損財多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然已有堪居地，　毁拆移居不奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":951,"lineType":9,"content":"官祿宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453327052931081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"有大人君子之權，更居樂廟之宫，則官職清髙。小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"帶之，則血光刑責。○孛照多因暗昧之事起災，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"重官厄。凡遇隂人，不可交結。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月孛午地是隂宫，　食祿雖遲也不空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"或若火星逄祿主，　多因官職至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛光芒號彗星，　衆星一見歛威明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"廟方若作天元主，　貴擁貔貅百萬兵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"入廟星辰最難得，　若臨官祿尤為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453322145742857"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"鸞臺鳳閣更光華，　只忌隂陽同月孛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星主祿大雄豪，　只要相參土火髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"斗角栁中為受用，文經武緯列勲曹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":979,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"多主反覆，纔有好事，反成凶兆。○孛照須有不分明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"人，隂謀相損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷福徳宫中要好星，　如何孛照有昌榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"心頭搔擾勞魂夢，　日日思量欲改更。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326549696575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳宫中怕孛星，　忽然火曜兩相刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"終身只可三旬夀，縱得長生也受迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":995,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"一生為災，經云：惟有太乙月孛星，生時不欲臨此地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"○孛照為人膽大，不信隂陽，作事不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷十二宫中有孛星，　形貌麄醜懼知聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"性情不定如狂妄，　舉止無慿似少神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"十相不完身跼蹐，　六根𧇊損善艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855514830618678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然身在公侯位，　斷作狂愚廢棄人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1011,"lineType":9,"content":"月孛變段星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫天權星，○又名天烈星，主武勇心機悍烈也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷月孛臨人狀似虎，　子上天權巧心路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"若是獨行無别星，　掌握權衡至台輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫伏屍星，○又名流血星，主流血惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷丑宫月孛見伏屍，身宫官祿最凶危，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"更有吉星相扶助，　福徳宫逄短命兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855514830635062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫天虎星，○又名天獄星，多招牢獄罪責。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天虎孛星寅地旺，　喜臨箕尾福非常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶二曜不相犯，　四正宫逄福祿昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫五鬼星○又名天文星，主狡猾隂謀，讒佞夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天衡五鬼為妖孽，　女落風塵男下劣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"妻家䘮盡定無人，　孤獨一身無處立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫天妖星，○又名破軍星，主威猛色慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855514830651446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天妖辰上為凶恠，　八煞遷移為六害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"若非寄食别人家，　庶出𠋣親多此軰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫雙鸞星，○又名彗孛星，主死兵刄毒藥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷孛臨天乙號雙鸞，　男女逄之是寡鰥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"更值惡星須惡死，　吉星相救可安全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫天鬼星，○又名流尸星，主刀鎗弓矢之難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天冠加臨獅子宫，　星張二宿最為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"如躔栁宿畨成吉，富貴功名百事通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855514830667830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹宫垣廟星，○又名威猛星，主威猛尊嚴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷孛星最喜到秦州，　文作清華武列侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"不怕惡星侵此位，　平生富貴自優游。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫天吉星，○又名敗殘星，主敗殘亂家道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷申宫天吉少人知，　四正宫逄得者稀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"戊乙庚人為上吉，　名標四海福相随。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫金堂星，○又名文際星，主文章際會也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷金堂酉地喜相侵，　不習詩書亦有名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855514830684214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"自是䕃封多福祿，　錦衣閭里有家聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊宫天囚星，○又名天邪星，主凶猛中失職祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷戌中月孛號天囚，　白髪孤寡亦未休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"此曜匕強如在上，　官災横禍作寃讎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚宫遊魂星，○又名威職星，主隂人多妖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷孛星須是要安和，　亥上遊魂福最多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"祿上資財當巨富，　終身落薄更消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855514830700598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l027o/1-SK1609_figure_00038.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wYYaKIoHGaGNzBTsI1IWnAZt8xU%3D","pictureHeight":311,"pictureWidth":320,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l027o/1-SK1609_figure_00038.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SRlRB9focdXG1lPCaY6a7XlX2ks%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l027o/1-SK1609_figure_00038.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"總龜筭法：置積日加五百六十，以六千七百九十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"逆遊數除之，逆遊數别列上位記之，其餘不盡者為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"殘分，以五因之，却加入上位逆數二，以九十三為一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453329628413986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"度，又不滿者入分秒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
