{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋為天首星，配属火之精，黄旛黄道之宿也，一名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"蝕神，隠行於天，其行宫度有喜怒，一宫一年半，十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"年行一周天，逆行天道，喜則為天統星，怒則為天傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"災。網星遇交於晦朔弦望，能掩日月之光，為之薄蝕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"天地犯之崩裂，山嶽犯之傾頺，川澤犯之枯竭。至於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453327053045769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"雲恠星妖，冬雷夏雪，未有不由此也。此曜不能興善，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"好作妖孽，主血光傷破，斬截凶殘，寒熱瘴氣身命犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"之則有成湯之旱，帝堯之水，文王拘於羑里，夫子厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"於陳蔡，司馬遷宫刑，左邱明失明，賈誼之賦忌鵩，李","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"斯之嘆黄耳。聖賢猶不免此，庸人見之，更有惡星同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，乃為六極之人，一曰凶折，二曰疾，三曰憂，四曰貧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰惡，六曰弱。若入廟則為貴格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生人以為祿主星，　甲生人以為魁權星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326549762111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為囚星。　　丙生人以為印星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生人以為催官刑星。戊生人以為貴星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"巳生人以為䕃星。　　庚生人以為耗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生人以為福星，　　壬生人以為暗星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"此星廟在午，樂在卯，旺在辰，好在酉，喜在戌，怒在申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕經云：權星守要最難遭，晝日陽宫近貴豪。張角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"度中身顯地，昴星宿上武名曹。又云：餘宫限內多為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"福，隂位無災禍必消。更有變凶為吉處，宫當十一自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339182972947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"榮超。馬嘶龍躍值羅㬋，卯酉還來戌上求。同日陷妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"并害父，雖居廟旺亦多憂。賦云：羅㬋在命，位至五品","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"殊勲。若得紫木同宫照視，可為雄鋭貴品，主人特逹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"慷慨。火土孛相㑹，多主權刑躁暴，公吏掌殺，妨妻廢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"祖。貴則威權，賤則傷刑。若獨行廟樂之宫照臨者，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。六癸生人，土為天官主祿，水為科名，與之同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"則大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453345948155956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋性格最為髙，形相猙獰膽氣豪。不奈是非無妬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"毒，日生陽位始堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋性格最髙，形相猙獰有膽氣，不奈是非無妬毒。好日在陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"逄廟地有操持。榮加旌節有旗旄。富貴只宜官位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"立，隂宫私合苦煎熬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋在廟地，有掌權加旌節之榮，宜官中立身。若在隂宫煞居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"日月㑹時人見蝕，湏憂父母死難逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋為蝕神，與日月㑹則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"掩日月無光，謂之蝕。故主尅父母也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"金㑹助權好兵武，更防因色病成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"癆。水到財多逄盗賊，本來才調好風騷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"與金㑹，好兵武，因色成疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"水到財招盗。木會文章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"土逆四肢不具足，火扶好殺弄鎗刀。兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326549778495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"弟不宜財破蕩四宫賣却祖東臯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"與土同，更逆　四支不具足，火同好武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"喜殺，二宫損財，三尅兄弟，四破祖業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"子息位，苦啼號。六宫妻本名春桃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋在五宫尅子，在六宫以妾為妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"妻位妻權中主尅，八宫攧撲定須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"遭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":115,"lineType":2,"content":"七宫妻有權主尅妻，六宫主攧撲之災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳夭亡并絶嗣，相貌為軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"是此遭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"在十一宫主夭亡絶嗣，在十二宫主為軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋一宿名天首，若在髙強好飲酒。如逄吉曜共扶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"持，必有重權來到手。○羅㬋元是貴權星，只憂土孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"與同行。廟樂二宫為福徳，他宫重疊犯官刑。○羅㬋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347491659795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"元自是權星，甲戊方中起犬刑。除却廟堂𠔥帶旺，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"饒為福也無名。○何以羅㬋號天首，只為凶星為福厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星福厚人未知，寅夘午宫分外竒。○九星活曜梟天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"首，太隂同宫人物醜。寅宫卯土午三辰，專主此星為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"福厚。○命宫官祿若相逄，必定其人身在公。若被孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"星來照着，一生刑責累遭凶。○荆州更及雙魚宫，兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"處臨之更不凶。若是貴人相遇着，定持兵印作元戎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"○白手成家自買田，只因天首氣聲聮。若非寅午并","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283619849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎，賣與他人不要錢。○大凡福徳與羅㬋，一生隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"徳旺田牛。或若對宫逄此宿，子孫名譽冠神州。○午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"人午上值羅㬋，置産生錢及外州。更得孛星臨帝座，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫佩印更封侯。○惟有羅㬋能起福，婦人失位招","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"夫祿。不在寅午并卯宫，子酉二方當納粟。○帝座尊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"星人未知，或為日位或生時。惟有羅㬋并月孛，此星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"相見十分竒。○羅㬋雖説是凶神，若使单行逈出倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"對合更無刑戰忌，威名端的冠朝臣。○首曜於人性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283570697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"不和，善星不助惡尤多。平生好作欺人語，壟斷無圖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"奈若何。○天首當生所在宫，限如逄此有威風。不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"為禍終成福，若在髙強更有功。○天首從來怕夜生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"更居凶位伏屍名。若非死在隂人手，即是征人奠旅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"處世貧窮不堪。照身宫主三般危險之疾，一主暴卒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"二主水火，三主血疾。若無此，主短夀貧賤之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"守照命宫主眼圓神潔，形質端厚，貌古有神，色重骨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"堅，語音亮大，性急怒物，臨事有斷，義直於人心，有謀用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"特逹慷慨，得人欽羡，不受人觸，小事致惑，大事有斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"謹而不慳，義而濟物，少年省事，福祿不堅，災難易得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"晚歲方有成立。五星相扶，便為重權，官職清顯。若五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283685385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"星在八煞宫及官祿宫，皆為貴人。鎮諸星而為首，背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星而獨行，順躔張栁，統領兵符，正入陽宫，威權獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"重，在命則表儀浩浩，照身則容貌熈熈，見木宜遷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"進職。好官星大煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"戌已午寅夘辰子丑申酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"君子立身廊廟，為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"掌兵，食邑萬户，一生榮華。金火土孛同入，主疾，尅害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子，破壊祖業，宜於貴命見之。經云：羅㬋臨命位，權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"勢自能髙，少逹終有滯，財名晚歲牢。若然入怒地，成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"敗屢經遭。晝遇限宫見，迎恩見貴豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453338931216421"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷羅㬋星惡見星君，　却見當年在卯寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"更若癸生為祿主，　仰觀平歩上青雲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋在命若何看，　文武𠔥資信不難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"但得一星金與水，　若非秉筆即登壇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":711,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"入廟吉，初年破，末自立，君子吉，小人破。如是煞方，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"耗大破。若吉相逄，則主横財。○羅照多得衆人財力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"若太盛則主有破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453338931232805"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷財宫之上是羅㬋，　得已財時便好休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"更若狂圖多富蓄，　如何不破被姦偷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋寅午最為佳，　男兒白手自成家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"平生兄弟渾無力，　縱多不若自榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"何以為人富不仁，　只縁財帛犯星辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰不怕逄羅孛，羅孛元來怕太隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"生時獨犯天首尾，　不入廟時災咎至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"如何財帛積如山，　只為此星居第二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453345948319796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"有財無産命如何，　只為財宫帶孛星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"午上孛星午天首，　浮財不足税錢多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋財上多官厄，　非人不用相接識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然熒孛入宫來，　任你嘍囉難計覔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":747,"lineType":9,"content":"兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟三人，各胞異姓，○羅照須見三人，怒宫全無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷第三宫中有羅㬋，　侼逆乖為可自憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"宗𣲖同源恩義等，　只縁凶曜一時休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453346493431843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":757,"lineType":9,"content":"田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"主父母兩三重，或自身螟蛉，或随母嫁。○羅照命有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅，先破後成，反不招祖業","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷若是羅㬋先尅父，　得居田宅敗湏榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"合得隂人財祿貴，　機權方藝定湏成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋天首最凶殘，　祖業雖多守則難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"可惜田園千萬頃，　都縁凶曜見闌珊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"僧家道舍屋楹多，實然土宿與天羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347256778793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"田土雖多無屋宇，　年年飽食别人禾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":777,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"各胞異姓，亦主損子添丁，則長子不利。○羅照合生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"偏子，大吉，宜求外姓親生者全不得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷男女如何便榮貴，　只為權星皆得地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"若教寅午遇天羅，　若子若孫長守貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"此星随處管吉凶，　惟有子孫不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"除却寅宫并午夘，　其餘長飬總成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541324322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫羅㬋最位強，　未必能歸子息鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"若在子宫真大貴，　有兒只是置田庄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋臨之皆下賤，犇馳茍得未為安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸生人多足嗣，　髙攀仙桂定為官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":801,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"防奴婢脱悮。○羅照平生因奴婢刑尅損命多迍邅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"事不宜小人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：天首加臨第六位，　心腹親人謹切防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453338931249189"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然足使奴無主，　欺𭰗偷盗被逃亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋難與善星交，　奴僕之宫逾怒號。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"假使尊嚴崇道徳，　反居陋巷自簞瓢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":817,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"男主損妾，女臨夫宫，一同○羅照，主惡曜之妻，中年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"方尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：羅㬋凶暗名天首，　不占髙強對宫守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"是惟一世有災迍，　孤寡難昏更麄醜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453358313013275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"天首和諧多美態，　湏教逺地始為婚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"不然帶祿𠔥連印，亦因官職有名聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人寅午為夫位，　第一不宜逄紫炁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"孛同羅㬋是福星，　合照夫榮并子貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":837,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"主偏廢風疾損四肢，多官災。○羅照，有險僻小疾，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"於胷脇下有痣，大吉，湏防登髙失墜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：天首羅㬋第八宫，　世間何事此真凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347491692563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒夜祿重重貴，　面也湏防有病攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄宫逄土與羅，　一生疾病十分多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒紫炁來相助，　争奈家豪常病磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":853,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"主攧撲，不宜朋友。羅孛對照，多招賊盗。○羅照不宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"道路出入，防有不良事損陷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷羅㬋凶曜號權星，　臨照遷移不畏人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"得在旺宫為祿主，　必因提薦貴榮身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362989613075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"如何破散又離鄉，　只為羅㬋到戌方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"戌是遷移羅孛到，漂流外縣置田庄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":869,"lineType":9,"content":"官祿宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"當官主有威權。日水同宫為台座，火土同主作盗。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"羅照合有主執，四方領袖，受相職位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷羅㬋元是貴權星，　四正居強最吉寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"限運逄之多吉慶，　更延夀筭祿千春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"天首羅㬋廟處尋，　得臨官祿是竒珍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453345948303412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"功著殺伐威聲振，　諫諍王庭動紫宸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"永主遭逄強又強，　天羅此處不相饒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄火土金交照，　半文半武志英豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":889,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"為人有權，不宜男女，同紫木金日、月更得地，少年榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。○羅照多因凶而吉，因災而福，主立身之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：天首羅㬋為福徳，　超羣出衆事乖張。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"合主瘟㾮𠔥盗賊，　財空貧賤少年亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541340706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"十一宫中天首臨，　凶星來照務荒滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"都縁暗曜無威徳，　故使逄人不仰欽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"為人似惡本非惡，　天首太陽相照着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿。若是衝太隂，　堂吏撫司𠔥重祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":909,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"為人美鬚髯貌黑○羅照，性多損失，言語不定，得人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"憎恠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：羅㬋天首臨相方，　别為隂徳觧其殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453358312980507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥忌曜縱横見，　若不相殘即繋梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":921,"lineType":9,"content":"羅㬋變叚星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫天玄星○又名天狼星，主貪盗亂世也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：天枵神首太玄星，　相呼集貴有佳聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"更在七宫逄吉曜，　還湏顕赫且髙陞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫天鬼星○又名天祿星，雄威鎮列九州聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：煞星天鬼號牛斗，　身命遷移浪蕩遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"假使強宫同吉曜，　也湏破蕩走他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453339283701769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫天威星○又名天印星，主印祿星貴也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷羅㬋寅位號天威，　掌握威權鎮四夷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"此是權星來入廟，　揚名何處不光輝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫武庫星，○又名天卒星，主卒亡惡死也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷武庫之星躔至卯，　主人心髙性情巧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"只忌日月此宫中，雖貴雙親湏早卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫地暗星，○又名天柄星，主權柄自為執事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天罡首宿為地暗，　夫婦鰥寡主惆悵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362989629459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"不然寄飬外人家，　父母資財無可望。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫地隔星，○又名天巨星，大富大祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷已上羅曜為地隔，　八煞宫中成水厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然吉曜與同流，　性格輕盈招盗賊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宫龍首星，○又名大權星，掌握貴權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷午上龍宫真可羡，　名至朝叅登玉殿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"馳名方面掌藩垣，　威鎮四夷能制亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"巨蟹宫暗金星，○又名天孽星，孽毒猖狂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855931971223595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷未上羅㬋號暗星，豈知凶禍苦來侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"身命犯之難得夀，輕則孤单鶴髪人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫天廢星，○又名妖毒星，主遭毒藥夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷申宫天廢是羅㬋，　禀性頑愚少智謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"更犯煞星同一位，　陣前戰士更無頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫祼形星○又名天章星，居官吉，謀利徒然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷祼形之曜在從魁，　女嫁男婚不用媒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"滛蕩無仁無禮節，棄妻傍妾小和諧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855931971239979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊宫都官星○又名九狐星，主狐媚妖邪事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷戌上都官獄吏神，　為人鯁直别尊𤰞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"土曜同臨并四正，　一生受祿有君恩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚宫天煞星，○又名暴卒星，主暴死亡，不得善終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷乾宫天煞是羅㬋，　怕至隂宫祿位休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"若被忌星相照破，　更加八煞死荒邱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"天尾計都星：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":9,"content":"計都論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"計都為天尾星配属土之精，豹尾黑道之宿也。擅行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453338931380261"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"於天，與羅㬋相對，逆行天道，喜則紅鸞天水星，怒則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"為黑煞貫索星，遇交於晦朔，圓望能掩日月之光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生人以為祿主星，　甲生人以為囚星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生人以為䕃星，　　丙生人以為刑星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生人以為正魁星，　戊生人以為印星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"已生人以為耗星，　　庚生人以為權星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生人以為暗星，　　癸生人以為催官福星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"此星廟在亥，旺在戌，樂在寅，好在未，喜卯已，怒在辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362666717193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"琅玕經云：計都廟旺最難逄，婁宿宫中祿更豐。躔栁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"在身知職貴，到寅生夜主名雄。榮華更在昴心宿，髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"旺湏同金木宫。十一位中尤好處，生來多事不成凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"○賦云：計都臨戌亥之位，官至左右僕射。洞㣲歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"計都之星喜戌亥，餘位之中不可逄。此星樂與木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"相㑹，可為貴品，威靈節操，文武兩全。歌云：天尾星辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹炁木，能觧災殃偏主福。只是孤尅。又云：計都之曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"不可聞，難為兄弟及兒孫，若得出家身最貴，總為學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541389858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"士兩三分。若䧟没與火土孛忌囚之星同宫，主下流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"凶殘夭折，刑法破害，少男少女少資財，多病多迍多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"口舌。若照身命宫，則主横死，或主身雕𤯝，六根不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：計都照身，值溺水𠔥於毒藥。又云：計都若臨獅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"子位，湏遭五法。又云：頻遭患難。暗曜入於月宫，若獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"行廟樂之宫照臨者，則大貴。六壬生人以水為天官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"正祿，與之同宫則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"計都性急好遊走，　夜旺二十四度。斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"土同炁月富貴全，　若非常流當獨守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔牛宿號天常，　丰采堂堂性格良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"更得善星同在度，　𡸁紳搢笏侍君王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"牛宿躔計廟，樂相并為人多福，温厚信誠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373274030107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"計都喜立在牛旁，　眉目分明性善良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"禮貌温㳟人急速，　官資卿監祖宗光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔女宿號天遷，　為福湏為土地官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"躔在度初大為貴，　遷官疾速定非難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"女計號金鑾，　　　金鑾福最難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"計都偏動女人心，　亦主奸邪亦主滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"暗時是非迷酒色，　何湏分度再逄金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453346493497379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔虚宿號天流，　父母湏逄骨肉仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"若見孛星同㑹死，　定知處處夜行偷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"虚喜計土為廟樂宫，惡星若入争雄反凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"若論虚中逄着計，值此星人多作贅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"不為僧流却無家，　亦主俗人相牽制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔危宿號天游，　衣食艱辛事事憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"尅子損妻身破散，　平生孤苦未應休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"危計到老無末福，　妻兒孤尅更無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347491725331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"計都奸濫上危門，　金水相同亂若紛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"男在妻宫男淫女，　女守夫宫女必犇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：天尾虚危偏福厚，　保安皇祚不傾危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔室宿號天真，　性烈官𤰞位不清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"若得水星來救助，　為官七品至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"室號天堂，計福異常，若為廟地，惡不相妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"計都室宿號髙強，　大貴權星吉又昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"三合若逄竒曜照，　少年遷職佐君王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362666700809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔璧宿號天魚，　四度之間十度居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"正廟之中官極貴，　十年之內位金吾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"璧星此地號天衢，　計都躔此福偏殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"祿主祿元同度內，　少年衣祿佩金魚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"計都本是到雙魚，　正廟之中璧水㺄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"四度以前至十度，　身當極貴宰臣居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔奎宿號天雄，　水月逄之官必榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄火土凶星照，　亂世英雄不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362989744147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"奎星在戌，計居多憂。到此不輔，沉埋悲愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"計都若守在奎中，　五度生人主智雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"不論隂陽并晝夜，　貴星亦要吉星同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格云：計都若臨奎宿度，掃净妖孽定封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔婁宿號天垣，　旺廟之中定主權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"體貌堂堂威望重，　將相論功二十年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"婁躔計，月朦朧。　若土同入不夭終凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"尾宿亦喜白羊宫，　婁宿逄之亦貴重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347256893481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"才智過人身烜赫，　夜生方得祿豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔胃宿號天刑，　日生更逄火來并。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"若不雕青文被面，　定湏犯法必為兵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"胃戌酉，　計為廟，　只要在　初度照。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"神尾行來西沒宫，　胃土雉中不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"十度以前尤可怕，　尅妻害子見重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373274062875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"計都躔鬼有風癆，斬指屠兒傷害多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨男女并田宅，晝生離散奈愁何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔栁宿號天災，命裏逄之大見乖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉分離財破散，　父南子北不和諧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是栁星在午宫，　十三度裏不宜逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"更有土星并木曜，　若來同度最為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"計都栁土度中居，　尅陷妻兒萬事虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生偏喜月榮貴，離倫絶類自超殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362989760531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔星宿號天鞍，　命若逄之有祿官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"庶俗若逄文秀士，　凶星如見刄傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"星逄計宿此來遊，　星火明而計必愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"星火凶星嫌晦曜，　一生不吉只多憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"計都星上日休同，　晝夜生人不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"此是蝕神傷犯分，　目不盲時耳也聾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔張宿號天狐，　妻子身邊一箇無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病耳聾并眼疾，　貧窮困苦莫嗟吁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347256909865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"張不喜計，必主迍邅。月不依土，主難還鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"天尾來臨張月鹿，毒害奸貪情性酷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"日生弱地不為宜，　夜見強宫未為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔翼宿號天蛇，　性毒心凶身剌花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥惡事重重見，　不然心亂好滛邪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有翼星不喜計，翼火蛇行計自通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇有尾𠔃能履地，　初生三度却無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"計都晝見翼宫傍，破祖湏宜兩父娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453326541406242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"勞心勞力身無暇，　為人性氣亦猖狂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"計躔軫宿號天強，　官職湏教訓練塲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"節度兵刑湏大位，　才猷奮迅佐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"軫宿計妙最髙位，　却喜計都來相纒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"若是福財𠔥祿主，　髙強入廟兩争先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"計都在天為暗曜，　軫水一度為正樂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"眉踈目秀委權尊，雄鋭英才多有効。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":537,"lineType":9,"content":"計都行度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362666848265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"天尾，在隂宫雙魚軫十三度十度以前至四度值之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"者，官位清髙，合居廊廟，掌國家兵戈財帛錢榖出納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"之權。如在髙位，四十前發。如在低位，晚旺十年，性不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"利父母兄弟。若在軫璧三度，居東出西没，官為三公，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"職封王侯，福祿及子孫也。陽宫白羊亦在貴位，旺十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"八年，仍湏在四正宫。若在諸位，見木日即吉，在下是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"火土為亂，是英雄必不善終。若在東出西没，主尅妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"前尅凶妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362666815497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":559,"lineType":9,"content":"計都入宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"日宫，主為人重厚，作事超羣，入位淺。諸星在有力位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"上，其人大貴。三方主在稍髙位者，多因賊害成事，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"貴逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"月宫主有心機，作事明敏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"木宫主性聰慧，更作強宫主貴，晝生轉加福力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫，主為人性急，好行凶惡事，一生多被人暗損，陷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"在心宿，其人有殺伐之權，不居此宿，㣲有職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362666799113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"土宫，主為性拘執，作事能審是非，得暗昧財成富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"金宫，主為人好争鬬，多口舌，因婦人致厄難，得善星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"救之可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫，主有少年多災，善星救之可免，晚年有祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":585,"lineType":9,"content":"琅玕經節要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"計乃好勝貪求之星，惟宜夜照，福祿贏餘。紫木炁同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"清俊顯任，旺廟陞遷，祿財榮盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"計都與紫木二星同居旺樂，不分晝夜，皆主顯官清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453346493612067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"俊之任，財帛豐盈，子孫榮旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"水計相逄，成敗重重，為性不定，共處難同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"水同計都，多奸猾，好訟便私，不可同交友，共立事亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"多成敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"金孛同行，夜照權名，晝人多難，險難招刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"或見金同，或與孛同。夜人居旺，主武職貴顯，若科名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"髙，亦主文科顯祿之人。晝逄則主犯刑招險，不忠良","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362989907987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"計都同土，晝益財利，夜生對照，經營迍滯。計同日月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"父母多别，主背身低，貧窮下劣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"計同日月，多刑尅，損頭目，促夀傷父母，成敗多更。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"主星不照，即窮苦下賤之人，為性不常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"火計夜照，宜居廟旺，生殺威權，兵符可詔。忽若逄晝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"變為凶曜，福臨救之，蠲災免害。獨宫夜照，權要自大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"計都臨照十二宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":627,"lineType":9,"content":"命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347257024553"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"守照命宫主頭圎眼急，貌稜心麄，眉小耳大，形瘦武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"勇身多毛，聲音焦烈，先痩後肥，性急不耐觸，心髙性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"烈，喜鬬貪求，每慳小棄大，執事不囬，為謀奸猾，千方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"百計，髙談闊論，頭妻有子，小得全成，主旺髙強，財祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"榮發，與善星扶合，在廟宫為祿主，可為貴品，威聲節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"操，文武兩全，守照命宫，居官清顯榮逹，職位彌髙，白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"日見之，災憂一世。經云：計都臨命照，性暴逞才能，背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"祖身孤立，依髙附勢行。初年災禍重，晚歲福宜生。夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453345948450868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"逄孤位照，家門財業成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷計都暗曜最凶星，　金水加臨名望振。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"何故有官不赴任，　只為計都入天秤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"計都守命衆星扶，初限元來懶讀書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"才氣無雙真可許，將軍湏到佩金魚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"計都在命孛相尋，　女破家風必好滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"但有善星相照着，侯門歌舞遇知音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"天尾之星人牢名，　呼為天上一提刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453361932681216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸壬庚并入廟，　前程必定可相成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":669,"lineType":9,"content":"財帛宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"取財如縁木求魚，水中逐鹿，近大財，使大財，随得随","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"失，初年成敗，中末主却旺。○計照財帛無成立，見財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"湏有惡事破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天尾加臨第二鄉，　勞心只為置田庄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"莫教土孛同來位，　翻令手足播馨香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"第二宫中犯計都，　一生財帛總成虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347491790867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"更有栁星同一位，　若不貪婪定主無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷兄弟宫中有計都，參商義薄有嗟呼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒四海皆同氣，　各自營謀各自居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"最是巳亥逄羅計，羅主尅兄計損弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"男犯羅孛女計都，男尅妻兒女尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
