{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"主父先亡，不受祖䕃，一世茫茫，自立家計。有吉星照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"者，只得二分田宅。有炁來傍照，則不以此論。○計照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"一生不招田産，及因子孫營立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷強宫之上計羅侵，　福祿消亡禍日深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"祖業到頭都不守，　虚勞計較沒身心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":715,"lineType":9,"content":"男女宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"男女希少，若見早則全尅，宜晚年，則主一子。縱有子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376302366759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"多，所謂貧家骨肉，不相和睦，不然亦主是少。在壁宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴，有福力。○計照合偏子大吉，宜求外姓親生，全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"不得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷計都或居五宫中，子息生來一箇無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"若問隂人湏寡婦，如推男子即鰥夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"第五宫中遇計都，　男兒箇箇要樗蒲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅戊申并酉上，　娶得妻來盡尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":735,"lineType":9,"content":"奴僕宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376302317607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"常被奴僕脱悮，及防小人欺詐。○計照平生不可乗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"騎，有墜跌之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：計都有妾便為妻，　失財連併及災危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"下陵上僣不安分，　湏教厄難馬前衰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"弱宫之內計都侵，　不見為凶百禍臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使機關多智慮，虚勞半世没身心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":751,"lineType":9,"content":"妻妾宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"臨妻主亂。經云：計都紅鸞星，一名號天尾。一妻不到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453347491807251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"頭，二妻不到尾。若娶第三妻，亦恐無終始。又云：三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"年前不問妻，三十年後不問兒。縱有還湏生死别，黄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"金也亦化為泥。若妻有惡星相抵，則無害。又云：計都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"第七位，賤女聘為妻。不賤湏重嫁，他時不可知。主以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"賤女為妻，年髙可免尅凶星産厄，脚手有疾。○計照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"主妻自刑惡横死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：計都暗曜莫相逄，　何况加臨對命宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"舉止乖張饒害尅，　定知造物不相容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377069875200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":775,"lineType":9,"content":"疾厄宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"土水疾多突壓身危，又云主氣疾手足刑破。孛同瘖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"瘂盲聾，金同雕青痕疾。○計照，主十相不具，或行歩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"搬移，有天災之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷次弱之宫名疾厄，　計羅守此多刑責。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄吉曜更加臨，　無病却為衣食廹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"計都一曜最凶宿，　威燄炎炎是窘廹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"得臨疾厄第八宫，　貴賤逄之湏病足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453362666831881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":793,"lineType":9,"content":"遷移宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜逺出，守祖業則安。若為官遇他州，亦主有權，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"忌水火災厄，不宜兄弟朋友，小人為刼奪之患。○計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"照招方外卒暴，不利改動作事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷計都天尾照遷移，　利害之端仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"出外迎祥因廟旺，　不然平照定傾危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移排在近弱宫，　第一凶星不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"偃蹇勒停𠔥破祖，　方知計孛在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376302333991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":811,"lineType":9,"content":"官祿宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"食祿遲晚，四十以後方顯逹，常人得之，主遭無頭公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"事。官刑，主有血光之災。初主不好，中末主方好，君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，小人犯刑殺死。又名剥官煞，居官進職及足有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"○計照不可與他人作保識，多被别人事犯重罪之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷計都之宿最凶殘，　官祿逄之利害間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"若在廟方湏貴重，　廷諍天陛逆天顔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453361932697600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計臨時必主凶，　不然身計係於公，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"若被孛星同守照，　徒流身寄異鄉中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"五星併位居官祿，　生處英豪多五榖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄太乙來照破，　上官赴任定不祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":837,"lineType":9,"content":"福徳宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"多主反覆，纔有好事，反成凶兆，亦主多計姦巧，夀短","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"刑破。○計照不可與下等人交往，多惹是非，與小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"同謀，損陷身事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376302415911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天之首尾臨福徳，　平生凶事反為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"坦然不忍妄加人，　患難尤能拯危急。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"天尾計都來到巳，　入廟之宫當巨富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"只愁土孛更同行，　南北遷移無處住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":855,"lineType":9,"content":"相貌宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"形神醜惡，面貌古恠，骨大肉小，顔色多惡少善，貴而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"有權，亦主暗疾貪花，不然以婢為小妾。○計照性多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"損失，言語不定，得人憎恠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376302350375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷計都在後命在前，陷溺之宫豈作權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"假使貴榮當顯要，　亦湏體貌不完全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"缺唇生瘦并夭刑，　十二宫中三箇星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌未方為福徳，却遭首尾孛同行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":873,"lineType":9,"content":"計都變叚星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"寳瓶宫黑道星，○又名悲怨星，主哀怨悲傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：欲知黑道在何宫，　子位計都不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"八煞命宫遭毒藥，　可憐短命䘮兒郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453358313193499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"磨蝎宫伏殃星，○又名孤尅星，恓惶尅害六親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：計都為惡伏殃星，　丑上逄之最不仁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"作事隂謀凶且狠，　土人得此不為迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬宫悖逆星，○又名卒中星，暴卒惡毒呪咀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：計都不入三陽宫，　人馬宫逄悖逆星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅宫逄人不義，　更加三五轉無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"天蝎宫祿昌星，○又名天疾星，腰駝脚跛刑害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：計都却喜卯中藏，　四正宫中號祿昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453361932730368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"兄友弟恭仁又義，家風榮盛性温良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤宫天嗔星，○又名刑吊星，䘮吊臨身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷：神尾逆行大不順，　若居辰上號天嗔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"一生為人心路險，　切忌雷傷虎豹驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女宫六陽星，○又名虎印星，主虎貔印祿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷太乙宫中喜計都，處身廊廟得安居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"君寵臣𠔃臣盡節，揚名鴈塞到中書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"獅子宮枉亡星，○又名哭泣星，主憂煎哭泣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453378378530879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷枉亡星宿在於離，神尾居之大不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"魄散酆都年不永，　更憂狼籍損妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"巨獬宫白衣星，○又名天孛星，主刑獄禁繋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷未上白衣事不堪，　隂宫凶吉兩相叅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"強宫吉曜同為福，　第七宫中妻見三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽宫地纛星，○又名天妬星，隂謀妬害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷隂陽神尾為地纛，　此位逄之不為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"身命四七十宫逄，　男女同臨受孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453378378514495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"金牛宫天蝕星，○又名䘮厄星，䘮吊哭泣臨門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷酉中日月怕同臨，　妻妾宫逄有異心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"更犯太隂娘早尅，　太陽父位少光隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊宫天符星，○又名天正星，得權祿馬之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷天符河魁神尾喜，雖逄惡曜即為災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"四正七強俱發福，　不求名利自然來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚宫六喜星，○又名天遊星，主遊冶孤虚之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"詩斷計都休作凶神位，　躔至雙女六喜神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453346493628451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"文章筆下龍蛇走，　却作驚天動地人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l0eus/1-SK1609_figure_00039.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Vzmfe1YEbp2ouXzqMfAjZxnUTnQ%3D","pictureHeight":308,"pictureWidth":321,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l0eus/1-SK1609_figure_00039.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9RK6A0Qjpv%2F6Axjri06gHto3KOA%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l0eus/1-SK1609_figure_00039.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"總龜一書，集諸家而總𩔖之，大半與三辰通載相似，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"是為通載所採摭也，今不復録。惟草堂丁無咎續集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"一篇，考厯象之性情，體禽類之𠮓化，摘星辰之善惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"類聚成格，非深達天文、洞究造化者，必不能作。余為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493614629"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"考訂，以廣其傳。草堂博洽多聞，學有源委，星命乃其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"一端云。易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":9,"content":"總龜條議","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"按金雞呈瑞條解言堯厯仲春日躔于昴，青龍用事條言紹興戊辰歳星在秦州，於厯算俱不相合。今以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"歳差考之，每年差一分五十秒，七十年差一度餘。堯厯立春日在箕四度，于今有三千五百年，差得五十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":2,"content":"度。今授時厯孟春日在虛一，無不知合，則堯時仲春日在午初度明矣。今曰堯厯仲春日在昴㝛，不知如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"何算也。歳星厯算，大約夘年俱從夘起，逆算十二辰而一周天，故謂之歳。以今厯考之，雖留逆不同，然亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":2,"content":"只差來徃一宫耳。今曰戊辰歳星在秦州，則差七宫，亦不知如何算也。意者古今厯算有不同歟？至如合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559390248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"璧以三合為説，華蓋以十二星配太隂所行，恐或非也。書此以俟後之知者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"夫日月五星皆㑹一次，日月則若璧合，五星則若珠連，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"進退皆無盈縮之患。惟㑹丑者九世一遇，㑹他次者，間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"世一遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：太初丁丑歳為頭，七政相逢㑹斗牛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493680165"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"誰識當年差五日，連珠合璧詎相侔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":9,"content":"日月合璧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽太隂同宫，或對照，或三合照是也。然須廟旺方為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"日有中道，月有九行。中道者，黄道也。九行者，青道二，出黄道東；赤道二，出黄道南；白道二，出黄道西；黑道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"二，出黄道北。分主八節，合乎四正四維。按隂陽中終之所交，則日行正當黄道八行，與巾道而九。乾坤定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"位，則八位各得其正。及其寒暑相推，晦朔相易，則在南者𠮓而居北，東者徙而為西。日行與歳運皆遷，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"行隨交限而𠮓。日出入赤道二十四度，月出入黄道六度。故交於子正，則晦日之朝，猶朔日之夕也，是日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453380467507210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"月皆不見。若合於午正，則晦日之晨，猶朔日之昏也，是以月日皆見。蓋其如合璧，當視子午正交，則人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":2,"content":"在其中，可論其强弱。且如昔紹興甲寅十一月朔夜半，日在斗一度，而月在斗四度，則是月於晦日之夕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"已交於子正也。又如在嘉定辛未正月朔日，已於十二月二十八日過子宫，至朔日，日在女六度，月離猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"在牛二度，是其交於午正後方過子。彼或者不知合璧，則見正月一日夘時便作合宫，得日月合璧亦惑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。况朔望交虧，而人命在其中者，豈能無害？如辛未四月朔日望日生，命在合璧對照宫是也。歌云：日居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"月諸是何如，日月流行有疾徐。誰知子午分交處，最愛生逢合璧如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":9,"content":"五星連珠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"五星不必同宫，只得順布五位，相續而不斷者，亦是虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453380467474442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"拱一位，而命居其中者，亦是拱日門，則是五星連珠拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"地户，則是五星拱太微，拱紫微，所謂坐實不如拱虛，對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"照不如正照者是也。或順乎兩位而拱亦妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"五星運行，各有次舍，及其相聚，却為難得，若得連珠尤妙。淳熈十三年丙午閏七月，五星同在雙女宫，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢此，已為竒特。　　又如乾道四年戊子丑月生，水在申，金在酉，火在戌，木在亥，土在丑，是為連珠。此年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"際㑹風雲，名位顯著者不少。歌云：五星次舍不同行，相㑹連珠亦吉亨。人命當生遭此㑹，不為宰相亦公𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":9,"content":"牛斗秀氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁十一曜之最尊，清而貴，文而美者也。丑位有斗牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373274308635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"二宿，乃二十八㝛之始。金陵之氣盛於東南，龍泉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"劒名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"神，光於牛斗。若紫炁一星對照，正照丑上，安命特為竒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"異。東南吳越，乃丑分也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":115,"lineType":2,"content":"日月五星初躔皆自星紀，故名星紀者，斗建之間也。十一月陽生於雲漢，漸退降及艮維，始下按於地，至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"斗建間，復於列舍之氣通於易，天地始交，泰之象也。雲漢下流，百川歸焉。火土二星雖為忌曜，至丑相逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"返為福星。獨歳星在此宫，閩人得之，為福尤重。春秋昭公三十二年夏，吳伐越，史墨曰：越得歳而吳伐之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"必受其凶。是時歳星與日合於南斗三度，後三十八年而越滅吳，歳星及斗牛矣。茍人命得曰木合於星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"紀者，無不獲福，故曰斗牛秀氣。易傳亦云：日月五星，起於牽牛，此説信矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377070104576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":127,"lineType":9,"content":"文章秘府","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"日、月、木、金、水，紫羅三合，對照亥宫，安命是也。亥有木星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"主圖書，乃文章秘府之星也。主為人才學富足，識見超","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"卓，福氣亦厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"十月隂氣進踰乾維，始上達乎天，雲漢至營室東壁間，升氣悉究，自王良閣道，由紫垣絶漢抵營室，上帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"之離宫也。故金、水木、日、月、計同在此宫，則有文章秘府之象，以其近帝宫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":139,"lineType":9,"content":"五星朝斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"五星㑹於雙魚，則有𡖖相之象。若一星二星居於前後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398803007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"者，亦是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"日月木金水五星同居雙魚宫是也。蓋亥為天門，乃上帝之離宫，衆星聚此以拱北辰，是五星朝斗之宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"也。夫斗星，北斗也，七星𤨔衛紫微者是也。其下有三台星、文昌星、尚書四輔、上相等星，五星若朝于此，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"人有𡖖相之榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":153,"lineType":9,"content":"孛居東井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"孛居未上，夜生人未上，安命是也。貴而有權之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"古者太平之世，日不蝕，星不孛，則孛者常順於天，隱而不見。惟怒則為彗星，一見則衆星失色。此星性猛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"機𠮓威權，常好居黄道正位，故在東井則為吉星，故曰孛居東井。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453380467458058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":163,"lineType":9,"content":"首攜龍角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"角亢二宿，為蒼龍之角也。羅㬋建首，乃天之神。首居辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"之位，乃如龍之有首，而角亢二宿，左右扶之，似為之角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。命居辰上而得羅㬋，主為人英武榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"羅㬋，天首之星也，屬火之氣，又為天權天統之星。其星廟於辰，樂於寅，喜於夘，乃龍尾伏辰故也。又旺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"午位，蓋其與日月交，則能蝕日月之光，如覇者之擅權也，故曰首攜龍角。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":175,"lineType":9,"content":"計居龍尾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"尾㝛四星，為蒼龍之尾宿也。計都星乃天之神，尾入寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376302628903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"之位，乃如龍之有尾，而尾之四星，又有輔翼，則為真龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。凢此二格，皆主權高職重。人命在寅而見計都，乃計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"居龍尾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"羅計二星若望而止於黄道，是謂臣壅君明，則陽為之蝕矣。故日者陽也，在陽則不蝕。羅計居陽則為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"𠮓而入隂則為凶。且一日有十二辰，自寅至午為陽，自未至亥為隂，故羅在寅、夘、辰、午則為吉星，計居龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"尾、鶉尾亦為吉㝛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":193,"lineType":9,"content":"大人虎𠮓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"西方參有九星，五星貫其中，四星𤨔其外，如首如尾，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493663781"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"足如手，有白虎之象。而金之一星，則為西方白虎之秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，如秋生於寅申，或在寅申上安命，謂之大人虎𠮓，酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"上尤妙，又謂之白虎當權，無不貴顯者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"酉雖在金旺之鄉，而有畢月烏之次舍焉，故金月同居則為吉也。茍人命安於此宫，得金月以相扶，必能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"改𠮓，故曰大人虎𠮓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":209,"lineType":9,"content":"老人星現","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"南極下生一星為老人星，在辰上亦謂之夀星。或金星、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"土星為夀元，居於辰，日月居於其上，皆謂之老人星現，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453380467441674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"主夀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"陽氣曰明堂，建於龍角曰夀星，龍角謂之天闗。在易以陽决隂，夬象也。然夬之象，乾居下，兊居上。夫以乾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"居下而夬兊隂，豈得為夀星？蓋乾金也，兊亦金也，與金同氣，故謂金樂鄉。是知土生金，而金與土同氣。茍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"人坐命在辰，而得金土佐臨，尤為重厚，福夀必獲兩全也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":225,"lineType":9,"content":"隂陽𩔖聚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽同居一處，合為廟旺，得同𩔖之吉星照身命者是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"易曰：水流濕，火就燥，亦各從其𩔖也。凢人命在午而得日火同宫，身在未而得金水同宫，無不發迹。蓋以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377070186496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"陽從陽，以陰聚陰，其氣味之相投故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":237,"lineType":9,"content":"衆星拱北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子曰：北辰居其所，而衆星拱之。蓋天之星運轉不窮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"而北辰一星不易其位。北辰所居，乃天之北極子位是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"也。十一曜環居衆位，而虚拱一子，却去子上安命是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"日、水、計、木、金月六星居亥，又得火土紫氣星居丑，以拱子一位，或環而拱之，散居諸位，虚拱一子，從而安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"命亦是也。此皆至貴之命，如鄒太叅貴命星辰，正按此局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":249,"lineType":9,"content":"豶豕之牙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396908933174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"奎星本天之武庫，亦為封豕之星，為性猛烈。人命若亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"生，或亥月亥時，或亥命得木星順行者，權貴之局。况亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"上室、璧二星，室為火猪，璧為水㺄，皆象豕之𩔖。茍木星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行，却為害不淺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"日、月、金、計、水、木，皆以娵訾為旺樂之宫，亥上是也。大抵皆從歳星。春秋傳曰：有星出于婺女，子上是也。禆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":263,"lineType":2,"content":"竈曰：今茲歳在顓帝之墟，其明年進及營室，復行豕韋之次，亥上是也。景王問萇弘曰：今茲諸侯何實吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"何實凶？對曰：蔡凶。此蔡侯般弑其君之歳也。夫豕韋之次，蔡分野也。木逆於此而蔡凶，則知木樂於亥而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"不可逆行也。惟其逆行于亥子之間，一吉一凶，此景王所以問萇弘也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373274292251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":271,"lineType":9,"content":"旄頭直事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋乃天之神首，酉上有昴㝛九，天之旄頭煞是也。安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"命在酉而遇羅㬋，加以一二惡星，為禍最惨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":277,"lineType":2,"content":"昴、畢二宿雖次大梁，而其分野則在常山之地，東南外接旄頭地，皆河外陰國也。茍日生人、火，計臨此，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"坐命在此，皆主不吉，故曰旄頭直事。蓋此煞乃外夷凶星也，人命值之，若不惡終必主逺配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":281,"lineType":9,"content":"大火當權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"古者閼伯居於商丘，後世配食於火星，或食於心，乃夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"上星㝛也。或食於星，乃午上小星也。故夘為大火，午為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453361932926976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"鶉火。季秋之後，天月建在邜，須是夜生於邜，午上安命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。其發最驟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"日月火星在戌，安命亦在戌，乃大火當權。蓋大火至戌而納火，火庫在戌，而火星宫主亦在戌，此所以謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"之當權也。須是夜生，方合此格。日生者非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":297,"lineType":9,"content":"限主當權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"衆星聚在一處，一限星居其中，其衆星各以𩔖聚來拱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"不然則忌星作限主，而衆善星拱之尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"竹羅限垣局厰云：凢立功名主重權，須要當生限入垣，正入三用居木位，㑹位臨限福仍𠔥。火為天帝居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559357480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"天蝎，土是太常守磨蝎，金星天秤亦太常榮顯，水星在南方，此乃限主當權之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":309,"lineType":9,"content":"太微受制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"火星常以十月入太微，受五帝之制命，行司賞罰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"太㣲者，南方朱雀權衡為三光之庭，北運斗星以臨制四方，運四時而均五行者也。故太陽居午，太隂居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"未，為樂宫，以其日月循黄道而行，入赤道内，而受制於太㣲也。茍人命得同日月，坐此樂宫，與木水相會，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"無印星入者，無不貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":319,"lineType":9,"content":"長庚入命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"東有啓明，乃水星之象。西有長庚，乃太白之象。昔李太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493631013"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"白母夢長庚星入懷，蓋月乃母道也，身之所從出也。夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"生金月同在酉，乃合此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"李太白母夢長庚入懐，已而有娠。及生太白，詩才冠天下。則知長庚入夢，必主産不世之竒才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":331,"lineType":9,"content":"神羊觸邪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"未上巨獬之分野。獬乃神羊之獸，遇惡則觸。古者帝王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"置之殿庭，以警不忠。如未生人，又在未上安命，純得凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"星者為貴。若不背日月而安命，在戌上白羊之位，亦是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙居紫㣲東，纒赤道内，警凶惡而斬姦邪，進良善而佑忠直。蓋遇善星則為善，遇惡星則為惡。愛巨獬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909015094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"之宮，謂之金羊，若見邪穢，無不擊觸。凡人命在未宫而得孛星入者，皆秉性忠直，靣刺人過，内無隠情，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"號神羊觸邪。凡乙人得孛與木金同在未宫者，官可至御史三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":347,"lineType":9,"content":"雙女爭權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"金火計月土星在雙女宮，主淫慾，或偏異生也。在易離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"上兊下為暌，兊上離下為革。聖人於暌卦則曰：二女同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"居，其志不同行。於革卦則曰：二女同居，其志不相得。夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"離火也，已亦火也。火能生土而尅金，今也金却生在已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"而土則䧟於已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"言金而及土者，以其泄火生金，故金與火争。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"兊屬金也，金能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396908949558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"生水而怕火尅也。今也木却敗放於酉，而火䧟於兊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"言火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"而及木者，以其木火俱敗䧟西方，故火與金閗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂爭權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":365,"lineType":9,"content":"日出扶桑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"夘為日門，乃晹谷扶桑之地，坐於邜，無惡曜對照，而在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"夘上安命者，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":371,"lineType":2,"content":"夘固為日門，而夏至日常自扶桑水府而出，故旦朝猶在於寅，若人命只得木日同在寅宫，而在寅宫安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"命，亦為貴格，其為在夘則同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":375,"lineType":9,"content":"箕星好風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453380467490826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"李尋云：日將出，清風發，羣隂皆伏，是日出則生風，日入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"則無風。日在丑，寅朝生，主有聲名，更有惡星，則未免却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"主淫蕩。月纒箕宿，亦主生風，反為不利。惟日在寅，命在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，無凶星者為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"風之從虎，以類應也。寅既為虎，風日從之，但宫有尾、箕、斗三㝛，而特有箕星好風者，蓋尾度更屬邜，斗度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"已屬丑，惟箕則得其正寅，故云箕星好風也。人命得與歳星同此宫者，皆為吉命，况寅為木，木又生風，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢之，安得不譽高望重哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":393,"lineType":9,"content":"畢星好雨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559373864"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：月離于畢，俾滂沱矣。書云：星有好風，星有好雨。太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"隂躔畢度而在酉上安命是也。若七八月之間正旱而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"沛然甘霖以澤萬民，更逢水星，雖辰上安命亦妙。儻在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"叄肆月生，乃水潦漲溢之時，則止為飄蕩之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"日月之行，則以風雨。釋洪範者以為不吉之兆，不知月之從星，從其所好，畢雨則有育物之功，豈得為不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":407,"lineType":2,"content":"吉之兆乎？如人命安身在畢，無凶星惡宿入者，皆能育物濟時，皆為有福之命。若凶曜入者，則不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":409,"lineType":9,"content":"大月當斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"韓昌黎云：愈生之辰月宿斗。東坡亦身在磨蝎宫，故知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493647397"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"月宿於斗，最出文人才子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":417,"lineType":2,"content":"詩云：惟北有斗，不可挹酒漿。主招口舌興讒謗也。二君子未免，故曰：君子為仕多折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":419,"lineType":9,"content":"青龍用事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"春生人見木星在寅夘，安命，乃青龍用事。夏生見火星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"在已午，安命，乃朱雀當權。秋生見金星在申酉，安命，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎當權。冬生見水星在亥子，安命，乃玄武當權。四季","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"生人，見土星在辰戌丑未，安命，乃勾陳得位。已上數者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"須是不背日月書夜者妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453361932943360"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":433,"lineType":2,"content":"木為青龍，其名為用事者，最愛順行而無退逆之患也。　紹興戊辰生人，其年歳星在秦州，人皆以為木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"入秦州，必有特達掀轟者。及視其年生人，非徒無甚顯達，又且成敗棲遲，每每皆是。若以百中經觀之，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"年五月木星在未，何為無顯達之人？及以統元經細算，其年歳星自丁夘八月過未，十月退，戊辰四月又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"至未，閏九月過午，十二月又退未，此與逆於玄枵者何異焉？此其無顯達之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":441,"lineType":9,"content":"星𤨔帝座","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽，帝之象也。日之所居在子午皆為帝座，吉星左右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"環拱者最佳。但人之生時亦為帝座，若吉星三合對照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"𤨔拱於時者，亦合此格，其貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377070088192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":451,"lineType":2,"content":"假如淳熈十三年丙午歳閏七月十六日已時生，其時諸星皆𤨔帝座，身命三合，又無空宫，實為難得，豈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"不為大貴人？况四元三限，時命二星，所謂九事者，又為滿用。洞微九事歌云：九事全而順五行，必然享福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"得遐齡。九事若離福不至，萬般智慮一無成。欲知九事本原例，四元三限時命至。乃正得此格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":457,"lineType":9,"content":"左右𤨔拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"凢人命宫，若得五星左右環拱，無有不顯達者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"假如坐命在璧五度，木星在壁一度，則為左青龍；金星居璧九度，則為右白虎；火星在奎一度，則為前朱雀；水星居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"室十六度，則為後𤣥武，真為左右𤨔拱。然亦不必如此之近，但布於左右前後宫分者，亦為難得也。其榮貴者當然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"印夀雙全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377070120960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"在亥上安命，而得木、火、土星在命者為貴格。蓋亥屬木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"故木為天元印；木生火，故火為地元禄；火生土，故土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"人元夀，其餘安命倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"洞微經説禄、印、壽三元星須要居高强宫而無留逆者，乃是吉命，故歌云：三元訣法少人知，亥邜未宫木曜推。火地土人高處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"着，必居俸禄定無疑。不逢惡曜相刑尅，為官權貴有彰施。忽然留逆𠔥無氣，官灾多失更流移。印壽雙全之説，於是歌而可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":479,"lineType":9,"content":"金雞浮瑞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢配，十二時以酉為雞，而書生乃日之精，𨓜居陰位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"若日在命而於酉上安命者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559341096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"堯厯於仲春，則曰寅賓出日。蓋日者，陽也，陽春布澤之時，惟藉日之融和，故堯敬而賓之。仲春之日，堯厯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"躔昴。昴者，日雞也。昴屬金垣，乃為金雞。日至日中，幽隱無不臨照。况仲春是時，發育之恩，其功最大，故昴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"雞與太陽當仲春之時，日中同運，至中天而發土月萬物，此金雞呈瑞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":493,"lineType":9,"content":"金紫朝斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生人，太陰與紫炁居申位，命與金星居辰位，水與太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"陽居子位，乃金紫朝斗格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋日者，人君之象，居於子位。子乃北方之地，而身命夾金紫朝日，此乃清貴之格。切忌土孛羅㬋入命併傍照則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":501,"lineType":9,"content":"月扶斗杓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471019042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"凢月建所在，則是斗柄魁星之所指也。惟閏月斗柄斜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"指兩辰之間，若太陰在月建之位者，乃合此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"一年有十二月節候，斗杓隨月建而轉，至於閠月，則斗杓乃指於兩辰之間，潮候亦隨之而盈縮，則知天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"地陰陽消息盈虚，應如凖繩，無毫髮之差誤。蓋日月之行，與斗杓所指相為經緯，此乃三光全而寒暑平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"也。茍人生安命，身應在斗杓所指之辰，名為月扶斗杓。如正月生人，安身在寅；二月生人，安身在邜；三月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"生人，安命在辰，皆為此格，主榮華富貴。然太隂與吉星同宫則為吉，土孛羅計侵之，則又為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":517,"lineType":9,"content":"身居華蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"五行以馬前二辰為華蓋，此謂太隂居華蓋是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453361932910592"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋以月居辰戌丑未為吉，然月居未為樂宫，戌為喜宫，若在辰丑，似無意義。要知華蓋者，乃北極天皇所居擁衛之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"星也。其星有十二星居中，又有六星庇於左右如蓋，故曰華蓋。太陰循黄道而行，未嘗居於華蓋。此言身居華蓋者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋人生負陰抱陽，故以時加太陽，循東而出，遇夘而坐命也，此乃抱陽也。又以太陰安身，亦如權衡之象，乃比華蓋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"然太陰一日行十三度三十七分，如華蓋之有十二星，又有六星之義也。故古人先論坐命，次論安身，亦以此也。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"如只論坐命，而人命在三日内生而同時者，必同一宫坐命，而太陰三日之内已行四十度，則人之安身異日而異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"宫也。古人之重三日宫者，蓋此也。故聿斯經云即都例經也。又見生後三日宫，月到何星分度中。金水相逢極為美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"文學聰明須見水。更得善星在宫主，宫主復在高强位。此為有福無難人，一生謀運皆如意。人云：忽然三日水金加，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"人間喜美事奢華。世上文章須水照，善星為主福無涯。故身居華蓋者，非獨清貴，又且一世無非横之灾禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471068194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":541,"lineType":9,"content":"坐禄帶轝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"禄前馬前，命前三辰位，名曰金轝。禄主星居於金轝，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"土星入局者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"五行惟土於物其功最多，古人論之詳矣。然十二支為馬者有四，為禄者有八，皆屬金木、水、火，而辰戌丑、未宫獨無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"禄馬，則是土無功於物矣。不知土之為物，無時不遇，常居中以統四方。故人命之帶禄馬者，常愛見土為重厚。然則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"土之所以權輿於萬物者，其功最多矣。茍人命坐禄而得命主入土局，皆是吉命。假如柯監丞壬子八月二十七日亥時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"生，作九月算，壬禄在亥，亥屬水也。坐命坐申，為水禄廟宫，宫主飛起入於辰，是坐禄而入土局，此坐禄帶金轝之格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":555,"lineType":9,"content":"金星入斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392286810162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"兊卦用事，在秋分、寒露、霜降之節。若辛人安命在酉，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"生居秋月，金星入於丑位為貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦是坐禄帶轝格。假如辛人禄在酉，則是以金為禄。茍辛人安命在酉宫，而金星飛入丑位，亦是吉命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"故名金星入斗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":567,"lineType":9,"content":"箕翕其舌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"兊卦用事，寅上安命。若見金星水星入命，則主口舌。詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"云：惟南有箕，載翕其舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"不獨金水二星為然，火星亦然。入命坐人馬官，而遇火守箕，皆多招口吻，愛説是非，偏惹滛辭，酌斟人過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493712933"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"飾已之非，好爭閑氣，傲慢尊長，雖割其舌，猶不已也。謂之翕者，合也，合其舌亦好言也，丙人見此尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":579,"lineType":9,"content":"神水華池","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"水星居亥，子上是也。水星隨日至酉，酉上安命亦是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"西宫咸池則有觜星，東南則有大星曰狼，下有四星曰狐。此地有大星曰南極老人。老人若見，治安太平，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"兵革不起。夫水星本無定性，遇吉則為吉，遇凶則為凶，故常輔日而行，至五月時出於狼狐，而遇老人星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"則為吉。凢人命遇此者，無不長壽享福。所謂神水者，以水星逐吉星也。所謂華池者，以老人所居西宫咸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"池酉上，是為神水華池也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":591,"lineType":9,"content":"風生浪擊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471100962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"凢人生時，遇初八、二十三日午時生者，皆狡猾凶惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋初八、二十三日午時，乃月弦初生，而漸生於海，風生浪擊之謂也。然又當算月弦日，乃太陰所在，而知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"其善惡，如太隂遇吉星，則為人威權有膽氣，如太隂遇惡星，則為人凶惡徒配之命。若無星同照者，則主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"困弱，乃風生浪擊而不寜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":603,"lineType":9,"content":"禄馬同鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"禄元星與馬元星照命者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"命書云：馬元為貴，禄為禄人元干配的無疑。壽元惟向納音取，要照强宫與限隨。凢人命最愛禄馬二元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"同在强宫以照命，未有不為顯仕者。若不照命，但得禄馬二元助限，亦能發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471051810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":613,"lineType":9,"content":"虎踞龍盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"木星乃東方之蒼龍，金星乃西方之白虎，金在命木正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"照夜生人得之乃龍盤虎踞。金木同居於命，又為龍虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"交馳，更在辰寅二宫坐命者尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"命宫居於子午，木星在邜，金星在酉，木正得之，正合此格。蓋木為青龍在東方，金為白虎在西方，又在前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"四宫與後四宫拱照，豈但二宫坐命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":625,"lineType":9,"content":"離坎交㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"水星禀北方坎宫之氣，火星禀南方離宫之氣。夜生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909047862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"火星在命，水星正照，乃合此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"此最主為人氣槩精神，能剸裁繁劇，禄位優厚。若水火二星同守命宫，則是為煎獒星矣，返主灾禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":635,"lineType":9,"content":"陰陽交輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"日為陽君，月為陰后。若與吉星夾照命宫者，此格也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜與日月同宫，則非惟不能為福，而且生禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":641,"lineType":9,"content":"三光𤨔微","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"日在相貌宫，月在遷移，夾拱已午二位，名三光𤨔微，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"已午全無星亦妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471084578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"三光全，寒暑平。註云：三光乃日月五星也。太㣲垣居已午，若日月身命在午，而五星𤨔拱之，極妙，為三光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"𤨔太微格，當有𡖖相之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":653,"lineType":9,"content":"雲漢騰輝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未二宫，雲漢經緯於其中。若丑未中得日月紫炁，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"金水之吉星交照，主為人文彩秀麗，學海淵深也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"詩云：倬彼雲漢，為章于天。雲漢即天河是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":661,"lineType":9,"content":"衆怒難犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"身命宫凶星相㑹，怒得一吉星解救，則不為凶。夫五星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453378378809407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"最愛順叚，如行順段，雖凶星亦不甚害。如入逆段，雖吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"星亦無力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"茍命中五星有三四入逆段，是謂衆怒難犯。前後凶徒死於非命者，皆此𩔖也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":673,"lineType":9,"content":"恃勢相陵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"善星入宫，犯衆凶星，故衆凶星恃勢以陵於善星。若同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"宫同度，則又為相合，在十三度外，則未免相陵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"凢五星欲其順軌，不欲其相陵，甘石已占之矣。順軌則彼此恊和，相陵則彼此不靜。又觀善惡二星同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"孰為有用，孰為無用也。如命宫帶木星，與火星同舍，若行木限，則不勝其凶，行火限，則不勝其福。故命書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471117346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":685,"lineType":2,"content":"云：木限當生遇火尅，更被孛臨全減福。則是木限當生，見火為凶也。又云：火若為限㑹於木，此限交之須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"發禄。則是火限見木則為吉也。故木限見火為凶，恃勢相陵者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":689,"lineType":9,"content":"鰲頭獨歩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"三春生人，在寅夘二宫安命，而寅夘上見木星也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"此得時得位得用，鰲頭自當獨歩也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":695,"lineType":9,"content":"江湖沛澤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為江，子為湖，水星在亥子二宫，而在亥子二宫安命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"也。四月生人為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642286143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":703,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋江湖當四月之時，有滔滔漲溢之勢，主為人抱負聰敏，志高量宏，驟居華選。若遇惡星同守，又恐不然，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"以水星性無定度也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":707,"lineType":9,"content":"子行父政","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽乃火之精，太隂乃水之精。故日為父，火為子，月為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"母，水為子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"且太陽之廟在午，太陽居之當然也。今則太陽却居子，火星却在午，又於午上安命，是父之政子乃行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰之廟在未，太隂居之當然也。今則太隂却居丑，水星却在未，又於未上安命，亦子行父政之説也。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"格主人艱難於始，逸樂於終，以其幹蠱之早也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909064246"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":721,"lineType":9,"content":"金神得位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛生人，金星入命是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"若更同在廟樂喜宫，主福夀雙全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":727,"lineType":9,"content":"河洛呈祥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
