{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁木星在午上，同照命宫，蓋午屬豫州，河洛之地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"天官書云：歳星一曰攝提，曰重華，曰應星，曰純星。營室為清廟，乃歳星之廟也。歳星出東行十二度，百日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"反逆行八度，百日後復東行三度十六分外之七。熒惑出東行十六舎而止，逆行二舍六旬，自所止之舍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"十月而入于西方。心為明堂，熒惑之廟也。太白其出行十八舎，二百四十日而入東方，復行十一舍，百三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081305635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"十日而入西方，又行三舍，十六日而出亢位。亢為䟽廟，太白之廟也。辰星其出東方四舍四十八日，其數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"二十日，而反入東方，其出西方四舍四十八日，其數二十日，而反入西方。星為員官，星辰廟也。鎮星出百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":743,"lineType":2,"content":"二十日而西行，西行者二十日反東行，現三百三十日而入，三十日後出東方。斗為太室，鎮星之廟也。夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"以室為木星廟，斗為土星廟，亢為金星廟，心為火星廟，星為木星廟。亥分屬衛，午分屬周，夘辰分屬宋鄭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"斗分屬吳，皆中國河洛分野。若人生而在此數宫安命，又得此数星歸宫，是為河洛呈祥。若正文謂紫炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"木星在午，而安命在午者，亦為此格，皆主才學過人，五福全備也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":751,"lineType":9,"content":"三台扶斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"斗在丑分，命若在丑而得三台星同宫，乃此格也。若丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559488552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"之前後三宫皆有兩星，亦是又有所謂三台扶日，三台","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"扶月，皆倣此而取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"所謂三台者，皆為三公之象，人命得之，位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":763,"lineType":9,"content":"雷乃發聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"二月驚蟄之後，生人在辰邜上安命，而遇水星，乃為此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"自雷未發聲，則未免汨没，發聲之後容易施為，非惟榮貴，且主聲名昭著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":771,"lineType":9,"content":"紫微四輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398835775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"旋轉天輪辰已午未上有四吉星，已午之間坐命是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":777,"lineType":2,"content":"輔星乃輔弼之𧰼，得之者當居宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":779,"lineType":9,"content":"精神具足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生水，為人之精，地二生火，為人之神。水火順受人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"命得之為精神具足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"精為養命之源，神為養形之源。精以養命而運內，神以養形而運外。内隂外陽，故水為隂之精，火為陽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"神。隂之不可無陽，陽之不可無隂。水與命同生於晝，火與命同生於夜，相望而各不失度者，豈不獲其厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":789,"lineType":2,"content":"福歟？又名坎離交㑹格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642253375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":793,"lineType":9,"content":"月華金闕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"金星在亥與太隂同宫，金星在辰與太隂同宫，皆謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"月華金闕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":799,"lineType":2,"content":"若金星在亥辰與太陽同宫者，謂之日華金闕。二格皆主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":801,"lineType":9,"content":"日中見斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽與羅㬋㑹合於未，而太隂又在未，此為日中見斗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽與太隂同宫，此為月朔可知。又與羅㬋相㑹，此為日蝕可知。况日在未，則日已過昃，設使安命在此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":807,"lineType":2,"content":"而遇日蝕，乃六月朔日生人晝既昧，則北斗見於東方，人命坐北，安得有吉？茍得五星或木星、火星同在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392286826546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"未宫以禦侮，則猶庶幾。不然，則竒禍之臨身者，大可畏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":813,"lineType":9,"content":"明入地中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽至申酉而没，而受羅㬋所蝕，然申酉安命是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽君星至申酉西没，既失君位矣，命坐此已為無力，况被羅㬋所蝕，其能自保乎？命值此，非惟破阻無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":819,"lineType":2,"content":"成，又恐招暗昧之事，因此䘮身，誠可憂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":821,"lineType":9,"content":"明出地晋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫在申，而太陽在寅，命宫在酉而太陽在邜，命宫在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"戌而太陽在辰，皆為明出地晋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471133730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"此格須是日生人為妙，更得金水輔太陽而行，或金水居前導引，皆為貴命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":831,"lineType":9,"content":"木上水井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"水先入宫，木後入宫，或木星先入，水星後入，皆為井象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"更得在東井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":835,"lineType":2,"content":"未上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"又在未上安命，必主道心員融，有常徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"以食天禄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"井居其所而不遷，地之徳也。而木居水上，有養而不窮之義。或人命得木同居於未，而水星對照於亥，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":841,"lineType":2,"content":"亦得木上水井格，蓋亥居下而有井之象也。然在天之井則異於是，以井而居河漢之中，其為度則三十，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":843,"lineType":2,"content":"視其他度數最長。半次實沈，半次鶉首。在實沈者，水為樂宫，在鶉首者，水為入廟，此亦養而不窮之義。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559472168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"者謂實沈、鶉首既以隔界，豈得為養而不窮？不知夫古人以為紫炁者木之餘氣，其廟實沈；月孛者，水之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":849,"lineType":2,"content":"餘氣，其廟鶉首。則是實沈、鶉首二宫乃木上水井，養而不窮之義誠爾也。若人命宫同得炁水在於實沈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"孛水在於鶉首者，皆得此格。須是無凶星則貴，有凶星則僧道出家𣴑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":853,"lineType":9,"content":"衆星環月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生坤方，五星𤨔太隂，更在太陰宫住命者合此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":857,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰之行有九道，其行最疾，衆星本不能𤨔也。且北辰不移，衆星可得而拱之。月既行速，則惟星是從，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":859,"lineType":2,"content":"以因之而有風雨。歳在庚午，二月初五夕，月入南斗中，其年自八月旱而無雨。以黄道推之，至十七日，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":861,"lineType":2,"content":"從黄道入畢宿下，知其日有雨。至此日其雨霶𩃱，此乃月之從星也。及十一月初五日，月在南斗三十餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909080630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"度，至二十　一日，亦從畢星之度經過，却又無雨。此蓋月别從九道行也。今此謂衆星𤨔月，乃隨其星之吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"凶而卜善惡。如月與木星同度則吉，與土孛同度則凶，與金星司度則主滛亂，與水星同度則主文華，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"火星同度則多疾患，與羅計同度則主夭折。當隨其所在宫分星㝛而詳之。若左右前後皆是吉星，雖太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"隂未至於從星，亦主獲非常之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":873,"lineType":9,"content":"輔弼雙星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗七星，斗杓謂之外庭，陽精之所布也。斗魁謂之㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"府，陽精之所復也。杓以治外，故鶉尾屬南方。魁以治內，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"故娵訾屬中州。是以鶉火、大火、夀星、豕韋為中州之分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909097014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"野。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"如亥午辰夘，生命得土星在子丑辰午亥夘，又無凶星侵入，皆得北斗輔弼雙星之臨照，為人必福禄豐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":889,"lineType":9,"content":"金居乾位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上乃西北乾位，乾宫為金，而金星亦居亥土，乃為此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"未年與申，主人得金居乾位最隹。蓋未屬井鬼，其分野則在秦；申屬觜參，其分野則在晉。得金之正氣，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"與未日同居於亥，乃金居乾位，若無火、計、羅、孛，人皆為貴命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559455784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":901,"lineType":9,"content":"水注東南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"巽居已位，東南之地也。四方之水則皆㑹之於箕。雖北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"有溟浡，南有大海，西有流沙，而水之傾注則歸於東海，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"以勢不滿於東南也。水星在已，而木星與命宫在寅，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"合此格。蓋水既順，則有滔滔無窮之福，其發達也必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"酉生人與寅生人得水星在已，木星與命在寅是也。蓋寅坐屬尾，巳分在燕，西屬畢，畢分在趙，是得正氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":913,"lineType":2,"content":"而流入於巽，是水有所歸。况與未命同在寅，或本命與寅生同在酉，得水日在四正之宫，則又為水歸地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"户格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642269759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":919,"lineType":9,"content":"除舊換新","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛乃天上之彗星，有除舊換新之象。所照之地則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"𠮓易更改，其星如箒掃，所以掃除塵穢，更新改舊。在亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"正月生，或在丑十一月生是也。蓋十一月一陽方生，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"改之始在丑次，正月為一歳之始，日在亥次故也。或孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"星在未上而七月生，蓋七月秋氣始生，先庚之象，有更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"革之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":933,"lineType":2,"content":"又如十　一月初一生，而日月在斗之初度，木星順室，亦為革故取新。蓋日月初躔於斗初，而木初躔於室","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842829331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"初，斗初在人馬宫，室初在雙魚宫，寅與亥合，至為貴格，又除舊取新之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":939,"lineType":9,"content":"火水未濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"火先入宫，水後入宫，同居一宫以照命者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":943,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋火自上炎，水自下注，相違而不相向，安得能和而能濟？故易曰：未濟，男之窮也。帶此者主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":945,"lineType":9,"content":"水火既濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"水先入宫，火後入宫，同居一位以照命者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋水性潤下，火性炎上，上下相得而不相違，切嫌一二凶星侵入，則返主生禍。更若水星為宫主，為命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"為禄主，則福最厚，冨貴雙全之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842845715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"附指南正貴格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":957,"lineType":9,"content":"天地徳合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"干為天之清氣，支為地之厚載。干合者，得賢人之心，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎天者親上。支合者，得衆人之心，本乎地者親下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"支干俱合，是為天地徳合。假如甲子見已丑，戊戌見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"癸夘之類是也。時合為上，日合次之。不然，年與月相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"合，日與時相合，尤為福𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":969,"lineType":9,"content":"君臣慶㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842862099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"干為君之象，支為臣之象。干支俱合，在一旬之內見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"之，是為君臣慶㑹。謂人臣近君，天威不違顔咫尺。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戌見已夘，戊辰見癸酉之類，並在一旬之內是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"也。時合為上，日合次之，所謂好日不如好時。不然，年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"與月合，日與時合，尤以為最。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":983,"lineType":9,"content":"一氣為根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"乃謂年月日時胎五合納音，純金、純水、純木、純火、純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"土也。假如甲子年，金；癸酉月，金；辛已日，金；乙未時，金；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842878483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子胎金是也。又如庚子年，土；丁亥月，土；戊申日，土；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰時，土；戊寅胎土之𩔖是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":995,"lineType":9,"content":"兩干不雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時，連占兩十，純一而不雜也。假如甲子年、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥月、甲戌日、乙丑時，甲乙兩字不亂。又如丙寅年、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉月、丙辰日、丁酉時，丙丁兩字不亂之類是也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之兩干連珠格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1005,"lineType":9,"content":"三合聚集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842894867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時胎，或干辰帶三位，支辰帶三位，納音帶三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"位，皆云三合聚集。假如乙丑年、乙酉月、丁已日、乙已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"時，三箇乙謂之干三合。又如丙寅年、庚寅月、戊寅日、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午時，三箇寅謂之支三合。又如辛邜年木、庚寅月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"木、丙戌日土、已亥時木，三箇木謂之納音三合。蓋以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"一生二，二生三，三生萬物，盈數之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1021,"lineType":9,"content":"四柱純全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"帶寅申已亥全者，有五行生氣，驛馬、學堂臨之，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842911251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱。帶子午邜酉全者，有五行旺氣，乙辛丁癸臨之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"是為四正。帶辰戌丑未全者，有五行財氣，華蓋、正印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之，則為四墓。然此四位若於年月日時得之，則富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。太乙云：凢物太盛則折，如漂風暴雨之至，易盛易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，要以胎代之，則為可久可大之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1037,"lineType":9,"content":"五行俱足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎一帶金木水火土全也。如甲子年金、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰月木、丁已日土、丁未時水、已未胎火是也。又如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842927635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉年水、壬午月木、辛未日土、丙申時，火、癸酉胎金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1049,"lineType":9,"content":"六位相乗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時，胎命，六位相乘，合起十二支辰，無有欠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"缺也。如甲子年，丁邜月、戊寅日、辛酉時、戊午胎，却去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"已上安命，子與丑合，邜與戌合，寅與亥合，辰與酉合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"午與未合，已與申合，位位相合，全無虧也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1059,"lineType":9,"content":"干辰一字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842944019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時，四位干辰不雜也。假如甲子年，甲戍月、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅日、甲子時是也。又如乙丑年，乙酉月、乙亥日、乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"酉時是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1069,"lineType":9,"content":"支辰一字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時，四位支辰不雜也。假如甲寅年，丙寅月、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日、戊寅時是也。又如戊辰年，丙辰月、甲辰日、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"辰時是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1077,"lineType":9,"content":"凰鳳池","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842960403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"謂如戊午年，戊午月、戊午日、戊午時是也。又癸亥年、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥月、癸亥日、癸亥時之𩔖是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1085,"lineType":9,"content":"引從包承","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子生人，以前三辰為引，則丙寅、丁夘為引。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"後二辰為從，則壬戌、癸亥為從。引宜逺，以丁邜為逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"從宜近，以癸亥為近。前遮後擁，左右包承。若甲子生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"人，後得癸亥，前得乙丑；丙寅生人，後得乙丑，前得丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"夘之類，又謂之年中太子，舉世難逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842976787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1099,"lineType":9,"content":"神藏煞没","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚丙壬為陽干之吉會，乙辛丁癸為隂干之貴徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"大凶神至此而遁藏，四惡煞遇茲而寂没。故陽則甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"庚丙壬，隂則乙亥丁癸。如年月日時四位上四干分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"明，不論刑害衝破，皆為吉氣。更加禄馬貴命，加增福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"力，而凶神惡煞自然遁藏寂没也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1111,"lineType":9,"content":"禄馬交馳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"馬是扶身之本，禄為養命之源。禄嫌衝破，馬忌空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813842993171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"禄無所破，則官職貴顯。馬無所損，則名位清高。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌馬在申，而時干得庚。亥夘未馬在已，而時干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"得丙戊申子辰馬在寅，而時干得甲。已酉丑馬在亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"而時干得壬。如年月日時四位支干互換得之，謂禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"馬交馳。如年月不見禄馬，而日時互見者，尤以為妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1129,"lineType":9,"content":"趕禄欄馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"禄不趕而不發，馬不欄而必驟。且如甲戌生人，甲禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843009555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅，須得丁丑以趕之。寅午戌馬在申，須得癸酉以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"欄之。此格極貴，得之者無不顯達成名。不必求正禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"正馬，但得此，則禄馬自然有也。他凖此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1141,"lineType":9,"content":"集福發福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時四位生旺之氣，或四位支干吉會之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"或四位禄馬福貴之氣，聚於時上者，謂之四位集福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"於帝座。如時上揭上旺氣秀氣聚在諸位之上者，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"之帝座發福於四位。集福於帝座，則以純厚忠信得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843025939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"君。發福於四位，則以聰明端直自進。五行自然之理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"造化之所不能移也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1157,"lineType":9,"content":"五字連珠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎五位干，得甲乙丙丁戊五字，與已庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"辛壬癸五字是也。蓋以甲與已合，乙與庚合，丙與辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"合，丁與壬合，戊與癸合，又謂之十干連珠格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"已上貴格，只忌空亡死絶相衝，刑破則减福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"全一路無破，善終州縣。全二路無破，善終京官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843042323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"全三路無破，善終朝官。全四路無破，官至員郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"全五路，無破，官至正郎。全六路無破，官至𡖖監。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"全七路，無破，官至兩制。全八路，無破，官至兩省。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"全九路，無破，官至兩府。全十路，無破，官至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1179,"lineType":9,"content":"細論身命宫主活法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"凢命先求坐命，次論安身福徳，次及貴星。官禄徒居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟地，禄元入照，雖無官亦有禄之人。本㝛加臨，縱遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"死有更生之理。陽為七政之尊，遇皆有救。陰為六陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843058707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"之祖，䧟恐無成。金雖妻象，居六隂怕近六陽。水是文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"星，背十位嫌逢土忌。計都原毒，六壬乃是禄元。月孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"為灾，四煞定居刑責。火居妻位，必先尅共枕之人。羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"入官鄉，乃食禄有權之位。土逢疾厄，主妻病以風顛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"金入弟兄，必妻閑而子弱。此十一曜之權綱，屬十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"宫之分野，更有相生相尅，或剥或刑，先到為主，後入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"為客，一切吉凶以為格式。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：論五星，無多訣，先從宫主分明説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843075091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"世人只泥原守星，此法原來不是活。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1209,"lineType":9,"content":"身命主星互垣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫在亥，木為宫主，身宫在辰，金為宫主，二宫主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"各歸本宫，固為吉命，設或木為木主，飛入身宫，辰上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"逢龍，金為身主，飛入命宫，亥上乗旺，名曰互垣，又為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"內外二臺，主富貴雙全，福禄深厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：內外二臺君且聽，命主入身身入命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"縱教生煞㑹凶星，冨貴榮華天賦定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843091475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"身命主星入財帛宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫大槩與田宅宫一同。身命主星若臨此宫，主財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"帛充盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：財帛主，　田宅主，身命二星喜相遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"若無暗曜與刑囚，可與石崇鬬豪富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1235,"lineType":9,"content":"身命主星入兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"第三宫，謂之閒極，此宫有喜星，亦只徒然，若身命之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"主飛入此宫，主衣食不足，惟喜太隂居此，却能與命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843107859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"宫添其福徳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：閒極主，　入命宫，縱為吉曜總成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"白日只宜閒袖手，不知衣禄自何從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1249,"lineType":9,"content":"身命主星入田宅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅宫又為父母宫。若身命主星照臨此位，主千斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"倉，萬斯箱。或田宅宫主飛入照身命，則家多金玉，滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"盛無比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"男女宫犯刑煞，被火土孛刑囚星照，主無子。如男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"宫主并第九宫主入命，更見田宅主星，須得外姓子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"養。若坐庫上，必成家。或兄弟男女宫主同入命宫，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"覔得兄弟子及姊妹子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫有吉星，必禮聘分明。若妻宫主星飛出逰行宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"見金孛，必奔走，不然則非禮聘成親。如命主飛入兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"弟父母宫，見妻星，或父母兄弟宫主星飛入妻宫，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"因親致親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1487,"lineType":9,"content":"又論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫見金孛星，係是四淫宫，妻必淫宫主入䧟宫，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"隨外人宫主及本宫。金孛星在四淫宫入廟旺，則淫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843337235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"蕩不止。如孛與紫炁在妻宫，宫主入䧟，必通僧道。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"孛同在妻宫，宫主星出逰行，更是四淫宫，必通秀才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"金水孛同在妻宫，宫主更入奴僕相貌宫，必通僕卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"金水孛同在妻宫，更是四淫宫，遇貴人，必通官人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1503,"lineType":9,"content":"論尅妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫帶刑煞尅妻，金星被火尅，亦損妻，或妻宫遇忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"星，必尅妻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1509,"lineType":9,"content":"論妻貌及性美徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843353619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"火在妻宫，性惡貌小少髪，土在妻宫，肥端性慢貌黑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅則醜而淫，羅獨在妻宫，長大損頭妻。金妻美貌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"温雅柔和，木妻性善貌平常，水妻伶俐貌小長瘦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1519,"lineType":9,"content":"論人多疾病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄宫犯刑煞見惡星，故多病。日生見火在疾厄宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"主惡死暴敗夭亡。若非雷傷斬首，必見血疾，并官棒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"血光死。如身宫不犯煞，則腸風血疾死。夜生土在疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，主癱風中風死，不然身帶風疾。若身宫犯刑煞，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843370003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"炁木，必主氣疾，無刑煞不病，見首尾星，主瘟癆死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1533,"lineType":9,"content":"論在家貧出家富或在家冨出家貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"身在逰行宫，入廟旺地，田宅宫值囚耗忌星，其主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"飛入廟旺地，故在家貧出家富。　田宅宫見福禄星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"其主星與財宫主星却飛出逰行宫受制，故出家貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1541,"lineType":9,"content":"論人有吉慶便生災禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"身命宫犯暗刑囚煞，雖官禄宫見吉星，凡遇吉慶則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"有凶災。如官宫見惡星，身命無刑煞，又見吉星，或居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843386387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人與福徳宫，宫主在命宫廟旺則無災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1551,"lineType":9,"content":"論為僧道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"生時䧟身命二位值炁，木星守之宫，主出在閒極位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"故為僧道。如更入廟旺，及生時在貴科，必主為高上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"僧。如羅獨守，主大權，夜生土孛尅身，後必還俗。如犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"刑煞，主徒流𡚖俗，如有救神即免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1561,"lineType":9,"content":"論人居官貧或因官致冨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"身命坐貴人官禄宫見吉星入廟，田宅財宫却見惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843402771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"星，主星受傷又䧟，故居官常貧。田財宫見火孛，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"化為刑囚宫主，身命同出在貴人禄馬廟旺地，初主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"貧，因官便冨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1573,"lineType":9,"content":"論帶子入舍大或帶子出嫁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"生時坐逰行宫，身命男女宫主俱出逰，行宫逢金入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"廟，身命主出逰行遇火入廟，必隨母嫁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1579,"lineType":9,"content":"論過房","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"生時身命俱在九宫，𠔥背日月，田宅宫無吉星，必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843419155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"過房之子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1587,"lineType":9,"content":"定奴隷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"生時身命俱在六宫，六宫主出逰，行宫更是土孛㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"日月，必為奴隷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1593,"lineType":9,"content":"定乞丐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"生時禄馬䧟，田宅宫無好星照，身命主星又出逢傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"逰行宫與忌星㑹，乞丐必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1599,"lineType":9,"content":"定風塵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843435539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1603,"lineType":1,"content":"天秤、巨蟹、雙魚、雙女，謂之四淫。此上安身命，更與金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛同㑹宫，主星飛入桃花上，必走風塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1607,"lineType":9,"content":"一曰歳煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰年，未上是。亥邜未年，戌上是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑年，辰上是。寅午戌年，丑上是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞乃三煞，太歳乗旺尅煞，歸於庫位，切忌與陽刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"相見，妻男位值之更凶，又當細辯。如申子辰三年，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"煞俱在於未，獨辰年尤緊，蓋四正庫墓相加，而三位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843451923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"之前煞尤重也。人但知數申子辰為三，而不知自辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"數至未為三，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：墓中歳煞最為凶，　更加陽刃禍非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1627,"lineType":1,"content":"辰火戌金水到丑，　土來未上不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1629,"lineType":9,"content":"二曰大煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑寅年申酉戌邜辰已年已午未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"午未申年寅邜辰酉戌亥年亥子丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞亦名飛亷，遇吉以之吉，遇凶以之凶。吉則司生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843468307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"殺予奪，凶則為横事惡死。喜官禄身命髙强臨之，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"為間忌煞難所占，是倒持太阿，授人以柄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：大煞飛亷不可當，小人命𫟚弗宜逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"官主高强為得用，自然名利出旗鎗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1647,"lineType":9,"content":"三曰的煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1649,"lineType":1,"content":"子午邜酉已是，　寅申已亥酉是，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未丑是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞乃暗金煞也。已酉丑金局，一名金神煞，一名破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843484691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"軍，一名破碎田財。妻男身命俱忌之，女命坐此更凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"若金水為恩福命，金在酉，丑水在巳，反凶為吉，吉不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"可量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：破軍不可日時逢，貴賤元來不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"五福朝元官極品，　小人徒配死囚中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1667,"lineType":9,"content":"四曰陽刄煞禄前一位是也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"甲刄在邜，加子酉，徒流；加戌，惡流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"乙刃在辰，加子亥，徒流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843501075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1675,"lineType":1,"content":"丙刄在午，四柱有財，惡死，加煞徒流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"丁刃在未，加戌亥徒流，加寅惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"戊刃在午，四柱有財，惡死，加煞徒流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"已刃在未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"庚刄在酉，加寅邜徒流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"辛刃在戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"壬刃在子，加邜酉徒流，邜已戌惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"癸刃在丑，加申午徒流，邜辰寅惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843517459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃者，為煞中不可當之煞，切忌與亡神、刼煞相見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"若見之，定主少年横死之兆，其煞又不可一槩而輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"議也。陽命夜生，隂命日生，則二當一。陽命日生，隂命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生，則一當二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1699,"lineType":2,"content":"甲陽乙隂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱雖有所取，須看煞在甚宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"時主初，日主徃，月主來，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"便是見徒流、惡死。見須以運考之，即見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"其年限也。且如人命，禄馬𤨔鎖，有官有禄，為兩府之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"資，時運正發，化煞為權，人皆畏慕。時運稍衰，化權為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。大凢人命四柱最不可遇之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843533843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：陽刄逢針號死囚，刼亡相見主徒流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥刑帶煞須當絞，惡煞争馳命不留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1715,"lineType":9,"content":"五曰刼煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰生人已是，已酉丑生人寅是，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"亥邜未生人申是，寅午戌生人亥是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此煞多生被小人謀害刼奪之事。人命值之，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"五星吉神之𩔖，刼煞更在生鄉，位居人臣之表。若五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"行駁雜，刧煞更在衰鄉，定主貧賤惡夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843550227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：刼煞凶神最不祥，主財渾似雪和湯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"若值生鄉𠔥值吉，位居臣表宰朝廊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l0rhw/1-SK1609_figure_00040.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nqVM9knwUvZsKlKJ%2FpjPktK5KOI%3D","pictureHeight":305,"pictureWidth":312,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l0rhw/1-SK1609_figure_00040.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3%2FstirNdEmJ4kVEEcSkuYYbJLRk%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l0rhw/1-SK1609_figure_00040.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855813843566611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1737,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
