{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"慨自道裂術興，星家者流徃徃挾一聞以為竒傳一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"得以為秘，不以告人，况肯著之書乎？古人觀天知命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"之公心，翻為後人釣名餬口之私計，江湖術士大率","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖此，余甚不取，乃裒集家藏秘訣精語，單經短賦共","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399542956070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"三十餘篇，總編一卷，以其非純於一家，故名之曰雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"後之覽觀者，有聞一知二之資，當念是集㧞十得五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"之難云。易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":9,"content":"星經雜著","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"唐一行禪師十六兩金　門人徐子賢註：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"造化分定，闗係身命壽夭、賢愚格局，乃知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命坐處，有官福拱夾，有四善拱夾，取其善則為吉。諸星間位成雙，曰星分兩兩格。每宫一星，遍布十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，安命空，曰星分五五格。卯上坐命金水輔日停匀，或輔命主不偏，曰三台輔弼格。金水日月同宫，合年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399542988838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"月日時之上者，曰魚水和同格。日月同宫同度，不相食者，曰合德格。金在亢，太常垣，木在室璧太極垣，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"在張翼軫太微垣，火在氐房天市垣，土在斗牛紫㣲垣。己上，曰五垣格。主星臨歲，駕祿馬在前後，曰前引","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"後從格。甲乙生人寅亥安命木守本垣。丙丁生人安命卯戍火守本垣。戊己生人，子丑安命土守本垣。庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"辛生人，辰酉安命金守本垣。士癸生人己申安命水守本垣，曰受命于天格。凡星辰在命順行，金前土後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"火前木後，木前水後，依次順行盤靣，曰五星順行格。太陽金、木、水、火土行，曰四令𤨔陽格。羅計子午得用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"者，曰跳關，曰首尾分天格。羅計各分星辰兩處，曰首尾平分格。衆星在已午未，曰戴天格。在亥子丑，曰履","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"地格。又要分其晝夜，更具七十二格，見于聚論中，宜詳審以知其妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"刃煞變直，立死無疑。日月並照，禍福誰期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471248418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"若刃星為煞，又作直難者，死不可逃此限。若太陽同行，斷其喪父，或父有疾。與太陰同行，斷其喪母，或母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"有疾，自身亦主災。犯重者與限有關係，順者則災可减矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"煞考衰旺，計于四時。榮枯得失，各應非遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":2,"content":"如煞是木星，又生春令，則煞旺而害人，非遇火金，不能制化，生于秋令，則减半矣。火旺夏，金旺秋，水旺冬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"土旺辰戍丑未，宜心㑹之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"衝駕驀駕，離祖獨居，逄生喜順，見煞喜逄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"如午生人，子上安命，謂之衝駕。己上安命，謂之驀駕。主孤尅離祖，有發福榮貴者，宜考聚論内説。逢生喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"順者如子上土，申上木，辰上火，則火順而能生，土化木背，則不能見炁，而無大凶害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081436707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"助煞化煞，逄空遽發。二限推遷，死生特逹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":2,"content":"如用土星，水木、炁孛同行對照，乃助煞有害。如木火炁羅同行，乃化煞致吉。若遇空，則煞無用，反能發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"大小二限，各有真理，宜取用星宿于口訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"四善重輕，拱夾分别，年月日時，各有詳訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"四善者，年月日時之殿也。以年殿居首，日殿居次，月時又其次也。看其坐照拱夾何星何宫，如子生人，拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"子曰拱駕，夾子曰夾駕。拱夾四柱内，年月日時各有其名。如子上坐命，寅戍有殿，曰夾命，午上有殿，曰對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":2,"content":"拱，申辰有殿，曰傍拱，在本宫曰坐殿。太陽一殿，例於聚論中取之。四殿拱夾之命妙秘，亦考聚論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫命宫。的池忌逢，非貴莫救，煞惡愈凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392286859314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"如酉上安命，的煞在上，又値水孛在内，此謂之金坐滛宫，非貴人不足以救解之，禄亦可以制定之。池者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池也。如寅午戍人，卯是咸池煞，又逢水孛，為花酒滛蕩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽雜處，㓜鬼定理，隨命制化，喜怒無比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"如辰上安命，土計金同行，土計日同宫，乃父毋有力，亦主生來坐享見成之福。火羅金火羅日同行，主尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"父，或不利父，或父有疾，不過應于少年。若發越者，在所限而斷其吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰獨明，輪運非輕。漏關跳關，晝夜有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"諸星皆欲生，惟月要獨明，或守年月日時處，大吉。輪運者，限元有相管攝關係也。口訣詳于聚論中，曉然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"如鏡。漏關乃羅計截斷，太陰出於外，或有吉星出於外，亦是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642417215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星守歲，逢順無配，又作吉神，立登科第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅生人，木為歲星。乙邜生人，火為歲星。若木在寅，火在卯，曰歲星守歲。其餘倣此。又逄生星，限元又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"順，其福無比，立登科甲。逢凶曰歲星化凶德深，為不吉之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"月居月位，各從其𩔖。若値亡神，其禍無避。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅月生人，太陰守寅之𩔖。最宜獨明獨行，値吉倍吉。忌凶星惡煞，重逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"日守日垣。晝逢作官，夜誕逢煞，刑害纒綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子日生人，太陽在子，寅日生，太陽在寅之𩔖，謂之日守日垣。以例推之，晝生坐官，順行大吉。若夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"又遇煞于上，大凶。主父毋有疾，亦纒綿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399542972454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢福曜，官星喜到。若論重籍，陰陽沓照。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"如子時生人，子上是籍得祿星，官星到曰爵星㑹籍。如日月並於上者，其貴可知矣。又當考限元命元祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"者，即甲祿在寅之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元戰尅，祖分無力。父母難存，必迎刄直。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人胎元，主人生前之事，與命有管攝。如惡星居之，則主胎中之孝服，或破祖。又値刃直星，不特父母難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"招，自身却作大禍。如戌上胎元，不宜水孛作刄直居之。餘依此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時旣已定，十二宫中留心訂。寅申己亥重相關，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未須當認。一篇亘古之玄機，神仙考之亦難盡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471264802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時旣定矣，論十二宫生尅，惟寅申己亥四位實有相關，為互刑重故也。非聚論之言，不足以明此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"理。辰戍丑未，考其本源，為力稍薄。若是四柱申地，亦還其富也。此十六金之真筌，於聚詩中大有管攝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"章章明白，當為萬金之柲。傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":9,"content":"唐一行禪師聚論詳議註解","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"星旣居垣，先論刑衝虚實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"垣者，本宫也。刑者，三刑也。衝者，對衝也。虚者，空位也，乃四柱旬中空也。實者，三合位實也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"命已入局，須分逆順遲留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"局者，寅午戍之𩔖。逆者退行，順者疾行，遲者慢行，留者不行，進退須有情也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081485859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"究根基以論尅制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"根基乃命元也。尅制者，五行有顚倒相生相尅之理。其中𤣥妙，即水生火、火生金之義也。有口訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"求貴賤以反因。由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝虚實之妙，能反其元，而致其可貴可賤、可貧可富之𤣥奥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"體必原於四柱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"論命必極其四柱之精。𦂳要處看生殺何如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"用深括於五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"論限元所用之星落于何處。遇尅犯者凶，遇相生者吉。又看虚實刑尅如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081403939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"祿不臨於四極，馬不徃於四刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"祿卽崇勲也，甲祿在寅之𩔖。四極者，辰戍丑未之地，此地原凶，非祿所止。馬者，寅午戌馬居申之𩔖。四刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"乃寅申已亥，是極刑之地，馬不安也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"煞喜居官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，即飛亷煞星也。若居官祿宫，主有大權，却忌居於男女夫妻、田宅弟兄之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"殿宜拱夾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"殿者，四善也，又名四喜。拱年月日時、身主、命主、官主并財元則吉，雖有衝壊亦吉，終不騐也。拱處如日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"上有凶星亦貴。凶星者，金在寅之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642368063"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"情性考年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"生於何地，情性何如，皆從人生年斷之。出身吉與不吉此段論煞，測之必以官主所屬配之，口訣諒如是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄參月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"生月中論父母兄弟蔭刀如何，便知尅制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"論夫婦凶吉尅制，以日辰考之，宜口訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫時别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223719464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"男女以時别之。此篇年月日時皆處煞地，以四柱推之，口訣有例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"日月交輝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"凡日月或三方，或對位之地。不空，凶亦可伏，能致其吉。若遇忌星或年尅，非疾厄則妨父母，或少年背父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"生也。遇之者終吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"四善拱煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"四善即四殿也。拱處空則吉，用夾財亦吉，亦不可以空而推之。此法非口傳心授不能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":9,"content":"衝能致吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"此言須口授，惟僧少異耳。男犯者必弱，否則淫於花酒而散。財遇空處尅亦可吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909178934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"刑能致凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"刑者，三刑，即寅刑已之𩔖。四柱八字與盤靣中相犯，全者方驗輕重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬重見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"有當生天馬，有流年天馬。如甲子生人，甲祿在寅，申子辰馬居寅，即火是天馬之𩔖。若受生者大貴。以十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"干禄主取天馬，如甲熒、乙孛、丙柴頭之例是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"天喜重逄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"有當生天喜有流年天喜坐七强宫為上，要與命限相關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星用三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223752232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"魁者，卽文魁、次魁、小魁，此星坐身命，更兼學館相㑹，即以文著名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"文星二用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"文星卽文昌枓甲是也。同上。斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤互沓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"如子午上安命二宫，申亥相逢得格者，乃文人才子，大貴顯，以文成其名也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"驛分天地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"天驛地驛二星在命，或在身宫，或在官祿，便可言其有名，更命限好者大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"難直忌重居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081420323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"八煞主與直頭星同行，其凶不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"權煞宜虚位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"煞星同作權者，臨空位則可取之。四柱内無，亦曰虚位，餘則不然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡畏三刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"孤神寡宿之星，畏三刑之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"六害窮八字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"子未六害之𩔖。若八字中全與盤内星合來，大凶，後有例見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"推大煞以論刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909195318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"有其刑則有其煞。在命位主尅性命，在兄弟主尅兄弟，在男女夫妻田宅奴僕疾病等宫皆忌之，此星有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"刑故也。惟官祿宫見之，必主有大權柄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"怪亡神以立身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"亡神在申，申上立身，安命忌之，駕上亦不宜見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"騰厄重迎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"風。騰煞與夭厄同宫者，大忌之。不宜坐命安身，更限不吉，必主破敗。一空重者主法死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"天妖刄神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"天妖即丁甲金兮丙從火之𩔖，若為煞星，深忌之。空亦刑尅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541606440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"池忌實見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"如咸池煞命主帶之，四柱上又見，深忌之，其人必因色而亡身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"相忌疾親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"相貌宫與疾厄宫，主有相關，及同位互換者，主破相有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"陽不守於四凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"陽者，陽刃也。寅申己亥為四凶之宫，惟辰戌丑未四宫值之偏重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"狗獨嫌於五七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"天狗星嫌居五七之地，在夫妻尅夫妻，在男女尅子女，不尅則亦如途人耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642384447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"産星用二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"此星遇之，男主血光，女主産厄。犯重者凶，輕者亦有血氣之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"帝城則一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"帝城，垣城也。為貴人之地，忌凶煞居之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人遷變，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星諸宫遇之則能伏煞，當各論其遷變，必論陰陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"祿神恊吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"禄神者，甲木孛兮乙水星，丙計丁羅是也。作生星則吉，作尅星則凶，用之終不吉也。舊本云催官恊吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541590056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣宜身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰居于生氣上者，主一生無險難事。其例有二月後第三位是也。考通書，合乃生月後，此法可用於小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱宜室，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"子午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"寅申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"卯酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"戍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"金匱星主妻財，宜居二七位，吉。田宅輕偏，宜妻宫坐之，得妻之財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"刼不利於少年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"刼在命，主少年多滯，老後主有權柄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398934079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"刑主妨於就晦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"本宫之星不喜與四柱内相刑，為就晦之禍太重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"坐馬忌衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午戌馬居申之𩔖。如限星坐馬上，忌年衝之，大凶。凡命吉星坐馬上，主機狡乖劣有格者，主五馬之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"如凶星破之，諸星不來，如五馬之害己也。有祿馬壓之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"子妨華盖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"華盖，男女宫忌之，身命亦不宜居之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"六合在全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081453091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"六合者，子與丑合之𩔖。此六合全不空方為合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"互垣宜制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":383,"lineType":2,"content":"互垣之星，看其吉凶相制，隨處斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"白羊立業，鎮、水同宫。金牛處命，羅土相從。閑處則吉，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"處則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"如戌上安命，水土偕行，當命限上，則欲作用。酉宫安命，羅土同居亦然。若刃水刃火，最為利害，忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"兎逐鷄窠，龍居犬穴。馬馳䑕道，牛奔羊結。凶可為祥，吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"可為孽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398950463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"此言卯酉辰戍、子午丑未二宫之星吉凶如何，用别輕重。反吉為凶，反凶為吉，變化不測。論造化異于常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"人，當口傳心授。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"兎逐雞窠，火入金鄉。龍居犬穴，金入火位。馬馳䑕道，移乾就濕。牛奔羊結，土鎮月宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"借宫則論煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"亥二宫坐命，以寅申水木借用，寅忌土計，申忌土金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘則論絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"金木水火土絶處，如以孛、羅、計作用神行事，吉凶立驗。如神金因絶於寅，而火生於寅。金生在已，火臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"己。金敗午，火旺午。故金無餘氣。金主殺，天道好生，故無餘氣。且水有孛，火有羅，木有炁，土有計，天地閒水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453396909162550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"土木多，火燃處即多，獨金雖神仙燒煉，亦無有也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"宵中火金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"凡夜生人火星看坐何宫。論空實則大驗。自未至子為陰，自丑至午為陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"晝逢太陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"同上，丑至午為陽。此二章論其空實之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"二德相拱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"天德、月德三方拱者至吉。縱然凶，終有救解，無大害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在箕度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223703080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":433,"lineType":2,"content":"冬至之日，太陽在箕七八九度，便作下年例之。看前後月之大小，便知其箕之幾度。若上月大，則牛一度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"上月小，則後一度。如二月俱小，則是九度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"身値獨處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰只要獨行。最忌刑衝，則吉凶在目前，淫樂亡敗有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"用在七强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"用者，限元也。起處要臨七强宫，方為得地，隨其制化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"衝處不起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"四殿，拱處伏了諸星，皆實行，則禍福於此最𦂳。可貴可富，可貧可賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398917695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"空處不生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"生我之星空了，諸星不在。取福反取禍。其中凶能致吉，吉反為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"身元極關於命主，四正刑切於三方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"雖三方照主吉，亦主凶。若四柱與命盤中相刑，則𦂳切致禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福先後，歲籍晦明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"命之死生，或應前，或應後。三年者，直年太歲，與人之生時𨵿係，或因衝戰，或三方吊起，以論吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛積聚，水計論量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命中水計同處，或命主或財關係，可致富。己宫立命之人，水計同行，可富可貴可壽，皆在衝尅中之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642400831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"量其或水木、水炁、水日月、水金之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"福自為福，殃處為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文財帛積聚之説言之。福自福，禍自禍，難用推除。此言極當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"驀駕立命，狡性戰爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"如子生人亥宫命，謂之驀駕。其人多狡猾，好與人爭鬬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"生曜逢空，反不為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"坐命處忽有生星至本宫，被魁鬼空了，反不為吉，餘宫减半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"杓宜指禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453373559554088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"斗杓指祿者驟富，合格令者大貴人也。又須論生尅，則應自生月起，至生時是也。非甲祿在寅者，乃甲人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"用辛為官，辛祿居酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"財宜制尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"財星起處，要尅他宫星，必主富。值空反不為祥。尅他不空為上吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"夾位喜母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"有用處有母曜在内拱夾者妙。如身坐處有吉星拱夾者，亦有變化之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"拱喜時徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"時者，生時也。德者，生年也。年時拱官命財者妙。拱凶者，主為禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399543005222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"三空四空，變化不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"三空者，魁鬼流魁也。四空者，日月時斗空也。與本年者輾轉相關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"囬衝順衝，貧富難容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時相關，衝實衝虚。順衝者，星隨而去之。老人忌衝空之位，雖吉處，他宫亦多災厄，衝則輕也。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"卯上値酉衝行卯年來則云回衝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"五常為吉，二符忌凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"官福田財，身宫主星，皆作吉星論生年病符死符到處，惡星坐其上，限又逢之。作惡星用，主大凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰位，已丑相關。已午未人，申辰欠安。申酉戍中，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453397471281186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"未翩翻。亥子丑宫，寅戍最難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"寅卯辰人，水土之星限見生則為吉。惟夫妻兄弟之中有妨，年月日時亦有相關。己午未生人，或坐命處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"金水二星。申酉戌上，木月二星。亥子丑上，木火二星。命限見之，尅與上同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"坐星生星，尅制非凡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"水木金水、木月木火，雖是生星，但生年與日時命限逢之，富自富，貴自貴，亦須有尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"星宫亂合，宫分偏正，逐兎攀龍，超凡入聖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"炁與羅合，木與日合。凡星坐命，宫分偏正淺深，驗生時之尅制刻數，則行限便知吉凶前後。如行卯限，先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"入乎辰，則吉凶可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392286990386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"以金伐木，猴來則變作權人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"仇土打蛇，猪見乃靑雲得路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"土埋雙女，己上行限，路遇此猪，乃亥星正管限，則有變化之理，平歩可致公卿。若不空不衝，大凶，亥宫命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。金騎人馬，遇水則轉生木。土埋雙女，遇木則制其難。要不外乎生尅制化之理耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"直財入庫，富有千金。直祿入官，位居極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"更有田星拱之足祿。如財帛星入庫。水土辰金丑木未火戍。如甲生人，祿在寅，更得命限好，大富宫主又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"作祿神，如祿宫為官宫，若受拱為大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"魁臨學館，主冠世之文章。馬入身元，乃離鄕之傑士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453377493794853"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"文冠臨於學堂之上者，生平有文學魁世，以文得名聲。馬與身主㑹，離祖成名，身性無定。女人切忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"衆星靜處，不作僧徒，翻作貧人。五星致凶不露，暴流自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"微得著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"五星皆靜而不相生者，一生不能發越，必下等人也。凶人欲行上人之志，立身後欠善終，　一時暴發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"君臣慶㑹，凡人卽拜公𡖖。命毋犯衝，當路卽為寒士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時同處為實地，平人即為公卿。生我之星謂之毋曜，被衝壊了，在限上不吉，或於他處亦然，終作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"貧寒之士也。詳究之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"命立歲主，配偶犯重。命立破鄉，生意濛濛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223785000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"如子年生人立命子上，則妻必犯重，或生尅逢生，亦主富貴。子生人立命午，則為歲破，必然自權自立，限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"行遇吉星生之，則亦富貴。若又子時生，則管限中亦能反覆其吉凶也。雖吉則七旬上必亡。子上有生星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"重子立命，土木七宫。少者怙恃，長則何庸。寅宫已水，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"日無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文而言，為十二宫網領，有𦂳之吉凶，人心自解。凶為吉，吉為凶，盡在此章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"重卯酉籍，孤苦貧窮。若遇日辰，和氣溶溶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"與上文相𩔖。以六十甲子中詳推之，卯酉為二人之門，故為而作例。然十　二宫亦有管攝，須以吉凶辰論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392287006770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"之，可以意㑹。在𫑗酉日辰上見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"福官入宫，須分彼此，若作令神，富貴無比，不令不尅，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"可為喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡官福星入命者，分其生尅，若能助其光輝者大吉。又作令神，則全美星光輝相助。若不是令星，旣無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"尅制，則亦為吉，終是福官之星，可喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"日取陽曜，夜取光芒。殿居四實，官坐廟廊。若處飛馬，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"奔夜忙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"如命係日中生，衆星入命。雖有尅制，亦分彼此。夜生人有光之星入命為通機。在實地當成名。若居飛馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561003042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":613,"lineType":2,"content":"奔走不閑。飛馬者，以日時起之，即申子辰馬在寅之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"陰忌計土，不分南北。已午未申，限元無力。若居酉辰，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"虎而翼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰。若與土計同宫，惟辰酉二宫相生，他宫同處，皆不為美限。若又行已午未申之地，則全然作凶論主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"夭折。若土計坐處値空，則不相妨，謂土計値空也。其不凶可知。若己午未申之地不空，其凶不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"大格五經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"大格者，大全格也。五經者，曰獨歩摘金歌、難經總斷論碎金也。其閒𤣥妙之語，摘金難經獨歩總論。雖少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"異於人，反説之。不知其義者，可于大格中例推之。然奴貌相宫，何異于人？非口訣安知其義？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393247244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神、吉神、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"諸凶煞諸喜神，不可不考。當考其直年為上。又有時候，不可輕斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"令星毋曜，實處為隣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"令星者，春木夏火之𩔖。毋曜者，如子宫命土主火為母星之𩔖。如星得令相關命主相宜同處者，為上格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"之命。限元中亦看，可推得令之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水土，寅亥巳申。順則富貴，刑則天貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"四星於四刑之中，相有相關，神妙莫測。如亥中有水，巳中有木，寅中有水，申中有木，如遇土金犯之，致富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"致貴。凡人皆以寅亥不宜見金，豈知其中有生水之妙。己中見土，有生金之義。若見刑尅則凶。忽遇流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399543087142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"致刑尅，亦不為祥。遇刑遇衝遇天空，則為妙處論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"留心考究，傳宜得人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"凡五星，須當留心細推空亡、刑尅、虚實，方得其驗。如不驗，必其生時之差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":655,"lineType":9,"content":"琴堂易覽註解","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"琴堂五星，先賢所秘。吉凶匪同，常星有異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"琴堂之名，乃昔有琴堂和尚傳授吕𨓜齋，𨓜齋受之唐一行禪師。盖因和尚盛行於世，故號之琴堂。所論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"吉凶禍福與加盤，即律躔度子平法。諸家五星取用不同。凶能致吉，吉處反凶，有變異，是以言常星有異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"先推命與身，次看生尅制。生尅旣巳明，三方并吊起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081584163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":667,"lineType":2,"content":"先看命宫受生受尅，命主起去如何。次看太陰落於何處，在强在弱。然後看三方對照，六命相生相尅，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"看田財官福。妻男受生者，便可言吉。受尅受空，以不吉斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"入垣入局廟，互垣合格𩔖。子細與推詳，其中多妙義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"五星入垣，其貴可知。互垣合格，多有深奥。入垣者可考十六兩金，合格者當詳七十二格，於中妙趣多矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"庸術能知之，可羨更可喜。一天星與辰，分明皆語汝。學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"者宜審思，非難亦非易。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星先看命和身，次察盤中各位星。最是限元為第一，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶惟與命同。論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392081567779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相生，最喜順行，順則有吉，退則無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"且如木生火，火在前，木在後，順行而相生。如木退度，則木火無相生之義，故為無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"五行順克，為禍太疾，若逢制化，稍减其力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"五星相尅者，順行為禍太速，且如金尅木，如木在前，金在後是也。若遇火羅，三方對照，金星則為制煞，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"遇水孛，則為化煞。為禍梢輕，反能致吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"魁從年生，掌握一世遇之全生，吉凶倒置，虚實要明，後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"詳次第。凶宿値之，反富反貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"此星於當生年上起，管一生事。虚者四柱中所無，實者四柱中所有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376398999615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"符憑月起半空之理。二十五年吉凶畏喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"此星從月上起，自少年管至二十五歲，半空也。吉凶變易。凶致吉，吉反凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"權乃日中推，𤣥妙罕能知。半管五十載，餘星各有期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"此星從日上起，自二十六歳管至五十歲，亦半空。虚實與前同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"印者時所攝。五十至末年。空空之妙訣，深逺不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"此言是時上主一生事而半空也。其星此處看是何胎元，如甲子胎，甲為陽斗在陽位。乙丑胎，乙為陰斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"在陰位也。坐身命者，為人欠實而不誠也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼曜卽天空，與前星亦同。半掌一生事，吉凶安止容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392287055922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":721,"lineType":2,"content":"天空即當生。天空有流年。天空管一生之事却半空也。以上六星皆看四柱有無，有則為實，無則為虚，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"斷其吉凶。若吉星遇此四柱内無填，則變吉為凶，尅星見此，則易禍為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙貴人星，値之能化煞。拱夾命與身，限到渾早發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"此星坐處多致吉，見凶亦能化伏，而不為大咎，加拱身命限者，大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"天祿是崇勲，如臨命與身。更坐官宫中，還須是貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"此星安身生命者主貴，更入官宫主大貴，所謂真禄居官，位居極品是也。却不宜䧟於奴僕之宫坐之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"一生勞碌，喜自庖厨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德入年干，命身深喜居。生平鮮難厄，入限中貴。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453376399015999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"德乃年干取。臨命坐身吉一生少難可伏煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"時籍是垣城。命身惟欲臨。坐之能致貴。當考生尅星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":743,"lineType":2,"content":"此星有三名，時籍、垣城、帝座。安命立身者主貴。然此又當看身命限元若何，方可言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"金轝主妻財，祿前三位該。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"此星坐妻宫，專主得妻財，餘宫非也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣臨身吉，一世永無災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":751,"lineType":2,"content":"當生月後第三宫是。如與身星同處，主一生少難無大災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"正祿與斗杓，二星一處來。富貴自天然，此格誠善哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642499135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":757,"lineType":2,"content":"此言斗杓指祿，主大富貴。如杓不指祿，但坐身命官宫亦貴也。斗杓者，卽用月常加戍，時上見破軍是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"自生月上起戌，順數至本生時，是斗杓也。正祿者，即甲用辛為官，辛祿居酉，非十干享祿主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬與地驛，二星專致吉。身命及官宫値之有祿秩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星坐身命官宫，其貴可知。如坐主星者亦貴，其驗如神，不可不考。如其不吉，亦有俸祿之人，有名播","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"世，試之累驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時云四柱，四柱有星名四喜，四星拱在髙强宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇相衝尅不起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"四喜即四殿，又名四善，拱身命限者皆吉，有凶不能致禍。拱尅處則尅不起，故四善拱伏則不能動也。宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393263628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"詳口訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"天喜紅鸞二吉星，常居四正喜臨身。若臨命元并限度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"與之進喜及添榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":781,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星常在四正之位，在命主有喜事，在財帛主得財，在兄弟主兄弟有喜，或朋友相舉而得名利，在財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"宅主父毋有喜，或增田宅。在官祿為官者有陞文書之喜，照身者家中進人口，與當生㑹極好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"文宿有三星，名利以文成。加臨學館上，天下播其名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"文宿乃文魁、次魁、小魁，坐身命官禄宫，與學館同處，乃文人才子名揚天下也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥須借官，官命難一般。申宫須借木，寅宫作水看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223801384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":793,"lineType":2,"content":"己上坐命行申，限水為官星，是以借木為官星。亥上坐命行寅，限亦以木為官星，故假水為官。以此斷之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"吉凶無有不驗。専以官星，却又難以限元論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"三合有天馬，値之有吉祥。安身并處命，莫不貴榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":799,"lineType":2,"content":"天馬者，即火、計、水、木、土之𩔖。此星為煞稍輕，為福甚大，能致吉，盖化為天馬故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"五星居絶地，絶地豈能生。權將餘曜論，非貧擬作僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":803,"lineType":2,"content":"金絶于寅，木絶于申，火絶於亥。旣自居於絶地，豈能生他人耶？却將餘星斷其生尅，此等命非貧即為僧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"道，為煞不甚凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞飛亷最主有權，尅妻害子，為煞至專，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392287023154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"即正戍二已之𩔖。若在官宫主有權，在妻宫尅妻，在男女宫尅男女，在田宅不利父母，在兄弟而少兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":813,"lineType":2,"content":"作尅星為禍太重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"的煞淫神，偏惟忌陰。男逢汨沒，女逄多淫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"一名淫神，一名汨沒。在命者淫佚，作事顛倒，女命深忌犯之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞一星坐命安身，少年不利，多主邅迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"此星坐命，安身不利，主疾病。有權煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神立身，命坐斯神，作事反覆，多學少成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"此星安身命者，似有如無，作事多學少成，一生不濟事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393280012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬之星，忌親命身。若逢戰破，日夜馳奔。有星居上，尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"而順行。身命㑹之，機狡無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午戌馬居申之𩔖。坐身命者，動靜不安，與身同行更限元不吉者，乃離鄕之士。若有星辰坐其上，遇尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":835,"lineType":2,"content":"去之。更有飛馬時上。惟安身立命，日夜奔馳辛苦，命限好者，却勞碌而成家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"刄星作直，致凶甚惡。若是尅星，匪亡亦厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"刃者，乃祿前一位是也。如刃宫主星入作直頭星者，為禍大惡，重者必死矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"星名天狗，主人無後。五七遇之，妻子安有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":843,"lineType":2,"content":"此星忌入妻男宫。在妻尅妻，在子尅子，其應如神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642515519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花煞主星，女命忌居臨命身如遇此，必定亂人倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":849,"lineType":2,"content":"乃寅午戍兎從茅裡出之𩔖。若坐命安身，男好酒色，女必淫佚。更行限値尅者，必因花酒而喪身。又當考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"獨歩中金水孛如何。此言厯厯皆驗，看女命宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"凶曜號風騰，命身不喜迎。夭厄更同處，家破又遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"命身在上更行限，必主破敗。更與天厄同行，家計一空，為尅星。至惡重者，必主徒刑，不然法死也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"衝駕衝驀，二曜孤尅。坐命安身，凶能致吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":859,"lineType":2,"content":"衝者當生歲破也，驀者當生歲後一位也。立命安身者，主孤獨奸狡。刑尅詳聚論中則皎然方知其美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"孤神寡宿，四柱所屬。凡人遇之，偏主孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453392287105074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星主孤尅，畏於三刑之地，妻子宫不宜見，亦必有損。男女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱地支與盤相刑，命身限遇，其刑匪輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱地支與盤圖中相刑者，身命限行至上，或流年相刑者，其禍太重，必受刑憲也。刑者即寅刑已，己刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"申之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"産星有𩔖例，惟主血光事。若也作煞星，女受産厄死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":875,"lineType":2,"content":"此星為煞星者，方忌之。男主血光刑害，女主産厄，重者必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"八煞宫主號難星，化為煞宿來相侵。若是遷移來互換，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"死於道旅受遭貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561019426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"疾厄宫主星，為禍最重，與遷移互換，重者亡于道路，輕則在外受貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"直頭星與天妖神，二星為煞甚難論。化作煞星來尅破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"十分為禍亦非輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星太惡，為十分凶，平常亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑立命，土為主星。寅亥相見，為殃豈輕。○寅亥命宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"辰酉相逄，若無制化，其凶愈凶。○卯戍二局，火作宫元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"若見已申，凶不可言。○辰酉宫中，太白所止，卯戍飛來，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"無救則死。○巳申之屬，土屬辰宿，子丑為殃，非亡則哭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395642531903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"○午未之宫，君后之京，鎭計相犯，非亡必刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":903,"lineType":2,"content":"以上十二宫，為禍不相容。若能反其吉，非尅必受空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"五星并二曜，生星深喜到。如是値空尅，安能言吉兆。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"究四餘氣，其中多妙理。生尅與星同，空空却别議。生尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"制化俱已明，還推坐命尅和生。一天星宿盤中取，學者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"留心子細評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958192179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
