{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"人命稟天，八字分辨。窮其本源，胎元尤顯。察乎德籍，究","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"乎四善。知富知貴，知貧知賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":2,"content":"德者，歲星。籍者，生時。四善者，年月日時四殿也。胎元者，生月前第十位是也。如殿内有官星，身命坐其一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":2,"content":"二位，或對拱相照，皆是貴命。不拱照者，雖富而不貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428722925577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"魁符、權印，斗鬼、飛亷。論極限位，天地並參。究其虚實，禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"福俱全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":2,"content":"魁符、權、印解見前。印者，時也。斗者，胎元也。鬼與飛亷，俱詳前篇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"刑的、刼亡，尸舌貫欄。祿馬、陽刄，善惡亦專。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"伏尸貫舌，欄干貫索，並詳前篇。陽刃在命主性重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱生氣，難値衝年。太歲輪運，卯酉門關。天驛地驛，妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"不可言。亦合貴人，其理顯然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲夭空之類。驗其當生，考其流年。門關者，午年卯酉，為鬼門關之地。遇凶星則十分凶，平常亦有灾晦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276670501"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"有大吉星則可吉矣。天驛，正己二申之𩔖。六合子與丑合之𩔖。如子上有凶吉，丑上亦有半凶，貴人能化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽正宫不易天地太陽偏處，前後三四，吉殿凶宫，凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"先吉位，扣其的時，禍福極大。流曜流魁，宜當審秘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"如太陽在正宫之中，則天地不易安處正中。如太陽方過交位之地，則安命不可移易。如淺，則有傷天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"造化正氣。如深，則易四時之位，如交宫淺，則易三歲之位。須當論其淺深。如年三十七歲方交官祿宫得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"吉限，則三十四歲與四十歲上下吉與不吉，當詳口訣。又當問其生時之的，吉凶禍福，無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"三限變化，四正三方。有尅無犯，必致死亡。無尅有犯，難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958372403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"直何妨。本値二三，末過十祥。本末全遇，此處大亨。遇生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"福輕，遇助福長。日星先交，歲歲一陽。空空之妙，細宜審","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":9,"content":"琴堂碎金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴論乎格局，貧賤究乎經垣。星有順行，必驟作而乆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。宿皆凶布，處困厄而不延。三三五五，惟主聰明；實實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"空空，反其賤榮；衝駕獨立，驀駕無情。至若吉曜當空，少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"易育而壯滯；凶星入命，少困厄而壯亨。宫宫遇吉，到老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416576270387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"終作賢良；一限逢空，他吉而終發。積水為貌主，豈宜逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"土。金作福神，火來悽楚。熒惑為官，水見䟦扈。若遇鎮陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"破祖榮祖。遷煞逢凶，旅况貧苦。如遇吉神，矗顯他所。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"乃火居妻位，妻須重娶；土入妻宫，妻娘無貌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"若在木垣，炁位别論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"火水火孛，蚤見孤孀。金火金羅，刑尅非常。喜水喜土於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅，宜木宜日於財鄕。子孫利金木陰陽兮，炁孛非祥；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕宜四餘兮，尅能戰爭。且比夫一星為吉，値生煞而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"同途。乃吏曹僧尼兮，終非善之徒。合局而帶貴煞兮，性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416576286771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"髙顯而為武夫；主星䧟煞而反凶兮，非離祖即應貧孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"何以一身為髙强兮，别其上下。何以為限之駁雜兮，致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"死無訝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":9,"content":"獨歩鈎玄琴堂秘訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"二曜麗天，歲功成兮。　五星垂象，人事應之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"所以月將　加臨生時先觀主曜起處髙低，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"次察身宫　泊處安厄。　命居寶瓶，舉一以例其餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"主星屬土，飛加卯戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"恩地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"最為得所。更遇火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"恩星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416576303155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"同行燕魯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"寅戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"或在周齊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"午子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"蛟龍，雲雨　如躔𣈆楚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"申己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"有力如虎。其他一體，定其賓主。太陰泊處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"其理一同。但嫌木炁，與之迎逢，　踏實無救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"乃為真凶。　火羅化之，和氣春風。　分其向背，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"究其實空。身命旣定，次求官福。生尅旣明，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"次看垣局。拱處如朝，夾處如矗。　日月拱命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"把麾開纛。　日月照母，　大貴榮祿。更有漏關","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥處煞祿。拱祿固榮，拱煞要伏。月為初主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416576254003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"日作中年，時為末主，限歲推遷。吉凶之變，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"深不可言。　四柱六甲，　與天地叅。　天地二盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶詳看年月日時。　四柱實地，實地有星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福非細。　坎離乾巽，　六甲空位。空位有星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶倒置。亘古真機，神仙所秘。　桃梅不李，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"鐵石匪金。　且如人命，立已與申，　以水為主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"難以金論。官福田財，見土俱沉。　日月逢之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"損自傷親。　天元納音，土屬則妙，　土入命宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438700978227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"更為吉兆，或坐財宫，　尤為𦂳要。丁未在戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"一水獨照，富有家資，仍嫌孛曜，　二主臨財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"萬頃良田。官福居垣，　佩印乗軒。身命逢官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴天然。或居殿駕，近君承宣，惡煞戰破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害綿綿。武官帶煞，　一有格目。　僧道九流，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"主䧟三六，　離祖過房，遷田不足。　寅申巳亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"四重之局，　人命立之，事多反覆。吏曹之命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福多專。刑不守籍，必在身元。或居相地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223965224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"刑賞難蠲，吉處十分，享用亦全。　官星滿用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"凡骨可仙。　祿馬貴人，太歲所攝，坐命安身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴雄傑。歲對為衝，歲後為驀，身命逢之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"悖逆驀越。更値星曜，言其優劣，　流年遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"衝驀一般，看在何方，宫定其端。刼亡刄害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"殘破迍邅，　的煞淫神，汨沒流連。唯有大煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"最主威權。身命逢主，有為作畧，　小人遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"膽大心惡。　以上煞星，驗其生尅。尅我命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416223948840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"不可救藥，更有直星狂怪。凡百　八煞宫主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"號曰難星。　四柱身命，不可交迎。午未二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"君后之位，　不論生尅，所畏難星。土計木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌侵。𭰗歲德朝垣，得地者貴，福官守籍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"相生者榮。諸星互垣，有忌有制。富人之命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"體弱用强。金木同位，水火同行，為富不仁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"故多戰爭。拱夾田財，不値空亡。　田連阡陌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"千倉萬箱。朝天拱斗，乾坤互合，　日月逢生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730239507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"日月拱夾，　日土晝合，　火月同宵，　二曜朝陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"一星伴月，福祿互聚，皆為貴格。　洞微大限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"各有定方。命宫子丑，　依數而行。體用俱全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"如木逢陽，　假如水命，水喜長庚，有一遇土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"輕重酌量，　更詳後限，是凶是吉。後限勝前，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾可入，　後限不利，如何得出？體用互空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"歸歟可必。　空不盡者，逢衝帶實。吉星得用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"𨚫又嫌衝。寅逢己亥，　水日無㓛。　更有天空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730288659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"䑕忌牛宫，吉凶輕重，直𩔖旬中，虎符喪吊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"次第推窮。女人最𦂳，身與福德，五八更好，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"子貴無厄，水星不淸，血氣不調，　居奸娼妓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池水孛，相貌必好，　夫宫必離，身星䧟弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"子曜居髙，乃生貴子，　因有稱呼。　夫坐三六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"淫賤暌孤。寅亥金水，　旺子榮夫，剛嚴貞固，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"土羅計都。五星六曜，　四時一體，　三春之木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"逢金亦美。各有善惡，要知其𩔖，用識其源，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840427559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"土能生水，　仰觀俯察，應如符契，吉凶亦然，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"或貧或富，隨其後先，　以時正命，　毋以貌觀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"顛倒之顛，玄中之𤣥，非人勿語，　得人而傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"看命之法，先看命主，起處髙低，富貴貧苦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"飛昇實地，　根本厚許，主喜入垣，　恩喜别遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"煞曜居垣，　限逢財聚，弱地弱宫，　浮業蕩祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"次看身星，　三合朋侣，命毋相依，　安然若堵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428722974729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"三看限逢，用星而取，　限主髙强，求謀遂緒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"官福田財，光我利我，奴兄疾相，　途見縈我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"不論生尅，吉凶如數。須看空亡，　詳在四柱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"年管平生，月先廿五　日，後廿五、　五十時主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"陽年。陽空陰空陰取當時者空，方為的語。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"命壯煞空，旱天得雨。命弱煞空，　一般困取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"襯貼當推。先後是務，更是遲留。限行不取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"凶吉不全。　缺漏必補，實地衝空。空衝出取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428722991113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"逢順而吉。弱強勝負，流年生尅，其理一同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"命泊子位，　計為本宫。途中遇木，獲吉無凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"見炁是禍，　水孛灾濛。　丑宫主是，　土星為宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌木炁，是為真凶。　火羅限逢，　生氣春風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫用炁，水孛欣逢。火羅泄我，　耗有侵衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"辰己有金，祿進名崇。少老見之，忌失一同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫屬火，孛不宜逢。水為我福，　日進興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"喜見木炁，尅土榮豐。辰宫金主，　土計相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428723007497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"為恩毋曜，喜氣匆匆。見火旺相，　不致災濛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計逢化，得失之㓛。　限逢計曜，乃有一凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"見金自忿，　無取而終。命安初地，　以水為宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"恩金若壯，富壽無疆。用孛為官，氣宇冲冲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"土計限遇，災忌難容。午宫安命，主星太陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"不論生尅，金水為强，三方拱合，　廼吉廼昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌木炁，　干我心膓，火羅相遇，喜怒不常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"未屬太陰，金水孛祥。所忌土計，致為災殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428722909193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫立命主，孛水同占起髙强。見金獨壯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴家資，　必顯榮旺。　土計限逢，災輕耗蕩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"正業。酉地　主曜金星，火羅仇隙，　土計恩榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"戍宫立命，　主用羅星，最忌水孛與之逢迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"為見木炁，　和暢充盈，限上逢羅，　必致災驚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"有救則善，　合水命傾。亥宫屬水，水孛我福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"金火羅纒，興災破祿。　十二宫中，金忌所泊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"欲問貴格，　日月分明，　日月拱駕，金水朝迎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541786664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"福官登駕，勲祿貴憑，職分髙下，須看恩星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"或居官祿，或抱月榮。武官帶煞，　格局居髙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"福星壯健，福祿滔滔。並忌流年，尅我災招。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"如犯其刄，　的刼亡夭。恩星不救，刑憲難迯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"欲問陞除，催官恩實，天馬來逢。恩星朝日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"宜在消詳，不可執一。　欲問富格，　田財坐實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"身帶泄神。福星伴月，煞星受制。身星透出，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"祿主髙强。福星垣實，貧賤可知。　煞犯月日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393411084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"田財落空，限元䧟失，馬後安身，駕衝的實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"貼襯逢迎。遠近分評。尅之者近尅重生輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"生之者近　生重尅輕。鬬合取化，　散背無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"流旬空月，營運無能。更忌刼的，陽刄來刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"財物耗散，　四柱减輕，　如何夭喪，遇煞難憑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"流旬空限，原守空星。太歲趕煞，的煞相爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"更以星弱，便得西行。正煞實地，無化縱横。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"但卜交㑹，𦂳要玄亨。流煞尅月，　的刄來刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958356019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"直難犯主，亦易而傾。師尼之命，命位兩岐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花帶馬，貴人多持。身坐官祿，財祿𤰞微。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"奴星犯月，疾主侵欺。壽數一月，宜心㑹之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"淫賤女格身命臨官，咸池帶馬，多不貴權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明嬌麗，貌好優㳺。宫主受尅，身坐祿官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"更忌四角勞苦，勤艱富夀。女格財福為先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"對拱三主，垣業舒顔。恩星伴月，晝日合闗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"閑星貌主，　互換福閑。奴宫有吉，福祿齊年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453416576335923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道之命，格與貴同。華盖安身，妻子刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"泄神伴月，炁木守宫，財福滿用，　田主逢空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"日月守駕，光顯宗風。衆星聚㑹，先入為尊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我利我，分其後先。尅星在後，疾病艱難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"生星在後，福祿舒顔。星辰留遲，災福如山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅取化，吉凶星完。庶俗之命，歲忌官符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"或犯煞神，耗火趦趄。或帶生氣，獲彩吉乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴之命，不忌官符，　只忌刼煞，剥我灾虞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730223123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"惟喜恩到，灾脱樂餘。更看流陽，散遇不虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"孤尅男女，命宫所取，或坐陽刄，或坐白虎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"或坐四角。羅計命怒，的煞犯身。　天狗七五，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅，炁孛來夾。身主。天主星空，　孤眠獨坐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"吏人之命，恩煞兩專，好處十分，煞犯身元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"交限生氣，　名列陞除。須要主健，氣𢿙綿綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜凶曜，朝日近君。　生星不福，煞曜無迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"當途限遇，須辯晨昏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"自寅亥至未時止，日有氣，申時减力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393427468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"日逢太隂，晦食無端。夜生太陽，亦以一般。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"更有四令，　不作空言。　日火夜土，斯乃俗談。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"並論生尅，不無二三。天乙貴人，坐命安身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"男命最好，女命賤貧。男女立處，並愛祿勲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"兼星得局，光顯宗親。驛馬有四，　喜忌揀分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"男喜生旺，　女喜衰神。八字𠔥用，叅究何旬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"納音所取，　死活緣音。衆星靜處，居垣反貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"十二次舎，喜忌同論。隨其憎愛，其驗如神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428722958345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"為歌一，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1450/1-SK1609_char_figure_00002.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=67J%2B5%2B2wY1JnXMHna7PQrKr8bfI%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1450/1-SK1609_char_figure_00002.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"同志斧斤。五宫夜日，子女參商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"晝月居五，災子孤張。七宫火羅，妻晚操強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"匪則年㓜，　失倍年量。　日月反背，　如此尋常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"夫冬木逢水而寒，夏木遇火而燥，秋金埋土而反晦，冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"水潰土而致濁。無根之木遇孛而漂泛東西，受尅之土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"逢水而崩流四出。冬金見月，饑寒徹骨。春金見金，淡薄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"無情。火逢月朗而無光，金遇火溫而渙𤼵。寒水最宜朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453428723023881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，夏火不妨見月。未宫坐命，太陰行限，則柔能制剛；星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"度為垣，太陰泊處，則懦而無力。盛夏之火，何須木炁相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"扶；六月之水，最怕火日涸轍。夏金逢日，銷蝕無聊；秋木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"逢陽，凋零無補。戍垣之火，所用與卯垣不同；酉宫之金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"行限與辰宫有異。冬水喜其南發，夏火惡其北露。冬春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"之木，遇晝日則謂向陽；冰凍之土，逢火羅方能發福。寒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"土何生金之有，秋水非滋木之時。酉辰坐命，土計犯陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"而反佳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"身逢生也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"卯戍為垣，太乙抱蟾而為害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"身傍鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"殘晦之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561183266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"土，遇火則有光輝；剛燥之金，遇土方能滋潤。諸星皆退，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"主星獨順，乃中流砥柱之人；羣曜皆遲，一星有用，則獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"步軒昻之士。土居女，木居星，雖相尅而有義，命在申，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"在亥，行此限以何妨。觜乃金石之火，觸木方燃；箕乃䝉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"泉之水，遇金為美。璧參之水，議論不殊，亢娄之金，所用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"則一。刄宫坐命，不可以木為刑；囚星柳為垣，當以木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"為難。曜宫分有水宫之火，火宫之木，木宫之土，議論萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"殊，所用不一。冬水為命，太陰行限，財不足，清有餘，春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"闕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561166882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"作主。土星發用，彼無力，我何藉。論星須當論時，論氣無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"過論理。造化貴在擇用，術士妙在推詳。若論太拘，過猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"不及。此論先天之妙，後學宜謹。斯文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"兩儀肇闢，六甲始生，將三元而作三才，建四時而為四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"柱。干為祿本，定一生職位髙低；支作命基，布三限壽元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"終始。年生為根，月建為苗。日管經營，斷中年之休咎；時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"為結果，定晚歲之榮枯。先推胎息之由，次入變通之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958339635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"為官為貴，緣上下以咸和；多滯多危，本限元而相尅。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"故格清局正，當為臺閣之臣；印旺官生，必作鈞衡之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭帶劔，鎭壓邉疆；印綬逢華，尊居翰苑。祿雖多而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"害，福不為祥；煞雖重而無傷，災反作吉。三竒弗背，才高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"立解成名；六甲正逢，家富又能增業。空亡親於寡宿，孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"孑寒眠；長生䧟於空亡，貧寒偃蹇。桃花若臨帝座，因色","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"亡身；咸池更㑹日宫，緣妻致富。根元淺薄，逢生旺而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"榮；本主興隆，遇休囚而反吉。陽刄臨于五鬼，定須重犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541803048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"徒流；勾絞疊于三刑，應是頻遭編配。是以登仕途者，莫逢吞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟，爵祿𧇊停；當兵權者，勿遇天中，身權退失。胷襟澄徹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"盖因水濟江湖；學問淵源，本是水居壬癸。慈祥愷悌，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"乘甲乙之鄕；焦燥炎陽，火盛丙丁之地，名髙祿重。乾金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹遇庚辛；貫𣏓粟陳，鎭土重親戍巳。木繁而無金斵削，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"縱榮而末歲孤窮；火炎而無水淘溶，縱發而早年夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"粤若水之浮泛，惟憑土以隄防。土重而無木䟽通，遂歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"愚濁；金堅而無火鍛鍊，終是凶頑。至若金脆火炎，多則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276703269"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"損已；木柔金重，利則傷身。水淸而不假土多，土弱而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"禁木盛。火强燥而微眇，水畧濟以寛和。須將勻配為佳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"亦以均調為美。大顯者，貴乎深隱；大屈者，必㑹早伸。壽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"極年髙，皆是祿臨帝旺；職崇位顯，為緣馬㑹生宫。華盖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"逢迎，偏宜僧道；學堂遇貴，惟利師儒。五行若也蕭索，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"命因而低弱。日逢空寡，其妻多致生離；時値孤虚，其子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"多饒不肖。絶宫為皷盆之煞，胎宫為白虎之神。天空臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣息之宫，末歲損成家之子。運逢吉宿，無本主則未足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701043763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"歡娛；限守凶神，有根苗則不須畏懼。歲君若臨惡弱，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"歲迍邅；生時若値休囚，一生愁嘆。源清者，其流必遠；本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"濁者，所作無成。八字超羣，不貴即當大富；五行駁雜，居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"安可不慮危。休囚者，身性卑微；旺相者，聲名壯實。先强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"後弱，必先吉而後凶；始弱終强，亦始凶而後吉。乃若初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"逢貴局，未可便作貴推；中遇凶强，豈可便為凶兆。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"文星好長生之地，刑煞宜死絶之宫。是以當憂不憂，聞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"喜不喜。詳其本末，察體盈虚。榮辱窮通，不言而喻，吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561265186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"悔吝，可考而知。名曰造微，豈云小補。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"天地萬物最靈者人。自一念媾精之兆，含先天無極之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"仁。根在苗先，貴莫貴乎胎息；實從花後，重莫重於時辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲君體，統攝煞局，勲垣日月，代用流行，富貴貧賤。欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"究虚實，先由胎而及歲；要知吉凶，必原命以推身。土在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"齊吳，驗木炁火羅之正變；天心午未，察計羅金孛之屈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"伸。勿以所愛者，盡作吉看；勿以所憎者，悉為凶論。無中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561281570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"還有，有中還無，則吉者反凶，凶者反吉。甲子歲，木乾命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"坎，四柱無戌亥，乃不吉之吉，吉不可量。甲午歲，水巽命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"離，四柱無已辰，乃非凶之凶，凶為已甚。甲戌旬，火羅申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"酉子丑，命逢申酉太歲，則福起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"火羅恩星在申酉空亡之地，遇申酉年太歲塡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"實恩星，則為福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰旬，土計寅卯巳酉垣，遇寅卯流年則禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"計難星在寅卯空亡之地，遇寅太歲塡實，則禍生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"特言其生尅，尚未盡其愛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"憎。官福田財，比同生氣；奴兄疾相，何異煞神。身居官祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"陰賤陽貴；主入閑極，男晦女貞。官祿田財俱無氣，家無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701076531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"擔石之儲；身命相貌俱受傷，身有刑傷之苦。遷移㑹馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"早歲暌離；疾厄逢生，暮年康泰。吉星坐戍寅，限歲逢空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"防小人之窺筭；凶星加巳午，福月用煞，招上貴之甄陶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"用則火可生金，達則水可尅土。其間守對三合，𩔖有顚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"倒五行。固不可刻舟求劍，尤不可膠柱調絃。智者如珠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"之走盤，愚者按圖而索驥。不辭緬縷，用爾發明。賈似道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"命癸酉庚申、丙子丙申，立命玄枵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"子上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"安身析木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"羅空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"戍地，木廟寅宫，木羅俱煞，豈不傷身？夫何權傾中外，威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730305043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"振人主。盖羅化煞其身，宫與木適居元空地，木為禍主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"是身與福星俱以煞羅為用。二十六後，大限入寅，釣起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"木羅，勃然而起，此遇煞逢空發也。五十九後，限入八，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"將旬屬空亡，土為命主，水為限主，一火在丑，體用俱傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"竄逐而死，此時轄晚年之騐也。舉此為例，學者舉一隅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"而反三隅，斯為美矣。其他格局，萬緒千條，不離殿駕，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"人勲垣，田財官福，取用則在環朝拱夾，衝合虚實，富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤，明如止水。大抵身命祿曜抱括空亡，官福田財朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393525772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"臨垣局，𠔥三才而兩之，混六合而一也，乃有為之人，建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"非常之業。至若胎命身曜環拱官福，官福田財朝拱垣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"城，印綬拱，時命、時命拱，官福、命官、命主環拱用神，歲得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"年星貫朝，祿命官福互垣，田財㑹聚，皆功名勲爵之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"盡富貴利達之士。踏空則方袍團領，步玉登金，生實則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"佩印乘軒，澤民致主。又有貧窮忽富貴，盛極則凶危，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"月駕籍之宫，祿馬亡刼之位，留情審諦，注意推詳。日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"交輝之地，有煞欲制。年時聚貴之宫，逢生忽空。凶者福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958454323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"實値空，吉者煞空坐實。要當認火為金，慎勿指水作木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"古人謂燕雀不生鹿，狐兎不乳馬，所以我之喜者，彼亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"喜之，彼之忌者，我亦忌之。體究一源，用叅八字。四柱坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"生成貴祿者，名髙利厚；四殿拱田財身命者，家富身榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星登殿駕拱財官入宫，有横來之財祿。祿星照胎月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，田祿承䕃，享見成之鎡基。地祿建寅，天元肇子，故丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"卯陽生巳宫，乃坐祿，而癸酉一陽戌地，則以實而不虚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"知命君子鑑之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092510772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":685,"lineType":9,"content":"星辰霄鑑經太史陳卓註","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"史有郞官上應列宿之語，傳有庶民中存惟星之言。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"閒廟旺遲留，須當精詳窮究。乗旺入廟，終為廊廟之才；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"五怒三刑，豈掌權衡之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"旺者：日戍月、酉金、亥木、未水、已火、丑土、辰紫、亥孛、未羅、寅計已。正廟者：日戍月、戌金、辰水、亥水、午火、卯土、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"丑紫、丑孛、未羅、午討戍。遲留者，應數所許也。順吉，遲留不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"宫主得位，縱臨弱限，不足為虞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"宫主者，命主星也。得位者，旺廟髙强也。縱弱限亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092527156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"身主髙强，假使科名，䧟而無害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"身主者，身宫學堂也。要髙强，縱科名䧟亦吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"金水相㑹，其人頓使有文章。月火同宫，此命平生多坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"坷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"金水同宫吉，月火同主，平生坎坷。都例經云：就中火星多灾障，相對在强并在月中，年困多苦歇㓕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"三方有用，見印綬以遷榮。八煞無凶，遇吉星而照擢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"三方者，乃三方主星也，有用則得地。印綬者，相主星曜也，主遷職榮貴。八煞者，疾厄宫，無惡星也。若遇吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"星，主限發福超達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541852200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"非格非局，見善曜未必為竒。逢怒逢囚，縱文學徒然費","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"格局者，謂星旺廟髙，三方有用。怒囚者，即五怒三刑，主費力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"庸人之命，亦多木德金星。君子命中，豈少羅㬋月孛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"庸人亦有。金木星，君子命中亦犯。羅計土孛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"先貧後富，想初限伏逆。䧟宫先富後貧，諒遷移逢於惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"限者，三才限主星也。初星䧟先貧，末星䧟後富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701092915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"終身享福，三方總在髙强。一世迍邅，五怒復逢伏逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"三方髙强吉，五怒又行伏逆凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"中年稱意，命星臨官祿之鄕。末限昌隆，身主在遷移之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"命星，主星也。要在髙强官祿宫，身主學堂，要在遷移宫吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"祖財破蕩，權星與惡曜同行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":751,"lineType":2,"content":"惡曜者，土火計孛。權星者，甲木、乙金、丙土、丁月、戊水、巳炁、庚訃、辛羅、壬火、癸孛。忌同惡曜，謂之枵星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"動止傷殘。囚星與蝕神，其位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958487091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":757,"lineType":2,"content":"甲計乙羅之𩔖是。囚星蝕神者，羅計怕與囚同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"五星躔度，貴在留順有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"五星者，前順後逆，皆喜。留惟有火土宫四，餘皆不喜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱之中，惟嫌囚怒無氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱者，年月日時，亦人命也。忌逢囚怒星，無氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"四元皆䧟，初中無救則貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"四元者，乃天地人壽元皆䧟，無救星主貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"九事並强，身家有歸必貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432652791871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"九事者，四元三限祿主命星也。及身命壽髙强，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星更逆，縱然貴必不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":779,"lineType":2,"content":"忌星者，日火夜正在，身命更逆，雖貴不乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜逢囚，設使富而不乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"惡曜者，火上計羅孛囚星會，雖富而不乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"善星權貴，遇之必定淸華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"善星者，金木水日月星也。權貴為權星，主貴，如遇之，必淸貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"喜曜髙强，逢者無疑榮顯。伏逆不順，得之恰也。如無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453395541868584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":793,"lineType":2,"content":"喜曜者，乃命主要用星辰也。髙强喜見，然得順方為吉，逆則無力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"飛起逢囚，此等遇如不遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":797,"lineType":2,"content":"飛起何宫分。善星纒忌，逢囚縱有如無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"木星紫炁見太陽，必作髙僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":801,"lineType":2,"content":"木星乃僧道之星也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑鎭星値月孛，必為曹吏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"火土忌孛月㑹為吏或軍人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"格局淸顯，當為館閣之官。木旺水淸，必拜玉堂之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415393542156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"木旺水入廟，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人之命，非惡曜以難榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":815,"lineType":2,"content":"惡曜廟旺，或為主星限，逢之必發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"五弱之宫，順行限而方發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":819,"lineType":2,"content":"有用星怕弱，逆行順段限，逢之方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"木雖難而遇火，禍反為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":823,"lineType":2,"content":"命宫雖有木星為忌見火星化祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"孛獨行而無金，安能為害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840493095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"月孛星要獨行，大忌金星相對。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂䧟却，才髙而不解成名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"身宫主星，䧟則成名晚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"天首獨行，庸軰而須還享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":837,"lineType":2,"content":"羅星大喜日在六陽宫，獨行吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星逢于忌怒，婚合難終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":841,"lineType":2,"content":"妻星金星也，逢忌怒，必主尅妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"宫主飛入休囚，科名無實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276736037"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"命主星忌囚同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"木。紫。土臨人馬，位處封侯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"三星喜在寅位，日生主封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"金計土入雙魚，身為將相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"三星喜在亥上相聚。如在命宫，主將相之仕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"水星逢孛，為色招凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":859,"lineType":2,"content":"水星忌與孛同，多主因色喪身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"金德入兊，因妻致富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561314338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"金星喜酉，必主陰貴成身，或妻家富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"五星伏逆，逢吉曜以難榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"在伏逆段，雖遇貴星，亦不成富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"身命髙强，遇空宫而反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"身命宫主坐在髙强宫，縱四空下生，亦須發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛金星同位，累冐憲章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"火忌孛，孛忌金，金忌火。三星相㑹主凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"土計水德同宫，頻遭編配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453415561297954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"三星㑹者，主徒配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星如臨身命，性習低微。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"惡星無用，或下入廟旺生身宫，多好下賤，不喜髙上之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"劍鋒如㑹命宫，交遊豪俊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"惡星有用，或入廟旺，主性好髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"仕途若逢黑道，爵祿難髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"仕宦之人，限逢計都，多退職。計都者為尾，黑道之宿也，作事不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"公吏如遇三刑，因權退職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958503475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":901,"lineType":2,"content":"公吏人命不可犯三刑，主遭罪退職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"最貴者諸星乗樂，其間反覆未為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"五星皆宜乘旺樂廟。反覆者，退留順疾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"最凶者六曜暗囚。若是命主，反為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"日月炁孛羅計為六曜，或作囚星，得逢凶反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"科名䧟而無貴，謾進趨求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":913,"lineType":2,"content":"科名乃甲乙木星之𩔖是也。若䧟無救，主不進。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星弱而有囚，多圖不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432652808255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"魁星甲羅戍火之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲若臨德合，一歲迍邅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":923,"lineType":2,"content":"主凶哭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭若併生時，終年坎坷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":927,"lineType":2,"content":"天庭亦太歲也，與時併並主災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"朝榮暮辱盖為金孛同宫。初困後榮盖因限逢末福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"乃大限也。先見吉則光榮，後見吉則後榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星者，天之文府，見之詞翰淸華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840509479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"魁星主貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"九事相扶，入廟則文章冠世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"九事喜廟旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄最宜獨位，免受其殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":945,"lineType":2,"content":"疾厄囚星固不喜雜諸星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"男女若遇弱宫，晚年方有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"男女天嗣也。甲月乙水作，男女進福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁星為晦氣，男孤而女子無夫。東方水曰吉神，縱破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432652857407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"也還他復位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":957,"lineType":2,"content":"木星者東方甲乙生，主散災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"四元駁雜，終身只是腐儒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":961,"lineType":2,"content":"三元祿主皆䧟名，駁雜乃白衣人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"三貴髙强，不貴亦須大富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":965,"lineType":2,"content":"三主居髙强，不貴即富也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"亷貞若臨身命，嗣續有傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":969,"lineType":2,"content":"亷貞，羅計也。在命宫主尅子息，縱有亦主貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453399958470707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"科目更入命宫，妻身難任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":975,"lineType":2,"content":"科目者，諸星也。命宫主尅，三妻方且保守，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻害子。太乙與首尾同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙孛星若同羅計，必尅妻子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"失業亡家。熒惑與刑囚共位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":983,"lineType":2,"content":"火星怕與刑星囚星共位，主災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"駝腰跛足。囚星火土同行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":987,"lineType":2,"content":"囚星者，疾厄星也。若日生與火同，夜生上同，或都共位，駝腰跛足之疾，作主星雖貴，不免疾厄之苦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092543540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"瘖啞盲矓疾厄，計羅共位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":993,"lineType":2,"content":"疾厄者亦囚星，或與計羅共位，主疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"是以强星入廟，豈可便作貴看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":997,"lineType":2,"content":"星入廟旺，不照身命二宫，亦無益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"命遇惡星，安可便為凶論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1001,"lineType":2,"content":"如火土羅計孛在孛命二宫，未可便為凶論。若作主星，有如祿主甲火乙孛之𩔖。又羅主星在陽宫，火孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1003,"lineType":2,"content":"計在陰宫，夜生人亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"推其强弱，細察幽微，休咎吉凶，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701109299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1009,"lineType":9,"content":"星辰瀛海經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
