{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"才名髙顯，紫金臨身命之宫。粟帛豐饒，紫土入田園之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"次。登第若逢年少，金水髙强。臨文兼及科名，忌星莫犯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"綬星入選限之宫，須由正奏。馬貴居壽元之上，定中甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"科。選祿朝元，喜紫金星居禁闕。時星入樂忌刑，晦度入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"封疆。分野。星居本度，利祿宜人。選除限入官宫，銓曹遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"主官優銓長。官星與科甲同明。限値忌刑，寺府以丞郞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"佐理。紫木臨財重佐，必膺錢榖合衝。有巳祿秩，定黜坑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840542247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"塲。臨文値命，豈姓字之𤰞沉。限度不刑，見師儒之榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"魁文星入官宫，甲科首選。天乙光臨冊府，館職榮登。學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"堂廟地，優登翰墨之塲。度分强宫，驟入臺郎之貴。水逰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"雙女，官居給舎郞臺。紫占限躔，職入淸華禁苑。天乙加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官祿，館殿優㳺選除。星入忌刑，初中迷滯。官同祿綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"居强，入叅禁從。限怕忌刑犯守，升礙銓曹。九事㑹限，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"膺九棘之榮。二忌主方，亦入二丞之貴。正臨七品，官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"與印綬同明。從厯九丞，地祿以凶刑入忌。計同人綬朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701125683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"元，入提樞柄。孛共權星，主向出鎭刑臺。印文廟旺，著三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"館之才猷；限祿刑衝，大一同之政績。聲馳玉帳，官星以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"金火加臨；部領邉疆，選限以土羅衡照水宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1049,"lineType":2,"content":"已申也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"文星，禁地入蓬仙，火位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"戌卯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"將權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"金火羅計也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"使節牙璋征","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"遠塞。選擢右科，天乙入火金之舎；官臨邉守，太白資首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"尾之威。鸞坡節制，科名與科甲同宫；鴈塞征强，走曜逐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"黄幡入限。金垣帶貴，任三品於樞庭；限忌逢官，祗外遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"於藩鎮。曹銓知遇，祗緣選限星髙；陞擢驟遷，𠔥得髙官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701142067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"曜合。科星忌䧟，少年登第應難；祿主髙强，中限臨官又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"顯。金星輔日，臨文還取髙科；武曜佐權，選授必居躐等。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"順星迎魁宿之强，早初登第；逆度値忌星之合，中末題","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"名。藩垣守土，十一曜以朝元；選祿値星，六合宫而降等。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"貴由科目，文星順入强宫；官出雜流，人元必以刑忌。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"犯科文，異日方登上第；時臨惡曜，中年乃顯仕途。臺丞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"戰掾，四元限付權謀；師幕兵叅，多忌星𠔥限弱。身入財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"宫無惡忌，省府優登。星居順殿守廟垣，丞郎佐理。優登","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276752421"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"瀛府。官星與祿主同明對。犯忌宫貼。職以花城降品；貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"由承襲，馬元還入官宫。居享羡餘，祿主元居職位。計羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"動以朝元，出兼權柄；火土忌而犯屬，入佐中臺。珠珍餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"羨，察飛伏以臨財；省府遷除，以星躔而拱日。印星拱日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"定膺府寺之榮；枓目同宫，兼領外臺之貴。命分十曜，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"飛拱於太陽；限㑹三星，必依光於帝座。官優府寺，以財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"限之主宫；佐入丞郞，怕忌星之犯舍。權曜順而主向，威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"總軍戎；福星守以限躔，職司藩鎮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1095,"lineType":2,"content":"羅為黄幡，計為豹尾，即天節天惡星也。在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730337811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1099,"lineType":2,"content":"好樂喜廟旺之宫曰順行。木金紫日月得地皆福也。要入限，乃帥臣守土之格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1101,"lineType":9,"content":"玉衡經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"日為衆星之宗，身乃一身之主。衆星司令，稟陽君方敢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"行威。三日逢刑，縱月光不能為福。書生從日，喜居六陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫。夜生從月，利見六陰之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1109,"lineType":2,"content":"子丑寅卯辰己，六陽也。午未申酉戍亥，六陰也。日喜居陽，月喜居陰，最怕失位。設若反背，未免災迍。酉乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1111,"lineType":2,"content":"西沉，生於卯時，必然夭折。卯為東照，生于酉時，必難長大。經云四月卯時人不壽，可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"若論陰陽，須看晝夜。背太陽於父有憾，背太陰於母有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962503715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"虧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"五星俱要比和，以得時為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1121,"lineType":2,"content":"經云得地不須論䧟弱，失時何必論髙强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘不宜衝突，而獨行為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1125,"lineType":2,"content":"单羅獨計能為福，獨孛孤熒最利人。雜犯有禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"伏逆無光，順行有氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1129,"lineType":2,"content":"五星有遲留伏逆，順行者由我，逆行者由他，受制則聽命于人也。盖曜髙强，逢之則能榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"金星孛命，好色而假淸髙。木德臨垣，剛德而懐惻隱。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962536483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨命，多學少成。火若當權，恣行惡毒。沉謀熟慮為緣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"土入命宫，巧𥮅多機，或者計居垣位。獨孛則為人慳吝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"单羅則賦性貪婪。紫炁照臨，為人伶俐。雖是星辰如此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"又看月令若何。女命限到火躔，防夫害子。男命限到月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"躔，招妾招妻。水孛如守田財，難招祖業。火羅若臨父母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"㓜失慈親。命主逢陽終富貴，安身傍母必尊榮。一宫遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"孛，終身漂泊無拘。十地逢羅，少年誇豪逞訟。水羅若居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"子午，終尅也有情。木土偏愛陽宫，雖戰而無損。彗星晝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840558631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"見，女人反以為殃。天乙夜行，男命見之反尅。年月日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"三生値煞，立見刑徒。官魁進爵，三主髙强，自然榮顯。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"月互垣，必有立成之分。水陽得局，豈非榮顯之人。主星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"喜居毋地，主傍貴以成家。毋星飛入命垣，多因妻而致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"木居獅子，居官不能享官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1165,"lineType":2,"content":"木星居于午宫，乃烟飛火滅之鄉，雖有官而不能享也。經曰：木星得令，早歲科名。然在午則為忌星，楠𥚙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1167,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432652873791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"計入三陽，有祿不沽于祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1173,"lineType":2,"content":"三陽，寅宫也，非計所居之地。然亥乃官祿之所，故祿最忌刑囚暗耗。計若居寅，乃能衝破。以寅癸生人論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"水喜順而不喜逆，土愛煖而不愛寒。以元守官食合論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"人之享用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1179,"lineType":2,"content":"元，天元也。食乃食神，合是天干合。論命不論元守官食合論人之享用，不識變通造化。如甲人，木為天元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1181,"lineType":2,"content":"火為祿主，辛為官，丙為食神，已為合是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"以官魁爵祿馬定人之前程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1185,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子生人，用金為官，羅為魁，土為爵，木為祿元，水為馬，此四星守照，逢生坐實，主一世富貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432652890175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"最喜者，四角之有星；所忌者，三宫之無曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1191,"lineType":2,"content":"四角，寅申已亥，三宫即申子辰之𩔖。四角有吉星則吉，三宫無星則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"馬臨官祿，出祖成家；祿入妻宫，因妻致富。男命安居子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"午，必强狠而專權；女人命立巽乾，必淫冶而誇色。坐貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜衝貴，見合不宜見刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1199,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生人命坐亥，貴在已，對衝則近貴，不為力也。又如貴人宜合不宜見刑，合則致其喜，刑則致其怒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"立身合論馬元。失官則徒然奔走","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1203,"lineType":2,"content":"凡坐命馬上，若得官禄主星同守之，則馬有拘朿，不致奔走。不然必勞碌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962520099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"聚財則觀財庫，無守則必定敗亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"如金庫在丑，若官祿財星臨于丑宫，則有収拾。又要看合拱，無他煞尅破則吉。若庫主失經受制，凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"不須輕用閑奴。此等須當我用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1213,"lineType":2,"content":"若兄弟奴主有來破我財庫，則為他用，我將何用？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不宜真，真難磨滅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"申子辰，煞在已，若安命其上，乃真煞也。若當令凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"祿不宜破，破則貧窮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"甲祿在寅，申宫有煞星衝，則為破祿，主衣食艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340508202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"孤而加寡，妻子難為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"寅卯辰生丑為寡，己為孤。男忌孤，女忌寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"空以加亡，功名難遂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1231,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子旬生人，甲為陽，見戍為空，見亥為亡。乙入見亥為空，見戍為亡是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"刑不宜戰，戰則必刑。三刑帶戰，必然刑害。合不宜衝，衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"則必破。合還衝破，作事無成。論刑須要論煞，刑害重而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"難當。論官必論魁星，官魁合而必貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1239,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生人以金為官，以羅為魁，逢生旺，居官享福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340524586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"旣參官星，本宿當以太陽相參。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"官星即官祿主星也。奈何以太陽相參？盖午宫天盤以日為主，官星故以此參也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"雖論刑害星辰合以天煞互論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1249,"lineType":2,"content":"人盤本無煞，若加盤上天煞來臨，更逢凶神禍甚。二句結上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"兩煞夾垣須破相，三刑臨煞必傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":1253,"lineType":2,"content":"且如辰生人已有煞，卯有刄，主帶疾。破相三刑即寅刑己，己刑申。煞若在申，主夭折","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"身命。最喜入宫坐，閑坐奴將何用。日月不宜夾煞、夾祿、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"夾貴以為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340540970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"子午為聖人端坐之宫，諸煞莫入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1263,"lineType":2,"content":"二宫乃端門帝座，凶神俱不敢犯，限到此，雖危無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍為小人惡弱之地，天乙莫臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1267,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙乃貴人也。辰戌本惡弱之宫，貴人豈居之哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"煞立必暗金可畏。若臨命宫，夭折無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1271,"lineType":2,"content":"此論四暗金煞。戍宫婁金度秋生，未宫鬼金度夏生，丑宫牛金度冬生，辰宫亢金春生。若人立命遇此四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1273,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，更魂星同遇，定主貧夭。魂星即飛亷也。余謂暗金恐是的煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"限遇，惟明火無情。若居煞位，惡凶難免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340557354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1279,"lineType":2,"content":"火居八極宫，行限遇之，煞星有令，主九死一生之斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"日月若居華盖，僧道流行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1283,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戍丑未為華盖，日月居之，主孤尅。不然僧道之流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬如䧟空亡，巫醫術士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1287,"lineType":2,"content":"如人命坐官祿及祿馬之宫，落空亡，九流術士也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花帶合，男女皆為無禮之淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1291,"lineType":2,"content":"如申子辰生見雞，寅午戌生人見兎，亥卯未見䑕，己酉丑見馬，為桃花也。若辰宫命人，見酉為合，為祼刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1293,"lineType":2,"content":"露體，男女皆為無禮之淫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340573738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"隔角逢孤，縱有嗣續，皆過房之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1299,"lineType":2,"content":"隔角如未申亥子丑寅已午是也。若人命逢之，更孤神同照身，定主過房螟蛉之子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"坐祿向馬，乃利名顯達之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1303,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅生人命坐寅，馬居申，乃坐祿向馬，水木得令，顯達之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"對祿坐貴，亦文章騰踏之士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1307,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬癸生人命坐巳，祿在亥，貴人。又有已為對祿坐貴，定文章之士終貴。然不如坐祿向馬為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"更不宜坐貴向勲，有官無祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1311,"lineType":2,"content":"命在貴人，對官勲者，為人取祿稍遠，有馬無祿矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340590122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"若能㑹祿馬交命，祿厚官髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1317,"lineType":2,"content":"祿馬二星夾身夾命，不富即貴。故曰祿馬夾命身富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"命臨六厄，三周必見災危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"六厄，馬前六害也。小兒立命于此三周之中。災凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"煞値三元，晚年方可進用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1325,"lineType":2,"content":"三元，陽男陰女衝前一辰，如子衝午未是也。陰男陽女衝後一位，是限行。只此尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"木羅㑹舍，喜入寅宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1329,"lineType":2,"content":"如六甲生人寅宫，命木羅臨㑹寅，謂文科守命宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340606506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"水計相刑，怕居辰地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1335,"lineType":2,"content":"二星相刑，主惡死。更加刑地不延年。己申命尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"刼頭乃非活路，刄末最是凶關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1339,"lineType":2,"content":"刼煞初逢至凶，陽刃臨脫至狠，故曰刼頭刃尾。凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星作黨，有不巳之戰爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1343,"lineType":2,"content":"如坐命宫，羅計孛同位，或三合見之，戰爭無巳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"二母爭權，乃制過于姑息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1347,"lineType":2,"content":"如火如羅，剛對剛也。木見炁，孤尅孤。上見計，遲鈍對遲鈍。水見孛，柔弱對柔弱。土命火羅，单行妙也。餘倣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340622890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1351,"lineType":2,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"孤日臨于命限，勤苦勞心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1355,"lineType":2,"content":"孤日守命限勞苦。盖孤陽不生，孤陰不長成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"一月单臨官祿，精靈可愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1359,"lineType":2,"content":"月要单行為妙，謂之孤月獨明。若當射三方無刑尅方好。如照官祿二宫，主夜生精彩最顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人當以身宫為重，男人當以八煞為權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1363,"lineType":2,"content":"女人身宫淸吉則尊貴，若凶星居之，則𤰞賤矣。男人若八煞宫吉星居之，主有威權，凶星居之，則有凶禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"靣目傷殘，刑囚不宜傷相貌。心神漂泊，水孛最忌入遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340639274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1371,"lineType":2,"content":"遷移本流遷之地，水孛又是漂泊之星，在宫心神泛濫不寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"對照逢羅，婚姻反掌。五宫逢孛，男女虚花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1375,"lineType":2,"content":"月孛當頭須損子，羅㬋在命必傷妻。見木方有子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅者為妻。對宫之禍福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1379,"lineType":2,"content":"如立命卯宫屬火，對衝酉宫金為妻。便看金星居于何所，而以强弱虚實定其禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"命𤰞而閒健，三位有鬭爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1383,"lineType":2,"content":"如立命亥，以酉為閒極，金健木弱，必爭鬬也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340655658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"二主臨財，資財豐厚。兩强戰尅，田宅動揺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1389,"lineType":2,"content":"身命自臨，財帛無尅，財必豐盈。兩强星戰尅，田宅不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"福星喜臨垣，祿星宜鎮位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1393,"lineType":2,"content":"福居福垣，祿居祿上，逢生旺，無不貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"以木炁金水為君子，以火羅計孛為小人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1397,"lineType":2,"content":"木炁金水受制，君子不能為福。火羅計、孛四星得時有用，則小人為大事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"十二煞神，子細推詳。三百六十，細參吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1401,"lineType":2,"content":"一太歲。二生氣。三喪門。四天醫。五官符。六死符。七年破。八龍德。九福德。十天德。十　一弔客。十二病符。一云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340672042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1405,"lineType":2,"content":"九白虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1407,"lineType":9,"content":"磨鐫賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"命惟一理，人為物靈。五星緯天，相尅相生而不定。二氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"賦命，其生其死之弗齊。須知取用多門，務必考叅諸說，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"詳觀制化，更識安危。富貴雙全，盖是用星制難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"如午安命，木炁為難，被金尅，羅被水尅是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"貧寒一世，只縁仇主傷恩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"立命子宫火為恩，被水尅，羅為次恩，被孛尅是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340688426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"恩居四正定超凡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"恩用二星守命㑹妻男，田財官福是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"難若當頭何用説？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1429,"lineType":2,"content":"如難星當頭照命，不吉無救。倒限有救。疾病破財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"仇難守命，非過房離祖，定主異姓同居。忌難臨身，非庻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"出偏生，必是塡房入舎。或刑傷骨肉，或出自貧寒。要明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"大化之機，不可一例而斷，取彼舎此，認假成真。難星若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"占田財，斷無祖業。恩星司守田宅，廣置田庄，凶中變吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340704810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"盖緣仇主受降，吉中成凶。却是恩星受制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1443,"lineType":2,"content":"官福田財，命宫主星逢生坐實財吉，反此則凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"難星秉令限宫，終身成敗破碎。刑傷財庫，衣祿艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":1447,"lineType":2,"content":"行限宫遇難星，得令無制，則成敗多矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"忌難同行當獲福，恩仇如遇主無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1451,"lineType":2,"content":"忌難同行自相尅，反吉。恩星到限忌亦到，則破害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"引鬼入室，貧不自聊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1455,"lineType":2,"content":"如子命水孛，守命木炁，合水孛拱照，主貧賤一世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340721194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"難星為用不可戰，尅化難生恩，福來不小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1461,"lineType":2,"content":"難用同行相尅凶。無尅反為福更難來。生恩反福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"忌㑹仇星，必主刑傷。恩星守限遇仇來，禍生不測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1465,"lineType":2,"content":"忌仇二星同家，凶尤甚。恩守限遇仇相攻尅大凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"難若當頭逢用制福𨚫難量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1469,"lineType":2,"content":"如行限遇難本凶，若是用星正照，尅難又大發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"二母爭權，决不為福。兩鬼自鬭，豈是無災。恩星縱顯，重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"見無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340737578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1477,"lineType":2,"content":"恩重當頭，得地升殿。仇用遇之，再見無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"難仇雖輕，再見必死。逄恩不發，盖因恩在仇宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1481,"lineType":2,"content":"单逢恩則發，在仇宫則不𤼵。此以限逢而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"遇難不凶，是由難居用地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1485,"lineType":2,"content":"逢限地遇凶難，必然為禍。在用地則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"難守難宫禍不淺。恩居恩地福無量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1489,"lineType":2,"content":"難守正宫，禍來不小。恩星升殿，發福非輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"難坐恩宫，轉凶成吉。恩居仇地，縱發亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340753962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1495,"lineType":2,"content":"難星若居恩宫反吉。恩星若居仇宫尤凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"是知造化之機，難盡明言之斷。官星貫日，定為顯達之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"人。恩用居官，亦是榮華之客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1501,"lineType":2,"content":"官祿貫太陽富貴。恩用二星照官祿宫尤貴顯。亦審虚實强弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"更無駁雜，何用狐疑。當看髙强，次推輕重。恩居用位，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"逢仇也見掀彰。難宫直待用恩來，方能榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":1507,"lineType":2,"content":"行限遇難本凶，若得恩用二星當途，方許發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星守照，須看三方。恩用照臨，必分正合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340770346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1513,"lineType":2,"content":"忌星三方拱照凶。恩用正照刀轉，重拱照刀轉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"恩無餘氣，藉用星而制仇。用若當頭，儘難星而作祟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1517,"lineType":2,"content":"忌命金為恩無餘氣，借木炁二星則富貴。更若太陰守命，雖限逢凶難，不為害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"向背固宜斟酌，晝夜更要推詳。夫妻本是難星，逢尅化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"反能偕老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1523,"lineType":2,"content":"如命辰水為妻，火為難，若同居，齊眉到老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"兒女主是恩宿，逢生旺反主刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1527,"lineType":2,"content":"如辰命，土為男女，火星同行，雖相生，終為難星主刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340786730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"恩守命宫，福祿雙全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1533,"lineType":2,"content":"恩星守命，必然富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"忌難臨身，破刑帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"如難星與身命二星同宫，縱然發福，亦主刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"巳身可免，母命難逃。命立土宫，諸宿喜躔火度。限行水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"局，三方忌見金星。木炁髙强，禍來無地。火羅夾命，福必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"滔天。二曜五星制化不同。三方四正照臨有氣。靑雲得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"路，恩星身命兩朝陽。白手成家，命主恩星同守宅。旣欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340803114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"求名請舉，須看當道祿神為難。忌則不榮無疑。化用恩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"而登科無慮。且看有無駁雜，庻㡬論命不差。行限。若遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"恩星，置田换宅。宫內如逢難曜，重病破財。或重或輕，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"黨有救。難星有黨得地，禍不可言。恩星坐實逢生，福尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"堪恃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1559,"lineType":2,"content":"身命主失纒，逢難則一生成敗反覆之間耳。已上本文甚明，然亦有註之者反生支節，故不錄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福依稀，盖是恩仇相雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1563,"lineType":2,"content":"恩星與仇星相混雜，則為禍福反掌耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340819498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"身命入恩，逢時發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1569,"lineType":2,"content":"身命纒難，度難宫至老艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"辰酉立命，土㑹太陰，須當獲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1573,"lineType":2,"content":"二宫安命，太陰㑹土，計乃恩星，反言富貴。又不以上忌犯太陰論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥立命，金氣臨身，將何以為？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1577,"lineType":2,"content":"二宫立命，太陰㑹金氣，謂之安身。傍鬼非金助，月華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅計孛本是凶神，化恩星，獲福莫量。木炁金水本為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"善宿，為忌難見禍最速。土命人行金限，遇火不能尅金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340835882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"而發福。土命人行木限，遇水反能黨木以生災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1587,"lineType":2,"content":"如子丑宫命行限酉金，乃金旺火衰。盖火生土，土生金，所以得助則福。如寅亥木限逢水旺則水助木尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1589,"lineType":2,"content":"土，所以災。生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢難在髙强，無救必然倒限。倘若恩居忌弱，有黨亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"不為祥。所以喜者，恩星秉令或逢生。最可嫌者，難星司","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"權𠔥有黨。恩居强宫逢生，行限遇之獲吉；難星秉令有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"黨，行限遇之無救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855949340852266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1gs4/1-SK1609_figure_00041.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FxCfGaErGLUHlUmBvU6Mtix3b%2Fg%3D","pictureHeight":309,"pictureWidth":318,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1gs4/1-SK1609_figure_00041.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hGCsACVN6i1VO8GJcftm%2F2ZoTGY%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1gs4/1-SK1609_figure_00041.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
