{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"碧玉真經，星家精要，余取而讀之，見其道理通隂陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"之運，格局盡星曜之𠮓，其㫖㣲，其言邃，未易以淺近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"窺也。近世編註圖例，破碎支離，弗得作者之意，余甚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"病焉。因暇日詳閲，融㑹其義，為之註解。雖未能盡合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962602019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"作者之意，而隂陽之運，星曜之𠮓，亦庶㡬窺其端云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":9,"content":"殿駕五星碧玉真經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"人為萬物之靈，覆載莫逃乎天地；命禀有生之初，災祥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"實係乎星辰。使其數少或有虧，則於人將何所頼？吕望","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"白頭為釣叟，時未來𠔃；子竒髫稚秉鈞衡，命使然也。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星者以本源為上，而論格者以殿駕為先。本或有差，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"末將何補？使一星背而難救其非，縱羣曜吉而莫能為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308518411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"福。或吉星入命而本主卑㣲，縱青衫入手，而身隨幻化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：凡觀星者，以本源為上，論格者以殿駕為先二句，乃碧玉經之綱領。故論五星，以命主身主為上，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"須坐殿駕合格局為貴。然二主所屬有淺深之不同，宫度有偏正之或異，茍或考究不真，其本亂矣，詳究","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"其末，亦何補哉。故命主虚虧，身主陷弱，恩星失躔，隂陽反背，是一星背也，何以自救其非？縱羣曜皆吉，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"入垣乘旺之類，亦屬閑辰，所以莫能為福也。或羣曜有吉星入命，而身命主却虚虧陷弱，是其本已𤰞㣲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"雖得榮名，豈能常享？可見論星者，當以本源為上也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"水居雙女，惟癸與巳酉丑之人。木入雙魚，乃甲見申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"辰之命。亥卯未逢丁，而火居卯位，寅午戌見庚，而金守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701174835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"辰宫，惟餘戊已生人，喜見土居丑位。雖見此五星之入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"格，亦湏滿三用，而入垣遇此者，何皆能為貴？金入酉，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"居戌，木臨寅，水居申，此乃偏垣，匪為正局。此曜若居本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"位，終身亦作貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"此首言五星入垣，乘旺為本源之要也。上五句乃五行各歸本垣，與當生嵗干合氣，更地支扶助，上則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"貴顯科名，次則為財富福壽。滿三用者，命主星入垣，又属仁元、馬元、禄元之類，或以之為恩為用，謂之三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"元並駕，禄又加官是也。盖格局髙竒，而又滿此三用，無有不貴顯者。金入酉四句，亦是五星入垣，但此以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"偏垣言，固雖不如前格局之髙，然五星既居本垣，亦不失為貴人也。星家以子丑二宫屬土，寅亥屬木，夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092609076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"戌屬火，辰酉屬金，申已屬水，然何以丑、亥、夘、辰已為土、木、火、金、水之正垣，而以子、寅、申、酉、戌為偏垣者，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":2,"content":"説？亥乃木之専主，夘乃火之自出，丑乃土之正位，辰藏三宿，獨亢居中，巳屬東南，萬派統㑹，故此五宫為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"正垣。寅木火相𠔥，戌火土各半，申水土並行，酉無金宿，子屬坎宫，是五者不得獨専其柄，故為偏垣。○一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"云殿者，當年天干也；駕者，地支也，本源者，命主也。天生地成，陽施隂受，合而為人，其氣相通而理亦相貫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"吾之命主歸窠，更與天干同垣，地支扶局，是謂得天地之正氣，方為正局。又必滿三用而後為貴。若空自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"歸垣，無殿駕以㑹合之，其氣尚與天地不相貫，故目之曰偏垣，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"火到金宫金受傷，金入火鄉金受制。火居水位，火神無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。木入金宫，木星有虧。水化伏尸，遇太陽豈為惡曜。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432653054015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"逢地刼，逢羅㬋𠮓作吉星。土埋雙女，見炁非凶。金騎人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，遇土則吉。有救皆善，無助則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"此繼言五星落陷受傷，而生尅制化不可以一律言也。五行皆喜生而惡尅，故五星所躔之宫亦然。然必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"無救解者乃為凶論，有救解者反是。水居戌宫，化為伏尸，本怒也，遇太陽之尊，水喜依輔，火不敢争，所以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"不為忌。木逢子位，名為地刼，本凶也，遇羅㬋之火，水生火，火轉生土，所以不為傷。土埋雙女，土尅水也，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"炁為柔曜以和解之，而又能制土之剛，故水不受傷。金騎人馬，木傷金也，有土為恩星以生旺之，而又能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"培木之根，故金為有救。盖五星生尅乃其常理，而制化之妙方成造化，學者宜詳察之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"水逢月孛，非夭則刑。金遇羅㬋，匪傷則折。紫木豈宜同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836317736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"舍，水火不可同居，若匪傷身，亦湏破病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"此以五星生尅制化無救者言也。水逢孛，木遇炁者，元氣脱也。金遇羅，火同水者，尅戰勝也。皆主刑夭折","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"傷，尤當審時令宫分，分向背往來㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"木先交，逢熒而易脱。火先入，遇木而有輝。使炁木無土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"則易失於偏枯。金火朝陽，則不成其戰尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"木行遲，火行疾，木先火後則火勢炎而易為煨燼，火先木後則火勢緩而漸有光輝。炁能泄木，有土則木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"得栽培，故不失於偏枯。火能尅金，朝陽則火氣降伏，故不成其戰尅。可見行度分先後，而吉凶頓異；同宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"遇助伏，而生尅則殊。在觀星者審之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276850725"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"木到大梁翻作咎，月居閑極反為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"木本善星，能作福也，惟到大梁則怒翻為凶論。閑極弱宫，不得力也，惟身主居之則喜反作祥。言。○又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"木怒大梁，月喜閑極，然其中又有得失之辯。假如午丑安命，則大梁之木反謂鬼星入弱；戌亥安命，則閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"極之月反謂安身傍鬼。不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽失位，必定為災。金木反盈，豈能邀福？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽，身命之主宰。日到日垣，月升月殿，則得位矣。如使晝生日在子之危、酉之畢，月在午之星、夘之房，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"失位也，則命本不立，必定為災。金木，仁義之吉宿，金居金度，木歸木經，則滿盈矣。如使金木同宫，金躔井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"角斗奎，木躔鬼、亢、牛、婁，是反盈也。有如同室之人，各乖其所，豈能邀福？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092592692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"既濟尤防於未濟，得經尤慮於失經。彼此貴乎相應，首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"尾懼乎相傷。若相刑相尅，則處世多迍。相順相和，則終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"身安静。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"此數句，總結上文之意也。彼此，分兩星而言；首尾，總一星而言。彼此句，應既濟。首尾句，應得經。盖謂此之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"既濟，尤防於彼之未濟。首而得經，尤慮於尾而失經。假如金躔辰宫，入垣為既濟矣。若三合對照，遇土計，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"則相應，是濟中之濟者也。若三合對照，遇火羅，則不應，是濟中之未濟者也。彼此貴乎相應，如金躔亢，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"得經於首矣。若當夏令，干音時日屬火，是不能全於尾矣，故首尾懼乎相傷。相應則和而順，終身安静。相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"傷則刑而尅，處世多迍。學者當詳究之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836334120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"他來刑我，我居廟旺亦何妨。我若賴他，他既休囚而何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"此以五星生尅制化，而論廟旺休囚也。廟者，入垣局也。旺者，得時令也。休囚者反此。凡觀命者，二主之外，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"當視恩難之廟旺休囚。假如寅宫立命，木入垣而春生，縱有刑來刑我，我何患焉？如木失陷而夏生，當藉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"水以濟，而水源夏絶，將焉賴之？餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"所喜者，官、魁、福、禄。所忌者，暗、耗、刑、囚。若往者吉，來者凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"則始焉成，而終焉敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"此以十干化曜言也。官魁福禄，曜之吉者，命之所喜；暗耗刑囚，曜之凶者，命之所忌。若先入者吉，後至者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730436115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"凶，則始焉值吉而成，終焉值凶而敗矣。若先入者凶，後至者吉，反此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁拱命，當膺孟子之萬鍾；福禄夾身，可比石崇之巨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"富。左右吉星，最喜拱主，前後忌曜，尤忌傷身。刑囚拱夾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"雖韓信難免遭刑；暗煞加臨，縱龎㳙焉能迯命？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文而歸重於身命也。言官魁彰顯而拱命，又必受拱者之廟旺，得以享其重禄。福禄垣窠而夾身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"又必受夾者之髙强，得以任其巨富。夫左右吉星，既最喜于拱主，而前後忌曜，尤切忌乎傷身。刑囚拱夾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"必主弱而鬼强。暗煞加臨，復凶難而㑹煞。如此則難免韓龎之禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄夾身為上客，隂陽拱命豈凡夫。計孛往來，尤恐傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840640551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"夀。火羅反背，是豈為災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"此六句，舉官福隂陽，就其吉星之重者而言之。舉火羅計孛，就其凶星之剛者而言之。然福禄不夾身，隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"陽不拱命，亦為無用。計孛不往來，亦不大害；火羅非反背，乃始為災也。往來者，此往而彼來。假如孛角十，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"計亢四，命主在亢初，孛順往而計逆來，前後夾廹，必然傷夀。反背者，相反而背去。假如羅角五，火亢八，命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"主在角十二，羅往西而火行東，金雖在中，而火羅反背，不能為災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"煞前主後，當膺藩輔之權。煞後主前，必有徒流之患。煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"星入命，是豈為煞。刑曜傷身，惟其自刑。身命坐煞，煞本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"為榮。本主逢官，官能遷轉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276899877"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"此條以煞與命對㸔，亦承上文火、羅、計、孛而言之。蓋煞星各就命宫論，在十一曜俱有，然火、羅、計、孛，其煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"尤為利害，若煞在主前，而其主强，權膺藩輔；煞在主後，而其主輕，患配徒流。亦如子平，身强煞淺，假煞為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"權，煞重身輕，終身有損之意也。但子平以輕重言，此以前後言耳。煞星入命，安可就以煞論，湏身命陷弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"方能為煞，故云自刑也。是知身命兩宫在髙强而坐煞，則煞為我用，而本為榮。身命二主逢官禄而㑹煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"則官以煞顯，而能遷轉。假如子宫安命，以土為主，以卯為官，以木為煞，土在卯火，木亦在卯，木生火，火生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"土，豈不威顯？五七賦云催官天馬太嵗吊合煞方遷調是也。○舊説煞前主後者，如亥命金在戌，木在子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"反此是為煞後主前。愚謂前後者，歴家右算之前後也。先别主煞二星所行之遲疾留退，次察主煞之衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"旺向背，而後可以言吉凶。假如水月為命主在前，土計為難星在後，是煞後主前，凶矣。然水月行疾，土計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432653103167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"行遲，則後者不及於前，不可以凶論也。又如火為命主在後，水為煞在前，是煞前主後，吉矣。適水躔留退，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"火星順行，則前者返傷於後，此又不可以吉言也。且其中又有衰旺見伏者存焉，觀星者不可以一例論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽拱帝座，當為朝省正郎。日月夾垣城，便是廟堂宰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"帝座，命之時支；垣城，命之日支。人命重乎日時，故日月拱夾皆貴。然日之比時，尤為𦂳要，而夾之比拱，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"為親切。故其貴有小大，而其近君則一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"官忌囚星之反集，魁防暗曜以相侵。如禄星𠮓作刑星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"是吉曜反為凶曜。官非魁星莫誘其進，禄由官主始見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276834341"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"其榮。是必相資而後成，雖欲缺一而不可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"官魁，當年之吉曜；囚暗，當年之化曜也。囚集官，則官受辱；暗侵魁，則魁無光。是固命之所當忌防者也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄主𠮓作刑星，是吉曜反為凶曜。官待魁而進，是官魁相𠋣也。禄由官而榮，是官禄相湏也。蓋人命有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"官無魁，有官無禄，亦焉能以有成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"爵星助禄，當為顯貴吉人；禄主隨官，便是榮華上客。福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"喜居於福地，禄宜坐於禄宫。一世無災，終身有慶。福居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"禄地，福日見於川增；禄入福宫，禄時聞於山峙。星若無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"於駁雜，夀俾見於熾昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771893799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"爵者，地元爵。禄者，天元禄。爵星助禄，則禄益豐；禄主隨官，則官愈美。所以俱榮顯也。福者，福德主也。禄者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄主也。福居福，禄居禄，是各居本垣，固終身有慶。福居禄，禄居福，是彼此互垣，固福禄有加。然必無閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"神忌曜，以駁雜於其間，方夀命悠久，而享此福禄也。不然，亦豈能終保哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"隂忌計，陽忌羅，名為惡曜。日蝕朔，月蝕望，始為蝕神。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"火月土，莫臨十五度之中；隂計陽羅，怕在二三躔之內。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以日月為𦂳，而星以火、羅、計、孛為畏。日之所忌者，羅與火也；月之所忌者，土與計也。然日遇火羅，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"朔則蝕；月遇土計，在望則蝕。故日大月土，莫臨十五度之中；而隂計陽羅，怕在二三躔之内。餘時則輕，度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"逺不忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453419730452499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛當頭湏尅子，羅㬋在命必傷妻。水逢月孛，非緇尼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"必在娼門。炁遇羅㬋，乃清閑而為居士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"火、羅、計、孛，為剛星，當頭皆主尅子，在命俱主傷妻。然孛為妖彗，除舊布新之𧰼，以之當頭，則一畨掃除，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"尅子也。羅㬋逆行，截㫁隔别，以之在命，則彼此暌離，必傷妻也。水性無定，吉凶隨所遇之星，逢月孛，則妖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"滛無制，愈加流蕩。女命宫值此，非尼則娼也。炁性本柔，善解剛星之厄，遇羅㬋則和其毒而益其孤，愈見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"清髙。男命得此，乃清閑而為居士。○望斗經以火為兒，以金為妻。孛能尅火，羅能尅金，二星在命當頭，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"難為妻子。亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"耗居二四，難免傷財；主到九三，定須離祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771795495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"二四，財田宫也，宜聚而不宜耗。九三，遷閒位也，宜客而不宜主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"主入煞宫，非富則貴；煞侵命位，非夭則刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞宫，非疾厄之宫也。若以疾厄為煞宫，則辰酉卯戌同𩔖無煞，乃是甲子甲午起隂陽，甲辰甲戍起天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"秤，甲寅甲申起寳瓶，逆數至本生年位，使身命躔入其宫，則𠋣太嵗而得權，非富則貴。煞侵者，乃刼亡的","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"刃刑囚直難同鬼星犯命是也。更主弱無以制之，非夭則刑。○一説命主入疾厄宫，入垣升殿，化為官魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"福禄，不富則貴。疾厄宫主為難星，入命宫無制，加以刑囚直難，不夭則刑。亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"晝忌火，夜忌土，尤看三方。日從陽，夜從隂，總司百福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"晝夜指日月言，非晝夜之晝夜也。晝火興禍，夜土為災，然無忌於三方。詩云火在隂宫土計陽，縱有災殃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308485643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"還較可是也。晝重太陽，夜重太隂，實總司乎百福。經云：太陽入陷人終賤，身主逢刑處世難是也。○又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"晝隂夜陽，若是三方，主不以為忌，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"命臨妻位財豐阜，閒守身宫禄破除。主居相貌必長軀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"身守遷移須出祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以妻為財，命臨妻位，故財主豐阜，兄弟能刼我之禄。閒守身宫，故禄主破除。主居相貌，湏木守而軀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"方長。身守遷移，當落陷而祖方出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"白首奔忙塲屋，盖暗星守而主星㣲。丱角馳騁鄉閭，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星現而官星顯。或圭角不露而顯出於隠，或華實相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840673319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"副，從微而至著。魁彰官隠，少年薦鶚快横秋；官隠禄彰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"晚景化龍知有日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"此足上文官魁禄爵相資之意。蓋言暗星䕶守，而命主𤰞㣲，終為書債不了。魁星光現而官星顯著，必能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"少年發逹。又有韜光渾渾而圭角不露者，蓋由文魁顯星出於田財地下，隠而莫之遇也。又有文彩斌斌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"而華實相副者，蓋由官魁禄爵升於官禄天上，著而莫之掩也。又有魁彰官隠，則官由魁而進，以其魁先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"彰，故必早登於仕路。又有官隠禄彰，則禄待官而至，以其官尚隠，故湏晚嵗而得名。此可見窮逹之或異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"者，由於官魁之明暗；遲速之不齊者，由於官禄之隠彰。故曰是必相資而後成，雖欲缺一而不可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"禄在刑先，既榮復辱。耗居福後，雖榮亦枯。福刑胥㑹，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276916261"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"分在前在後之差。禄耗並行，當主一敗一成之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"此申明上文往吉來凶，始成終敗之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼非相，文旺身衰。李廣不侯，官髙禄薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"身命衰㣲，縱文星顯而不相；禄曜陷弱，縱官星髙而不侯。見人當以身命為𦂳，官禄為要也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕四空之無曜，尤㸔方主以何如。所喜八煞之有星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"亦㸔垣窠而奚若。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"四空者，三合與對宫也，最忌無星。若三方主居强坐實，雖空不以為忌。八煞宫者，解見前註。最喜有星，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":375,"lineType":2,"content":"湏㸔其星之垣殿何若，乃以為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771828263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"三方三日不陷則貴，八煞八元居髙則榮。三方有力，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"生發非横之財。八煞無虧，一世享優游之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":383,"lineType":2,"content":"三方者，假如亥卯未，安命金火月之𩔖。蓋其説以亥屬乾金，以夘屬火，以未屬月隂，從隂位，故為三方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"主。三日者，太隂前後三日宫也。蓋立命以太陽數至卯位，則凡三十日，同一時者，皆同一命宫，而太隂三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"日之内，巳行四十度，是人之安身，異日而移宫也，故重三日宫。使三方三日入弱遇惡，則主陷身虧，何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"取貴？故必不陷而後貴。八煞者，六甲布於申子辰，而逆數至生年，其法皆至八而更端，故曰八煞。八元者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"禄元、馬元、貴元、命元、壽元、天元、地元、人元，故曰八元。使八煞八元入弱失垣，則本傷位卑，何以為榮？故必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":393,"lineType":2,"content":"居髙而後榮也。然三方司一生之限，比三日為尤重，廟旺有力，定發非横之財，蓋不止於貴也。八煞掌一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292407849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"世之權，比八元為尤𦂳，髙强無虧，必享優游之福，蓋不止於榮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"官星入命，當主貴榮身。命坐官，亦能遷轉。官坐徳，徳坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"官，乃是徃來貴客。命入身，身入命，此為內外二臺，名曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"互垣，當膺顯爵。湏無惡曜以相雜，㫁曰終身而有權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"此一節専以身命官福互垣言也。官星入命位，則命得官而榮；命主入官福，則官佐命而顯。是身命官福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":407,"lineType":2,"content":"互垣格局，俱以美論。官福二宫皆為貴客，官坐徳，徳坐官，是徃來皆美，故曰貴客。身命二宫分為内外臺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"身入命，命入身，内外皆吉，故曰二臺。然互垣格局最怕惡曜雜之，不為純美，故又曰湏無惡曜以相雜，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"以終身而有權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453432653070399"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"君幸臣，臣背君，官難遷轉；母顧子，子顧母，禄必豐盈。徃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"或在於怒宫，來不居於樂地。此格虚言互垣不善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"此因上文言互垣之有未善者。太陽行徤而為巡狩之君，五星朝拱而為廵職之臣。君臣慶㑹，則上下咸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":421,"lineType":2,"content":"賴。如或太陽到於命宫，登殿坐駕，是君幸臣，而臣却背之不來，引從朝拱，是臣背君。官者，君之所予，今既","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"背之，安能遷轉？又有生我者為母，我生者為子，母子相依，則氣脉相闗。母顧子，如金入水位，則水賴以生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"子又顧母，如水入金鄉，則金以水潤。禄者，身之所享，今既相顧，豈不豐厚？然又當審君臣子母徃來之地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"何若也。假使陽君入西没之鄉，子母躔反盈之度，是謂怒地，雖名互垣，終歸虚格，而實不善矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"前引後從，貴有吉星。左提右挈，亦嫌凶曜。引從者吉，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962585635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"外貴乎空。提挈者凶，則內喜乎善。使夾拱之雖貴，恐包","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"羅之或遺。內拱雖善，而外拱者凶。始用皆諧，而終謀不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"引從者，身主之前後星也。提挈者，命主之左右星也。要吉而不要凶，喜應而不喜背。如引從之星吉矣，湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"外無忌曜以傷之。提挈之星凶矣，喜内有吉星以助之。若外之拱夾雖貴，而内之包羅有遺；内之拱夾雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"善，而外之照合不美，皆主終始成敗之㫁。此一節可與既濟未濟一條叅㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄若臨身命，其貴可知。刑囚外輔官魁，為災莫大。始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"雖禄秩無虧，終見暴亡不善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836350504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":451,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄臨身命，固為貴矣。然官之所忌者刑，禄之所忌者囚。若加以刑囚夾輔，官魁雖貴，不能悠久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"一星兩用，有吉助則以吉言。孤跡角形，若凶多，則從凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁。或𠮓不𠮓，而𠮓者貴乎吉。或用不用，而用者毋自傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"如凶星掌善事，富貴非遲。吉曜作凶神，敗亡亦速。凶無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"吉助，一生勞漉不曾閑。惡有善從，晚景優游能自樂。使","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"非凶之凶，而凶實難救。不吉之吉，則吉誠可嘉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"角形者，如角之形有兩也。一星兩用，與孤跡角形句同。言可以作吉，可以作凶。有吉助則以吉言，若凶多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"則從凶㫁也。𠮓者，承吉助而𠮓，不𠮓者，承凶多而不𠮓。用者，因吉而用之；不用者，因凶多而不用之。蓋言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771811879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"或有助而𠮓，或無助而不𠮓，如欲𠮓則貴乎吉，使𠮓而為凶，不若不𠮓之為無害也。或善而為用，或善而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"不用，如欲用之，則毋自傷，使用而自傷，不若不用之為無傷也。如火、羅、土、計、孛，本凶神也，或在官福而掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"善事，或為恩用而司官魁，則力雄氣壮，精彩愈倍，無不富貴。日、月、金、水、木炁，雖善星也，或在弱陷而作凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"神，或為仇難而㑹暗煞，則憤惋不平，不能相容，而敗亡尤速。不吉之吉，即凶星掌善事句。非凶之凶，即吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"曜作凶神句。盖言星雖吉凶有定，而實𠮓化無常。此一凶星也，無吉助而不𠮓，而勞漉乎平生；有善從而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"𠮓吉，而優游乎晚景。可見吉曜作凶神，是非凶之凶，凶實難救，而凶曜無吉助，但不免勞漉而已。凶星掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"善事，是不吉之吉，吉誠可嘉，而惡星有善從，亦能享優游而已。夫星之吉凶，人所知也。而中有不吉之吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"非凶之凶，非逹造化者，孰能識之？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771861031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚內拱，初年必定傷身。福禄外從，末主湏還享福。凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉用，用者皆吉。吉作凶行，行之亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"刑囚内拱者，左右夾也。福禄外從者，三方拱也。内拱則近，故初年傷身。外從則緩，故末年享福。若刑囚外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"從而福禄內拱，則初年享福而末年傷身，可逆推矣。凶為吉用四句，即上文凶星掌善事，吉曜作凶神之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶相雜，以先入為尊。善惡相半，以主星為上。先凶後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，乃惡星入而吉星從。先富後貧，乃財星弱而耗星徤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"此指一宫者而言，分先後主客也。吉凶相雜四句互看，蓋言吉凶相雜，乃善惡相半也。當究其何星孰先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308469259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"入，孰後入，先入則得氣為尊，乃以尊者而配乎吉凶。又當察其何星是命主，是宫主，主則以得垣為上，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"以上者而配乎禍福。或惡星先入，而吉星後從，則先值惡而凶，後值善而吉。或財主星弱，而耗主星徤，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"先以財而富，後以耗而貧。反此則以反推。○又日相雜之中，而欲究先入者，必察其星所行之遲疾。若遲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"者先入而反在後，疾者後入而反在前，須詳究之，不可因其立度而定先入也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"徳官引援，而徳官皆厚。福禄擁隨，而福禄俱豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"徳官，即福禄主也。引援在命主之前，引逺而援近也。擁隨在命主之後，擁近而隨逺也。官福二星，為身命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"之引從，是前後皆有貴客衛護身命，而身命又入垣升殿，逄生坐實，其福禄豈不豐厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"升一位，沉一位，明晦不同。縱漏闗，横漏闗，徃來俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453404840656935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"升一位者，命宫東升之位。沉一位者，對宫西没之位。如晝生日，木土在東升之度，火金月在西没之度；夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"生，火，金月在東升之度；日，木土在西没之度。出者明則入者晦，昏旦得宜。反是，則明晦倒置矣。此蓋以出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"没為東西，而非以卯酉為東西；以升沉為明晦，而非以晝夜為明晦也。縱漏闗者，四正相闗；横漏闗者，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"合相闗。或彼有星而此無曜，此有曜而彼無星，皆得徃來相闗，無彼此得失之異。是此貴字以貴重言，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"非富貴之貴也。自此以下，多論格局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"中分五五，首尾遮闌。前後三三，官魁引從。計羅闌截，夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"西北而日東南；日月循行，朝子午而暮夘酉。天地喜守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"望於已亥之位，日月宜守照於子午之宫。逆則為災，順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292473385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"則為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"星盤以子午為中央，羅為天首居午，計為夭尾居子，是中分二曜對直，故名遮闌。左右均有五宫也，湏漏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"出有用星辰，晝夜不背為妙。身命以前後為引從，午命前隔三位為戍，後隔三位為寅，魁在寅而官在戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"前後各有引從也。須官魁引從，命主得廟乗旺為佳。餘曜以羅計為重，蓋二星為交道相對，所以截㫁衆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"星不能過。然必晝生而衆星截於東南，夜生而衆星截於西北，方成竒局。七曜以日月為尊，日月欲循行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"者，必朝從陽宫，月在子而日在午；暮從隂宫，日在夘而月在酉。隂陽各得其位，晝夜不背其行，方為正局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"亥為天門，木守之，巳為地户，水守之，是謂得乾巽相對之體。午為天上，日守之，子為地下，月守之，是謂得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"坎離相媾之用。遵此則順而為福，反此則逆而為災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292489769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"一星伴月，喜加臨於巨蟹之宫；二曜朝陽，當併㑹於離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"明之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"一星謂水，天一生水也。二曜謂火，地二生火也。水伴月，火輔陽，隂陽𩔖聚也。水月㑹於巨蟹，火日㑹於離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"明，日月得宜也。止論命宫，不論晝夜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛夾身還短命，刑囚拱主必傷身。須觀釣出飛來，次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"看横衝直撞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"計孛二句，不可槩以凶論。茍上盤有恩星釣出而生扶之，下盤有用星飛來而尅制之，或恩用二星，有自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"三合横衝而解其圍，有自對照直撞以紓其難，亦不可以短命傷身言也。經謂正煞暗生，轉禍為福。賦謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836432424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"正煞暗中還有救，凶禍應無有是已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"尤防起處𤓾傷身，須信無中還有曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"此二句以身命通加言也。身命二主，明見無煞。假如辰宫命以金為主，起在子宫土位，似為美矣。却有夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"宫火星暗通，或有亥宫羅星加入，是起處受傷，無中有曜。假如子宫安命，以土為主，起在寅宫木位，似為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"凶矣。却有已宫火星加入，丑宫羅星暗通，是起處受傷，無中有曜。可以吉言，可以凶言也。故明有不如暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"面南拱北，君臣之禮不相拘；移東就西，夫婦之情終至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962651171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"日為君，月為臣。子宫立命，日在亥，月在丑，拱夾命宫，是君臣同列而名分不拘。共，拱于北而面南離此格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"湏如此方合，他則非也。東是命宫，西是妻位。辰宫立命，金飛入酉，則是移東就西。男命以金為妻，而辰命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"以金為主。夫妻一體，氣味相投，豈不諧老。此格湏辰宫安命方是，餘則非也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙抱蟾，官必顯逹。計都朝斗，禄自豐榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"孛為太乙，蟾為太隂。不謂之孛而謂之月孛者，以孛與太隂同水之𩔖也。孛在未入廟，月在未入垣，二者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"同度，方為太乙抱蟾。若彼此先後有間，不可以抱言也。未命值此，官必顯逹。計属土曜，斗為土垣。不謂入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"斗而謂之朝斗者，必虚其斗舎而躔於牛女，二者異度，方為計都朝斗。若計直居斗之次，不可以朝論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"丑命值此，禄自豐榮。夫孛，妖星也，以之抱蟾，則相扶而輝。計，毒曜也，以之朝斗，則歛迹而善。故皆主榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308616715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"木金逢龍遇官魁，方合入垣。金水會蛇為官禄，始名上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"辰屬龍，金躔亢，木躔角，是逢龍也。然必為當年官魁，辰宫安命，方合入垣。餘雖金木升殿，亦不合格。已屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"蛇，金躔翼，水躔翼，是㑹蛇也，然必為命中官禄，寅宫安命，方成上格。餘雖金水相㑹，亦為次等。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"或星分四維，𤨔拱四斗。或星聮三位，𤨔衛三方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"四維者，乃乾坤艮、巽之位，軫角箕斗、壁奎參井隔界之度也。四斗者，乃虚、房星、昴之宿，太陽次舎，至尊之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"位也。安命在四斗正位，十一曜排列於四維，餘宿無星，名為𤨔拱四斗。星聮三位者，如午宫命三合，寅午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"戌無星，而未申酉卯、辰、已、亥子丑九位三聮排列，有星獨𤨔衛此三方。此二格一則四正無星，一則三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701240371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"無星，皆為大貴格。○舊本三位𤨔三方者，乃以三方主聮命宫。假如午宫立命，六丙生人日、木、土為三方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"主。日在午，木在巳化禄，土在未化福。是已午、未聮三方主星，而寅、午、戍三合無星以照破之。又如六乙生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"人，申宫安命，水、木、土為三方主。水在申化貴，木在未文星，土在酉化福。是未、申、酉聮三方主星，而申、子、辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"三合無星以照破之，俱為竒格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"背君朝主必榮身，出坤入乾為上格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"背君朝主者，巳宫安命，水為命，月為身，水在已，月在未，共朝午未太陽，因太陽不在其位，而入已躔軫。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"與水同宫，是身背君之虚位，而朝君所幸之實位也。人臣面君，身豈有不榮之理。出坤入乾者，亥屬乾，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"屬坤，木為命主，而喜出於坤，是木入秦州也。月為身主，而喜入於乾，是月到天門也。身命出入居乾坤，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771942951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"上格而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤定位，平分諸曜拱天庭；日月循行，引領衆星朝帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"闕。拱斗朝天，夫豈為禍？戴天履地，斯能致祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"乾坤，造化之本原，亥屬天庭，要虚其官。坤為地維，貴實其主。今身居命，命在亥，乾坤定位，而十一曜分居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"十一宫，𤨔拱天庭之虚，是平分諸曜拱天庭也。然必命居乾，身居坤，方合。日月衆星之領袖。日在月前，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"在日後，日月循行子丑之宫，而引領衆星之先。衆星順布寅卯辰位，而聮續日月之後，以向乾天，是引領","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"衆星朝帝闕也。然必日月循行不背，而衆星又聮絡不絶，亥宫安命方合。惟亥屬天，惟丑有斗。朝天拱斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"者，以三方主言也。如午宫安命，木、日、土為三方主，日在戌，土在子，木在寅，獨空亥丑二官，是朝天拱斗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092641844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":667,"lineType":2,"content":"午位為天，子丑為地。戴天履地者，以身命主言也。如身在午未為戴天，而日月金水麗之；命在子丑為履","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"地，而木火土羅居之。左右四宫俱無星曜，是戴天履地也。凢此皆為竒格，萬無一二，又豈不能致祥，而反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"為禍者哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"五曜連珠，便是廟堂宰輔；日月合璧，當為鐘鼎竒英。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"五曜運行，各有次舍，然前後參差，疾速互異，欲其聮珠也，難矣。今却順布五位，纍纍不㫁，如珠之聮而無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"盈縮於其間焉，此命間世一遇，所以為廟堂宰輔。日月循行，各有躔度，然每月一㑹，每㑹皆同，欲其合璧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"也，難矣。今則同宫同度，相符無間，如璧之合而無虧蝕於其中焉，此命殊世難逢，所以為鐘鼎竒英。○　一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"云：五曜連珠，五星不必順布五位，或同一宫而在官福，或相聮一處而拱命宫，無四餘犯雜俱是。又如水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836448808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":685,"lineType":2,"content":"在申，金在酉，火在戌，木在亥，土在子，聮珠入垣，尤為難得。一云：日月合璧，璧乃文章之府、天庭之位，日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"恰好合，此如五星㑹奎之類，然豈易得哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"守一空一，便主文章；居三隔三，乃為秀士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"守一空一者，十二宫中或六陽有星而六隂無曜，或六隂有曜而六陽無星是也。内得二主垣窠，三方得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"力，便為文章之魁。居三隔三者，十二宫中，或亥子丑有星，而寅卯辰則無；已午未有星，而申酉戌則無。內","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"得身命髙强，官福廟旺，乃為俊彦之士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"正闗漏闗，而官禄為無用。闢拱闔拱，而刑囚徒具文。蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜失度，似吉非吉。凶星得地，雖凶不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701223987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":703,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命主皆以官禄為正闗，以三合為漏闗。假如六庚生人，寅宫立命，已為官禄，水為禄主，却入於戌之漏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"闗，謂水泛白羊，官禄失地，將焉用之？闢拱三合，外拱也。闔拱左右，内拱也。假如六庚生人，寅宫立命，丑夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"為闔拱，木在夘，土在丑，化為刑囚。午宫安命，寅戌為闢拱，水在寅，土在戌，化為刑囚，俱凶。然二凶得地，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"為三方官田之主，不能為害，其刑囚徒具文耳。此可見官禄吉曜也，入漏闗之失度，反以凶言。刑囚，凶星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"也，隨拱夾而得地，翻為吉㫁。然則論星格之吉凶者，宜細詳焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾隂陽居四正，禄厚官髙。火羅計孛守四强，權尊禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"重。若獨行而為貴，如混處以為災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"四正：子午夘酉。四强：命、禄、妻、田。凡四正立命位者，以羅㬋、計都、太隂、太陽而分布於四正，升于廟垣，則對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276932645"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":721,"lineType":2,"content":"待之體以立，故禄厚官髙。凡四强為原守者，以熒惑、天首、天尾、月孛而分居於四强，安于廟旺，則英雄之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"勢以張，故權尊禄重。然此二格，在二曜貴乎清明，在四餘貴乎獨旺。茍有他星混處於其間，則善惡相揉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"明晦相奪，必以為災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛同宫，須防夭折。火羅作黨，易致災危。火怕入於陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，土忌居於隂位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"火孛異類，必相讐也，以之同居命宫，則尅戰不已，故湏防乎夭折。火羅同黨，必自焚也，以之同侵命位，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"剛烈異常，故易致乎災危。晝忌火也，宜隂而不宜陽。夜忌土也，宜陽而不宜隂。若火在陽宫而晝生，土居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"隂位而夜誕，其災危夭折也，又何疑焉？若火土是本命，三方主又不以為忌，當併詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292522537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"以輕易重，富而夀，夀而康；將重換輕，苗不秀，秀不實。論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"格局，論垣窠，庶清濁之必辯；分源𣴑，分體用，貴本末之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"相承。正則重，偏則輕，主莫背，守莫失。體用俱勝，少年題","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈塔之名；本末若差，至老作鷄窻之士。使用輕而本重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"則始逸而終勞；或用重而體輕，則始勞而終𨓜。初敗終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"成，蓋耗在前，禄在後，先難後獲，由主居弱，限居强，强弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"不分，始終何益？凶㣲吉衆，乃先弱而後强；吉少凶多，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"始成而終敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836465192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":757,"lineType":2,"content":"以輕易重者，假如辰宫立命，在角度金論，是為偏垣，偏則輕矣。若命主金星，飛入酉宫昴度，或入丑宫牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"度，此謂之以輕易重，富夀之命也。以重易輕者，假如亢度立命，為金之正垣，正則重矣。金星却飛入寅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"尾度，或入卯宫房度，此謂之將重換輕，秀而不實之命也。命有格局，有垣窠。格局正而垣窠得者為清，垣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"窠失而格局偏者為濁。又有清濁之相半者，或合格而失垣，或得垣而廢格，皆當細而論之，庶可以辯其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"清濁之分。命有源𣴑，有體用。體即源，命之本也；用即流，命之末也。當因源而遡其流，因體而究其用，或自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":767,"lineType":2,"content":"𣴑而反其原，自用而觀其體，真見其何者為本，何者為末，而尤貴乎本末之相承。清濁以分，本末以悉。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"得其正垣則重也，而不可易之以輕；凡得其偏垣則輕也，而貴乎換之以重。凡為身命官福之主，不宜弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"陷，而勝之以客；凡為七强原守之星，最怕飛吊，而失之以傷。體用俱勝，身命官福得地也，宜題鴈塔而早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962667555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"擢髙科；本末俱失，命主限主落陷也，則老鷄窻而終身不第。使用輕而本重，其𣴑弊也，鮮克有終；使用重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":777,"lineType":2,"content":"而體輕，其源濁也，罔功於始。使耗前而禄後，則初敗終成；使主弱而限强，則先難後獲。使凶微而吉衆，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":779,"lineType":2,"content":"重能勝乎輕也，故先弱而後强；使吉少而凶多，是清而混於濁也，故始成而終敗。觀星者審之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡不宜混處，吉凶要在分居。源清流逺，始榮復見於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"終榮；本固末滋，後吉何殊於先吉。原守雖然無咎，流行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"尤怕為災。體用皆强，始終盡吉。流行雖惡，猶如潢潦之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"無根；原守皆醇，尤勝膏粱之有味。造化體用，固亦如是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"限數流行，亦當細推。主或有虧，限湏得地。諸限以洞㣲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292506153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"為上，逐年惟小限可推。竹羅茍能論，則休咎潦然；碧玉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"若明推，則吉凶洞若。雷公急脚，尤防入斗尅身；斗底黄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"泉，亦怕傷身居煞。子午卯酉，實為去路；寅申巳亥，須憑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼門。一不可拘，二湏敢㫁。吉凶同會，較量重輕，星曜交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，尤宜詳究。命强限弱，渾如逆艇之上灘；命弱限强，猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"似槁苗而得雨。始終發禄，亦聮限之吉星；首末破財，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"一生之凶限。福財俱背，㫁無吉曜之可言；刑煞若臨，湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"信凶年之將至。吉星臨限，富可享而貴可求；凶曜當宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308747787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"禍將萌而夀將折。如限裏全空，則未必為福；宫中有主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"則豈能致災？禍福無門，脩短有數，脩為由命，𠋣伏在人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"此論實珠珍之比，推源乃碧玉之名，茲不虚傳，固宜實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":819,"lineType":2,"content":"此篇詳舉諸家限數，言原守者，當生之星也；言流行者，流年之曜也。若原守體用，皆在髙强，而流行凶惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"亦無大害。茍或主本有虧，要觀限途得失，諸家限數，所當悉推。有名洞㣲限者，一二本限裏，三四對照衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":823,"lineType":2,"content":"三合五六載，其年見吉凶是也；有名竹羅限者，開端隔節數三宫，逆行零順㡬年終，若見逺時數二節，零","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"年交入甚宫中是也；有雷公急脚、斗底黄泉限者，皆以子午夘酉為去路，寅申已亥憑鬼門，一順一逆而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308665867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"互推之是也；有逐年小限者，自命宫起當生之年而逆推之是也。然諸家之限，湏以洞㣲為上，小限次之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":831,"lineType":2,"content":"竹羅次之，黄泉急脚又其次之。洞㣲飛限遍乎一周，逐年小限輪於二六。竹羅重三方之主，黄泉急脚因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"其命限俱弱者，而交併於二六之門，亦所當推。若吉凶同㑹，湏較量彼此之重輕；星曜交臨，當詳究本末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":835,"lineType":2,"content":"之强弱。或命强限弱，渾如逆艇上灘，雖載重而莫能進；或命弱限强，猶似槁苗得雨，雖受滋而莫能生。聮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":837,"lineType":2,"content":"限皆是吉星，主始終之發禄；一生無非凶限，㫁首尾之破財。福以居身，財以養命。二主星俱背，又何有吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"曜之堪言？刑者刑難，煞者地煞。在明暗加臨，必湏防凶年之釣動。然行限怕空，臨宫喜實。若限裏對合俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":841,"lineType":2,"content":"空，豈能為福？若一空對合有主，未必為災。是以禍福無門，脩短有數。脩為由命，𠋣伏在人。善通造化者，固","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":843,"lineType":2,"content":"當不二以聴天，又當居易以俟命可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292571689"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":847,"lineType":9,"content":"通星賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"推歩已定，占星不移。吉凶先驗於廟堂，災福實係乎星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"曜。且如出入烏府，無迯日入廟堂；優游鳯池，多是水居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸。一吉入命，必作公卿；一忌臨官，多難富貴。廟一也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"而有得失之殊；忌一也，而有吉凶之異。主雖臨於旺地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"湏看宫分之髙低。生不生，尅不尅，蹤跡飄流；吉不吉，凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"不凶，行藏汨沒。命吉而限亦吉，取功名如拾芥；命凶而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"限亦凶，求財利如捕風。吉莫吉乎五星不戰；凶莫凶乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308682251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"六曜相臨。始辱終凶，只因火去刑金；先敗後成，多是水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"來生木。木星須貴，猶慮金傷；水宿輕清，湏妨土尅。水孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"入遷移，㑹火，晝見穿窬；火羅㑹官禄，逢金，夜生紋面。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"土非盲則缺，計土不啞則聾。日同土計，揚子雲訥不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"言；孛共水羅，公孫𢎞詐而不實。紫炁雖是吉曜，失度而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"反為災；計孛應是凶星，得地却能為福。水孛坐咸池之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"位，男好色而女為娼。木炁臨華盖之宫，男為孤而女為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"寡。為僧為道，炁臨身命而命入閑宫；做賈做商，主入遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771959335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"移而財居命位。火為文士而坐奎，决為儒者。金是武人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"而臨計，主利兵戎。水星見木，口吐鷄舌之言。紫炁逢金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"足躡丹砂之地。水星無定，要吉同宫，孛計多疑，嫌凶共","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"位。隂陽逢蝕，子夏䘮明。計孛同鄉，鄧攸哭子。計臨妻位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞僻處鳯將來。木在兒宫，丹桂芳時春未老。布衣藜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"食，火土俱髙。甕牖繩樞，木星俱陷，疾厄遭逢火孛常患","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"瘡痍。月宫常傍羅㬋，必多心氣。學堂失陷，徒闗孫敬之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"門；科名不髙，枉鑿匡衡之壁。登金門而歩玉堂，田聚福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453436276949029"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"位，衣輕裘而乗肥馬，身入財宫。木入命，為人仁義，金入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"身，本性猖狂。孛水金臨疾厄，枯木生春，水土孛臨財宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"薄氷見日。官宫遇刑耗臨囚加照定作罪囚。命主得福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"禄𠔥權，聚㑹必膺富貴。忌曜髙𠔃難發，福星見兮易榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"孟軻不遇主，命限四值空亡；李廣不封侯，福禄二宫失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"陷。投河投井。身逢刑曜，而水孛落在疾厄之宫；自縊自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"刑。命居刃宫，而火羅坐於相貌之地。或逢兵厄，金羅火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"入刄煞之宫；或值産傷，水火孛犯身星之位。惡星臨照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771975719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"百事相縈；嵗徳加臨，千災頓息。火羅入命，皷莊子之盆；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"土計臨夫，哭秦王之璧。遷移遇吉，必利遊行；疾厄逢凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"多招横禍。火臨五位，中年妻子少亡。孛在四宫，早嵗爹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"娘多尅。兄弟若逢孛宿，必主孤單。僕馬若逢羅㬋，多防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"走失。紫金相會，身居翰苑之中；羅火同宫，位處諫臺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"上。太乙抱蟾，一生榮顯。姮娥抱鬼，多見災殃。羅㬋得位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"勇畧過人。水星居髙，智謀出衆。若水星妙入命位，百藝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"多能；如紫炁妙臨身宫，是非屢有。火宿逢羅，成敗相仍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308731403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"水星見計，刑囚㑹惡。金為妻宿，逢火羅必定難為。火作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"夫星，逢水計决然相尅。孛在福宫必夭，命炁逢月孛定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"長年，火羅更逢月孛，死在刀兵，土孛若遇火金，終於犴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"狴。水耗財宫荷葉露，土刑身位栁花風。下弦之月守妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，有圓有缺，白晝之火逢子位，多損多傷。木星守財兮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"仁而不富，計水守財兮，富而不仁。夫主星受妻主星尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"則妻奪夫權；父宫曜得子官曜生，則父慈子孝。忤逆不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"孝者，羅計犯於太陽；四徳𠔥全者，金水會於妻位。奎宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455771992103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"會於木位，文章冠當世，桃花逢於金孛，好色損天年。炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"孛傷人者，晝見火金；羅計尅命者，夜見土木。婦人帶子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"重嫁，夫命主與男，女主。同在遷移，男子停妻再聚，妾身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"主與妻妾主俱陷奴僕。青龍領木庫喜逢春，朱雀妙午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"宫宜向夏。白虎候秋金得位，𤣥武正冬水司權。勾陳宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"四季之中，人命獲一生衣禄。命清限晦，蘇老泉二十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"而讀書；身貴限㣲，朱買臣四十九而應詔。星辰低弱，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"憂限遇低星；身命俱髙，仍慮限逢忌曜。入吉宫便離凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836481576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"處，逢吉星便見安寧。炁星本吉，奚如木徳之純全；計曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"多凶，尤勝孛星之最暴。計、孛守身宫，切忌行船渡水；火、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"孛守命位，宜防履險登髙。箕星好風，不宜見火，必防風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"疾之災；畢宿好雨，不宜見羅，多生血勞之疾。羅為天首，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"逢凶星頭靣有災；計為地尾，遇惡曜手足有患。身吉限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，十分好也難成；命强身弱，萬事成而弗就。脾屬土，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"逢木，主脾疾而不和；腎屬水，水遇土，主血濁而盈積。咳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"嗽者，肺屬金，金逢火制；寒熱者心屬火，火遇水刑。木逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453434469023794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"金，而肝受傷，金屬孛，而色害命。計、羅侵日月，而眼目失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"明；金、水逢計孛，而手脚多疾。孛、羅在命虎狼心，計、羅在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"命惡毒輩。艱危處享福無凶，蓋縁星辰俱吉。是非中成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"家立計，自是身命俱髙。子孫星弱，裸蜾負螟。財帛曜凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"花蜂釀蜜。田宅逢火水，蕩産破家。妻妾逢羅孛，傷妻尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"子。幹事不辭勞苦，主入奴宫，求財每受艱辛，財居閑極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁同孛星入命，閨女未出嫁而産嬰孩。主曜與金羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"守身，老夫已白頭而生赤子。三方俱吉，勝如平地湧泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453434468991026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"四正逢凶，好似聚毛見火。塵灰滿釡，宫主休囚。金玉滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"堂，身居旺相。聚此賦者，名曰通星。同志見知，幸無失矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
