{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"煞前主後，踈則憂疑，親則煎廹。煞後主前，遐則剥削，邇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"則摧殘。月居閒極而無傷，始為福元。主到遷移而逢吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"豈諳羇旅。遷移星惡，當為東西南北之人。閒極曜佳，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"是散誕游談之士。七宫得地，可擢髙科。五位逢仇，難招","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣續。官宫强，財宫弱，爵禄豐盈而府庫虚耗。財星勝，田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308764171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"星負，貨資富厚而隴畆蕭條。金孛相逢，號為花酒之客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄兩旺，㫁為富貴之人。年管平生，月當早嵗，日居中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"主，時轄末年，須當次第而推，慎勿躐等而㫁。孛星守時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"守身，偏能舌辦，火羅照身照命，必是粗豪。吉星得助，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"錦添花，惡曜逢生，似虎生翼。忌星背，免致為災，喜星背，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"莫能邀福。休旺自屬四時，尅化闗係五命。日生忌火，夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"生忌土，此乃俗談。羅宿傷陽，計宿傷隂，斯為正論。忌曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"如歸本垣，不甚為災，喜星若居本位，尤能為福。凡居本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455772008487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"垣為上，但落陷宫則㣲。主起逢生，基址已厚，限雖值弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"福氣未衰。福命至於衰鄉，尚有餘福，窮途漸行旺地，猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"帶餘窮。火羅偏能驟發，土孛只解晚成。身命二主俱逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"生，不富即貴。主身兩處盡遭尅，非夭則刑。二主坐貴坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，逢生則貴禄可崇。兩宫俱刼俱刄，遇囚則刼刄致死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"主坐驛馬，不生何濟，身居刼煞，無尅何憂？無中還有，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"中還無，吉者反凶，凶者反吉。亡神如坐囚煞，愚蠢可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花若臨身命，淫蕩何言。父母見傷，不尅則離祖出繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453437308780555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"男女值尅，縱得亦頑蠢。螟蛉日月拱夾，有生則榮華可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"期。刑囚夾拱，無煞則摧折莫保。官宫雖美，身命受傷亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"徒然。福主髙强，限次縱虧亦不甚。身主重於命主，官宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"那勝福宫。主居陽刄，逢囚犯刑。身居福馬，遇吉則貴。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"生木，木生火，五星生尅衆皆知。水尅木，木生土，一法須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"求人不識。一本固有萬殊，萬殊豈遺一本。一宫星有善","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"惡，當推在前在後之等殊。本位曜值吉凶，更辨或制或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"化之輕重。生尅制化，貴在細推，遲留伏逆，亦當研究。好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399575078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"星互換而多吉，惡曜入廟亦少凶。喜極宜坐於崇勲，惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"極惡登於嵗駕。四柱空亡，須分初主、中主、末主。一年災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"厄，可推官符、病符、死符。限宫限主，俱逢惡曜，不死何為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"限主限宫，兩值好星，其發不小，源清者，其流必清，本弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"者，其末亦弱。太嵗扶起惡星，其惡必横，流年來佐吉曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"其福尤豐。月愛孛星，乃得比和之道。日要土宿，誰知生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之功。太嵗空亡遇三位，此宫還實。平生通順得一星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"運照限成。火性急，望見即發，孛星遲，過後方見。土計臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092690996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"照太陽，喜尤勝於金水。計土照臨太隂，虐更甚於火羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"且相貌宫主兩傷，必逢惡死，𠔥遷移宫主受尅，當没殊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"方。須防樂極悲來，最善凶中救至。空亡自古最驗，議論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"何今不然。禍福最驗於星曜，秤停若較於權衡。諸星隨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"主曜之所生尅，譬一樹由根本以致榮枯。水泛白羊，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"騎人馬。土埋雙女，木打寳瓶。湏知此類以謂何，非坐命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"宫則毋論。諸星𤨔拱命宫，其人必貴，三方傷犯身命，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"世亦貧。四角有星，居官則權柄不小，八煞星吉，蒞政則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837735460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"風力異常。我之喜者彼亦喜之，彼之忌者我非忌也。正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"論所宗，當權顛倒之義。惟顛倒之理不逹，故起驗不驗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"之疑。吉則喜臨於實地，凶則愛入於空宫。今年明年之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"推遷，故於小限以詳也。逐月逐日之禍福，宜於太隂而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"取之。惡星登駕若臨，身命必傾危。吉曜守籍，當主兒孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"以榮貴。金木得時，能膺臺閣之職。火孛用事，尤宏將相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"之權。禄位吉助既重，應叨正禄。官宫生意若輕，僅可偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"官。田宅宫又為父母之宫，相貌宫亦是徒配之位。相貌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453438701289523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"宫主，或本主受傷，刑傷惡死。福徳宫主，或本主受尅，顛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"沛流離。大限為主，小限受難，可稍有乘除，當生為重。流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"年逢尅，亦不過損益。金宿與太陽臨地，難曰空亡。五星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥餘炁同空，誰云烏府？是宜互體以推，不可一槩而論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"女推閑極一宫，以㫁平生貴賤。男詳福徳一位，可定終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"始窮通。金空則鳴，蓋縁反振音聲。火空則發，尤謂終歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"煨燼。星坐四正，謂之髙强。曜在四空，譬之沉溺。本根既","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，最忌後限不如前，限主雖佳，奈何身主却遭煞。得經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292620841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"失經，固當詳也。似格非格，亦宜推之。當生忌巳云空，𣴑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"年扶之還實。最愛日月拱夾，深憐星曜背馳。囚星有黨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"凶尤横，要宿無生吉不來。奚須論暗耗刑囚，不必推印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"權貴禄。能遵正法以推，免有多岐之惑。當生既論四空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"流年亦合一體。主居相貌必豐肥，忌居疾厄希康徤。雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"云造化分定，亦在修為何如。合格合局，㣲有尅亦自無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。傷命傷身，縱逢吉似難發越。限臨之宫，辯躔度淺深，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"以定遲速。星臨之位，推制化虚實，而詳重輕。木羅㑹舍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962700323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"湏知可吉可凶。金水㑹蛇，當分有憎有愛。䘮門吊客臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"命限，逢凶則服動奚疑。陽刄刼煞坐主身，遇吉則權髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"㧞萃。身主命，主值太陽，遇吉則貴。限主宫，主遇生宿，陷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"則無妨。他刑我，他居陷弱則反隹。我用他，我居空位則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"何濟。惡星為限主，為我用則惡頗輕，善星到限宫，被他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"傷則善亦薄。木入秦州，只利未宫安命，金居乾位最便，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐已宫，火居已申，不必為忌，金到亥寅，豈謂有傷。諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"宫湏有忌喜，一理湏定吉凶。惡星怕衝怕合，吉曜愛合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453451992743945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"愛衝。一生一尅，當以或輕或重而言，一合一衝，湏於有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"偽有真而辨。金無餘氣，効勝兩宿，星夾太陽，權匪常倫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"合不如照之功，拱豈勝夾之理。星躔退度，善惡分别有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"情，宿值空亡，生尅總成顛倒。或喜或怒，其要在於迎逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"所愛所憎，正當明於分背。飛來湏曰切當，釣出尤為致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"親。吉則喜有吉助，凶則患於凶扶。知命則推吉避煞，樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"天則安命固窮。如大限本佳，吉扶月建，則早嵗亦可粗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"通。或大限自强，凶臨月建，則中年亦湏剥削。當生太嵗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292604457"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶則闗係平生，推行三限，得失則管領窮逹。湏互以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"推，勿固以論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"原夫刑衝喜樂，逆順伏留，夜厭柔星而用事，晝嫌强曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"以聚天。土在齊吳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":2,"content":"子丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"雖夜生福猶昌熾。火居宋魯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":2,"content":"邜戍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"日誕禄亦盈餘。名題鴈塔，天首周邦，足躡雲霄，太陽魯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"分。水日妙星張之位，孛羅同箕尾之鄉。金水㑹蛇，廣納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092740148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"殊祥，金木逢龍，多招福禄。水流鶉尾，巧計千般。孛坐玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"枵，機謀百𠮓。金羅同而虎閫制兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":21,"lineType":2,"content":"同在寅宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"水木清而蘭臺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"掌翰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":23,"lineType":2,"content":"申宫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫忌孛，妻妾宜金，家藏異寳。從來日在金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，困乏資財。大抵火居金位，柔星在命，無奈發遲，惡曜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"臨身，奔波衣食。金乗火位，其人少失尊親。火入金鄉，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"命早抛兄弟。掠他人之物以為已有，蓋縁水㑹計都捐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"自已之財以濟他人，必是木同紫炁，炁月為人之華蓋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"金孛乃命之咸池。火在八宫而主疾，羅居十位以遷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836547112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"金到亥而主夀，木到亥而福延。厄雖主疾，亦是貴人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"威權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"疾尼宫主飛起受尅主疾，亦主貴人權柄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"妻不專財，蓋觀㓜年之禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"天元納音，所屬福深，八煞有權，不富則貴。火寅則旺，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"丑則嫌。非水孛不妓，非木日不儒。金計乃軍庶之流，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"日必技能之士。論冨須㸔財宫，貴榮須參限路。五星順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"序，入命位以封侯；一孛朝天，到官宫而作宰。羅斷計謀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"孛尚權勇。火星赤黒，暴燥難瞞。土㝛短肥，寡言多佞。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"未來而先應，土雖去而尤遺。月穿細栁，黒頭宰相何疑；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399771686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"木打寳瓶，白首愚夫奚惑。炁羅見日，非道即僧。土㑹孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"羅，不貴則富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"或命主限主則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"水日計孛，志巧而心靈；日木炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"土，徳和而性厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"或日在命依此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"日出扶桑，遇白羊而金烏朗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"烈；月生滄海，到金牛而玉兎熒煌。羅計土孛兮，容貌粗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"俗，金水陰陽兮，形容端莊。水火併於田宅，破家傷業。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"木㑹於財宫，發福多財。一星伴月於天門，二曜朝陽於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"邜位。後學之士宜評識焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837899300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"十一星辰拱玉堂，玉堂宫主坐庭光。三主齊高還入廟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"必然超侍聖明王。貴人元有紫薇垣，惟此宫中最可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"身命主星來到此，必能富貴作廷元。惡星犯煞最恓惶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"凶曜逢刑不可當。㓜歳多殃羅計破，中年蹇滯忌囚傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"木羅㑹舍分强弱，金計同宫論後先。吉㝛强時能壓煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星强後吉如燃。吉星先入多强妙，後入宫時氣不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"女人先推居福徳，男人切重在移遷。福星廟旺人欽仰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"夀主高時夀必延。日背太陽難得力，夜生月皎正光妍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453439292669993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"官高官必居台位，夀顯年庚比泰山。八煞有星權不小，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"七强無宿賤堪言。身宫清吉休愁命，福徳堅高不問官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"囚忌顯時人破散，徳官相聚必榮歡。夫妻和睦因金到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"父老娘延自炁還，兄弟多時緣木至，資財耗散孛相㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫擁從星尤貴，身位飛來宿更鮮，身命清時多福禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"木金死絶必衰貧，女人怕帶男人曜，日裏防逢夜裏星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"天徳相逢為將相，印官相聚必公卿。月逢晦曜須還蝕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"日遇凶星亦不明，惡曜偏宜居死絶，吉星最喜帶生成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238731327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"木星獨貴諸凶散，孛彗當凶吉㝛沉。䧟處受傷多破碎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"强宫得地越生成。惡星帶吉分先後，吉㝛逢凶論淺深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜為元添福徳，凶星作煞最傷刑。計羅遇日元凶散，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"金月逢霄兎魄盈，土炁夾羅多險厄，炁陽金計主孤单。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"一星有氣皆為得，諸曜齊星事可憐。孛入財宫財自散，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"火居子位子難延。火星拱斗人膺禄，諸曜朝天福最綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"五星歸宫人足禄，三主犯惡必無年。生時須愛居尊位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"坐命偏防入四刑。二主俱高權顯大，七强有宿貴終身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238682175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"財中有氣財終聚，身上逢凶身不安。生處逢傷生氣絶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"逆中有順逆神閑。諸星逢逆全無氣，衆曜强時必貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"凶曜主强多惡暴，吉星帶絶必衰零。福元淺䧟多無福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"夀主凋殘夀不興。三主俱低無發氣，兩㝛䧟却亦堪憐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星得地須榮顯，衆曜相衝越苦貧。吉曜逢傷多尅剥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星帶煞損精神。兩宫坐福千年夀，二徳臨財萬頃田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"坐貴宫中宜立命，死凶局內怕安身。此經總是真玄語，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"細把工夫宻地論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"水星隨日至天中，錦繡文章達聖聰。羅在日前官顯顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"羅居日後禍重重。火入金宫兄弟喪，金尋火位䘮雙親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"孤陽射退三方煞，一木能消四正凶。水火失躔多厄難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"木星失度主傷殘。羅計偏宜居已亥，縱為禍曜禍無干。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"君居臣位娘先死，臣犯君宫父早傾。日月反躔依此斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"日月升殿兩親康。日邜月酉命坐邜，火星居午妙非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"日酉月邜相違背，人生值此有乖張。太乙抱蟾宜未亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453451992776713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生富貴足衣糧。羅曜獨居官禄上，必是為官佐聖王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"四角有星權不小，四空無曜夀難延。四空無曜看命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"不知命主在何方。若是主星入强位，官强福弱有災殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"四空之限依此斷，限主受制入泉鄉。福禄夾身還促命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼福鬼禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚守命夀延長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"刑囚得度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相交多死氣，火金同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"度夭天年。木羅㑹舍分强弱，木羅反背主貧寒。孛騎獅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"子人凶惡，佛口蛇心毒害人。計羅截出孤月滿，夜生西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"北富家翁。計羅截出单陽滿，日在東南福不窮。計羅截","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836563496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"星還反背，一生辛苦暗朦朦。命中金孛少男女，三十年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"前不得妻。若是有時刑尅早，回頭只見影相隨。日月分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"明共金水，此星高照位三公。水星伴月終須貴，火曜朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"陽福最隆。當生身煞㑹身宫，身主無破在禄宫。掌握兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"權宜武職，聲揚萬里抑蠻戎。背禄何嘗得寸禄，命前行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽守巽，至老耳目聰明。火孛臨坤，未免腰背屈曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287760418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"安身在巽，見日月主總明，已為耳目也。又申為腰背之所，火孛乃凶星，無制，主有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"羅居午位，眼必無光。水入寅宫，喉風壅塞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"午乃眼目之鄉，寅為喉舌之所。惡犯星辰，主有是疾患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻頭帶赤，火孛而守申宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"命在申，或行限在申，火孛居之，主有災疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"臉面萎黄，土孛而居辰位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"辰乃闗人顔色之所。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"計臨申位，面上有虧。羅入命宫，胡鬚可驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399738918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"命臨計六丙為刑，六甲為囚，夜生無騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅到酉，心氣徃來。晝羅衝心，心風難禁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"酉為心氣之府，孛與羅居之，更或在命宫，或行限遇之，及帶煞刀，則主是疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅居於亥子，臂犯瘡疽。金木戰於辰酉，肺心咳𠻳。羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行而不順，多犯血光；火若退而遲𤲢，難堪酒痢。更若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星有黨，血上加膿。那堪土宿來臨，痔而帶疾。木到巽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"而見煞，左手拘攣。炁入寅而逢刑，脚腿虛腫。要觀疾病，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"先論䧟星，吉凶了然，易如反掌矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837850148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":235,"lineType":9,"content":"相真行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"人生夀夭與貧賤，五星推之晦實顯。官禄臨之夀必崇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚傍照福必淺。木人最怕計金扶，老來咳喇自焦枯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"木人者，乃令星木金主也，最怕金計入命，行限遇之，則依此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"水命亦怕炁與火，吐紅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"翻胃䘮其軀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"水怕炁火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"土命尤防炁孛臨，腸風虚腫夀難圖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"土怕炁孛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"金命亦怕木羅侵，氣瘤痔疾㑹傷人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"金怕木羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"火命若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"逢水孛梗，定在人前語不真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"火人怕水孛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"莫教火土入其中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"纔年二十耳便聾。若是計孛三方照，腰駝背屈身躘蹱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399820838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"萬一火金加入馬，一生奔走如飛蜂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"火金入馬，勞力不定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟勞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"力自奔走，生瘡發癩又疽癰。命宫若遇火孛夾，頭尖項","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"縮似村農。金遇孛羅兩邉拱，遍身出水成虚腫。萬一紫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"炁暗相加，定知唇缺鼻無孔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"有金在命，孛羅拱夾，則主水腫。有炁暗侵者，則依此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"斷，添減皆不可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"此訣君須仔細詳，有人得之似仙方。宜將宫度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"仔細㸔，却把他星細酌量。又有一般極可鄙，炁在馬宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"逢的是。此命生來極不仁。定教手足無一指，金水毗和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"無别慮。堂堂相貌好驚人，一生快樂無憔悴。女人命裏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399722534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"却不同，他身五漏不作比。若問女人受命源，他篇說了","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"子細觀。篇篇盡看有意義，若無此訣怎談言。知理之人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"更須看，尚書洪範晉天文。前賢説事有條理，世人雜説","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"徒紛紛。擎天遊奕亦須看，假如夘酉在其間。只看二月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"與八月，其餘月分亦等閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"擎天逰奕主二月禍福，如在邜酉，只是二八月有凶吉事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"寅申正七月有吉凶，依此例推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"土忌夜兮火忌晝，此是世人煅煉就。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"土人間日夜生，此說那來斷休咎。却是朔望不須疑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"朔望見之生受，此兩日外，其餘不問。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"見之其人多生受。不惟一生無享用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453430962798627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"且是壓身多損夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"金木生人火是，水生人土是。餘不怕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"四正日月怕西沉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"便㸔日月在酉申。亦須日月為度主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"日月西沉，須是為度主方説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"人值之似鶺鴒。不惟懵懂身不足，又且汨没奔風塵。女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"人值之却不害，只怕丈夫不為人。女人欺負丈夫善，淫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"蕩全無畏懼心。縱有舅姑不伏事，不孝不義恣其淫。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"篇最是𦂳切語，後學詳悉不誤人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"女人欺夫善懦，恣行淫蕩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"星家路徑直如筆，争奈世人俱不識。天運東南冬之餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399706150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"地傾西北夏之日。最嫌水火㑹于箕，猶怕日月㑹于畢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"水火更加計來臨，蛇傷虎咬定可必。日月若有土計侵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"顛狂心𤍠㝛瘤疾。萬一火孛入咸池，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"上弦酉是，下弦夘是，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"更加火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"金來㑹之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"火孛入咸池，女嫁夫分離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"此人定是自縊死，投河落井更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑。女人值此惡星臨，嫁夫十箇九箇離。老少如何得乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"十五以下六十以上行限入馬宫主跌撲傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"莫教惡星在分野，寅申已亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"四宫神。釣起馬元是何星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"以四馬宫頭初度主為馬元，寅申尾三火為馬元，申宫畢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"八度月為馬元，巳上張度月為馬元，亥宫危十四度月為馬元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁跌兮金孛賤，火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453434469122098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"勞削自傷辰。土計一生癱手足，日月見之役一身。婦人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"見之身薄賤，一生産難好驚人。的煞初星入命度，子午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"邜酉正屬已。誰知張月是初星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"自軫初度已張月酉胃土丑斗木，或火為馬元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"或月為馬元，有此星相臨，如此斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"傷殘骨肉穢男婦。不問男女及老少，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"恩情半路相辜負。不惟夫妻與父母，雖與朋友亦難聚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"限行三方四正對照見之，是則依上斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫星各有屬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"假如財帛兄弟之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"安命財宫木。初度若見客星臨，此人一生定不足。萬一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"耗星在初度，田宅㗖盡如破竹。若人了烈及聰明，須是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837915684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫見文曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"十二宫中取初度為例。忌尅星文曲聰明對宫見年干是也。假論年干為文曲，即本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"年間所屬，如甲子木、丙丁火之𩔖，臨於命對宫無尅制者方驗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"此篇叚叚皆已效，實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"藏於身莫教人。除此篇篇有秘傳，淳風無敢施其巧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"此篇喚為初伏吟，名為初伏值千金。加合之中多意義，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"可因此本暗搜尋。婦人最重見崇勲，正看干支與歳君。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"命主崇勲却不是，時上崇勲却堪言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"女人要時帶禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知時乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"自家時，時乃一生受用之。若得崇勲來守此，平生便是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238698559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"好根基。女人安命對六合，更要禄在二宫生。假如甲生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"人坐命，最喜禄在寅中盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"婦人最喜禄在二宫，遷移、疾厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"又要庚人禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"居申。此是八宫最可人，八疾辰宫亦喜居。遷移有禄又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"其次，正是三宫係其身。莫教二貴夾一禄，一生流落在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"風塵。更教二貴夾一馬，一生辛苦減精神。豈知好是日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"月夾，更無刑囚直難雜。生來白手自成家，夫賢子貴相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"和合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":373,"lineType":2,"content":"日月夾禄，夫賢子貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人要禄不要馬，帶馬之人多淫冶。縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"有囬頭百媚生，身姿輕薄與幽雅。萬一咸池有宿臨，朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238665791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"朝暮暮貪歡耍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池有㝛主淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"貴要单兮禄要单，禄重尤較貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"重難。女人坐命如逢此，定作簾前婢妾看。若是馬元逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"暗耗，一生孤苦自饑寒。時上若還俱帶馬，死於道路没","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"衣棺。生尅之中有制化，命值刑囚誰不怕。主在遷移見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚，身到老來尤重嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"命主在遷移，更見刑囚，主老了又再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"二八宫中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"難宿臨，婦人見此便傷心。假如子宫安命度，已亥須防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"金火臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"二八宫惟忌星夾，亥二宫己八宫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"亦忌十辰居難宿，疾病淹淹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"多不足。婦人最怕金火臨，壓身破相不成人。更值鰥寡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287711266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"與孤獨，此宫論命人難測。若論刑人人不識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"乃三刑，非刑囚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"怕三刑一例推，此篇視之尤詳悉。經云寅來刑已已刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"申，最怕三刑見孛星。女人坐命如值此，平生茍合入風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"塵。四句章詩為𦂳切，百試百中不悮人。男人值此亦尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，况乎生來為女人。更將年干上叅㸔，女人禍福在二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"宫。命若吉兮遇貴婿，命若低兮值夫窮。君不聞勸人莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"作婦人身，一生苦樂由他人。又不聞婦人三從古有義，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"夫為妻綱亦有倫。夫身居貴妻亦貴，夫身若貧妻亦貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399755302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"方知命脉係於夫，命中豈能自有無。世人但把命中㸔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知命內有兩途。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"更有一訣似神仙，馬入的宫真驗然。女人值之不堪說，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"嫁夫枉自腹便便。生兒不令腹中死，子出定是脚先懸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"縱令有人來扶掖，也教胎衣在身邉。萬死千死定無疑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"説起今賢一一知。婦人在世極生受，恰是浪上駕船兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君從頭論到尾，算星只此是便宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人只重身為貴，貴逢吉曜必純粹。身命二主吉星臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453435836579880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"决定榮華𠔥子貴。不要金水孛相逢，仝宫入命皆淫慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人以水為福星，福星守命多衣禄。却喜金星同木行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"金木臨之多富足。身命怕見孛火土，産難胎亡主凶禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"羅孛行限極不宜，惡㝛遷移多殃否。賤人限居六十二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"身命䧟空為切忌。主居切要居高位，禄守禄宫為大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"日月升殿世所稀，必有賢夫為正配。三限四元俱得力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"斯人可有后妃榮。諸星入廟高强福。星無駁雜夀康寜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":447,"lineType":9,"content":"女人碎金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238649407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛入夫帶咸池，先姦後娶水來汚。水孛同行照身命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"為人不足心色麄。遷移書水淫堪言。水日雖淫有所禦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"金日照身不可犯，金水惺惺蕩有餘。主人遷移皆不正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"計都不語却非愚。見土持重真堪羡。囚忌臨身破相軀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"貴在九宫為婢妾，水來坐貴理家徒。孛羅坐貴有權柄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"炁金見貴作尼姑。炁孛花酒遭人𥬇，偷盡風流美少夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛水星如相㑹，夫壻生情意外思。重婚再嫁多離别，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"僥僥內亂作麻絲。孛羅火日如相㑹，若不傷夫有幾夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287727650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬安身與立命，性却惺惺賢不愚。隔界安身與立命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"若不淫奔定尅夫。福徳更𠔥田宅內，刑囚忌煞不堪居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"夫宫子位星高顯，賢夫賢子曜門閭。郎官朝命真富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳星高禄有餘。若依此語叅詳斷，貧賤富貴總如斯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":477,"lineType":9,"content":"婦人歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人偏是怕金水，金水分明是賤人。若是再行金水㝛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"終能榮貴亦無倫。禄要单兮貴要单，禄重尤較貴重難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"不為奴婢貪淫輩，便作簾前婢妾看。婦人造化在身上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238633023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"千古朝昏㸔太陰。若遇火羅相對照，强豪過似丈夫身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"命主寅申已亥宫，少年嫁娶主重重，一夫未能得到老，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"須是三夫方保終。婦人限行遇羅計，妨夫害子一生孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人禍福在福徳，炁若居之終戦尅，若是金水孛同居，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"到老沉迷貪花色。婦人最要㸔財宫，非星入此便為凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"若是此宫逢日月，為人端正好儀容。婦人亦要㸔遷移，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"羅孛居之主别離，若是限行逢紫炁，尅夫害子定無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人安命若坐馬，東驢西鶩常奔走，若有羅火在其中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837882916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"戀酒貪淫情太雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":507,"lineType":9,"content":"妻星論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"七宫之星在何宫，身星妻位須入贅，妻星入命最高門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"金星妻曜臨强位。妻星奴位宜偏室，不然奴僕壞人倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星入田并財帛，招得妻家人益財。妻星入子招好子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"陽宫多男陰多女。妻星若在疾厄宫，妻多疾厄還夀促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星福徳并官禄，夫妻和諧家富足。金炁同行在妻宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"此妻必與僧道通。金孛妻宫難得子，妻星須見兩三重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287694882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星若或在遷移，外州外縣與成親。金木妻宫多美貌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"金水同和百歳縁。火入妻宫妻用雙，土入妻宫無貌娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計妻宫多損失，夫妻不和亦主疾。妻星若在閑極宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟伯叔亦相通。妻星若在桃花上，淫聲四達醜家風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"男兒當把金為婦，女子元來火是夫。夫星得位夫無厄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"火星失位兩三重。水星若在桃花上，百嫁千夫無定向。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星若或在夫宫，孤眠獨枕誰與共。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453431092772916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"問曰：凡女人命，孰為吉為良？何為凶為賤？荅曰：凡女人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"命，須要五行清淡，不要生旺，又不要暴敗，不犯臨官，欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"得四柱無氣為隹，貴乎休囚死絶為上。不要帶貴人驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"馬、旺禄合神，已上為吉為良。若犯生旺臨官，𠔥有貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬、旺禄合神，皆為不美。若犯生旺臨官，三刑六害、陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"刃飛刃，皆為不善。○神白縱有云：驛馬遇貴人，終竟落","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"風塵。合絶莫合貴，此法人難知。但以日為年，此法聖人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"傳。帶禄入生旺，産死遭人謗。帶禄入衰鄉，雖禍未為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399837222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"司馬季主云：女人推命，貴人一者為良，若叢雜合多不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"尼，即妓又𠔥帶雙鴛合。○沈芝曰：桃花又帶雙鴛合，冗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"雜貴人真妓才。桃花者，臨官上見馬，謂之桃花馬。臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"上見刦煞，謂之桃花煞。又有一般煞。已酉丑，騎馬街頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"走","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"此言已酉丑生人見午是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"亥邜未，鼠子須堪避","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"此言亥邜未生人見子是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，兎子門前立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"此言寅午戌生人見邜是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，逢鷄夜不眠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"此言申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"辰生人見酉是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"○問曰：又何以謂之雙鴛合？荅曰：譬如一已見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"兩申，一乙見兩庚，一丙見兩辛，一丁見兩壬，皆為雙鴛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453451992825865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"合也。或是四柱干元有甲已，有乙庚，但是四柱中兩兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"對合，皆謂之雙鴛合。餘者皆倣此以為例。女命有之，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"為不良。○李愚叔云：貴人或落空亡𫟚，禄馬皆違如不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"值。設令性識甚聰明，男即伶倫女娼妓。亦有生來貴族","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"中，淫聲浪迹與娼同。須知斯命有所使，桃花三月開春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"風。○源髓歌云：滚滚桃花逐水飄，月籠花影任偏饒。多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"情只為傷空合，惆悵寡合魂易消。已上皆係桃花煞也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"犯之者皆為不良。○壺中子云：負天月二徳，則霞帔金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453451992842249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"冠；得禄命之財，則夫榮子貴。此可謂之吉也。若見三刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"六害、亡神、刼煞、孤辰寡㝛，皆主䘮夫尅子。凡男女宫皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"怕犯臨官帝旺，全主夫妻相傷。○源髓歌云：臨官帝旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"未為好，再嫁重婚傷亦早。若還相敵作夫妻，頭男頭女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"常見夭。若犯陽刃煞及朝冲陽刃者，皆主産厄。○源髓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：或時藏刃入於胎，日刃或朝時上來。更若干支相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"尅剥，妻身當産妊憂災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"此言夫命犯之，當主妻有産厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人之命若如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"此，敢斷定憂生産死。更加夘酉二時生，若免墮胎應尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850318399"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"子。朝充陽刃者，譬如卯生之人，見甲日與甲時之𩔖，或辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"日而時干見乙，此皆謂之朝充陽刃。餘者倣此以為例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
