{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"人生日月要分明，惡曜來侵禍不輕，金水若還來扶助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"不教富貴也聰明。○度主元來最緊要，人生難得當頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"照，若得升殿更當頭，定是生來福禄厚。○刃星最怕惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"星同，行限逢之定見凶，女命定因遭産厄，男人亦是惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"亡終。○禄主當頭坐命宫，此人至老不貧窮。若還登殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837932068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"入垣局，衣禄豐隆又不同。○官主朝陽定作貴，福星隨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"月福難攀。太陽落限人終賤，身主遭刑處世難。○仇星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"不可例言囚，若居垣局反自由。正怕㑹刑來尅命，平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗又多愁。○諸星㑹惡為交戰，人命逢之禍不輕。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"獨朝天居亥上，反為伏化吉星名。○若有星辰在命多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"必看星辰果如何，要知須是强星主，若是閑星莫羨他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"○大凡照命星辰行，便看其中弱與强。若是力停相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"戦，便是凶斷細推詳。○命看妻妾薄姻縁，只因命裏見羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287776802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"㬋。獨居午上當離地，反主齊眉到白頭。○惡㝛原來拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"刃星，限行隨刃禍非輕。倘還化吉仍為福，若是凶星惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"損身。○宫主離窠及失躔，未宜便把作凶言。若然來命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"歸垣數，是謂餘星反主權。○各各宫中只一星，對宫虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"拱最為榮。命中極喜相逢月，得地當為間世英。○赦文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"臨限喜非常，限主為囚亦不妨。但忌赦文來受尅，人逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"此難定堪傷。○孛星若見守財時，定主其人不妄為。决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"是慳貪無厚施，更於財上用心機。○南離一位號端門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238747711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"最喜陰陽兩伴存。若無惡星居此位，定教榮顯佐君尊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"○日月同宫守四正，富貴雙全無比並。若還羅計又交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，必主終身多疾病。○安命若居兩隔界，便把其宫度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"主看。各宫隨局看星辰，難把當生宫主斷。○人言財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"怕刑星，不曉刑星福不輕。反主分來多富貴，財星不䧟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"始豐榮。○官值刑囚須㑹得，便且看宫分主客。若還主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"客不齊强，有禄有權為上客。○紫炁原來是徳星，若居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"福位福非輕。亦須純粹無凶雜，惡煞星來隨𠮓更。○孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149887039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"星若是坐命宫，不可逢之便説凶。必主為人多計較，相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"交未可許其忠。○女命如逢水孛星，為人多曉又多能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"若還命在桃花上，必落煙花度此生。○女命因何不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"閑，只因刑囚在命間。更加福徳宫逢㑹，定主辛勤下賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"看。○惡曜如逢犯太陰，也應宿疾便來侵。不然母道相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"刑尅，更恐琴弦調失音。○妻宫若見月華明，定主其妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"貌相清。不但夫家得其力，定知財物亦豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"一說月有盈𧇊，妻宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"見之反是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"○妻宫若見惡星來，定主其妻見禍災。若是對降","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149903423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"無尅戦，也教琴瑟不和諧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":705,"lineType":9,"content":"續歩天經警句","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"二十二首此後人倣耶律而作也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴須將田宅尋，閑神不到福星臨。此星不落空亡地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"富主高强直萬金。日月若臨并拱夾，奴星亦到禍尤深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"若居惡弱須加合，萬頃千庄是此星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"富命以田宅為論，閑神不須臨之，要母星到，不落空亡，日月夾拱，當以富貴論。若田宅主奴僕，破之不宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。若田宅守惡，却得加盤入强宫，必是大富人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識徃來徹骨窮，母星尅䧟手拏空。互垣衆煞尤相併，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149919807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"身命還居惡弱宫。更犯天涯地角處，驅馳奔走任西東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"主照日月臨刑局，日不聊生此世中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"貧命母星受尅，更加衆煞相併，身命更守惡弱，辰戌之邦，奔走衣食，更日月臨刑局，日不聊生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"日月官星要得宜，加臨拱夾是玄機。若居惡弱須詳察，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"反在高强衣錦衣。身趕禄星并截馬，掌權握柄福巍巍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"母星若更逢生旺，富貴雙全世所稀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"貴命日月官禄星，須要得地，若居惡弱須加合，推之反在高强，身為高官而衣錦也。若太陰趕禄攔馬，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"為朝相，更命母居生旺，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149936191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"財星不必官星至，最怕財星落官位。為官端的是貪汚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮職剥官以為例。天馬若還居死絶，遷轉艱難當困滯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"奴星若更在高强，權在奴星少得志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"士夫功名當以天馬運行為凖。若遷官轉職，又以天馬加流年而數之，生旺遷轉、休囚死絶，必罷職剥官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"言為官之人，官星不宜居財帛，財星不可居官位，主為貪婪之人，因財䘮職。若天馬居當生太歳納音死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"絶之地，必然遷轉艱難。若官星為奴所泄，是為奴隷執權矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"主星最怕奴星泄，更怕餘奴居福徳身宫。若居惡弱宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"附近貴人無所得。太隂若躔四煞度，處世多迍無所遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149952575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"何期短夭夀命危。煞尅身命須畏懼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"命主為奴星所泄，更居福徳加太歳，命主皆居惡弱，乃奴隷附近貴人求温飽而已。若太陰居四煞度，平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"生遇貴不遇財。更煞星近身，命必不長年也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"局主官星居煞宫，孤寒門户豈亨通。太陰若更居三煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"命犯亡神主困窮。財星縱顯應無力，田力須强亦不中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"日月命身居死絶，空亡之地豈豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"局主，三限主也。官星，官禄主也。局主官星坐刼煞宫，乃孤寒之人。太陰最怕守三煞，命犯亡神，必主窮困。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"縱田財高强，若日月守死絶空亡，亦主生受。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149968959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰元主平生福，晝夜須當細品量。若是上弦為福重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢既望熾而昌。晝若逢羅夜逢計，生平成敗尅爺娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"縱是母星應不尅，若為官職豈安康。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":781,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以太陰為主，上弦至十五六夜生必為重福。若逢羅計，必生平成敗尅害父母。縱羅計不𧇊命母為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"官亦不安静。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"先看命主，次看度主，度二星為體用。主星若更坐高强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"度，主受刑為禍重。主若强時度更强，更逢生旺福而昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然落在休囚死，也是平生富足郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620149985343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":793,"lineType":2,"content":"看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":793,"lineType":2,"content":"命以宫度二主為體用，若命在高强度，主受刑為祸愈重。若宫度兩强逢生旺為福禄重，縱在休囚，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"作富人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"午忌羅㬋，未忌計躔。在鬼星作𦕈視。若以八煞眼無光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"限入此宫最可畏。兩宫坐命此星逢，為人强狠多奸計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻害子性無常。處事有權人義氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":803,"lineType":2,"content":"午未最忌羅計躔鬼星二㝛，若子丑　二宫安命，逢此二星守宫，乃八煞之地，必然眼目無光，輕則眇視，重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"則雙盲。若此兩宫安命，逢此必為强很，尅妻害子，為性不弱，有義氣之人也。午安命不以此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"申已二宫為肩背，孛羅土計忌相逢。肩斜背曲皆為爾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150001727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"兩耳須防病更聾。若是太陰同到此，為人夭折夀難終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"若躔觜翼尤為忌，若在張畢不相同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":815,"lineType":2,"content":"申已為肩背，若孛羅土計同到，必肩斜背曲，耳更常聾，太陰亦到此宫，夀非可永。若日月躔觜翼，為禍尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"深。若躔張畢，又能畧為小福耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"馬元若為難星尅，子丑寅亥最親切。不惟病跛不能行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"二限相逢須一跌。更加火孛來相侵，歳君衝動脚須折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"若還逢計亦為凶，足有風兮何待說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"凡馬元受尅，更在子丑寅亥四宫，必然跛足。若二限相併，更流年火孛交侵，歳君衝動，必然跛折脚足。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150018111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"此四宫逢計，亦有風足之災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"木人最怕計金扶，平生咳𠻳自焦枯。若是秋生應更𦂳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅相㑹命難圖。炁計更來必癆瘵，肺膓氣軋內空虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"行年若是炁金到，定在秋前䘮一軀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":837,"lineType":2,"content":"木命忌炁金相尅，更秋生㑹孛炁計，必主癆瘵，平生咳𠻳肌肉消瘦。流年炁金又來，秋前必死矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"為人蹇吃不能言，火命尤防土計孛。土若退行真可畏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"畧無誠信向人前。命在胃氐并栁女，若逢土計亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"若為夜忌居辰戌，身在其中福亦偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150034495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"火星忌土計相攻，為人蹇吃語滯。若胃氐栁女安命，更土逆在辰戌，太隂同到，必是啞人，為福亦淺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"吐紅翻胃是何星，水命須防炁火臨。身䘮命亡從此得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"更加孛計定相刑。太陰受此惡星制，處世艱難貧又貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"更值行年惡星犯，其人必定入泉扃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":855,"lineType":2,"content":"水命逢煞火相㑹，主有吐紅翻胃之疾。更孛計㑹太陰，必主貧賤。若行年惡星犯，其人必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"金命尤防羅火逢，氣瘤之疾必傷人。若在寅亥躔尾室，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"痔疾相煎亦損神。更忌癰疽并癤毒，羅㬋相㑹禍須頻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"若在辰命限居未，腦發摧殘禍有因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150050879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"金命逢火羅，必有氣疾瘤癭。若星在寅亥室尾，亦患痔漏，更流羅重㑹，主有癰疽癤毒。如辰命限未，或合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"見木羅，流年更到，必為腦發，因此命終矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"膓風虚膽常驚畏，土命怕逢孛與計。更逢木炁兩相侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"若是馬元手足墜，太陰孛計若同宫。女人值之誠不利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"一生産厄損兒男。歸在辰宫生腋氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":875,"lineType":2,"content":"土命怕計孛，主病膓風，更木炁相㑹，又是馬元損足。太陰與計孛同宫，女人值之，産厄損胎，在八煞主腋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，男女同斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"倒限從來要煞推，限行遇此實相猜。須分書夜還當忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150067263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不臨時禍不摧。限路若危防節氣，若逢凶曜禍須來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"節如帶煞須難度，此是星家大妙哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"倒限以煞為難，亦分書夜行，年煞不臨，則不然矣，終輕。若行年煞到更遇節氣，如金命忌立夏，是節帶煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"男忌黄泉女急脚，限危遇此端消爍。要知此煞有動時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"火年動在寅午戌。若逢此月禍相侵，限在危時身必卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"不作黄泉久逝魂，也作人間無禄客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"急脚限是子午夘酉為黄泉，寅申巳亥辰戌丑未為急脚。此煞火年動在寅午戍月，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150083647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"羅食朔兮計食望，日月相逢身浪蕩。若居厄難眼無光，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"若守命身人性莽。不為朔望何須忌，平生作事多奸計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"定主陰謀䧟害人，與人寡合無一是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"羅計分朔望忌之。若日月相逢，必是浪蕩之人，在疾厄則眼目無光。若此星犯命，主為人譎而不正，與人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"寡合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星為性最猖狂，男女逢之定不良。若使羅㬋相㑹遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"定於産厄必身亡。奸計㑹之為賊首，毒熒同到必凶强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"若人值此四餘曜，禍有胎𠔃福不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150100031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"孛星為性不定，不問男女皆淫冶不良。若會羅，男必尅妻損子，女必墮胎。若㑹計為賊首，若是有用星，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"因得疾，福不長久，與火相㑹，為人凶强奸猾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"且說婦人淫不淫，最嫌命位孛金臨。墮胎血塊令人駭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"十度懷胎九不成。若得木星相㑹遇，轉為吉兆福來臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫再見熒羅㑹，害子妨夫不可禁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"女人若金孛守命，必然墮胎損子，血塊常有。若三合木臨，可轉凶為吉。若火羅同守或三合會，害夫損子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"二三重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"天上星辰皆拱北，斷星須要觀星客。天機妙訣少人知，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150116415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中有生尅。就中制化未易言，心中經綸自推測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"合將宫度兩相叅，便是神仙竒妙訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":941,"lineType":9,"content":"星躔摘金集十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要訣有真機，更有幽玄識者稀。不遇明師親付與，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"任君模倣盡皆非。摘金語句臨行訣，漏泄天機竒更竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"立命星辰分母賊，太陰一訣在詳推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"559","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"解日：五行要訣端有玄微，不可模倣忖度，非明師親付，何從得之？如十二宫命中要訣及卦氣，己授受矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"感君之厚，察君之勤，摘金一書，臨行分付，此竒中竒，玄中玄。看命之法，命宫且緩，身宫最急。蓋命衆人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150132799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":955,"lineType":2,"content":"所同，身一人之所獨，所以推歩月行，最為親切。子今得吾之傳，當秘藏之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"月行中天多顯晦，圓缺朔望不相同。如人降生禀所賦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴貧賤有窮通。所以推月不執泥，分配五星各相從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅制化於身取，若還反背實無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":963,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰月行中天，自有明暗圓缺、晦朔弦望不同，如人處世，有貧賤富貴亨迍之異，此命宫緩而身宫急也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":965,"lineType":2,"content":"平生禍福，必以身驗，看月不可以拘泥，當從五星分配生尅制化取之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"命在子丑月是土，命居寅亥配成木，命火還從火星推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"命居辰酉從金取，命在已申以水論，命居太陽從日程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150149183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有未垣并金鬼，宿身順背看陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"土星嫌木最嫌炁，木怕金星與火羅。火㝛從來嫌水孛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"金星熒惑莫相過。已申之水最怕土，計孛兩曜不諧和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"午日木炁為掩禍，太陰土計福消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":981,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰此論仇賊也。以月配五星，惡見仇賊，所謂安身傍鬼者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"土垣見火為命母，木垣水㝛福無阻。火垣木曜喜相逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"金垣土宿真貴路。水逢金徳占巍魁，太陽金水分明美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"月見金高並火羅，十二宫中忌奴氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150165567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":991,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰此論命母也。以月配五行，喜見生我助我，子丑命火羅夾月皆福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"五行在天成象緯，分曜於地便成形。假如水徳降於地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"子旺辰墓長生申。萬物成形有生滅，消長陰陽從屈伸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"不須執泥五星象，旺生墓即是星辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":999,"lineType":2,"content":"觧曰五形在天成象，在地成形。金木水火土，光芒炳炳於天，本與天地相長久，及其降形於地，則生旺便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1001,"lineType":2,"content":"有墓。蓋五行在人間，消長盈虛，存乎四時，安可不求五行之盛衰。及至流行於地，則生申旺子，繼之墓辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1003,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋申子辰即水之所成，於此取星辰三合，義極為當，吉凶有准。如戌命火，故忌水。但月在申子辰之地，繼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1005,"lineType":2,"content":"以煞在限，於此必死，蓋即水也，不必要明見水奪，方指為凶。無中有象，莫重於此。直曜母星，鬼奪殿駕，重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150181951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1009,"lineType":2,"content":"垣之星，皆以鬼母相叅，得用失用，玄齋所謂局勢叅詳判死生，此乃察五星之地支者至切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"亥宫主木木長生，至邜旺位轉敷榮。未宫成庫全木局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"春來得勢便亨通。惟有土命為鬼局，太陰在上恐難行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"火宫取位為毋位，太隂同火見光明。限行取舍判於此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"凶吉猶如谷裏聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1019,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰亥邜未，木局，最宜火命，用為毋鄉，稍有星辰，得用全吉。但不宜土命。如子丑命有木，邜上險地也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1021,"lineType":2,"content":"生當春月，有煞合太陰居之，無陰注陽，受䧟禍必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"已宫金炁初舒處，酉位横鋒逞刃芒。丑則成形歸庫實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150198335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫秋月最難當。若是木星為命主，申限一見便刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"惟喜水人居正局，太陰符合獲禎祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1031,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰已酉丑，金局也，木命忌之。若見土計身在其上，便是黨惡，更加神煞衝動，生平福氣消磨，限行即死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1033,"lineType":2,"content":"但水命人用為母局，當殿駕禄貴月在其中有利益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"人馬之宫火始生，纔臨南午勢炎炎。白羊入墓成局勢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"辰酉安命最為嫌。若有木星當夏月，太陰限路禍相𠔥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"土命若還得正局，平生福禄實光亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1041,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：寅午戌火局，辰酉二金所嫌，生於夏月，火烈金銷，更有木炁閑神入局，同惡相濟，身命相干，必死。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150214719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1045,"lineType":2,"content":"土命為福地，蓋母也。經云：五行既列諸辰次，相叅推究定枯榮。二十八宿本脉絡，其名雖異實同途。假如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1047,"lineType":2,"content":"火命火為局，尾觜翼室即一隅。不待星見方是限，但觀氣數辯盈虚。○五星即五行，五行即地支之寄，地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1049,"lineType":2,"content":"支即二十八㝛之閫奥，二十八㝛即辰舍之脉絡，初不待正見星辰方為凶吉。蓋五行之氣寄於二十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"㝛之度中，便當推度主之。火得時得位在他宫，何若在地垣，借氣守重垣，則入四火度中，便為吉凶。如金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1053,"lineType":2,"content":"忌之，土樂之之𩔖，一得一失，殃咎立至，諸垣以例推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"看星須看得時星，看煞須看局重輕。星若得時主事立，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"局若重時禍轉深。煞星切忌時之旺，更𠔥當直禍流行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星若也俱休廢，貰死須知福不増。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150231103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1063,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：推五星於𦂳處，便當明得時失時。所用之星要得時，所忌之星要失時。局勢最嫌專城，禍煞最要失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1065,"lineType":2,"content":"時。若得時守局，一死無疑。煞星若尅此命，安身於凶神之地，命中何所仰賴，此𤣥中𤣥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"談命最急為局勢，其次最切是閒神。閒神返背實為禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"夾煞侵垣凶即生。若也諸星當夜煞，十人九死决難生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"若得調達煞神意，便是神仙陸地行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1073,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：煞者，亡神刼的凶神也。神者，局勢也。煞神衝合地局，一叚閒神亂占，我家有禍生焉。又有閒神侵凌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":1075,"lineType":2,"content":"為之勢，安得生意夜生暗占煞行限十人九死，大抵限路最切，消詳局勢，生我者吉，尅我者凶。閒神入局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1077,"lineType":2,"content":"者凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150247487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"貴禄同宫煞又臨，居垣得地禍辰侵。吉凶同位如何判，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"於此分明說摘金。出入度中還煞管，正垣分爾善星明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"貴禄歳垣依舊制，不妨發福事從心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1087,"lineType":2,"content":"解曰：貴禄在此宫，又有閒神同守，還如何分？訣以入垣出垣為煞主之，見凶兆合倒限，及至中間正垣，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1089,"lineType":2,"content":"吉神之位。蓋天星吉神正臨垣度，若君子席不正不坐地煞專守偏處，候人於危厄之際。大抵一宫必分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"中初末，有隂注陽受解之，雖不死亦無吉利。至於出垣交承之際，禍竟再合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星居煞有其煞，陽刃亡神三煞同。更有一般為的位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌重疊定招凶。獨見煞垣難煞尾，兩煞當詳隔界中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150263871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有三神至三位，亭亭禍患在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"此法當審煞度也。如　一宫見煞，限到其上，則出限三四度定凶，詳湧頭接脚之法，以定出入。前後宫兩有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1103,"lineType":2,"content":"有煞，則於兩宫之界出此宫入彼垣，必然凶發。若是三煞倒限行煞正中間不好。大抵專看神煞重疊。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1105,"lineType":2,"content":"一垣有煞，天盤地局兩三處又見，則莫大之禍。若是三煞更天盤，煞神合處人應死，不問命母互加，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞之中皆倒限，至切靈驗。與何星。三合更加閒神到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"斯人斷定入泉扄。最是直星居煞地，大限纔交身必傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"此是摘金真口訣，方知神煞最為靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1113,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞交合處，前所説限入必死，不問毋曜，皆可倒限。若見間神入局，直難星入煞限行十有九死。大抵地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150280255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":1117,"lineType":2,"content":"煞若合，縱有善星亦救不得，但流年有凶，來即死矣。所謂母曜倒限，此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"從來日月是尊星，限見無非福禄榮。夾拱吉慶為吉局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"惹凶引禍害須生。三合若也包煞局，閑神一入更難行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有根基為穩實，也應著脚向㝠程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":1125,"lineType":2,"content":"日月為天之曜，限見當發，其說自是。若夾拱凶星，直難閑神三合拱住煞局，則不可知矣，限入必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄從來號健宫，中年限路便相逢。陰陽合朔來相照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇闗闌禍竟攻。陰凌陽替天盤午，限路交承實是凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中皆忌見，解神欲救亦無從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150296639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1135,"lineType":2,"content":"命前巳宫是官禄，乃天盤南離之地，至貴之曜，當權之時，豈陰陽同處？十　二宫中坐命入限，見日月合朔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1137,"lineType":2,"content":"官宫若遇闗闌皆倒，無闗闌者，富貴闗闌必羅計也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星形勢最為先，禍福無差玄又玄。限路榮枯生死訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"却為局勢有真詮。星位乎天辰次地，星辰勢路要叅研。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"摘取幽玄金様比，擇人而付有心傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1145,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴貧賤，必以星而取。觀星之法，形勢為先。限路榮枯，生死真機，只於煞局而取。所謂形勢煞局，乃觀星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1147,"lineType":2,"content":"推測要領。摘出幽㣲，真金可比，擇人傳心，斯得之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":1149,"lineType":9,"content":"星辰雜斷歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150313023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"五星衆宿逐官移，日月得地要明知。忽然落䧟𠔥遲疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"沒處有星仔細推。○日在子兮月在午，移乾就濕夭而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"貧。日若纒危方可慮，月躔星宿始為凶。若還日虚月張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"位，何愁南北與西東。○火行戌亥便為災，水土龍蛇忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"有哀。金遇邜寅須有否，木行申酉最相乖。○太隂生來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"在陷宫，僥倖吏軰又英雄。府縣㕔前聽呼喚，上弦月皎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"福昌隆。○四月生人帶邜時，斯人不夀報君知。若教父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"沒身隨沒，三十年來父不隨。○四月生人月照亥，少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150329407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此便為災。若值空亡禍減半，若臨煞地禍重來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1171,"lineType":2,"content":"照亥則在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":1173,"lineType":2,"content":"巳也已為陽極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"假如申上安命宫，最嫌土計便為凶。若還土計居衛分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有災殃命不終。○月作妻宫宜作贅，不然妻主立其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"雙。如何妻年不相同，月孛元來在妻宫。○男女宫中多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"竅妙，日生最怕太陰照。夜誕亦忌太陽臨，縱然有子無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"兒呌。○第四火星嫌在晝，但看命中何所守。少年孤苦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"老無兒。百歳何曽開得口。○第五宫中須哭兒，第七宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150345791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"中須䘮偶。忽然火星臨十一，福禄𧇊𠔃仍損夀。○女人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"安命坐四馬，嫁夫生子定重重。男人命坐四馬位，超越","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"世𩔖更英雄。○男人行限見太隂，娶妻招妾每年𡬶。忽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"然金孛一齊入，咏月嘲風使萬金。○魁星若産在高强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇官星名必揚。孛羅為權計為印，定他壯歳拜三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"○十月酉時月在邜，若躔房宿始為竒。若還晝誕行已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"限，夫妻不死也分離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1201,"lineType":2,"content":"亥限見妻宫，晝月故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃最嫌自刃宫，戊午丙午最為凶。壬子癸丑相逢著，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150362175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"决定危亡不善終。○享通顯達逢生旺，遯悶迍危遇併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"衝。此是交相生死訣，吉凶消息在其中。○壬子之人生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"十月，空胎無禄兩般凶。假饒時日逢亡刼，也須危亡不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"善終。○空亡空盡始為竒，空則能容塞則迷。萬物皆從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"空裏出，能令富貴享耆頤。○惟有金空空則鳴，火空則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"發土空䧟。木空則折君須記，水空河海能枯渴。○隂見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"陽空無足取，陽見陰空真可懼。雖然空裏分陰陽，也須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"識得天機趣。○論命之人見論時，時真命定更無疑。天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150378559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"時隂晦夜長短，仔細推詳講是非。○人生從何論吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"又嫌運限禄馬衝。禄逢衝破馬逢絶，富貴之人亦語凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"○凡人命限無生旺，吉曜臨𠔃吉不動。生又不生旺不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，一切妻兒無可望。○最嫌運限禄馬衝，破盡錢財費","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"盡功。初限若還逢太歳，若無凶曜亦無凶。○人生體用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"要高强，生旺臨官吉宿長。生處自生旺自旺，一切營求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"皆吉昌○時。人身命絶中生死，命衰中衰不榮。絶處逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"生君細認，背中反旺是高人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星把甚為根源。當以宫主為闗鍵，三命天盤在眼前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"當頭對照天淵逺，諸宫皆以邜宫加。又以天盤再轉寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"邜酉二宫却加子。此宫又以數宫主，强弱尤須看命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"命母尤為利害闗。母若逢生能獲福，若逢尅母禍之端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"賊星若見犯吾毋，一世貧窮百事難。假如安命在辰酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"便看太陰何所守。若居邜戌必傷身，最喜躔在於子丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150411327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有火羅子丑中，火羅又能生二㝛。凶星反作吉星行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中細推究。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1265,"lineType":9,"content":"歌凶躔次度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"安命若坐陰陽界，更在穿心并六害。若男定是正男兒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"焉知父母重重拜。女命安命在此宫，嫁送不妨三兩再。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神刼煞互相加，若不犯刑亦破敗。生尅星辰固易言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"隨宫制化最難明。金若逢火被孛制，木來尅土更逢熒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"吉多凶少為吉斷，凶多吉少作凶行。吉凶禍福明如鏡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150427711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"當以分毫别重輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1281,"lineType":9,"content":"歌定時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"生時訛説不分明，虚費心機枉役情。好語生時自差錯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"莫言算法不分明。測驗生時正與攲，却從何理得明知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"但將父母𠔥兄弟，妻子宫中察細微。先安命位落何中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾兒孫在甚宫。父母兄弟何所在，隨星推屬識窮通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1291,"lineType":9,"content":"又歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"同年同月日時同，福禄如何兩不通。或有妻房并子息，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150444095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"或無兒女守空宫。一人富貴無長夀，二命之中難測度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"諭君靜處細思量：生時同處命難齊，聽我分明為指迷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"必是婚中不同命，只因孤尅尅妻兒。又推風水𠔥陰徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"又怕夫妻命運低。好把人生三代論，何愁南北與東西。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1tf8/1-SK1609_figure_00042.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XDIeavy64PkDWx3e8QSYdqJ%2B%2F3M%3D","pictureHeight":307,"pictureWidth":310,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1tf8/1-SK1609_figure_00042.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Dk3zhhW0ViGzNljF%2Be1BdkhULLY%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l1tf8/1-SK1609_figure_00042.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618855620150460479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
