{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"流年禍福，必從當生禍福為凖，以正命宫為定，方判吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。且如一般行限，一般流年，星辰到而禍福並不同者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？必須先㸔身命限度，當生有無吉凶星守照，方可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"言之。如立命子，行限寅，當生難星守大限流年難星亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599162368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"到，甚者死，輕者病。如有天官符、地官符，干渉田財命限，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"則有官刑，輕重一般斷之。有喪門、白虎守命限，則有孝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"服。如當生無難星到流年，有難星到命限者有禍，或者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"當生有一恩照則吉。餘倣此。切不可一例以火羅、計孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"為凶星，木炁、金、水、土為善星。又如立命於子，木炁為難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅為恩，若火羅照命限，未可以為凶，乃恩星也，必得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"意。遇紅鸞、天喜有喜，遇陽刃、亡刼、空亡，太歳亦不降福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢流孛，難星到火羅亦到，是他星反激起火羅之怒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453434469236786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"又不能降福矣。又如木炁是流年，難星到命限，或是對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"合，必主不寜，亦須㸔當生星得地否，更㸔流年限到何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"度。如是限到難度，當生難星明健，必主重險。如限到恩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"度，當生難柔弱流年，難星來而禍重矣。更可詳細分别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"病、訟、孝服等事，如逢歳破、大耗、亡刼、天地官符，必訟。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"流年、䘮門、白虎、天哭、吊客，輕則孝服，重則親䘮。如擎遊、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"病符、死符、披頭、血刃有病。重輕生死依當生限度上定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"之。但是凶難守照命宫則禍輕，臨照限宫則禍重，吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599195136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然。所緊要者太歳，有太歳守命限，一年平安，又有喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"事。有太歳守命限，而一年凶災疊出，或孝服重重，止從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"納音生尅與命宫限度，有情無情衝守，有偏有正，正則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"必禍，偏則無妨。更於當生星辰上，衝併吉凶以斷之。便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"從太歳上數起，一太歳，二太陽，三䘮門，四太陰，五官符，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"六死符，七歳破，八龍徳，九白虎，十福徳，十一吊客，十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"病符。從命限所臨之地，流年星辰凶吉，以定禍福。火羅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"頭見計孛，土主尾見木炁同時，皆主末闗之事，全在太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238878783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"歳神煞上取用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":9,"content":"流年都天賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"命為本，限為末，定中年之榮枯；星移次煞移宫，决流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"之休咎。太歳乃諸神之統領，月將為衆煞之樞機。月建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"併煞臨身，無吉曜必遭横攪；太歳趕煞入局，遇惡曜定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"入泉鄉。䘮門白虎哭聲騰，血刃官符公訟起。擎天遊奕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"照身命，則倐頓生災；豹尾黄幡臨限程，則纒綿有病。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"耗并計孛、火羅於地座，則家破人離；紅鸞遇木金、炁水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850465855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"於限程，則財豐禄厚。催官星至，須知恩命之榮；食禄星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，乃見文書之喜。添人進口，天喜便遇吉星；足禄多財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞不臨財位。紅鸞乃非吉曜，天喜乃是凶神。須看交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"併何如，方定災祥奚若。遇吉則為吉斷，逢凶須作凶㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"天蠱為血光之神，白虎乃重䘮之煞。紅鸞照命有喜可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"消膿血之災；大煞臨身，無病必招刑憲之禍。木炁須為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜，土命之人則以為災。土孛本是凶星，木星之人反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"能招福。水孛主腎部疾𠻳，失脱破財。火羅主心腹血光，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456279388212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"是非致訟。欲知陰人齟齬。金孛照命值官符，如逢高貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"提攜，炁木臨身逢天喜。財逢刼煞，須防盜賊之侵；田值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"官符，未免户争之撓。擎天莫臨妻子之位，骨肉相刑；官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"符怕到兄弟之宫，訟庭爭理。死符病符當命限，切忌浮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"災；大煞刼煞臨田財，須防暗損。凶攅煞聚，九死一生之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"年；煞值星扶，三滿三平之歳。馬到遷移逢紫炁，千里稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"心；禄臨主限照金星，四時進喜。血刄傷財破蕩，六害尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"子防妻。咸池併限閙林中，三煞衝身路泉口。吊客主門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238846015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"庭之孝，血毒生瘡疾之災。黄幡怕與火羅併，囚中致死；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"豹尾只宜木金救，險處生祥。凶星得用進權名，惡煞攻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"身防險厄。棄人間事。歳君趕煞併限入喪門；從地下遊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"歳破攅凶併，命臨三煞。所喜者左助右救，所忌者後逼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"前空。更加闌干之凶，必定幽㝠之禍。驟加官職。天喜照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"限，福星臨，横進資財；官禄臨身凶曜退，勾絞。四時多撓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"交争不明。刼亡一日為災，迍邅莫免。更忌星躔留退，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"防煞反攻神。攅凶須作夢中人，聚惡乃為泉下客。有救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837981220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉，無救則凶。若叅較乎災祥，宜酌量乎輕重。僅見斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"文，秘之為寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":149,"lineType":9,"content":"流年雜斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"且如子丑安命，火羅計孛入命，更元守有凶。蓋命宫屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"土，火羅生我，如書生以火羅為嫌，雖凶亦輕，但恐孛併，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"却為凶惡。如夜生遇火羅，更有木合之，天喜扶之，飛殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"合之，是年𨚫有喜慶。仕宦有遷除之喜，常人亦吉慶。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌木炁孛，更以土計併，或限入煞鄉，或遇子午邜酉之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287891490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"年，禍患愈甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"且如命在已申，俱以火羅土計孛為災，火羅晝生愈速，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生稍輕，土計孛亦主災患，夜生其禍甚焉。若土計交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"運交限最凶，諸化福禄何益？在庶人則多疾病破耗，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴則被紏彈，公吏則主剌配。若命中元守薄惡，根基","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"淺弱，必主夭亡。若是天干夀元金者，或木炁交合，却不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"致於傷夀，亦不能無災病官非。若木炁交合，天喜飛殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之，申命則取木為官，已命則取木為田主，皆為吉用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287957026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"倘或晝生甲乙干，或納音木者，便以水為天馬職元局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"主，及當用三方主之𩔖，是年决有喜慶，庶人得財，仕宦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"升職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"且如寅亥坐命，亥以火為財，夜生得之有財，寅以土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"財，晝生乃得利。若星交羅計土孛在命限者，書生皆能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"為災，甚至夭折。若命與身元坐煞地，必致傷殘。但諸星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"单行，斯為有用，不犯官、病、符、䘮門、吊客，其流行之星雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"為忌曜、難星，無凶星黨之，其為害不甚切。忽以土星入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931211813"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"流於寅亥，遇流金入宫為害，其人當一塲大禍，縱根基","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"深厚，倘三合無火制之亦危。若生秋冬月，更㑹流年，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"冬三月其禍未易支持，勢須水入宫或三合見水，方可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"少化其毒。生於春夏，命中元守有水在焉，可以泄土金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，壯木之根，則無患矣。若流年火、土金星三合交併，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"加以煞動，即不可遏矣。若水星合木流入命宫，又天喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"加臨飛殿，在仕則遷，在庶人得財喜，僧道有住持，商賈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"得財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456279371828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"且如命在辰酉，最怕流年火羅為災，如火羅入命限，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁㑹之，比其黨惡，縱其歳煞星不動，亦主多災。本宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"三合有土見之，方可化其毒。若土单行於此二宫，或臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"限度，晝生當有名利，夜生為福亦輕。○酉宫立命者，流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"年火土交，土孛㑹，皆為吉用。土為官星，君子為官，小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"得財。○辰宫立命，獨火行權，無孛羅相掩，夜生主有財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"喜，晝生亦輕，蓋火為財帛主也。若火土木為天馬職元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"局主，得之大吉，縱非驛馬職元局主，次吉。獨辰宫夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470837997604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"見火為吉，酉宫見火為嫌。若流年有土計㑹之亦好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"且如命坐夘戌，最怕流年水孛為災，遇火羅不為忌。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"羅土計孛併官符病符相犯，即主災殃。若獨火獨羅，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛流行，或水孛流退，逆在彼則災不小，若加流煞衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"動，多致夭亡。必須元守有木炁土計制化之，方可無害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"否則有膓風腎氣之病。若流木合水孛，更有喜氣扶之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"即為吉用。若飛殿㑹命限入官，木炁得地入照對宫或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"三合，更遇時令强盛，必有不擬機㑹，縱無火得用，亦可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850515007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"稱情。若命元守當用之星高强，斷可名利。○夘宫命者，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"水為難，更值流水孛同行，或遲或留，在少年一病可過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"中年值此必得㝛疾，縱不致死，亦為身累。○戌宫命者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"或火孛入限，遇䘮門、白虎、吊客併到，於六親兄弟必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"殘傷。如䘮門、吊客等不併，只為官符之𩔖相併，主奴僕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"小人侵盜，以致官災，否則兄弟有争，此為至驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"且如命在午未者，午太陽，未太陰，居午者則火、羅、計、孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"為武職之用，不可目之為忌曜。若他宫則火、羅、計、孛為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238911551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"犯分之星。午宫流年獨火獨羅、計、孛，俱不足畏。蓋以端","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"門帝座之位，凶徒惡黨何敢犯上，只恐羣凶交併，傍無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"吉曜解紛，倘有制化，亦不然矣。若火、羅、計、孛獨行，不見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"流年諸煞官符重㑹則吉。未上之火見於白晝，未免為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。夜生值火，流入命宫，或三合無土，計、孛合之，斯為吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"宿。蓋未以火為官主，火、羅晝交亦非吉，土、計夜交尤為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，甚至傷殘，輕則重厄。蓋夜見土、計，本為忌曜，况土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"難，故值此不死，亦主有㝛疾及陰小之災，仕宦則有剥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931195429"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"職之憂，庶民有非常之厄。最忌土計處强為𦂳。若獨孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"流入命宫，不㑹流年諸煞，反為可取之星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"凡流年諸星，須詳與命限有用無用，切勿以化氣為取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"舍。得其用，則刑囚暗耗能為吉矣。失其用，則福禄權貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"又何益焉。詳推造化，斟酌吉凶，出於一時之明見，安可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"執一而不通也哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":301,"lineType":9,"content":"太歳歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"最是凶神為太歳，須把宫神相正配。相生相順福之基，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456279355444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅相刑真可畏。假如木徳是宫神，最怕納金來相尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"一生福氣少精神，縱有發揮終進退。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"歳駕歳勲并歳貴，此星最忌入空亡。馬如空馬貴空貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有前程不久長。若是崇勲居此地，不能安享坐高堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"身空宜向門前立，須把年頭仔細詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"歳㝛當權為惡毒，衆星各各俱降伏。他如尅我我無權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"一生寂寞多孤獨。我尅他時他受制，手足傷殘傷耳目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星宫主要比和，同室操戈皆不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599178752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"流年太歳怕當頭，中度逢之實可憂。口舌破財須疊見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥忌尅惹閑愁。若還壓命𠔥臨限，更值凶神不死休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中皆可畏，惟有子午得優游。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神惡煞如何看，須把凶神叅可斷。如逢旺相必為凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇長生多險難。休囚死絶禍尤遲，縱有災危應减半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"歳星惡黨禍難迯，不憂侵命憂侵限。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"駕為太歳號尊君，命忌居前不足論。奴僕若臨終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"闕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻如遇奪夫權。兄弟臨之多凌辱，疾厄臨之貌不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599211520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌凶星侵限路，又怕難星傷限元。若是命身如坐馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"一生安享福長年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"更説歳星玄又妙，駕星最喜居垣廟。平生多近貴人財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"必有貴人扶左右。不宜破駕有飛星，不喜臨朝逢客曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"少年及第取功名，駕中還有官星照。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"歳星若是土為區，行限須當怕計都。縱使金神為命主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢餘曜亦焦枯。能奪土星又無氣，處世無權作懦夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"歳徳為尊防泄氣，豈知所忌在餘奴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453452399869990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"命宫莫把他宫取，須於命處尋元守。行限須交論𠮓通，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"便把局垣深考究。若本宫星已䧟弱，雖有流年安可救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"兩强爭長迭强梁，到底還須奴㝛强。須要正星知退伏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"自相遜讓更何妨。若還兩母俱生我，正母還須氣力剛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"餘母無權𠔥受制，自然安靜更無殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"假如辰上安命人，已未兩宫偏怕土。命宫為體限為用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"命主論宫限論度。其中造化妙而玄，十二宫中俱倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"古來子丑偏怕計，彼皆分泄當生氣，縱然能生不到頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931277349"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"若是单行生我主，他宫别處可推求。三合照臨却得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"五星推此無限休，已申之中孛可忌，邜戌二宫羅可憂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥二宫炁不喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":385,"lineType":9,"content":"倒限要訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"倒限之法亦難取用，有一般難星，而一死一生，須看命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"躔何度次㸔虚實時候，書夜旺相休囚死絶，方可判之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"如立命辰，金為主，所怕者火羅，不死者何必先問命度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"如或命緯亢度，前面逢火羅，若是司令，晝現必死，背時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453472238895167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生不死。命緯金度亦如是斷。又如立命在辰，土計為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"恩，守於命宫，前面逢火羅，甚者必死。或火羅稍弱，决不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"可倒限。其餘宫分並依此例。又如一般難度，必須問空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，有空亡者不死，無空亡者死。又如難星值限，𠔥被黨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"之者必死矣。又如立命亥，怕者金星，如金居子三合，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"援者不死，無援者死。金若在丑，及已酉丑三方照見金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"星，皆可斷的然倒限巳酉丑乃金局，縱然有援，不甚親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"切，必死。餘者依此例斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931179045"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":415,"lineType":9,"content":"暘谷倒限説","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"且如倒限一説，跟挨度數而推，有煞刃者遇太歳必傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"無煞刃者，縱凶不死。子虚女度，木煞真凶。丑金斗木金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"亦為憂，惟有牛金獨炁為害。箕水寅宫，木土兩取，土當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"火令，水弱必傷。若逢春季之中，却又不能為禍。尾火度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"內，寅邜兩端，寅宫屬木，水孛禍輕。卯末尾初，羅水必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"心月房日，忌水孛羅。氐土火垣，木弱不尅，辰宫末度，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"炁必傷。亢金堅實，不忌火羅，怕逢夏令，角木焦枯，專嫌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850449471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"羅火，金亦為憂。軫占辰已兩宫，已軫獨怕計渴。翼火水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"垣，冬嫌土計星忌奴羅。張懼奴計，桞土兩説，午桞最怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"奴忌鬼栁，忌炁忌羅。井懼計羅，又怕冬旺。參嫌奴孛，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"亦為憂，奴炁亦凶，四時皆忌。畢月忌炁，又怕土計為害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"不問申酉二宫，最怕炁以燋渴。昴日胃土，見木必尅。婁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"金火殿，又忌水星。夏火最嗔羅㬋。奎中金炁，皆是凶神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"壁水又忌炁星，又嫌水孛滋嘬。觜火室火，羅計、水孛皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"凶煞。若同行其度，不以為利，更㸔命在何宫，限行何處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850531391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"於斯消詳，决不失也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":453,"lineType":9,"content":"倒限歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"子虛有木星，三冬人須卒。丑牛有金星，遇土須富室。秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"土損亢金，計都亦相逼。刃月怕傷木，不死生重疾。設若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴人，見之破屋室。角木遇者凶，斗木遇者吉。若犯奎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"木度，十有九人死。木土好齊瓶，九夏水為迍。尾火怕秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"金，冬水傷房日，又有翼火蛇。有土三冬滅，星日與翼同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼井忌計攻，昴日忌羅火，參水專怕孛，婁金怕水星。孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287858722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"亦能為泄，室火木之垣。計羅難說吉。須要辯，煞星難忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"皆值刑，更落空亡位，遇者夀須傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":473,"lineType":9,"content":"説三闗之詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"如子上初闗危十二度，中闗虚六度，末闗女二度，並以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾出入度分，初中末度為正闗，九五度為卒，三合吊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"者不過三度，四正衝者不過一度。煞居三方之正垣，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"人死於上節；煞居初闗，死於下節之前，上節之後；煞居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"末闗，死於下節之後，上節之前。一度節後一日死，二度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456287875106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"節後二日死，三度節後三日死。並依度數加减日分上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"取之，無有不准。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":491,"lineType":9,"content":"歌云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"危張心月怕土計，虛危二㝛又怕炁。心中二㝛怕羅星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"畢月嫌羅與計炁。火羅同木日灰飛，夏月逢之死莫疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁不宜居土度，若躔土度有災危。金木不宜居四土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"行限木度必災殃。火星忌剗四金度限，若逢之人必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"水星若躔四火度，喚作斷橋無去路。土行水限不為竒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850482239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"若行此度便驚危。陽刃的煞奴欺主，皆怕同行剗度中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"煞重權高逞劒鋒，剛强勇敢氣如虹。項王休逞㧞山力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"韓信徒誇建國功。一行剗度無星救，堪喚危亡頃刻中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":511,"lineType":9,"content":"倒限要訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"日月夾煞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命以日月為𦂳，但臨於本年煞地為凶，子午邜酉煞已宫是也。二曜同居其上，或前後兩宫皆有夾煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"倘凶併即傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"日月㑹煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453470850433087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"如破碎三煞之鄉，二曜同臨其上，前後不出三十度，少年行限亦危，中年多不出，此最是𦂳闗之煞，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"不信。大忌官宫入煞，即無解也，必至傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"日月犯刄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙人辰為刃，更以歳家三煞交㑹其上，日月臨之，雖吉星資扶，行限至此，亦為凶兆。或者行限脫此煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"尾亦不可脱。若在强宫，如官禄福徳之類。緊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"日月入四正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"命以日月為諸星之首，三合對處有利害，若㑹處亦有疾病。如日月之㑹近朔晦，即臨於朔前後，不過三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"四日矣。若日月㑹四正，最怕天凶地煞併之。天凶乃羅計、土孛，地煞乃陽刃、四刑、破碎之𩔖。若合此格限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931342885"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":541,"lineType":2,"content":"度臨之，亦凶矣。與其發福發禍更速。若日月合天凶地煞，在偏局則輕，正局不免，輕亦傷身，甚則惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星犯日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"夫惡星犯限，居日月之後則不凶，犯日月之前為凶不小。日月同犯，促日月同行，逢之於前皆為忌。須是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"落空亡，方不為傷，若在强宫，斷非所宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"善星㑹日月：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"善星㑹日月，本以為吉，人皆知吉善，而不知其善中有惡，是真惡也。善者惡之胎，若星曜㑹於吉地則可，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"倘或臨於空亡、陽刃、破碎之鄉，為災不可言。雖處安居無事之時，而有卒天暴亡之患，多出於人所不意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵凶星居空亡則利，吉㝛居之則凶，此理之必然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456279420980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"忌曜相攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"且如未上安命，本以夜忌土為煞，若忌星居空亡，則無力矣。或又日生孛炁之𩔖攻之，則忌土，何暇為我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"害？倘以火助其威，計黨其毒，則其勢巳甚，必至夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"善星失用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"何謂善星？金木水炁之類是也。一星居强得用，則為我福受傷，我失其恃，限行於此，流煞小有所衝，必成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"險厄，多是無事中暴忽之禍，人所不知也。所謂天星不能制地煞。何謂鬼局？金行寅午戌之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"將煞就煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"且如命宫正盤十二宫，有禄馬貴人之神，陽刄破碎七煞之類。如寅申巳亥生人，限行於酉，上盤亦是酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931359269"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"字。子午邜酉生人，交已限，上盤亦是已字。此將煞就煞，以邜宫命論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"以煞見煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"且如丙戊生人，陽刃是午，行午限，是此局。更子午邜酉生人，有上盤之陽刃，下盤陽刃，上之破碎，下之破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"碎。已限是福徳，亦為陽刃加的煞，的煞加陽刃，皆為以煞見煞。若遇福徳則遲見禍，若遇官宫則速禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"縱有吉星日月臨之，其死尤速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"出煞入煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"如人行限，前是陽刃，後是破碎。如乙酉生辰，上是三煞，陽刃入巳限破碎，或前三煞後破碎。限度出入之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"際如二十五六、三十六七、五十　一二，出限入限之際，值出煞入煞之時，更加流年，小有凶，併必難保","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456288006178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"夀元。失䧟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以夀元為緊。何為壽元？納音是也。如納音受尅，乃木生人，木望金，金生人，金望火。倘鬼旺主衰，四正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"三合見之，行限至此值之，雖少年亦主傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"暗炁加臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"且如炁星天文無象，如盲人然亦是老人之象。凡入命照命，亦主刑尅孤獨，主人慈祥。如命宫三合對照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"之時，人當有夀，然亦須見合照無四正星以破之方好。若老人行限值此，設若流炁併當生之炁，此年必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"主倒限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":609,"lineType":9,"content":"倒限拾遺詩十二首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453451992924169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"主星遇煞是如何，限到其中是煞窩。流煞更來無避處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"𨶒浮一夢入南柯。○子宫箕限水星臨，木炁同臨定不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"禁。若在邜宫逢水孛，夀應難買任千金。○寅宫立命邜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"宫行，羅火金星亦可憎。夘火命居行已限，倘逢金水不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"聊生。○丑宫辰限水星來，命入黄泉不可猜。土計更臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"并㑹煞，陰司有詔急相催。○辰宫午限煞之鄉，切莫加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"臨見煞王。救度有星須見土，若無逢救定堪傷。○已宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"須㸔未與申，莫教土計暗相侵。土計若逢金到處，反殃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489057841187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉更精神。○午宫木炁最無情，孛若同行更可憎。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"遇煞星加得到，限行至此必須傾。○未申土計莫教留，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫土計不須憂。只愁羅火居其上，限行似火炙氷消。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"○酉宫到戌土之鄉，亥上元來火母藏。有煞加臨尤可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"畏，若無煞到不須防。○戌宫子上煞來臨，煞旺其間怎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"可禁。木土不來休道好，黄泉有詔急相尋。○亥命逢金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"固可憂，火羅二曜亦為仇。煞宫遇此加臨到，身世悠悠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"蝶化周。○煞宫元係鬼門闗，地煞天星要細觀。福曜加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489057792035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"臨還壓煞，凶星加到出應難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453455931375653"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"五星麗於天，以入躔為吉，失躔為凶。星之常性，人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"所共知也。然亦有不盡然者，或入躔而反凶，失躔而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"反吉，其喬拗之謂乎？拗而不失其順，亦何惡於拗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"此理淵微，非通於造化者，孰能知之？鄧太史喬拗，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477976653850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"獨得龍從火裏出，虎向水中生之玄，所以補諸家之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"未備也。若定光矞天機，則又不論好樂廟旺、盈縮圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"缺、伏留順逆、三方三日、七强五弱，而專以二明三暗、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"三明一暗論貴賤禍福，此又特見陽中之陰，陰中之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，其㫖與鄧太史雖不同，而其用意則一也。故合而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"為一卷，聊叙作者之意，引於首簡。易水育吾子識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601410596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"予生西京，世居太史之職，仰觀天文，俯察地理，靡所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"不至。因𥬇世人但知金、水、木、火、土五星垣殿有喜有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"怒，而獨不知有喬抝存乎其間。鑑於司天，明盡五星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"之玄奥，洞知造化之幽微，真吕公所謂五行顛倒術","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"五行若逆行，龍從火裏出，五行不順行，虎向水中生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"之𩔖是也。斯文本不傳於世，不求聞達於人，適遭時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"多艱，遍厯宇內，屢試屢騐。后之君子，韞匱藏諸。宋太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"史鄧鑑心傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"火土二星號喬廟，世人知音少。物有相反乃相成，此理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"最為精。世人只愛正廟好，更不詳推考。誰知喬廟更為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"竒，細説與君知。晝火參軫及箕壁，無咎乃大吉。夜土角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"斗及井奎，降福亦如之。火逢水廟俱宜利，剛柔得相濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"土徳如居木度中，晦滯乃踈通。貴命若還逢此限，臺省","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"并給諌。常人遇此亦為竒，富貴更康寜。此是官星微妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"訣，真機休漏泄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申壬申詩：甲申壬申寅上木，不主官司定主哭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"寅上木星曰：若還身命更凶時，必主夀年於此促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"辛已生金在辰丙戌生詩：辛已生人金在辰，丙戌生人土齊瓶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"土在子乙亥生木在亥曰：乙亥命人木在亥，若非傷夀必然貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午癸已詩：庚午癸已水居申，衆論皆言是吉神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"生水在申曰：限逢出入皆遭險，若是孤刑免䘮身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"庚　寅　生詩：木入秦州庚惡寅，戊寅寅亥限非宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477775261707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"木　在　未曰：非惟孝服并官事，否則亡身定不疑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"木鬼金室詩：木躔鬼度號高强，金室翌牛福亦昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"翼土角木曰：更有土星躔斗角，限行至此福非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"火土水命宜詩：木躔亢度號逢龍，若是秋生福亦濃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"木躔　亢角曰：三合只愁金尅戰，水金命遇又還凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子生人詩：木躔婁度是凶躔，甲子生人又不然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"木星婁吉曰：命限田財寅亥者，必然發福進庄田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453475740925990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"水　星　躔詩：水星躔胃木來凶，行限申宫及已宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"胃　　　吉曰：三合飛來無尅破，命限相逢必富翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"金火相逢詩：金星行限火同躔，未可為凶一例言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"宜分書夜曰：晝𫟚生人貧且夭，夜生福夀必雙全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"木　土居詩：土居申酉如逢木，子丑限中富夀足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"申　　酉曰：縁何土木不為主，鬼弱畨能為我福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"木　炁宜詩：木逢紫炁本來凶，若居午酉又難同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"午　　酉曰：行限逢之人必吉，此是餘奴救主翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601426980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"令　星　宜詩：四季司權號令星，若還受尅始為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"受　　　尅曰：且如木命金來尅，可許榮華福更新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"又四季司權號令星，諸星不敢與争衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：任他囚的臨刑難，也須膽落更心驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛不宜詩：計孛名為紙筆星，如居田宅最堪嗔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"居　田　宅曰：破家蕩産令人哭，命好除非自立成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅計孛詩：火羅計孛四雄星，若守財宫福愈深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"冝　守　財曰：若也財星更明白，其家必定富千金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453486121959465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"火　羅　宜詩：火羅夾命福滔天，縱犯凶星福亦堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"夾　　　命曰：金命生人還不足，必然夭死在童年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"限主入垣當生詩：限宫宫主入垣中，最忌當生太歳衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳衝有大凶。曰：破耗相攅宜出位，限星至此總成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"星　　　　曰：人命若逢申酉限，金星水伴盡皆凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑生孛為詩：乙丑生人孛在寅，化為禄主限中迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"禄忌木對曰：誰知木炁申宫照，不死終為帶疾人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453503192645683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎星最詩：破碎星辰煞最凶，人生切忌命宫逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"忌　入　命曰：為人慷慨多光霽，縱有鎡基亦主窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎宫主詩：破碎星辰不出宫，那堪行限在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜居垣曰：若非官事并䘮服，到此終須百事凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"相　　　濟曰：若得剛柔相濟遇，為權為福定非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚暗耗宜詩：刑囚暗耗實難言，我尅他時反是權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"納音尅他曰：身命逢之鄉曲富，官星明白玉堦行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子生人最不宜詩：戊子生人最忌土，當生元化為禄主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"土星守命限田財曰：若守田財大限中，不但䘮財仍破祖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"諸凶並宜空亡並吉詩：尅命忌囚暗耗刑，更𠔥破碎刃宫星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕太歳衝凶曰：逢空有吉皆無禍，太歳相衝又不寜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456279617588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎宫限主逢詩：破碎空中最是凶，限星遇泊便為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"之無不退落曰：非惟冷退仍招禍，縱使廟垣禍一同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"當生八煞有鬼煞詩：當生鬼煞落空亡，大限相逢空鬼鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡大限空大吉曰：不貴即當家大冨，名高仍且夀延長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼曜星辰不宜詩：鬼曜星辰坐命宫，那堪行限一般同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"命限有空則吉曰：無破無空傷本命，可憐揮淚對西風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"女命不宜詩：女人天首命宫加，纔嫁夫時便做家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"羅　守　命曰：必主公姑皆隔角，不然刑尅定無差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453486122057769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"陽星不宜夜見詩：晝見星辰夜宿時，限逢福作五分推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"陰星不宜晝見曰：陰星垣廟如逢晝，命限相逢大不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"陽　　　刃曰：限好終須有刑尅，限凶終是禍重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489057988643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"凶　空　吉詩：凶星行限要空亡，吉曜空亡又不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"吉　空　凶曰：吉曜空亡還减福，凶星空却可無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"土計相逢却要詩：土星行限元怕計，只要當生木同制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"木制餘星倣此。曰：限行至此皆無福，他星亦可為前例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"金火二星為限詩：火星行限如逢日，此限之中難發積。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"主怕日同躔曰：金星與日又同躔，縱居垣廟皆無益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"刃　星　互詩：飛刄星辰陽刄鄉，刃星互換實堪傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"垣　最　凶曰：無空無破如逢此，縱有相生亦少亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453456279601204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰行限詩：限星最要仄垣宫，宫主相逢反見凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"宜出垣吉曰：金辰若發酉限內，金酉却富辰限中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"行　限　宜詩：限宫切忌正垣星，比如亥限木星臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"避　宫　主。曰：非惟無福仍招禍，木亥限寅福反深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"行限太陽不宜詩：太陽居午太陰未，自古皆言垣廟地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"午太陰不冝未。曰：太限相逢不發財，若出廟垣方吉利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"田財命主詩：若問田財又不然，主星又喜不離垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"又宜居垣日。只愁大限逢宫主，縱發猶防夀不堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477976686618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"尅命星入命詩：尅命之星真可畏，命宫切忌逢刑至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"宫限亦然曰：若還為忌又逢凶，惡死身亡須棄市。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"計都在命及居詩：天尾星辰在命宫，嫁夫必定兩三重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉宫符女命曰：若居午酉官符位，定主身亡在獄中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁臨身命詩：紫炁從來號善星，若臨身命主孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"又逢計都曰：更逢天尾同相守，巧語能言最不情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"命居福徳詩：命居福徳火同躔，天首同居夀不堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅同躔曰：若是金星并夜見，限行至此福綿綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453486122041385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"水火同居四詩：寅申已亥四强宫，水火同居一宿中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"强為官田主曰：若是官星并田主，玉堦金殿富家翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"歳駕星升垣火詩：歳駕星辰喜入垣，火羅孛計愛同躔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"羅孛計同躔曰：惡曜受制𠔥朝斗，節鉞聲名播九天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃星在命是詩：陽刄星辰在命宫，假如星命運亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"火命在水宫曰：聞詩聞禮多閑雅，富貴中年永不窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎陽刃同宫詩：破碎星辰陽刃臨，若居命裏是前程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"命主居陽破位曰：命主若居陽破位，火人金局福多全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453486121975849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"水星行限水詩：水星行限計來侵，水在申宫計在辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"在申計在辰曰：不問升垣并入殿，也須貧困促年齡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"木為財主居三宫詩：木為財主第三宫，金若同躔福最隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"金同躔於四庫，曰：丑未更𠔥辰戌位，經營財穀永無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"四庫中有水計詩：辰戌丑未為四庫，水計相逢貧且妬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"又為命貌主曰：若還命貌在其中，不義取財而致富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛逢四主詩：水孛如逢田宅宫，更加天尾又相同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"又計都同宫，曰：為人幹僕添財産，末主須交不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453486122008617"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"命主土計日又詩：水孛奴星入命宫。命主土計日，怕逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛入命宫。曰：其家必主生淫慾，奴婢貪花犯主公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"身星與羅同宫最詩：身星最忌與羅同，猶怕魁罡子午中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"怕在魁罡子午。曰：此是計羅升殿位，若非夭夀必然窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑生命丑身詩：乙丑生人命丑宫，太陰身主又相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"命主登歳駕曰：身命主星登歳駕，惡星丑未怕相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉生命在詩：乙酉生人命未宫，太陰却向酉宫逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"未月在酉宫曰：已邜丑宫分善惡，非官貴也富家翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
