{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477775245323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"凡土䧟山崩，枯枝敗葉，長江浩蕩，爛斧繡針，爝火大明，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶救解，最須詳説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"土星最忌落空亡，升殿入垣而落空，謂之土䧟山崩，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"主退敗可畏。如有惡星降夾逼迫，多有氣蹙噎吃之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"惡星降夾，多主倒限。如火㑹謂之填凹補缺，金㑹謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"山嘯呈寳，又皆主名利發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"木星落空，謂之栁枝落根，如金㑹則斵削成林，火會則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"焚折灰滅，火出木燼，水㑹則漂槎泛筏，不免漂蕩無物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599309824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"水星落空，謂之長江浩蕩，退敗無餘。金㑹則洪水漂蕩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"滔天，常有不測之灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"金星落空，謂之爛斧繡針，最宜煆煉。又得貴人星㑹之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"則是常行用之物，又主名利有成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"火星落空，乃離中之虛，謂之爝火大明，反主發達，夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"尤妙，蓋火遇夜則明故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"如前件落空者，皆是升殿入垣，而有此格禍福，即旬中空是也。如丙辰生土，為福在女度行限，甲寅旬無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"子丑，亦主退財坐地受灾，能説不能行。如戊申生人，土禄在夘，甲辰旬無寅邜行限，反主奔波勞碌，不利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453475740893222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":415,"lineType":2,"content":"財穀。所以星落空者，切不可以福禄及升垣殿以為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":417,"lineType":9,"content":"四時五星論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"春月生人命限連有土孛金水、太陰、羅計，謂之雲雨不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"解，淋漓花果，觸目愁景，主退敗可畏。四五月雖然得雨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦不可連接行限，見前項星辰，為久霖不晴，皆主冷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"退愁悶，生意蕭然。如有此格，日火行限，謂之久雨逢晴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"伸眉舒目，人物欣快，必主驟然大發。秋月生人，連有風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"雨星行限，主霖雨傷稼。冬月生人，連有凶，不妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909235764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"凡炁入申，為入猴山，不過作事混沌。凡木炁為禍，不過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"冷淡是非，留連不寜，所以木星為禍遲，淹延不安，炁木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"為人執抝不惺㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"凡水泛揚州，損自已之財，命逢炁吉，拏他人之財，為自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"已之用，為縁水計相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行水㝛，水宫㑹土於寅邜上，决主見災，無妨，不倒。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"尅木於已午，火尅金於亥子，木尅土於申酉，水尅火於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，皆主重災。凡金為天地肅殺之星，是以行金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931509779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"星限未，有無刑尅孝服化吉亦然。春天土木相㑹，行土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"限，驟發名權，而死則難免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"凡疾、奴、兄、財、妻、兒等宫，仍𠔥其宫度主，論之極騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":457,"lineType":9,"content":"剗法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"凡七政為身主、命主、夀主、命度主、夀元限主所泊躔宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕在前剗破多死，化凶亦然。占煞刃尤惡，其在後剗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"破又輕。假如限行火宿，怕水同在火㝛，行土㝛，怕木同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"躔，行月㝛，怕土羅計，日宿畏木羅計孛等奪，他倣此。然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477775278091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"如行木宿受金，春月剗脉不斷。行火㝛遇此，謂雨雪載","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"途，皆非好格，冷落寂寞，不言可知。所以晴雨之星，要有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"相間行限得晴雨停勻，生意順快。凡土孛炁羅計㑹日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"皆謂黒雲暗日，主大貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"人命。五六月生火日，行限却在已午，謂之旱魃南離，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"意焦枯。如遊年孛土羅計到，晦掩其光，反主一發。過了","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"遊年，又主禍依然，是以喜行雨限。若行限又俱是火日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"亦曰久晴不雨，萬物爍落。如忽行一星，如羅計孛、金水、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909252148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂炁星，則雲興雨降，物苗勃然發達可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行風雨星，而逢日在戌，或行限在戌，三合對照，則雲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"收雨過，落照餘暉。遇此格者，主晚年發達。凡太陽坐命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"極主勞碌不閑，一云慷慨，蓋日運行不息故也。冬月水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㑹，謂之和風解凍，寒林生春。火㑹土，謂之寒谷囬春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主發越。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"春木宜日，火怕羅計。如㑹日，可謂蒸烘日火，則春入園","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"林，粧綴紅紫。羅計到風僝雨僽，反主貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477976703002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"秋天水居，水宿見金，謂寒潭浸月。火寒未免清秀而貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"薄。炁㑹月在前，謂慶雲捧月。在後謂浮雲蔽月。化水夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"生，剗脉不斷。金值火宿，秋生無害。土行水㝛，冬月反好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"四季之土，遇木何妨，最須詳辯，剗法至要。有一人土在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"危三度，好在危五度行土限遂死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":515,"lineType":9,"content":"抝星例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"愚謂此法謂之全降與半降也，即空亡空盡最為竒之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"意，甚騐。水在金宫，遇金反吉。次喜火羅三合，喜木炁。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601394212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁在酉辰角日，羅亦解之。在張月火可解，羅子遇水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"可活。凡木逢金，要水氣之扶，或火羅之救，便無害。金在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"邜戌，遇火反吉。火入酉，金入戌，或火金同戌，或火金同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，或火在辰，金在邜，或火金同辰，或火金同邜，皆主無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"妨。惟金在邜一節，秋生又斷。或寅亥，或木到，或炁同到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"或土水火救。凡金入䧟，或遇火，喜土星之生，水孛之救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"或火金而在金宫，或火宫而反無害。金火只忌秋生。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"在已，木解炁亦可解。土在寅亥，火羅金可救。凡土喜計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489058021411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"來救，又喜火羅來救，亦可。又辯凡土計同喜炁。木水在辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"戌丑未，遇金孛炁木月反可無害。火在酉巳，要木炁土計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"羅日可解。太陽之斷，惟金拱救，或月㑹可救。太陰之斷，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"金孛水星可救，或日可解。水不斷乾，火不斷坤，火歸坤地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"害災除。土不斷四木：辰角戌奎未井、丑斗。木不斷辰亢，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"東方水地也。冬金不斷夘，冬水夏火難斷，春木秋金易斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":553,"lineType":9,"content":"四直星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"正、二月太陽，三、四月太陰，七、八月水孛，九、十月木炁，十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505025523762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"一、十二月金星，五六月火星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"凢遇直星，煞難守照。命位限宫者，刑尅、疾破、虛耗、勞碌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"損夀，逢日傷父，逄月傷母，逄妻刑妻，逄子刑子，為煞星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"大凶，為父母星相生相順，不以此論。又合論福鬼房二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"宿度，號為天眼，男命值之，多是多非，凶狠權豪，便能反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"叛，女主淫亂。亢井，主敢為敢斷。箕畢，主病患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"花甲循環六十年，星辰喬抝細推論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453503192727603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"一隅不以三隅反，奥妙當知在不傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"木躔婁度號凶躔，甲子生人又不然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"命限田財寅亥者，必然發福進庄田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子生人孛在寅，化為禄主限宫迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"誰知木到申宫照，不死終為帶疾人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑金人命丑宫，太陰身主又相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"身命主星登殿駕，惡星酉未怕相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅木喜入秦州，限入東方百不憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505025507378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"火木同行或逢孛，前程亦許享優游。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"丁邜邜寅惟喜計，孛在乾亥子宫利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"木星午未羅在申，隨有希求皆稱意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰午宫遇木炁，兩耗而推難一例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"酉羅戌孛總相宜，土㝛莫嫌居井位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"已已計耗為有用，土在午宫福尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅戰激總無妨，定主為權能伏衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午癸已水居申，衆論皆言是吉神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601525284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢出入皆遭險，若是孤刑免䘮身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未水計羅在亥，須知亥限為最快。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"辰已二限最相宜，刑破六親誰避諱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申甲申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉宫宜計水同，木居牛斗總無凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅更且能為福，軫壁參箕火轉紅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌逢羅福更多，火星逢孛亦無疴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"只愁軫水夜逢土，　凶禍重重福奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599391744"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥、辛已丙戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"辛已生人金在辰，丙戌生人好齊瓶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥生逢亥上木，　若非傷夀必然貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子生人喜四餘，炁羅光彩耀天衢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"計水為禍只宜孛，　土水遭逢亦不虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑人逢計最宜，黄星不可以為非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"只愁土孛遥相望，貧病交攻孰解圍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601508900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"已邜羅㬋最有權，戊宜逢計耗難言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星逢紫居高位，安樂和平福禄全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰金酉若居垣，限盡窮途豈偶然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"計守限宫還有力，土羅雖好莫争先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textInde {"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午生人細品評，炁權計禄福難慿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星若是居寅邜，為害為災實不輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未木邜炁在亥，亥當禍重邜為輕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477775343627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛土羅居丑未，限行至此倍精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉子丑逢土木，　名為暗耗翻為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"羅申滿用實可慿，戌亥炁孛見禍速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉生人命未宫，太隂却向酉宫逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"已邜丑宫分善惡，非常貴也富家翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥亥木便為迍，五星亥上福難慿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477775360011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"計羅孛限應無禍，更有金牛福氣増。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子生人最怕土，當生元化為禄主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"若守田財大限中，不特䘮財仍破祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"已丑行年子細推，計都孛宿兩相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"单行三合無争戦，命限逢之作福基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅莫遇羅并土，　已上偏宜見計都，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"申上水星皆不吉，誰知喬抝有二夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"辛邜星辰兩得宜，炁申羅子互光輝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599408128"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫水計相遭遇，衣禄隨縁度歳時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰遇計寅増光，火孛同行亦不妨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌土刑難减福，寅宫单孛又須防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"癸已","logicSentenceId" {"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午生人逢炁土，皆主平生無險阻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"設或行限遇火羅，即許滔天多福助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未羅㬋最是凶，　限行至此一塲空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星土木相遭遇，試看晦滯得踈通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489058037795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申行限到東南，紫炁羅㬋樜境甘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛那能添福力，計都陰險更難堪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉星辰又不同，桃花見孛却無凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"限行羅計俱為禍，造化分明指掌中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌土計福平平，羅宿单行有用星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁遭逢財不聚，可憐孤苦更伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥火羅偏有情，逢茲順境福川增。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"炁餘為福力尤重，木計用逢各逞能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453453599440896"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子火星為有用，命限逢之福尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪行限厯西南，名利兩全誰與共。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑炁居辰已界，發福發財誠穩耐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"設使土計兩强梁，命與仇謀翻取敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅却喜羅居未，炳耀揚輝無不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪孛又在玄枵，定許希求俱稱遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"癸邜逢羅又不宜，　雖名禄主禍相隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"計都行用翻為福，喬抝宫中子細推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909383220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰獅子忌逢木，不主官司須夀促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"行限如臨此位中，禍患重重難主福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"乙已生人喜計都，慳貪致富語非虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"常人遇此皆竒意，積善之家慶有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午辰邜逢土木，　根基穩耐非庸俗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"康寜夀福足平生，蓄積多金榮福禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未生人偏喜計，命限逢之翻吉利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"此為相反仍相成，漏泄真機難自秘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601541668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申木不喜臨官，禍患須知見百端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"馬遇空亡難著脚，限行至此倍悲酸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉納音元屬土，遭逢木宿人皆妬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"誰知木炁若相逢，無害無灾安若堵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌金命却嫌火，自我觀之又無禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"能以妙理定無差，命限逢之當自賀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥木星嫌在亥，欲求發福應空待。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"若非傷夀定孤貧，　必見非災多横害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931542547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子計都為禄主，限宫逢著皆無取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"能於造化細推尋，禍福莫言無定㨿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑土星計孛火，誰知作黨非為禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"却為權禄暗相扶，横發資財聲譽福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅命若逢南斗，土宿相逢反為咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚暗耗總為祥，已午見之福猶厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"乙邜孛星臨限度，雖為禄主空遭遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"除非權福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":807,"lineType":2,"content":"火月也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"二星來，方許榮華無錯誤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909317684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰土星至在子，塊然一物無可取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"木星化禄已午間，起禍生災難制御。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"丁已土正好齊瓶，木星為福又還輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"刑權囚孛皆無慮，限裏逢之定有成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午午宫忌遇日，水金輔之皆不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"安命如逢又不然，　限裏逢之數難出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"已未夘辰宜火羅，最忌計都居酉戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"行限如逢火土星，却主旺家多發積。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931558931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辰戌宜計羅，土多亥宫生意多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"木遇臨官反無用，辰羅臨出暗消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉禄宫嫌炁禄，木星朝斗多愁哭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星土計更羅㬋，却主光輝能發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌戊上宜土刑，亥逢火計更豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"孛宜在已偏嫌炁，土計如臨亦不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥嫌木居亥宫，羅如在午福昌隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"孛宜在已偏嫌炁，　土計如臨亦不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909366836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"限主升本垣，當生太歳衝動為禍。諸宫宫主星倣此為例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"限宫宫主本垣中，最怕當生太歳衝。破耗相攅宜出位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"限行至此總成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"限主還元大可愁，五星帶奪煞同謀。更𠔥忌曜來助虐，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"此命須登白玉樓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":857,"lineType":9,"content":"論倒限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"倒限之法，奪星為第一。奪星行限，逢氣生起，或宫主相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"生，或化惡背時，决然倒限。火土名忌，乃煞星也。二宫相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931608083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，謂之二煞同謀，最為凶害。此等格局，雖有過北斗之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"資，亦難買無常之厄。如忌奪相㑹相尅，謂之二煞反目，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"十度之外相逢，不過見災而已，雖䘮亡亦可救也。如行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"限遇之，死無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":873,"lineType":9,"content":"煞星帶刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"火土雙星帶刃來，那堪垣廟兩和諧。流年太歳來衝倒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"任是公侯也受灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"火土二曜乃煞星也，况又帶奪，其惡尤甚，又且得經得垣，加之太歳月將衝動，為禍不可勝言。限行到此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453477775376395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":883,"lineType":2,"content":"雖有扁鵲之智，亦不能救。若二星身帶陽刃，破碎的煞，决不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":885,"lineType":9,"content":"凶送凶迎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星行限又將終，又有凶星後限中。凶送凶迎，凶鐵定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"饒君，鐵漢也成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"凶星如忌如奪，固凶星也。金羅計孛火土化惡亦惡。一惡星在後行𦂳闗，來闗將盡，又有一凶星初闗，𦂳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":893,"lineType":2,"content":"闗方來，惡星光芒相射，必為薤露人矣。○又如剛星得田財戰鬬，或剛星聚吉戰闘，得炁救解，只恐炁之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"光星一出，或忌或奪來迎，皆主大發，亦速死無饒矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":897,"lineType":9,"content":"木星奪煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931591699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"木星帶奪命難延，五福之中夀不堅。若使炁星同共到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"玉皇來詔靳天年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"炁木雖善，柰為讐星。二星不宜㑹光景之内，木星又帶煞，是善以需惡。二星相遇於三十度内，忌計孛金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"羅於中間間斷。至於㑹合相逢，必登無常之録矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":909,"lineType":9,"content":"前闗後鎻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"身命田星日月曜。兩箇欄星占前後。限到中間進退難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"任是神仙也難救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"日月二曜乃君后也，初不為害於人，而闗人之夀夭，何歟？蓋日月命田之主受傷故也。若日月為身命之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453501108092963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"星，當生却被羅計於緊闗攔截，掩其光彩，或闗煞來犯，或孛大土化惡，羅計夾輔穿釣，有如此者，非惟日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"月受傷，而吾之身命亦受傷矣。至若太陽為身命田之主，尤其緊切。蓋月是身，若是惡星來釣，是壊其所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":923,"lineType":2,"content":"生之主矣，豈不為南柯夢中人也！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":925,"lineType":9,"content":"剛星帶戦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"剛星穿戦實難當，田命逢之怕受傷。化惡化讐年夀促，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"散財散福見𨶒王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"剛星為夀主，命主當生，遇剛星於𦂳闗内，或望合相穿正照，皆非吉兆。儻得煞星為命田之主，或帶奪受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":933,"lineType":2,"content":"二星之尅，或受彼之所傷，限數還元。假饒化吉穿戰受制，得志之時，速死之患難免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931624467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":937,"lineType":9,"content":"異宿相攻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"火星行限孛星來，金星行限羅㬋猜。日月二宿怕羅計，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星忌曜兩崔嵬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":943,"lineType":9,"content":"聚煞交戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"火計金羅孛一同，更𠔥忌奪二星攻。假饒徳炁中間救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"光景無從亦主凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"火孛、計羅，皆剛星也，若三剛互戰，使根基壯，亦無益也。縱得炁水來救，光彩一出，不復解救，又更詳其命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"金星帶煞遇羅星，二煞相生奈例評，老㓜反常還不利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"𨶒王來詔入蓬瀛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":961,"lineType":2,"content":"金星帶奪於緊闗内正度，或鋒芒交承之際，或火土兩煞星為主限，而金孛羅𠔥，老人遇此於生旺，少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":963,"lineType":2,"content":"逢此於死絶，此等格局，多死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"限入空闗多煞神，星辰遼逺又無情，流年衝到招凶煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"定作南柯夢裏人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931657235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":973,"lineType":2,"content":"限到當生所在，煞上無星主事，兩旁三合之星亦復遼逺，即為空限。若火羅計孛交戦於此限之正度，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":975,"lineType":2,"content":"為夢蝶人矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":977,"lineType":9,"content":"又六十年詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子熒羅紫炁輝，計都乃是禍之基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"人言木土雖無吉，我道其星禍果宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑孛羅寅夘宫，非惟無福禍來攻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚暗耗非凶論，　天尾牛宫福反豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅木未限行東，只怕南方熒惑凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505025540146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"若只单行為福，緊限行權孛化為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"丁夘計寅孛亥子，更有羅申木未午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"四箇星辰最為吉，唯有水星是禍祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰木炁居於中，雖則囚耗最為愈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"更有孛羅酉戌好，土井亦言是吉主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"已已計都匪耗言，孛羅交戰有威權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"土星更喜居於午，行限相逢有福田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午生人羅耗加，計都月孛亦堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453503192809523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星囚耗反為用，命限相逢福禄奢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未陽猪木邜中，人行亥限福興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星辰已雖無吉，　不免孤貧亦是凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申未㝛限平平，計在南方最有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有孛星還不利，求謀作事少能成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉火星喜失躔，計都合水亦為先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星最好羅為忌，木斗依然以禍言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌夜生土最凶，羅午計未喜相通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453503192776755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命限臨其上，　作事偏成喜氣濃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥羅㬋㑹孛星，此星不可以凶名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"土星若遇還為弱，亥夘升垣反禍崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子土木不相宜，　天首羅㬋紫炁竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"更是四餘皆有用，計都與孛福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑孛星豈為凶，　不應土㝛對宫衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"計都若又還為用，命限相逢作富翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅木炁亦言凶，月到申宫横禍宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453475740958758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"夘上土羅凶𠮓吉，計都遇着亦中庸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"已夘羅㬋最有權，計陽雖耗反為堅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星若在高强位，亦是平平不十全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰最喜計都逢，招入資財足萬重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"更有土羅亦可取，　若人限遇事還通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"辛已土寅與木羅，此星最喜限中過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星禄主還無用，金在辰垣反化訛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午孛臨寅夘木，還言此是禍之胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453503192793139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁為權計為禄，限行平穩可無災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未炁猪木邜居，若行亥限命還危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"禍來夘限還消㓕，土計孛羅未丑竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申孛子木寅宫，　土月五星皆是空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"只有炁猪為福力，羅㬋星更不為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉吉星土木羅，獨嫌孛計戌上過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"更嫌水日三合座，無禍仍教有禍磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌孛酉邜計都，須知為福十分呼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453501108076579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"木夘亥宫土歸子，　無端禍患並來扶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥土子有災危，五星居亥反為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛羅星凶吉半，人行酉戌禍來隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子木炁酉無凶，　天尾戊辰富可求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上土星平穩當，若臨强位反為仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"已丑計都與孛星，若教遇着禍來陵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋最喜单行吉，果决威權福禄興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅土羅無所取，計都却又喜居蛇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909399604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"人言水在參垣好，我道忌星亦不佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"辛夘羅子申炁來，　凶星自作吉星裁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"更嫌木炁居於午，便斷平平不用𭛯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"壬。辰土酉戌無災，但於孤刑不免哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"火孛同行無碍處，寅宫单孛禍之胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"癸已孛子羅㬋丑，若言福禄皆無有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"更有䕃金亦無取，　若問當生土在酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午羅㬋做事來，更亥火宿亦然哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453489909415988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"盡言土炁亦為好，　只有未辰反不才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未羅囚亦是凶，孛星禄主反無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"二星木土多屯否，作事還如制縛同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申羅吉炁平平，　只利東南限度榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛二星知可貴，計都險惡亦遭驚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉羅刑與計貴，遭逢命限福重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然囚孛桃花上，然亦平平無大凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌土計有機權，更有单羅亦吉言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453503192825907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"天尾炁星還不吉，　更破財糓不堪論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥熒羅却有情，木星天尾亦為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"更有炁星亦云吉，皆是平平匪至精。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子土羅是吉星，西南限度好經營。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘星㝛宜詳斷，當審飛來釣起情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑忌星辰已間，限中遇得享安閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜土星及天尾，此箇星辰作事難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅金水總朝陽，命限相逢反不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505025654834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有斷躔金是禍，秋冬却以火為良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"癸夘水星亦輔君，若居財帛總無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋化禄亦非吉，木宿限行主訟庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰土㝛忌升垣，若也升垣禍蔓延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"更有凶星水孛限，　只能晦氣不傷年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"乙已還畏水金張，若在田財命限當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"不特䘮身并破祖，更教夀亦夢黄粱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午水星利失經，夘辰土計是良星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453501108125731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星天乙臨寅丑，大吉須防亦有刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未土星在邜辰，若居惡煞免灾迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"水星限度諸為顯，限到水星有訟争。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申金木限中來，孝服臨門更妨財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"唯有土熒還發福，限宫命裏細推裁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉熒羅是福基，只言太白不為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"水星與木還為禍，命限相逢大不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌秋冬愁火羅，只言土星少比和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453506875228201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨命限田財上，舉動云為百事訛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥土星臨限中，虚花財穀盡成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"唯有秋冬火曜吉，炁羅作事正興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子計土能為福，春水水金限不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨命位主破相，損耗資財不用疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑土計水為忌，命限如逢必見殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢羅㬋與日月，限中逢此是高强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅土星在於丑，命宫逢之福乃有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453501108142115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"暗耗刑囚已午間，無災無禍平平守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"乙夘孛星限不宜，羅㬋不可以囚窺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命限遭臨著，福禄威權最是竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰十福子上土，已午福星為禄主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"命限逢之無福禄，仍且招延禍患苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"丁已土子禍又鍾，木乃平平可免凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"羅孛刑囚皆有用，限行至此必從容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午太陽居午位，水火輔之皆不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453490601607204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"限若逢之亦可憂，更遇流凶必顛墮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"已未木羅居夘辰，須知生意日津津。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"火星若遇亦冝利，唯有計都作事迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申土計與辰羅，此箇星辰最喜過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有木寅無用處，辰羅臨出訟消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉忌禄反成殃，木計來朝亦不良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有戍宫土計吉，辰羅逢著亦為强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌土刑戌亦佳，亥間火計最堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505931722771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"孛羅已午禍難測，炁計孤刑不免邪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥羅㬋不背禄，火孛逢之必有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"土躔婁星亦無禍，惟有金星禍最速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚生人不用火，火星在戌為殃禍。乙辛生人不用金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"金星辰上化為塵。丙丁生人不用木，木徳在寅多反覆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬生人不用水，水星在已無依𠋣。戊已生人不用土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"土星在子多愚魯。朔日太陽居於午，十五太陰居於未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453506875211817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"身命運限若相逢，如此之人須正忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l262c/1-SK1609_figure_00043.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=keK5dT8dpTg4kjgaj3zK0EVfvbo%3D","pictureHeight":304,"pictureWidth":312,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l262c/1-SK1609_figure_00043.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=eU%2BkQeJNiLadipulK3%2B56vmCCb4%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l262c/1-SK1609_figure_00043.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426453505025671218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷二十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢陳氏論星辰，猶勝巫咸與石申。命若契符如影響，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"莫將機宻亂傳人。苗公郎子修行去，雲夢之中遇一賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"悟了五星真秘術，布出聲名天下傳。大梁甘石得遺丈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629320219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"曾究乾坤驗十分。造化天機從此泄，災祥得與後人聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"二交火土孛皆同，只在東西南北逢。議命須論强與弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"精微全在五星中。星曜照人看得力，命宫少緩身宫急。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"無星合照㑹空關，生死窮通便消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"星文自有淵微訣，今古諸經皆未說。金木雖云本善星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有却作災時節。土火雖云是惡星，此星致福非常别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"五星六曜自消詳，豈可膠柱而定轍。任他留順并伏逆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629336603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"不顧樂旺并員缺。也無晝火夜忌土，亦無五弱七强說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"福德相貌并三日，方主限元更迂濶。但能把此數端求，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"休咎何憂不精切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"天機常例，星無順留伏逆，亦無好樂廟旺。日無盈縮，月無圓缺，無晝火夜土忌，無三方主向背之說，不用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"相貌生後三日宫，只以五星正生爲髙，天涯地角爲𤰞，○奴僕爲天涯，相貎爲地角。○見月爲𦂳，不見月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"爲緩。二明三暗爲强，三明　一暗爲弱。若依歌斷之，則禍福無不應矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
