{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生水，地二生火，天三生木，地四生金，天五生土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"陽爲竒陰爲偶，陽爲剛陰爲柔。土水木爲陽星，金火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"爲陰星，此其常性也。然水屬北方太陰幽㝠之氣，順時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629369371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"趨流而就下。木屬東方少陽仁厚之氣，其陰可庇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"其水可食，雖是陽星，其性柔，爲陽中之陰。故金、水木、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁皆係柔星，所謂三明一暗者是也。火者南方陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"明之氣，其性炎上，不容於物；金屬西方乾健義勇之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，雖是陰星，其性剛，爲陰中之陽。故火土羅計、孛皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"係剛星，所謂二明三暗者是也。交初爲羅㬋，交中爲計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"都，所謂二交者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"剛强　　二交月孛是權星，　不須觀𧰼又觀形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629385755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"得限逢之爲吉曜，　自然富貴得安寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"火土吉曜惡星辰，　剛徤輝光見日新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"身命見之皆吉慶，布衣換作錦衣人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"柔弱　金木雖是善柔星，　限數相逢都不寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"四正居之爲大禍，　直教謹守保生平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁惡曜九流星，　僧道孤惸及藝精。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"此限纔逢䘮厥福，　妨財妨利又妨名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":9,"content":"論剛柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629402139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"苗公星度真竒絶，强弱諸宫皆不說。只言金水是休祥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"火土謂之禍凶孽。苗公本意秘深妙，造化真機安漏泄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"何須仰觀星辰𧰼，不必髙低比優劣。根深歩取太陰宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"合對同宫磨觀切。火土强星髙照月，其間富貴并員缺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"四方强曜富華人，五弱居强就卑列","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":9,"content":"論輕耀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"二交首尾必賢豪，日月相逢當虧缺。朝身逢忌職司權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"見月宫位失臣節。天吏躔月求火土，金木來叅犯刑法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629418523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"曾因水火漫漂流，不是損傷須廢折。明星金火但煌煌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"與月相逢發禍殃。亦有小兒曾異母，無辜風疾及痍瘡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"異母妨親孤害子，亦悲金木作仇讎。行年子午招貧困，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道爲人及九流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"日月。　　男女宫中星曜照，　多憑星性窮多少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"於中若見至陽精，四五二男爲繼紹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"獨月。　五星六曜無常主，已亥逢空無一處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"斯人必主古人言，生得五男並二女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629434907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"第三宫中名閑極，月到諸經稱得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"本言月到反吟宫，月到其宫云置福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"木月。　對偶身宫何用木，當時婚娶妻居服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"加之木紫又交加，　中道暌離又反目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"星有太陰同對木，生來未便豐財榖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"東西二位無强曜，南北宫中計孛羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"若是身中關木月，功名終是見犇波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"火月：　火星關䧟到身宫，爲人情性不和同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629451291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"台元金紫相關照，奸猾多謀愛逞功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"土月：　　土星天吏聚身間，值䧟須知性小寛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"或作台元多懶慢，木星如㑹有機關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"玩日廢時妨進習，傷財破産謾經營。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"常行土後二宫半，安得京川兩字名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"金月：　　娶妻年紀信髙低，除是長庚坐正西。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛不關迎少女，枯楊今巳見生梯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"水月：　水月流精臨後嗣，到了千端求一子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629467675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"衆星不犯女雙雙，嵗星性氣還同此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"三元宫有申子辰，水德騰輝上應辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"成𧰼在天如犯月，　少年非命喪其身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"本月宫中說性靈，　誕情虚詭老奸情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"萬般機巧便宜事，　羸得鄉閭有溢名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"炁月：　𨓜星紫炁加身命，　鰥寡之徒孤獨逈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"月逢母氏再從夫，　即目憂身招疾病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"老人星出丙丁隅，　一似斯人土木居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629484059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"不及龜年并鶴髮，　也須終盡百年餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"篤疾纒綿何以知，　命宫强曜細尋推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰紫炁加辰戌，　腰曲低頭四大推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"孛月：　　天吏文星說最佳，　限頭逢處接榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"兒宫遇着生男貴，妻上相逢得麗華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星主禄性雄豪，要得相叅火土髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"爲報士人休嘆晚，到頭名姓列仙曹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"羅月：　身宫若也坐羅㬋，四正强星不㑹柔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629500443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"燮理陰陽居輔弼，　三明來䧟號仇讎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"計月：　　計都守命主宫身，更看南北位星辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"果然强曜加臨照，兩府樞機作近臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"木土月：　此名天上三灾星，　今嵗相逢又不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"財散遭官䘮與病，其間亦有損年齡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"明星木土照光芒，　不問髙低與合方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"男女居之無刑剋，　官居如遇有災殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"木金月：　金性剛兮木性柔，　一如氷炭不相投。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629516827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"生時若值同宫分，　富貴來兮身已悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"出木入金爲六悲，　月之前後較毫𨤲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"果然對照并三合，　蹤跡蕭然人不知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"金木從來號六悲，　爲妨父母及妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"正言碩望當途者，　不是黄衣即褐衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"五常金木爲仁義，　仁義之中不主財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"今日木金相對照，　聲名淹抑四旬來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"木火月，　明星木曜火同宫，　財帛强宫倉庫虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629533211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"若見命身臨二宿，　令人冷淡處閻閭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"木水月，水木四正纒坎經，　不然獨木發洪名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"里閭贏得先生號，　富貴除非别有星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"南北東西如水木，　光芒射月年華促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"肌膚消瘦藥無靈，　忍死親親情不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁月，木星紫炁來相併，　惟愛林泉門閥伶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"若關後嗣或雙女，　到了他人作親迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"木星紫炁前後宫，　叅謁門庭是此公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856143629549595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"誰識螟蛉爲後嗣，　不然異姓紹家風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"紫炁與木是孤星，　九流之士道及僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"不然疾厄如孤宫，　行限逢之禍患併。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075316270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"大元經星，甘石紀之，元矞定之，陳卓論之，皆命宫為首，身宫次之。天機例論以命宫為緩，身宫為急。命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1229,"lineType":2,"content":"者，以太陽所在之宫，加所生之時，順數至夘，即就夘上所得之宫為命，似於人無所係。月者，衆人之身，太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1231,"lineType":2,"content":"陰所在，即為身宫，實為要害。故言月到之宫格局成，太陰坐處吉凶生。然人之吉凶禍福，率皆在於身宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1233,"lineType":2,"content":"則凡推命，宜先定於身躔，身躔即太陰，太陰既定，則禍福無不應者。欲知月躔所在，即以太陰星正身宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1235,"lineType":2,"content":"悉以十二月起常例㸃之。至於當閏之月，或前後差互不定，即以日直闗節氣及望推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1237,"lineType":9,"content":"起太陽法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"正月朔起室，二月奎，三月胃，四月觜，五月鬼，六月星，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075332654"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"月翼，八月亢，九月房，十月尾，十一月斗，十二月虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"歌云：　正室二奎胃暮春，　四觜五鬼六星鄰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"七翼八亢九房宿，尾斗同虚冬月循","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"死敗二宫身與命，二交強曜入南曹。聲名雖則傳州里，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得為官也不超。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫值陷居閒地，又以其人強曜推。強忽有星居大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"限，中年亦可及緋衣。二明強曜午宫當，更臨身陷落","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"何方？吉星若也居閒地，門蔭之官子細詳。身陷無星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075414574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"四正強，縱然不貴足錢糧。強星若不加身命，財物雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"豐壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1339,"lineType":9,"content":"宫有所主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中見所主，卯為夫兮酉為婦。夫婦左右前後宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"不出二交榮孛土。申辰前後為僕從，寅戌左右属財庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"震離坎兊宫辰别，善惡之星從性説。已亥丑未男女宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"鰥寡軰流因獨月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":1349,"lineType":9,"content":"論四空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075430958"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"本宫對視并三合，四位都縁不見星。強曜更加沉溺所，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"陷纔出没便沉㝠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"四正無星身在強，難名衣食足錢糧。安知四正無強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，爵秩如何至正郎。東西两位無星照，南北宫中聚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"首星。錯雜陰邪無剋剥，狀元及第擁旗旌。何知人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"有英聲，四正無強有一星。三四坐髙名位好，其人必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"定有虚名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"水星刑火火刑金，金曜無令陷木星。水是天元憂土到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"木為禄主怕金刑。土人憂木來相尅，此徒誰與免刑名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"788","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"甲計乙羅丙忌火，丁孛戊木却為禍，己忌金星庚土星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"辛陰壬水癸炁過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":1381,"lineType":2,"content":"化囚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1383,"lineType":9,"content":"論星散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"每一宫中坐一星，此名為散限頭乾。仍存四正加臨着，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075463726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"財利驅牽過一生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1391,"lineType":2,"content":"每一宫坐一星，無同宫者為散。凡星禍福不甚𦂳切，無成多敗，區區用心，勞煩過生爾。仍取強星加四正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1393,"lineType":2,"content":"見月方可斷，其人僅足，不爾更寒賤也。但每一星，人命罕有值此者，有一二星同宫而散者多，亦可以此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1395,"lineType":2,"content":"斷之。如景徳丁丑年正月初七日生，諸星各占　一宫，惟有火月一處是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1397,"lineType":9,"content":"論星聚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰聚作一宫安，相生相尅性不純。正坐四方言食禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"天涯地角必艱辛。五七星辰同一位，互相辭避難專事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"相生即是富豪家，相尅還憂貧困悴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075480110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1407,"lineType":2,"content":"諸星一宫聚，以五緯取次，必有相生相尅。書云：相生則富貴，相尅則貧困憂悴。此以序推之也。如木在先，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1409,"lineType":2,"content":"火次之，土又次之，是為相生。木為先，金次之，火又次之，是為相尅。若相生坐見月，即是富貴之人，卿相之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":1411,"lineType":2,"content":"命。若相尅更在天涯地角，必是艱辛，亦不至貧。如景徳丁未六月十八日生人，木金火土聚於獅子宫是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":1413,"lineType":2,"content":"也。然則星散者，五星六曜皆散；星聚者，止言五星，不言六曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":1415,"lineType":9,"content":"相生相尅歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"五緯相生與相尅，舉此二端為凖則。火土水土併水金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"此外餘殘鬬相賊。如此相生與相惡，交互變成一十數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"第一火土豐厚人，第二水土豐家户，第三金水多才藝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075496494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"第四火木空倉庫，第五水火破薄家，第六土木無男女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"第七木金孛計虚，第八水木孤寒聚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":1427,"lineType":2,"content":"一云水火相刑禦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"第九金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"火主驕淫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":1429,"lineType":2,"content":"一云金水土相刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"第十土金頻官府。止言同宫并對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"照，更值太陰福禍愈。二交叅錯生異端，強弱宫辰量力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1435,"lineType":9,"content":"論星辰換宫見月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"曽説換宫星照曜，素聞火土主豐盈。但看金水人才藝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"不久京華振大名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075512878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1443,"lineType":2,"content":"十二宫皆有五星，所主火土換宫正坐見月，富貴之命。金水換宫見月，巧妙技能之士。木水換宫見月，清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1445,"lineType":2,"content":"閑文藝之軰。水火換宫見月，薄技飄蓬之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1447,"lineType":9,"content":"論火土金木月相叅貴賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"火土要高金木叅，生來富貴世間談。若交火土與金木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤催殘實不堪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1453,"lineType":2,"content":"星主看尊𤰞有金木叅火土，火土叅金木，識其尊𤰞，方可論此。處髙為尊，處低為𤰞，居先為尊，居後為卑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1455,"lineType":2,"content":"火土居尊，金木居𤰞，則謂之金木叅火土，反此謂之火土叅金木，亦以見月為凖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1457,"lineType":9,"content":"日月朝天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075529262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"天門星斗互相迎，日在奎婁月次經。身命忽臨乾位上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"日朝月拱至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1465,"lineType":9,"content":"身命朝天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"身居寳瓶奎作命，中虚一位為天門。生時或逢寅子位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"官顯三公近至尊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1471,"lineType":9,"content":"朝天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"月到天心象帝王，或躔室璧或奎房。身命各號前後位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"定為將相近清光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075545646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1479,"lineType":9,"content":"主星入廟旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"主星入廟在生鄉，科甲官星㑹一方。更得主星三用滿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"少年作相入朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1485,"lineType":9,"content":"背陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"身命宫星前一位，太陽君象後先朝。一生休作調羮手，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"纔近清光壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1491,"lineType":9,"content":"月在強宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"強星四正各居高，月在強宫又不朝。一暗明星如從月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075562030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"為官災患壽難逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1499,"lineType":9,"content":"強曜犯月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"強曜須教犯月光，若逢月陷自乖張。有官減尅多閒曠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"庻俗財虚不積倉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1505,"lineType":9,"content":"強星從月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"強曜強星有數般，吉如不吉細推看。强星從月無柔弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"八座三台是貴官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1511,"lineType":9,"content":"強星近月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075578414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"強星若乃兼臨月，又要申宫子午高。更有權星居十位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"亦驚天地振英豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1519,"lineType":9,"content":"月居惡弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"月犯空閒居惡弱，定知父母早抛來。強星日月居閒地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"異母須知四五胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1525,"lineType":9,"content":"月㑹柔星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"三明一暗居男女，月共柔星剥戌辰。子息強宫交在照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"到頭一子總為親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075594798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"立命三強與二明，太陰交㑹照柔星。高文只是推鄉薦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"桂籍之中不與名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"月落柔星分度間，柔星高處善星閒。三方不照强星陷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"下賤之人處一班。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1541,"lineType":9,"content":"蝕神犯月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"南北宫中星不强，蝕神犯月戌辰方。胎方若要加金計，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病相纒主少亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1547,"lineType":9,"content":"柔星犯月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075611182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"若犯柔星兼禄主，常流百姓一生難。更逢忌曜兼刑煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"只是軍戎受歲寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"富而不貴看星位，盖有柔星犯太陰。若還四方逢火土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"滿堂盈富足資金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1559,"lineType":2,"content":"金木叅火土，不犯計孛水炁，必主富貴。須要二交孛火土當位也。若金木低，即成六悲不富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1561,"lineType":9,"content":"柔星照月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"强曜煌煌照八方，柔星照月少年亡。二交從月居低弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"終身困苦走他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075627566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1569,"lineType":9,"content":"水星捧月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"月到天門四海明，水居雙女一天清。月白水清天得地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"一星捧月誓横行。六壬水木官柔顯，金命之人富有成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1575,"lineType":9,"content":"金星捧月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"月生滄海耀金牛，太白相逢入趙州。科甲官星如廟旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"定知年少作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1581,"lineType":9,"content":"木孛捧月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星掌禄木同宫，捧月那堪向命宫。火水計羅官禄位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075643950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"少年鼎食至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"忽若相逢天蝎上，太陽不照恐無終。夾帶身居雙女位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星巨蟹作命宫。獅子位中多貴禄，此名夾貴富重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛命入逢土木，丁人合木火皆同。忽然一宿居其上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"拖紫腰金官顯榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1597,"lineType":9,"content":"水土入命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1599,"lineType":1,"content":"强星引從坐元胎，水土二星入命來。富貴榮華多財帛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"家豪金物積成堆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075660334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1605,"lineType":9,"content":"水土朝北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"身命二宫逢坎方，定應水土向南方。禄貴相逢朝北位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"少年濶歩上朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1611,"lineType":9,"content":"熒惑靣南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"北方熒惑木為殃，却喜生時背太陽。更加命臨獅子位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"定知年少禄軒昻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"陰人多陷紫金鄉，定是淫邪色慾娘。胎元若無善星助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"風塵歌舞近侯王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075807790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1773,"lineType":1,"content":"宫辰十二一周天，禍福依憑信是先。卯戌子宫言十四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"卯六乙八戌五，乾九癸五、子九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1797,"lineType":1,"content":"天地人三方，人居於中，晝夜運行，日自東出西入，故東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":1799,"lineType":1,"content":"西為之三主。寅夘辰為初主，已午未為中主，申酉戌為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1801,"lineType":1,"content":"未主，餘皆為身後之宫。天機大約與今之洞微、玄象、璧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":1803,"lineType":1,"content":"玉三限雖少異，而大意無殊，但以見生星辰所主，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1805,"lineType":1,"content":"元頭星，性氣斷之，災福可見。大約亦從卯上起，其數一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075840558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1809,"lineType":1,"content":"依上篇取定之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1811,"lineType":9,"content":"論元頭限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1813,"lineType":1,"content":"大限元頭要近身，却看辰已午星辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1815,"lineType":1,"content":"卓然火土相臨照，磊落文章冠縉紳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1817,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰為限弱同宫，　或然相望也為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"本命若還無根柢，　此限交之命必終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"木星為限金相望，刑水之星見月光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075856942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":1827,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄若無強曜助，其人要死在長江。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"金限相逢計與羅，　自然財散自消磨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"或然柔曜來相凑，　憔悴危亡怎奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"金星為限主傷財，　僧道之人尚有灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若木柔為小限，　自然疾困破家財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1837,"lineType":1,"content":"金木身命催限照，　可怕灾星四象臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"若不目盲終是夭，疾困孤寒不稱心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"行年如是金當限，限有元初金木見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075873326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"損財傷病又遭官，要好且須熒孛見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":1847,"lineType":1,"content":"何期短夭壽年厄，限內逢金入木時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"不要行年逢木限，限時身世且抛離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1851,"lineType":1,"content":"金星為限木星來，　此限交之必有灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"更有木陰相對望，器小無成惹禍媒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"金若為限㑹於木，　此限木交須命促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":1857,"lineType":1,"content":"貴者停官富者灾，　小人逢此遭刑獄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1859,"lineType":9,"content":"論火金限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618856346075889710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1863,"lineType":1,"content":"火星為限來相逐，　二交坐命半為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"或居大限及身宫，　淫色傷財主壽促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":1867,"lineType":1,"content":"金星為限火星侵，　斷定其人至死淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1869,"lineType":1,"content":"更被木星來會此，　定傷骨肉復傷心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"星學大成卷三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l2vck/1-SK1609_figure_00045.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tp7ZquP7NMBzm00akTGZ47kUogM%3D","pictureHeight":352,"pictureWidth":365,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l2vck/1-SK1609_figure_00045.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ahIalhkULw%2Fnd2SQz4rG%2B9K1zL0%3D","uri":"read/SK1609/5/ref/1m2n3dv4l2vck/1-SK1609_figure_00045.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
